```ts
// src/core/spectrum/emissions/tracker.ts
import {
	dutyFromEnvelope,
	envelopeAcf,
	obwAtDb,
	spectralShape,
} from "./spectral-features.js"
import type {
	ObservationEndReason,
	PipelineEvent,
	TrackFlags,
	TrackSnapshot,
	TuningTrust,
} from "../types.js"
import type { Segment } from "./segmenter.js"

/**
 * Per-epoch emission tracks (spec §4.2, §6.2): matches each block's segments to open tracks by bin
 * overlap, keeps a 1 ms envelope (first 1 s) for the TDMA features, accumulates the mean PSD for
 * OBW and shape, and closes tracks after a hang, on a new epoch, on a long gap or at maxTrackMs.
 */
export interface TrackerOptions {
	sourceId: string
	binHz: number
	blockMs: number
	hangBlocks: number
	maxTracks: number
	maxTrackBlocks: number
	idPrefix: string
}

export interface TrackerBlock {
	endSample: number
	powerDb: Float32Array
	floorDb: Float32Array
	blockFloorDb: number
	thresholdDb: number
	gap: boolean
	overload: boolean
}

interface EpochInfo {
	stream: number
	epoch: number
	centreHz: number
	tuningTrust: TuningTrust
}

const ENV_MAX_MS = 1000
const ACF_MIN_MS = 300
const SPEC_PAD_BINS = 2
const OBW_MIN_SNR_DB = 20
const MATCH_TOLERANCE_BINS = 1
const FIRST_UPDATE_BLOCKS = 2

class SpectrumAccumulator {
	lo = 0
	hi = 0
	private sum = new Float64Array(0)
	private count = new Uint32Array(0)

	add(powerDb: Float32Array, lo: number, hi: number): void {
		if (this.hi === this.lo) {
			this.lo = lo
			this.hi = hi
			this.sum = new Float64Array(hi - lo)
			this.count = new Uint32Array(hi - lo)
		} else if (lo < this.lo || hi > this.hi) {
			const nlo = Math.min(lo, this.lo)
			const nhi = Math.max(hi, this.hi)
			const sum = new Float64Array(nhi - nlo)
			const count = new Uint32Array(nhi - nlo)
			sum.set(this.sum, this.lo - nlo)
			count.set(this.count, this.lo - nlo)
			this.lo = nlo
			this.hi = nhi
			this.sum = sum
			this.count = count
		}
		for (let i = lo; i < hi; i++) {
			const j = i - this.lo
			this.sum[j] = (this.sum[j] ?? 0) + 10 ** ((powerDb[i] ?? -200) / 10)
			this.count[j] = (this.count[j] ?? 0) + 1
		}
	}

	/** Mean PSD in dB over the window; index 0 is bin `lo`. */
	meanDb(): Float32Array {
		const out = new Float32Array(this.hi - this.lo)
		for (let j = 0; j < out.length; j++) {
			const c = this.count[j] ?? 0
			out[j] = c > 0 ? 10 * Math.log10(Math.max((this.sum[j] ?? 0) / c, 1e-20)) : -200
		}
		return out
	}
}

interface Features {
	acf30?: number
	acf60?: number
	duty: number | null
}

interface OpenTrack {
	id: string
	epoch: EpochInfo
	openedAtBlock: number
	lastOnBlock: number
	startSample: number
	lastSample: number
	startBin: number
	endBin: number
	lastSeg: Segment
	onMin: number
	onMax: number
	maxWidthBins: number
	blocks: number
	misses: number
	peakDbfs: number
	maxBlockSnrDb: number
	bandLinSum: number
	floorLinSum: number
	floorDbSum: number
	centroidNum: number
	centroidDen: number
	thresholdDb: number
	spectrum: SpectrumAccumulator
	env: Float32Array
	envLen: number
	envOrigin: number
	envBucket: number
	envSum: number
	envFrames: number
	frozen: Features | null
	flags: TrackFlags
	flagsChanged: boolean
	justOpened: boolean
}

export class Tracker {
	private open: OpenTrack[] = []
	private seq = 0
	private blockNo = 0
	private n = 0 // fft size, learned from the first frame or block
	private epoch: EpochInfo = { stream: 0, epoch: 0, centreHz: 0, tuningTrust: "unverified" }
	private readonly updateEvery: number

	constructor(private readonly opts: TrackerOptions) {
		this.updateEvery = Math.max(1, Math.round(1000 / opts.blockMs))
	}

	get openCount(): number {
		return this.open.length
	}

	beginEpoch(e: { stream: number; epoch: number; centreHz: number; tuningTrust: TuningTrust }): PipelineEvent[] {
		const events = this.closeAll("retune")
		this.epoch = { ...e }
		return events
	}

	frame(framePowerDb: Float32Array, sample: number): void {
		this.n = framePowerDb.length
		const samplesPerMs = (this.opts.binHz * framePowerDb.length) / 1000
		for (const t of this.open) {
			if (t.frozen) continue
			let sum = 0
			for (let i = t.startBin; i < t.endBin; i++) sum += 10 ** ((framePowerDb[i] ?? -200) / 10)
			if (t.envOrigin < 0) t.envOrigin = sample
			const bucket = Math.floor((sample - t.envOrigin) / samplesPerMs)
			if (bucket !== t.envBucket) this.flushEnvelope(t, bucket)
			if (t.frozen) continue
			t.envSum += sum
			t.envFrames++
		}
	}

	block(segments: Segment[], b: TrackerBlock): PipelineEvent[] {
		this.blockNo++
		this.n = b.floorDb.length
		const n = b.floorDb.length
		const blockSamples = Math.round((this.opts.blockMs * this.opts.binHz * n) / 1000)
		const events: PipelineEvent[] = []
		const matched = new Set<OpenTrack>()
		const order = segments.map((_, i) => i).sort((x, y) => (segments[y]?.peakDb ?? 0) - (segments[x]?.peakDb ?? 0))
		for (const idx of order) {
			const s = segments[idx]
			if (s === undefined) continue
			const t = this.bestMatch(s, matched)
			if (t) {
				matched.add(t)
				this.extend(t, s, b, n)
				continue
			}
			if (b.gap) continue
			if (s.flags.truncated || this.open.length >= this.opts.maxTracks) {
				events.push({ kind: "transient", centreHz: this.rf(s.centroidBin, n), epoch: this.epoch.epoch, sample: b.endSample - blockSamples })
				continue
			}
			const nt = this.openTrack(s, b, n, blockSamples)
			matched.add(nt)
			events.push({ kind: "track-open", track: this.snapshot(nt, n) })
		}
		for (const t of [...this.open]) {
			if (matched.has(t)) continue
			t.misses++
			if (t.misses >= this.opts.hangBlocks) events.push(this.close(t, b.gap ? "gap" : "quiet", n))
		}
		for (const t of matched) {
			if (t.justOpened) {
				t.justOpened = false
				continue
			}
			if (this.blockNo - t.openedAtBlock + 1 >= this.opts.maxTrackBlocks) {
				const seg = t.lastSeg
				events.push(this.close(t, "max-duration", n))
				const nt = this.openTrack(seg, b, n, blockSamples)
				nt.justOpened = false
				events.push({ kind: "track-open", track: this.snapshot(nt, n) })
				continue
			}
			if (t.blocks === FIRST_UPDATE_BLOCKS || t.blocks % this.updateEvery === 0 || t.flagsChanged) {
				t.flagsChanged = false
				events.push({ kind: "track-update", track: this.snapshot(t, n) })
			}
		}
		return events
	}

	closeAll(reason: ObservationEndReason): PipelineEvent[] {
		const events: PipelineEvent[] = []
		for (const t of [...this.open]) events.push(this.close(t, reason, this.n))
		return events
	}

	/** Sets 1 on the current bins of open tracks with ≥ minBlocks on-blocks that were on in the last block. */
	trackBinsMask(out: Uint8Array, minBlocks: number): void {
		out.fill(0)
		for (const t of this.open) {
			if (t.blocks < minBlocks || t.misses > 0) continue
			for (let i = t.startBin; i < t.endBin; i++) out[i] = 1
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Raises the sticky `spur` flag (spec § 4.9, Task 7a) on open tracks whose current bins all lie on
	 * a spur line and returns their updates. Their segments are dropped from now on, so they close after the hang.
	 */
	flagSpurs(lineMask: Uint8Array): PipelineEvent[] {
		const events: PipelineEvent[] = []
		for (const t of this.open) {
			if (t.flags.spur || t.endBin <= t.startBin) continue
			let inside = true
			for (let i = t.startBin; i < t.endBin && inside; i++) inside = lineMask[i] === 1
			if (!inside) continue
			t.flags.spur = true
			events.push({ kind: "track-update", track: this.snapshot(t, this.n) })
		}
		return events
	}

	private bestMatch(s: Segment, taken: ReadonlySet<OpenTrack>): OpenTrack | undefined {
		let best: OpenTrack | undefined
		let bestOverlap = 0
		for (const t of this.open) {
			if (taken.has(t)) continue
			const overlap =
				Math.min(s.endBin + MATCH_TOLERANCE_BINS, t.endBin) - Math.max(s.startBin - MATCH_TOLERANCE_BINS, t.startBin)
			if (overlap > bestOverlap) {
				bestOverlap = overlap
				best = t
			}
		}
		return best
	}

	private openTrack(s: Segment, b: TrackerBlock, n: number, blockSamples: number): OpenTrack {
		const t: OpenTrack = {
			id: `${this.opts.idPrefix}${(++this.seq).toString(36)}`,
			epoch: { ...this.epoch },
			openedAtBlock: this.blockNo,
			lastOnBlock: this.blockNo,
			startSample: b.endSample - blockSamples,
			lastSample: b.endSample,
			startBin: s.startBin,
			endBin: s.endBin,
			lastSeg: s,
			onMin: s.startBin,
			onMax: s.endBin,
			maxWidthBins: 0,
			blocks: 0,
			misses: 0,
			peakDbfs: -Infinity,
			maxBlockSnrDb: -Infinity,
			bandLinSum: 0,
			floorLinSum: 0,
			floorDbSum: 0,
			centroidNum: 0,
			centroidDen: 0,
			thresholdDb: b.thresholdDb,
			spectrum: new SpectrumAccumulator(),
			env: new Float32Array(ENV_MAX_MS),
			envLen: 0,
			envOrigin: -1,
			envBucket: 0,
			envSum: 0,
			envFrames: 0,
			frozen: null,
			flags: { overload: false, gap: false, truncated: false, edge: false, skirt: false, obwBiased: false, spur: false },
			flagsChanged: false,
			justOpened: true,
		}
		this.open.push(t)
		this.extend(t, s, b, n)
		t.flagsChanged = false
		return t
	}

	private extend(t: OpenTrack, s: Segment, b: TrackerBlock, n: number): void {
		t.startBin = s.startBin
		t.endBin = s.endBin
		t.lastSeg = s
		t.blocks++
		t.misses = 0
		t.lastOnBlock = this.blockNo
		t.lastSample = b.endSample
		t.thresholdDb = b.thresholdDb
		let band = 0
		let floor = 0
		let maxSnr = -Infinity
		for (let i = s.startBin; i < s.endBin; i++) {
			const p = b.powerDb[i] ?? -200
			const f = b.floorDb[i] ?? -200
			band += 10 ** (p / 10)
			floor += 10 ** (f / 10)
			maxSnr = Math.max(maxSnr, p - f)
		}
		t.bandLinSum += band
		t.floorLinSum += floor
		t.floorDbSum += b.blockFloorDb
		t.peakDbfs = Math.max(t.peakDbfs, s.peakDb)
		t.maxBlockSnrDb = Math.max(t.maxBlockSnrDb, maxSnr)
		const weight = Math.max(band - floor, 1e-30)
		t.centroidNum += s.centroidBin * weight
		t.centroidDen += weight
		t.onMin = Math.min(t.onMin, s.startBin)
		t.onMax = Math.max(t.onMax, s.endBin)
		t.maxWidthBins = Math.max(t.maxWidthBins, s.endBin - s.startBin)
		t.spectrum.add(b.powerDb, Math.max(0, s.startBin - SPEC_PAD_BINS), Math.min(n, s.endBin + SPEC_PAD_BINS))
		this.raise(t, "overload", b.overload)
		this.raise(t, "gap", b.gap)
		this.raise(t, "truncated", s.flags.truncated)
		this.raise(t, "edge", s.flags.edge)
		this.raise(t, "skirt", s.flags.skirt)
	}

	private raise(t: OpenTrack, flag: keyof TrackFlags, value: boolean): void {
		if (!value || t.flags[flag]) return
		t.flags[flag] = true
		t.flagsChanged = true
	}

	private flushEnvelope(t: OpenTrack, nextBucket: number): void {
		if (t.envFrames > 0) {
			const value = t.envSum / t.envFrames
			const until = Math.min(Math.max(nextBucket, t.envLen + 1), ENV_MAX_MS)
			for (let i = t.envLen; i < until; i++) t.env[i] = value
			t.envLen = until
			if (t.envLen >= ENV_MAX_MS) t.frozen = this.features(t)
		}
		t.envSum = 0
		t.envFrames = 0
		t.envBucket = nextBucket
	}

	private features(t: OpenTrack): Features {
		if (t.frozen) return t.frozen
		const env = t.env.subarray(0, t.envLen)
		const f: Features = { duty: dutyFromEnvelope(env) }
		if (t.envLen >= ACF_MIN_MS) {
			f.acf30 = envelopeAcf(env, 30)
			f.acf60 = envelopeAcf(env, 60)
		}
		return f
	}

	private rf(bin: number, n: number): number {
		return this.epoch.centreHz + (bin - n / 2) * this.opts.binHz
	}

	private close(t: OpenTrack, reason: ObservationEndReason, n: number): PipelineEvent {
		this.open = this.open.filter(o => o !== t)
		return { kind: "track-close", track: this.snapshot(t, n), endReason: reason }
	}

	private snapshot(t: OpenTrack, n: number): TrackSnapshot {
		const binHz = this.opts.binHz
		const centroid = t.centroidDen > 0 ? t.centroidNum / t.centroidDen : (t.startBin + t.endBin - 1) / 2
		const mean = t.spectrum.meanDb()
		const a = Math.max(0, t.onMin - 1 - t.spectrum.lo)
		const e = Math.min(mean.length, t.onMax + 1 - t.spectrum.lo)
		const useDb = t.maxBlockSnrDb >= OBW_MIN_SNR_DB
		const f = this.features(t)
		const blocks = Math.max(1, t.blocks)
		const bandMean = t.bandLinSum / blocks
		const floorMean = t.floorLinSum / blocks
		const snap: TrackSnapshot = {
			trackId: t.id,
			sourceId: this.opts.sourceId,
			stream: t.epoch.stream,
			epoch: t.epoch.epoch,
			startSample: t.startSample,
			lastSample: t.lastSample,
			centreHz: t.epoch.centreHz + (centroid - n / 2) * binHz,
			obwHz: useDb ? obwAtDb(mean, a, e, binHz, 20) : t.maxWidthBins * binHz,
			obwMethod: useDb ? "-20dB" : "on-bins",
			peakDbfs: t.peakDbfs,
			meanDbfs: 10 * Math.log10(Math.max(bandMean, 1e-30)),
			snrDb: 10 * Math.log10(Math.max(bandMean - floorMean, 1e-30) / Math.max(floorMean, 1e-30)),
			floorDbfs: t.floorDbSum / blocks,
			thresholdDb: t.thresholdDb,
			blocks: t.blocks,
			maxBlockSnrDb: t.maxBlockSnrDb,
			dutyCycle: f.duty ?? t.blocks / Math.max(1, t.lastOnBlock - t.openedAtBlock + 1),
			spectralShape: spectralShape(mean, a, e, binHz),
			flags: { ...t.flags },
			tuningTrust: t.epoch.tuningTrust,
		}
		if (f.acf30 !== undefined) snap.acf30 = f.acf30
		if (f.acf60 !== undefined) snap.acf60 = f.acf60
		return snap
	}
}
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/pipeline-harness.ts
import { SpectrumPipeline } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/pipeline.js"
import type {
	FreqRange,
	PendingEpoch,
	PipelineConfig,
	PipelineEvent,
	PipelineInput,
	Raster,
	TrackSnapshot,
} from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"
import { packCu8, packF32 } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import type { Iq } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"

export const FS = 256_000
export const N = 256
export const BIN_HZ = FS / N
export const BLOCK = 12_800 // 50 frames of 256 at T = 50 ms
export const CENTRE = 446_100_000

export function pipelineConfig(over: Partial<PipelineConfig> = {}): PipelineConfig {
	return {
		sourceId: "s1",
		format: "U8_IQ",
		sampleRateHz: FS,
		fftSize: N,
		integrationMs: 50,
		usableFraction: 0.8,
		dcGuardHz: 1500,
		ppmMargin: 2,
		hysteresisDb: 3,
		clipFraction: 1e-3,
		minSurfaceBlocks: 2,
		thresholdDb: null,
		faTargetPerMhzMin: 1,
		spectrumBins: 512,
		trackHangMs: 500,
		maxTracks: 512,
		maxTrackMs: 120_000,
		...over,
	}
}

type EventOf<K extends PipelineEvent["kind"]> = Extract<PipelineEvent, { kind: K }>

/** Drives a SpectrumPipeline with absolute sample indices, like the engine (Task 32) does. */
export class Harness {
	readonly events: PipelineEvent[] = []
	readonly pipeline: SpectrumPipeline
	readonly config: PipelineConfig
	sample = 0
	private readonly bps: number

	constructor(over: Partial<PipelineConfig> = {}, deps: { provisionalWindowMs?: number } = {}) {
		this.config = pipelineConfig(over)
		this.pipeline = new SpectrumPipeline(this.config, { now: () => 0, ...deps })
		this.bps = this.config.format === "U8_IQ" ? 2 : this.config.format === "S16_IQ" ? 4 : 8
	}

	send(input: PipelineInput): PipelineEvent[] {
		const ev = this.pipeline.handle(input)
		this.events.push(...ev)
		return ev
	}

	start(opts: { centreHz?: number; feed?: boolean; inWindow?: boolean; rasters?: Raster[]; exclusions?: FreqRange[] } = {}): void {
		this.sample = 0
		this.send({
			kind: "masks",
			exclusions: opts.exclusions ?? [],
			cfarRanges: [],
			burstRanges: [],
			rasters: opts.rasters ?? [],
			obwHz: [],
			inWindow: opts.inWindow ?? true,
		})
		this.send({ kind: "spectrum-feed", enabled: opts.feed ?? true })
		this.send({ kind: "new-stream", stream: 1, centreHz: opts.centreHz ?? CENTRE, sampleRateHz: FS, gainKey: "m:496", tuningTrust: "commanded" })
	}

	push(iq: Iq, chunkSamples = 4096): void {
		const bytes = this.config.format === "U8_IQ" ? packCu8(iq.re, iq.im) : packF32(iq.re, iq.im)
		this.pushBytes(bytes, chunkSamples)
	}

	pushBytes(bytes: Uint8Array, chunkSamples = 4096): void {
		const step = chunkSamples * this.bps
		for (let off = 0; off < bytes.length; off += step) {
			const part = bytes.subarray(off, Math.min(bytes.length, off + step))
			this.send({ kind: "bytes", startSample: this.sample, bytes: part })
			this.sample += part.length / this.bps
		}
	}

	gap(samples: number): void {
		this.send({ kind: "gap", startSample: this.sample, samples })
		this.sample += samples
	}

	pending(over: Partial<PendingEpoch> & { centreHz: number }): void {
		this.send({
			kind: "pending-epoch",
			pending: {
				epoch: 0,
				commandSample: this.sample,
				bufferedSamples: 0,
				settleSamples: 0,
				expectMarker: false,
				markerTimeoutSamples: 2 * FS,
				pllSettleSamples: 0,
				sampleRateHz: FS,
				gainKey: "m:496",
				tuningTrust: "commanded",
				centreChanged: true,
				...over,
			},
		})
	}

	of<K extends PipelineEvent["kind"]>(kind: K): EventOf<K>[] {
		return this.events.filter((e): e is EventOf<K> => e.kind === kind)
	}

	tracks(): TrackSnapshot[] {
		return this.events.flatMap(e =>
			e.kind === "track-open" || e.kind === "track-update" || e.kind === "track-close" ? [e.track] : [],
		)
	}
}
```

```ts
		const far = h.tracks().filter(t => Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + 40_000)) < 3000)

		expect(near.every(t => t.flags.obwBiased)).toBe(true)
		expect(far.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
		expect(far.every(t => !t.flags.obwBiased)).toBe(true)
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/pipeline-p6.test.ts
import fc from "fast-check"
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { addInto, counterRun, gaussianNoise, mulberry32, tone } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import { BLOCK, CENTRE, FS, Harness, N } from "./pipeline-harness.js"

const SIGMA = 0.05
const POISON_HZ = 30_000 // baseband offset of a loud tone in samples that must never be used
const PLL = 1280

const stepArb = fc.record({
	kind: fc.constantFrom("marker", "timer", "gap"),
	lead: fc.integer({ min: BLOCK, max: 3 * BLOCK }),
	chunk: fc.integer({ min: 64, max: 6000 }),
	stale: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 2 * BLOCK }),
	settle: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 2 * BLOCK }),
	run: fc.integer({ min: 128, max: 2000 }),
	gap: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 3 * BLOCK }),
	startByte: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 255 }),
})

describe("SpectrumPipeline epochs and gaps", () => {
	it("never lets pre-settle, counter-run or gap samples into a block and keeps indices absolute", () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 6: Epoch and gap accounting
		// Validates: spec § 4.1, § 4.6
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 0x7fffffff }), fc.array(stepArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 4 }), (seed, steps) => {
				const rng = mulberry32(seed)
				const h = new Harness()
				h.start({ inWindow: false })
				let centre = CENTRE
				const expected: { command: number; start: number; marker: boolean; centre: number }[] = []
				const poison = (n: number) => addInto(gaussianNoise(rng, n, SIGMA), tone(n, FS, POISON_HZ, 0.4))
				for (const s of steps) {
					h.push(gaussianNoise(rng, s.lead, SIGMA), s.chunk)
					if (s.kind === "gap") {
						h.gap(s.gap)
						continue
					}
					const command = h.sample
					centre += 500_000
					if (s.kind === "timer") {
						h.pending({ centreHz: centre, bufferedSamples: s.stale, settleSamples: s.settle })
						if (s.stale + s.settle > 0) h.push(poison(s.stale + s.settle), s.chunk)
						expected.push({ command, start: command + s.stale + s.settle, marker: false, centre })
					} else {
						h.pending({ centreHz: centre, expectMarker: true, markerTimeoutSamples: 10 * BLOCK, pllSettleSamples: PLL })
						if (s.stale > 0) h.push(poison(s.stale), s.chunk)
						h.pushBytes(counterRun(2 * s.run, s.startByte), s.chunk)
						h.push(poison(PLL), s.chunk)
						expected.push({ command, start: command + s.stale + s.run + PLL, marker: true, centre })
					}
				}
				h.push(gaussianNoise(rng, 3 * BLOCK, SIGMA), 4096)

				const started = h.of("epoch-started")
				expect(started).toHaveLength(expected.length + 1)
				expected.forEach((x, i) => {
					const st = started[i + 1]!
					expect(st.settleMode).toBe(x.marker ? "marker" : "timer")
					expect(st.startSample).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(x.start)
					expect(st.startSample).toBeLessThanOrEqual(x.start + (x.marker ? 1 : 0))
				})
				const startOf = new Map(started.map(e => [e.epoch, e.startSample]))
				const commandAfter = new Map(started.map((e, i) => [e.epoch, expected[i]?.command ?? Infinity]))
				const centreOf = new Map(started.map((e, i) => [e.epoch, i === 0 ? CENTRE : (expected[i - 1]?.centre ?? 0)]))
				const poisonIndex = POISON_HZ / (FS / N) + N / 2 - 26 // decimation 1 at spectrumBins 512
				for (const { summary } of h.of("block-summary")) {
					const s0 = startOf.get(summary.epoch)
					expect(s0).toBeDefined()
					expect(summary.stream).toBe(1)
					expect((summary.endSample - (s0 ?? 0)) % BLOCK).toBe(0)
					expect(summary.endSample - BLOCK).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(s0 ?? 0)
					expect(summary.endSample).toBeLessThanOrEqual(commandAfter.get(summary.epoch) ?? Infinity)
					expect(summary.centreHz).toBe(centreOf.get(summary.epoch))
					expect(summary.bins[poisonIndex]! - summary.floorDbfs).toBeLessThan(15)
				}
				for (const t of h.tracks()) {
					const c = centreOf.get(t.epoch) ?? 0
					expect(Math.abs(t.centreHz - (c + POISON_HZ))).toBeGreaterThan(3000)
				}
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	}, 60_000) // 8–26 s on a loaded Mac once Task 7a's per-frame work is wired
})
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/pipeline-p4.test.ts
import fc from "fast-check"
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import {
	addInto,
	fsk4Burst,
	gaussianNoise,
	heavyTailedNoise,
	mulberry32,
	narrowbandPsd,
	obwBelowPeakHz,
	tone,
} from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import type { Iq } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import { CENTRE, FS, Harness } from "./pipeline-harness.js"

const SIGMA = 0.01
const RBW = 1000
const LEAD = Math.round(0.1 * FS)
const SIGNAL = Math.round(0.5 * FS)
const TOTAL = Math.round(1.2 * FS)

/** Amplitude whose power over the noise in 12.5 kHz equals `snrDb`. */
function ampFor(snrDb: number): number {
	return Math.sqrt(10 ** (snrDb / 10) * SIGMA * SIGMA * (12_500 / FS))
}
const offsetArb = fc
	.tuple(fc.boolean(), fc.integer({ min: 150, max: 800 }))
	.map(([neg, h]) => (neg ? -1 : 1) * h * 100)

/** A macrotask boundary: minutes of synchronous DSP would otherwise starve vitest's worker RPC ("Timeout calling onTaskUpdate"). */
const yieldToRpc = (): Promise<void> => new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve))

function runWith(seed: number, signal: Iq): Harness {
	const rng = mulberry32(seed)
	const iq = gaussianNoise(rng, TOTAL, SIGMA)
	addInto(iq, signal, LEAD)
	const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE" })
	h.start({ feed: false })
	h.push(iq, 8192)
	return h
}

describe("detector on synthetic signals", () => {
	beforeEach(yieldToRpc)

	it("opens a track within 1 RBW of a tone at SNR ≥ 3 dB", () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 4: Detector on synthetic signals
		// Validates: spec § 4.5, § 7.2
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 0x7fffffff }), fc.integer({ min: 3, max: 25 }), offsetArb, (seed, snr, offset) => {
				const h = runWith(seed, tone(SIGNAL, FS, offset, ampFor(snr)))
				const hits = h.tracks().filter(t => Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + offset)) <= RBW)
				expect(hits.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100, seed: 4_001 }, // fixed (spec § 13): 3 dB sits on the statistical boundary
		)
	}, 120_000)

	it("opens a track within 2 RBW of a 9 kHz 4FSK burst at SNR ≥ 3 dB", () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 4: Detector on synthetic signals
		// Validates: spec § 4.5, § 7.2
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 0x7fffffff }), fc.integer({ min: 3, max: 25 }), offsetArb, (seed, snr, offset) => {
				const sig = fsk4Burst(mulberry32(seed ^ 0x5a5a), SIGNAL, FS, offset, ampFor(snr))
				const h = runWith(seed, sig)
				const hits = h.tracks().filter(t => Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + offset)) <= 2 * RBW)
				expect(hits.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100, seed: 4_002 },
		)
	}, 120_000)

	it("measures the −20 dB OBW of a 4FSK burst within ±25 % at SNR ≥ 30 dB", async () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 4: Detector on synthetic signals
		// Validates: spec § 4.5, § 6.2
		// async with a yield per run: this property alone takes 19–48 s on the loaded Mac
		await fc.assert(
			fc.asyncProperty(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 0x7fffffff }), fc.integer({ min: 30, max: 45 }), offsetArb, async (seed, snr, offset) => {
				await yieldToRpc()
				const sig = fsk4Burst(mulberry32(seed ^ 0x5a5a), SIGNAL, FS, offset, ampFor(snr))
				const truth = obwBelowPeakHz(narrowbandPsd(sig, FS, offset, { decimation: 4, nfft: 512 }), 20)
				const h = runWith(seed, sig)
				// the burst's last block can leave a 1-block, 1 kHz fragment near the centre; P4 is about the emission's track
				const closed = h
					.of("track-close")
					.filter(c => Math.abs(c.track.centreHz - (CENTRE + offset)) <= 2 * RBW && c.track.blocks >= h.config.minSurfaceBlocks)
				expect(closed).toHaveLength(1)
				const t = closed[0]!.track
				expect(t.obwMethod).toBe("-20dB")
				expect(Math.abs(t.obwHz - truth)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.25 * truth)
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100, seed: 4_003, examples: [[28, 30, -66_000]] }, // the example once left a second, 1-block fragment
		)
	}, 120_000)

	function heavyTail(seed: number, eventsPerMhzMin: number): Harness {
		const rng = mulberry32(seed)
		const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE" })
		h.start({ feed: false })
		for (let s = 0; s < 60; s++) {
			const iq = heavyTailedNoise(rng, FS, SIGMA, { fs: FS, eventsPerMhzSec: eventsPerMhzMin / 60, excessDb: 13, eventMs: 5 })
			h.push(iq, 16_384)
		}
		return h
	}

	it.each([1, 2, 3])("never builds a surfacing-length track from calibrated heavy-tailed noise in 60 s (seed %i)", seed => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 4: Detector on synthetic signals
		// Validates: spec § 4.5, § 7.2
		const h = heavyTail(seed, 1)
		expect(h.tracks().filter(t => t.blocks >= h.config.minSurfaceBlocks)).toEqual([])
	}, 60_000)

	it("sees the heavy-tail events as single-block edges when they are 60× more frequent", () => {
		const h = heavyTail(4, 60)
		const opened = h.of("track-open").length
		// most events split across two blocks and stay below k; at this seed 2 cross it (measured on the Task 10 code)
		expect(opened).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)
		const long = h.tracks().filter(t => t.blocks >= h.config.minSurfaceBlocks).length
		expect(long / opened).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.1)
	}, 60_000)
})
```

The heavy-tail model (Task 2) adds Poisson 5 ms narrowband complex-Gaussian events at `excessDb` 13 over the noise in 1 kHz: a whole event lifts its 50 ms block by ≈ 4.8 dB (above the table k 4.0), and no split of one event lifts both neighbouring blocks above k, so the calibrated rate (1 event/MHz/min ≈ 1 noise edge/MHz/min) yields single-block edges only. The 60× run proves the events do cross k.

- [ ] **Step 8a: Write the failing artefact-rejection pipeline tests (P23, P24 end to end)**

These drive Task 7a's blanker, provisional lines and `artefactOf` through the pipeline. They feed FLOAT32LE (no quantisation; the impulses stay far below clipping) and read a shared seeded noise pool at a random offset, and P24 injects a 3 s provisional-line window (`Harness` deps → `SpectrumPipeline` `provisionalWindowMs`; the 30 s default is covered by Task 7a's module half), so a P24 run (4.5 s of samples, streamed in 0.5 s chunks) costs about 0.3 s and the file about 40 s on this Mac (P23 ≈ 11 s, P24 ≈ 29 s); both properties are async and yield once per run so vitest's worker RPC stays responsive.

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/pipeline-artefacts.test.ts
import fc from "fast-check"
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { artefactOf } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/artefacts.js"
import type { EngineState, PipelineConfig, TrackSnapshot } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"
import { addInto, fsk4Burst, gaussianNoise, impulseTrain, mulberry32, toneComb, zerosIq } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import type { Iq } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import { BIN_HZ, BLOCK, CENTRE, FS, Harness, N } from "./pipeline-harness.js"

const KEY = `${FS}:m:496:${N}`
const SIGMA = 0.005
const NOISE_BIN_POWER = (SIGMA * SIGMA * 1.5) / N // tone-calibrated per-bin noise power (Task 3 note)
const POOL_SIZE = 1 << 20
/** P24: the injected provisional-line window (the pipeline default is 30 s). */
const WINDOW_MS = 3_000
const POOL = gaussianNoise(mulberry32(20261010), POOL_SIZE, SIGMA)

function noiseAt(offset: number, n: number): Iq {
	const out = zerosIq(n)
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		const j = (offset + i) % POOL_SIZE
		out.re[i] = POOL.re[j] ?? 0
		out.im[i] = POOL.im[j] ?? 0
	}
	return out
}

/** A macrotask boundary per run: minutes of synchronous DSP would otherwise starve vitest's worker RPC. */
const yieldToRpc = (): Promise<void> => new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve))

/** Amplitude of a bin-centred tone (or one impulse tone) at `perBinSnrDb` over the per-bin noise. */
const toneAmp = (perBinSnrDb: number): number => Math.sqrt(NOISE_BIN_POWER * 10 ** (perBinSnrDb / 10))

function run(iq: Iq, over: Partial<PipelineConfig> = {}): Harness {
	const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE", ...over })
	h.start()
	h.push(iq, 16_384)
	return h
}

/** Mean effective block floor after the first 0.5 s. */
function meanFloor(h: Harness): number {
	const floors = h
		.of("block-summary")
		.filter(e => e.summary.endSample > FS / 2)
		.map(e => e.summary.floorDbfs)
	return floors.reduce((s, f) => s + f, 0) / floors.length
}

/** The last snapshot of every track. */
function lastSnapshots(h: Harness): TrackSnapshot[] {
	const last = new Map<string, TrackSnapshot>()
	for (const t of h.tracks()) last.set(t.trackId, t)
	return [...last.values()]
}

describe("SpectrumPipeline artefact rejection", () => {
	it("blanks periodic broadband impulses: no track, floor lift ≤ 0.5 dB, period reported", async () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 23: Impulse blanking
		// Validates: spec § 4.9
		const n = 2 * FS
		await fc.assert(
			fc.asyncProperty(
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: POOL_SIZE - 1 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 25_599 }), // impulse phase in samples, not frame-aligned
				fc.double({ min: 20, max: 26, noNaN: true }),
				fc.double({ min: 0.9, max: 1, noNaN: true }),
				fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 2 ** 31 - 1 }),
				async (offset, phase, excessDb, fraction, seed) => {
					await yieldToRpc()
					const noise = noiseAt(offset, n)
					const clean = run(noise)
					const impulses = impulseTrain(mulberry32(seed), n, FS, {
						periodMs: 100,
						widthMs: 2,
						toneSpacingHz: BIN_HZ,
						occupiedFraction: fraction,
						toneAmp: toneAmp(excessDb),
						phaseMs: (phase * 1000) / FS,
					})
					const dirty = run(addInto(impulses, noise))
					expect(dirty.of("track-open")).toEqual([])
					expect(meanFloor(dirty) - meanFloor(clean)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.5)
					const masks = dirty.pipeline.artefactMasks()
					expect(masks.rfi.active).toBe(true)
					expect(Math.abs((masks.rfi.periodMs ?? 0) - 100)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10)
					expect(masks.rfi.blankedFrames).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(19) // ≥ 1 whole frame per 2 ms impulse
					expect(artefactOf(CENTRE + 30_000, masks.epoch, masks)).toBe("rfi")
				},
			),
			{ numRuns: 100, seed: 23 },
		)
	}, 180_000)

	it("masks a 7-tooth comb within one line window of settled data (30 s by default) while a real 9 kHz emission between teeth is still detected", async () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 24: Comb masking
		// Validates: spec § 4.9
		// The line window is injected at 3 s (default PROVISIONAL_WINDOW_MS = 30 s, covered by Task 7a's module
		// half): the same 0.1 s masking margin, at a tenth of the simulated time.
		const total = ((WINDOW_MS + 1500) * FS) / 1000
		const emitFrom = ((WINDOW_MS + 500) * FS) / 1000
		const maskedBy = ((WINDOW_MS + 100) * FS) / 1000
		await fc.assert(
			fc.asyncProperty(
				fc.integer({ min: 20, max: 26 }), // tooth spacing in bins (kHz)
				fc.double({ min: 0, max: 1, noNaN: true }), // comb position around DC
				fc.double({ min: -0.3, max: 0.3, noNaN: true }), // common sub-bin offset of the teeth
				fc.double({ min: 15, max: 26, noNaN: true }), // tooth per-bin SNR
				fc.constantFrom(0, 1, 4, 5), // the gap that holds the emission (DC sits in gap 2)
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: POOL_SIZE - 1 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 2 ** 31 - 1 }),
				async (d, pos, frac, snr, gap, offset, seed) => {
					await yieldToRpc()
					const u = 5 + Math.round(pos * (Math.min(d - 5, 100 - 3 * d) - 5))
					const toothBins = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, k) => N / 2 + (k - 3) * d + u)
					const teethHz = toothBins.map(b => (b - N / 2 + frac) * BIN_HZ)
					const amps = teethHz.map(() => toneAmp(snr))
					const emissionHz = ((toothBins[gap] ?? 0) + d / 2 - N / 2) * BIN_HZ
					const emissionAmp = Math.sqrt((SIGMA * SIGMA * 12_500 * 100) / FS) // 20 dB in 12.5 kHz (Task 2 SNR convention)
					const emission = fsk4Burst(mulberry32(seed), total - emitFrom, FS, emissionHz, emissionAmp)
					const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE" }, { provisionalWindowMs: WINDOW_MS })
					h.start()
					for (let at = 0; at < total; at += FS / 2) {
						const len = Math.min(FS / 2, total - at)
						const iq = addInto(noiseAt(offset + at, len), toneComb(len, FS, teethHz, amps, at))
						if (at + len > emitFrom) addInto(iq, emission, emitFrom - at)
						h.push(iq, 16_384)
					}
					const tracks = lastSnapshots(h)
					const onTooth = (t: TrackSnapshot): boolean => teethHz.some(hz => Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + hz)) <= 2 * BIN_HZ)
					const teeth = tracks.filter(onTooth)
					expect(teeth.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(7)
					expect(teeth.every(t => t.flags.spur)).toBe(true)
					// the bound itself: the first snapshot that carries `spur` ends no later than one line window (+ 0.1 s)
					for (const t of teeth) {
						const firstSpur = h.tracks().find(s => s.trackId === t.trackId && s.flags.spur)
						expect(firstSpur?.lastSample ?? Infinity).toBeLessThanOrEqual(maskedBy)
					}
					const found = tracks.filter(
						t => !t.flags.spur && t.startSample >= emitFrom - BLOCK && Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + emissionHz)) <= 2 * BIN_HZ,
					)
					expect(found.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
					const masks = h.pipeline.artefactMasks()
					expect(masks.spurs.filter(s => s.origin === "comb")).toHaveLength(7)
					for (const hz of teethHz) expect(artefactOf(CENTRE + hz, masks.epoch, masks)).toBe("spur")
					expect(artefactOf(CENTRE + emissionHz, masks.epoch, masks)).toBeNull()
				},
			),
			{ numRuns: 100, seed: 24 },
		)
	}, 120_000)

	it("starts masked after a restart: persisted comb lines drop their segments from the first block", () => {
		const toothBins = [70, 95, 160, 185]
		const persistedEngine: EngineState = {
			version: 1,
			absoluteFloors: [],
			kByRange: [],
			spurs: toothBins.map(b => ({ key: KEY, basebandBin: b - 1, widthBins: 3, kind: "baseband" as const })),
			provisionalSpurs: toothBins.map(b => ({ key: KEY, basebandBin: b, widthBins: 1, comb: true })),
		}
		const n = 2 * FS
		const teethHz = toothBins.map(b => (b - N / 2) * BIN_HZ)
		const betweenHz = (120 - N / 2) * BIN_HZ
		const tones = [...teethHz, betweenHz]
		const h = run(addInto(noiseAt(0, n), toneComb(n, FS, tones, tones.map(() => toneAmp(25)))), { persistedEngine })
		const near = (hz: number): TrackSnapshot[] => h.tracks().filter(t => Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + hz)) <= 2 * BIN_HZ)
		for (const hz of teethHz) expect(near(hz)).toEqual([])
		expect(near(betweenHz).length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
		const masks = h.pipeline.artefactMasks()
		expect(masks.spurs.map(s => s.origin)).toEqual(["comb", "comb", "comb", "comb"])
		for (const hz of teethHz) expect(artefactOf(CENTRE + hz, masks.epoch, masks)).toBe("spur")
	})
})
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Implement the pipeline**

```ts
// src/core/spectrum/pipeline.ts
import { WaveKitError } from "../../utils/errors.js"
import { segment } from "./emissions/segmenter.js"
import type { Segment } from "./emissions/segmenter.js"
import { Tracker } from "./emissions/tracker.js"
import type { TrackerBlock } from "./emissions/tracker.js"
import type {
	BlockSummary,
	EngineState,
	FreqRange,
	PendingEpoch,
	PipelineConfig,
	PipelineEvent,
	PipelineInput,
	PipelineStats,
	SettleMode,
	TuningTrust,
} from "./types.js"
import { dcGuardBins, Detector, usableEdgeBins } from "./detector.js"
import { accumulateShiftedPower, Fft, powerToDb } from "./fft.js"
import { bytesPerSample, FrameSource } from "./frame-source.js"
import { NoiseFloor } from "./noise-floor.js"
import { SpurMap } from "./spur-map.js"
import { ACTIVITY_HOLD_MS } from "./artefacts.js"
import type { ArtefactMasks, ArtefactSpurLine } from "./artefacts.js"
import { ImpulseBlanker } from "./impulse-blanker.js"
import { PROVISIONAL_WINDOW_MS, ProvisionalSpurs } from "./provisional-spurs.js"
import type { BinRange } from "./provisional-spurs.js"

/**
 * The whole tier-1 pipeline for one source (decision D1): bytes → frames → blocks → floor →
 * detector → segmenter → tracker, with epoch resolution (marker / timer, spec §4.6), the stale
 * check, gap accounting (§4.1), block summaries and periodic stats. Pure and synchronous: every
 * input returns the events it caused. Runs inside the spectrum worker (Task 32) and in tests.
 */

type MasksInput = Omit<Extract<PipelineInput, { kind: "masks" }>, "kind">
interface Frame {
	startSample: number
	re: Float32Array
	im: Float32Array
	clipped: number
}

const SKIRT_DB = 30
/** Far skirts (§6.2, P18): regrowth and phase noise sit ≥ 50 dB down one or two channels out; intermod products (≈ 40 dBc) stay. */
const FAR_SKIRT_DB = 50
const FAR_SKIRT_REACH_HZ = 31_250 // ±2 channels of a 12.5 kHz raster plus half a channel
const STATS_INTERVAL_S = 5
const STALE_MAX_MS = 1000
const STUCK_TEST_MODE_S = 0.5
const FLOOR_TAU_S = 30
const SPUR_MIN_OBSERVED_MS = 600_000
const SPUR_ON_FRACTION = 0.95
const SPUR_MAX_WIDTH_BINS = 3
const CFAR_BUCKET_HZ = 2_000_000
const KNOWN_RF_MAX = 1024
const GAP_TOLERANCE_HZ = 2000
const NO_FLOOR_DBFS = -200

interface EpochState {
	epoch: number
	stream: number
	centreHz: number
	tuningTrust: TuningTrust
	absKey: string
	settledStart: number | null
	settleMode: SettleMode
	staleLeft: number
	staleRef: Uint8Array | null
}

function parseKey(key: string): FreqRange {
	const [a, b] = key.split(":")
	return { startHz: Number(a ?? 0), endHz: Number(b ?? 0) }
}

/** Maximal runs of 1s in a bin mask. */
function runsOf(mask: Uint8Array): BinRange[] {
	const out: BinRange[] = []
	for (let i = 0; i < mask.length; ) {
		if (mask[i] !== 1) {
			i++
			continue
		}
		let j = i
		while (j < mask.length && mask[j] === 1) j++
		out.push({ startBin: i, endBin: j })
		i = j
	}
	return out
}

export class SpectrumPipeline {
	private readonly n: number
	private readonly fs: number
	private readonly binHz: number
	private readonly framesPerBlock: number
	private readonly blockSamples: number
	private readonly blockMs: number
	private readonly bytesPerSample: number
	private readonly gapBins: number
	private readonly edgeBins: number
	private readonly dcBins: number
	private readonly dcGuardHz: number
	private readonly maxStaleBlocks: number
	private readonly hangSamples: number
	private readonly fft: Fft
	private readonly floor: NoiseFloor
	private readonly spurs: SpurMap
	private readonly detector: Detector
	private readonly tracker: Tracker
	private readonly wideband: Tracker
	private frames: FrameSource

	private readonly frameAcc: Float64Array
	private readonly blockAcc: Float64Array
	private readonly frameDb: Float32Array
	private readonly powerDb: Float32Array
	private readonly floorDb: Float32Array
	private readonly on: Uint8Array
	private readonly extra: Uint8Array
	private readonly learnMask: Uint8Array
	private readonly joined: Uint8Array
	private readonly lastTrackBins: Uint8Array
	private readonly exclusionMask: Uint8Array
	private exclusionEdges: number[] = []
	private rasterEdges: number[] = []
	private masks: MasksInput = { exclusions: [], cfarRanges: [], burstRanges: [], rasters: [], obwHz: [], inWindow: true }
	private feed = false

	private ep: EpochState | null = null
	private resolving: PendingEpoch | null = null
	private epochCounter = 0
	private stream = 0
	private gaps: { start: number; end: number }[] = []
	private knownRf: { rfHz: number; obwHz: number }[] = []

	private blockIndex = -1
	private blockFrames = 0
	private blockClipped = 0

	private overloadedBlocks = 0
	private gapSamples = 0
	private staleAfterSettle = 0
	private settledSamples = 0
	private observedSamples = 0
	private nextStatsAt: number
	private stuck = false
	private lastFloorDbfs = NO_FLOOR_DBFS
	// artefact rejection (spec § 4.9, Task 7a)
	private readonly blanker: ImpulseBlanker
	private readonly provisional: ProvisionalSpurs
	private readonly lineMask: Uint8Array
	private readonly lineScratch: Uint8Array
	private readonly lastActive: Float64Array
	private lastActivityEnd = 0
	/** IQ-image tracks of the last block, for artefactMasks() (Task 11a fills it). */
	private imageTracks: { centreHz: number; obwHz: number }[] = []
	private out: PipelineEvent[] = []

	constructor(
		private readonly cfg: PipelineConfig,
		/** `provisionalWindowMs` (default 30 s) is a test knob: P24 runs the comb property at 3 s. */
		deps: { now?: () => number; provisionalWindowMs?: number } = {},
	) {
		const now = deps.now ?? Date.now
		this.n = cfg.fftSize
		this.fs = cfg.sampleRateHz
		this.binHz = this.fs / this.n
		this.framesPerBlock = Math.max(1, Math.round((cfg.integrationMs * this.fs) / (this.n * 1000)))
		this.blockSamples = this.framesPerBlock * this.n
		this.blockMs = (this.blockSamples / this.fs) * 1000
		this.bytesPerSample = bytesPerSample(cfg.format)
		this.gapBins = Math.max(1, Math.round(GAP_TOLERANCE_HZ / this.binHz))
		this.edgeBins = usableEdgeBins(this.n, cfg.usableFraction)
		this.dcBins = dcGuardBins(cfg.dcGuardHz, this.binHz, this.binHz)
		this.dcGuardHz = Math.max(cfg.dcGuardHz, 2 * this.binHz)
		this.maxStaleBlocks = Math.ceil(STALE_MAX_MS / this.blockMs)
		const hangBlocks = Math.max(1, Math.round(cfg.trackHangMs / this.blockMs))
		this.hangSamples = hangBlocks * this.blockSamples
		this.fft = new Fft(this.n)
		this.frames = new FrameSource({ format: cfg.format, fftSize: this.n })
		this.floor = new NoiseFloor({
			fftSize: this.n,
			framesPerBlock: this.framesPerBlock,
			tauBlocks: Math.max(1, Math.round((FLOOR_TAU_S * 1000) / this.blockMs)),
		})
		this.spurs = new SpurMap({
			fftSize: this.n,
			minObservedMs: SPUR_MIN_OBSERVED_MS,
			onFraction: SPUR_ON_FRACTION,
			maxWidthBins: SPUR_MAX_WIDTH_BINS,
		})
		this.detector = new Detector({
			fftSize: this.n,
			hysteresisDb: cfg.hysteresisDb,
			faTargetPerMhzMin: cfg.faTargetPerMhzMin,
			pinnedK: cfg.thresholdDb,
			rbwHz: this.binHz,
			integrationMs: cfg.integrationMs,
		})
		const idPrefix = `${cfg.sourceId}-${now().toString(36)}-`
		const maxTrackBlocks = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(cfg.maxTrackMs / this.blockMs))
		this.tracker = new Tracker({
			sourceId: cfg.sourceId,
			binHz: this.binHz,
			blockMs: this.blockMs,
			hangBlocks,
			maxTracks: Math.max(1, cfg.maxTracks - 1), // one slot is the wideband tracker's (P11)
			maxTrackBlocks,
			idPrefix,
		})
		this.wideband = new Tracker({
			sourceId: cfg.sourceId,
			binHz: this.binHz,
			blockMs: this.blockMs,
			hangBlocks,
			maxTracks: 1,
			maxTrackBlocks,
			idPrefix: `${idPrefix}w`,
		})
		this.frameAcc = new Float64Array(this.n)
		this.blockAcc = new Float64Array(this.n)
		this.frameDb = new Float32Array(this.n)
		this.powerDb = new Float32Array(this.n)
		this.floorDb = new Float32Array(this.n)
		this.on = new Uint8Array(this.n)
		this.extra = new Uint8Array(this.n)
		this.learnMask = new Uint8Array(this.n)
		this.joined = new Uint8Array(this.n)
		this.lastTrackBins = new Uint8Array(this.n)
		this.exclusionMask = new Uint8Array(this.n)
		this.nextStatsAt = STATS_INTERVAL_S * this.fs
		this.blanker = new ImpulseBlanker({
			fftSize: this.n,
			usableStartBin: this.edgeBins,
			usableEndBin: this.n - this.edgeBins + 1,
			sampleRateHz: this.fs,
		})
		this.provisional = new ProvisionalSpurs({ fftSize: this.n, windowMs: deps.provisionalWindowMs ?? PROVISIONAL_WINDOW_MS })
		this.lineMask = new Uint8Array(this.n)
		this.lineScratch = new Uint8Array(this.n)
		this.lastActive = new Float64Array(this.n).fill(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)
		const persisted = cfg.persistedEngine
		if (persisted) {
			this.floor.importState({ absoluteFloors: persisted.absoluteFloors })
			this.spurs.importState({ spurs: persisted.spurs })
			this.detector.importK(persisted.kByRange.map(e => ({ key: `${e.startHz}:${e.endHz}`, k: e.k })))
			this.provisional.importState(persisted)
		}
	}

	handle(input: PipelineInput): PipelineEvent[] {
		this.out = []
		switch (input.kind) {
			case "bytes":
				this.onBytes(input.startSample, input.bytes)
				break
			case "gap":
				this.onGap(input.startSample, input.samples)
				break
			case "pending-epoch":
				this.onPending(input.pending)
				break
			case "new-stream":
				this.onNewStream(input)
				break
			case "masks": {
				const { kind: _kind, ...masks } = input
				this.masks = masks
				this.applyMasks()
				break
			}
			case "spectrum-feed":
				this.feed = input.enabled
				break
		}
		return this.out
	}

	exportEngineState(): EngineState {
		return {
			version: 1,
			absoluteFloors: this.floor.exportState().absoluteFloors,
			spurs: this.spurs.exportState().spurs,
			provisionalSpurs: this.provisional.exportState().provisionalSpurs,
			kByRange: this.detector.stats().map(s => {
				const r = parseKey(s.key)
				return { startHz: r.startHz, endHz: r.endHz, k: s.k }
			}),
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Spec § 4.9: the current epoch's artefacts as plain data (structured-clone safe, so the worker can
	 * post them) for the pure `artefactOf` (identify mode, § 10.8; Task 35a carries them to the main thread).
	 */
	artefactMasks(): ArtefactMasks {
		const report = this.blanker.rfi()
		const rfi = { active: report.active, periodMs: report.periodMs, blankedFrames: this.blanker.blankedFrames }
		const base = { sourceId: this.cfg.sourceId, binHz: this.binHz, dcGuardHz: this.dcGuardHz, rfi }
		const ep = this.ep
		if (!ep) return { ...base, epoch: 0, centreHz: 0, usable: { startHz: 0, endHz: 0 }, spurs: [], images: [], activity: [] }
		const n = this.n
		const rfLow = (bin: number): number => ep.centreHz + (bin - n / 2 - 0.5) * this.binHz
		const lines = this.provisional.lines(ep.absKey)
		const spurs = lines.map(
			(l): ArtefactSpurLine => ({
				startHz: rfLow(Math.max(0, l.startBin - 1)),
				endHz: rfLow(Math.min(n, l.endBin + 1)),
				origin: l.comb ? "comb" : "provisional",
			}),
		)
		const baseband = new Uint8Array(n)
		this.spurs.mask(ep.absKey, baseband)
		for (const run of runsOf(baseband)) {
			// a promoted comb tooth is listed once, as its comb line
			if (lines.some(l => l.comb && l.startBin - 1 < run.endBin && l.endBin + 1 > run.startBin)) continue
			spurs.push({ startHz: rfLow(run.startBin), endHz: rfLow(run.endBin), origin: "baseband" })
		}
		const horizon = this.lastActivityEnd - (ACTIVITY_HOLD_MS * this.fs) / 1000
		const active = new Uint8Array(n)
		for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) active[i] = (this.lastActive[i] ?? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY) >= horizon ? 1 : 0
		return {
			...base,
			epoch: ep.epoch,
			centreHz: ep.centreHz,
			usable: { startHz: rfLow(this.edgeBins), endHz: rfLow(n - this.edgeBins + 1) },
			spurs,
			images: this.imageTracks.map(t => ({ centreHz: t.centreHz, obwHz: t.obwHz, partnerHz: 2 * ep.centreHz - t.centreHz })),
			activity: runsOf(active).map(r => ({ startHz: rfLow(r.startBin), endHz: rfLow(r.endBin) })),
		}
	}

	// ---- inputs ----

	private onBytes(startSample: number, bytes: Uint8Array): void {
		const samples = Math.floor(bytes.length / this.bytesPerSample)
		this.observedSamples += samples
		if (this.ep) {
			this.frames.push(startSample, bytes)
			this.drain()
			this.checkMarkerTimeout(startSample + samples)
			const run = this.frames.activeCounterRun
			if (run && run.samples > STUCK_TEST_MODE_S * this.fs) this.stuck = true
		}
		this.maybeStats()
	}

	private onGap(startSample: number, samples: number): void {
		this.observedSamples += samples
		this.gapSamples += samples
		this.frames.gap(startSample, samples)
		this.gaps.push({ start: startSample, end: startSample + samples })
		if (samples >= this.hangSamples) {
			this.emit(this.tracker.closeAll("gap"))
			this.emit(this.wideband.closeAll("gap"))
		}
		this.drain()
		this.checkMarkerTimeout(startSample + samples)
		this.maybeStats()
	}

	private onPending(p: PendingEpoch): void {
		this.checkRate(p.sampleRateHz)
		this.discardBlock()
		const staleRef = this.ep && p.centreChanged ? Uint8Array.from(this.lastTrackBins) : null
		this.lastTrackBins.fill(0)
		const epoch = p.epoch > this.epochCounter ? p.epoch : this.epochCounter + 1
		this.epochCounter = epoch
		const info = { stream: this.stream, epoch, centreHz: p.centreHz, tuningTrust: p.tuningTrust }
		this.emit(this.tracker.beginEpoch(info))
		this.emit(this.wideband.beginEpoch(info))
		this.ep = {
			epoch,
			stream: this.stream,
			centreHz: p.centreHz,
			tuningTrust: p.tuningTrust,
			absKey: this.absKey(p.gainKey),
			settledStart: null,
			settleMode: p.expectMarker ? "marker" : "timer",
			staleLeft: staleRef ? this.maxStaleBlocks : 0,
			staleRef,
		}
		this.startEpochState()
		this.resolving = p
		if (!p.expectMarker) this.resolve(p.commandSample + p.bufferedSamples + p.settleSamples, "timer")
	}

	private onNewStream(input: Extract<PipelineInput, { kind: "new-stream" }>): void {
		this.checkRate(input.sampleRateHz)
		this.discardBlock()
		this.emit(this.tracker.closeAll("gap"))
		this.emit(this.wideband.closeAll("gap"))
		this.frames = new FrameSource({ format: this.cfg.format, fftSize: this.n })
		this.gaps = []
		this.resolving = null
		this.stream = input.stream
		this.lastTrackBins.fill(0)
		const epoch = ++this.epochCounter
		const info = { stream: input.stream, epoch, centreHz: input.centreHz, tuningTrust: input.tuningTrust }
		this.emit(this.tracker.beginEpoch(info))
		this.emit(this.wideband.beginEpoch(info))
		this.ep = {
			epoch,
			stream: input.stream,
			centreHz: input.centreHz,
			tuningTrust: input.tuningTrust,
			absKey: this.absKey(input.gainKey),
			settledStart: 0,
			settleMode: "none",
			staleLeft: 0,
			staleRef: null,
		}
		this.startEpochState()
		this.out.push({ kind: "epoch-started", epoch, startSample: 0, settleMode: "none" })
	}

	// ---- epoch resolution ----

	private checkRate(sampleRateHz: number): void {
		if (sampleRateHz !== this.fs) {
			throw new WaveKitError(
				`spectrum pipeline built for ${this.fs} S/s cannot take ${sampleRateHz} S/s`,
				"SCANNER_PIPELINE_RATE",
			)
		}
	}

	private absKey(gainKey: string): string {
		return `${this.fs}:${gainKey}:${this.n}`
	}

	private startEpochState(): void {
		const ep = this.ep
		if (!ep) return
		this.detector.reset()
		this.resetArtefacts()
		this.floor.useKey(ep.absKey)
		this.applyMasks()
	}

	private checkMarkerTimeout(atSample: number): void {
		const p = this.resolving
		if (!p?.expectMarker || atSample < p.commandSample + p.markerTimeoutSamples) return
		this.resolve(Math.max(p.commandSample + p.bufferedSamples + p.settleSamples, atSample), "timer")
	}

	private resolve(startSample: number, mode: SettleMode, markerRunSamples?: number): void {
		this.resolving = null
		const ep = this.ep
		if (!ep) return
		ep.settledStart = startSample
		ep.settleMode = mode
		this.discardBlock()
		this.out.push(
			markerRunSamples === undefined
				? { kind: "epoch-started", epoch: ep.epoch, startSample, settleMode: mode }
				: { kind: "epoch-started", epoch: ep.epoch, startSample, settleMode: mode, markerRunSamples },
		)
	}

	private drain(): void {
		this.frames.drain(
			f => this.onFrame(f),
			r => this.onCounterRun(r),
		)
	}

	private onCounterRun(run: { startSample: number; endSample: number }): void {
		const samples = run.endSample - run.startSample
		this.gapSamples += samples
		if (samples > STUCK_TEST_MODE_S * this.fs) this.stuck = true
		const p = this.resolving
		if (p?.expectMarker && run.startSample >= p.commandSample) {
			this.resolve(run.endSample + p.pllSettleSamples, "marker", samples)
			return
		}
		this.gaps.push({ start: run.startSample, end: run.endSample }) // another engine's marker
	}

	// ---- frames and blocks ----

	private onFrame(f: Frame): void {
		const ep = this.ep
		if (!ep) return
		if (this.resolving) {
			this.checkMarkerTimeout(f.startSample)
			if (this.resolving) return
		}
		const s0 = ep.settledStart
		if (s0 === null || f.startSample < s0) return
		// A frame belongs to the block it starts in. After a seam the frame grid is no longer aligned to
		// the block grid, so the last frame of a block may overhang into the next one (same epoch only:
		// frames before s0 are dropped above, and nothing past a command is ever pushed before it).
		const bi = Math.floor((f.startSample - s0) / this.blockSamples)
		const blockEnd = s0 + (bi + 1) * this.blockSamples
		if (bi !== this.blockIndex) {
			if (this.blockFrames > 0) this.finishBlock()
			this.blockIndex = bi
		}
		this.fft.transform(f.re, f.im)
		this.frameAcc.fill(0)
		accumulateShiftedPower(f.re, f.im, this.frameAcc)
		this.blockClipped += f.clipped
		this.blockFrames++
		// § 4.9 (Task 7a): a blanked frame, or a pending one in an epoch's first block, is neither integrated nor enveloped
		if (this.blanker.offer(this.frameAcc, f.startSample) === "keep") {
			for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) this.blockAcc[i] = (this.blockAcc[i] ?? 0) + (this.frameAcc[i] ?? 0)
			if (this.tracker.openCount > 0) {
				powerToDb(this.frameAcc, 1, this.frameDb)
				this.tracker.frame(this.frameDb, f.startSample)
			}
		}
		if (f.startSample + this.n >= blockEnd) this.finishBlock()
	}

	private resetBlock(): void {
		this.blockAcc.fill(0)
		this.blockFrames = 0
		this.blockClipped = 0
		this.blanker.dropBlock()
	}

	private discardBlock(): void {
		this.resetBlock()
		this.blockIndex = -1
	}

	private finishBlock(): void {
		const ep = this.ep
		const s0 = ep?.settledStart
		const frames = this.blockFrames
		if (!ep || s0 === null || s0 === undefined || frames === 0) {
			this.resetBlock()
			return
		}
		const blockStart = s0 + this.blockIndex * this.blockSamples
		const blockEnd = blockStart + this.blockSamples
		const gap = frames < this.framesPerBlock || this.gaps.some(g => g.start < blockEnd && g.end > blockStart)
		const overload = this.blockClipped / (frames * this.n) > this.cfg.clipFraction
		const blanking = this.blanker.endBlock(this.blockAcc) // § 4.9: blanked frames are not integrated
		powerToDb(this.blockAcc, blanking.integrated, this.powerDb)
		this.resetBlock()
		this.gaps = this.gaps.filter(g => g.end > blockEnd)

		this.extra.set(this.exclusionMask)
		this.spurs.mask(ep.absKey, this.extra)
		this.detector.setMasks({ dcGuardBins: this.dcBins, edgeBins: this.edgeBins, extra: this.extra })
		const unmasked = this.detector.unmasked()
		const blockFloor = this.floor.blockFloor(this.powerDb, unmasked)
		const effective = this.floor.effectiveFloor(blockFloor, ep.absKey)
		this.floor.perBinFloor(this.floorDb, effective)
		this.detector.detect(this.powerDb, this.floorDb, this.on)
		const k = this.detector.kFor(this.n / 2)
		const floorOccupied = this.floor.occupied(blockFloor, k, ep.absKey)
		const segs = this.withoutLines(ep, segment(this.on, this.powerDb, this.floorDb, {
			gapBins: this.gapBins,
			usableStartBin: this.edgeBins,
			usableEndBin: this.n - this.edgeBins + 1,
			exclusionEdges: this.exclusionEdges,
			rasterBinEdges: this.rasterEdges,
			skirtDb: SKIRT_DB,
			inWindow: this.masks.inWindow,
			farSkirt: { reachBins: Math.floor(FAR_SKIRT_REACH_HZ / this.binHz), minDb: FAR_SKIRT_DB, dcBin: this.n / 2 },
		}))

		if (ep.staleLeft > 0) {
			if (this.isStale(segs, ep)) {
				ep.staleLeft--
				this.staleAfterSettle++
				this.detector.reset()
				this.out.push({ kind: "stale-discard", epoch: ep.epoch, blocks: 1 })
				return
			}
			ep.staleLeft = 0
			ep.staleRef = null
		}

		const learn = !gap && !overload
		if (learn && !blanking.excluded) {
			for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) this.learnMask[i] = unmasked[i] === 1 && this.on[i] !== 1 ? 1 : 0
			this.floor.update(this.powerDb, this.learnMask, segs.length === 0, ep.absKey)
			this.spurs.observe(ep.absKey, { epoch: ep.epoch, centreHz: ep.centreHz, binHz: this.binHz }, this.on, this.blockMs)
			this.observeLines(ep)
		}
		const block: TrackerBlock = {
			endSample: blockEnd,
			powerDb: this.powerDb,
			floorDb: this.floorDb,
			blockFloorDb: effective,
			thresholdDb: k,
			gap,
			overload,
		}
		this.emit(this.tracker.flagSpurs(this.lineMask))
		this.noteActivity(segs, blockEnd)
		this.emit(this.tracker.block(segs, block))
		this.emit(this.wideband.block(floorOccupied ? [this.widebandSegment()] : [], block))
		this.tracker.trackBinsMask(this.lastTrackBins, 1)
		if (learn) {
			this.tracker.trackBinsMask(this.joined, 2)
			let usable = 0
			for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) usable += unmasked[i] ?? 0
			if (!blanking.excluded) this.detector.recordNoiseEdges(this.on, this.joined, this.blockMs / 60_000, (usable * this.binHz) / 1e6)
			this.settledSamples += this.blockSamples
		}
		if (overload) this.overloadedBlocks++
		this.lastFloorDbfs = effective
		if (this.feed) {
			this.out.push({ kind: "block-summary", summary: this.summary(ep, blockEnd, effective, k, segs, floorOccupied, overload) })
		}
	}

	/** Spec §4.6: a segment at the baseband bins of a pre-epoch track that no known emitter explains. */
	private isStale(segs: Segment[], ep: EpochState): boolean {
		const ref = ep.staleRef
		if (!ref) return false
		for (const s of segs) {
			let overlaps = false
			for (let i = s.startBin; i < s.endBin && !overlaps; i++) overlaps = ref[i] === 1
			if (!overlaps) continue
			const rf = ep.centreHz + (s.centroidBin - this.n / 2) * this.binHz
			const explained = this.knownRf.some(k => Math.abs(k.rfHz - rf) <= Math.max(2 * this.binHz, k.obwHz / 2))
			if (!explained) return true
		}
		return false
	}

	/** Spec § 4.9: drops segments that lie wholly on a spur line (baseband, provisional or comb), ±1 bin of Hann skirt. */
	private withoutLines(ep: EpochState, segs: Segment[]): Segment[] {
		this.lineScratch.fill(0)
		this.spurs.mask(ep.absKey, this.lineScratch)
		this.provisional.mask(ep.absKey, this.lineScratch)
		this.lineMask.fill(0)
		for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) {
			if (this.lineScratch[i] === 1) this.lineMask.fill(1, Math.max(0, i - 1), Math.min(this.n, i + 2))
		}
		return segs.filter(s => {
			for (let i = s.startBin; i < s.endBin; i++) if (this.lineMask[i] !== 1) return true
			return false
		})
	}

	/** Spec § 4.9 fast path: lines on ≥ 95 % for 30 s become provisional spurs; combs become baseband spurs at once. */
	private observeLines(ep: EpochState): void {
		const promoted = this.provisional.observe(ep.absKey, this.on, this.powerDb, this.detector.unmasked(), this.blockMs)
		if (promoted.length > 0) this.spurs.promote(ep.absKey, this.binHz, promoted)
	}

	/** Bins of this block's tracked segments (after blanking and line filtering), for artefactMasks().activity. */
	private noteActivity(segs: readonly Segment[], blockEnd: number): void {
		for (const s of segs) this.lastActive.fill(blockEnd, s.startBin, s.endBin)
		this.lastActivityEnd = blockEnd
	}

	/** Epoch start: the blanker's reference, the activity and the image list describe the old window. */
	private resetArtefacts(): void {
		this.blanker.reset()
		this.lastActive.fill(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)
		this.imageTracks = []
	}

	private rfiStats(): PipelineStats["broadbandRfi"] {
		const r = this.blanker.rfi()
		return r.active && r.periodMs !== null ? { periodMs: r.periodMs } : null
	}

	private widebandSegment(): Segment {
		const start = this.edgeBins
		const end = this.n - this.edgeBins + 1
		let peakBin = start
		let peakDb = -Infinity
		for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
			const p = this.powerDb[i] ?? -Infinity
			if (p > peakDb) {
				peakDb = p
				peakBin = i
			}
		}
		return { startBin: start, endBin: end, peakBin, peakDb, centroidBin: this.n / 2, flags: { truncated: false, skirt: false, edge: true } }
	}

	private emit(events: PipelineEvent[]): void {
		const ep = this.ep
		for (const e of events) {
			if (ep && (e.kind === "track-open" || e.kind === "track-update" || e.kind === "track-close")) {
				const t = e.track
				const bin = Math.round((t.centreHz - ep.centreHz) / this.binHz + this.n / 2)
				t.thresholdDb = this.detector.kFor(Math.min(this.n - 1, Math.max(0, bin)))
				if (Math.abs(t.centreHz - ep.centreHz) - t.obwHz / 2 < this.dcGuardHz) t.flags.obwBiased = true
				if (e.kind === "track-close" && t.blocks >= 2) {
					this.knownRf.push({ rfHz: t.centreHz, obwHz: t.obwHz })
					if (this.knownRf.length > KNOWN_RF_MAX) this.knownRf.shift()
				}
			}
			this.out.push(e)
		}
	}

	// ---- masks, summaries, stats ----

	private applyMasks(): void {
		const ep = this.ep
		if (!ep) return
		const n = this.n
		const c = ep.centreHz
		const binOf = (hz: number): number => (hz - c) / this.binHz + n / 2
		this.exclusionMask.fill(0)
		this.exclusionEdges = []
		for (const x of this.masks.exclusions) {
			const first = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(binOf(x.startHz)))
			const last = Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor(binOf(x.endHz)))
			if (first > last) continue
			this.exclusionMask.fill(1, first, last + 1)
			this.exclusionEdges.push(first, last + 1)
		}
		const lo = this.edgeBins
		const hi = n - this.edgeBins + 1
		const edges = new Set<number>()
		const half = this.fs / 2
		for (const r of this.masks.rasters) {
			if (r.spacingHz <= 0) continue
			const kFirst = Math.floor((c - half - r.firstChannelHz) / r.spacingHz) - 1
			const kLast = Math.ceil((c + half - r.firstChannelHz) / r.spacingHz) + 1
			for (let k = kFirst; k <= kLast; k++) {
				const b = Math.ceil(binOf(r.firstChannelHz + (k + 0.5) * r.spacingHz))
				if (b > lo && b < hi) edges.add(b)
			}
		}
		this.rasterEdges = [...edges].sort((a, b) => a - b)
		this.detector.setMasks({ dcGuardBins: this.dcBins, edgeBins: this.edgeBins, extra: this.exclusionMask })
		this.detector.setCfarRanges(this.cfarRanges(c))
	}

	/** Per-range CFAR buckets over the usable span: bandplan/job ranges first, else 2 MHz RF buckets. */
	private cfarRanges(centreHz: number): { startBin: number; endBin: number; key: string; burst: boolean }[] {
		const out: { startBin: number; endBin: number; key: string; burst: boolean }[] = []
		for (let i = this.edgeBins; i < this.n - this.edgeBins + 1; i++) {
			const rf = centreHz + (i - this.n / 2) * this.binHz
			const r = this.masks.cfarRanges.find(x => rf >= x.startHz && rf < x.endHz)
			const bucket = Math.floor(rf / CFAR_BUCKET_HZ) * CFAR_BUCKET_HZ
			const key = r ? `${Math.round(r.startHz)}:${Math.round(r.endHz)}` : `${bucket}:${bucket + CFAR_BUCKET_HZ}`
			const burst = this.masks.burstRanges.some(x => rf >= x.startHz && rf < x.endHz)
			const last = out.at(-1)
			if (last && last.key === key && last.burst === burst && last.endBin === i) last.endBin = i + 1
			else out.push({ startBin: i, endBin: i + 1, key, burst })
		}
		return out
	}

	private summary(
		ep: EpochState,
		endSample: number,
		floorDbfs: number,
		k: number,
		segs: Segment[],
		floorOccupied: boolean,
		overload: boolean,
	): BlockSummary {
		const lo = this.edgeBins
		const hi = this.n - this.edgeBins + 1
		const d = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((hi - lo) / this.cfg.spectrumBins))
		const bins: number[] = []
		for (let a = lo; a < hi; a += d) {
			let m = -Infinity
			for (let i = a; i < Math.min(hi, a + d); i++) m = Math.max(m, this.powerDb[i] ?? -Infinity)
			bins.push(Math.round(m * 2) / 2)
		}
		const rfLow = (bin: number): number => ep.centreHz + (bin - this.n / 2 - 0.5) * this.binHz
		// Baseband spur bins as RF ranges (display only; summaries are built only while the feed is on).
		const spur = new Uint8Array(this.n)
		this.spurs.mask(ep.absKey, spur)
		this.provisional.mask(ep.absKey, spur) // provisional and comb lines (Task 7a)
		const spurRanges: FreqRange[] = []
		for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) {
			if (spur[i] !== 1) continue
			let j = i
			while (j < this.n && spur[j] === 1) j++
			spurRanges.push({ startHz: rfLow(i), endHz: rfLow(j) })
			i = j
		}
		return {
			sourceId: this.cfg.sourceId,
			stream: ep.stream,
			epoch: ep.epoch,
			endSample,
			centreHz: ep.centreHz,
			sampleRateHz: this.fs,
			binHz: d * this.binHz,
			startHz: rfLow(lo),
			bins,
			floorDbfs,
			thresholdDb: k,
			tracks: segs.map(s => ({
				startHz: rfLow(s.startBin),
				endHz: rfLow(s.endBin),
				flags: { burst: false, iqImage: false, edge: s.flags.edge },
			})),
			masks: { dcHz: ep.centreHz, dcGuardHz: this.dcGuardHz, spurRanges },
			floorOccupied,
			overload,
		}
	}

	private maybeStats(): void {
		if (this.observedSamples < this.nextStatsAt) return
		while (this.nextStatsAt <= this.observedSamples) this.nextStatsAt += STATS_INTERVAL_S * this.fs
		const stats: PipelineStats = {
			sourceId: this.cfg.sourceId,
			floorDbfs: this.lastFloorDbfs,
			absoluteFloorDbfs: this.ep ? this.floor.absoluteFloor(this.ep.absKey) : null,
			kByRange: this.detector.stats().map(s => ({ range: parseKey(s.key), k: s.k, faPerMhzMin: s.faPerMhzMin })),
			overloadedBlocks: this.overloadedBlocks,
			gapSamples: this.gapSamples,
			staleAfterSettle: this.staleAfterSettle,
			stuckTestMode: this.stuck,
			settledSamples: this.settledSamples,
			observedSamples: this.observedSamples,
			blankedFrames: this.blanker.blankedFrames,
			broadbandRfi: this.rfiStats(),
		}
		this.out.push({ kind: "stats", stats })
		const run = this.frames.activeCounterRun
		this.stuck = run !== null && run.samples > STUCK_TEST_MODE_S * this.fs
	}
}
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/frame-source-overlap.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { FrameSource } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/frame-source.js"
import { gaussianNoise, mulberry32, packF32 } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"

const N = 64

function collect(overlap: 0 | 0.5, bytes: Uint8Array, chunk: number): { start: number; re: number[] }[] {
	const src = new FrameSource({ format: "FLOAT32LE", fftSize: N, overlap })
	const out: { start: number; re: number[] }[] = []
	for (let off = 0; off < bytes.length; off += chunk) {
		src.push(off / 8, bytes.subarray(off, Math.min(bytes.length, off + chunk)))
		src.drain(f => out.push({ start: f.startSample, re: Array.from(f.re) }), () => undefined)
	}
	return out
}

describe("FrameSource overlap", () => {
	const iq = gaussianNoise(mulberry32(3), 1000, 0.1)
	const bytes = packF32(iq.re, iq.im)

	it("emits a frame every N/2 samples with 50 % overlap, identical to the unoverlapped frames at even indices", () => {
		const plain = collect(0, bytes, 8 * 100)
		const half = collect(0.5, bytes, 8 * 100)
		expect(plain.map(f => f.start)).toEqual(Array.from({ length: Math.floor(1000 / N) }, (_, i) => i * N))
		expect(half.map(f => f.start)).toEqual(Array.from({ length: Math.floor((1000 - N) / (N / 2)) + 1 }, (_, i) => (i * N) / 2))
		plain.forEach((f, i) => expect(half[2 * i]?.re).toEqual(f.re))
	})

	it("does not depend on how the bytes are chunked", () => {
		expect(collect(0.5, bytes, 8 * 7).map(f => f.start)).toEqual(collect(0.5, bytes, 8 * 333).map(f => f.start))
	})

	it("restarts the overlapped grid after a gap", () => {
		const src = new FrameSource({ format: "FLOAT32LE", fftSize: N, overlap: 0.5 })
		const starts: number[] = []
		src.push(0, bytes.subarray(0, 8 * 100))
		src.gap(100, 50)
		src.push(150, bytes.subarray(8 * 150, 8 * 300))
		src.drain(f => starts.push(f.startSample), () => undefined)
		expect(starts).toEqual([0, 32, 150, 182, 214])
	})
})
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/pipeline-burst.test.ts
import fc from "fast-check"
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest"
import { Fft } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/fft.js"
import type { TrackSnapshot } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"
import {
	addInto,
	fsk4Burst,
	gaussianNoise,
	heavyTailedNoise,
	meanPower,
	mulberry32,
	ookBursts,
	tone,
	zerosIq,
} from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import type { Iq } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import { BLOCK, CENTRE, FS, Harness } from "./pipeline-harness.js"

const SIGMA = 0.01
const K_SHORT = 8.5
const TOTAL = Math.round(0.4 * FS)

/** A 5 ms OOK burst whose in-burst power is `snrDb` above the noise in 12.5 kHz. */
function ookBurst(seed: number, offsetHz: number, startMs: number, snrDb: number): Iq {
	const sig = ookBursts(mulberry32(seed), TOTAL, FS, offsetHz, 1, { bursts: [{ startMs, durationMs: 5 }] })
	const from = Math.round((startMs * FS) / 1000)
	const p = meanPower(sig, from, from + Math.round(0.005 * FS))
	const target = 10 ** (snrDb / 10) * SIGMA * SIGMA * (12_500 / FS)
	const g = Math.sqrt(target / p)
	for (let i = 0; i < TOTAL; i++) {
		sig.re[i] = (sig.re[i] ?? 0) * g
		sig.im[i] = (sig.im[i] ?? 0) * g
	}
	return sig
}

/** A 5 ms carrier burst (deterministic level) whose power is `snrDb` above the noise in 12.5 kHz. */
function toneBurst(offsetHz: number, startMs: number, snrDb: number): Iq {
	const amp = Math.sqrt(10 ** (snrDb / 10) * SIGMA * SIGMA * (12_500 / FS))
	const sig = zerosIq(TOTAL)
	addInto(sig, tone(Math.round(0.005 * FS), FS, offsetHz, amp), Math.round((startMs * FS) / 1000))
	return sig
}

function run(signal: Iq, seed: number, over: ConstructorParameters<typeof Harness>[0] = {}): Harness {
	const iq = gaussianNoise(mulberry32(seed), signal.re.length, SIGMA)
	addInto(iq, signal)
	const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE", ...over })
	h.start({ feed: false })
	h.push(iq, 8192)
	return h
}

const near = (h: Harness, hz: number, tol = 2000): TrackSnapshot[] =>
	h.tracks().filter(t => Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + hz)) <= tol)
const surfacesBurst = (t: TrackSnapshot) => t.maxBlockSnrDb >= t.thresholdDb + 3

describe("short-burst path", () => {
	// these tests run synchronously for ~50 s in total; yield a macrotask between them so vitest's worker RPC is not starved
	beforeEach(() => new Promise<void>(resolve => setImmediate(resolve)))

	it("opens a burst track for a 5 ms OOK burst at +10 dB SNR", () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 20: Short bursts
		// Validates: spec § 4.10
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(
				fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 0x7fffffff }),
				fc.integer({ min: -900, max: 900 }).map(x => x * 100).filter(x => Math.abs(x) >= 8000),
				fc.integer({ min: 120, max: 300 }),
				(seed, offset, startMs) => {
					const h = run(ookBurst(seed, offset, startMs, 10), seed)
					// P20 is about the opening snapshot: a burst straddling a block edge can be extended one block by
					// the long detector's hysteresis tail, and that non-burst segment clears `burst` on later snapshots
					const hits = h
						.of("track-open")
						.map(e => e.track)
						.filter(t => Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + offset)) <= 2000)
					expect(hits.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
					for (const t of hits) {
						expect(t.flags.burst).toBe(true)
						expect(t.thresholdDb).toBe(K_SHORT)
					}
				},
			),
			// fixed seed (spec § 13); the example straddles a 5 ms sub-block and the 300 ms block edge (296–301 ms),
			// which fixed sub-blocks split and the sliding window (Step 8) integrates whole
			{ numRuns: 100, seed: 20_001, examples: [[1, 16_700, 296]] },
		)
	}, 120_000)

	it("surfaces a block-aligned +10 dB OOK burst by the burst rule, as one burst track", () => {
		for (const seed of [31, 32, 33]) {
			const h = run(ookBurst(seed, 30_000, 200, 10), seed)
			const hits = near(h, 30_000)
			expect(new Set(hits.map(t => t.trackId)).size).toBe(1)
			expect(hits.some(surfacesBurst)).toBe(true)
		}
	})

	it.each([12, 13, 15])("finds a 10 dB-diluted 5 ms burst on the short path that the long path misses (seed %i)", seed => {
		// −1 dB in 12.5 kHz: 8.8–11.4 dB per-bin S/N over 5 ms measured (≈ 10 dB mean, k_short 8.5; with 5 frames the
		// spread is ≈ ±2 dB, so seeds 11 and 14 miss it and no single level suits every seed), ≈ 0 dB over 50 ms
		// (total 3.0 dB, still below k 4). Seeds 12, 13, 15 measured long-path 0 tracks, short-path 1 burst track.
		const sig = toneBurst(30_000, 200, -1)
		expect(near(run(sig, seed, { shortIntegrationMs: null }), 30_000)).toEqual([])
		const short = near(run(sig, seed), 30_000)
		expect(short.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
		expect(short.every(t => t.flags.burst)).toBe(true)
	})


	function heavyTail(seed: number, eventsPerMhzMin: number): Harness {
		const rng = mulberry32(seed)
		const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE" })
		h.start({ feed: false })
		for (let s = 0; s < 60; s++) {
			h.push(heavyTailedNoise(rng, FS, SIGMA, { fs: FS, eventsPerMhzSec: eventsPerMhzMin / 60, excessDb: 8, eventMs: 5 }), 16_384)
		}
		return h
	}

	it.each([1, 2, 3])("opens no burst track that passes the surfacing rule from calibrated heavy-tailed noise (seed %i)", seed => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 20: Short bursts
		// Validates: spec § 4.10
		const h = heavyTail(seed, 1)
		expect(h.tracks().filter(t => t.flags.burst && surfacesBurst(t))).toEqual([])
	}, 60_000)

	it("sees 60× more heavy-tail events as burst tracks, few of which pass the rule", () => {
		const h = heavyTail(4, 60)
		const bursts = h.of("track-open").map(e => e.track).filter(t => t.flags.burst)
		// 8 dB events sit just below k_short; at this seed only a few cross it (1 with fixed sub-blocks, measured)
		expect(bursts.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)
		const closed = h.of("track-close").map(e => e.track).filter(t => t.flags.burst)
		expect(closed.filter(surfacesBurst).length / Math.max(1, closed.length)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.2)
	}, 60_000)

	it("treats a continuous tone that starts late in a block as one ordinary track", () => {
		const n = 20 * BLOCK
		const start = 2 * BLOCK + Math.round(0.045 * FS) // 5 ms before the block ends
		const sig = zerosIq(n + 30 * BLOCK) // 30 quiet blocks after the tone, so the track closes inside the data
		addInto(sig, tone(n - start, FS, 25_000, 0.05), start)
		const h = run(sig, 8)
		const hits = near(h, 25_000)
		expect(new Set(hits.map(t => t.trackId)).size).toBe(1)
		const closed = h
			.of("track-close")
			.map(e => e.track)
			.filter(t => Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + 25_000)) <= 2000)
		expect(closed).toHaveLength(1)
		expect(closed[0]!.flags.burst).toBe(false)
		expect(closed[0]!.blocks).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(15)
	})

	it("never flags a TDMA 4FSK transmission as a burst", () => {
		const n = Math.round(1.2 * FS)
		const amp = Math.sqrt(10 ** 3 * SIGMA * SIGMA * (12_500 / FS))
		const h = run(fsk4Burst(mulberry32(21), n, FS, -40_000, amp, { tdma: true }), 21)
		const hits = near(h, -40_000, 3000)
		expect(hits.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
		expect(hits.every(t => !t.flags.burst)).toBe(true)
	})

	it("reuses the long path's frame powers: no extra FFT for the short path, twice the FFTs with 50 % overlap", () => {
		const iq = gaussianNoise(mulberry32(5), 20 * BLOCK, SIGMA)
		const count = (over: ConstructorParameters<typeof Harness>[0]) => {
			const spy = vi.spyOn(Fft.prototype, "transform")
			const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE", ...over })
			h.start({ feed: false })
			h.push(iq, 8192)
			const calls = spy.mock.calls.length
			spy.mockRestore()
			return calls
		}
		const off = count({ shortIntegrationMs: null })
		expect(count({})).toBe(off)
		const overlapped = count({ overlap: 0.5 })
		expect(overlapped).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2 * off - 1)
		expect(overlapped).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2 * off)
	})

	it("keeps block boundaries, the floor and a tone's level with 50 % overlap", () => {
		const n = 12 * BLOCK
		const sig = tone(n, FS, 20_000, 0.05)
		const a = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE" })
		const b = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE", overlap: 0.5 })
		for (const h of [a, b]) {
			h.start()
			const iq = gaussianNoise(mulberry32(9), n, SIGMA)
			addInto(iq, sig)
			h.push(iq, 8192)
		}
		const sa = a.of("block-summary").map(e => e.summary)
		const sb = b.of("block-summary").map(e => e.summary)
		// with overlap the frame starting N/2 before the data ends overhangs it, so b can finish one block fewer
		expect(sb.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(sa.length - 1)
		expect(sb.map(s => s.endSample)).toEqual(sa.slice(0, sb.length).map(s => s.endSample))
		const last = sb.length - 1
		expect(Math.abs(sb[last]!.floorDbfs - sa[last]!.floorDbfs)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.5)
		expect(Math.abs(Math.max(...sb[last]!.bins) - Math.max(...sa[last]!.bins))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.5)
		expect(sb.every(s => !s.overload)).toBe(true)
	})
})
```

Append after `defaultK`:

```ts
/** k for the 5 ms short-burst path (feasibility § 3a, T = 5 ms column; 250 Hz measured "> 14", unvalidated). */
export const SHORT_K_TABLE: readonly { rbwHz: number; kDb: number }[] = [
	{ rbwHz: 1000, kDb: 8.5 },
	{ rbwHz: 500, kDb: 11.5 },
	{ rbwHz: 250, kDb: 15 },
]

/** Nearest-RBW row (in octaves) of SHORT_K_TABLE. */
export function shortK(rbwHz: number): number {
	let row = SHORT_K_TABLE[0]!
	for (const r of SHORT_K_TABLE) {
		if (Math.abs(Math.log2(rbwHz / r.rbwHz)) < Math.abs(Math.log2(rbwHz / row.rbwHz))) row = r
	}
	return row.kDb
}
```

```ts
		if (!ep) return

		this.resetShort()
```
