Replace `onFrame` with:

```ts
	private onFrame(f: Frame): void {
		const ep = this.ep
		if (!ep) return
		if (this.resolving) {
			this.checkMarkerTimeout(f.startSample)
			if (this.resolving) return
		}
		const s0 = ep.settledStart
		if (s0 === null || f.startSample < s0) return
		// A frame belongs to the block it starts in; with a seam (or overlap) it may overhang the block end.
		const bi = Math.floor((f.startSample - s0) / this.blockSamples)
		const blockEnd = s0 + (bi + 1) * this.blockSamples
		if (bi !== this.blockIndex) {
			if (this.blockFrames > 0) this.finishBlock()
			this.blockIndex = bi
		}
		this.fft.transform(f.re, f.im)
		this.frameAcc.fill(0)
		accumulateShiftedPower(f.re, f.im, this.frameAcc)
		this.blockClipped += f.clipped
		this.blockFrames++
		// § 4.9 (Task 7a): a blanked or pending frame is neither integrated, short-pathed nor enveloped;
		// the frame after it is a seam for shortFrame, so the 5 ms window restarts
		if (this.blanker.offer(this.frameAcc, f.startSample) === "keep") {
			for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) this.blockAcc[i] = (this.blockAcc[i] ?? 0) + (this.frameAcc[i] ?? 0)
			this.shortFrame(f.startSample)
			if (this.tracker.openCount > 0) {
				powerToDb(this.frameAcc, 1, this.frameDb)
				this.tracker.frame(this.frameDb, f.startSample)
			}
		}
		if (f.startSample + this.hop >= blockEnd) this.finishBlock()
	}

	/**
	 * Short path (spec § 4.10): the same frame powers (no extra FFT) summed over a sliding T_short window
	 * that is evaluated on every frame, so a burst is integrated whole wherever it starts, across a block
	 * edge too (fixed sub-blocks would split a straddling burst and dilute each half by up to 3 dB).
	 * O(N) per frame: a ring of the last framesPerShort frame powers and a running sum. The window
	 * restarts on a seam (a frame that does not follow its predecessor) and at each epoch.
	 */
	private shortFrame(startSample: number): void {
		const d = this.shortDetector
		if (!d) return
		if (startSample !== this.shortNext) this.resetShort()
		this.shortNext = startSample + this.hop
		const w = this.framesPerShort
		const base = this.shortSlot * this.n
		for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) {
			const p = this.frameAcc[i] ?? 0
			this.shortAcc[i] = (this.shortAcc[i] ?? 0) + p - (this.shortRing[base + i] ?? 0)
			this.shortRing[base + i] = p
		}
		this.shortSlot = (this.shortSlot + 1) % w
		if (this.shortSlot === 0) this.resumShort() // exact once per window: the running sum never drifts
		if (this.shortFill < w) this.shortFill++
		if (this.shortFill < w || !this.floorReady) return
		powerToDb(this.shortAcc, w, this.shortDb)
		d.detect(this.shortDb, this.floorDb, this.shortOn)
		for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) {
			const p = this.shortDb[i] ?? NO_FLOOR_DBFS
			if (p > (this.burstPeakDb[i] ?? NO_FLOOR_DBFS)) this.burstPeakDb[i] = p
			// on-window frames of this block (saturating; only the comparison with burstMaxOnFrames matters)
			if (this.shortOn[i] === 1 && (this.burstCount[i] ?? 0) < 255) this.burstCount[i] = (this.burstCount[i] ?? 0) + 1
		}
	}

	private resetShort(): void {
		this.shortRing.fill(0)
		this.shortAcc.fill(0)
		this.shortSlot = 0
		this.shortFill = 0
	}

	private resumShort(): void {
		this.shortAcc.fill(0)
		for (let s = 0; s < this.framesPerShort; s++) {
			const base = s * this.n
			for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) this.shortAcc[i] = (this.shortAcc[i] ?? 0) + (this.shortRing[base + i] ?? 0)
		}
	}
```

```ts
	private finishBlock(): void {
		const ep = this.ep
		const s0 = ep?.settledStart
		const frames = this.blockFrames
		if (!ep || s0 === null || s0 === undefined || frames === 0) {
			this.resetBlock()
			return

		const blockStart = s0 + this.blockIndex * this.blockSamples
		const blockEnd = blockStart + this.blockSamples
		const gap = frames < this.expectedFrames || this.gaps.some(g => g.start < blockEnd && g.end > blockStart)
		const overload = this.blockClipped / (frames * this.n) > this.cfg.clipFraction
		const blanking = this.blanker.endBlock(this.blockAcc) // § 4.9: blanked frames are not integrated
		powerToDb(this.blockAcc, blanking.integrated, this.powerDb)
		this.burstCountDone.set(this.burstCount)
		this.burstPeakDone.set(this.burstPeakDb)

		this.extra.set(this.exclusionMask)
		this.spurs.mask(ep.absKey, this.extra)
		const masks = { dcGuardBins: this.dcBins, edgeBins: this.edgeBins, extra: this.extra }

		this.shortDetector?.setMasks(masks)

		const floorOccupied = this.floor.occupied(blockFloor, k, ep.absKey)
		const segOpts: SegmentOptions = {
			gapBins: this.gapBins,
			usableStartBin: this.edgeBins,
			usableEndBin: this.n - this.edgeBins + 1,
			exclusionEdges: this.exclusionEdges,
			rasterBinEdges: this.rasterEdges,
			skirtDb: SKIRT_DB,
			inWindow: this.masks.inWindow,
			farSkirt: { reachBins: Math.floor(FAR_SKIRT_REACH_HZ / this.binHz), minDb: FAR_SKIRT_DB, dcBin: this.n / 2 },
		}
		const segs = this.withoutLines(ep, segment(this.on, this.powerDb, this.floorDb, segOpts))

		if (ep.staleLeft > 0) {
			if (this.isStale(segs, ep)) {
				ep.staleLeft--
				this.staleAfterSettle++
				this.detector.reset()
				this.shortDetector?.reset()
				// the sliding short window spans blocks and frames stay contiguous through a stale discard: restart it,
				// or the first accepted block opens a burst ghost at the previous hop's emitters (spec § 4.6)
				this.resetShort()
				this.out.push({ kind: "stale-discard", epoch: ep.epoch, blocks: 1 })
				return
			}
			ep.staleLeft = 0
			ep.staleRef = null
		}

		const learn = !gap && !overload
		if (learn && !blanking.excluded) {
			for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) this.learnMask[i] = unmasked[i] === 1 && this.on[i] !== 1 ? 1 : 0
			this.floor.update(this.powerDb, this.learnMask, segs.length === 0, ep.absKey)
			this.spurs.observe(ep.absKey, { epoch: ep.epoch, centreHz: ep.centreHz, binHz: this.binHz }, this.on, this.blockMs)
			this.observeLines(ep)
		}
		const { trackSegs, burstSet } = this.mergeBursts(segs, segOpts)
		const block: TrackerBlock = {
			endSample: blockEnd,
			powerDb: burstSet.size > 0 ? this.mergedPower(burstSet) : this.powerDb,
			floorDb: this.floorDb,
			blockFloorDb: effective,
			thresholdDb: k,
			gap,
			overload,
			burstSegments: burstSet,
		}
		this.emit(this.tracker.flagSpurs(this.lineMask))
		this.noteActivity(trackSegs, blockEnd)
		this.emit(this.tracker.block(trackSegs, block))
		this.emit(this.wideband.block(floorOccupied ? [this.widebandSegment()] : [], { ...block, powerDb: this.powerDb }))
		this.tracker.trackBinsMask(this.lastTrackBins, 1)
		if (learn) {
			this.tracker.trackBinsMask(this.joined, 2)
			let usable = 0
			for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) usable += unmasked[i] ?? 0
			if (!blanking.excluded) this.detector.recordNoiseEdges(this.on, this.joined, this.blockMs / 60_000, (usable * this.binHz) / 1e6)
			this.settledSamples += this.blockSamples
		}
		if (overload) this.overloadedBlocks++
		this.lastFloorDbfs = effective
		if (this.feed) {
			this.out.push({ kind: "block-summary", summary: this.summary(ep, blockEnd, effective, k, trackSegs, floorOccupied, overload, burstSet) })
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Spec § 4.10: short-path segments that were on for ≤ BURST_MAX_ON_MS (≤ burstMaxOnFrames on-window
	 * frames in the block) and are either unseen by the long path or ≥ BURST_DILUTION_DB stronger than its
	 * peak replace the overlapping long segments and are marked as bursts; everything else stays with the long path.
	 */
	private mergeBursts(segs: Segment[], segOpts: SegmentOptions): { trackSegs: Segment[]; burstSet: Set<Segment> } {
		const burstSet = new Set<Segment>()
		if (!this.shortDetector) return { trackSegs: segs, burstSet }
		for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) this.burstOn[i] = (this.burstCountDone[i] ?? 0) > 0 ? 1 : 0
		const candidates = segment(this.burstOn, this.burstPeakDone, this.floorDb, segOpts)
		if (candidates.length === 0) return { trackSegs: segs, burstSet }
		const replaced = new Set<Segment>()
		for (const b of candidates) {
			let onFrames = 0
			for (let i = b.startBin; i < b.endBin; i++) onFrames = Math.max(onFrames, this.burstCountDone[i] ?? 0)
			if (onFrames > this.burstMaxOnFrames) continue
			const overlapping = segs.filter(s => s.startBin < b.endBin && s.endBin > b.startBin)
			const longPeak = overlapping.reduce((m, s) => Math.max(m, s.peakDb), -Infinity)
			if (longPeak > b.peakDb - BURST_DILUTION_DB) continue
			for (const s of overlapping) replaced.add(s)
			burstSet.add(b)
		}
		if (burstSet.size === 0) return { trackSegs: segs, burstSet }
		const trackSegs = [...segs.filter(s => !replaced.has(s)), ...burstSet].sort((a, b) => a.startBin - b.startBin)
		return { trackSegs, burstSet }
	}

	/** Block PSD for the tracker: long-path power, with the short-path max-hold over burst segments. */
	private mergedPower(burstSet: ReadonlySet<Segment>): Float32Array {
		this.mergedDb.set(this.powerDb)
		for (const b of burstSet) {
			for (let i = Math.max(0, b.startBin - SPEC_PAD_BINS); i < Math.min(this.n, b.endBin + SPEC_PAD_BINS); i++) {
				this.mergedDb[i] = this.burstPeakDone[i] ?? NO_FLOOR_DBFS
			}
		}
		return this.mergedDb
	}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement the alarm**

```ts
// src/core/spectrum/retune-alarm.ts
/**
 * Spec § 4.7 discontinuity alarm. Given the persistent features present in the previous settled
 * block (RF-fixed carriers and long-lived tracks) and this block's segments, decide whether the
 * receiver moved without the core seeing a command: ≥ ALARM_FRACTION of ≥ ALARM_MIN_FEATURES
 * visible features vanished. When most of them reappear at one common shift Δ (± toleranceHz),
 * Δ (apparent: new − old) is reported.
 */
export interface PersistentFeature {
	rfHz: number
	widthHz: number
}

export interface SegmentRange {
	startHz: number
	endHz: number
	centreHz: number
}

export const ALARM_MIN_FEATURES = 3
export const ALARM_FRACTION = 0.6
const MIN_SHIFT_MATCHES = 2
const EPS = 1e-9

function median(xs: number[]): number {
	const s = [...xs].sort((a, b) => a - b)
	const mid = s.length >> 1
	return s.length % 2 === 1 ? (s[mid] ?? 0) : ((s[mid - 1] ?? 0) + (s[mid] ?? 0)) / 2
}

export function untrackedRetuneAlarm(
	features: readonly PersistentFeature[],
	segments: readonly SegmentRange[],
	opts: { toleranceHz: number; visible: (hz: number) => boolean; minFeatures?: number; fraction?: number },
): { deltaHz: number | null } | null {
	const tol = opts.toleranceHz
	const minFeatures = opts.minFeatures ?? ALARM_MIN_FEATURES
	const fraction = opts.fraction ?? ALARM_FRACTION
	const eligible = features.filter(f => opts.visible(f.rfHz))
	if (eligible.length < minFeatures) return null
	const present = (hz: number): boolean => segments.some(s => hz >= s.startHz - tol && hz <= s.endHz + tol)
	const vanished = new Set(eligible.filter(f => !present(f.rfHz)))
	if (vanished.size < Math.ceil(fraction * eligible.length - EPS)) return null

	let best: { delta: number; matches: number[] } | null = null
	for (const f of vanished) {
		for (const s of segments) {
			const delta = s.centreHz - f.rfHz
			if (Math.abs(delta) <= tol) continue
			let inView = 0
			const matches: number[] = []
			for (const g of eligible) {
				const target = g.rfHz + delta
				if (!opts.visible(target)) continue
				inView++
				if (!vanished.has(g)) continue
				const m = segments.find(x => Math.abs(x.centreHz - target) <= tol)
				if (m) matches.push(m.centreHz - g.rfHz)
			}
			if (matches.length < MIN_SHIFT_MATCHES || matches.length < Math.ceil(fraction * inView - EPS)) continue
			const better =
				best === null ||
				matches.length > best.matches.length ||
				(matches.length === best.matches.length && Math.abs(delta) < Math.abs(best.delta))
			if (better) best = { delta, matches }
		}
	}
	return { deltaHz: best ? median(best.matches) : null }
}
```

```ts
	/** Open, non-burst tracks that were on in the last block and have been open ≥ minSamples (spec § 4.7). */
	longLived(minSamples: number): { rfHz: number; widthHz: number }[] {
		const out: { rfHz: number; widthHz: number }[] = []
		for (const t of this.open) {
			if (t.misses > 0 || t.flags.burst || t.lastSample - t.startSample < minSamples) continue
			const centroid = t.centroidDen > 0 ? t.centroidNum / t.centroidDen : (t.startBin + t.endBin - 1) / 2
			out.push({
				rfHz: t.epoch.centreHz + (centroid - this.n / 2) * this.opts.binHz,
				widthHz: (t.endBin - t.startBin) * this.opts.binHz,
			})
		}
		return out
	}
```

Add these methods after `isStale`:

```ts
	private segmentRf(s: Segment, ep: EpochState): SegmentRange {
		const rf = (bin: number): number => ep.centreHz + (bin - this.n / 2) * this.binHz
		return { startHz: rf(s.startBin - 0.5), endHz: rf(s.endBin - 0.5), centreHz: rf(s.centroidBin) }
	}

	/** Inside the usable span and not masked (DC, exclusions, baseband spurs). */
	private visibleRf(hz: number, ep: EpochState): boolean {
		const bin = Math.round((hz - ep.centreHz) / this.binHz + this.n / 2)
		if (bin < this.edgeBins || bin > this.n - this.edgeBins) return false
		return this.detector.unmasked()[bin] === 1
	}

	/** Long-lived tracks and RF-fixed carriers present in this block (spec § 4.7). */
	private persistentFeatures(segRanges: SegmentRange[], ep: EpochState): PersistentFeature[] {
		const tol = this.binHz
		const out: PersistentFeature[] = this.tracker.longLived(PERSISTENT_TRACK_S * this.fs)
		for (const c of this.spurs.rfCarriers()) {
			if (!this.visibleRf(c.rfHz, ep)) continue
			if (!segRanges.some(s => c.rfHz >= s.startHz - tol && c.rfHz <= s.endHz + tol)) continue
			if (out.some(f => Math.abs(f.rfHz - c.rfHz) <= tol)) continue
			out.push({ rfHz: c.rfHz, widthHz: c.widthBins * this.binHz })
		}
		return out
	}

	/**
	 * Spec § 4.7: the scene moved without a command we saw. Close tracks ("retune"), start an
	 * unverified epoch at the end of the alarm block with the caps centre unchanged (Δ is reported,
	 * not applied), and announce it. Persistent features re-arm only after new 10 s tracks.
	 */
	private startUntrackedEpoch(ep: EpochState, startSample: number, deltaHz: number | null): void {
		const epoch = ++this.epochCounter
		const info = { stream: ep.stream, epoch, centreHz: ep.centreHz, tuningTrust: "unverified" as const }
		this.emit(this.tracker.beginEpoch(info))
		this.emit(this.wideband.beginEpoch(info))
		this.ep = {
			...ep,
			epoch,
			tuningTrust: "unverified",
			settledStart: startSample,
			settleMode: "none",
			staleLeft: 0,
			staleRef: null,
		}
		this.blockIndex = -1
		this.lastTrackBins.fill(0)
		this.startEpochState()
		this.out.push({ kind: "untracked-retune", epoch, startSample, deltaHz })
		this.out.push({ kind: "epoch-started", epoch, startSample, settleMode: "none" })
	}
```

The alarm block itself is not fed to the floor, spur map, CFAR or tracker: its samples are at an unknown RF. Consumers (Task 32 engine, Task 35 runner) must not send a `pending-epoch` for it. They raise the status warning, and a sweep re-sends its current hop, which re-establishes `commanded`.

The spectral features themselves (`envelopeAcf`, `obwAtDb`, `dutyFromEnvelope`, `spectralShape`) were created in Task 9 because the tracker computes them; this task adds the classifier on top of `TrackSnapshot`.

Class rules, applied in order (thresholds from feasibility §4; analog FM, APRS, P25, NXDN and D-STAR are unvalidated until the §15 fixtures exist):

| # | Condition | Class |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `obwHz > 25 kHz` | `wideband` |
| 2 | `spectralShape === "narrow"` | `carrier` |
| 3 | `acf30 ≤ −0.5` and `acf60 ≥ +0.5` | `tdma-ms` |
| 4 | `blocks ≤ 4` and bursts are plausible (ISM prior is 1 or absent) | `ook-burst` |
| 5 | flat, OBW ≤ 5.5 kHz / ≤ 10.5 kHz / ≤ 14 kHz | `fsk4-6k25` / `fsk4-12k5` / `fsk2-wide` |
| 6 | peaked, 4–7.5 kHz / 7.5–18 kHz | `gmsk-narrow` / `analog-fm` |
| 7 | otherwise | `unknown` |

```ts
import fc from "fast-check"
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { leakOrIntermod } from "../../../../../src/core/scanner/classify/classifier.js"

import { CENTRE, FS, Harness } from "../../spectrum/pipeline-harness.js"

const SIGMA = 0.001
const RASTER = { spacingHz: 12_500, firstChannelHz: 446_006_250 }
const ampFor = (snrDb: number) => Math.sqrt(10 ** (snrDb / 10) * SIGMA * SIGMA * (12_500 / FS))

function track(id: string, centreHz: number, peakDbfs: number): TrackSnapshot {
	return {
		trackId: id, sourceId: "s1", stream: 1, epoch: 1, startSample: 0, lastSample: 0, centreHz, obwHz: 2000,
		obwMethod: "-20dB", peakDbfs, meanDbfs: peakDbfs, snrDb: 30, floorDbfs: -90, thresholdDb: 4, blocks: 5,
		maxBlockSnrDb: 30, dutyCycle: 1, spectralShape: "narrow",
		flags: { overload: false, gap: false, truncated: false, edge: false, skirt: false, obwBiased: false, spur: false, burst: false },
		tuningTrust: "commanded",
	}
}

describe("no neighbour ghosts", () => {
	it("a +60 dB emission produces no track in its neighbour raster channels", () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 18: No neighbour ghosts
		// Validates: spec § 6.2
		const channelArb = fc.constantFrom(-4, -3, -2, 2, 3, 4) // channel m sits at CENTRE + 6250 + 12500·(m − 1)
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 0x7fffffff }), channelArb, fc.integer({ min: 60, max: 66 }), (seed, m, snr) => {
				const rng = mulberry32(seed)
				const offset = 6250 + 12_500 * (m - 1)
				const n = Math.round(0.6 * FS)
				const iq = gaussianNoise(rng, n, SIGMA)
				addInto(iq, fsk4Burst(rng, n, FS, offset, ampFor(snr)))
				const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE" })
				h.start({ rasters: [RASTER], inWindow: false, feed: false })
				h.push(iq, 8192)
				const main = CENTRE + offset
				const tracks = h.tracks()
				expect(tracks.some(t => Math.abs(t.centreHz - main) <= 2000 && t.blocks >= 2)).toBe(true)
				// The 4FSK generator's own spectral regrowth sits ≈ 66 dB down about 23 kHz out; a hole in the
				// on-bins keeps it from merging, so the segmenter's far-skirt rule (Task 9) drops it: no track at all.
				for (const t of tracks) {
					for (const k of [-2, -1, 1, 2]) {
						expect(Math.abs(t.centreHz - (main + k * 12_500))).toBeGreaterThan(5000)
					}
				}
			}),
			// fixed seed (spec § 13: statistical boundary); the example is the regrowth counterexample [seed 1, m 2, +60 dB]
			{ numRuns: 100, seed: 18_001, examples: [[1, 2, 60]] },
		)
	}, 120_000)

	it("an exact 2f1 − f2 product of two stronger tracks is flagged suspected-intermod", () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 18: No neighbour ghosts
		// Validates: spec § 6.2
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(
				fc.integer({ min: 400_000_000, max: 470_000_000 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 12_500, max: 400_000 }),
				fc.integer({ min: -1000, max: 1000 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 21, max: 60 }),
				(f1, spacing, jitter, dbc) => {
					const f2 = f1 + spacing
					const product = 2 * f1 - f2 + jitter // within ±1 RBW (1 kHz)
					const others = [track("a", f1, -20), track("b", f2, -22)]
					expect(leakOrIntermod(track("p", product, -20 - dbc), others, () => [])).toBe("suspected-intermod")
					expect(leakOrIntermod(track("p", product + 2500, -20 - dbc), others, () => [])).toBeUndefined()
					const weaker = [track("a", f1, -20), track("b", f2, -25 - dbc)]
					expect(leakOrIntermod(track("p", product, -20 - dbc), weaker, () => [])).toBeUndefined()

		const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE" })

		expect(leakOrIntermod(p, [a, b], () => [])).toBe("suspected-intermod")
		expect(leakOrIntermod(a, [p, b], () => [])).toBeUndefined()
	})
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/classify/classifier.ts
import type {
	Classification,
	Hypothesis,
	Identity,
	ProtocolFamily,
	ScannerClass,
	ScannerProtocol,
} from "../types.js"
import type { TrackSnapshot } from "../../spectrum/types.js"

/**
 * Spectral-tier classification (spec §6.2): a coarse class from OBW, shape, envelope ACF and burst
 * length, then a ranked protocol hypothesis list multiplied by bandplan priors and cut to the job's
 * protocols. The channel tier (Task 41) refines it after the channelizer lands.
 */

const WIDEBAND_OBW_HZ = 25_000
const TDMA_ACF30_MAX = -0.5
const TDMA_ACF60_MIN = 0.5
const BURST_MAX_BLOCKS = 4
const FSK4_6K25_MAX_HZ = 5500
const FSK4_12K5_MAX_HZ = 10_500
const FSK2_WIDE_MAX_HZ = 14_000
const GMSK_MIN_HZ = 4000
const ANALOG_MIN_HZ = 7500
const ANALOG_MAX_HZ = 18_000
const DEFAULT_RBW_HZ = 1000
const LEAK_MIN_DB = 20

export const CLASS_HYPOTHESES: Readonly<Record<ScannerClass, readonly Hypothesis[]>> = {
	"tdma-ms": [{ protocol: "dmr", score: 0.9 }],
	"fsk4-12k5": [
		{ protocol: "dmr", score: 0.55 },
		{ protocol: "ysf", score: 0.45 },
		{ protocol: "p25p1", score: 0.4 },
		{ protocol: "nxdn96", score: 0.3 },
	],
	"fsk4-6k25": [
		{ protocol: "nxdn48", score: 0.5 },
		{ protocol: "dpmr", score: 0.5 },
	],
	"gmsk-narrow": [
		{ protocol: "dstar", score: 0.6 },
		{ protocol: "digital-unknown", score: 0.2 },
	],
	"fsk2-wide": [
		{ protocol: "pocsag", score: 0.6 },
		{ protocol: "flex", score: 0.4 },
	],
	"afsk-fm": [
		{ protocol: "aprs", score: 0.7 },
		{ protocol: "analog-fm", score: 0.3 },
	],
	"analog-fm": [
		{ protocol: "analog-fm", score: 0.6 },
		{ protocol: "aprs", score: 0.2 },
	],
	"ook-burst": [
		{ protocol: "ism", score: 0.6 },
		{ protocol: "digital-unknown", score: 0.1 },
	],
	carrier: [{ protocol: "carrier", score: 0.8 }],
	wideband: [{ protocol: "unknown", score: 0.3 }],
	unknown: [
		{ protocol: "unknown", score: 0.3 },
		{ protocol: "digital-unknown", score: 0.2 },
	],
}

const FAMILY: Readonly<Record<ScannerProtocol, ProtocolFamily>> = {
	"analog-fm": "analog",
	"analog-am": "analog",
	dmr: "digital-voice",
	p25p1: "digital-voice",
	p25p2: "digital-voice",
	nxdn48: "digital-voice",
	nxdn96: "digital-voice",
	ysf: "digital-voice",
	dstar: "digital-voice",
	dpmr: "digital-voice",
	pocsag: "pager",
	flex: "pager",
	aprs: "packet",
	ism: "ism",
	"digital-unknown": "unknown",
	carrier: "carrier",
	unknown: "unknown",
}

export function familyOf(p: ScannerProtocol): ProtocolFamily {
	return FAMILY[p]
}

export function classOf(track: TrackSnapshot, opts: { allowBurst?: boolean } = {}): ScannerClass {
	if (track.obwHz > WIDEBAND_OBW_HZ) return "wideband"
	if (track.spectralShape === "narrow") return "carrier"
	if (
		track.acf30 !== undefined &&
		track.acf60 !== undefined &&
		track.acf30 <= TDMA_ACF30_MAX &&
		track.acf60 >= TDMA_ACF60_MIN
	) {
		return "tdma-ms"
	}
	if ((opts.allowBurst ?? true) && track.blocks <= BURST_MAX_BLOCKS) return "ook-burst"
	if (track.spectralShape === "flat") {
		if (track.obwHz <= FSK4_6K25_MAX_HZ) return "fsk4-6k25"
		if (track.obwHz <= FSK4_12K5_MAX_HZ) return "fsk4-12k5"
		if (track.obwHz <= FSK2_WIDE_MAX_HZ) return "fsk2-wide"
		return "unknown"
	}
	if (track.obwHz >= GMSK_MIN_HZ && track.obwHz < ANALOG_MIN_HZ) return "gmsk-narrow"
	if (track.obwHz >= ANALOG_MIN_HZ && track.obwHz <= ANALOG_MAX_HZ) return "analog-fm"
	return "unknown"
}

/** Multiply by priors (missing = 1), zero everything outside a non-empty job protocol list, clamp, sort. */
export function applyPriors(
	h: readonly Hypothesis[],
	ctx: { priors: Partial<Record<ScannerProtocol, number>>; protocols: ScannerProtocol[] },
): Hypothesis[] {
	const only = ctx.protocols.length > 0 ? new Set(ctx.protocols) : null
	const out: Hypothesis[] = []
	for (const x of h) {
		if (only && !only.has(x.protocol)) continue
		const score = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x.score * (ctx.priors[x.protocol] ?? 1)))
		if (score > 0) out.push({ protocol: x.protocol, score })
	}
	return out.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.protocol.localeCompare(b.protocol))
}

export function classifySpectral(
	track: TrackSnapshot,
	ctx: { priors: Partial<Record<ScannerProtocol, number>>; protocols: ScannerProtocol[] },
): Classification {
	const cls = classOf(track, { allowBurst: (ctx.priors.ism ?? 1) >= 1 })
	return { class: cls, hypotheses: applyPriors(CLASS_HYPOTHESES[cls], ctx), tier: "spectral" }
}

/**
 * Spec §6.2 caps: `adjacent-leak` when the track's decoded identity is also decoded ≥ 20 dB stronger
 * at another frequency in the window; `suspected-intermod` when the centre is within ±1 RBW of
 * 2f1 − f2 for two other tracks that are both stronger.
 */
export function leakOrIntermod(
	track: TrackSnapshot,
	others: TrackSnapshot[],
	decodedIdentityAt: (identity: Identity) => { centreHz: number; peakDbfs: number }[],
	opts: { identity?: Identity; rbwHz?: number } = {},
): Classification["cap"] {
	const rbw = opts.rbwHz ?? DEFAULT_RBW_HZ
	if (opts.identity) {
		const apart = Math.max(rbw, track.obwHz / 2)
		const leak = decodedIdentityAt(opts.identity).some(
			o => Math.abs(o.centreHz - track.centreHz) > apart && o.peakDbfs - track.peakDbfs >= LEAK_MIN_DB,
		)
		if (leak) return "adjacent-leak"
	}
	const stronger = others.filter(o => o.trackId !== track.trackId && o.peakDbfs > track.peakDbfs)
	for (const a of stronger) {
		for (const b of stronger) {
			if (a === b) continue
			if (Math.abs(2 * a.centreHz - b.centreHz - track.centreHz) <= rbw) return "suspected-intermod"
		}
	}
	return undefined
}
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/pipeline-iq-image.test.ts
import fc from "fast-check"
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { addInto, gaussianNoise, mulberry32, tone } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import type { Iq } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import { CENTRE, FS, Harness } from "./pipeline-harness.js"

const SIGMA = 0.001
const N_SAMPLES = Math.round(0.4 * FS)
const AMP = 0.5

/** An IQ-imbalance image: the conjugate of the signal, `rejectionDb` down (mirrored about the LO). */
function mirror(sig: Iq, rejectionDb: number): Iq {
	const g = 10 ** (-rejectionDb / 20)
	return { re: sig.re.map(v => v * g), im: sig.im.map(v => -v * g) }
}
function run(seed: number, parts: Iq[]): Harness {
	const iq = gaussianNoise(mulberry32(seed), N_SAMPLES, SIGMA)
	for (const p of parts) addInto(iq, p)
	const h = new Harness({ format: "FLOAT32LE" })
	h.start({ feed: false })
	h.push(iq, 8192)
	return h
}
const at = (h: Harness, hz: number) => h.tracks().filter(t => Math.abs(t.centreHz - (CENTRE + hz)) <= 1000)
const offsetArb = fc.tuple(fc.boolean(), fc.integer({ min: 150, max: 900 })).map(([neg, k]) => (neg ? -1 : 1) * k * 100)

describe("IQ images in the pipeline", () => {

					const images = at(withImage, -x)
					expect(images.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
					expect(images.every(t => t.flags.iqImage)).toBe(true)
					expect(at(withImage, x).every(t => !t.flags.iqImage)).toBe(true)

					const other = tone(N_SAMPLES, FS, -x + nudge * 100, AMP * 10 ** (-independentDb / 20))
```

```ts
// src/core/spectrum/emissions/iq-image.ts
import type { TrackSnapshot } from "../types.js"

/**
 * Spec § 4.9: an RTL dongle's IQ imbalance mirrors every emission at baseband offset +x to −x,
 * typically 25–45 dB down. B is flagged as A's image when B sits at −offset(A) within
 * max(RBW, toleranceHz), neither is inside the DC guard, their −6 dB OBWs agree within
 * max(30 %, 2 RBW), and B is 20–65 dB below A. An independent emitter within 20 dB of its mirror
 * partner is never flagged.
 */
export type ImageCandidate = Pick<TrackSnapshot, "trackId" | "centreHz" | "obwHz" | "peakDbfs">

export interface IqImageOptions {
	rbwHz: number
	toleranceHz: number
	minRejectionDb: number
	maxRejectionDb: number
	dcGuardHz?: number
}

export const OBW_SIMILARITY = 0.3

export function flagIqImages(tracks: readonly ImageCandidate[], epochCentreHz: number, opts: IqImageOptions): Set<string> {
	const tol = Math.max(opts.rbwHz, opts.toleranceHz)
	const guard = Math.max(opts.dcGuardHz ?? 0, tol)
	const out = new Set<string>()
	for (const b of tracks) {
		const ob = b.centreHz - epochCentreHz
		if (Math.abs(ob) <= guard) continue
		for (const a of tracks) {
			if (a === b) continue
			const oa = a.centreHz - epochCentreHz
			if (Math.abs(oa) <= guard || Math.abs(ob + oa) > tol) continue
			if (Math.abs(b.obwHz - a.obwHz) > Math.max(OBW_SIMILARITY * a.obwHz, 2 * opts.rbwHz)) continue
			const rejection = a.peakDbfs - b.peakDbfs
			if (rejection < opts.minRejectionDb || rejection > opts.maxRejectionDb) continue
			out.add(b.trackId)
			break
		}
	}
	return out
}
```

```ts
	/** Open, non-burst tracks on in the last block, with the −6 dB OBW of their mean spectrum (spec § 4.9). */
	openCandidates(): { trackId: string; centreHz: number; obwHz: number; peakDbfs: number }[] {
		const out: { trackId: string; centreHz: number; obwHz: number; peakDbfs: number }[] = []
		for (const t of this.open) {
			if (t.misses > 0 || t.flags.burst) continue
			const mean = t.spectrum.meanDb()
			const a = Math.max(0, t.onMin - 1 - t.spectrum.lo)
			const e = Math.min(mean.length, t.onMax + 1 - t.spectrum.lo)
			const centroid = t.centroidDen > 0 ? t.centroidNum / t.centroidDen : (t.startBin + t.endBin - 1) / 2
			out.push({
				trackId: t.id,
				centreHz: t.epoch.centreHz + (centroid - this.n / 2) * this.opts.binHz,
				obwHz: obwAtDb(mean, a, e, this.opts.binHz, 6),
				peakDbfs: t.peakDbfs,
			})
		}
		return out
	}

	/** Sets a sticky flag on open tracks; returns the ids that were newly flagged. */
	raiseFlag(ids: ReadonlySet<string>, flag: "iqImage"): string[] {
		const raised: string[] = []
		for (const t of this.open) {
			if (!ids.has(t.id) || t.flags[flag]) continue
			t.flags[flag] = true
			raised.push(t.id)
		}
		return raised
	}

	snapshotOf(trackId: string): TrackSnapshot | undefined {
		const t = this.open.find(o => o.id === trackId)
		return t ? this.snapshot(t, this.n) : undefined
	}
```

```ts
	/**
	 * Spec § 4.9: flag IQ images among the open tracks in the block where both are open, so every
	 * snapshot of an image carries `iqImage` (events of this block are patched; tracks flagged now
	 * that emitted nothing this block get an immediate track-update).
	 */
	private emitWithImages(events: PipelineEvent[], ep: EpochState): void {
		const candidates = this.tracker.openCandidates()
		const images = flagIqImages(candidates, ep.centreHz, {
			rbwHz: this.binHz,
			toleranceHz: IMAGE_TOLERANCE_HZ,
			minRejectionDb: IMAGE_MIN_REJECTION_DB,
			maxRejectionDb: IMAGE_MAX_REJECTION_DB,
			dcGuardHz: this.dcGuardHz,
		})
		this.imageHz = candidates.filter(c => images.has(c.trackId)).map(c => c.centreHz)
		this.imageTracks = candidates.filter(c => images.has(c.trackId)).map(c => ({ centreHz: c.centreHz, obwHz: c.obwHz })) // § 4.9 artefact masks (Task 7a)
		if (images.size === 0) {
			this.emit(events)
			return
		}
		const raised = this.tracker.raiseFlag(images, "iqImage")
		const reported = new Set<string>()
		for (const e of events) {
			if (e.kind !== "track-open" && e.kind !== "track-update" && e.kind !== "track-close") continue
			if (images.has(e.track.trackId)) e.track.flags.iqImage = true
			reported.add(e.track.trackId)
		}
		this.emit(events)
		for (const id of raised) {
			if (reported.has(id)) continue
			const track = this.tracker.snapshotOf(id)
			if (track) this.emit([{ kind: "track-update", track }])
		}
	}
```

### Task 12: Bandplans, raster union, snapping, frequency keys

**Spec:** §5.1 (table), §5.2, §6.2 (priors), §7.4 (correction). **Depends on:** 1. **Batch:** S1-A

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/scanner/bandplan/builtin.ts`
- Create: `src/core/scanner/bandplan/index.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/bandplan/bandplan.test.ts`

Decisions inside this task:
- EU/US variants share an id; `bandplansFor(region)` returns the `"all"` plans plus the variant for the region: `EU` → EU, `US` and `CA` → US, every other region → no regional variant (the spec only defines EU and US; inventing AU/JP plans would be unvalidated data).
- `nxdn` in the spec table means both `nxdn48` and `nxdn96`. `tetra (energy only)` has no protocol in the vocabulary, so it adds nothing to the priors.
- Ranges without OBW classes in the table (`ism-*`, "burst") carry `obwHz: []`; the hop planner uses its free-range width for them.
- The single-channel `aprs` plan is a 16 kHz range around the channel with a 25 kHz raster anchored on it.
- `marine-vhf` excludes the AIS channels (161.975 and 162.025 MHz) by splitting the range around them.
- `priorsFor(ranges, hz)`: protocols listed by any range covering `hz` get 1, every other specific protocol 0.25 (soft bandplan prior); `carrier`, `unknown`, `digital-unknown` stay 1; `{}` when no covering range lists protocols. The job's protocol list (hard filter) is applied by the classifier, not here.

```ts
import type { Bandplan } from "../../../../../src/core/scanner/bandplan/index.js"

const MHz = (x: number) => Math.round(x * 1e6)
function plan(id: string, region: "EU" | "US" = "EU"): Bandplan {
	const p = resolveBandplan(id, region)
	if (!p) throw new Error(`missing ${id}`)
	return p
}

describe("built-in bandplans (spec § 5.1)", () => {
	it("PMR446: 446.0–446.2 MHz, 12.5 kHz from 446.00625, 9 k digital + 11 k analog", () => {

	it("dPMR446 and the land-mobile plans carry their rasters, sub-rasters and OBW classes", () => {

		const uhf = plan("uhf-land-mobile").ranges[0]!

		expect(uhf.obwHz).toEqual([9000, 11_000, 4500])
		expect(uhf.protocols).toEqual(["dmr", "analog-fm", "p25p1", "nxdn48", "nxdn96"])

		expect(vhf.rasters?.[1]).toEqual({ spacingHz: 6250, firstChannelHz: MHz(136.003125) })
		expect(vhf.protocols).toContain("pocsag")
	})
	it("amateur and APRS plans differ by region", () => {
		expect(plan("amateur-2m", "EU").ranges[0]).toMatchObject({ startHz: MHz(144), endHz: MHz(146), rasters: [{ spacingHz: 12_500 }] })
		expect(plan("amateur-2m", "US").ranges[0]!.rasters?.map(r => r.spacingHz)).toEqual([15_000, 20_000])
		expect(plan("amateur-2m", "US").ranges[0]!.endHz).toBe(MHz(148))
		expect([plan("amateur-70cm", "EU").ranges[0]!.startHz, plan("amateur-70cm", "EU").ranges[0]!.endHz]).toEqual([MHz(430), MHz(440)])
		expect([plan("amateur-70cm", "US").ranges[0]!.startHz, plan("amateur-70cm", "US").ranges[0]!.endHz]).toEqual([MHz(420), MHz(450)])
		const eu = plan("aprs", "EU").ranges[0]!
		expect(eu.startHz).toBeLessThan(MHz(144.8))
		expect(eu.endHz).toBeGreaterThan(MHz(144.8))
		expect(eu.rasters).toEqual([{ spacingHz: 25_000, firstChannelHz: MHz(144.8) }])
		expect(plan("aprs", "US").ranges[0]!.rasters?.[0]?.firstChannelHz).toBe(MHz(144.39))
	})
	it("ISM plans are free ranges; pager and marine plans have their rasters", () => {
		expect(plan("ism-433").ranges[0]).toMatchObject({ startHz: MHz(433.05), endHz: MHz(434.79), obwHz: [], protocols: ["ism"] })
		expect(plan("ism-433").ranges[0]!.rasters ?? []).toEqual([])
		expect(plan("ism-868").ranges[0]).toMatchObject({ startHz: MHz(863), endHz: MHz(870) })
		expect(plan("pager-vhf").ranges[0]).toMatchObject({ startHz: MHz(137), endHz: MHz(174), obwHz: [12_000], protocols: ["pocsag", "flex"] })
	})
	it("marine VHF never covers the AIS channels but keeps 162.000 MHz", () => {
		const ranges = plan("marine-vhf").ranges
		const inside = (hz: number) => ranges.some(r => hz >= r.startHz && hz <= r.endHz)
		expect(inside(MHz(161.975))).toBe(false)
		expect(inside(MHz(162.025))).toBe(false)
		expect(inside(MHz(162.0))).toBe(true)
		expect(inside(MHz(156.8))).toBe(true)
	})
	it("offers EU-only plans in the EU, US variants in the US and Canada, and only global plans elsewhere", () => {
		const ids = (r: Parameters<typeof bandplansFor>[0]) => bandplansFor(r).map(p => p.id).sort()
		expect(ids("EU")).toEqual(["amateur-2m", "amateur-70cm", "aprs", "dpmr446", "ism-433", "ism-868", "marine-vhf", "pager-vhf", "pmr446", "uhf-land-mobile", "vhf-land-mobile"])
		expect(ids("US")).toEqual(["amateur-2m", "amateur-70cm", "aprs", "marine-vhf", "pager-vhf", "uhf-land-mobile", "vhf-land-mobile"])

		expect(ids("JP")).toEqual(["marine-vhf", "pager-vhf", "uhf-land-mobile", "vhf-land-mobile"])
		expect(resolveBandplan("pmr446", "US")).toBeUndefined()
		expect(resolveBandplan("nope", "EU")).toBeUndefined()
		for (const p of bandplansFor("EU")) for (const r of p.ranges) expect(r.bandplanId).toBe(p.id)
	})
})

	})

describe("snapToRaster and frequency keys (spec § 5.2)", () => {
	const main = { spacingHz: 12_500, firstChannelHz: MHz(446.00625) }
	const sub = { spacingHz: 6250, firstChannelHz: MHz(446.003125) }
	it("snaps within max(1 kHz, spacing/4) and keeps the measured centre beyond it", () => {
		expect(rasterToleranceHz(12_500)).toBe(3125)
		expect(rasterToleranceHz(2500)).toBe(1000)
		expect(snapToRaster(MHz(446.09375) + 3125, [main], 0)).toEqual({ hz: MHz(446.09375), snapped: true })
		expect(snapToRaster(MHz(446.09375) + 3126, [main], 0)).toEqual({ hz: MHz(446.09375) + 3126, snapped: false })
	})
	it("applies the frequency-error correction before snapping", () => {
		expect(snapToRaster(MHz(446.09375) + 4000, [main], 1500)).toEqual({ hz: MHz(446.09375), snapped: true })
		expect(snapToRaster(MHz(446.09375) + 4000, [main], -1500)).toEqual({ hz: MHz(446.09375) + 5500, snapped: false })
	})
	it("picks the nearest channel of the raster union", () => {
		expect(snapToRaster(MHz(446.0975), [main, sub], 0)).toEqual({ hz: MHz(446.096875), snapped: true })
		expect(snapToRaster(MHz(446.0942), [main, sub], 0)).toEqual({ hz: MHz(446.09375), snapped: true })
	})
	it("keys raster channels by channel and free emissions by a fixed grid", () => {
		expect(frequencyKey(MHz(446.09375), true, 9000)).toBe("r:446093750")
		expect(gridToleranceHz(9000)).toBe(2500)
		expect(gridToleranceHz(4000)).toBe(2000)
		expect(gridToleranceHz(16_000)).toBe(4000)
		expect(frequencyKey(433_920_400, false, 9000)).toBe("g:433920000")
	})
	it("grid keys are a pure function of the centre, within tol/2 of it", () => {
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 24_000_000, max: 1_766_000_000 }), fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 200_000 }), (hz, obw) => {
				const tol = gridToleranceHz(obw)
				expect(tol % 500).toBe(0)
				expect(tol).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2000)
				const key = frequencyKey(hz, false, obw)
				expect(key).toBe(frequencyKey(hz, false, obw))
				expect(Math.abs(Number(key.slice(2)) - hz)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(tol / 2)
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})
})

describe("priorsFor", () => {
	it("weights listed protocols at 1, others at 0.25, generic ones at 1, and is empty outside plans", () => {

		expect(priorsFor([{ startHz: 0, endHz: MHz(1000) }], MHz(446))).toEqual({})
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/bandplan/builtin.ts
import type { ScannerProtocol, ScanRange } from "../types.js"
import type { Bandplan } from "./index.js"

/** Built-in bandplans: exactly the spec § 5.1 table. Data only; served by GET /api/scanner/bandplans. */

const MHz = (x: number): number => Math.round(x * 1e6)
const LAND_MOBILE_OBW = [9000, 11_000, 4500]
const LAND_MOBILE: ScannerProtocol[] = ["dmr", "analog-fm", "p25p1", "nxdn48", "nxdn96"] // tetra: energy only

function range(id: string, startMhz: number, endMhz: number, r: Omit<ScanRange, "startHz" | "endHz" | "bandplanId">): ScanRange {
	return { startHz: MHz(startMhz), endHz: MHz(endMhz), ...r, bandplanId: id }
}
function raster(spacingHz: number, firstMhz: number): { spacingHz: number; firstChannelHz: number } {
	return { spacingHz, firstChannelHz: MHz(firstMhz) }
}
function aprsChannel(id: string, mhz: number): ScanRange {
	return { startHz: MHz(mhz) - 8000, endHz: MHz(mhz) + 8000, rasters: [raster(25_000, mhz)], obwHz: [16_000], protocols: ["aprs"], bandplanId: id }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the bandplan API**

```ts
// src/core/scanner/bandplan/index.ts
import type { BandRegion } from "@wavekit/api-types"
import type { Raster } from "../../spectrum/types.js"
import type { ScannerProtocol, ScanRange } from "../types.js"
import { BUILTIN_BANDPLANS } from "./builtin.js"

export type BandRegionCode = BandRegion

export interface Bandplan {
	id: string
	region: "all" | BandRegionCode
	name: string
	ranges: ScanRange[]
}

export { BUILTIN_BANDPLANS }

const SPECIFIC_PROTOCOLS = [
	"analog-fm", "analog-am", "dmr", "p25p1", "p25p2", "nxdn48", "nxdn96", "ysf", "dstar", "dpmr",
	"pocsag", "flex", "aprs", "ism",
] as const satisfies readonly ScannerProtocol[]
const SOFT_PRIOR = 0.25

function variantFor(region: BandRegionCode): BandRegionCode | null {
	if (region === "EU") return "EU"
	if (region === "US" || region === "CA") return "US"
	return null
}

export function bandplansFor(region: BandRegionCode): Bandplan[] {
	const variant = variantFor(region)
	return BUILTIN_BANDPLANS.filter(p => p.region === "all" || p.region === variant)
}

export function resolveBandplan(id: string, region: BandRegionCode): Bandplan | undefined {
	return bandplansFor(region).find(p => p.id === id)
}

/** Distinct rasters of the ranges (same spacing and channel phase = same raster); the first is the main raster. */
export function rasterUnion(ranges: ScanRange[]): Raster[] {
	const out: Raster[] = []
	const seen = new Set<string>()
	for (const r of ranges) {
		for (const x of r.rasters ?? []) {
			if (!(x.spacingHz > 0)) continue
			const phase = ((x.firstChannelHz % x.spacingHz) + x.spacingHz) % x.spacingHz
			const key = `${x.spacingHz}:${phase}`
			if (seen.has(key)) continue
			seen.add(key)
			out.push(x)
		}
	}
	return out
}

export function rasterToleranceHz(spacingHz: number): number {
	return Math.max(1000, spacingHz / 4)
}

export function gridToleranceHz(obwHz: number): number {
	return Math.round(Math.max(2000, obwHz / 4) / 500) * 500
}

/** Spec § 5.2: snap the corrected centre (hz − correctionHz) to the nearest channel within tolerance. */
export function snapToRaster(hz: number, rasters: Raster[], correctionHz: number): { hz: number; snapped: boolean } {
	const corrected = hz - correctionHz
	let best: { hz: number; d: number; spacing: number } | null = null
	for (const r of rasters) {
		if (!(r.spacingHz > 0)) continue
		const ch = r.firstChannelHz + Math.round((corrected - r.firstChannelHz) / r.spacingHz) * r.spacingHz
		const d = Math.abs(corrected - ch)
		if (d > rasterToleranceHz(r.spacingHz)) continue
		const better =
			best === null ||
			d < best.d ||
			(d === best.d && (r.spacingHz > best.spacing || (r.spacingHz === best.spacing && ch < best.hz)))
		if (better) best = { hz: ch, d, spacing: r.spacingHz }
	}
	return best ? { hz: best.hz, snapped: true } : { hz: corrected, snapped: false }
}

/** `r:<channel Hz>` for snapped centres, `g:<grid Hz>` (fixed grid, pure function of the centre) otherwise. */
export function frequencyKey(hz: number, snapped: boolean, obwHz: number): string {
	if (snapped) return `r:${Math.round(hz)}`
	const tol = gridToleranceHz(obwHz)
	return `g:${Math.round(hz / tol) * tol}`
}

export function priorsFor(ranges: ScanRange[], hz: number): Partial<Record<ScannerProtocol, number>> {
	const listed = new Set<ScannerProtocol>()
	for (const r of ranges) {
		if (hz < r.startHz || hz > r.endHz) continue
		for (const p of r.protocols ?? []) listed.add(p)
	}
	if (listed.size === 0) return {}
	const out: Partial<Record<ScannerProtocol, number>> = { carrier: 1, unknown: 1, "digital-unknown": 1 }
	for (const p of SPECIFIC_PROTOCOLS) out[p] = listed.has(p) ? 1 : SOFT_PRIOR
	return out
}
```

### Task 13: Hop planner

**Spec:** §5.3, §13 P1 and P2, §11 (44 hops). **Depends on:** 1, 12. **Batch:** S1-A

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/scanner/plan/hop-planner.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/plan/hop-planner.test.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/plan/hop-planner-props.test.ts`

Rules (spec §5.3, made exact):
- `H = fs·u/2`; `g = max(dcGuardHz, 2·RBW)`; `m = ppmMargin·10⁻⁶·h` per hop. `HopPlan.ppmMarginHz` is the largest per-hop `m`.
- **Requirements.** Raster channels: every channel `c = first + k·spacing` of every raster of a range with `start ≤ c ≤ end`, not inside an exclusion (closed interval); planning width `w` = the largest raster spacing that produces `c`. Free ranges (no rasters): every point of `[start, end]` minus exclusions, width `w = max(obwHz)` or `FREE_RANGE_WIDTH_HZ` (25 kHz) when the range has no OBW classes.
- **Expected emission edge** of a channel: `edgeHalf = max(OBW classes ≤ spacing)/2`; if no class fits the spacing, the smallest class; if the range has no classes, `0.72·spacing` (9 k / 12.5 k). An emission wider than a raster's spacing does not run on that raster, so an 11 kHz analog class is not applied to 6.25 kHz sub-raster channels.
- **Slack** `s = min raster spacing` (0 without rasters) is reserved on both sides of every greedy window so that the DC search (±`s`) never uncovers a channel. Coverage margin `M = H − s`; a requirement is covered by greedy centre `h` if `[c − w/2, c + w/2] ⊆ [h − M, h + M]`.
- **Greedy covering.** If all requirements fit in `2M`, one hop at the midpoint of their extent. Otherwise the first hop sits at `low + M` (the lowest requirement edge on the window's low margin); each next hop is `prev + step` with `step = 2H − w_max − 2s` when the lowest uncovered requirement fits in that window (contiguous scope: hops overlap by ≥ `w_max` after any DC shift), else jumps to `low + M` (a gap from exclusions or disjoint ranges). Only non-excluded requirements create hops, so no hop is all-excluded. 400–470 MHz at 2.048 Msps, 12.5 kHz: `step` = 1600.9 kHz → 44 hops (spec says 2H − w_max ≈ 1.626 MHz → 44; the 2s reserve leaves the count unchanged).
- **DC placement.** Candidates: multiples of 100 Hz within `[h − s, h + s] ∩ tunerRange`. Objective: `min over channels near the hop of (|c − h| − edgeHalf)`; maximise; ties → half-raster points of the main raster (first raster of the union), then nearest to the greedy centre, then lower. Free-only hops keep the greedy centre (first visit; spec "previous visit" placement is the scheduler's job), clamped to the tuner range.
- **Hop report.** `covered = [h − H, h + H]`; `channelCount` = raster channels with `|c − h| + w/2 ≤ H`; `dcMinEdgeHz` = the objective over those channels (H when there are none); `dcAdjacentChannelsHz` = those with `|c − h| − edgeHalf < g + m`, ascending; `excluded` = exclusions clipped to the window and merged.
- `w_max ≥ 2(H − s)` (a channel wider than the usable span) → no hops; the preview reports `channel-too-wide`.

```ts
		expect(plan.dcGuardHz).toBe(2000)
		expect(plan.hops.map(h => h.index)).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 44 }, (_, i) => i))
		for (let i = 1; i < 44; i++) expect(plan.hops[i]!.centreHz - plan.hops[i - 1]!.centreHz).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2 * 819_200 - 12_500)
		expect(plan.hops.reduce((n, h) => n + h.channelCount, 0)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5600)
		expect(plan.ppmMarginHz).toBeCloseTo(2e-6 * plan.hops[43]!.centreHz, 6)
	})

	it("plans PMR446 as one hop with DC between channels and reports the analog-class neighbours", () => {
		const plan = planHops(input({ ranges: pmr([9000, 11_000]) }))
		expect(plan.hops).toHaveLength(1)
		const hop = plan.hops[0]!
		expect(hop.centreHz).toBe(MHz(446.1))
		expect((hop.centreHz - MHz(446.00625)) % 12_500).toBe(6250)
		expect(hop.channelCount).toBe(16)
		expect(hop.dcMinEdgeHz).toBe(750)
		expect(hop.dcAdjacentChannelsHz).toEqual([MHz(446.09375), MHz(446.10625)])
	})

	it("gives 1.75 kHz for 9 kHz digital: clears g but not g + m at 446 MHz", () => {
		const withMargin = planHops(input({ ranges: pmr([9000]), rbwHz: 500 })).hops[0]!
		expect(withMargin.dcMinEdgeHz).toBe(1750)
		expect(withMargin.dcAdjacentChannelsHz).toEqual([MHz(446.09375), MHz(446.10625)])
		const noMargin = planHops(input({ ranges: pmr([9000]), rbwHz: 500, ppmMargin: 0 })).hops[0]!
		expect(noMargin.dcAdjacentChannelsHz).toEqual([])
	})

	it("uses the coarse-RBW guard at 2.4 Msps", () => {
		const plan = planHops(input({ ranges: pmr([9000]), sampleRateHz: 2_400_000, rbwHz: 2_400_000 / 2048 }))
		expect(plan.dcGuardHz).toBeCloseTo(2343.75, 6)
	})

	it("drops all-excluded windows and reports exclusions clipped to each hop", () => {
		const ranges = [{ startHz: MHz(400), endHz: MHz(410), rasters: [{ spacingHz: 12_500, firstChannelHz: MHz(400.00625) }], obwHz: [9000] }]
		const full = planHops(input({ ranges }))
		const cut = planHops(input({ ranges, exclusions: [{ startHz: MHz(401.5), endHz: MHz(408.5) }] }))
		expect(cut.hops.length).toBeLessThan(full.hops.length)
		for (const h of cut.hops) expect(h.channelCount).toBeGreaterThan(0)
		const withEx = cut.hops.filter(h => h.excluded.length > 0)
		expect(withEx.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
		for (const h of withEx) {
			for (const x of h.excluded) {
				expect(x.startHz).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(h.covered.startHz)
				expect(x.endHz).toBeLessThanOrEqual(h.covered.endHz)
			}
		}
	})

	it("keeps every hop centre inside the tuner range", () => {
		const plan = planHops(
			input({
				ranges: [{ startHz: MHz(400.0), endHz: MHz(400.1), rasters: [{ spacingHz: 12_500, firstChannelHz: MHz(400.00625) }], obwHz: [9000] }],
				tunerRange: { startHz: MHz(400.06), endHz: MHz(1766) },
			}),
		)
		expect(plan.hops).toHaveLength(1)
		expect(plan.hops[0]!.centreHz).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(MHz(400.06))
	})

	it("returns no hops when a channel is wider than the usable span", () => {
		const plan = planHops(input({ ranges: [{ startHz: MHz(400), endHz: MHz(410), rasters: [{ spacingHz: 2_000_000, firstChannelHz: MHz(401) }] }] }))
		expect(plan.hops).toEqual([])
	})

	it("covers a free ISM range with 25 kHz planning width", () => {
		const plan = planHops(input({ ranges: [{ startHz: MHz(433.05), endHz: MHz(434.79), obwHz: [] }] }))
		expect(plan.hops).toHaveLength(2)
		for (let p = MHz(433.05); p <= MHz(434.79); p += 1000) {
			expect(plan.hops.some(h => Math.abs(p - h.centreHz) + 12_500 <= plan.usableHalfSpanHz + 1e-6)).toBe(true)
		}
		expect(plan.hops.every(h => h.channelCount === 0 && h.dcMinEdgeHz === plan.usableHalfSpanHz)).toBe(true)
	})

	it("describeHop reports a fixed in-window centre with the same rules", () => {
		const hop = describeHop(0, MHz(446.1), input({ ranges: pmr([9000, 11_000]) }))
		expect(hop).toEqual(planHops(input({ ranges: pmr([9000, 11_000]) })).hops[0])
	})
})
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the hop planner**

```ts
// src/core/scanner/plan/hop-planner.ts
import { rasterUnion } from "../bandplan/index.js"
import type { FreqRange, Raster } from "../../spectrum/types.js"
import type { Hop, HopPlan, ScanExclusion, ScanRange } from "../types.js"

/** Spec § 5.3: greedy covering with a reserved DC-search slack, DC placement on a 100 Hz grid. */
export interface HopPlanInput {
	ranges: ScanRange[]
	exclusions: ScanExclusion[]
	sampleRateHz: number
	usableFraction: number
	rbwHz: number
	dcGuardHz: number
	ppmMargin: number
	tunerRange: FreqRange
}

/** A raster channel: centre, planning width (raster spacing) and expected emission half-width. */
export interface PlanItem {
	hz: number
	widthHz: number
	edgeHalfHz: number
}

export const FREE_RANGE_WIDTH_HZ = 25_000
const DC_GRID_HZ = 100
const DEFAULT_OBW_FRACTION = 0.72 // 9 kHz on 12.5 kHz
const EPS = 1e-6

interface FreeSpan {
	lo: number
	hi: number
	widthHz: number
	next: number
}

function inExclusion(hz: number, exclusions: readonly FreqRange[]): boolean {
	return exclusions.some(x => hz >= x.startHz && hz <= x.endHz)
}

function clamp(hz: number, r: FreqRange): number {
	return Math.min(r.endHz, Math.max(r.startHz, hz))
}

export function rasterItems(ranges: ScanRange[], exclusions: ScanExclusion[]): PlanItem[] {
	const byHz = new Map<number, PlanItem>()
	for (const r of ranges) {
		const classes = r.obwHz ?? []
		for (const raster of r.rasters ?? []) {
			const s = raster.spacingHz
			if (!(s > 0)) continue
			let fitting = -Infinity
			for (const o of classes) if (o <= s) fitting = Math.max(fitting, o)
			const obw = fitting > 0 ? fitting : classes.length > 0 ? Math.min(...classes) : DEFAULT_OBW_FRACTION * s
			const first = Math.ceil((r.startHz - raster.firstChannelHz) / s - EPS)
			for (let k = first; raster.firstChannelHz + k * s <= r.endHz + EPS; k++) {
				const hz = Math.round(raster.firstChannelHz + k * s)
				if (inExclusion(hz, exclusions)) continue
				const prev = byHz.get(hz)
				byHz.set(hz, { hz, widthHz: Math.max(s, prev?.widthHz ?? 0), edgeHalfHz: Math.max(obw / 2, prev?.edgeHalfHz ?? 0) })
			}
		}
	}
	return [...byHz.values()].sort((a, b) => a.hz - b.hz)
}

function freeSpans(ranges: ScanRange[], exclusions: ScanExclusion[]): FreeSpan[] {
	const out: FreeSpan[] = []
	for (const r of ranges) {
		if ((r.rasters ?? []).length > 0) continue
		const widthHz = (r.obwHz ?? []).reduce((a, b) => Math.max(a, b), 0) || FREE_RANGE_WIDTH_HZ
		let pieces: [number, number][] = [[r.startHz, r.endHz]]
		for (const x of exclusions) {
			pieces = pieces.flatMap(([a, b]): [number, number][] => {
				if (x.endHz < a || x.startHz > b) return [[a, b]]
				const parts: [number, number][] = []
				if (x.startHz > a) parts.push([a, x.startHz])
				if (x.endHz < b) parts.push([x.endHz, b])
				return parts
			})
		}
		for (const [lo, hi] of pieces) out.push({ lo, hi, widthHz, next: lo })
	}
	return out
}

function greedyCentres(items: PlanItem[], spans: FreeSpan[], H: number, slack: number, wMax: number): number[] {
	const margin = H - slack
	const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) => a.hz - a.widthHz / 2 - (b.hz - b.widthHz / 2))
	let lowAll = Infinity
	let highAll = -Infinity
	for (const i of sorted) {
		lowAll = Math.min(lowAll, i.hz - i.widthHz / 2)
		highAll = Math.max(highAll, i.hz + i.widthHz / 2)
	}
	for (const s of spans) {
		lowAll = Math.min(lowAll, s.lo - s.widthHz / 2)
		highAll = Math.max(highAll, s.hi + s.widthHz / 2)
	}
	if (highAll - lowAll <= 2 * margin) return [(lowAll + highAll) / 2]
	const step = 2 * H - wMax - 2 * slack
	const covered = new Uint8Array(sorted.length)
	const out: number[] = []
	let ptr = 0
	let prev: number | null = null
	for (;;) {
		while (ptr < sorted.length && covered[ptr] === 1) ptr++
		let low = Infinity
		let high = -Infinity
		const first = sorted[ptr]
		if (first) {
			low = first.hz - first.widthHz / 2
			high = first.hz + first.widthHz / 2
		}
		for (const s of spans) {
			if (s.next > s.hi) continue
			const l = s.next - s.widthHz / 2
			if (l < low) {
				low = l
				high = s.next + s.widthHz / 2
			}
		}
		if (low === Infinity) break
		let hG = low + margin
		if (prev !== null) {
			const c = prev + step
			if (low >= c - margin - EPS && high <= c + margin + EPS) hG = c
		}
		out.push(hG)
		prev = hG
		const lo = hG - margin - EPS
		const hi = hG + margin + EPS
		for (let j = ptr; j < sorted.length; j++) {
			const x = sorted[j]
			if (!x) break
			const xl = x.hz - x.widthHz / 2
			if (xl > hi) break
			if (xl >= lo && x.hz + x.widthHz / 2 <= hi) covered[j] = 1
		}
		for (const s of spans) {
			if (s.next > s.hi) continue
			const upTo = hG + margin - s.widthHz / 2
			if (upTo < s.next) continue
			s.next = upTo >= s.hi ? Infinity : upTo
		}
	}
	return out
}

/** Maximise min(|c − h| − edgeHalf) over the 100 Hz grid in [greedy ± slack] ∩ tunerRange. */
export function placeDc(
	greedyHz: number,
	slackHz: number,
	items: PlanItem[],
	mainRaster: Raster | null,
	tunerRange: FreqRange,
): { centreHz: number; minEdgeHz: number } {
	const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) => a.hz - b.hz)
	const maxEdge = sorted.reduce((m, i) => Math.max(m, i.edgeHalfHz), 0)
	// min(|c − h| − edgeHalf), walking outward from h; stops once no farther channel can lower it.
	const objective = (h: number): number => {
		let m = Infinity
		const at = lowerBound(sorted, h)
		for (let j = at; j < sorted.length; j++) {
			const i = sorted[j]
			if (!i || i.hz - h - maxEdge >= m) break
			m = Math.min(m, i.hz - h - i.edgeHalfHz)
		}
		for (let j = at - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
			const i = sorted[j]
			if (!i || h - i.hz - maxEdge >= m) break
			m = Math.min(m, h - i.hz - i.edgeHalfHz)
		}
		return m
	}
	const score = (h: number): number => (items.length > 0 ? objective(h) : 0)
	const isHalf = (h: number): boolean => {
		if (!mainRaster) return false
		const s = mainRaster.spacingHz
		return (((h - mainRaster.firstChannelHz) % s) + s) % s === s / 2
	}
	const prefer = (a: number, b: number): boolean => {
		const ha = isHalf(a)
		const hb = isHalf(b)
		if (ha !== hb) return ha
		const da = Math.abs(a - greedyHz)
		const db = Math.abs(b - greedyHz)
		if (da !== db) return da < db
		return a < b
	}
	const lo = Math.max(tunerRange.startHz, greedyHz - slackHz)
	const hi = Math.min(tunerRange.endHz, greedyHz + slackHz)
	const first = Math.ceil(lo / DC_GRID_HZ) * DC_GRID_HZ
	if (first > hi) {
		const c = clamp(greedyHz, tunerRange)
		return { centreHz: c, minEdgeHz: objective(c) }
	}
	let best = first
	let bestScore = score(first)
	for (let h = first + DC_GRID_HZ; h <= hi; h += DC_GRID_HZ) {
		const v = score(h)
		if (v > bestScore + EPS || (Math.abs(v - bestScore) <= EPS && prefer(h, best))) {
			best = h
			bestScore = v
		}
	}
	return { centreHz: best, minEdgeHz: objective(best) }
}

function lowerBound(items: PlanItem[], hz: number): number {
	let lo = 0
	let hi = items.length
	while (lo < hi) {
		const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1
		if ((items[mid]?.hz ?? Infinity) < hz) lo = mid + 1
		else hi = mid
	}
	return lo
}

function mergeRanges(ranges: FreqRange[]): FreqRange[] {
	const sorted = [...ranges].sort((a, b) => a.startHz - b.startHz)
	const out: FreqRange[] = []
	for (const r of sorted) {
		const last = out.at(-1)
		if (last && r.startHz <= last.endHz) last.endHz = Math.max(last.endHz, r.endHz)
		else out.push({ ...r })
	}
	return out
}

function hopAt(index: number, centreHz: number, items: PlanItem[], input: HopPlanInput, H: number, g: number): Hop {
	const m = input.ppmMargin * 1e-6 * centreHz
	let channelCount = 0
	let dcMinEdgeHz = H
	const dcAdjacentChannelsHz: number[] = []
	for (let j = lowerBound(items, centreHz - H); j < items.length; j++) {
		const i = items[j]
		if (!i || i.hz > centreHz + H) break
		const d = Math.abs(i.hz - centreHz)
		if (d + i.widthHz / 2 > H + EPS) continue
		channelCount++
		const edge = d - i.edgeHalfHz
		dcMinEdgeHz = Math.min(dcMinEdgeHz, edge)
		if (edge < g + m) dcAdjacentChannelsHz.push(i.hz)
	}
	const lo = centreHz - H
	const hi = centreHz + H
	const excluded = mergeRanges(
		input.exclusions
			.filter(x => x.endHz > lo && x.startHz < hi)
			.map(x => ({ startHz: Math.max(x.startHz, lo), endHz: Math.min(x.endHz, hi) })),
	)
	return { index, centreHz, covered: { startHz: lo, endHz: hi }, channelCount, dcAdjacentChannelsHz, excluded, dcMinEdgeHz }
}

function geometry(input: HopPlanInput): { H: number; g: number } {
	return { H: (input.sampleRateHz * input.usableFraction) / 2, g: Math.max(input.dcGuardHz, 2 * input.rbwHz) }
}

/** The hop report for a given centre (in-window jobs use the source's current centre). */
export function describeHop(index: number, centreHz: number, input: HopPlanInput): Hop {
	const { H, g } = geometry(input)
	return hopAt(index, centreHz, rasterItems(input.ranges, input.exclusions), input, H, g)
}

export function planHops(input: HopPlanInput): HopPlan {
	const { H, g } = geometry(input)
	const items = rasterItems(input.ranges, input.exclusions)
	const spans = freeSpans(input.ranges, input.exclusions)
	const rasters = rasterUnion(input.ranges)
	const main = rasters[0] ?? null
	const slack = items.length > 0 ? rasters.reduce((a, r) => Math.min(a, r.spacingHz), Infinity) : 0
	let wMax = 0
	for (const i of items) wMax = Math.max(wMax, i.widthHz)
	for (const s of spans) wMax = Math.max(wMax, s.widthHz)
	const finish = (hops: Hop[]): HopPlan => ({
		hops,
		usableHalfSpanHz: H,
		dcGuardHz: g,
		ppmMarginHz: hops.reduce((a, h) => Math.max(a, input.ppmMargin * 1e-6 * h.centreHz), 0),
	})
	if ((items.length === 0 && spans.length === 0) || wMax >= 2 * (H - slack)) return finish([])
	const hops = greedyCentres(items, spans, H, slack, wMax).map((hG, index) => {
		let centre: number
		if (slack > 0) {
			const from = lowerBound(items, hG - H - slack)
			const near: PlanItem[] = []
			for (let j = from; j < items.length; j++) {
				const i = items[j]
				if (!i || i.hz > hG + H + slack) break
				near.push(i)
			}
			centre = placeDc(hG, slack, near, main, input.tunerRange).centreHz
		} else {
			centre = clamp(hG, input.tunerRange)
		}
		return hopAt(index, centre, items, input, H, g)
	})
	return finish(hops)
}
```

### Task 14: Plan preview (validation, derived defaults, provenance, estimates, issues)

**Spec:** §5.4, §6.4 (`confirmHoldMs`), §9 (CPU, disk), §10.1 (`ScanJobSpec` defaults), §10.5 (POI), §11, §13 P15. **Depends on:** 1, 12, 13. **Batch:** S1-A

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/scanner/plan/cost.ts`
- Create: `src/core/scanner/plan/plan-preview.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/plan/plan-preview.test.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/plan/plan-preview-p15.test.ts`

Rules (each `PlanIssueCode`):

| Code | Severity | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `range-empty` | error | a range with `startHz ≤ 0` or `endHz ≤ startHz`; an unknown bandplan id for the region; a sweep with no ranges |
| `range-outside-tuner` | error | a range not inside `ctx.tunerRange(sourceId)` |
| `all-excluded` | error | the exclusion union covers every range |
| `plan-empty` | error | a sweep whose hop plan has zero hops and no `range-empty`/`range-outside-tuner`/`all-excluded`/`channel-too-wide` error already explains it (exclusions remove every channel but not the whole continuum; a raster range holds no channel). Task 19's scheduler throws `SCANNER_EMPTY_PLAN` on such a plan, so preview must reject it as a 400 first |
| `not-in-window` | error | `mode: "in-window"` and some range is outside `centre ± fs·u/2` (or the centre is unknown) |
| `no-tuner-control` | error | sweep on a source without a TunerController (`controllable: false`) |
| `source-busy` | error | sweep while `controlMode === "external"` (409 `SCANNER_SOURCE_BUSY` on create) |
| `dwell-too-short` | error | sweep with `dwellMs < settle + (minSurfaceBlocks + 1)·integrationMs` |
| `hold-inconsistent` | error | `hold.policy ≠ never` and `maxHoldMs` below the largest `confirmHoldMs` of the job's decodable classes |
| `channel-too-wide` | error | a raster spacing or OBW class ≥ `2(H − s)` (the planner's limit) or > `2H` |
| `source-not-iq` | error | source format not `U8_IQ`/`S16_IQ`/`FLOAT32LE` |
| `no-probe-transport` | error | operator protocols set, every one of them needs a probe decoder, and none has a transport on this source (S16/F32 source; `ism` before the channelizer). Protocols without a confirm decoder (`analog-fm`, …) never trigger it |
| `poi-low` | warning | detection POI < 0.5 on any hop for `txDurationHintMs` |
| `rbw-coarse` / `rbw-fine` | warning | RBW > smallest OBW class / 4 (9 kHz when none) / RBW < 250 Hz |
| `settle-timer` | warning | sweep in timer mode (`sweep.markers` off or `markerSupported[source] === false`) |
| `settle-unmeasured` | warning | sweep without operator `settleMs` and: marker mode with `markerSupported[source]` unknown, or timer mode with `measured.settleMs[link] === null` |
| `budget-cpu` | warning | `estimates.cpuCores > cpuBudgetCores` |
| `budget-disk` | warning | `diskMbPerHour × 6 h > storage.maxRecordingsMb` |
| `dc-adjacent-channels` | warning | any hop with `dcAdjacentChannelsHz` |
| `dedicated-available` | warning | sweep on a shared source while another controllable IQ source has `role: "dedicated"` |
| `unrestorable` | warning | `impact.unrestorable` non-empty |
| `probe-unavailable` | warning | some (not all) requested protocols lack a transport; details give the reason per protocol |

Derived defaults (provenance `operator` when set, else `bandplan`/`measured`/`default`): source = first non-dedicated; ranges from bandplans; an operator range with neither `rasters` nor `bandplanId` inherits rasters/OBW/protocols/bandplanId from the smallest enclosing regional bandplan range (`rasters: []` means "free, do not inherit"; an ISM range stays free because `ism-433` encloses it more tightly than `uhf-land-mobile`); `mode` auto → `in-window` iff every range fits the current window (no ranges = follow the window); `protocols` = union of the ranges' bandplan protocols; `fftSize` = `2^round(log2(fs/1000))` clamped 512–16384; `integrationMs` 50 (100 for `high`); settle: in-window 0, sweep marker = 30 ms assumed run + `pllSettleMs`, timer = `measured.settleMs[link] ?? settings.sweep.settleMs[link]`; `dwellMs = settle + (minSurfaceBlocks + 1)·T`; `confirmHoldMs` per class (spec §6.4 late-entry values; the scheduler adds probe start latency); `maxHoldMs`/`hangMs`/`revisit.share` from settings; `resume.autoAfterIdleMs` 60000, `priority` 50, `txDurationHintMs` 5000.

Estimates: `sweepPeriodMs = (hops + ⌊hops / round(1/share)⌋) × dwellMs` (the scheduler inserts one revisit every `round(1/share)` coarse hops, spec §10.2; `dwellMs` already contains the settle), `null` for in-window and one-hop jobs. POI per hop (spec §10.5) with `d = dwellMs − settleMs`, `P = sweepPeriodMs`, `D = txDurationHintMs`, `confirmTime` = the largest `confirmHoldMs` of the hop's decodable protocols (job protocols, else the bandplan protocols of ranges in the hop, else every protocol with a transport); continuous (`P = null`): detection = `D ≥ 2T`, decode = `D ≥ confirmTime`. CPU = engine 0.08 + probes × per-probe cost (`cost.ts`), probes = `maxProbes.channel` with the channelizer, else `maxProbes.offset` when an offset-capable protocol is in scope, else 0. Disk = probes × 57.6 MB/h (8 kHz s16 voice, 100 % airtime upper bound) when `record.voice` and dsd-fme protocols are in scope, + probes × 60 × 0.096 MB/h with `evidence.iq`.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { planForSpec, previewPlan, toJobSpec } from "../../../../../src/core/scanner/plan/plan-preview.js"
import type { PreviewContext, PreviewSourceView } from "../../../../../src/core/scanner/plan/plan-preview.js"
import type { ScanJobSpec, ScannerProtocol, ScanRange } from "../../../../../src/core/scanner/types.js"

const PI: PreviewSourceView = { id: "pi", kind: "rtl_tcp", format: "U8_IQ", sampleRateHz: 2_048_000, centreHz: 446_100_000, controllable: true, controlMode: "internal", role: "shared", link: "network" }

function deepFreeze<T>(x: T): T {
	if (x !== null && typeof x === "object" && !Object.isFrozen(x)) {
		Object.freeze(x)
		for (const v of Object.values(x)) deepFreeze(v)
	}
	return x
}

function context(): PreviewContext {
	return {
		sources: [PI],
		channelizerAvailable: false,
		usableFraction: 0.8,
		settings: {
			enabled: true, passive: { enabled: true, offsetProbes: false }, cpuBudgetCores: 1, cpuGuardPercent: 90, maxProbes: { offset: 1, channel: 4 }, ringSeconds: 3,
			detection: { fftSize: "auto", integrationMs: 50, sensitivity: "normal", faTargetPerMhzMin: 1, dcGuardHz: 1500, ppmMargin: 2, clipFraction: 0.001, hysteresisDb: 3, minSurfaceBlocks: 2, shortIntegrationMs: 5, overlap: 0 },
			sweep: { markers: true, markerTimeoutMs: 2000, pllSettleMs: 5, settleMs: { local: 300, network: 1000 }, revisitShare: 0.3 },
			hold: { maxHoldMs: 60_000, hangMs: 2000, preRollMs: 300 },
			storage: { dir: null, maxRecordingsMb: 512, maxEvidenceMb: 64, maxJournalMb: 64, maxAgeDays: 30, discoveryMaxAgeDays: 180, minFreeDiskMb: 2048, maxDiscoveries: 10_000, maxCapturesMb: 256 },
			ws: { maxMessagesPerSecond: 10, spectrumHz: 2, spectrumBins: 512 },
		},
		measured: { settleMs: { local: null, network: null }, markerSupported: { pi: true }, probeStartMs: 400 },
		impactFor: () => ({ liveAudioClients: 0, digitalVoiceListeners: 0, runningDecoders: [], pinnedDecoders: [], scannerJobs: [], unrestorable: [] }),
		region: "EU",
		tunerRange: () => ({ startHz: 24_000_000, endHz: 1_766_000_000 }),
	}
}

const rangeArb = fc
	.record({ startKhz: fc.integer({ min: 400_000, max: 468_000 }), widthKhz: fc.integer({ min: 10, max: 2000 }), raster: fc.constantFrom("inherit", "free", "12k5") })
	.map(({ startKhz, widthKhz, raster }): ScanRange => {
		const base = { startHz: startKhz * 1000, endHz: (startKhz + widthKhz) * 1000 }
		if (raster === "inherit") return base
		if (raster === "free") return { ...base, rasters: [] }
		return { ...base, rasters: [{ spacingHz: 12_500, firstChannelHz: base.startHz + 6250 }], obwHz: [9000] }
	})
const specArb = fc
	.record({
		ranges: fc.array(rangeArb, { maxLength: 2 }),
		bandplans: fc.subarray(["pmr446", "dpmr446", "uhf-land-mobile", "ism-433"]),
		exclusions: fc.array(fc.record({ startKhz: fc.integer({ min: 400_000, max: 470_000 }), widthKhz: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 500 }) }), { maxLength: 2 }),
		mode: fc.constantFrom("auto" as const, "sweep" as const, "in-window" as const, null),
		fftSize: fc.constantFrom(1024, 2048, 4096, null),
		sensitivity: fc.constantFrom("low" as const, "normal" as const, "high" as const, null),
		sampleRateHz: fc.constantFrom(2_048_000, 2_400_000, null),
		protocols: fc.option(fc.subarray<ScannerProtocol>(["dmr", "analog-fm", "pocsag", "ism"]), { nil: null }),
		confirmHoldMs: fc.option(fc.integer({ min: 500, max: 5000 }), { nil: null }),
	})
	.map(r => {
		const spec: ScanJobSpec = {
			ranges: r.ranges,
			bandplans: r.bandplans,
			exclusions: r.exclusions.map(x => ({ startHz: x.startKhz * 1000, endHz: (x.startKhz + x.widthKhz) * 1000 })),
		}
		if (r.mode !== null) spec.mode = r.mode
		if (r.fftSize !== null) spec.fftSize = r.fftSize
		if (r.sensitivity !== null) spec.sensitivity = r.sensitivity
		if (r.sampleRateHz !== null) spec.tuner = { sampleRateHz: r.sampleRateHz }
		if (r.protocols !== null) spec.protocols = r.protocols
		if (r.confirmHoldMs !== null) spec.hold = { policy: "hold", confirmHoldMs: r.confirmHoldMs }
		return spec
	})

describe("plan preview agreement", () => {
	it("is side-effect free and agrees with the plan a job created from it would use", () => {
		// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 15: Preview agreement
		// Validates: spec § 5.4, § 12.1
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(specArb, spec => {
				const ctx = deepFreeze(context())
				deepFreeze(spec)
				const first = previewPlan(spec, ctx)
				expect(previewPlan(spec, ctx)).toEqual(first)
				expect(planForSpec(first.spec, ctx)).toEqual(first.plan)
				const again = previewPlan(toJobSpec(first.spec), ctx)
				expect(again.plan).toEqual(first.plan)
				const { provenance: _a, ...normalised } = first.spec
				const { provenance: _b, ...renormalised } = again.spec
				expect(renormalised).toEqual(normalised)
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)	}, 60_000) // 100 full previews (planner + POI per hop): ~5 s on a loaded laptop
})
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/plan/cost.ts
/**
 * Spec § 9 CPU estimates in cores. Task 43 replaces the numbers with the channelizer capacity
 * gate's measurements; the probe pool (Task 34) and the preview use only these exports.
 */
export const CPU_COST = {
	engine: 0.08,
	offsetProbe: 0.5,
	channelBase: 0.05,
	decoder: { "dsd-fme": 0.045, "multimon-ng": 0.03, direwolf: 0.05, rtl433: 0.1 },
} as const

const UNKNOWN_DECODER_CORES = 0.1

export function probeCores(transport: "offset" | "channel", decoderType: string): number {
	if (transport === "offset") return CPU_COST.offsetProbe
	const decoders: Readonly<Record<string, number>> = CPU_COST.decoder
	return CPU_COST.channelBase + (decoders[decoderType] ?? UNKNOWN_DECODER_CORES)
}
```
