```ts
// src/core/scanner/plan/plan-preview.ts
import type { TunerControlMode } from "@wavekit/api-types"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../../utils/errors.js"
import { defaultFftSize } from "../../spectrum/fft.js"
import { bandplansFor, resolveBandplan } from "../bandplan/index.js"
import type { BandRegionCode } from "../bandplan/index.js"
import type {
	FreqRange,
	IqFormat,
} from "../../spectrum/types.js"
import type {
	Hop,
	HopPlan,
	Impact,
	NormalisedJobSpec,
	PlanIssue,
	PlanIssueCode,
	PlanPreview,
	ScanExclusion,
	ScanJobSpec,
	ScanMode,
	ScannerClass,
	ScannerProtocol,
	ScannerSettings,
	ScanRange,
} from "../types.js"
import { CPU_COST, probeCores } from "./cost.js"
import { describeHop, planHops } from "./hop-planner.js"
import type { HopPlanInput } from "./hop-planner.js"

/**
 * POST /api/scanner/plan (spec § 5.4): pure. Normalises a job spec (every derived default plus its
 * provenance), plans the hops through the one plan function create/PATCH also use (P15), and
 * reports estimates and issues. No I/O, no clocks, no mutation of the inputs.
 */

export interface PreviewSourceView {
	id: string
	kind: string
	format: string // IqFormat | "audio_pcm" | "auto"
	sampleRateHz: number
	centreHz: number | null
	controllable: boolean // a TunerController manages it (rtl_tcp)
	controlMode: TunerControlMode | null // null when not controllable
	role: "shared" | "dedicated"
	link: "local" | "network"
}

export interface PreviewMeasured {
	settleMs: { local: number | null; network: number | null }
	markerSupported: Record<string, boolean | null> // by source id; missing or null = not measured yet
	probeStartMs: number | null
}

export interface PreviewContext {
	sources: PreviewSourceView[]
	channelizerAvailable: boolean
	usableFraction: number
	settings: ScannerSettings
	measured: PreviewMeasured
	impactFor(sourceId: string, spec: NormalisedJobSpec): Impact
	region: BandRegionCode
	tunerRange(sourceId: string): FreqRange
}

type Provenance = NormalisedJobSpec["provenance"][string]
type DecoderType = "dsd-fme" | "multimon-ng" | "direwolf" | "rtl433"

export const MARKER_RUN_ASSUMED_MS = 30 // spec § 11; A0 (Task 47) replaces it

export const DEFAULT_CONFIRM_HOLD_MS: Readonly<Record<ScannerClass, number>> = {
	"tdma-ms": 1800, // late entry 1337 + 360 + 100; the scheduler adds probe start latency
	"fsk4-12k5": 3800, // DMR late entry + 2000 for the -fn pass
	"fsk4-6k25": 4000, // -fi then -fm, 2000 each
	"gmsk-narrow": 2000,
	"fsk2-wide": 4000,
	"afsk-fm": 3000,
	"ook-burst": 10_000,
	"analog-fm": 1500,
	carrier: 0,
	wideband: 0,
	unknown: 0,
}

export const PROTOCOL_DECODER: Readonly<Record<ScannerProtocol, DecoderType | null>> = {
	"analog-fm": null,
	"analog-am": null,
	dmr: "dsd-fme",
	p25p1: "dsd-fme",
	p25p2: "dsd-fme",
	nxdn48: "dsd-fme",
	nxdn96: "dsd-fme",
	ysf: "dsd-fme",
	dstar: "dsd-fme",
	dpmr: "dsd-fme",
	pocsag: "multimon-ng",
	flex: "multimon-ng",
	aprs: "direwolf",
	ism: "rtl433",
	"digital-unknown": null,
	carrier: null,
	unknown: null,
}

const PROTOCOL_CLASS: Readonly<Record<ScannerProtocol, ScannerClass | null>> = {
	"analog-fm": "analog-fm",
	"analog-am": null,
	dmr: "tdma-ms",
	p25p1: "fsk4-12k5",
	p25p2: "fsk4-12k5",
	nxdn48: "fsk4-6k25",
	nxdn96: "fsk4-12k5",
	ysf: "fsk4-12k5",
	dstar: "gmsk-narrow",
	dpmr: "fsk4-6k25",
	pocsag: "fsk2-wide",
	flex: "fsk2-wide",
	aprs: "afsk-fm",
	ism: "ook-burst",
	"digital-unknown": null,
	carrier: null,
	unknown: null,
}

const ALL_PROTOCOLS = Object.keys(PROTOCOL_DECODER) as ScannerProtocol[]
const ALL_CLASSES = Object.keys(DEFAULT_CONFIRM_HOLD_MS) as ScannerClass[]
const IQ_FORMATS: readonly string[] = ["U8_IQ", "S16_IQ", "FLOAT32LE"] satisfies IqFormat[]
const DEFAULT_PRIORITY = 50
const DEFAULT_AUTO_RESUME_MS = 60_000
const DEFAULT_TX_HINT_MS = 5000
const TYPICAL_OBW_HZ = 9000
const RBW_FINE_HZ = 250
const POI_LOW = 0.5
const VOICE_WAV_MB_PER_HOUR = 57.6 // 8 kHz s16 mono at 100 % airtime (upper bound)
const IQ_SNIPPET_MB = 0.096 // ≤ 1 s at 48 kHz cu8 (spec § 8)
const CONFIRMS_PER_PROBE_HOUR = 60
const DISK_BUDGET_HOURS = 6 // warn when the recordings cap would fill in under 6 h
/** Errors that already explain an empty sweep plan; `plan-empty` covers every other cause (e.g. exclusions eating every channel but not the whole continuum, or a raster range holding no channel). */
const PLAN_EMPTY_CAUSES: ReadonlySet<PlanIssueCode> = new Set<PlanIssueCode>(["range-empty", "range-outside-tuner", "all-excluded", "channel-too-wide"])

function emptyImpact(): Impact {
	return { liveAudioClients: 0, digitalVoiceListeners: 0, runningDecoders: [], pinnedDecoders: [], scannerJobs: [], unrestorable: [] }
}

function issue(code: PlanIssueCode, severity: "error" | "warning", message: string, details?: Record<string, unknown>): PlanIssue {
	return details === undefined ? { code, severity, message } : { code, severity, message, details }
}

function copyRange(r: ScanRange): ScanRange {
	const out: ScanRange = { startHz: r.startHz, endHz: r.endHz }
	if (r.rasters !== undefined) out.rasters = r.rasters.map(x => ({ ...x }))
	if (r.obwHz !== undefined) out.obwHz = [...r.obwHz]
	if (r.protocols !== undefined) out.protocols = [...r.protocols]
	if (r.bandplanId !== undefined) out.bandplanId = r.bandplanId
	return out
}

function unique<T>(xs: Iterable<T>): T[] {
	return [...new Set(xs)]
}

export function probeTransportFor(
	protocol: ScannerProtocol,
	format: string,
	channelizerAvailable: boolean,
): { transport: "offset" | "channel" | null; reason?: "unsupported-format" | "needs-channelizer" | "no-decoder" } {
	const decoder = PROTOCOL_DECODER[protocol]
	if (decoder === null) return { transport: null, reason: "no-decoder" }
	if (format !== "U8_IQ") return { transport: null, reason: "unsupported-format" }
	if (decoder === "rtl433") return channelizerAvailable ? { transport: "channel" } : { transport: null, reason: "needs-channelizer" }
	return { transport: channelizerAvailable ? "channel" : "offset" }
}

function findSource(id: string | undefined, ctx: PreviewContext): PreviewSourceView {
	const source =
		id === undefined ? (ctx.sources.find(s => s.role !== "dedicated") ?? ctx.sources[0]) : ctx.sources.find(s => s.id === id)
	if (!source) throw new WaveKitError(`unknown scanner source ${id ?? "(default)"}`, "SCANNER_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND")
	return source
}

function fullyExcluded(r: FreqRange, exclusions: readonly ScanExclusion[]): boolean {
	let reach = r.startHz
	for (const x of [...exclusions].sort((a, b) => a.startHz - b.startHz)) {
		if (x.startHz > reach) break
		reach = Math.max(reach, x.endHz)
		if (reach >= r.endHz) return true
	}
	return false
}

/** Classes whose confirm rule applies to the protocols (all protocols when the list is empty). */
function decodableClasses(protocols: readonly ScannerProtocol[], format: string, channelizer: boolean): ScannerClass[] {
	const list = protocols.length > 0 ? protocols : ALL_PROTOCOLS
	const out: ScannerClass[] = []
	for (const p of list) {
		const cls = PROTOCOL_CLASS[p]
		if (cls === null || probeTransportFor(p, format, channelizer).transport === null) continue
		out.push(cls)
	}
	return unique(out)
}

export function normaliseSpec(
	spec: ScanJobSpec,
	ctx: PreviewContext,
): { spec: NormalisedJobSpec; source: PreviewSourceView; issues: PlanIssue[] } {
	const issues: PlanIssue[] = []
	const prov: Record<string, Provenance> = {}
	const pv = (key: string, operator: boolean, fallback: Provenance = "default"): void => {
		prov[key] = operator ? "operator" : fallback
	}
	const s = ctx.settings
	const source = findSource(spec.sourceId, ctx)
	pv("sourceId", spec.sourceId !== undefined)
	if (!IQ_FORMATS.includes(source.format)) {
		issues.push(issue("source-not-iq", "error", `source ${source.id} delivers ${source.format}, not IQ`, { format: source.format }))
	}

	// Ranges: operator ranges (inheriting rasters from the enclosing regional bandplan), then bandplans.
	const ranges: ScanRange[] = []
	let inherited = false
	const hosts = bandplansFor(ctx.region)
		.flatMap(p => p.ranges)
		.sort((a, b) => a.endHz - a.startHz - (b.endHz - b.startHz))
	for (const r of spec.ranges ?? []) {
		const own = copyRange(r)
		// Only ranges with neither rasters nor a bandplan inherit, from the smallest enclosing plan range.
		const host =
			r.rasters === undefined && r.bandplanId === undefined
				? hosts.find(h => h.startHz <= r.startHz && h.endHz >= r.endHz)
				: undefined
		if (host) {
			inherited = true
			if (host.rasters !== undefined) own.rasters = host.rasters.map(x => ({ ...x }))
			if (own.obwHz === undefined && host.obwHz !== undefined) own.obwHz = [...host.obwHz]
			if (own.protocols === undefined && host.protocols !== undefined) own.protocols = [...host.protocols]
			if (own.bandplanId === undefined && host.bandplanId !== undefined) own.bandplanId = host.bandplanId
		}
		ranges.push(own)
	}
	for (const id of spec.bandplans ?? []) {
		const bp = resolveBandplan(id, ctx.region)
		if (!bp) {
			issues.push(issue("range-empty", "error", `bandplan ${id} is not available in region ${ctx.region}`, { bandplan: id }))
			continue
		}
		for (const r of bp.ranges) ranges.push(copyRange(r))
	}
	const operatorRanges = (spec.ranges ?? []).length > 0
	const planRanges = (spec.bandplans ?? []).length > 0
	prov["ranges"] = operatorRanges ? "operator" : planRanges ? "bandplan" : "default"
	prov["ranges.rasters"] = inherited || planRanges ? "bandplan" : operatorRanges ? "operator" : "default"
	const exclusions: ScanExclusion[] = (spec.exclusions ?? []).map(x => ({ ...x }))
	pv("exclusions", spec.exclusions !== undefined)

	const tuner = ctx.tunerRange(source.id)
	for (const r of ranges) {
		const range = { startHz: r.startHz, endHz: r.endHz }
		if (!(r.startHz > 0) || !(r.endHz > r.startHz)) {
			issues.push(issue("range-empty", "error", `range ${r.startHz}–${r.endHz} Hz is empty or inverted`, { range }))
		} else if (r.startHz < tuner.startHz || r.endHz > tuner.endHz) {
			issues.push(issue("range-outside-tuner", "error", `range ${r.startHz}–${r.endHz} Hz is outside the tuner's ${tuner.startHz}–${tuner.endHz} Hz`, { range, tuner }))
		}
	}
	if (ranges.length > 0 && ranges.every(r => fullyExcluded(r, exclusions))) {
		issues.push(issue("all-excluded", "error", "the exclusions cover every range"))
	}

	// Mode.
	const windowHalf = (source.sampleRateHz * ctx.usableFraction) / 2
	const centre = source.centreHz
	const fits = centre !== null && ranges.every(r => r.startHz >= centre - windowHalf && r.endHz <= centre + windowHalf)
	const requested = spec.mode ?? "auto"
	const mode: ScanMode = requested === "auto" ? (fits ? "in-window" : "sweep") : requested
	pv("mode", requested !== "auto")
	if (mode === "in-window" && !fits) {
		issues.push(issue("not-in-window", "error", "in-window mode needs every range inside the source's current usable span", { centreHz: centre, halfSpanHz: windowHalf }))
	}
	if (mode === "sweep") {
		if (ranges.length === 0) issues.push(issue("range-empty", "error", "a sweep needs at least one range or bandplan"))
		if (!source.controllable) {
			issues.push(issue("no-tuner-control", "error", `source ${source.id} (${source.kind}) has no tuner control`))
		} else if (source.controlMode === "external") {
			issues.push(issue("source-busy", "error", `source ${source.id} is under external (relay) control`))
		}
	}

	// Detection parameters.
	const fs = mode === "sweep" ? (spec.tuner?.sampleRateHz ?? source.sampleRateHz) : source.sampleRateHz
	const sensitivity = spec.sensitivity ?? s.detection.sensitivity
	pv("sensitivity", spec.sensitivity !== undefined)
	const fftSize = spec.fftSize ?? (s.detection.fftSize === "auto" ? defaultFftSize(fs) : s.detection.fftSize)
	pv("fftSize", spec.fftSize !== undefined)
	const integrationMs = spec.integrationMs ?? (sensitivity === "high" ? 100 : s.detection.integrationMs)
	pv("integrationMs", spec.integrationMs !== undefined)
	const thresholdDb = spec.thresholdDb ?? null
	pv("thresholdDb", spec.thresholdDb !== undefined)
	const rbw = fs / fftSize
	const obwClasses = ranges.flatMap(r => r.obwHz ?? []).filter(o => o > 0)
	const typicalObw = obwClasses.length > 0 ? Math.min(...obwClasses) : TYPICAL_OBW_HZ
	if (rbw > typicalObw / 4) issues.push(issue("rbw-coarse", "warning", `RBW ${rbw.toFixed(0)} Hz is above a quarter of the ${typicalObw} Hz OBW`, { rbwHz: rbw, obwHz: typicalObw }))
	if (rbw < RBW_FINE_HZ) issues.push(issue("rbw-fine", "warning", `RBW ${rbw.toFixed(0)} Hz is below ${RBW_FINE_HZ} Hz`, { rbwHz: rbw }))
	const half = (fs * ctx.usableFraction) / 2
	const spacings = ranges.flatMap(r => (r.rasters ?? []).map(x => x.spacingHz))
	const slack = spacings.length > 0 ? Math.min(...spacings) : 0
	const widest = Math.max(0, ...spacings, ...obwClasses)
	if (widest >= 2 * (half - slack) || widest > 2 * half) {
		issues.push(issue("channel-too-wide", "error", `a ${widest} Hz channel does not fit the ${2 * half} Hz usable span`, { widthHz: widest, usableSpanHz: 2 * half }))
	}

	// Settle and dwell.
	let settleMs: number
	if (mode === "in-window") {
		settleMs = spec.settleMs ?? 0
		pv("settleMs", spec.settleMs !== undefined)
	} else {
		const markerSupported = ctx.measured.markerSupported[source.id] ?? null
		const marker = s.sweep.markers && markerSupported !== false
		const measured = ctx.measured.settleMs[source.link]
		if (spec.settleMs !== undefined) settleMs = spec.settleMs
		else if (marker) settleMs = MARKER_RUN_ASSUMED_MS + s.sweep.pllSettleMs
		else settleMs = measured ?? s.sweep.settleMs[source.link]
		pv("settleMs", spec.settleMs !== undefined, !marker && measured !== null ? "measured" : "default")
		if (!marker) issues.push(issue("settle-timer", "warning", `timer settle mode (${settleMs} ms) on ${source.id}`, { settleMs }))
		const unmeasured = marker ? markerSupported === null : measured === null
		if (spec.settleMs === undefined && unmeasured) {
			issues.push(issue("settle-unmeasured", "warning", `settle behaviour of ${source.id} is not measured yet`, { link: source.link }))
		}
	}
	const minimumDwell = settleMs + (s.detection.minSurfaceBlocks + 1) * integrationMs
	const dwellMs = spec.dwellMs ?? minimumDwell
	pv("dwellMs", spec.dwellMs !== undefined)
	if (mode === "sweep" && dwellMs < minimumDwell) {
		issues.push(issue("dwell-too-short", "error", `dwell ${dwellMs} ms is below settle + ${s.detection.minSurfaceBlocks + 1} blocks (${minimumDwell} ms)`, { minimumMs: minimumDwell }))
	}

	// Protocols, holds, probes.
	const fromPlans = unique(ranges.flatMap(r => r.protocols ?? []))
	const protocols = spec.protocols !== undefined ? [...spec.protocols] : fromPlans
	prov["protocols"] = spec.protocols !== undefined ? "operator" : fromPlans.length > 0 ? "bandplan" : "default"
	const policy = spec.hold?.policy ?? "hold"
	pv("hold.policy", spec.hold !== undefined)
	const confirmHoldMs: Partial<Record<ScannerClass, number>> = {}
	for (const c of ALL_CLASSES) confirmHoldMs[c] = spec.hold?.confirmHoldMs ?? DEFAULT_CONFIRM_HOLD_MS[c]
	pv("hold.confirmHoldMs", spec.hold?.confirmHoldMs !== undefined)
	const maxHoldMs = spec.hold?.maxHoldMs ?? s.hold.maxHoldMs
	pv("hold.maxHoldMs", spec.hold?.maxHoldMs !== undefined)
	const hangMs = spec.hold?.hangMs ?? s.hold.hangMs
	pv("hold.hangMs", spec.hold?.hangMs !== undefined)
	const relevant = decodableClasses(protocols, source.format, ctx.channelizerAvailable)
	const neededHold = relevant.reduce((m, c) => Math.max(m, confirmHoldMs[c] ?? 0), 0)
	if (policy !== "never" && maxHoldMs < neededHold) {
		issues.push(issue("hold-inconsistent", "error", `maxHoldMs ${maxHoldMs} is below confirmHoldMs ${neededHold}`, { maxHoldMs, confirmHoldMs: neededHold }))
	}
	const unavailable: Record<string, string> = {}
	let needsProbe = 0
	let withTransport = 0
	for (const p of spec.protocols ?? []) {
		const t = probeTransportFor(p, source.format, ctx.channelizerAvailable)
		if (t.reason === "no-decoder") continue
		needsProbe++
		if (t.transport !== null) withTransport++
		else unavailable[p] = t.reason ?? "unsupported-format"
	}
	const requestedProtocols = spec.protocols ?? []
	if (needsProbe > 0 && withTransport === 0 && needsProbe === requestedProtocols.length) {
		issues.push(issue("no-probe-transport", "error", `no requested protocol can be confirmed on ${source.id}`, { protocols: unavailable }))
	} else if (Object.keys(unavailable).length > 0) {
		issues.push(issue("probe-unavailable", "warning", "some requested protocols have no probe transport", { protocols: unavailable }))
	}
	if (mode === "sweep" && source.role === "shared") {
		const dedicated = ctx.sources
			.filter(o => o.id !== source.id && o.role === "dedicated" && o.controllable && IQ_FORMATS.includes(o.format))
			.map(o => o.id)
		if (dedicated.length > 0) issues.push(issue("dedicated-available", "warning", `a dedicated receiver is available: ${dedicated.join(", ")}`, { sourceIds: dedicated }))
	}

	pv("revisit.share", spec.revisit?.share !== undefined)
	pv("revisit.maxIntervalMs", spec.revisit?.maxIntervalMs !== undefined)
	pv("priority", spec.priority !== undefined)
	pv("resume.autoAfterIdleMs", spec.resume?.autoAfterIdleMs !== undefined)
	pv("txDurationHintMs", spec.txDurationHintMs !== undefined)
	pv("kind", spec.kind !== undefined)

	const n: NormalisedJobSpec = {
		sourceId: source.id,
		sensitivity,
		priority: spec.priority ?? DEFAULT_PRIORITY,
		mode,
		kind: spec.kind ?? "discover",
		ranges,
		exclusions,
		protocols,
		fftSize,
		integrationMs,
		thresholdDb,
		dwellMs,
		settleMs,
		hold: { policy, confirmHoldMs, maxHoldMs, hangMs },
		revisit: { share: spec.revisit?.share ?? s.sweep.revisitShare, maxIntervalMs: spec.revisit?.maxIntervalMs ?? null },
		record: { voice: spec.record?.voice ?? true, analog: spec.record?.analog ?? true, data: spec.record?.data ?? true },
		evidence: { psd: spec.evidence?.psd ?? true, iq: spec.evidence?.iq ?? false },
		tuner: {
			sampleRateHz: spec.tuner?.sampleRateHz ?? null,
			gainTenthsDb: spec.tuner?.gainTenthsDb ?? null,
			agc: spec.tuner?.agc ?? null,
			overload: spec.tuner?.overload ?? "flag",
		},
		stop: { afterSweeps: spec.stop?.afterSweeps ?? null, afterMs: spec.stop?.afterMs ?? null, onFirstDecoded: spec.stop?.onFirstDecoded ?? false },
		takeover: spec.takeover ?? false,
		resume: {
			autoAfterIdleMs: spec.resume?.autoAfterIdleMs === undefined ? DEFAULT_AUTO_RESUME_MS : spec.resume.autoAfterIdleMs,
			onBoot: spec.resume?.onBoot ?? false,
		},
		txDurationHintMs: spec.txDurationHintMs ?? DEFAULT_TX_HINT_MS,
		provenance: prov,
	}
	return { spec: n, source, issues }
}

/** The only hop-plan function: preview, create, PATCH and re-plan all call it (P15). */
export function planForSpec(spec: NormalisedJobSpec, ctx: PreviewContext): HopPlan {
	const source = findSource(spec.sourceId, ctx)
	const fs = spec.mode === "sweep" ? (spec.tuner.sampleRateHz ?? source.sampleRateHz) : source.sampleRateHz
	const input: HopPlanInput = {
		ranges: spec.ranges,
		exclusions: spec.exclusions,
		sampleRateHz: fs,
		usableFraction: ctx.usableFraction,
		rbwHz: fs / spec.fftSize,
		dcGuardHz: ctx.settings.detection.dcGuardHz,
		ppmMargin: ctx.settings.detection.ppmMargin,
		tunerRange: ctx.tunerRange(source.id),
	}
	if (spec.mode === "sweep") return planHops(input)
	const half = (fs * ctx.usableFraction) / 2
	const g = Math.max(input.dcGuardHz, 2 * input.rbwHz)
	if (source.centreHz === null) return { hops: [], usableHalfSpanHz: half, dcGuardHz: g, ppmMarginHz: 0 }
	return {
		hops: [describeHop(0, source.centreHz, input)],
		usableHalfSpanHz: half,
		dcGuardHz: g,
		ppmMarginHz: input.ppmMargin * 1e-6 * source.centreHz,
	}
}

function sweepPeriod(hops: number, dwellMs: number, share: number): number {
	const every = share > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.round(1 / share)) : Infinity
	const revisits = Number.isFinite(every) ? Math.floor(hops / every) : 0
	return (hops + revisits) * dwellMs
}

function hopProtocols(hop: Hop, n: NormalisedJobSpec): ScannerProtocol[] {
	if (n.protocols.length > 0) return n.protocols
	const inHop = n.ranges.filter(r => r.endHz >= hop.covered.startHz && r.startHz <= hop.covered.endHz)
	return unique(inHop.flatMap(r => r.protocols ?? []))
}

function poiFor(hop: Hop, n: NormalisedJobSpec, periodMs: number | null, source: PreviewSourceView, channelizer: boolean): PlanPreview["poi"][number] {
	const T = n.integrationMs
	const D = n.txDurationHintMs
	const classes = decodableClasses(hopProtocols(hop, n), source.format, channelizer)
	const confirm = classes.length > 0 ? classes.reduce((m, c) => Math.max(m, n.hold.confirmHoldMs[c] ?? DEFAULT_CONFIRM_HOLD_MS[c]), 0) : null
	if (periodMs === null) {
		return { hopIndex: hop.index, detection: D >= 2 * T ? 1 : 0, decode: confirm !== null && D >= confirm ? 1 : 0 }
	}
	const d = n.dwellMs - n.settleMs
	return {
		hopIndex: hop.index,
		detection: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, D + d - 2 * T) / periodMs),
		decode: confirm === null ? 0 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, D - confirm + d) / periodMs),
	}
}

function estimate(n: NormalisedJobSpec, source: PreviewSourceView, ctx: PreviewContext): PlanPreview["estimates"] {
	const s = ctx.settings
	const candidates = n.protocols.length > 0 ? n.protocols : ALL_PROTOCOLS
	const usable: { decoder: DecoderType; transport: "offset" | "channel" }[] = []
	for (const p of candidates) {
		const decoder = PROTOCOL_DECODER[p]
		const t = probeTransportFor(p, source.format, ctx.channelizerAvailable).transport
		if (decoder !== null && t !== null) usable.push({ decoder, transport: t })
	}
	if (usable.length === 0) return { cpuCores: CPU_COST.engine, diskMbPerHour: 0, probes: 0 }
	const channel = usable.some(u => u.transport === "channel")
	const probes = channel ? s.maxProbes.channel : s.maxProbes.offset
	const decoders = unique(usable.map(u => u.decoder))
	const perProbe = decoders.reduce((m, d) => Math.max(m, probeCores(channel ? "channel" : "offset", d)), 0)
	const voice = n.record.voice && decoders.includes("dsd-fme") ? probes * VOICE_WAV_MB_PER_HOUR : 0
	const iq = n.evidence.iq ? probes * CONFIRMS_PER_PROBE_HOUR * IQ_SNIPPET_MB : 0
	return {
		cpuCores: Math.round((CPU_COST.engine + probes * perProbe) * 1000) / 1000,
		diskMbPerHour: Math.round((voice + iq) * 10) / 10,
		probes,
	}
}

export function previewPlan(spec: ScanJobSpec, ctx: PreviewContext): PlanPreview {
	const { spec: n, source, issues } = normaliseSpec(spec, ctx)
	const plan = planForSpec(n, ctx)
	const s = ctx.settings
	const explained = issues.some(i => PLAN_EMPTY_CAUSES.has(i.code))
	if (n.mode === "sweep" && plan.hops.length === 0 && !explained) {
		issues.push(issue("plan-empty", "error", "the sweep plan has no hops: no channel or free span is left to scan"))
	}
	const adjacent = plan.hops.filter(h => h.dcAdjacentChannelsHz.length > 0)
	if (adjacent.length > 0) {
		issues.push(
			issue("dc-adjacent-channels", "warning", `${adjacent.length} hop(s) have channels within g + m of DC`, {
				hops: adjacent.map(h => ({ index: h.index, channelsHz: h.dcAdjacentChannelsHz })),
			}),
		)
	}
	const sweepPeriodMs = n.mode === "sweep" && plan.hops.length > 1 ? sweepPeriod(plan.hops.length, n.dwellMs, n.revisit.share) : null
	const poi = plan.hops.map(h => poiFor(h, n, sweepPeriodMs, source, ctx.channelizerAvailable))
	const low = poi.filter(p => p.detection < POI_LOW)
	if (low.length > 0) {
		issues.push(
			issue("poi-low", "warning", `detection POI below ${POI_LOW * 100} % for a ${n.txDurationHintMs} ms transmission`, {
				hops: low.map(p => p.hopIndex),
				txDurationHintMs: n.txDurationHintMs,
			}),
		)
	}
	const estimates = estimate(n, source, ctx)
	if (estimates.cpuCores > s.cpuBudgetCores) {
		issues.push(issue("budget-cpu", "warning", `estimated ${estimates.cpuCores} cores exceeds the ${s.cpuBudgetCores} core budget`, { cpuCores: estimates.cpuCores }))
	}
	if (estimates.diskMbPerHour * DISK_BUDGET_HOURS > s.storage.maxRecordingsMb) {
		issues.push(issue("budget-disk", "warning", `${estimates.diskMbPerHour} MB/h fills the ${s.storage.maxRecordingsMb} MB recordings cap in under ${DISK_BUDGET_HOURS} h`, { diskMbPerHour: estimates.diskMbPerHour }))
	}
	const impact = n.mode === "sweep" ? ctx.impactFor(source.id, n) : emptyImpact()
	if (impact.unrestorable.length > 0) {
		issues.push(issue("unrestorable", "warning", `pre-job value unknown for: ${impact.unrestorable.join(", ")}`, { fields: impact.unrestorable }))
	}
	return { spec: n, plan, sweepPeriodMs, poi, estimates, impact, issues }
}

/** Inverse of normaliseSpec for create/PATCH round trips (everything explicit; provenance is lost). */
export function toJobSpec(n: NormalisedJobSpec): ScanJobSpec {
	const holds = Object.values(n.hold.confirmHoldMs)
	const first = holds[0]
	const uniform = n.provenance["hold.confirmHoldMs"] === "operator" && first !== undefined && holds.every(v => v === first)
	const out: ScanJobSpec = {
		sourceId: n.sourceId,
		mode: n.mode,
		kind: n.kind,
		ranges: n.ranges.map(copyRange),
		exclusions: n.exclusions.map(x => ({ ...x })),
		protocols: [...n.protocols],
		sensitivity: n.sensitivity,
		fftSize: n.fftSize,
		integrationMs: n.integrationMs,
		dwellMs: n.dwellMs,
		settleMs: n.settleMs,
		hold: { policy: n.hold.policy, maxHoldMs: n.hold.maxHoldMs, hangMs: n.hold.hangMs },
		revisit: { share: n.revisit.share },
		record: { ...n.record },
		evidence: { ...n.evidence },
		tuner: { overload: n.tuner.overload },
		stop: { onFirstDecoded: n.stop.onFirstDecoded },
		priority: n.priority,
		takeover: n.takeover,
		resume: { autoAfterIdleMs: n.resume.autoAfterIdleMs, onBoot: n.resume.onBoot },
		txDurationHintMs: n.txDurationHintMs,
	}
	if (uniform && out.hold && first !== undefined) out.hold.confirmHoldMs = first
	if (n.revisit.maxIntervalMs !== null && out.revisit) out.revisit.maxIntervalMs = n.revisit.maxIntervalMs
	if (out.tuner) {
		if (n.tuner.sampleRateHz !== null) out.tuner.sampleRateHz = n.tuner.sampleRateHz
		if (n.tuner.gainTenthsDb !== null) out.tuner.gainTenthsDb = n.tuner.gainTenthsDb
		if (n.tuner.agc !== null) out.tuner.agc = n.tuner.agc
	}
	if (out.stop) {
		if (n.stop.afterSweeps !== null) out.stop.afterSweeps = n.stop.afterSweeps
		if (n.stop.afterMs !== null) out.stop.afterMs = n.stop.afterMs
	}
	if (n.thresholdDb !== null) out.thresholdDb = n.thresholdDb
	return out
}
```

### Task 15: Discovery store (association, keys, merge rules, surfacing, ladder, caps, re-key, bounds)

**Spec:** § 5.2, § 6.2 (truncated/edge), § 7.1, § 7.2, § 7.3, § 7.4 (correction input, snapshot of corrections, pure estimator), § 8 (journal payload), § 9 (memory), § 13 P3 (store part), P7, P8, P11 (store part), P17 (store part: `Observation.decode`). **Depends on:** Tasks 1, 2, 11 (`familyOf`), 12 (`snapToRaster`, `frequencyKey`, `rasterToleranceHz`, `gridToleranceHz`). **Batch:** S1-A

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/scanner/store/schemas.ts`, `src/core/scanner/store/discovery-store.ts` (class `DiscoveryStore` plus the pure § 7.4 estimator `estimateFrequencyError`), `tests/mocks/scanner/observations.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/discovery-store.test.ts`, `tests/unit/core/scanner/discovery-store.property.test.ts`

Design notes (read before coding):

- **Observation → protocol.** `ObservationInput` never carries an identity (decodes arrive later through `applyEvidence`). The observed protocol is the top hypothesis when its score is ≥ 0.5, else `analog-fm`/`carrier` from the class, else `unknown`; the family is `familyOf(protocol)`. An observation whose track has `flags.edge` (in-window truncation, § 6.2) counts as protocol `unknown` and confidence `activity` ("edge activity").
- **Rejected before association (P3, store part):** an observation with `jobIds.length === 0` (no job's scope covers it), `track.flags.truncated`, `track.flags.iqImage` or `track.flags.spur` (§ 4.9) is a transient and never touches the store; it is also dropped from the pending single-block hits, so rule (d) never counts it.
- **Re-ingest of a known id (P3, § 4.9).** `truncated`, `iqImage` and `spur` are sticky flags that can be raised after a track surfaced (Task 11a, Task 10; Task 7a: a comb tooth surfaces in its first 30 s, then is flagged). A re-ingest that carries either flag **unlinks** the observation: the discovery loses its count and airtime, and it is deleted when no observation is left and it holds no decode evidence (`decoded`, an identity, `encrypted` or decoded metadata) and is not `keep`; all of it is one `"observation"` journal entry (`removedObservations` + `deleted`), and the call returns `transient`. A re-ingest with `jobIds: []` is **not** a rejection: the covering job ended or was re-scoped while the track was open, which does not make the earlier emission false, so the record keeps the union of its job credits (spec § 7.1: credited to every job that covered it).
- **Association (§ 7.2) in order:** (1) sticky: nearest discovery on the same source with the same family whose median measured centre (last 64 observations) is within `tol` of the observation centre (`tol` = `rasterToleranceHz(min spacing)` when the source has rasters at that frequency, else `gridToleranceHz(obw)`); (2) key lookup by `(frequencyKey, family)`: one → merge; several → most recently active with the same class, else the one without identity, else a new discovery cross-linked to them (this keeps `(key, family, identity)` unique, P7); (3) none with the family: an `unknown`-family observation merges into the single non-`carrier` discovery at the key; a known-family observation merges into a lone `unknown`-family discovery at the key (and makes it more specific); otherwise a new discovery cross-linked (`coChannel`) with every discovery at the key (rule 3: analog and digital on one channel stay two discoveries).
- **Surfacing filter (creation only):** (a) `track.blocks ≥ minSurfaceBlocks`; (b) `singleBlockSurfacingAllowed` and `track.maxBlockSnrDb ≥ track.thresholdDb + 6`; (c) a classification attached (top hypothesis ≥ 0.5 for a protocol other than `unknown`/`carrier`, or a class other than `unknown`/`carrier`/`wideband`); (d) the third single-block hit on the same `${sourceId}|${frequencyKey}` within 10 minutes of observation time creates the discovery and merges all three. Pending hits are in-memory only (≤ 4096 keys × 2 hits) and are lost on restart.
- **Derived fields** (`frequencyHz`, `frequencyKey`, `measuredOffsetHz`, `bandwidthHz`) are recomputed after every merge from the medians of the discovery's last 64 observations (kept in a canonical `(startedAt, id)` order, so they do not depend on arrival order). After any recompute, identity adoption or family change, `settle()` merges discoveries that collide on `(source, key, family, identity)`; the survivor is the one first seen (ties: smaller id).
- **Ladder (§ 7.3):** `activity` → `candidate` (top hypothesis ≥ 0.5 or a class ≠ `unknown`) → `classified` (channel tier, no cap, top ≥ 0.5, class ∉ {carrier, wideband, unknown}) → `decoded` (CRC-clean `DecodeEvidence`). Confidence takes the max; a leak/intermod cap (`Classification.cap`) is recorded only while not `decoded` and clamps to `candidate`. Spec gap resolved: § 6.2 says the cap is set "after a decode" while P8 allows a decrease only "before it was decoded"; the job runner (Task 35) computes the cap for a decode first and passes it **with** that decode, `applyEvidence(id, ev, { cap })`; the store records the cap before applying the decode, so the capped decode leaves the discovery at `candidate` with `confidenceCap` set and the identity/metadata adopted (§ 6.2 "capped at candidate (reason shown)"). Once a discovery is `decoded` (an earlier uncapped decode) caps are ignored (P8), and later evidence on a capped discovery raises it to `candidate` at most. `discoveryIdOf(observationId)` returns the surviving discovery of an observation after any settle merge (the caller's discovery id may have been merged away).
- **Protocol:** classification can only make it more specific (`unknown`/`carrier` → anything; `digital-unknown` → a digital-voice protocol); decode evidence sets it while not yet `decoded`; once `decoded` it never changes, and evidence for another protocol is ignored.
- **Identity conflicts:** evidence whose identity differs from the discovery's goes to the co-channel discovery with that `(key, family, identity)`, created (observation count 0, cross-linked) if absent (rule 2: CC 1 and CC 5 on one channel).
- **Journal:** every mutation emits one `"mutation"` entry whose payload is a `StoreMutation` holding the **resulting** records (touched discoveries, touched observations, deleted discovery ids, optional `removedObservations` ids, optional correction). `replay()` is an upsert of those records: deterministic, idempotent, needs neither ids nor clocks. `replay` ignores `seq ≤` the last applied seq.
- **Corrections in the snapshot (P13).** `snapshot()` and `restore()` carry `corrections: { sourceId, hz }[]` (sorted by `sourceId`). A correction otherwise lives only in `rekey` journal entries, which `pruneJournal` deletes once a snapshot covers them; without it a restart would snap new observations without the correction while existing discoveries keep corrected keys, splitting emitters.
- **Observation decode list (§ 7.1 `decode?`, P17 store part).** `appendObservationEvidence(observationId, ev)` appends accepted evidence to `Observation.decode`: CRC-clean only; the epoch rule of P17 as the probe pool applies it (Task 34: `ev.epoch === epoch` and the evidence is not stamped after that epoch ended) with the observation's `sampleRange.epoch`, and the epoch counts as ended at `endedAt` when `endReason` is `retune` or `hop`; exact duplicates are ignored; the list keeps the 16 newest by `at`. One `"evidence"` journal entry carries the resulting observation record, so replay reproduces it; re-ingests and merges keep the list. The caller (Task 35) calls it next to `applyEvidence` with the live observation id.
- **Frequency-error estimate (§ 7.4, pure).** `estimateFrequencyError(discoveries, sourceId)` takes the discoveries of `sourceId` that are `decoded` and raster-snapped (`frequencyKey` starts with `r:`, finite `measuredOffsetHz`), finds the largest set whose offsets agree within 300 Hz (sliding window over the sorted offsets; ties: the window whose median is nearest the overall median), and returns `{ hz: median offset, ppm: hz / median frequencyHz × 1e6, n }` when that set has ≥ 5 members, else `null`. Task 35 calls it after each `decoded` upgrade and calls `rekey(sourceId, est.hz)` when the value moves by more than `REKEY_MIN_CHANGE_HZ` = 500 Hz (spec § 7.2 "more than tol/2", taken at the smallest tolerance, `rasterToleranceHz` ≥ 1 kHz).
- **Runtime limits.** `setLimits({ maxDiscoveries, minSurfaceBlocks })` replaces the constructor values (runtime settings PATCH, Task 24/35). Eviction then evicts down to the new bound on the next creation, in one `"evict"` entry.
- **Order independence (P7) has a precondition.** Sticky association compares against a discovery's *median* centre, so two emitters closer than the tolerance can associate order-dependently (e.g. grid tol 2.5 kHz, OBW 9 kHz: x@446.0000, y1@446.0022, y2@446.0040 gives {g:446000000×2, g:446005000×1}, while y2, y1, x gives {g:446000000×1, g:446002500×2}). The property holds when every two emitters' centres are more than `tol + 2·J` apart (`J` = largest centre jitter of either emitter): an observation is then never within `tol` of the other emitter's median, and their keys never coincide. The P7 order test generates clusters at exactly that minimum separation and keeps the counterexample as a documented fixed case.
- **Bounds (P11):** discoveries ≤ `maxDiscoveries` (evict, before creating, the lowest-confidence then oldest-`lastSeenAt` discovery that is neither `decoded` nor `keep`; if none is evictable the observation is a transient); metadata lists ≤ 64 (LRU); `jobIds` and `coChannel` ≤ 64; `Observation.decode` ≤ 16; ≤ 256 observations per discovery in memory (the journal keeps all).

```ts
// tests/mocks/scanner/observations.ts
import type {
	Classification,
	ConfidenceCap,
	DecodeEvidence,
	Identity,
	ObservationInput,
	ScannerClass,
	ScannerProtocol,
} from "../../../src/core/scanner/types.js"
import type { TrackSnapshot } from "../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"

export interface ObsSpec {
	id: string
	centreHz: number
	startedAt: number
	durationMs?: number // default 1000
	open?: boolean // no endedAt
	blocks?: number // default 4
	obwHz?: number // default 9000
	snrDb?: number // default 20
	maxBlockSnrDb?: number // default snrDb
	thresholdDb?: number // default 9
	cls?: ScannerClass // default "unknown"
	hypotheses?: [ScannerProtocol, number][]
	cap?: ConfidenceCap
	tier?: "spectral" | "channel"
	jobIds?: string[] // default ["job-1"]
	sourceId?: string // default "src-1"
	truncated?: boolean
	edge?: boolean
	burst?: boolean // short-path burst track (Task 10a)
	iqImage?: boolean // IQ mirror image (Task 11a)
	spur?: boolean // on a spur line (Task 7a)
	sweep?: boolean // singleBlockSurfacingAllowed
}

export function classification(
	cls: ScannerClass,
	hypotheses: [ScannerProtocol, number][] = [],
	cap?: ConfidenceCap,
	tier: "spectral" | "channel" = "spectral",
): Classification {
	const c: Classification = {
		class: cls,
		hypotheses: hypotheses
			.map(([protocol, score]) => ({ protocol, score }))
			.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score),
		tier,
	}
	if (cap !== undefined) c.cap = cap
	return c
}

export function makeTrack(s: ObsSpec): TrackSnapshot {
	const snrDb = s.snrDb ?? 20
	return {
		trackId: `t-${s.id}`,
		sourceId: s.sourceId ?? "src-1",
		stream: 1,
		epoch: 1,
		startSample: s.startedAt * 2048,
		lastSample: (s.startedAt + (s.durationMs ?? 1000)) * 2048,
		centreHz: s.centreHz,
		obwHz: s.obwHz ?? 9000,
		obwMethod: "-20dB",
		peakDbfs: -80 + snrDb + 5,
		meanDbfs: -80 + snrDb,
		snrDb,
		floorDbfs: -80,
		thresholdDb: s.thresholdDb ?? 9,
		blocks: s.blocks ?? 4,
		maxBlockSnrDb: s.maxBlockSnrDb ?? snrDb,
		dutyCycle: 1,
		spectralShape: "flat",
		flags: {
			overload: false,
			gap: false,
			truncated: s.truncated ?? false,
			edge: s.edge ?? false,
			skirt: false,
			obwBiased: false,
			burst: s.burst ?? false,
			iqImage: s.iqImage ?? false,
			spur: s.spur ?? false,
		},
		tuningTrust: "commanded",
	}
}

export function makeObs(s: ObsSpec): ObservationInput {
	const obs: ObservationInput = {
		id: s.id,
		sourceId: s.sourceId ?? "src-1",
		jobIds: s.jobIds ?? ["job-1"],
		track: makeTrack(s),
		classification: classification(s.cls ?? "unknown", s.hypotheses ?? [], s.cap, s.tier ?? "spectral"),
		startedAt: s.startedAt,
		singleBlockSurfacingAllowed: s.sweep ?? false,
	}
	if (s.open !== true) {
		obs.endedAt = s.startedAt + (s.durationMs ?? 1000)
		obs.endReason = "quiet"
	}
	return obs
}

export function evidence(
	protocol: ScannerProtocol,
	at: number,
	extra: { identity?: Identity; encrypted?: boolean; crcClean?: boolean; talkgroups?: string[] } = {},
): DecodeEvidence {
	const ev: DecodeEvidence = {
		protocol,
		metadata: extra.talkgroups !== undefined ? { talkgroups: extra.talkgroups } : {},
		crcClean: extra.crcClean ?? true,
		at,
		epoch: 1,
		origin: "probe",
	}
	if (extra.identity !== undefined) ev.identity = extra.identity
	if (extra.encrypted !== undefined) ev.encrypted = extra.encrypted
	return ev
}

export const dmrCc = (cc: number): Identity => ({ kind: "dmr-cc", value: String(cc) })

/** Sequential ids so tests are deterministic. */
export function counterIds(): () => string {
	let n = 0
	return () => {
		n += 1
		return n.toString(36).toUpperCase().padStart(26, "0")
	}
}
```

```ts
	})

	it("deletes a discovery with its observations and co-channel links", () => {
		const { store } = newStore({ rasters: PMR })
		const fm = store.ingest(makeObs({ id: "o1", centreHz: CH, startedAt: T0, cls: "analog-fm", hypotheses: [["analog-fm", 0.8]] })).discoveryId ?? ""
		const dmr = store.ingest(dmrObs("o2", CH, T0)).discoveryId ?? ""
		expect(store.delete(dmr)).toBe(true)
		expect(store.delete(dmr)).toBe(false)
		expect(store.get(fm)?.coChannel).toEqual([])
		expect(store.snapshot().observations.map(o => o.id)).toEqual(["o1"])
	})

	it("links probe recordings to an observation and counts them on the discovery", () => {
		const { store } = newStore()
		const id = store.ingest(dmrObs("o1", CH, T0)).discoveryId ?? ""
		expect(store.attachRecordings("o1", [`${id}~a.wav`], "linked")).toBe(true)
		expect(store.attachRecordings("o1", [`${id}~a.wav`, `${id}~b.wav`], "linked")).toBe(true)
		expect(store.get(id)?.evidence.recordings).toBe(2)
		expect(store.attachRecordings("missing", [], "none")).toBe(false)
	})
})

describe("DiscoveryStore queries and replay", () => {
	it("filters, sorts and paginates with an opaque cursor", () => {
		const { store } = newStore()
		store.ingest(makeObs({ id: "o1", centreHz: CH + 200_000, startedAt: T0 }))
		store.ingest(dmrObs("o2", CH, T0 + 1_000))
		store.ingest(dmrObs("o3", CH + 100_000, T0 + 2_000))
		const page1 = store.list({ minConfidence: "candidate", sort: "frequency", limit: 1 })
		expect(page1.items.map(d => d.frequencyHz)).toEqual([CH])
		const page2 = store.list({ minConfidence: "candidate", sort: "frequency", limit: 1, cursor: page1.nextCursor })
		expect(page2.items.map(d => d.frequencyHz)).toEqual([CH + 100_000])
		expect(page2.nextCursor).toBeNull()
		expect(store.list({}).items.map(d => d.frequencyHz)).toEqual([CH + 100_000, CH, CH + 200_000])
		expect(() => store.list({ cursor: "abc" })).toThrow(WaveKitError)
	})

	it("reproduces the store from a snapshot plus later journal entries, idempotently", () => {
		const { store, entries } = newStore({ rasters: PMR })
		const a = store.ingest(dmrObs("o1", CH, T0)).discoveryId ?? ""
		store.ingest(makeObs({ id: "o2", centreHz: CH, startedAt: T0, cls: "analog-fm", hypotheses: [["analog-fm", 0.8]] }))
		const snap = store.snapshot()
		const cut = entries.length
		store.applyEvidence(a, evidence("dmr", T0 + 10, { identity: dmrCc(1), encrypted: true }))
		store.ingest(dmrObs("o3", CH + 3_500, T0 + 20))
		store.rekey("src-1", 3_000)
		store.setOperator(a, { keep: true })

		const replica = newStore({ rasters: PMR }).store
		replica.restore(snap)
		for (const e of entries.slice(cut)) replica.replay(e)
		expect(replica.snapshot()).toEqual(store.snapshot())
		for (const e of entries) replica.replay(e)
		expect(replica.snapshot()).toEqual(store.snapshot())
		expect(replica.correction("src-1")).toBe(3_000)
	})

	it("carries per-source corrections in the snapshot, so a restart after journal pruning keeps snapping corrected (P13)", () => {
		const { store } = newStore({ rasters: PMR })
		store.ingest(dmrObs("o1", CH + 3_200, T0))
		store.rekey("src-1", 3_000)
		const snap = store.snapshot()
		expect(snap.corrections).toEqual([{ sourceId: "src-1", hz: 3_000 }])
		// ids from another generator: a restarted process never reuses ids (ULIDs in production)
		const replica = new DiscoveryStore({ maxDiscoveries: 100, now: () => T0, newId: () => "REPLICA", rasters: () => PMR })
		replica.restore(snap) // no journal: the rekey entry was pruned
		expect(replica.snapshot()).toEqual(snap)
		expect(replica.correction("src-1")).toBe(3_000)
		const late = dmrObs("o2", CH + 3_300 + 12_500, T0 + 60_000) // snaps only with the correction applied
		const original = store.get(store.ingest(late).discoveryId ?? "")
		const restored = replica.get(replica.ingest(late).discoveryId ?? "")
		expect(restored?.frequencyKey).toBe(`r:${CH + 12_500}`)
		expect(restored?.frequencyKey).toBe(original?.frequencyKey)
		expect(restored?.observationCount).toBe(1)
	})

	it("fills Observation.decode with accepted evidence of the observation's epoch, deduped and bounded (§ 7.1, P17)", () => {
		const { store, entries } = newStore()
		const id = store.ingest(dmrObs("o1", CH, T0, { open: true })).discoveryId ?? ""
		const ev = evidence("dmr", T0 + 100, { identity: dmrCc(1) })
		const before = entries.length
		expect(store.appendObservationEvidence("o1", ev)).toBe(true)
		expect(entries).toHaveLength(before + 1)
		expect(entries.at(-1)?.op).toBe("evidence")
		expect(store.appendObservationEvidence("o1", ev)).toBe(false) // duplicate
		expect(store.appendObservationEvidence("o1", evidence("dmr", T0 + 200, { crcClean: false }))).toBe(false)
		expect(store.appendObservationEvidence("o1", { ...evidence("dmr", T0 + 300), epoch: 2 })).toBe(false)
		expect(store.appendObservationEvidence("missing", ev)).toBe(false)
		expect(entries).toHaveLength(before + 1)
		store.ingest(dmrObs("o1", CH, T0, { durationMs: 2_000 })) // finishes; the list survives the re-ingest
		const decodeOf = () => store.observations(id, null, 10).items[0]?.decode ?? []
		expect(decodeOf()).toEqual([ev])
		for (let i = 1; i <= 20; i++) store.appendObservationEvidence("o1", evidence("dmr", T0 + 1_000 + i, { identity: dmrCc(1) }))
		expect(decodeOf()).toHaveLength(16)
		expect(decodeOf()[0]?.at).toBe(T0 + 1_005)
		expect(decodeOf()[15]?.at).toBe(T0 + 1_020)
		const replica = newStore().store
		for (const e of entries) replica.replay(e)
		expect(replica.snapshot()).toEqual(store.snapshot())
	})

	it("rejects evidence stamped after a retune ended the observation's epoch", () => {
		const { store } = newStore()
		store.ingest({ ...dmrObs("o1", CH, T0, { durationMs: 1_000 }), endReason: "retune" })
		expect(store.appendObservationEvidence("o1", evidence("dmr", T0 + 1_500))).toBe(false)
		expect(store.appendObservationEvidence("o1", evidence("dmr", T0 + 900))).toBe(true)
		store.ingest(dmrObs("o2", CH + 100_000, T0, { durationMs: 1_000 })) // endReason "quiet": the epoch did not end
		expect(store.appendObservationEvidence("o2", evidence("dmr", T0 + 5_000))).toBe(true)
	})

	it("rejects a journal entry whose payload is not a store mutation", () => {
		const replica = newStore().store
		expect(() => replica.replay({ seq: 1, at: new Date(T0).toISOString(), op: "observation", payload: { nope: true } })).toThrow(WaveKitError)
	})
})

describe("estimateFrequencyError (§ 7.4)", () => {
	let seq = 0
	const disc = (offsetHz: number, extra: { sourceId?: string; confidence?: ScannerConfidence; key?: "r" | "g"; hz?: number } = {}): Discovery => {
		seq += 1
		const hz = extra.hz ?? CH + seq * 12_500
		const stats = { peakDbfs: -50, meanDbfs: -55, snrDb: 25, floorDbfs: -80 }
		return {
			id: `d_${seq}`,
			frequencyHz: hz,
			frequencyKey: `${extra.key ?? "r"}:${hz}`,
			measuredOffsetHz: offsetHz,
			bandwidthHz: 9_000,
			protocol: "dmr",
			family: "digital-voice",
			class: "fsk4-12k5",
			confidence: extra.confidence ?? "decoded",
			encrypted: false,
			coChannel: [],
			firstSeenAt: new Date(T0).toISOString(),
			lastSeenAt: new Date(T0).toISOString(),
			observationCount: 1,
			airtimeMs: 1_000,
			signal: { best: stats, last: { ...stats } },
			metadata: { talkgroups: [], sources: [], slots: [], callsigns: [], capcodes: [], ismModels: [] },
			sourceIds: [extra.sourceId ?? "src-1"],
			jobIds: ["job-1"],
			tuningTrust: "commanded",
			evidence: { recordings: 0, psd: false, iq: false },
		}
	}

	it("returns null with fewer than 5 agreeing decoded discoveries", () => {
		expect(estimateFrequencyError([disc(400), disc(420), disc(380), disc(410)], "src-1")).toBeNull()
		expect(estimateFrequencyError([], "src-1")).toBeNull()
	})

	it("returns the median offset, ppm and count of 5 agreeing discoveries", () => {
		const ds = [disc(400, { hz: 446_000_000 }), disc(450, { hz: 446_000_000 }), disc(300, { hz: 446_000_000 }), disc(500, { hz: 446_000_000 }), disc(420, { hz: 446_000_000 })]
		const est = estimateFrequencyError(ds, "src-1")
		expect(est?.hz).toBe(420)
		expect(est?.n).toBe(5)
		expect(est?.ppm).toBeCloseTo((420 / 446_000_000) * 1e6, 9)
	})

	it("takes the largest cluster agreeing within 300 Hz and returns null when the offsets are scattered", () => {
		const cluster = [disc(-200), disc(-150), disc(-100), disc(-50), disc(0), disc(50)]
		const est = estimateFrequencyError([...cluster, disc(2_000), disc(-3_000)], "src-1")
		expect(est?.n).toBe(6)
		expect(est?.hz).toBe(-75)
		expect(estimateFrequencyError([disc(0), disc(400), disc(800), disc(1_200), disc(1_600), disc(2_000)], "src-1")).toBeNull()
	})

	it("ignores other sources, non-decoded and grid-keyed discoveries", () => {
		const four = [disc(100), disc(110), disc(120), disc(130)]
		expect(estimateFrequencyError([...four, disc(105, { sourceId: "src-2" })], "src-1")).toBeNull()
		expect(estimateFrequencyError([...four, disc(105, { confidence: "classified" })], "src-1")).toBeNull()
		expect(estimateFrequencyError([...four, disc(105, { key: "g" })], "src-1")).toBeNull()
		expect(estimateFrequencyError([...four, disc(105)], "src-1")?.n).toBe(5)
		expect(estimateFrequencyError([...four, disc(105, { sourceId: "src-2" })], "src-2")).toBeNull()
	})
})
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/scanner/discovery-store.property.test.ts
import fc from "fast-check"
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { DiscoveryStore } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/store/discovery-store.js"
import { CONFIDENCE_RANK } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/types.js"
import type { Discovery, ScannerProtocol } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/types.js"
import type { Raster } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"
import {
	classification,
	counterIds,
	dmrCc,
	evidence,
	makeObs,
} from "../../../mocks/scanner/observations.js"

const CH = 446_006_250
const PMR: Raster[] = [{ spacingHz: 12_500, firstChannelHz: CH }]
const T0 = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 9, 12, 0, 0)
const PROTOS: ScannerProtocol[] = ["dmr", "analog-fm", "unknown", "nxdn96"]

type Op =
	| { kind: "ingest"; slot: number; jitter: number; blocks: number; proto: number; sweep: boolean; noJob: boolean; truncated: boolean }
	| { kind: "evidence"; pick: number; cc: number; proto: number; encrypted: boolean; clean: boolean; tgBase: number; tgCount: number; cap: boolean }
	| { kind: "classify"; pick: number; proto: number; cap: boolean; channel: boolean }
	| { kind: "rekey"; corr: number }
	| { kind: "delete"; pick: number }

const opArb: fc.Arbitrary<Op> = fc.oneof(
	{ weight: 6, arbitrary: fc.record({ kind: fc.constant("ingest" as const), slot: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 7 }), jitter: fc.integer({ min: -400, max: 400 }), blocks: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4 }), proto: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }), sweep: fc.boolean(), noJob: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 9 }).map(n => n === 0), truncated: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 9 }).map(n => n === 0) }) },
	// up to 80 talkgroups per decode, so a single op can exceed the 64-entry metadata bound (P11)
	{ weight: 3, arbitrary: fc.record({ kind: fc.constant("evidence" as const), pick: fc.nat(), cc: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 3 }), proto: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }), encrypted: fc.boolean(), clean: fc.boolean(), tgBase: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 200 }), tgCount: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 80 }), cap: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }).map(n => n === 0) }) },
	{ weight: 2, arbitrary: fc.record({ kind: fc.constant("classify" as const), pick: fc.nat(), proto: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }), cap: fc.boolean(), channel: fc.boolean() }) },
	{ weight: 1, arbitrary: fc.record({ kind: fc.constant("rekey" as const), corr: fc.integer({ min: -4_000, max: 4_000 }) }) },
	{ weight: 1, arbitrary: fc.record({ kind: fc.constant("delete" as const), pick: fc.nat() }) },
)

function newStore(max = 1_000): DiscoveryStore {
	return new DiscoveryStore({ maxDiscoveries: max, now: () => T0, newId: counterIds(), rasters: () => PMR })
}

function pickId(store: DiscoveryStore, pick: number): string | undefined {
	const ids = store.snapshot().discoveries.map(d => d.id)
	return ids.length === 0 ? undefined : ids[pick % ids.length]
}

function apply(store: DiscoveryStore, op: Op, i: number): void {
	const proto = PROTOS[op.kind === "ingest" || op.kind === "evidence" || op.kind === "classify" ? op.proto : 0] ?? "dmr"
	switch (op.kind) {
		case "ingest": {
			const cls = proto === "dmr" ? "fsk4-12k5" : proto === "analog-fm" ? "analog-fm" : proto === "nxdn96" ? "fsk4-12k5" : "unknown"
			store.ingest(makeObs({
				id: `o${i}`,
				centreHz: CH + op.slot * 6_250 + op.jitter,
				startedAt: T0 + i * 1_000,
				blocks: op.blocks,
				cls,
				hypotheses: proto === "unknown" ? [] : [[proto, 0.8]],
				sweep: op.sweep,
				jobIds: op.noJob ? [] : ["job-1"],
				truncated: op.truncated,
			}))
			return
		}
		case "evidence": {
			const id = pickId(store, op.pick)
			if (id === undefined || proto === "unknown" || proto === "analog-fm") return
			const identity = proto === "dmr" ? dmrCc(op.cc) : { kind: "nxdn-ran" as const, value: String(op.cc) }
			const talkgroups = Array.from({ length: op.tgCount }, (_, j) => String(op.tgBase + j))
			const ev = evidence(proto, T0 + i * 1_000, { identity, encrypted: op.encrypted, crcClean: op.clean, talkgroups })
			if (op.cap) store.applyEvidence(id, ev, { cap: "suspected-intermod" })
			else store.applyEvidence(id, ev)
			return
		}
		case "classify": {
			const id = pickId(store, op.pick)
			if (id === undefined) return
			store.applyClassification(id, classification(proto === "analog-fm" ? "analog-fm" : "fsk4-12k5", proto === "unknown" ? [] : [[proto, 0.8]], op.cap ? "adjacent-leak" : undefined, op.channel ? "channel" : "spectral"))
			return
		}
		case "rekey":
			store.rekey("src-1", op.corr)
			return
		case "delete": {
			const id = pickId(store, op.pick)
			if (id !== undefined) store.delete(id)
			return
		}
	}
}

const identityKey = (d: Discovery): string =>
	`${d.sourceIds.join(",")}|${d.frequencyKey}|${d.family}|${d.identity ? `${d.identity.kind}:${d.identity.value}` : "-"}`

describe("DiscoveryStore properties", () => {
	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 7: Identity and dedupe
	// Validates: spec § 5.2, § 7.2
	it("never holds two discoveries with the same (key, family, identity), including after re-key", () => {
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.array(opArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 60 }), ops => {
				const store = newStore()
				ops.forEach((op, i) => {
					apply(store, op, i)
					const keys = store.snapshot().discoveries.map(identityKey)
					expect(new Set(keys).size).toBe(keys.length)
				})
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 7: Identity and dedupe
	// Validates: spec § 5.2, § 7.2
	it("yields the same keys and counts for any arrival order that preserves per-key order, for emitters more than tol + 2·J apart", () => {
		// Precondition (spec P7, § 7.2): sticky association compares with a discovery's median centre, so order
		// independence holds only for emitters whose centres are more than tol + 2·J apart (J = largest centre
		// jitter). Clusters sit at exactly that minimum separation (+1 Hz); the random base offset makes the
		// jitter cross grid-key boundaries, and the two orders permute observations across clusters.
		const TOL = 2_500 // gridToleranceHz(9 kHz): no rasters, makeObs' default OBW
		const clusterObs = fc.array(
			fc.record({ jitter: fc.integer({ min: -1_000, max: 1_000 }), blocks: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 3 }) }),
			{ minLength: 1, maxLength: 12 },
		)
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(
				fc.array(clusterObs, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 5 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: TOL / 2 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: TOL - 1 }),
				fc.array(fc.nat(), { minLength: 60, maxLength: 60 }),
				fc.array(fc.nat(), { minLength: 5, maxLength: 5 }),
				(clusters, maxJitter, base, choices, rankKeys) => {
					const separation = TOL + 2 * maxJitter + 1
					const obsFor = (c: number, k: number, spec: { jitter: number; blocks: number }) =>
						makeObs({
							id: `c${c}-${k}`,
							centreHz: 446_000_000 + base + c * separation + Math.round((spec.jitter * maxJitter) / 1_000),
							startedAt: T0 + k * 1_000 + c,
							blocks: spec.blocks,
						})
					const run = (order: [number, number][]) => {
						const store = new DiscoveryStore({ maxDiscoveries: 1_000, now: () => T0, newId: counterIds() })
						for (const [c, k] of order) {
							const spec = clusters[c]?.[k]
							if (spec !== undefined) store.ingest(obsFor(c, k, spec))
						}
						return store.snapshot().discoveries.map(d => `${d.frequencyKey}|${d.observationCount}`).sort()
					}
					const permuted = clusters.map((_, c) => c).sort((a, b) => (rankKeys[a] ?? 0) - (rankKeys[b] ?? 0) || a - b)
					const clusterMajor: [number, number][] = permuted.flatMap(c => (clusters[c] ?? []).map((_, k): [number, number] => [c, k]))
					const next = clusters.map(() => 0)
					const interleaved: [number, number][] = []
					let step = 0
					while (interleaved.length < clusterMajor.length) {
						const open = clusters.map((_, c) => c).filter(c => (next[c] ?? 0) < (clusters[c]?.length ?? 0))
						const c = open[(choices[step % choices.length] ?? 0) % open.length] ?? 0
						interleaved.push([c, next[c] ?? 0])
						next[c] = (next[c] ?? 0) + 1
						step++
					}
					expect(run(interleaved)).toEqual(run(clusterMajor))
				},
			),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 7: Identity and dedupe
	// Validates: spec § 7.2 (documents the P7 precondition; this result is expected, not a bug)
	it("associates order-dependently for emitters closer than tol + 2·J (reviewed counterexample)", () => {
		const at: Record<string, [number, number]> = { x: [446_000_000, T0], y1: [446_002_200, T0 + 1_000], y2: [446_004_000, T0 + 2_000] }
		const run = (order: string[]) => {
			const store = new DiscoveryStore({ maxDiscoveries: 1_000, now: () => T0, newId: counterIds() })
			for (const id of order) {
				const [centreHz, startedAt] = at[id] ?? [0, T0]
				store.ingest(makeObs({ id, centreHz, startedAt, blocks: 4 })) // OBW 9 kHz, grid tol 2.5 kHz
			}
			return store.snapshot().discoveries.map(d => `${d.frequencyKey}|${d.observationCount}`).sort()
		}
		expect(run(["x", "y1", "y2"])).toEqual(["g:446000000|2", "g:446005000|1"])
		expect(run(["y2", "y1", "x"])).toEqual(["g:446000000|1", "g:446002500|2"])
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 7: Identity and dedupe
	// Validates: spec § 7.2
	it("is idempotent on repeated observation ids (ingesting each observation twice equals once)", () => {
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.array(opArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 40 }), ops => {
				const once = newStore()
				const twice = newStore()
				ops.forEach((op, i) => {
					apply(once, op, i)
					apply(twice, op, i)
					if (op.kind === "ingest") apply(twice, op, i)
				})
				expect(twice.snapshot()).toEqual(once.snapshot())
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 8: Monotone confidence, sticky flags
	// Validates: spec § 7.3, H1
	it("never lowers confidence except to a pre-decode cap, never clears encrypted, never changes a decoded protocol", () => {
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.array(opArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 60 }), ops => {
				const store = newStore()
				const prev = new Map<string, Discovery>()
				ops.forEach((op, i) => {
					apply(store, op, i)
					for (const d of store.snapshot().discoveries) {
						const p = prev.get(d.id)
						if (p !== undefined) {
							const now = CONFIDENCE_RANK[d.confidence]
							const was = CONFIDENCE_RANK[p.confidence]
							if (now < was) {
								expect(p.confidence).not.toBe("decoded")
								expect(d.confidence).toBe("candidate")
								expect(d.confidenceCap).toBeDefined()
							}
							if (p.encrypted) expect(d.encrypted).toBe(true)
							if (p.confidence === "decoded") expect(d.protocol).toBe(p.protocol)
						}
						prev.set(d.id, d)
					}
				})
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 11: Bounded state
	// Validates: spec § 9
	it("keeps discoveries ≤ maxDiscoveries and metadata lists ≤ 64 for any event stream", () => {
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.array(opArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 120 }), ops => {
				const store = newStore(5)
				ops.forEach((op, i) => {
					apply(store, op, i)
					const all = store.snapshot().discoveries
					expect(all.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(5)
					for (const d of all) {
						for (const list of [d.metadata.talkgroups, d.metadata.sources, d.metadata.callsigns, d.metadata.capcodes, d.metadata.slots, d.metadata.ismModels])
							expect(list.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(64)
						expect(d.coChannel.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(64)
					}
				})
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 3: Exclusions and truncation
	// Validates: spec § 4.9, § 5.1, § 6.2
	it("never stores an observation without a covering job or with a truncated, IQ-image or spur track", () => {
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.array(opArb, { minLength: 0, maxLength: 30 }), fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 7 }), fc.constantFrom("noJob", "truncated", "iqImage", "spur"), (ops, slot, reason) => {
				const store = newStore()
				ops.forEach((op, i) => apply(store, op, i))
				const before = store.snapshot()
				const r = store.ingest(makeObs({ id: "probe-obs", centreHz: CH + slot * 6_250, startedAt: T0 + 1e6, cls: "fsk4-12k5", hypotheses: [["dmr", 0.9]], jobIds: reason === "noJob" ? [] : ["job-1"], truncated: reason === "truncated", iqImage: reason === "iqImage", spur: reason === "spur" }))
				expect(r).toEqual({ discoveryId: null, change: "transient" })
				expect(store.snapshot()).toEqual(before)
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 3: Exclusions and truncation
	// Validates: spec § 4.9, § 6.2
	it("unlinks an observation whose second ingest carries truncated, iqImage or spur, whatever came before", () => {
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.array(opArb, { minLength: 0, maxLength: 30 }), fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 7 }), fc.constantFrom("truncated", "iqImage", "spur"), fc.boolean(), (ops, slot, late, open) => {
				const store = newStore()
				ops.forEach((op, i) => apply(store, op, i))
				const spec = { id: "late-flag", centreHz: CH + slot * 6_250, startedAt: T0 + 1e6, cls: "fsk4-12k5" as const, hypotheses: [["dmr", 0.9]] as [ScannerProtocol, number][] }
				const first = store.ingest(makeObs({ ...spec, open }))
				const idsAfterFirst = new Set(store.snapshot().discoveries.map(d => d.id))
				const r = store.ingest(makeObs({ ...spec, truncated: late === "truncated", iqImage: late === "iqImage", spur: late === "spur" }))
				expect(r).toEqual({ discoveryId: null, change: "transient" })
				const after = store.snapshot()
				expect(after.observations.some(o => o.id === "late-flag")).toBe(false)
				expect(store.discoveryIdOf("late-flag")).toBeUndefined()
				for (const d of after.discoveries) expect(idsAfterFirst.has(d.id)).toBe(true)
				if (first.change === "created") expect(store.get(first.discoveryId ?? "")).toBeUndefined()
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})
})
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/store/schemas.ts
/**
 * Zod schemas for the scanner's persisted records (spec § 7.1, § 8). JSON has no `undefined`, so a
 * parsed optional key is either absent or set and the parsed value has exactly the interface type;
 * the `Assert` aliases fail the typecheck if a schema and its interface drift apart.
 */
import { z } from "zod"
import type {
	DecodeEvidence,
	Discovery,
	Observation,
	ProtocolFamily,
	ScannerClass,
	ScannerConfidence,
	ScannerProtocol,
} from "../types.js"
import type { Assert, SchemaMatches } from "../../spectrum/types.js"

type SameUnion<A, B> = [A] extends [B] ? ([B] extends [A] ? true : false) : false

export const ScannerProtocolSchema = z.enum([
	"analog-fm", "analog-am", "dmr", "p25p1", "p25p2", "nxdn48", "nxdn96", "ysf", "dstar",
	"dpmr", "pocsag", "flex", "aprs", "ism", "digital-unknown", "carrier", "unknown",
])
export const ScannerClassSchema = z.enum([
	"fsk4-12k5", "fsk4-6k25", "tdma-ms", "fsk2-wide", "gmsk-narrow", "afsk-fm", "analog-fm",
	"ook-burst", "carrier", "wideband", "unknown",
])
export const ProtocolFamilySchema = z.enum(["analog", "digital-voice", "pager", "packet", "ism", "carrier", "unknown"])
export const ConfidenceSchema = z.enum(["activity", "candidate", "classified", "decoded"])
export type ProtocolEnumCheck = Assert<SameUnion<ScannerProtocol, z.output<typeof ScannerProtocolSchema>>>
export type ClassEnumCheck = Assert<SameUnion<ScannerClass, z.output<typeof ScannerClassSchema>>>
export type FamilyEnumCheck = Assert<SameUnion<ProtocolFamily, z.output<typeof ProtocolFamilySchema>>>
export type ConfidenceEnumCheck = Assert<SameUnion<ScannerConfidence, z.output<typeof ConfidenceSchema>>>

const IdentitySchema = z.object({
	kind: z.enum(["dmr-cc", "p25-nac", "nxdn-ran", "ysf-dgid", "dstar-call", "dpmr-cc", "pocsag-capcode", "aprs-call", "ism-model"]),
	value: z.string(),
})
const TuningTrustSchema = z.enum(["commanded", "relay", "unverified"])
const SignalStatsSchema = z.object({ peakDbfs: z.number(), meanDbfs: z.number(), snrDb: z.number(), floorDbfs: z.number() })
const MetadataSchema = z.object({
	talkgroups: z.array(z.string()),
	sources: z.array(z.string()),
	slots: z.array(z.number()),
	callsigns: z.array(z.string()),
	capcodes: z.array(z.string()),
	ismModels: z.array(z.string()),
	ctcssHz: z.number().optional(),
})

export const DecodeEvidenceSchema = z.object({
	protocol: ScannerProtocolSchema,
	identity: IdentitySchema.optional(),
	metadata: MetadataSchema.required().partial(),
	crcClean: z.boolean(),
	encrypted: z.boolean().optional(),
	callId: z.string().optional(),
	at: z.number(),
	epoch: z.number().int(),
	origin: z.enum(["probe", "ambient"]),
	probeId: z.string().optional(),
	decoderId: z.string().optional(),
})
export type DecodeEvidenceCheck = Assert<SchemaMatches<DecodeEvidence, typeof DecodeEvidenceSchema>>

export const DiscoverySchema = z.object({
	id: z.string().min(1),
	frequencyHz: z.number(),
	frequencyKey: z.string(),
	measuredOffsetHz: z.number(),
	bandwidthHz: z.number(),
	protocol: ScannerProtocolSchema,
	family: ProtocolFamilySchema,
	class: ScannerClassSchema,
	confidence: ConfidenceSchema,
	confidenceCap: z.enum(["adjacent-leak", "suspected-intermod"]).optional(),
	identity: IdentitySchema.optional(),
	encrypted: z.boolean(),
	undecodedReason: z.enum(["no-sync", "crc-errors", "timeout", "no-probe-transport", "budget", "unsupported-format"]).optional(),
	coChannel: z.array(z.string()),
	firstSeenAt: z.string(),
	lastSeenAt: z.string(),
	observationCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	airtimeMs: z.number().nonnegative(),
	signal: z.object({ best: SignalStatsSchema, last: SignalStatsSchema }),
	metadata: MetadataSchema,
	sourceIds: z.array(z.string()),
	jobIds: z.array(z.string()),
	tuningTrust: TuningTrustSchema,
	operator: z
		.object({ label: z.string().optional(), notes: z.string().optional(), lockout: z.boolean().optional(), keep: z.boolean().optional() })
		.optional(),
	evidence: z.object({ recordings: z.number().int().nonnegative(), psd: z.boolean(), iq: z.boolean() }),
})
export type DiscoveryCheck = Assert<SchemaMatches<Discovery, typeof DiscoverySchema>>

export const ObservationSchema = z.object({
	id: z.string().min(1),
	discoveryId: z.string().min(1),
	startedAt: z.string(),
	endedAt: z.string().optional(),
	endReason: z.enum(["quiet", "retune", "hop", "job-end", "max-duration", "gap"]).optional(),
	sampleRange: z.object({ stream: z.number().int(), epoch: z.number().int(), start: z.number(), end: z.number().optional() }),
	centerHz: z.number(),
	obwHz: z.number(),
	obwMethod: z.enum(["-20dB", "on-bins"]),
	peakDbfs: z.number(),
	meanDbfs: z.number(),
	snrDb: z.number(),
	floorDbfs: z.number(),
	thresholdDb: z.number(),
	dutyCycle: z.number(),
	acf30: z.number().optional(),
	acf60: z.number().optional(),
	hypotheses: z.array(z.object({ protocol: ScannerProtocolSchema, score: z.number() })),
	decode: z.array(DecodeEvidenceSchema).optional(),
	recordingIds: z.array(z.string()),
	recording: z.enum(["linked", "cut", "encrypted-dropped", "none"]).optional(),
	flags: z.object({
		overload: z.boolean(),
		gap: z.boolean(),
		offRaster: z.boolean(),
		obwBiased: z.boolean(),
		adjacentLeak: z.boolean(),
		suspectedIntermod: z.boolean(),
		edge: z.boolean(),
	}),
	sourceId: z.string(),
	jobIds: z.array(z.string()),
	hopIndex: z.number().int().optional(),
	tuningTrust: TuningTrustSchema,
})
export type ObservationCheck = Assert<SchemaMatches<Observation, typeof ObservationSchema>>

/** One journal payload: the resulting records of one store mutation (spec § 8). */
export interface StoreMutation {
	discoveries: Discovery[]
	observations: Observation[]
	/** Discovery ids removed by this mutation. */
	deleted: string[]
	/** Observation ids unlinked by this mutation (a late truncated/iqImage flag, P3). */
	removedObservations?: string[]
	correction?: { sourceId: string; hz: number }
}
export const StoreMutationSchema = z.object({
	discoveries: z.array(DiscoverySchema),
	observations: z.array(ObservationSchema),
	deleted: z.array(z.string()),
	removedObservations: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
	correction: z.object({ sourceId: z.string(), hz: z.number() }).optional(),
})
export type StoreMutationCheck = Assert<SchemaMatches<StoreMutation, typeof StoreMutationSchema>>

export function parseStoreMutation(value: unknown): StoreMutation | null {
	const parsed = StoreMutationSchema.safeParse(value)
	return parsed.success ? (parsed.data as StoreMutation) : null
}

export function parseDiscoveries(value: unknown): Discovery[] | null {
	const parsed = z.array(DiscoverySchema).safeParse(value)
	return parsed.success ? (parsed.data as Discovery[]) : null
}

export function parseObservations(value: unknown): Observation[] | null {
	const parsed = z.array(ObservationSchema).safeParse(value)
	return parsed.success ? (parsed.data as Observation[]) : null
}
```
