```ts
// src/core/scanner/store/discovery-store.ts
/**
 * Discovery store (spec § 7): turns observations into deduplicated discoveries.
 *
 * Association per observation (§ 7.2): sticky (nearest same-family discovery whose median centre is
 * within the § 5.2 tolerance), then the fixed frequency key with the co-channel rules 2–4. Creation
 * passes the surfacing filter (a)–(d); anything else is a transient. Confidence follows the ladder
 * (§ 7.3): monotone, except a leak/intermod cap recorded before a decode. Every mutation emits one
 * journal entry whose payload holds the resulting records, so replay is an idempotent upsert.
 */
import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../../utils/errors.js"
import { frequencyKey, gridToleranceHz, rasterToleranceHz, snapToRaster } from "../bandplan/index.js"
import { familyOf } from "../classify/classifier.js"
import { CONFIDENCE_RANK } from "../types.js"
import type {
	Classification,
	ConfidenceCap,
	DecodeEvidence,
	Discovery,
	DiscoveryMetadata,
	Identity,
	Observation,
	ObservationInput,
	ProtocolFamily,
	ScannerClass,
	ScannerConfidence,
	ScannerProtocol,
	SignalStats,
} from "../types.js"
import type {
	Raster,
	TrackSnapshot,
} from "../../spectrum/types.js"
import { parseStoreMutation } from "./schemas.js"
import type { StoreMutation } from "./schemas.js"

export type StoreChange = "created" | "updated" | "upgraded" | "merged" | "deleted" | "transient"
export interface JournalEntry {
	seq: number
	at: string
	op: "observation" | "evidence" | "classification" | "operator" | "delete" | "rekey" | "evict"
	payload: unknown
}
export interface DiscoveryFilter {
	jobId?: string
	sourceId?: string
	protocol?: ScannerProtocol
	minConfidence?: ScannerConfidence
	freqMinHz?: number
	freqMaxHz?: number
	since?: number
	encrypted?: boolean
	q?: string
	sort?: "lastSeen" | "frequency" | "confidence"
	cursor?: string | null
	limit?: number
}
export interface DiscoveryStoreOptions {
	maxDiscoveries: number
	now: () => number
	newId: () => string
	minSurfaceBlocks?: number
	rasters?: (sourceId: string, centreHz: number) => Raster[]
}
export type RecordingLinkState = "linked" | "cut" | "encrypted-dropped" | "none"
export interface StoreSnapshot {
	discoveries: Discovery[]
	observations: Observation[]
	corrections: { sourceId: string; hz: number }[]
}

type Ingested = { discoveryId: string | null; change: StoreChange }

const METADATA_MAX = 64
const LINKS_MAX = 64
const OBSERVATIONS_PER_DISCOVERY = 256
const OBSERVATION_DECODE_MAX = 16
const MEDIAN_WINDOW = 64
const SINGLE_BLOCK_HITS = 3
const SINGLE_BLOCK_WINDOW_MS = 10 * 60_000
const SINGLE_BLOCK_EXTRA_DB = 6
const BURST_EXTRA_DB = 3 // spec § 4.10: k_short + 3 dB
const MAX_PENDING_KEYS = 4096
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 100
const MAX_LIMIT = 500
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000
const TRANSIENT: Ingested = { discoveryId: null, change: "transient" }
const CHANGE_RANK: Record<StoreChange, number> = { transient: 0, updated: 1, upgraded: 2, merged: 3, created: 4, deleted: 5 }

interface Op {
	discoveries: Set<string>
	observations: Set<string>
	deleted: string[]
	changes: Map<string, StoreChange>
	merged: [string, string][]
	removedObservations: string[]
	correction?: { sourceId: string; hz: number }
}

function newOp(): Op {
	return { discoveries: new Set(), observations: new Set(), deleted: [], changes: new Map(), merged: [], removedObservations: [] }
}

function mark(op: Op, id: string, change: StoreChange): void {
	const current = op.changes.get(id)
	if (current === undefined || CHANGE_RANK[change] > CHANGE_RANK[current]) op.changes.set(id, change)
}

const rank = (c: ScannerConfidence): number => CONFIDENCE_RANK[c]
const maxConfidence = (a: ScannerConfidence, b: ScannerConfidence): ScannerConfidence => (rank(a) >= rank(b) ? a : b)
const iso = (ms: number): string => new Date(ms).toISOString()
const compareText = (a: string, b: string): number => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0)
const compareObs = (a: Observation, b: Observation): number => compareText(a.startedAt, b.startedAt) || compareText(a.id, b.id)
const clone = <T>(value: T): T => structuredClone(value)

function median(values: readonly number[]): number {
	const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b)
	const mid = sorted.length >> 1
	const upper = sorted[mid] ?? 0
	return sorted.length % 2 === 1 ? upper : ((sorted[mid - 1] ?? upper) + upper) / 2
}

/** Appends values not yet present without reordering (link and job lists); keeps the newest `max`. */
function appendMissing(list: readonly string[], values: readonly string[], max = LINKS_MAX): string[] {
	const out = [...list]
	for (const v of values) if (!out.includes(v)) out.push(v)
	return out.length > max ? out.slice(out.length - max) : out
}

function lruMerge<T>(list: readonly T[], values: readonly T[], max = METADATA_MAX): T[] {
	const out = [...list]
	for (const v of values) {
		const i = out.indexOf(v)
		if (i >= 0) out.splice(i, 1)
		out.push(v)
	}
	return out.length > max ? out.slice(out.length - max) : out
}

function sameIdentity(a: Identity | undefined, b: Identity | undefined): boolean {
	if (a === undefined || b === undefined) return a === b
	return a.kind === b.kind && a.value === b.value
}

function observedProtocol(c: Classification): ScannerProtocol {
	const top = c.hypotheses[0]
	if (top !== undefined && top.score >= 0.5) return top.protocol
	if (c.class === "analog-fm") return "analog-fm"
	if (c.class === "carrier") return "carrier"
	return "unknown"
}

/** § 7.3 ladder value a classification supports on its own. */
function ladderOf(c: Classification): ScannerConfidence {
	const top = c.hypotheses[0]
	const strong = top !== undefined && top.score >= 0.5
	const known = c.class !== "carrier" && c.class !== "wideband" && c.class !== "unknown"
	if (c.tier === "channel" && c.cap === undefined && strong && known) return "classified"
	if (strong || c.class !== "unknown") return "candidate"
	return "activity"
}

/** § 7.2 (c): a classification counts as attached when it names something real. */
function classificationAttached(c: Classification): boolean {
	const top = c.hypotheses[0]
	if (top !== undefined && top.score >= 0.5 && top.protocol !== "unknown" && top.protocol !== "carrier") return true
	return c.class !== "unknown" && c.class !== "carrier" && c.class !== "wideband"
}

function moreSpecific(current: ScannerProtocol, next: ScannerProtocol): boolean {
	if (current === next || next === "unknown") return false
	if (current === "unknown" || current === "carrier") return true
	if (current === "digital-unknown") return familyOf(next) === "digital-voice" && next !== "digital-unknown"
	return false
}

function statsOf(t: TrackSnapshot): SignalStats {
	return { peakDbfs: t.peakDbfs, meanDbfs: t.meanDbfs, snrDb: t.snrDb, floorDbfs: t.floorDbfs }
}

function emptyMetadata(): DiscoveryMetadata {
	return { talkgroups: [], sources: [], slots: [], callsigns: [], capcodes: [], ismModels: [] }
}

/** Anything only a decode brings; a retracted observation never deletes a discovery that holds it. */
function hasDecodeEvidence(d: Discovery): boolean {
	const m = d.metadata
	const listed = m.talkgroups.length + m.sources.length + m.slots.length + m.callsigns.length + m.capcodes.length + m.ismModels.length
	return d.confidence === "decoded" || d.identity !== undefined || d.encrypted || listed > 0 || m.ctcssHz !== undefined
}

const durationOf = (obs: ObservationInput): number =>
	obs.endedAt === undefined ? 0 : Math.max(0, obs.endedAt - obs.startedAt)
const recordDuration = (o: Observation): number =>
	o.endedAt === undefined ? 0 : Math.max(0, Date.parse(o.endedAt) - Date.parse(o.startedAt))

export class DiscoveryStore extends EventEmitter {
	private maxDiscoveries: number
	private readonly now: () => number
	private readonly newId: () => string
	private minSurfaceBlocks: number
	private readonly rastersFor: (sourceId: string, centreHz: number) => Raster[]
	private readonly discoveries = new Map<string, Discovery>()
	private readonly observationIndex = new Map<string, Observation>()
	private readonly byDiscovery = new Map<string, Observation[]>()
	private readonly bySource = new Map<string, Set<string>>()
	private readonly pending = new Map<string, ObservationInput[]>()
	private readonly corrections = new Map<string, number>()
	private appliedSeq = 0

	constructor(opts: DiscoveryStoreOptions) {
		super()
		this.maxDiscoveries = opts.maxDiscoveries
		this.now = opts.now
		this.newId = opts.newId
		this.minSurfaceBlocks = opts.minSurfaceBlocks ?? 2
		this.rastersFor = opts.rasters ?? (() => [])
	}

	ingest(obs: ObservationInput): Ingested {
		const flagged = obs.track.flags.truncated || obs.track.flags.iqImage || obs.track.flags.spur // sticky, may be raised late (P3, § 4.9)
		const known = this.observationIndex.get(obs.id)
		if (known !== undefined) return flagged ? this.retract(known) : this.reingest(known, obs)
		if (flagged) {
			this.dropPending(obs.id)
			return TRANSIENT
		}
		if (obs.jobIds.length === 0) return TRANSIENT
		const edge = obs.track.flags.edge
		const protocol = edge ? "unknown" : observedProtocol(obs.classification)
		const family = familyOf(protocol)
		const sticky = this.stickyMatch(obs, family)
		if (sticky !== undefined) return this.commit("observation", op => this.addObservation(op, sticky, obs))
		const place = this.placement(obs.sourceId, obs.track.centreHz, obs.track.obwHz)
		const target = this.keyTarget(obs.sourceId, place.key, family, obs.classification.class)
		const into = target.merge
		if (into !== null) return this.commit("observation", op => this.addObservation(op, into, obs))
		if (!this.surfaces(obs)) return this.singleBlockHit(obs, place.key, protocol, family, target.coChannel)
		return this.createFrom([obs], protocol, family, target.coChannel)
	}

	/**
	 * Applies CRC-clean decode evidence. `opts.cap` is the leak/intermod cap computed for this decode
	 * (Task 35): it is recorded before the decode, so a capped decode leaves the discovery at `candidate`
	 * (§ 6.2); it is ignored once the discovery is `decoded` (P8). The discovery may be merged away by
	 * `settle()`; use `discoveryIdOf(observationId)` for the survivor.
	 */
	applyEvidence(discoveryId: string, ev: DecodeEvidence, opts: { cap?: ConfidenceCap } = {}): StoreChange | null {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(discoveryId)
		if (d === undefined || !ev.crcClean) return null
		if (ev.identity !== undefined && d.identity !== undefined && !sameIdentity(ev.identity, d.identity))
			return this.coChannelEvidence(d, ev, opts.cap)
		if (d.confidence === "decoded" && ev.protocol !== d.protocol) return null
		const before = JSON.stringify(d)
		const beforeRank = rank(d.confidence)
		this.capInto(d, opts.cap)
		this.decodeInto(d, ev)
		if (JSON.stringify(d) === before) return null
		const op = newOp()
		op.discoveries.add(d.id)
		mark(op, d.id, rank(d.confidence) > beforeRank ? "upgraded" : "updated")
		const id = this.settle(op, d)
		this.finish("evidence", op)
		return op.changes.get(id) ?? "updated"
	}

	applyClassification(discoveryId: string, c: Classification): StoreChange | null {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(discoveryId)
		if (d === undefined) return null
		const before = JSON.stringify(d)
		const beforeRank = rank(d.confidence)
		this.applyClassificationTo(d, c)
		if (JSON.stringify(d) === before) return null
		const op = newOp()
		op.discoveries.add(d.id)
		mark(op, d.id, rank(d.confidence) > beforeRank ? "upgraded" : "updated")
		const id = this.settle(op, d)
		this.finish("classification", op)
		return op.changes.get(id) ?? "updated"
	}

	/** Surviving discovery id of an in-memory observation (after any settle merge); undefined when unknown or trimmed. */
	discoveryIdOf(observationId: string): string | undefined {
		return this.observationIndex.get(observationId)?.discoveryId
	}

	/**
	 * Appends accepted evidence to `Observation.decode` (§ 7.1 "accepted values only"): CRC-clean, the
	 * observation's epoch (P17, as the probe pool's rule in Task 34), not stamped after that epoch ended
	 * (`endedAt` when the observation ended by `retune` or `hop`). Exact duplicates are ignored; the list
	 * keeps the 16 newest by `at`. Journaled as one `"evidence"` entry.
	 */
	appendObservationEvidence(observationId: string, ev: DecodeEvidence): boolean {
		const o = this.observationIndex.get(observationId)
		if (o === undefined || !ev.crcClean || ev.epoch !== o.sampleRange.epoch) return false
		const epochEnded = o.endReason === "retune" || o.endReason === "hop"
		if (epochEnded && o.endedAt !== undefined && ev.at >= Date.parse(o.endedAt)) return false
		const list = o.decode ?? []
		const text = JSON.stringify(ev)
		if (list.some(x => JSON.stringify(x) === text)) return false
		const added = clone(ev)
		const sorted = [...list, added].sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at)
		const kept = sorted.length > OBSERVATION_DECODE_MAX ? sorted.slice(sorted.length - OBSERVATION_DECODE_MAX) : sorted
		if (!kept.includes(added)) return false // older than the 16 kept
		o.decode = kept
		const op = newOp()
		op.observations.add(o.id)
		this.finish("evidence", op)
		return true
	}

	/** Runtime settings change (Task 35): the new bounds apply from the next ingest/eviction pass. */
	setLimits(opts: { maxDiscoveries: number; minSurfaceBlocks: number }): void {
		this.maxDiscoveries = opts.maxDiscoveries
		this.minSurfaceBlocks = opts.minSurfaceBlocks
	}

	setOperator(id: string, patch: Partial<NonNullable<Discovery["operator"]>>): Discovery {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(id)
		if (d === undefined) throw new WaveKitError(`Discovery ${id} not found`, "SCANNER_DISCOVERY_NOT_FOUND")
		const operator: NonNullable<Discovery["operator"]> = { ...(d.operator ?? {}) }
		if (patch.label !== undefined) operator.label = patch.label
		if (patch.notes !== undefined) operator.notes = patch.notes
		if (patch.lockout !== undefined) operator.lockout = patch.lockout
		if (patch.keep !== undefined) operator.keep = patch.keep
		d.operator = operator
		const op = newOp()
		op.discoveries.add(id)
		mark(op, id, "updated")
		this.finish("operator", op)
		return clone(d)
	}

	delete(id: string): boolean {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(id)
		if (d === undefined) return false
		const op = newOp()
		this.deleteInto(op, d)
		this.finish("delete", op)
		return true
	}

	rekey(sourceId: string, correctionHz: number): { merged: [string, string][] } {
		const op = newOp()
		this.corrections.set(sourceId, correctionHz)
		op.correction = { sourceId, hz: correctionHz }
		const ids = [...(this.bySource.get(sourceId) ?? [])].sort()
		for (const id of ids) {
			const d = this.discoveries.get(id)
			if (d === undefined) continue
			const before = `${d.frequencyKey}|${d.frequencyHz}|${d.measuredOffsetHz}`
			this.refresh(d)
			if (`${d.frequencyKey}|${d.frequencyHz}|${d.measuredOffsetHz}` !== before) {
				op.discoveries.add(id)
				mark(op, id, "updated")
			}
		}
		for (const id of ids) {
			const d = this.discoveries.get(id)
			if (d !== undefined) this.settle(op, d)
		}
		this.finish("rekey", op)
		return { merged: op.merged }
	}

	attachRecordings(observationId: string, recordingIds: string[], state: RecordingLinkState): boolean {
		const o = this.observationIndex.get(observationId)
		const d = o === undefined ? undefined : this.discoveries.get(o.discoveryId)
		if (o === undefined || d === undefined) return false
		const added = recordingIds.filter(r => !o.recordingIds.includes(r))
		o.recordingIds = [...o.recordingIds, ...added]
		o.recording = state
		d.evidence.recordings += added.length
		const op = newOp()
		op.discoveries.add(d.id)
		op.observations.add(o.id)
		mark(op, d.id, "updated")
		this.finish("evidence", op)
		return true
	}

	setEvidenceFlags(discoveryId: string, patch: Partial<Discovery["evidence"]>): boolean {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(discoveryId)
		if (d === undefined) return false
		if (patch.recordings !== undefined) d.evidence.recordings = patch.recordings
		if (patch.psd !== undefined) d.evidence.psd = patch.psd
		if (patch.iq !== undefined) d.evidence.iq = patch.iq
		const op = newOp()
		op.discoveries.add(d.id)
		mark(op, d.id, "updated")
		this.finish("evidence", op)
		return true
	}

	setUndecodedReason(discoveryId: string, reason: NonNullable<Discovery["undecodedReason"]>): boolean {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(discoveryId)
		if (d === undefined || d.confidence === "decoded" || d.undecodedReason === reason) return false
		d.undecodedReason = reason
		const op = newOp()
		op.discoveries.add(d.id)
		mark(op, d.id, "updated")
		this.finish("classification", op)
		return true
	}

	pruneInactive(maxAgeDays: number): string[] {
		const cutoff = iso(this.now() - maxAgeDays * DAY_MS)
		const op = newOp()
		const removed: string[] = []
		for (const d of [...this.discoveries.values()]) {
			if (d.operator?.keep === true || d.lastSeenAt >= cutoff) continue
			removed.push(d.id)
			this.deleteInto(op, d)
		}
		this.finish("evict", op)
		return removed
	}

	correction(sourceId: string): number {
		return this.corrections.get(sourceId) ?? 0
	}

	get(id: string): Discovery | undefined {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(id)
		return d === undefined ? undefined : clone(d)
	}

	list(filter: DiscoveryFilter): { items: Discovery[]; nextCursor: string | null } {
		const limit = Math.min(MAX_LIMIT, Math.max(1, Math.floor(filter.limit ?? DEFAULT_LIMIT)))
		const offset = parseCursor(filter.cursor ?? null)
		const q = filter.q?.toLowerCase()
		const min = filter.minConfidence
		const items = [...this.discoveries.values()].filter(
			d =>
				(filter.jobId === undefined || d.jobIds.includes(filter.jobId)) &&
				(filter.sourceId === undefined || d.sourceIds.includes(filter.sourceId)) &&
				(filter.protocol === undefined || d.protocol === filter.protocol) &&
				(min === undefined || rank(d.confidence) >= rank(min)) &&
				(filter.freqMinHz === undefined || d.frequencyHz >= filter.freqMinHz) &&
				(filter.freqMaxHz === undefined || d.frequencyHz <= filter.freqMaxHz) &&
				(filter.since === undefined || Date.parse(d.lastSeenAt) >= filter.since) &&
				(filter.encrypted === undefined || d.encrypted === filter.encrypted) &&
				(q === undefined || (d.operator?.label ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q)),
		)
		const byLastSeen = (a: Discovery, b: Discovery): number => compareText(b.lastSeenAt, a.lastSeenAt) || compareText(a.id, b.id)
		const sort = filter.sort ?? "lastSeen"
		items.sort(
			sort === "frequency"
				? (a, b) => a.frequencyHz - b.frequencyHz || compareText(a.id, b.id)
				: sort === "confidence"
					? (a, b) => rank(b.confidence) - rank(a.confidence) || byLastSeen(a, b)
					: byLastSeen,
		)
		const page = items.slice(offset, offset + limit).map(clone)
		return { items: page, nextCursor: offset + limit < items.length ? String(offset + limit) : null }
	}

	observations(discoveryId: string, cursor: string | null, limit: number): { items: Observation[]; nextCursor: string | null } {
		const all = [...(this.byDiscovery.get(discoveryId) ?? [])].reverse()
		const offset = parseCursor(cursor)
		const size = Math.min(MAX_LIMIT, Math.max(1, Math.floor(limit)))
		return {
			items: all.slice(offset, offset + size).map(clone),
			nextCursor: offset + size < all.length ? String(offset + size) : null,
		}
	}

	/** Everything replay cannot rebuild without the pruned journal: records plus per-source corrections (P13). */
	snapshot(): StoreSnapshot {
		return {
			discoveries: [...this.discoveries.values()].sort((a, b) => compareText(a.id, b.id)).map(clone),
			observations: [...this.observationIndex.values()].sort(compareObs).map(clone),
			corrections: [...this.corrections].sort(([a], [b]) => compareText(a, b)).map(([sourceId, hz]) => ({ sourceId, hz })),
		}
	}

	restore(s: StoreSnapshot): void {
		this.discoveries.clear()
		this.observationIndex.clear()
		this.byDiscovery.clear()
		this.bySource.clear()
		this.pending.clear()
		this.corrections.clear()
		this.appliedSeq = 0
		for (const c of s.corrections) this.corrections.set(c.sourceId, c.hz)
		for (const d of s.discoveries) this.insertDiscovery(clone(d))
		for (const o of [...s.observations].sort(compareObs))
			if (this.discoveries.has(o.discoveryId)) this.putObservation(clone(o))
	}

	replay(entry: JournalEntry): void {
		if (entry.seq <= this.appliedSeq) return
		const m = parseStoreMutation(entry.payload)
		if (m === null)
			throw new WaveKitError(`Journal entry ${entry.seq} has an invalid payload`, "SCANNER_JOURNAL_INVALID")
		this.applyMutation(m)
		this.appliedSeq = entry.seq
	}

	// ── association ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	private stickyMatch(obs: ObservationInput, family: ProtocolFamily): Discovery | undefined {
		const ids = this.bySource.get(obs.sourceId)
		if (ids === undefined) return undefined
		const tol = this.toleranceHz(obs.sourceId, obs.track.centreHz, obs.track.obwHz)
		let best: Discovery | undefined
		let bestDist = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
		for (const id of ids) {
			const d = this.discoveries.get(id)
			if (d === undefined || d.family !== family) continue
			const dist = Math.abs(this.medianCentre(d) - obs.track.centreHz)
			if (dist > tol) continue
			const better =
				best === undefined ||
				dist < bestDist ||
				(dist === bestDist && (d.lastSeenAt > best.lastSeenAt || (d.lastSeenAt === best.lastSeenAt && d.id < best.id)))
			if (better) {
				best = d
				bestDist = dist
			}
		}
		return best
	}

	private keyTarget(
		sourceId: string,
		key: string,
		family: ProtocolFamily,
		cls: ScannerClass,
	): { merge: Discovery | null; coChannel: string[] } {
		const atKey = this.atKey(sourceId, key)
		const same = atKey.filter(d => d.family === family)
		const [only] = same
		if (same.length === 1 && only !== undefined) return { merge: only, coChannel: [] }
		if (same.length > 1) {
			const pick = same.find(d => d.class === cls) ?? same.find(d => d.identity === undefined)
			return pick !== undefined ? { merge: pick, coChannel: [] } : { merge: null, coChannel: same.map(d => d.id) }
		}
		if (family === "unknown") {
			const others = atKey.filter(d => d.family !== "carrier")
			const [single] = others
			if (others.length === 1 && single !== undefined) return { merge: single, coChannel: [] }
		} else {
			const [lone] = atKey
			if (atKey.length === 1 && lone !== undefined && lone.family === "unknown") return { merge: lone, coChannel: [] }
		}
		return { merge: null, coChannel: atKey.map(d => d.id) }
	}

	private surfaces(obs: ObservationInput): boolean {
		const t = obs.track
		if (t.flags.burst) return t.maxBlockSnrDb >= t.thresholdDb + BURST_EXTRA_DB // otherwise rule (d) repetition only
		if (t.blocks >= this.minSurfaceBlocks) return true
		if (obs.singleBlockSurfacingAllowed && t.maxBlockSnrDb >= t.thresholdDb + SINGLE_BLOCK_EXTRA_DB) return true
		return !t.flags.edge && classificationAttached(obs.classification)
	}

	private singleBlockHit(
		obs: ObservationInput,
		key: string,
		protocol: ScannerProtocol,
		family: ProtocolFamily,
		coChannel: string[],
	): Ingested {
		const pendingKey = `${obs.sourceId}|${key}`
		const hits = (this.pending.get(pendingKey) ?? []).filter(
			h => h.id !== obs.id && Math.abs(obs.startedAt - h.startedAt) <= SINGLE_BLOCK_WINDOW_MS,
		)
		hits.push(obs)
		this.pending.delete(pendingKey)
		if (hits.length < SINGLE_BLOCK_HITS) {
			this.pending.set(pendingKey, hits)
			if (this.pending.size > MAX_PENDING_KEYS) {
				const oldest = this.pending.keys().next()
				if (oldest.done !== true) this.pending.delete(oldest.value)
			}
			return TRANSIENT
		}
		hits.sort((a, b) => a.startedAt - b.startedAt || compareText(a.id, b.id))
		return this.createFrom(hits, protocol, family, coChannel)
	}

	private createFrom(hits: ObservationInput[], protocol: ScannerProtocol, family: ProtocolFamily, coChannel: string[]): Ingested {
		const [first, ...rest] = hits
		if (first === undefined || !this.makeRoom()) return TRANSIENT
		return this.commit("observation", op => {
			const d = this.newDiscovery(op, first, protocol, family, coChannel)
			let id = this.addObservation(op, d, first)
			for (const hit of rest) {
				const current = this.discoveries.get(id)
				if (current !== undefined) id = this.addObservation(op, current, hit)
			}
			return id
		})
	}

	private newDiscovery(op: Op, obs: ObservationInput, protocol: ScannerProtocol, family: ProtocolFamily, coChannel: string[]): Discovery {
		const place = this.placement(obs.sourceId, obs.track.centreHz, obs.track.obwHz)
		const stats = statsOf(obs.track)
		const at = iso(obs.startedAt)
		const d: Discovery = {
			id: `d_${this.newId()}`,
			frequencyHz: Math.round(place.frequencyHz),
			frequencyKey: place.key,
			measuredOffsetHz: 0,
			bandwidthHz: Math.round(obs.track.obwHz),
			protocol,
			family,
			class: obs.track.flags.edge ? "unknown" : obs.classification.class,
			confidence: obs.track.flags.edge ? "activity" : ladderOf(obs.classification),
			encrypted: false,
			coChannel: coChannel.filter(id => this.discoveries.has(id)).slice(0, LINKS_MAX),
			firstSeenAt: at,
			lastSeenAt: at,
			observationCount: 0,
			airtimeMs: 0,
			signal: { best: stats, last: { ...stats } },
			metadata: emptyMetadata(),
			sourceIds: [obs.sourceId],
			jobIds: [],
			tuningTrust: obs.track.tuningTrust,
			evidence: { recordings: 0, psd: false, iq: false },
		}
		this.insertDiscovery(d)
		for (const otherId of d.coChannel) {
			const other = this.discoveries.get(otherId)
			if (other === undefined) continue
			other.coChannel = appendMissing(other.coChannel, [d.id])
			op.discoveries.add(other.id)
			mark(op, other.id, "updated")
		}
		this.pending.delete(`${obs.sourceId}|${place.key}`)
		op.discoveries.add(d.id)
		mark(op, d.id, "created")
		return d
	}

	private addObservation(op: Op, d: Discovery, obs: ObservationInput): string {
		const beforeRank = rank(d.confidence)
		const record = this.toRecord(obs, d.id)
		this.putObservation(record)
		op.observations.add(record.id)
		d.observationCount += 1
		d.airtimeMs += durationOf(obs)
		this.absorbStats(d, obs, true)
		this.refresh(d)
		op.discoveries.add(d.id)
		mark(op, d.id, rank(d.confidence) > beforeRank ? "upgraded" : "updated")
		return this.settle(op, d)
	}

	private reingest(known: Observation, obs: ObservationInput): Ingested {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(known.discoveryId)
		if (d === undefined) return TRANSIENT
		const beforeD = JSON.stringify(d)
		const beforeO = JSON.stringify(known)
		const beforeRank = rank(d.confidence)
		const record = this.toRecord(obs, d.id)
		record.jobIds = appendMissing(known.jobIds, obs.jobIds) // a job that ended while the track was open keeps its credit
		record.recordingIds = known.recordingIds
		if (known.recording !== undefined) record.recording = known.recording
		if (known.decode !== undefined) record.decode = known.decode
		d.airtimeMs = Math.max(0, d.airtimeMs + durationOf(obs) - recordDuration(known))
		this.unlinkObservation(known)
		this.putObservation(record)
		const sameClassification =
			JSON.stringify(record.hypotheses) === JSON.stringify(known.hypotheses) &&
			record.flags.adjacentLeak === known.flags.adjacentLeak &&
			record.flags.suspectedIntermod === known.flags.suspectedIntermod
		this.absorbStats(d, obs, !sameClassification)
		this.refresh(d)
		if (JSON.stringify(d) === beforeD && JSON.stringify(record) === beforeO) return { discoveryId: d.id, change: "updated" }
		return this.commit("observation", op => {
			op.discoveries.add(d.id)
			op.observations.add(record.id)
			mark(op, d.id, rank(d.confidence) > beforeRank ? "upgraded" : "updated")
			return this.settle(op, d)
		})
	}

	/**
	 * A known observation whose track became truncated or an IQ image (sticky flags, raised late) is
	 * unlinked (P3, § 4.9). Its discovery loses the count and airtime and is deleted when nothing is left
	 * that the observation did not bring: no observation, no decode evidence, not `keep`. One entry.
	 */
	private retract(known: Observation): Ingested {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(known.discoveryId)
		this.dropPending(known.id)
		if (d === undefined) return TRANSIENT
		const op = newOp()
		this.unlinkObservation(known)
		op.removedObservations.push(known.id)
		d.observationCount = Math.max(0, d.observationCount - 1)
		d.airtimeMs = Math.max(0, d.airtimeMs - recordDuration(known))
		if (d.observationCount === 0 && !hasDecodeEvidence(d) && d.operator?.keep !== true) {
			this.deleteInto(op, d)
		} else {
			this.refresh(d)
			op.discoveries.add(d.id)
			mark(op, d.id, "updated")
			this.settle(op, d)
		}
		this.finish("observation", op)
		return TRANSIENT
	}

	private dropPending(observationId: string): void {
		for (const [key, hits] of this.pending) {
			if (!hits.some(h => h.id === observationId)) continue
			const rest = hits.filter(h => h.id !== observationId)
			if (rest.length === 0) this.pending.delete(key)
			else this.pending.set(key, rest)
		}
	}

	private absorbStats(d: Discovery, obs: ObservationInput, applyClassification: boolean): void {
		const startedAt = iso(obs.startedAt)
		const endedAt = iso(obs.endedAt ?? obs.startedAt)
		if (startedAt < d.firstSeenAt) d.firstSeenAt = startedAt
		const stats = statsOf(obs.track)
		if (endedAt >= d.lastSeenAt) {
			d.lastSeenAt = endedAt
			d.signal.last = stats
			d.tuningTrust = obs.track.tuningTrust
		}
		if (stats.snrDb > d.signal.best.snrDb) d.signal.best = { ...stats }
		d.jobIds = appendMissing(d.jobIds, obs.jobIds)
		d.sourceIds = appendMissing(d.sourceIds, [obs.sourceId])
		if (applyClassification && !obs.track.flags.edge) this.applyClassificationTo(d, obs.classification)
	}

	private applyClassificationTo(d: Discovery, c: Classification): void {
		const decoded = d.confidence === "decoded"
		if (c.cap !== undefined && !decoded) d.confidenceCap = c.cap
		const p = observedProtocol(c)
		if (!decoded && moreSpecific(d.protocol, p)) {
			d.protocol = p
			d.family = familyOf(p)
		}
		if (!decoded && c.class !== "unknown") d.class = c.class
		d.confidence = maxConfidence(d.confidence, ladderOf(c))
		this.clampToCap(d)
	}

	private decodeInto(d: Discovery, ev: DecodeEvidence): void {
		if (d.protocol !== ev.protocol) {
			d.protocol = ev.protocol
			d.family = familyOf(ev.protocol)
		}
		if (d.identity === undefined && ev.identity !== undefined) d.identity = { kind: ev.identity.kind, value: ev.identity.value }
		if (ev.encrypted === true) d.encrypted = true
		const m = ev.metadata
		if (m.talkgroups !== undefined) d.metadata.talkgroups = lruMerge(d.metadata.talkgroups, m.talkgroups)
		if (m.sources !== undefined) d.metadata.sources = lruMerge(d.metadata.sources, m.sources)
		if (m.slots !== undefined) d.metadata.slots = lruMerge(d.metadata.slots, m.slots)
		if (m.callsigns !== undefined) d.metadata.callsigns = lruMerge(d.metadata.callsigns, m.callsigns)
		if (m.capcodes !== undefined) d.metadata.capcodes = lruMerge(d.metadata.capcodes, m.capcodes)
		if (m.ismModels !== undefined) d.metadata.ismModels = lruMerge(d.metadata.ismModels, m.ismModels)
		if (m.ctcssHz !== undefined) d.metadata.ctcssHz = m.ctcssHz
		d.confidence = maxConfidence(d.confidence, d.confidenceCap !== undefined ? "candidate" : "decoded")
		if (d.confidence === "decoded") {
			delete d.confidenceCap
			delete d.undecodedReason
		}
		const at = iso(ev.at)
		if (at > d.lastSeenAt) d.lastSeenAt = at
	}

	private coChannelEvidence(d: Discovery, ev: DecodeEvidence, cap: ConfidenceCap | undefined): StoreChange | null {
		const family = familyOf(ev.protocol)
		const sourceId = d.sourceIds[0] ?? ""
		const existing = this.atKey(sourceId, d.frequencyKey).find(o => o.family === family && sameIdentity(o.identity, ev.identity))
		if (existing !== undefined) return this.applyEvidence(existing.id, ev, cap === undefined ? {} : { cap })
		if (!this.makeRoom()) return null
		const op = newOp()
		const at = iso(ev.at)
		const twin: Discovery = {
			id: `d_${this.newId()}`,
			frequencyHz: d.frequencyHz,
			frequencyKey: d.frequencyKey,
			measuredOffsetHz: d.measuredOffsetHz,
			bandwidthHz: d.bandwidthHz,
			protocol: ev.protocol,
			family,
			class: d.class,
			confidence: "activity",
			encrypted: false,
			coChannel: [],
			firstSeenAt: at,
			lastSeenAt: at,
			observationCount: 0,
			airtimeMs: 0,
			signal: clone(d.signal),
			metadata: emptyMetadata(),
			sourceIds: [...d.sourceIds],
			jobIds: [...d.jobIds],
			tuningTrust: d.tuningTrust,
			evidence: { recordings: 0, psd: false, iq: false },
		}
		this.insertDiscovery(twin)
		this.capInto(twin, cap)
		this.decodeInto(twin, ev)
		const partner = this.discoveries.get(d.id)
		if (partner !== undefined) {
			twin.coChannel = [partner.id]
			partner.coChannel = appendMissing(partner.coChannel, [twin.id])
			op.discoveries.add(partner.id)
			mark(op, partner.id, "updated")
		}
		op.discoveries.add(twin.id)
		mark(op, twin.id, "created")
		const id = this.settle(op, twin)
		this.finish("evidence", op)
		return op.changes.get(id) ?? "created"
	}

	/** Records a leak/intermod cap that arrives with a decode, before the decode is applied (§ 6.2, P8). */
	private capInto(d: Discovery, cap: ConfidenceCap | undefined): void {
		if (cap === undefined || d.confidence === "decoded") return
		d.confidenceCap = cap
		this.clampToCap(d)
	}

	private clampToCap(d: Discovery): void {
		if (d.confidenceCap !== undefined && d.confidence !== "decoded" && rank(d.confidence) > rank("candidate"))
			d.confidence = "candidate"
	}

	// ── keys, medians and collisions ─────────────────────────────────────

	private toleranceHz(sourceId: string, centreHz: number, obwHz: number): number {
		const rasters = this.rastersFor(sourceId, centreHz)
		if (rasters.length === 0) return gridToleranceHz(obwHz)
		return rasterToleranceHz(Math.min(...rasters.map(r => r.spacingHz)))
	}

	private placement(sourceId: string, centreHz: number, obwHz: number): { frequencyHz: number; key: string; offRaster: boolean } {
		const rasters = this.rastersFor(sourceId, centreHz)
		const snap = snapToRaster(centreHz, rasters, this.corrections.get(sourceId) ?? 0)
		return { frequencyHz: snap.hz, key: frequencyKey(snap.hz, snap.snapped, obwHz), offRaster: rasters.length > 0 && !snap.snapped }
	}

	private medianCentre(d: Discovery): number {
		const recent = (this.byDiscovery.get(d.id) ?? []).slice(-MEDIAN_WINDOW)
		return recent.length > 0 ? median(recent.map(o => o.centerHz)) : d.frequencyHz + d.measuredOffsetHz
	}

	/** Recomputes frequency, key, offset and bandwidth from the last 64 observations. */
	private refresh(d: Discovery): void {
		const recent = (this.byDiscovery.get(d.id) ?? []).slice(-MEDIAN_WINDOW)
		const centre = recent.length > 0 ? median(recent.map(o => o.centerHz)) : d.frequencyHz + d.measuredOffsetHz
		const obw = recent.length > 0 ? median(recent.map(o => o.obwHz)) : d.bandwidthHz
		const place = this.placement(d.sourceIds[0] ?? "", centre, obw)
		d.frequencyHz = Math.round(place.frequencyHz)
		d.frequencyKey = place.key
		d.measuredOffsetHz = Math.round(centre - place.frequencyHz)
		d.bandwidthHz = Math.round(obw)
	}

	private atKey(sourceId: string, key: string): Discovery[] {
		const out: Discovery[] = []
		for (const id of this.bySource.get(sourceId) ?? []) {
			const d = this.discoveries.get(id)
			if (d !== undefined && d.frequencyKey === key) out.push(d)
		}
		return out.sort((a, b) => compareText(b.lastSeenAt, a.lastSeenAt) || compareText(a.id, b.id))
	}

	/** Merges every discovery that collides with `start` on (source, key, family, identity). */
	private settle(op: Op, start: Discovery): string {
		let d = start
		for (;;) {
			const other = this.atKey(d.sourceIds[0] ?? "", d.frequencyKey).find(
				o => o.id !== d.id && o.family === d.family && sameIdentity(o.identity, d.identity),
			)
			if (other === undefined) return d.id
			const [keep, drop] =
				compareText(d.firstSeenAt, other.firstSeenAt) < 0 || (d.firstSeenAt === other.firstSeenAt && d.id < other.id)
					? [d, other]
					: [other, d]
			this.absorb(op, keep, drop)
			d = keep
		}
	}

	private absorb(op: Op, keep: Discovery, drop: Discovery): void {
		for (const o of [...(this.byDiscovery.get(drop.id) ?? [])]) {
			this.unlinkObservation(o)
			o.discoveryId = keep.id
			this.putObservation(o)
			op.observations.add(o.id)
		}
		keep.observationCount += drop.observationCount
		keep.airtimeMs += drop.airtimeMs
		if (drop.firstSeenAt < keep.firstSeenAt) keep.firstSeenAt = drop.firstSeenAt
		if (drop.lastSeenAt > keep.lastSeenAt) {
			keep.lastSeenAt = drop.lastSeenAt
			keep.signal.last = drop.signal.last
			keep.tuningTrust = drop.tuningTrust
		}
		if (drop.signal.best.snrDb > keep.signal.best.snrDb) keep.signal.best = drop.signal.best
		const km = keep.metadata
		const dm = drop.metadata
		km.talkgroups = lruMerge(km.talkgroups, dm.talkgroups)
		km.sources = lruMerge(km.sources, dm.sources)
		km.slots = lruMerge(km.slots, dm.slots)
		km.callsigns = lruMerge(km.callsigns, dm.callsigns)
		km.capcodes = lruMerge(km.capcodes, dm.capcodes)
		km.ismModels = lruMerge(km.ismModels, dm.ismModels)
		if (km.ctcssHz === undefined && dm.ctcssHz !== undefined) km.ctcssHz = dm.ctcssHz
		keep.jobIds = appendMissing(keep.jobIds, drop.jobIds)
		keep.sourceIds = appendMissing(keep.sourceIds, drop.sourceIds)
		keep.encrypted = keep.encrypted || drop.encrypted
		if (keep.identity === undefined && drop.identity !== undefined) keep.identity = drop.identity
		if (keep.confidence !== "decoded" && (drop.confidence === "decoded" || moreSpecific(keep.protocol, drop.protocol))) {
			keep.protocol = drop.protocol
			keep.family = drop.family
			if (drop.class !== "unknown") keep.class = drop.class
		}
		keep.confidence = maxConfidence(keep.confidence, drop.confidence)
		if (keep.confidence === "decoded" || drop.confidenceCap === undefined) delete keep.confidenceCap
		if (keep.confidence === "decoded") delete keep.undecodedReason
		else if (keep.undecodedReason === undefined && drop.undecodedReason !== undefined) keep.undecodedReason = drop.undecodedReason
		if (keep.operator !== undefined || drop.operator !== undefined) {
			const a = keep.operator ?? {}
			const b = drop.operator ?? {}
			const merged: NonNullable<Discovery["operator"]> = {}
			const label = a.label ?? b.label
			const notes = a.notes ?? b.notes
			if (label !== undefined) merged.label = label
			if (notes !== undefined) merged.notes = notes
			if (a.lockout === true || b.lockout === true) merged.lockout = true
			if (a.keep === true || b.keep === true) merged.keep = true
			keep.operator = merged
		}
		keep.evidence = {
			recordings: keep.evidence.recordings + drop.evidence.recordings,
			psd: keep.evidence.psd || drop.evidence.psd,
			iq: keep.evidence.iq || drop.evidence.iq,
		}
		keep.coChannel = appendMissing(keep.coChannel, drop.coChannel).filter(id => id !== keep.id && id !== drop.id)
		for (const partnerId of drop.coChannel) {
			const partner = this.discoveries.get(partnerId)
			if (partner === undefined || partner.id === keep.id) continue
			partner.coChannel = appendMissing(partner.coChannel.filter(id => id !== drop.id), [keep.id])
			op.discoveries.add(partner.id)
			mark(op, partner.id, "updated")
		}
		this.removeDiscovery(drop.id)
		op.discoveries.delete(drop.id)
		op.deleted.push(drop.id)
		op.merged.push([keep.id, drop.id])
		mark(op, drop.id, "deleted")
		mark(op, keep.id, "merged")
		op.discoveries.add(keep.id)
		this.refresh(keep)
	}

	/** Evicts until one more discovery fits (several after `setLimits` lowered the bound); one "evict" entry. */
	private makeRoom(): boolean {
		if (this.discoveries.size < this.maxDiscoveries) return true
		const op = newOp()
		let fits = true
		while (this.discoveries.size >= this.maxDiscoveries) {
			const victim = this.evictionVictim()
			if (victim === undefined) {
				fits = false
				break
			}
			this.deleteInto(op, victim)
		}
		this.finish("evict", op)
		return fits
	}

	/** Lowest confidence, then oldest `lastSeenAt` (ties: smaller id); never `decoded` or `keep`. */
	private evictionVictim(): Discovery | undefined {
		let victim: Discovery | undefined
		for (const d of this.discoveries.values()) {
			if (d.confidence === "decoded" || d.operator?.keep === true) continue
			if (
				victim === undefined ||
				rank(d.confidence) < rank(victim.confidence) ||
				(rank(d.confidence) === rank(victim.confidence) &&
					(d.lastSeenAt < victim.lastSeenAt || (d.lastSeenAt === victim.lastSeenAt && d.id < victim.id)))
			)
				victim = d
		}
		return victim
	}

	private deleteInto(op: Op, d: Discovery): void {
		for (const partnerId of d.coChannel) {
			const partner = this.discoveries.get(partnerId)
			if (partner === undefined) continue
			partner.coChannel = partner.coChannel.filter(id => id !== d.id)
			op.discoveries.add(partner.id)
			mark(op, partner.id, "updated")
		}
		this.removeDiscovery(d.id)
		op.discoveries.delete(d.id)
		op.deleted.push(d.id)
		mark(op, d.id, "deleted")
	}

	// ── records and indexes ──────────────────────────────────────────────

	private toRecord(obs: ObservationInput, discoveryId: string): Observation {
		const t = obs.track
		const place = this.placement(obs.sourceId, t.centreHz, t.obwHz)
		const cap = obs.classification.cap
		const record: Observation = {
			id: obs.id,
			discoveryId,
			startedAt: iso(obs.startedAt),
			sampleRange: { stream: t.stream, epoch: t.epoch, start: t.startSample },
			centerHz: t.centreHz,
			obwHz: t.obwHz,
			obwMethod: t.obwMethod,
			peakDbfs: t.peakDbfs,
			meanDbfs: t.meanDbfs,
			snrDb: t.snrDb,
			floorDbfs: t.floorDbfs,
			thresholdDb: t.thresholdDb,
			dutyCycle: t.dutyCycle,
			hypotheses: obs.classification.hypotheses.map(h => ({ protocol: h.protocol, score: h.score })),
			recordingIds: [],
			flags: {
				overload: t.flags.overload,
				gap: t.flags.gap,
				offRaster: place.offRaster,
				obwBiased: t.flags.obwBiased,
				adjacentLeak: cap === "adjacent-leak",
				suspectedIntermod: cap === "suspected-intermod",
				edge: t.flags.edge,
			},
			sourceId: obs.sourceId,
			jobIds: [...obs.jobIds],
			tuningTrust: t.tuningTrust,
		}
		if (obs.endedAt !== undefined) {
			record.endedAt = iso(obs.endedAt)
			record.sampleRange.end = t.lastSample
		}
		if (obs.endReason !== undefined) record.endReason = obs.endReason
		if (t.acf30 !== undefined) record.acf30 = t.acf30
		if (t.acf60 !== undefined) record.acf60 = t.acf60
		if (obs.hopIndex !== undefined) record.hopIndex = obs.hopIndex
		return record
	}

	private insertDiscovery(d: Discovery): void {
		const previous = this.discoveries.get(d.id)
		if (previous !== undefined) for (const s of previous.sourceIds) this.bySource.get(s)?.delete(d.id)
		this.discoveries.set(d.id, d)
		for (const s of d.sourceIds) {
			let set = this.bySource.get(s)
			if (set === undefined) {
				set = new Set()
				this.bySource.set(s, set)
			}
			set.add(d.id)
		}
	}

	private removeDiscovery(id: string): void {
		const d = this.discoveries.get(id)
		if (d === undefined) return
		this.discoveries.delete(id)
		for (const s of d.sourceIds) this.bySource.get(s)?.delete(id)
		for (const o of this.byDiscovery.get(id) ?? []) this.observationIndex.delete(o.id)
		this.byDiscovery.delete(id)
	}

	/** Inserts an unlinked observation in canonical order and trims the per-discovery window. */
	private putObservation(o: Observation): void {
		this.observationIndex.set(o.id, o)
		let list = this.byDiscovery.get(o.discoveryId)
		if (list === undefined) {
			list = []
			this.byDiscovery.set(o.discoveryId, list)
		}
		let i = list.length
		for (;;) {
			const previous = list[i - 1]
			if (previous === undefined || compareObs(previous, o) <= 0) break
			i--
		}
		list.splice(i, 0, o)
		while (list.length > OBSERVATIONS_PER_DISCOVERY) {
			const dropped = list.shift()
			if (dropped !== undefined) this.observationIndex.delete(dropped.id)
		}
	}

	private unlinkObservation(o: Observation): void {
		const list = this.byDiscovery.get(o.discoveryId)
		if (list !== undefined) {
			const i = list.findIndex(x => x.id === o.id)
			if (i >= 0) list.splice(i, 1)
		}
		this.observationIndex.delete(o.id)
	}

	private applyMutation(m: StoreMutation): void {
		if (m.correction !== undefined) this.corrections.set(m.correction.sourceId, m.correction.hz)
		for (const d of m.discoveries) this.insertDiscovery(clone(d))
		for (const o of m.observations) {
			const previous = this.observationIndex.get(o.id)
			if (previous !== undefined) this.unlinkObservation(previous)
			this.putObservation(clone(o))
		}
		for (const id of m.removedObservations ?? []) {
			const previous = this.observationIndex.get(id)
			if (previous !== undefined) this.unlinkObservation(previous)
		}
		for (const id of m.deleted) this.removeDiscovery(id)
	}

	// ── journal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	private commit(kind: JournalEntry["op"], run: (op: Op) => string): Ingested {
		const op = newOp()
		const id = run(op)
		this.finish(kind, op)
		return { discoveryId: id, change: op.changes.get(id) ?? "updated" }
	}

	private finish(kind: JournalEntry["op"], op: Op): void {
		const discoveries = [...op.discoveries]
			.map(id => this.discoveries.get(id))
			.filter((d): d is Discovery => d !== undefined)
			.sort((a, b) => compareText(a.id, b.id))
			.map(clone)
		const observations = [...op.observations]
			.map(id => this.observationIndex.get(id))
			.filter((o): o is Observation => o !== undefined)
			.sort(compareObs)
			.map(clone)
		const removed = op.removedObservations.filter(id => !this.observationIndex.has(id))
		if (discoveries.length === 0 && observations.length === 0 && op.deleted.length === 0 && removed.length === 0 && op.correction === undefined) return
		const payload: StoreMutation = { discoveries, observations, deleted: [...op.deleted] }
		if (removed.length > 0) payload.removedObservations = removed
		if (op.correction !== undefined) payload.correction = { ...op.correction }
		const entry: Omit<JournalEntry, "seq"> = { at: iso(this.now()), op: kind, payload }
		this.emit("mutation", entry)
		for (const [id, change] of op.changes) this.emit("change", id, change)
	}
}

function parseCursor(cursor: string | null): number {
	if (cursor === null) return 0
	if (!/^\d{1,9}$/.test(cursor)) throw new WaveKitError("Invalid discovery cursor", "SCANNER_INVALID_CURSOR")
	return Number(cursor)
}

const FREQ_ERROR_MIN_DECODES = 5
const FREQ_ERROR_AGREE_HZ = 300

/**
 * Spec § 7.4: the receiver frequency error of `sourceId`, from its `decoded`, raster-snapped
 * discoveries (`r:` keys). The largest set whose `measuredOffsetHz` agree within 300 Hz (sliding window
 * over the sorted offsets; ties: the window whose median is nearest the overall median) must hold ≥ 5;
 * the estimate is that set's median offset, with ppm against its median channel frequency. Pure.
 */
export function estimateFrequencyError(discoveries: readonly Discovery[], sourceId: string): { hz: number; ppm: number; n: number } | null {
	const usable = discoveries
		.filter(d => d.confidence === "decoded" && d.sourceIds.includes(sourceId) && d.frequencyKey.startsWith("r:") && Number.isFinite(d.measuredOffsetHz))
		.sort((a, b) => a.measuredOffsetHz - b.measuredOffsetHz || compareText(a.id, b.id))
	if (usable.length < FREQ_ERROR_MIN_DECODES) return null
	const overall = median(usable.map(d => d.measuredOffsetHz))
	let best: readonly Discovery[] = []
	let bestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
	let start = 0
	for (let end = 0; end < usable.length; end++) {
		const hi = usable[end]?.measuredOffsetHz ?? 0
		while ((usable[start]?.measuredOffsetHz ?? hi) < hi - FREQ_ERROR_AGREE_HZ) start++
		const window = usable.slice(start, end + 1)
		const distance = Math.abs(median(window.map(d => d.measuredOffsetHz)) - overall)
		if (window.length > best.length || (window.length === best.length && distance < bestDistance)) {
			best = window
			bestDistance = distance
		}
	}
	if (best.length < FREQ_ERROR_MIN_DECODES) return null
	const hz = median(best.map(d => d.measuredOffsetHz))
	const centreHz = median(best.map(d => d.frequencyHz))
	return { hz, ppm: centreHz > 0 ? (hz / centreHz) * 1e6 : 0, n: best.length }
}
```

### Task 16: Scanner persistence (snapshot, seq journal, replay, jobs + lease, settings, engine state)

**Spec:** § 8 (files, write patterns, startup, journal retention), § 10.1 (jobs lifecycle), § 10.3 (persisted lease), § 12.1 (settings), § 13 P13, P14 (journal part). **Depends on:** Tasks 1, 15. **Batch:** S1-A

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/scanner/store/persistence.ts`, `src/core/spectrum/engine-state.ts` (`EngineStateSchema`, shared with the Task 32 worker protocol), `tests/mocks/scanner/job-spec.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/persistence.test.ts`

Design notes:

- Layout under `dir`: `discoveries.json` (`{version: 1, lastSeq, savedAt, discoveries, observations, corrections}`; `corrections` = the store's per-source § 7.4 corrections, `.default([])` when absent, because pruning deletes the `rekey` entries a snapshot covers), `journal/observations-YYYYMMDD.jsonl` (UTC day of `now()` at append time), `jobs.json` (`{version: 1, jobs}`), `settings.json` (`{version: 1, settings}`), `engine/<encodeURIComponent(sourceId)>.json` (`EngineState`).
- Atomic writes replicate the `BandOverrideStore.write` pattern (`src/decoders/band-override-store.ts`): mkdir -p, write `<file>.<pid>.tmp`, `fsync`, `rename`, remove the tmp on failure. A small local `atomicWrite()` helper; nothing is extracted from the band override store.
- Every disk operation runs on one promise chain in call order. `append()` assigns the `seq` and serialises the line **synchronously at call time**, so a caller that appends inside the store's synchronous `"mutation"` listener and later calls `writeSnapshot(store.snapshot())` gets a snapshot whose `lastSeq` (= last assigned seq at call time) matches its content exactly.
- `load()` must run first (`append`/`writeSnapshot` reject with `SCANNER_PERSISTENCE_NOT_LOADED`): it reads the snapshot (missing → empty, `lastSeq` 0; invalid → renamed to `discoveries.json.invalid-<ms>`, warn, empty), every journal file in name order (a final line without `\n` is torn: dropped, logged, and the file truncated to its last newline so later appends start on a clean line; any other invalid line is dropped and logged), keeps entries with `seq > lastSeq` unique by seq in ascending order, and sets the next seq to `max(lastSeq, highest seq in any file) + 1`, so seq stays monotonic across restarts even after pruning.
- A failed `append` (ENOSPC is plausible: the journal keeps writing while `disk-low`) may leave part of a line. The append truncates the file back to its last known size and rethrows `SCANNER_PERSIST_FAILED`, so the next line never glues onto a fragment (which would lose two entries at load) and `fileBytes` stays exact. The seq of the failed line is not reused (a gap is harmless; seq only has to be monotonic). `appendFile` is injectable (`opts.appendFile`) for the short-write test.
- `pruneJournal` deletes only files whose highest seq ≤ the last durable snapshot's `lastSeq` (the value of the last `writeSnapshot` that completed, or the loaded one): first expired files (day stamp older than `maxAgeDays`), then the oldest until the total size ≤ `maxBytes`. It returns `{ deleted }` in deletion order (contract addition: the C3 `Promise<void>` return is widened; callers that ignore it are unaffected).
- Every file read is Zod-validated: snapshot and journal payloads with Task 15's schemas, jobs with `NormalisedJobSpecSchema` (+ `rawSpec` validated only as an object here; Task 35 re-validates it with the REST schema of Task 36), settings with `RuntimeSettingsOverridesSchema` (Task 24 re-exports this schema as `ScannerSettingsPatchSchema`, the `PATCH /api/scanner/settings` body, so every loaded settings.json accepts later patches; keys are exactly the spec § 12.1 runtime settings, so no `cpuGuardPercent`; `RuntimeSettingsOverrides` is its `z.infer` and is defined only here), engine state with `EngineStateSchema` (`src/core/spectrum/engine-state.ts`).

```ts
}

export function makeHopPlan(centresHz: number[], halfSpanHz = 819_200): HopPlan {
	return {
		hops: centresHz.map(
			(centreHz, index): Hop => ({
				index,
				centreHz,
				covered: { startHz: centreHz - halfSpanHz, endHz: centreHz + halfSpanHz },
				channelCount: Math.round((2 * halfSpanHz) / 12_500),
				dcAdjacentChannelsHz: [],
				excluded: [],
				dcMinEdgeHz: 1_750,
			}),
		),
		usableHalfSpanHz: halfSpanHz,
		dcGuardHz: 1_500,
		ppmMarginHz: 900,
	}
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { appendFile, mkdtemp, readdir, readFile, rm, stat, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"
import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"
import fc from "fast-check"
import { DiscoveryStore } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/store/discovery-store.js"
import type { JournalEntry } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/store/discovery-store.js"
import { ScannerPersistence } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/store/persistence.js"
import type { PersistedJob } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/store/persistence.js"
import type { EngineState, Raster } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../../../src/utils/errors.js"
import { createLogger } from "../../../../src/utils/logger.js"
import { makeNormalisedSpec } from "../../../mocks/scanner/job-spec.js"
import { counterIds, dmrCc, evidence, makeObs } from "../../../mocks/scanner/observations.js"

const logger = createLogger({ level: "fatal" })
const DAY = 86_400_000
const T0 = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 9, 12, 0, 0)
const EMPTY_MUTATION = { discoveries: [], observations: [], deleted: [] }
const entry = (at: number): Omit<JournalEntry, "seq"> => ({ at: new Date(at).toISOString(), op: "observation", payload: EMPTY_MUTATION })

async function withDir<T>(fn: (dir: string) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
	const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "wavekit-scanner-"))
	try {
		return await fn(dir)
	} finally {
		await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
	}
}

async function journalFiles(dir: string): Promise<string[]> {
	try {
		return (await readdir(join(dir, "journal"))).sort()
	} catch {
		return []
	}
}

async function maxSeqOf(path: string): Promise<number> {
	const text = await readFile(path, "utf8")
	let max = 0
	for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
		if (line === "") continue
		try {
			const seq = (JSON.parse(line) as { seq?: unknown }).seq
			if (typeof seq === "number") max = Math.max(max, seq)
		} catch {
			// torn line
		}
	}
	return max
}

describe("ScannerPersistence journal", () => {
	it("assigns monotonic seq across restarts and rotates files per UTC day", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			let clock = T0
			const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => clock })
			await p.load()
			expect(await p.append(entry(clock))).toBe(1)
			expect(await p.append(entry(clock))).toBe(2)
			clock += DAY
			expect(await p.append(entry(clock))).toBe(3)
			expect(await journalFiles(dir)).toEqual(["observations-20261009.jsonl", "observations-20261010.jsonl"])

			const again = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => clock })
			const loaded = await again.load()
			expect(loaded.entries.map(e => e.seq)).toEqual([1, 2, 3])
			expect(await again.append(entry(clock))).toBe(4)
		})
	})

	it("drops a torn final line, keeps earlier lines, and appends cleanly after it", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 })
			await p.load()
			await p.append(entry(T0))
			await p.append(entry(T0))
			const [file] = await journalFiles(dir)
			await appendFile(join(dir, "journal", file ?? ""), '{"seq":3,"at":"2026-10-09T12:00:00.000Z","op":"obs')
			const reopened = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 })
			const loaded = await reopened.load()
			expect(loaded.entries.map(e => e.seq)).toEqual([1, 2])
			expect(loaded.droppedLines).toBe(1)
			expect(await reopened.append(entry(T0))).toBe(3)
			const final = await new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 }).load()
			expect(final.entries.map(e => e.seq)).toEqual([1, 2, 3])
			expect(final.droppedLines).toBe(0)
		})
	})

	it("skips invalid middle lines and lines whose payload is not a store mutation", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 })
			await p.load()
			await p.append(entry(T0))
			const [file] = await journalFiles(dir)
			const path = join(dir, "journal", file ?? "")
			await appendFile(path, "not json\n")
			await appendFile(path, `${JSON.stringify({ seq: 2, at: "x", op: "observation", payload: { bogus: 1 } })}\n`)
			await appendFile(path, `${JSON.stringify({ seq: 3, ...entry(T0) })}\n`)
			const loaded = await new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 }).load()
			expect(loaded.entries.map(e => e.seq)).toEqual([1, 3])
			expect(loaded.droppedLines).toBe(2)
		})
	})

	it("replays only entries newer than the snapshot", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 })
			await p.load()
			for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await p.append(entry(T0))
			await p.writeSnapshot({ discoveries: [], observations: [], corrections: [{ sourceId: "src-1", hz: -1_200 }] })
			await p.append(entry(T0))
			const loaded = await new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 }).load()
			expect(loaded.lastSeq).toBe(3)
			expect(loaded.entries.map(e => e.seq)).toEqual([4])
			expect(loaded.corrections).toEqual([{ sourceId: "src-1", hz: -1_200 }])
		})
	})

	it("reads a snapshot written without corrections as no corrections", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			await writeFile(join(dir, "discoveries.json"), JSON.stringify({ version: 1, lastSeq: 0, savedAt: new Date(T0).toISOString(), discoveries: [], observations: [] }))
			const loaded = await new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 }).load()
			expect(loaded.corrections).toEqual([])
			expect(await readdir(dir)).toEqual(["discoveries.json"])
		})
	})

	it("truncates a failed partial append so the next line starts clean and nothing else is lost", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			let failNext = false
			const shortWrite = async (path: string, data: string): Promise<void> => {
				if (!failNext) return appendFile(path, data)
				failNext = false
				await appendFile(path, data.slice(0, Math.floor(data.length / 2)))
				throw Object.assign(new Error("ENOSPC: no space left on device"), { code: "ENOSPC" })
			}
			const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0, appendFile: shortWrite })
			await p.load()
			expect(await p.append(entry(T0))).toBe(1)
			failNext = true
			await expect(p.append(entry(T0))).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(WaveKitError)
			expect(await p.append(entry(T0))).toBe(3)
			const [file] = await journalFiles(dir)
			const text = await readFile(join(dir, "journal", file ?? ""), "utf8")
			expect(text.split("\n").filter(l => l !== "")).toHaveLength(2)
			const loaded = await new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 }).load()
			expect(loaded.entries.map(e => e.seq)).toEqual([1, 3])
			expect(loaded.droppedLines).toBe(0)
		})
	})

	it("rejects appends and snapshots before load()", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 })
			await expect(p.append(entry(T0))).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(WaveKitError)
			await expect(p.writeSnapshot({ discoveries: [], observations: [], corrections: [] })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(WaveKitError)
		})
	})

	it("never prunes a file holding a seq beyond the durable snapshot", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			let clock = T0
			const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => clock })
			await p.load()
			await p.append(entry(clock))
			await p.append(entry(clock))
			await p.writeSnapshot({ discoveries: [], observations: [], corrections: [] })
			clock += DAY
			await p.append(entry(clock))
			expect(await p.pruneJournal({ maxBytes: 0, maxAgeDays: 30 })).toEqual({ deleted: ["observations-20261009.jsonl"] })
			expect(await journalFiles(dir)).toEqual(["observations-20261010.jsonl"])
		})
	})
})

describe("ScannerPersistence lifecycle files", () => {
	const job: PersistedJob = {
		id: "j_1",
		spec: makeNormalisedSpec(),
		rawSpec: { name: "UHF sweep", mode: "sweep", ranges: [{ startHz: 400_000_000, endHz: 470_000_000 }] },
		state: "paused",
		reason: "preempted-operator",
		createdAt: new Date(T0).toISOString(),
		updatedAt: new Date(T0 + 1_000).toISOString(),
		lease: {
			sourceId: "src-1",
			jobId: "j_1",
			acquiredAt: T0,
			snapshot: { frequency: 446_100_000, gainMode: "manual", gain: 496 },
			changedFields: ["frequency"],
		},
	}
	const engine: EngineState = {
		version: 1,
		absoluteFloors: [{ key: "2048000:m:496:2048", dbfs: -92.5 }],
		spurs: [{ key: "2048000:m:496:2048", basebandBin: 1100, widthBins: 2, kind: "baseband" }],
		kByRange: [{ startHz: 446_000_000, endHz: 446_200_000, k: 9.5 }],
		provisionalSpurs: [{ key: "2048000:m:496:2048", basebandBin: 1590, widthBins: 2, comb: true }],
	}

	it("round-trips jobs with the lease, settings and per-source engine state", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 })
			await p.writeJobs([job])
			await p.writeSettings({ cpuBudgetCores: 0.5, passive: { "src-1": false }, ws: { spectrumHz: 1 } })
			await p.writeEngine("rtl/one", engine)
			const loaded = await new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 }).load()
			expect(loaded.jobs).toEqual([job])
			expect(loaded.settings).toEqual({ cpuBudgetCores: 0.5, passive: { "src-1": false }, ws: { spectrumHz: 1 } })
			expect(loaded.engines).toEqual({ "rtl/one": engine })
		})
	})

	it("starts from defaults when files are corrupt or out of bounds, and never throws", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			await writeFile(join(dir, "jobs.json"), "{bad json")
			await writeFile(join(dir, "settings.json"), JSON.stringify({ version: 1, settings: { cpuBudgetCores: -1 } }))
			await writeFile(join(dir, "discoveries.json"), JSON.stringify({ version: 1, lastSeq: "x" }))
			const loaded = await new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 }).load()
			expect(loaded.jobs).toEqual([])
			expect(loaded.settings).toEqual({})
			expect(loaded.discoveries).toEqual([])
			expect(loaded.lastSeq).toBe(0)
			const names = await readdir(dir)
			expect(names.some(n => n.startsWith("discoveries.json.invalid-"))).toBe(true)
		})
	})
})

type POp =
	| { k: "ingest"; slot: number; blocks: number; jitter: number }
	| { k: "evidence"; pick: number; cc: number }
	| { k: "obsEvidence"; pick: number; cc: number }
	| { k: "operator"; pick: number; label: string }
	| { k: "delete"; pick: number }
	| { k: "rekey"; corr: number }
	| { k: "snapshot" }
	| { k: "day" }
	| { k: "prune"; maxBytes: number }

const pOpArb: fc.Arbitrary<POp> = fc.oneof(
	{ weight: 6, arbitrary: fc.record({ k: fc.constant("ingest" as const), slot: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 5 }), blocks: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 3 }), jitter: fc.integer({ min: -4_000, max: 4_000 }) }) },
	{ weight: 2, arbitrary: fc.record({ k: fc.constant("evidence" as const), pick: fc.nat(), cc: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 3 }) }) },
	{ weight: 2, arbitrary: fc.record({ k: fc.constant("obsEvidence" as const), pick: fc.nat(), cc: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 3 }) }) },
	{ weight: 1, arbitrary: fc.record({ k: fc.constant("operator" as const), pick: fc.nat(), label: fc.string({ maxLength: 8 }) }) },
	{ weight: 1, arbitrary: fc.record({ k: fc.constant("delete" as const), pick: fc.nat() }) },
	{ weight: 1, arbitrary: fc.record({ k: fc.constant("rekey" as const), corr: fc.integer({ min: -4_000, max: 4_000 }) }) },
	{ weight: 2, arbitrary: fc.record({ k: fc.constant("snapshot" as const) }) },
	{ weight: 1, arbitrary: fc.record({ k: fc.constant("day" as const) }) },
	{ weight: 1, arbitrary: fc.record({ k: fc.constant("prune" as const), maxBytes: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 20_000 }) }) },
)
const RASTER: Raster[] = [{ spacingHz: 12_500, firstChannelHz: 446_000_000 }]

describe("ScannerPersistence properties", () => {
	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 13: Persistence round trip
	// Validates: spec § 8, § 7.4 (corrections survive pruning)
	it("snapshot + journal replay reproduces the store for any interleaving of snapshots, rotations, re-keys and retention", async () => {
		await fc.assert(
			fc.asyncProperty(fc.array(pOpArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 25 }), fc.boolean(), async (ops, torn) => {
				await withDir(async dir => {
					let clock = T0
					const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => clock })
					await p.load()
					const store = new DiscoveryStore({ maxDiscoveries: 50, now: () => clock, newId: counterIds(), rasters: () => RASTER })
					const writes: Promise<unknown>[] = []
					store.on("mutation", (e: Omit<JournalEntry, "seq">) => writes.push(p.append(e)))
					const pick = (n: number): string | undefined => {
						const ids = store.snapshot().discoveries.map(d => d.id)
						return ids[n % Math.max(1, ids.length)]
					}
					const pickObservation = (n: number): string | undefined => {
						const ids = store.snapshot().observations.map(o => o.id)
						return ids[n % Math.max(1, ids.length)]
					}
					ops.forEach((op, i) => {
						switch (op.k) {
							case "ingest":
								store.ingest(makeObs({ id: `o${i}`, centreHz: 446_000_000 + op.slot * 25_000 + op.jitter, startedAt: clock + i, blocks: op.blocks, cls: "fsk4-12k5", hypotheses: [["dmr", 0.8]] }))
								break
							case "evidence": {
								const id = pick(op.pick)
								if (id !== undefined) store.applyEvidence(id, evidence("dmr", clock + i, { identity: dmrCc(op.cc), talkgroups: [String(i)] }))
								break
							}
							case "obsEvidence": {
								const id = pickObservation(op.pick)
								if (id !== undefined) store.appendObservationEvidence(id, evidence("dmr", clock + i, { identity: dmrCc(op.cc) }))
								break
							}
							case "operator": {
								const id = pick(op.pick)
								if (id !== undefined) store.setOperator(id, { label: op.label })
								break
							}
							case "delete": {
								const id = pick(op.pick)
								if (id !== undefined) store.delete(id)
								break
							}
							case "rekey":
								store.rekey("src-1", op.corr)
								break
							case "snapshot":
								writes.push(p.writeSnapshot(store.snapshot()))
								break
							case "day":
								clock += DAY
								break
							case "prune":
								writes.push(p.pruneJournal({ maxBytes: op.maxBytes, maxAgeDays: 1 }))
								break
						}
					})
					await Promise.all(writes)
					const files = await journalFiles(dir)
					const newest = files.at(-1)
					if (torn && newest !== undefined)
						await appendFile(join(dir, "journal", newest), '{"seq":999999,"at":"2026-10-09T00:00:00.000Z","op":"observ')
					const loaded = await new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => clock }).load()
					// a restarted process never reuses ids (ULIDs in production)
					const replica = new DiscoveryStore({ maxDiscoveries: 50, now: () => clock, newId: () => `R${clock}`, rasters: () => RASTER })
					replica.restore(loaded)
					for (const e of loaded.entries) replica.replay(e)
					expect(replica.snapshot()).toEqual(store.snapshot())
					expect(replica.correction("src-1")).toBe(store.correction("src-1"))
					for (const e of loaded.entries) replica.replay(e)
					expect(replica.snapshot()).toEqual(store.snapshot())
					// the restored store keeps snapping like the original (a lost correction splits emitters)
					const late = makeObs({ id: "late", centreHz: 446_003_300, startedAt: clock + 1_000, cls: "fsk4-12k5", hypotheses: [["dmr", 0.8]] })
					const original = store.ingest(late)
					const restored = replica.ingest(late)
					expect(restored.change).toBe(original.change)
					expect(replica.get(restored.discoveryId ?? "")?.frequencyKey).toBe(store.get(original.discoveryId ?? "")?.frequencyKey)
				})
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	}, 120_000) // 100 runs of real file I/O: ≈ 6 s here, above vitest's 5 s default

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 14: Retention
	// Validates: spec § 8
	it("journal retention never deletes a file with seq > lastSeq, meets the cap otherwise, expired before oldest", async () => {
		const batchArb = fc.record({ day: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 5 }), lines: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4 }) })
		await fc.assert(
			fc.asyncProperty(
				fc.array(batchArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 6 }),
				fc.nat(),
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3_000 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4 }),
				async (rawBatches, snapAt, maxBytes, maxAgeDays) => {
					await withDir(async dir => {
						const batches = [...rawBatches].sort((a, b) => a.day - b.day)
						let clock = T0
						const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => clock })
						await p.load()
						let lastSeq = 0
						let highest = 0
						for (const [i, batch] of batches.entries()) {
							clock = T0 + batch.day * DAY
							for (let n = 0; n < batch.lines; n++) highest = await p.append(entry(clock))
							if (i === snapAt % batches.length) {
								await p.writeSnapshot({ discoveries: [], observations: [], corrections: [] })
								lastSeq = highest
							}
						}
						clock = T0 + 6 * DAY
						const before = new Map<string, { maxSeq: number; bytes: number }>()
						for (const name of await journalFiles(dir)) {
							const path = join(dir, "journal", name)
							before.set(name, { maxSeq: await maxSeqOf(path), bytes: (await stat(path)).size })
						}
						const { deleted } = await p.pruneJournal({ maxBytes, maxAgeDays })
						const cutoff = new Date(clock - maxAgeDays * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10).replaceAll("-", "")
						const expired = (name: string) => (name.slice(13, 21) < cutoff)
						for (const name of deleted) expect(before.get(name)?.maxSeq ?? Infinity).toBeLessThanOrEqual(lastSeq)
						const remaining = await journalFiles(dir)
						const total = remaining.reduce((s, n) => s + (before.get(n)?.bytes ?? 0), 0)
						if (total > maxBytes) for (const n of remaining) expect(before.get(n)?.maxSeq ?? 0).toBeGreaterThan(lastSeq)
						for (const n of remaining) if (expired(n)) expect(before.get(n)?.maxSeq ?? 0).toBeGreaterThan(lastSeq)
						const firstFresh = deleted.findIndex(n => !expired(n))
						if (firstFresh >= 0) expect(deleted.slice(firstFresh).every(n => !expired(n))).toBe(true)
						expect(deleted.filter(expired)).toEqual([...deleted.filter(expired)].sort())
						expect(deleted.filter(n => !expired(n))).toEqual([...deleted.filter(n => !expired(n))].sort())
					})
				},
			),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	}, 120_000)
})
```

```ts
// src/core/spectrum/engine-state.ts
/** Zod schema of the persisted per-source engine state (spec § 8 `engine/<sourceId>.json`). */
import { z } from "zod"
import type { Assert, EngineState, SchemaMatches } from "./types.js"

export const EngineStateSchema = z.object({
	version: z.literal(1),
	absoluteFloors: z.array(z.object({ key: z.string(), dbfs: z.number() })),
	spurs: z.array(
		z.object({
			key: z.string(),
			basebandBin: z.number().int(),
			widthBins: z.number().int().positive(),
			kind: z.enum(["baseband", "rf"]),
			rfHz: z.number().optional(),
		}),
	),
	kByRange: z.array(z.object({ startHz: z.number(), endHz: z.number(), k: z.number() })),
	provisionalSpurs: z
		.array(
			z.object({ key: z.string(), basebandBin: z.number().int().nonnegative(), widthBins: z.number().int().positive(), comb: z.boolean() }),
		)
		.optional(), // Task 7a; absent in files written before it
})
export type EngineStateCheck = Assert<SchemaMatches<EngineState, typeof EngineStateSchema>>
```
