```ts
// src/core/scanner/store/persistence.ts
/**
 * Scanner persistence (spec § 8) under `scanner.storage.dir`:
 *
 * - `discoveries.json`: snapshot of discoveries + observations with `lastSeq` (atomic write);
 * - `journal/observations-YYYYMMDD.jsonl`: one line per store mutation, monotonic `seq`, UTC daily files;
 * - `jobs.json`: job specs, lifecycle state and the persisted lease (lifecycle changes only);
 * - `settings.json`: runtime settings overrides; `engine/<sourceId>.json`: learned engine state.
 *
 * Atomic writes follow the BandOverrideStore pattern (tmp + fsync + rename). All disk work runs on
 * one promise chain in call order; `append` assigns its seq synchronously. Every file read is
 * validated with Zod; a corrupt file never stops the core.
 */
import { appendFile, mkdir, open, readdir, readFile, rename, rm, truncate } from "node:fs/promises"
import { dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path"
import { z } from "zod"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../../utils/errors.js"
import { createComponentLogger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import type { Logger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import type {
	Discovery,
	FailReason,
	JobState,
	NormalisedJobSpec,
	Observation,
	PauseReason,
	ScanJobSpec,
} from "../types.js"
import type { Assert, EngineState, SchemaMatches } from "../../spectrum/types.js"
import { EngineStateSchema } from "../../spectrum/engine-state.js"
import type { JournalEntry, StoreSnapshot } from "./discovery-store.js"
import {
	DiscoverySchema,
	ObservationSchema,
	ScannerClassSchema,
	ScannerProtocolSchema,
	StoreMutationSchema,
} from "./schemas.js"

const FILE_VERSION = 1
const SNAPSHOT_FILE = "discoveries.json"
const JOBS_FILE = "jobs.json"
const SETTINGS_FILE = "settings.json"
const JOURNAL_DIR = "journal"
const ENGINE_DIR = "engine"
const JOURNAL_NAME = /^observations-(\d{8})\.jsonl$/
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000

export interface LeaseTunerFields {
	frequency: number
	sampleRate: number
	gainMode: "agc" | "manual"
	gain: number
	agcMode: boolean
}
export interface PersistedLease {
	sourceId: string
	jobId: string
	acquiredAt: number
	snapshot: Partial<LeaseTunerFields>
	changedFields: (keyof LeaseTunerFields)[]
}
export interface PersistedJob {
	id: string
	spec: NormalisedJobSpec
	rawSpec: ScanJobSpec
	state: JobState
	reason?: PauseReason | FailReason
	createdAt: string
	updatedAt: string
	lease?: PersistedLease
}
/**
 * Persisted runtime settings overrides (settings.json). Task 24 re-exports this schema as
 * ScannerSettingsPatchSchema (PATCH /api/scanner/settings body), so every loaded settings.json accepts
 * later patches.
 */
export type RuntimeSettingsOverrides = z.infer<typeof RuntimeSettingsOverridesSchema>
export interface LoadedState {
	discoveries: Discovery[]
	observations: Observation[]
	/** Per-source § 7.4 corrections from the snapshot (`rekey` entries after it replay on top). */
	corrections: { sourceId: string; hz: number }[]
	lastSeq: number
	entries: JournalEntry[]
	jobs: PersistedJob[]
	settings: RuntimeSettingsOverrides
	engines: Record<string, EngineState>
	droppedLines: number
}

// ── schemas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const RasterSchema = z.object({ spacingHz: z.number().positive(), firstChannelHz: z.number() })
const ScanRangeSchema = z.object({
	startHz: z.number(),
	endHz: z.number(),
	rasters: z.array(RasterSchema).optional(),
	obwHz: z.array(z.number().positive()).optional(),
	protocols: z.array(ScannerProtocolSchema).optional(),
	bandplanId: z.string().optional(),
})
const ScanExclusionSchema = z.object({ startHz: z.number(), endHz: z.number(), reason: z.string().optional() })

export const NormalisedJobSpecSchema = z.object({
	sourceId: z.string().min(1),
	sensitivity: z.enum(["low", "normal", "high"]),
	priority: z.number().min(0).max(100),
	mode: z.enum(["in-window", "sweep"]),
	// "identify" mirrors Task 1's NormalisedJobSpec (the SchemaMatches guard below needs it); identify jobs are
	// filtered out of persistJobs (Task 35a) and never written, so a persisted file never holds one
	kind: z.enum(["discover", "monitor", "identify"]),
	ranges: z.array(ScanRangeSchema),
	exclusions: z.array(ScanExclusionSchema),
	protocols: z.array(ScannerProtocolSchema),
	fftSize: z.number().int().positive(),
	integrationMs: z.number().positive(),
	thresholdDb: z.number().nullable(),
	dwellMs: z.number().nonnegative(),
	settleMs: z.number().nonnegative(),
	hold: z.object({
		policy: z.enum(["hold", "confirm", "never"]),
		confirmHoldMs: z.record(ScannerClassSchema, z.number().nonnegative()),
		maxHoldMs: z.number().nonnegative(),
		hangMs: z.number().nonnegative(),
	}),
	revisit: z.object({ share: z.number().min(0).max(1), maxIntervalMs: z.number().positive().nullable() }),
	record: z.object({ voice: z.boolean(), analog: z.boolean(), data: z.boolean() }),
	evidence: z.object({ psd: z.boolean(), iq: z.boolean() }),
	tuner: z.object({
		sampleRateHz: z.number().positive().nullable(),
		gainTenthsDb: z.number().nullable(),
		agc: z.boolean().nullable(),
		overload: z.enum(["flag", "reduce-gain"]),
	}),
	stop: z.object({
		afterSweeps: z.number().int().positive().nullable(),
		afterMs: z.number().positive().nullable(),
		onFirstDecoded: z.boolean(),
	}),
	takeover: z.boolean(),
	resume: z.object({ autoAfterIdleMs: z.number().nonnegative().nullable(), onBoot: z.boolean() }),
	txDurationHintMs: z.number().nonnegative(),
	provenance: z.record(z.enum(["operator", "bandplan", "measured", "default"])),
})
export type NormalisedJobSpecCheck = Assert<SchemaMatches<NormalisedJobSpec, typeof NormalisedJobSpecSchema>>

const LEASE_FIELDS = ["frequency", "sampleRate", "gainMode", "gain", "agcMode"] as const
const PersistedLeaseSchema = z.object({
	sourceId: z.string().min(1),
	jobId: z.string().min(1),
	acquiredAt: z.number(),
	snapshot: z.object({
		frequency: z.number().optional(),
		sampleRate: z.number().optional(),
		gainMode: z.enum(["agc", "manual"]).optional(),
		gain: z.number().optional(),
		agcMode: z.boolean().optional(),
	}),
	changedFields: z.array(z.enum(LEASE_FIELDS)),
})
export type PersistedLeaseCheck = Assert<SchemaMatches<PersistedLease, typeof PersistedLeaseSchema>>

const PersistedJobSchema = z.object({
	id: z.string().min(1),
	spec: NormalisedJobSpecSchema,
	/** Checked as a plain object only; the job runner re-validates it with the REST schema (Task 36). */
	rawSpec: z.custom<ScanJobSpec>(v => typeof v === "object" && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)),
	state: z.enum(["pending", "starting", "running", "holding", "paused", "completed", "cancelled", "failed"]),
	reason: z
		.enum([
			"operator", "preempted-operator", "preempted-relay", "preempted-job", "source-down", "core-restart",
			"resume-blocked", "source-removed", "tuner-unavailable", "invalid",
		])
		.optional(),
	createdAt: z.string(),
	updatedAt: z.string(),
	lease: PersistedLeaseSchema.optional(),
})
export type PersistedJobCheck = Assert<SchemaMatches<PersistedJob, typeof PersistedJobSchema>>

/**
 * Task 24 re-exports this schema as ScannerSettingsPatchSchema (PATCH /api/scanner/settings body), so
 * every loaded settings.json accepts later patches. Keys are the spec § 12.1 runtime-safe settings.
 */
export const RuntimeSettingsOverridesSchema = z
	.object({
		passive: z.record(z.string().min(1), z.boolean()).optional(),
		cpuBudgetCores: z.number().min(0.1).max(64).optional(),
		maxProbes: z
			.object({ offset: z.number().int().min(0).max(16).optional(), channel: z.number().int().min(0).max(64).optional() })
			.strict()
			.optional(),
		detection: z
			.object({
				integrationMs: z.number().min(5).max(1000).optional(),
				sensitivity: z.enum(["low", "normal", "high"]).optional(),
				faTargetPerMhzMin: z.number().min(0.01).max(1000).optional(),
				hysteresisDb: z.number().min(0).max(20).optional(),
				minSurfaceBlocks: z.number().int().min(1).max(20).optional(),
			})
			.strict()
			.optional(),
		storage: z
			.object({
				maxRecordingsMb: z.number().int().min(1).max(1_000_000).optional(),
				maxEvidenceMb: z.number().int().min(1).max(100_000).optional(),
				maxJournalMb: z.number().int().min(1).max(10_000).optional(),
				maxAgeDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(3650).optional(),
				discoveryMaxAgeDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(3650).optional(),
				minFreeDiskMb: z.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).optional(),
				maxDiscoveries: z.number().int().min(1).max(1_000_000).optional(),
				maxCapturesMb: z.number().int().min(1).max(100_000).optional(),
			})
			.strict()
			.optional(),
		ws: z
			.object({
				maxMessagesPerSecond: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).optional(),
				spectrumHz: z.number().min(0.5).max(25).optional(),
				spectrumBins: z.number().int().min(128).max(2048).optional(),
			})
			.strict()
			.optional(),
	})
	.strict()

const SnapshotFileSchema = z.object({
	version: z.literal(FILE_VERSION),
	lastSeq: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	savedAt: z.string(),
	discoveries: z.array(DiscoverySchema),
	observations: z.array(ObservationSchema),
	corrections: z.array(z.object({ sourceId: z.string().min(1), hz: z.number() })).default([]),
})
const JobsFileSchema = z.object({ version: z.literal(FILE_VERSION), jobs: z.array(PersistedJobSchema) })
const SettingsFileSchema = z.object({ version: z.literal(FILE_VERSION), settings: RuntimeSettingsOverridesSchema })
const JournalLineSchema = z.object({
	seq: z.number().int().positive(),
	at: z.string(),
	op: z.enum(["observation", "evidence", "classification", "operator", "delete", "rekey", "evict"]),
	payload: StoreMutationSchema,
})

// ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function errorCode(err: unknown): string | undefined {
	if (err !== null && typeof err === "object" && "code" in err) {
		const code = (err as { code: unknown }).code
		return typeof code === "string" ? code : undefined
	}
	return undefined
}

function dayStamp(ms: number): string {
	return new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0, 10).replaceAll("-", "")
}

function journalName(ms: number): string {
	return `observations-${dayStamp(ms)}.jsonl`
}

/** Tmp file + fsync + rename, as in BandOverrideStore.write. Also used by the EvidenceStore (Task 17). */
export async function atomicWrite(file: string, data: string | Uint8Array): Promise<void> {
	const tmp = `${file}.${process.pid}.tmp`
	try {
		await mkdir(dirname(file), { recursive: true })
		const handle = await open(tmp, "w")
		try {
			await handle.writeFile(data)
			await handle.sync()
		} finally {
			await handle.close()
		}
		await rename(tmp, file)
	} catch (err) {
		await rm(tmp, { force: true }).catch(() => undefined)
		throw new WaveKitError(`Could not write ${file}`, "SCANNER_PERSIST_FAILED", err instanceof Error ? err : undefined)
	}
}

type JsonRead = { kind: "missing" } | { kind: "invalid"; reason: unknown } | { kind: "ok"; value: unknown }

async function readJson(file: string): Promise<JsonRead> {
	let text: string
	try {
		text = await readFile(file, "utf8")
	} catch (err) {
		if (errorCode(err) === "ENOENT") return { kind: "missing" }
		return { kind: "invalid", reason: err }
	}
	try {
		return { kind: "ok", value: JSON.parse(text) as unknown }
	} catch (err) {
		return { kind: "invalid", reason: err }
	}
}

function parseJournalLine(line: string): JournalEntry | null {
	let raw: unknown
	try {
		raw = JSON.parse(line)
	} catch {
		return null
	}
	const parsed = JournalLineSchema.safeParse(raw)
	return parsed.success ? parsed.data : null
}

export class ScannerPersistence {
	private readonly root: string
	private readonly log: Logger
	private readonly now: () => number
	private readonly appendFile: (path: string, data: string) => Promise<void>
	private readonly fileMaxSeq = new Map<string, number>()
	private readonly fileBytes = new Map<string, number>()
	private chain: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve()
	private nextSeq = 1
	private durableLastSeq = 0
	private loaded = false

	/** `appendFile` is injectable for the short-write test; default `fs/promises.appendFile`. */
	constructor(opts: { dir: string; logger: Logger; now: () => number; appendFile?: (path: string, data: string) => Promise<void> }) {
		this.root = resolve(opts.dir)
		this.log = createComponentLogger(opts.logger, "ScannerPersistence")
		this.now = opts.now
		this.appendFile = opts.appendFile ?? ((path, data) => appendFile(path, data))
	}

	async load(): Promise<LoadedState> {
		this.fileMaxSeq.clear()
		this.fileBytes.clear()
		const snapshot = await this.readSnapshot()
		const journal = await this.readJournal(snapshot.lastSeq)
		const jobs = await this.readJobs()
		const settings = await this.readSettings()
		const engines = await this.readEngines()
		this.durableLastSeq = snapshot.lastSeq
		this.nextSeq = Math.max(snapshot.lastSeq, journal.maxSeq) + 1
		this.loaded = true
		this.log.info(
			{ dir: this.root, discoveries: snapshot.discoveries.length, lastSeq: snapshot.lastSeq, replay: journal.entries.length, dropped: journal.dropped },
			"Loaded scanner state",
		)
		return {
			discoveries: snapshot.discoveries,
			observations: snapshot.observations,
			corrections: snapshot.corrections,
			lastSeq: snapshot.lastSeq,
			entries: journal.entries,
			jobs,
			settings,
			engines,
			droppedLines: journal.dropped,
		}
	}

	append(entry: Omit<JournalEntry, "seq">): Promise<number> {
		if (!this.loaded) return Promise.reject(notLoaded())
		const seq = this.nextSeq++
		const line = `${JSON.stringify({ seq, at: entry.at, op: entry.op, payload: entry.payload })}\n`
		const name = journalName(this.now())
		return this.enqueue(async () => {
			const dir = join(this.root, JOURNAL_DIR)
			const path = join(dir, name)
			const knownBytes = this.fileBytes.get(name) ?? 0 // load() sized every existing file; a new file is 0
			try {
				await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true })
				await this.appendFile(path, line)
			} catch (err) {
				// A partial line would glue onto the next one and lose both at load: cut back to the known size.
				await truncate(path, knownBytes).catch(() => undefined)
				this.log.warn({ err, file: path, seq }, "Journal append failed; truncated the partial line")
				throw new WaveKitError(`Could not append to ${path}`, "SCANNER_PERSIST_FAILED", err instanceof Error ? err : undefined)
			}
			this.fileMaxSeq.set(name, Math.max(this.fileMaxSeq.get(name) ?? 0, seq))
			this.fileBytes.set(name, knownBytes + Buffer.byteLength(line))
			return seq
		})
	}

	writeSnapshot(s: StoreSnapshot): Promise<void> {
		if (!this.loaded) return Promise.reject(notLoaded())
		const lastSeq = this.nextSeq - 1
		const text = JSON.stringify({
			version: FILE_VERSION,
			lastSeq,
			savedAt: new Date(this.now()).toISOString(),
			discoveries: s.discoveries,
			observations: s.observations,
			corrections: s.corrections,
		})
		return this.enqueue(async () => {
			await atomicWrite(join(this.root, SNAPSHOT_FILE), text)
			this.durableLastSeq = Math.max(this.durableLastSeq, lastSeq)
		})
	}

	writeJobs(jobs: PersistedJob[]): Promise<void> {
		const text = JSON.stringify({ version: FILE_VERSION, jobs }, null, "\t")
		return this.enqueue(() => atomicWrite(join(this.root, JOBS_FILE), text))
	}

	writeSettings(s: RuntimeSettingsOverrides): Promise<void> {
		const text = JSON.stringify({ version: FILE_VERSION, settings: s }, null, "\t")
		return this.enqueue(() => atomicWrite(join(this.root, SETTINGS_FILE), text))
	}

	writeEngine(sourceId: string, s: EngineState): Promise<void> {
		const text = JSON.stringify(s)
		return this.enqueue(() => atomicWrite(join(this.root, ENGINE_DIR, `${encodeURIComponent(sourceId)}.json`), text))
	}

	pruneJournal(caps: { maxBytes: number; maxAgeDays: number }): Promise<{ deleted: string[] }> {
		return this.enqueue(async () => {
			const dir = join(this.root, JOURNAL_DIR)
			const deleted: string[] = []
			const deletable = (name: string): boolean => (this.fileMaxSeq.get(name) ?? 0) <= this.durableLastSeq
			const remove = async (name: string): Promise<void> => {
				await rm(join(dir, name), { force: true })
				this.fileMaxSeq.delete(name)
				this.fileBytes.delete(name)
				deleted.push(name)
			}
			const cutoff = dayStamp(this.now() - caps.maxAgeDays * DAY_MS)
			for (const name of [...this.fileMaxSeq.keys()].sort()) {
				const day = JOURNAL_NAME.exec(name)?.[1]
				if (day !== undefined && day < cutoff && deletable(name)) await remove(name)
			}
			let total = 0
			for (const bytes of this.fileBytes.values()) total += bytes
			for (const name of [...this.fileMaxSeq.keys()].sort()) {
				if (total <= caps.maxBytes) break
				if (!deletable(name)) continue
				total -= this.fileBytes.get(name) ?? 0
				await remove(name)
			}
			if (deleted.length > 0) this.log.info({ deleted, durableLastSeq: this.durableLastSeq }, "Pruned scanner journal")
			return { deleted }
		})
	}

	private enqueue<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
		const next = this.chain.then(fn)
		this.chain = next.catch(() => undefined)
		return next
	}

	private async readSnapshot(): Promise<StoreSnapshot & { lastSeq: number }> {
		const file = join(this.root, SNAPSHOT_FILE)
		const empty = { discoveries: [], observations: [], corrections: [], lastSeq: 0 }
		const read = await readJson(file)
		if (read.kind === "missing") return empty
		const parsed = read.kind === "ok" ? SnapshotFileSchema.safeParse(read.value) : null
		if (parsed === null || !parsed.success) {
			const aside = `${file}.invalid-${this.now()}`
			await rename(file, aside).catch(() => undefined)
			this.log.warn(
				{ file, movedTo: aside, issues: parsed?.success === false ? parsed.error.issues : undefined, err: read.kind === "invalid" ? read.reason : undefined },
				"Scanner snapshot is invalid; starting from the journal alone",
			)
			return empty
		}
		return {
			discoveries: parsed.data.discoveries as Discovery[],
			observations: parsed.data.observations as Observation[],
			corrections: parsed.data.corrections,
			lastSeq: parsed.data.lastSeq,
		}
	}

	private async readJournal(lastSeq: number): Promise<{ entries: JournalEntry[]; maxSeq: number; dropped: number }> {
		const dir = join(this.root, JOURNAL_DIR)
		let names: string[]
		try {
			names = (await readdir(dir)).filter(n => JOURNAL_NAME.test(n)).sort()
		} catch (err) {
			if (errorCode(err) !== "ENOENT") this.log.warn({ err, dir }, "Scanner journal directory unreadable")
			return { entries: [], maxSeq: 0, dropped: 0 }
		}
		const bySeq = new Map<number, JournalEntry>()
		let maxSeq = 0
		let dropped = 0
		for (const name of names) {
			const path = join(dir, name)
			let text = await readFile(path, "utf8")
			if (text.length > 0 && !text.endsWith("\n")) {
				const keep = text.slice(0, text.lastIndexOf("\n") + 1)
				dropped++
				this.log.warn({ file: path, tornBytes: Buffer.byteLength(text) - Buffer.byteLength(keep) }, "Dropping a torn final journal line")
				await truncate(path, Buffer.byteLength(keep))
				text = keep
			}
			let fileMax = 0
			for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
				if (line === "") continue
				const parsed = parseJournalLine(line)
				if (parsed === null) {
					dropped++
					this.log.warn({ file: path }, "Skipping an invalid journal line")
					continue
				}
				fileMax = Math.max(fileMax, parsed.seq)
				if (parsed.seq > lastSeq && !bySeq.has(parsed.seq)) bySeq.set(parsed.seq, parsed)
			}
			this.fileMaxSeq.set(name, fileMax)
			this.fileBytes.set(name, Buffer.byteLength(text))
			maxSeq = Math.max(maxSeq, fileMax)
		}
		return { entries: [...bySeq.values()].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq), maxSeq, dropped }
	}

	private async readJobs(): Promise<PersistedJob[]> {
		const file = join(this.root, JOBS_FILE)
		const read = await readJson(file)
		if (read.kind === "missing") return []
		const parsed = read.kind === "ok" ? JobsFileSchema.safeParse(read.value) : null
		if (parsed === null || !parsed.success) {
			this.log.warn({ file, issues: parsed?.success === false ? parsed.error.issues : undefined }, "Scanner jobs file is invalid; starting with no jobs")
			return []
		}
		return parsed.data.jobs as PersistedJob[]
	}

	private async readSettings(): Promise<RuntimeSettingsOverrides> {
		const file = join(this.root, SETTINGS_FILE)
		const read = await readJson(file)
		if (read.kind === "missing") return {}
		const parsed = read.kind === "ok" ? SettingsFileSchema.safeParse(read.value) : null
		if (parsed === null || !parsed.success) {
			this.log.warn({ file, issues: parsed?.success === false ? parsed.error.issues : undefined }, "Scanner settings file is invalid; using config values")
			return {}
		}
		return parsed.data.settings as RuntimeSettingsOverrides
	}

	private async readEngines(): Promise<Record<string, EngineState>> {
		const dir = join(this.root, ENGINE_DIR)
		const out: Record<string, EngineState> = {}
		let names: string[]
		try {
			names = (await readdir(dir)).filter(n => n.endsWith(".json"))
		} catch (err) {
			if (errorCode(err) !== "ENOENT") this.log.warn({ err, dir }, "Scanner engine directory unreadable")
			return out
		}
		for (const name of names) {
			const read = await readJson(join(dir, name))
			const parsed = read.kind === "ok" ? EngineStateSchema.safeParse(read.value) : null
			if (parsed === null || !parsed.success) {
				this.log.warn({ file: join(dir, name) }, "Ignoring an invalid engine state file")
				continue
			}
			let sourceId: string
			try {
				sourceId = decodeURIComponent(name.slice(0, -".json".length))
			} catch {
				continue
			}
			out[sourceId] = parsed.data as EngineState
		}
		return out
	}
}

function notLoaded(): WaveKitError {
	return new WaveKitError("Scanner persistence used before load()", "SCANNER_PERSISTENCE_NOT_LOADED")
}
```

### Task 17: Evidence store (probe WAV linking, PSD/IQ evidence, retention, free-disk guard)

**Spec:** § 6.5 (Recording), § 8 (recordings/evidence layout, retention order and exemptions, `minFreeDiskMb`), § 13 P14. **Depends on:** Task 16 (`atomicWrite`). **Batch:** S1-A

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/scanner/store/evidence-store.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/evidence-store.test.ts`

Design notes:

- **dsd-fme names** (verified in `src/decoders/builtin/call-recordings.ts` and `dsd-fme.ts` `searchForWavFile`/`parseFilenameTimestamp`): final `<YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>_<5 digits>_<proto/sysid…>_<GROUP|PRIVATE|UNIT>_TGT_<tgt>_SRC_<src>.wav` (call-recordings documents `GROUP|PRIVATE`, the search regex in `dsd-fme.ts` uses `GROUP|UNIT`; accept all three), in-progress `TEMP_<YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>_<%04X>.wav`; the time stamp is **local** time at call start (`new Date(y, m − 1, d, h, mi, s)`, as `parseFilenameTimestamp`). `findWavFileAsync` searches `<dir>`, `<dir>/WAV`, `<dir>/wav`; so does the linker, listing each directory once by `realpath` (on case-insensitive disks such as APFS `WAV` and `wav` are the same directory and every file would otherwise be listed twice; a move that hits ENOENT counts as already handled).
- **Linking** (`linkProbeRecordings`): each final WAV goes to the candidate whose TG/SRC match (a candidate without `talkgroup`/`source` matches any) and whose `[startedAt − 2 s, endedAt + 2 s]` contains the file stamp, nearest `startedAt` first. Encrypted candidate → file deleted, observation listed in `droppedEncrypted`. `TEMP_*` → deleted; the time-matched observation is listed in `cut`. No candidate → deleted. Disk low → every file deleted, nothing linked. The probe directory (`recordings/dv/probe-<probeId>/`, scanner-owned) is removed afterwards, also when a move fails part-way (`try`/`finally`). Linked files move to `recordings/dv/<discoveryId>/<name>`; `recordingId = ${discoveryId}~${name}`.
- **Retention** (`retention(keep)`): files under `recordings/dv/*`, `recordings/analog/*` (cap `maxRecordingsMb`) and `evidence/*` (cap `maxEvidenceMb`). Protected: modified within `RECORDING_IN_PROGRESS_MS` (10 s, imported from `call-recordings.ts`) or belonging to a `keep` discovery. Order: every unprotected file older than `maxAgeDays` (oldest first), then per category the oldest unprotected files until the category is under its cap. Empty discovery directories are removed. Files in `recordings/dv/probe-*` folders (live probes, including their `WAV`/`wav` subfolders) count against `maxRecordingsMb` but are never deleted by retention: linking moves or drops them. Probes are never persisted, so every `probe-*` folder present at start is a crash leftover: `removeOrphanProbeDirs(): Promise<string[]>` wipes them and Task 35's `start()` calls it once before the probe pool runs. Together this keeps P14 "sizes ≤ caps" honest. The journal's share of P14 is in Task 16.
- **Free-disk guard:** `diskState()` = `disk-low` when `statfs(dir).bavail × bsize < minFreeDiskMb` MiB (injectable `statfs`; an unavailable metric reads as `ok`). PSD/IQ writes and linking stop while low; discoveries keep updating (not this class's concern).
- Contract additions used by Tasks 35–36: `setCaps(caps: StorageCaps): void` (runtime settings), `evidencePath(discoveryId: string, name: string): string | null` (`psd.json`, `iq-<ms>.cu8`, `iq-<ms>.json`; for the evidence download routes), `removeDiscovery(discoveryId: string): Promise<void>` (`DELETE /discoveries/:id` deletes its evidence and recordings).

```ts
// tests/unit/core/scanner/evidence-store.test.ts

import { tmpdir } from "node:os"

const logger = createLogger({ level: "fatal" })
const MIB = 1024 * 1024
const DAY = 86_400_000
const CAPS: StorageCaps = { maxRecordingsMb: 512, maxEvidenceMb: 64, maxAgeDays: 30, minFreeDiskMb: 2048 }
const plentyOfDisk = async () => ({ freeBytes: 100 * 1024 * MIB })
const lowDisk = async () => ({ freeBytes: 100 * MIB })

async function withDir<T>(fn: (dir: string) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
	const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "wavekit-evidence-"))
	try {
		return await fn(dir)
	} finally {

	}
}

const pad = (n: number): string => String(n).padStart(2, "0")
function localStamp(ms: number): string {
	const d = new Date(ms)
	return `${d.getFullYear()}${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(d.getDate())}_${pad(d.getHours())}${pad(d.getMinutes())}${pad(d.getSeconds())}`
}
const callWav = (ms: number, tg: string, src: string): string => `${localStamp(ms)}_00042_DMR_CC_1_GROUP_TGT_${tg}_SRC_${src}.wav`
const tempWav = (ms: number): string => `TEMP_${localStamp(ms)}_1A2B.wav`

// 2026-10-09 12:00:00 local, whole second so file stamps are exact
const T0 = new Date(2026, 9, 9, 12, 0, 0).getTime()

async function probeDirWith(root: string, files: string[], sub = ""): Promise<string> {
	const dir = join(root, "recordings", "dv", "probe-scn-abc-dmr-1")
	await mkdir(join(dir, sub), { recursive: true })
	for (const f of files) await writeFile(join(dir, sub, f), Buffer.alloc(1_000, 1))
	return dir
}

describe("EvidenceStore.linkProbeRecordings", () => {
	it("moves a call WAV to its discovery by TG, SRC and time, and resolves the recording id", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0 + 60_000, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
			const name = callWav(T0 + 1_000, "9", "2001")
			const probe = await probeDirWith(root, [name], "WAV")
			const result = await store.linkProbeRecordings(probe, [
				{ observationId: "o-other", discoveryId: "d_OTHER", talkgroup: "9", source: "3003", startedAt: T0, endedAt: T0 + 5_000, encrypted: false },
				{ observationId: "o-1", discoveryId: "d_ONE", talkgroup: "9", source: "2001", startedAt: T0 + 500, endedAt: T0 + 6_000, encrypted: false },
			])
			expect(result).toEqual({ linked: [{ observationId: "o-1", recordingId: `d_ONE~${name}` }], cut: [], droppedEncrypted: [] })
			expect(store.recordingPath(`d_ONE~${name}`)).toBe(join(root, "recordings", "dv", "d_ONE", name))
			expect(existsSync(probe)).toBe(false)
		})
	})

	it("lists a directory reached twice (WAV and wav on a case-insensitive disk) once", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0 + 60_000, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
			const name = callWav(T0 + 1_000, "9", "2001")
			const probe = await probeDirWith(root, [name], "WAV")
			// case-insensitive disks (APFS) already alias wav to WAV; elsewhere a symlink stands in so the test bites there too
			if (!existsSync(join(probe, "wav"))) await symlink(join(probe, "WAV"), join(probe, "wav"))
			const result = await store.linkProbeRecordings(probe, [
				{ observationId: "o-1", discoveryId: "d_ONE", talkgroup: "9", source: "2001", startedAt: T0, endedAt: T0 + 6_000, encrypted: false },
			])
			expect(result).toEqual({ linked: [{ observationId: "o-1", recordingId: `d_ONE~${name}` }], cut: [], droppedEncrypted: [] })
			expect(await readdir(join(root, "recordings", "dv", "d_ONE"))).toEqual([name])
			expect(existsSync(probe)).toBe(false)
		})
	})

	it("drops recordings of encrypted calls and TEMP leftovers of calls cut by a hop", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0 + 60_000, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
			const probe = await probeDirWith(root, [callWav(T0, "9", "2001"), tempWav(T0 + 10_000), callWav(T0 + 30_000, "77", "5")])
			const result = await store.linkProbeRecordings(probe, [
				{ observationId: "o-enc", discoveryId: "d_ONE", talkgroup: "9", source: "2001", startedAt: T0, endedAt: T0 + 3_000, encrypted: true },
				{ observationId: "o-cut", discoveryId: "d_ONE", startedAt: T0 + 9_500, endedAt: T0 + 12_000, encrypted: false },
			])
			expect(result.linked).toEqual([])
			expect(result.droppedEncrypted).toEqual(["o-enc"])
			expect(result.cut).toEqual(["o-cut"])
			expect(existsSync(join(root, "recordings", "dv", "d_ONE"))).toBe(false)
			expect(existsSync(probe)).toBe(false)
		})
	})

	it("links nothing and deletes the probe files while the disk is low", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0, statfs: lowDisk })
			const probe = await probeDirWith(root, [callWav(T0, "9", "2001")])
			const result = await store.linkProbeRecordings(probe, [
				{ observationId: "o-1", discoveryId: "d_ONE", talkgroup: "9", source: "2001", startedAt: T0, endedAt: T0 + 3_000, encrypted: false },
			])
			expect(result.linked).toEqual([])
			expect(await store.diskState()).toBe("disk-low")
			expect(existsSync(probe)).toBe(false)
		})
	})

	it("rejects recording ids that could escape the storage directory", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
			expect(store.recordingPath("d_ONE~../../etc/passwd.wav")).toBeNull()
			expect(store.recordingPath("../d_ONE~a.wav")).toBeNull()
			expect(store.recordingPath("d_ONE~missing.wav")).toBeNull()
			expect(store.evidencePath("d_ONE", "../psd.json")).toBeNull()
		})
	})
})

describe("EvidenceStore PSD and IQ", () => {
	it("overwrites the PSD only when the SNR improves", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
			expect(await store.writePsd("d_ONE", { startHz: 446e6, binHz: 1000, bins: [-90, -60, -90], snrDb: 20 })).toBe(true)
			expect(await store.writePsd("d_ONE", { startHz: 446e6, binHz: 1000, bins: [-90, -70, -90], snrDb: 15 })).toBe(false)
			expect(await store.writePsd("d_ONE", { startHz: 446e6, binHz: 1000, bins: [-90, -50, -90], snrDb: 30 })).toBe(true)
			const path = store.evidencePath("d_ONE", "psd.json") ?? ""
			const saved = JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf8")) as { snrDb: number; bins: number[] }
			expect(saved.snrDb).toBe(30)
			expect(saved.bins).toEqual([-90, -50, -90])
		})
	})

	it("writes at most one second of IQ and nothing while the disk is low", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
			const name = await store.writeIq("d_ONE", new Uint8Array(200_000), { sampleRateHz: 48_000, centreHz: 446_006_250 })
			expect(name).toBe(`iq-${T0}.cu8`)
			expect((await stat(store.evidencePath("d_ONE", name ?? "") ?? "")).size).toBe(96_000)
			const low = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0, statfs: lowDisk })
			expect(await low.writeIq("d_ONE", new Uint8Array(10), { sampleRateHz: 48_000, centreHz: 1 })).toBeNull()
			expect(await low.writePsd("d_TWO", { startHz: 0, binHz: 1, bins: [], snrDb: 50 })).toBe(false)
		})
	})

	it("removes a discovery's recordings and evidence", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
			await store.writePsd("d_ONE", { startHz: 0, binHz: 1, bins: [1], snrDb: 10 })
			await mkdir(join(root, "recordings", "dv", "d_ONE"), { recursive: true })
			await writeFile(join(root, "recordings", "dv", "d_ONE", "a.wav"), "x")
			await store.removeDiscovery("d_ONE")
			expect(existsSync(join(root, "evidence", "d_ONE"))).toBe(false)
			expect(existsSync(join(root, "recordings", "dv", "d_ONE"))).toBe(false)
		})
	})
})

describe("EvidenceStore.removeOrphanProbeDirs", () => {
	it("wipes every probe folder left by a crash and nothing else", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: CAPS, logger, now: () => T0, statfs: plentyOfDisk })

interface FileSpec {
	kind: "dv" | "analog" | "evidence"
	disc: number
	bytes: number
	ageMs: number
}

const fileArb: fc.Arbitrary<FileSpec> = fc.record({
	kind: fc.constantFrom("dv" as const, "analog" as const, "evidence" as const),
	disc: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }),
	bytes: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4_000 }),
	// young (< 10 s, well clear of the boundary) or whole hours + 30 min (clear of day boundaries)
	ageMs: fc.oneof(fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 8_000 }), fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 960 }).map(h => h * 3_600_000 + 1_800_000)),
})

describe("EvidenceStore.retention", () => {
	it("deletes expired files first, then the oldest, sparing young and keep files", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const now = Date.now()
			// cap 3000 B: after the expired file goes, 4000 B remain (1000 of them keep, 1000 live): deleting mid.wav reaches the cap
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: { ...CAPS, maxRecordingsMb: 3_000 / MIB, maxAgeDays: 1 }, logger, now: () => now, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
			const put = async (rel: string, ageMs: number) => {
				const path = join(root, rel)
				await mkdir(join(path, ".."), { recursive: true })
				await writeFile(path, Buffer.alloc(1_000))
				const t = (now - ageMs) / 1000
				await utimes(path, t, t)
			}
			await put("recordings/dv/d_A/old.wav", 3 * DAY)
			await put("recordings/dv/d_KEEP/old.wav", 3 * DAY)
			await put("recordings/dv/d_A/mid.wav", 5 * 3_600_000)
			await put("recordings/dv/d_B/new.wav", 3_600_000)
			await put("recordings/dv/d_B/live.wav", 1_000)
			const { deleted } = await store.retention(new Set(["d_KEEP"]))
			expect(deleted).toEqual([join("recordings", "dv", "d_A", "old.wav"), join("recordings", "dv", "d_A", "mid.wav")])
			expect(await readdir(join(root, "recordings", "dv"))).toEqual(["d_B", "d_KEEP"])
		})
	})

	it("counts live probe folders against the recordings cap without deleting them", async () => {
		await withDir(async root => {
			const now = Date.now()
			const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps: { ...CAPS, maxRecordingsMb: 1_500 / MIB }, logger, now: () => now, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
			const put = async (rel: string, ageMs: number) => {
				const path = join(root, rel)
				await mkdir(join(path, ".."), { recursive: true })
				await writeFile(path, Buffer.alloc(1_000))
				const t = (now - ageMs) / 1000
				await utimes(path, t, t)
			}
			await put("recordings/dv/probe-scn-abc-dmr-1/WAV/call.wav", 3_600_000)
			await put("recordings/dv/d_A/old.wav", 1_800_000)
			// 2000 B > 1500 B: only d_A's file may go; the probe's (older) file waits for linking
			const { deleted } = await store.retention(new Set())
			expect(deleted).toEqual([join("recordings", "dv", "d_A", "old.wav")])
			expect(existsSync(join(root, "recordings", "dv", "probe-scn-abc-dmr-1", "WAV", "call.wav"))).toBe(true)
		})
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 14: Retention
	// Validates: spec § 8
	it("meets the caps unless only protected files remain, never deletes young or keep files, expired before oldest", async () => {
		await fc.assert(
			fc.asyncProperty(
				fc.array(fileArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 20 }),
				fc.subarray([0, 1, 2, 3]),
				fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 30 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 30_000 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 30_000 }),
				async (files, keepIdx, maxAgeDays, recCap, evCap) => {
					await withDir(async root => {
						const now = Date.now()
						const caps: StorageCaps = { maxRecordingsMb: recCap / MIB, maxEvidenceMb: evCap / MIB, maxAgeDays, minFreeDiskMb: 0 }
						const store = new EvidenceStore({ dir: root, caps, logger, now: () => now, statfs: plentyOfDisk })
						const meta = new Map<string, FileSpec>()
						for (const [i, f] of files.entries()) {
							const rel = f.kind === "evidence" ? join("evidence", `d_${f.disc}`, `f${i}.bin`) : join("recordings", f.kind, `d_${f.disc}`, `f${i}.wav`)
							await mkdir(join(root, rel, ".."), { recursive: true })
							await writeFile(join(root, rel), Buffer.alloc(f.bytes))
							const t = (now - f.ageMs) / 1000
							await utimes(join(root, rel), t, t)
							meta.set(rel, f)
						}
						const keep = new Set(keepIdx.map(k => `d_${k}`))
						const isProtected = (f: FileSpec) => f.ageMs < 10_000 || keep.has(`d_${f.disc}`)
						const isExpired = (f: FileSpec) => f.ageMs > maxAgeDays * DAY
						const category = (f: FileSpec) => (f.kind === "evidence" ? "evidence" : "recordings")
						const { deleted } = await store.retention(keep)
						const gone = new Set(deleted)
						for (const rel of deleted) expect(isProtected(meta.get(rel) as FileSpec)).toBe(false)
						for (const [cat, cap] of [["recordings", recCap], ["evidence", evCap]] as const) {
							const remaining = [...meta].filter(([rel, f]) => !gone.has(rel) && category(f) === cat)
							const total = remaining.reduce((s, [, f]) => s + f.bytes, 0)
							if (total > cap) for (const [, f] of remaining) expect(isProtected(f)).toBe(true)
						}
						for (const [rel, f] of meta) if (!gone.has(rel) && isExpired(f)) expect(isProtected(f)).toBe(true)
						const specs = deleted.map(rel => meta.get(rel) as FileSpec)
						const firstFresh = specs.findIndex(f => !isExpired(f))
						if (firstFresh >= 0) expect(specs.slice(firstFresh).every(f => !isExpired(f))).toBe(true)
						const nonIncreasingAge = (list: FileSpec[]) => list.every((f, i) => i === 0 || (list[i - 1] as FileSpec).ageMs >= f.ageMs)
						expect(nonIncreasingAge(specs.filter(isExpired))).toBe(true)
						for (const cat of ["recordings", "evidence"] as const)
							expect(nonIncreasingAge(specs.filter(f => !isExpired(f) && category(f) === cat))).toBe(true)
					})
				},
			),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	}, 60_000) // 100 runs of real file I/O: ~5 s on a loaded laptop
})
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/store/evidence-store.ts
/**
 * Evidence store (spec § 6.5 Recording, § 8): probe recordings, PSD and IQ evidence, retention.
 *
 * Layout under the scanner storage dir: `recordings/dv/<discoveryId>/*.wav` (dsd-fme per-call WAVs
 * moved in from a probe's `recordings/dv/probe-<probeId>/`), `recordings/analog/<discoveryId>/`
 * (post-channelizer), `evidence/<discoveryId>/psd.json` and `iq-<ms>.cu8` (+ `.json` metadata).
 * Retention deletes expired files first, then the oldest per category until under its cap; files
 * from the last 10 s and files of `keep` discoveries are never deleted. Writes stop while free disk
 * is below `minFreeDiskMb`.
 */
import { existsSync } from "node:fs"
import { copyFile, mkdir, readdir, readFile, realpath, rename, rm, rmdir, stat, statfs } from "node:fs/promises"
import { join, relative, resolve } from "node:path"
import { z } from "zod"
import { RECORDING_IN_PROGRESS_MS } from "../../../decoders/builtin/call-recordings.js"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../../utils/errors.js"
import { createComponentLogger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import type { Logger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import { atomicWrite } from "./persistence.js"

export interface StorageCaps {
	maxRecordingsMb: number
	maxEvidenceMb: number
	maxAgeDays: number
	minFreeDiskMb: number
}

/** `${discoveryId}~${fileName}`; the file lives in recordings/{dv,analog}/<discoveryId>/. */
export const RECORDING_ID = /^(d_[0-9A-Za-z]+)~([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.wav)$/
const DISCOVERY_ID = /^d_[0-9A-Za-z]+$/
/** `recordings/dv/probe-<probeId>/`: a live probe's recording folder (probes are never persisted). */
const PROBE_DIR = /^probe-[0-9A-Za-z._-]+$/
const EVIDENCE_NAME = /^(?:psd\.json|iq-\d+\.(?:cu8|json))$/
/** dsd-fme close_and_rename_wav_file (call-recordings.ts, dsd-fme.ts searchForWavFile). */
const CALL_WAV = /^(\d{8})_(\d{6})_\d{5}_.+_(?:GROUP|PRIVATE|UNIT)_TGT_([^_]+)_SRC_([^_.]+)\.wav$/
/** dsd-fme open_wav_file, left behind when the call is cut. */
const TEMP_WAV = /^TEMP_(\d{8})_(\d{6})_[0-9A-F]{4}\.wav$/
const RECORDING_KINDS = ["dv", "analog"] as const
const MATCH_SLACK_MS = 2_000
const MIB = 1024 * 1024
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000

export interface LinkCandidate {
	observationId: string
	discoveryId: string
	talkgroup?: string
	source?: string
	startedAt: number
	endedAt: number
	encrypted: boolean
}

interface StoredFile {
	path: string
	rel: string
	category: "recordings" | "evidence"
	/** The discovery folder, or the `probe-*` folder for a probe's not-yet-linked files. */
	discoveryId: string
	/** In a live probe's folder: counted against the cap, never deleted (linking moves or drops it). */
	probe: boolean
	bytes: number
	mtimeMs: number
}

const PsdFileSchema = z.object({ snrDb: z.number() }).passthrough()

/** dsd-fme stamps are local time (dsd-fme.ts parseFilenameTimestamp). */
function localStampMs(date: string, time: string): number | null {
	const d = /^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/.exec(date)
	const t = /^(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/.exec(time)
	if (d === null || t === null) return null
	const ms = new Date(Number(d[1]), Number(d[2]) - 1, Number(d[3]), Number(t[1]), Number(t[2]), Number(t[3])).getTime()
	return Number.isFinite(ms) ? ms : null
}

function nearestCandidate(candidates: readonly LinkCandidate[], at: number, tg?: string, src?: string): LinkCandidate | undefined {
	let best: LinkCandidate | undefined
	let bestDiff = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
	for (const c of candidates) {
		if (at < c.startedAt - MATCH_SLACK_MS || at > c.endedAt + MATCH_SLACK_MS) continue
		if (tg !== undefined && c.talkgroup !== undefined && c.talkgroup !== tg) continue
		if (src !== undefined && c.source !== undefined && c.source !== src) continue
		const diff = Math.abs(at - c.startedAt)
		if (diff < bestDiff) {
			best = c
			bestDiff = diff
		}
	}
	return best
}

function errorCode(err: unknown): string | undefined {
	if (err !== null && typeof err === "object" && "code" in err) {
		const code = (err as { code: unknown }).code
		return typeof code === "string" ? code : undefined
	}
	return undefined
}

async function listDir(dir: string): Promise<string[]> {
	try {
		return await readdir(dir)
	} catch (err) {
		if (errorCode(err) === "ENOENT" || errorCode(err) === "ENOTDIR") return []
		throw err
	}
}

/** `<dir>`, `<dir>/WAV`, `<dir>/wav` (as `findWavFileAsync`), deduplicated by real path; missing ones are skipped. */
async function wavDirs(dir: string): Promise<string[]> {
	const seen = new Set<string>()
	const out: string[] = []
	for (const d of [dir, join(dir, "WAV"), join(dir, "wav")]) {
		let real: string
		try {
			real = await realpath(d)
		} catch (err) {
			if (errorCode(err) === "ENOENT" || errorCode(err) === "ENOTDIR") continue
			throw err
		}
		if (seen.has(real)) continue
		seen.add(real)
		out.push(d)
	}
	return out
}

async function moveFile(from: string, to: string): Promise<void> {
	try {
		await rename(from, to)
	} catch (err) {
		if (errorCode(err) !== "EXDEV") throw err
		await copyFile(from, to)
		await rm(from, { force: true })
	}
}

function assertDiscoveryId(id: string): void {
	if (!DISCOVERY_ID.test(id)) throw new WaveKitError(`Invalid discovery id: ${id}`, "SCANNER_INVALID_ID")
}

async function defaultStatfs(p: string): Promise<{ freeBytes: number }> {
	const s = await statfs(p)
	return { freeBytes: s.bavail * s.bsize }
}

export class EvidenceStore {
	private readonly root: string
	private readonly log: Logger
	private readonly now: () => number
	private readonly statfs: (p: string) => Promise<{ freeBytes: number }>
	private caps: StorageCaps

	constructor(opts: {
		dir: string
		caps: StorageCaps
		logger: Logger
		now: () => number
		statfs?: (p: string) => Promise<{ freeBytes: number }>
	}) {
		this.root = resolve(opts.dir)
		this.caps = { ...opts.caps }
		this.log = createComponentLogger(opts.logger, "EvidenceStore")
		this.now = opts.now
		this.statfs = opts.statfs ?? defaultStatfs
	}

	setCaps(caps: StorageCaps): void {
		this.caps = { ...caps }
	}

	async linkProbeRecordings(
		probeDir: string,
		candidates: LinkCandidate[],
	): Promise<{ linked: { observationId: string; recordingId: string }[]; cut: string[]; droppedEncrypted: string[] }> {
		for (const c of candidates) assertDiscoveryId(c.discoveryId)
		const linked: { observationId: string; recordingId: string }[] = []
		const cut: string[] = []
		const droppedEncrypted: string[] = []
		const low = (await this.diskState()) === "disk-low"
		const files: { path: string; name: string }[] = []
		// WAV and wav are one directory on case-insensitive disks (APFS, macOS bind mounts): list each real directory once
		for (const dir of await wavDirs(probeDir))
			for (const name of await listDir(dir)) if (name.endsWith(".wav")) files.push({ path: join(dir, name), name })
		files.sort((a, b) => (a.name < b.name ? -1 : a.name > b.name ? 1 : 0))
		try {
			await this.linkFiles(files, candidates, low, { linked, cut, droppedEncrypted })
		} finally {
			// never leave a probe folder behind, even when a move fails part-way
			await rm(probeDir, { recursive: true, force: true })
		}
		if (files.length > 0)
			this.log.debug({ probeDir, files: files.length, linked: linked.length, cut: cut.length, droppedEncrypted: droppedEncrypted.length, low }, "Processed probe recordings")
		return { linked, cut, droppedEncrypted }
	}

	/**
	 * Probes are never persisted, so at start every `recordings/dv/probe-*` folder is a crash
	 * leftover. Call once before the probe pool starts; returns the removed folder names.
	 */
	async removeOrphanProbeDirs(): Promise<string[]> {
		const base = join(this.root, "recordings", "dv")
		const removed: string[] = []
		for (const name of await listDir(base)) {
			if (!PROBE_DIR.test(name)) continue
			await rm(join(base, name), { recursive: true, force: true })
			removed.push(name)
		}
		if (removed.length > 0) this.log.info({ removed: removed.length }, "Removed orphaned probe recording folders")
		return removed
	}

	private async linkFiles(
		files: readonly { path: string; name: string }[],
		candidates: readonly LinkCandidate[],
		low: boolean,
		out: { linked: { observationId: string; recordingId: string }[]; cut: string[]; droppedEncrypted: string[] },
	): Promise<void> {
		const { linked, cut, droppedEncrypted } = out
		for (const f of files) {
			const temp = TEMP_WAV.exec(f.name)
			if (temp !== null) {
				const at = localStampMs(temp[1] ?? "", temp[2] ?? "")
				const c = at === null ? undefined : nearestCandidate(candidates, at)
				if (c !== undefined && !cut.includes(c.observationId)) cut.push(c.observationId)
				await rm(f.path, { force: true })
				continue
			}
			const call = CALL_WAV.exec(f.name)
			const at = call === null ? null : localStampMs(call[1] ?? "", call[2] ?? "")
			const c = call === null || at === null ? undefined : nearestCandidate(candidates, at, call[3], call[4])
			if (c === undefined || low) {
				await rm(f.path, { force: true })
				continue
			}
			if (c.encrypted) {
				await rm(f.path, { force: true })
				if (!droppedEncrypted.includes(c.observationId)) droppedEncrypted.push(c.observationId)
				continue
			}
			const target = join(this.root, "recordings", "dv", c.discoveryId)
			await mkdir(target, { recursive: true })
			try {
				await moveFile(f.path, join(target, f.name))
			} catch (err) {
				// already handled through another listing of the same directory
				if (errorCode(err) === "ENOENT") continue
				throw err
			}
			linked.push({ observationId: c.observationId, recordingId: `${c.discoveryId}~${f.name}` })
		}
	}

	async writePsd(discoveryId: string, psd: { startHz: number; binHz: number; bins: number[]; snrDb: number }): Promise<boolean> {
		assertDiscoveryId(discoveryId)
		if ((await this.diskState()) === "disk-low") return false
		const file = join(this.root, "evidence", discoveryId, "psd.json")
		try {
			const existing = PsdFileSchema.safeParse(JSON.parse(await readFile(file, "utf8")) as unknown)
			if (existing.success && existing.data.snrDb >= psd.snrDb) return false
		} catch (err) {
			if (errorCode(err) !== "ENOENT") this.log.debug({ err, file }, "Replacing an unreadable PSD evidence file")
		}
		await atomicWrite(file, JSON.stringify({ version: 1, savedAt: new Date(this.now()).toISOString(), ...psd }))
		return true
	}

	async writeIq(discoveryId: string, bytes: Uint8Array, meta: { sampleRateHz: number; centreHz: number }): Promise<string | null> {
		assertDiscoveryId(discoveryId)
		if ((await this.diskState()) === "disk-low") return null
		const at = this.now()
		const limit = Math.max(2, Math.floor(meta.sampleRateHz) * 2)
		const body = bytes.length > limit ? bytes.subarray(0, limit) : bytes
		const dir = join(this.root, "evidence", discoveryId)
		const name = `iq-${at}.cu8`
		await atomicWrite(join(dir, name), body)
		await atomicWrite(
			join(dir, `iq-${at}.json`),
			JSON.stringify({ version: 1, sampleRateHz: meta.sampleRateHz, centreHz: meta.centreHz, savedAt: new Date(at).toISOString(), bytes: body.length }),
		)
		return name
	}

	recordingPath(recordingId: string): string | null {
		const m = RECORDING_ID.exec(recordingId)
		const discoveryId = m?.[1]
		const file = m?.[2]
		if (discoveryId === undefined || file === undefined || file.includes("..")) return null
		for (const kind of RECORDING_KINDS) {
			const path = join(this.root, "recordings", kind, discoveryId, file)
			if (existsSync(path)) return path
		}
		return null
	}

	evidencePath(discoveryId: string, name: string): string | null {
		if (!DISCOVERY_ID.test(discoveryId) || !EVIDENCE_NAME.test(name)) return null
		const path = join(this.root, "evidence", discoveryId, name)
		return existsSync(path) ? path : null
	}

	async removeDiscovery(discoveryId: string): Promise<void> {
		assertDiscoveryId(discoveryId)
		await rm(join(this.root, "evidence", discoveryId), { recursive: true, force: true })
		for (const kind of RECORDING_KINDS) await rm(join(this.root, "recordings", kind, discoveryId), { recursive: true, force: true })
	}

	async retention(keepDiscoveryIds: ReadonlySet<string>): Promise<{ deleted: string[] }> {
		const now = this.now()
		const files = await this.collect()
		const isProtected = (f: StoredFile): boolean => f.probe || now - f.mtimeMs < RECORDING_IN_PROGRESS_MS || keepDiscoveryIds.has(f.discoveryId)
		const byAge = [...files].sort((a, b) => a.mtimeMs - b.mtimeMs || (a.rel < b.rel ? -1 : a.rel > b.rel ? 1 : 0))
		const gone = new Set<string>()
		const deleted: string[] = []
		const remove = async (f: StoredFile): Promise<void> => {
			await rm(f.path, { force: true })
			gone.add(f.path)
			deleted.push(f.rel)
		}
		const maxAgeMs = this.caps.maxAgeDays * DAY_MS
		for (const f of byAge) if (!isProtected(f) && now - f.mtimeMs > maxAgeMs) await remove(f)
		const caps: [StoredFile["category"], number][] = [
			["recordings", this.caps.maxRecordingsMb * MIB],
			["evidence", this.caps.maxEvidenceMb * MIB],
		]
		for (const [category, capBytes] of caps) {
			let total = 0
			for (const f of files) if (f.category === category && !gone.has(f.path)) total += f.bytes
			for (const f of byAge) {
				if (total <= capBytes) break
				if (f.category !== category || gone.has(f.path) || isProtected(f)) continue
				await remove(f)
				total -= f.bytes
			}
		}
		await this.removeEmptyDirs()
		if (deleted.length > 0) this.log.info({ deleted: deleted.length }, "Scanner retention removed files")
		return { deleted }
	}

	async diskState(): Promise<"ok" | "disk-low"> {
		try {
			await mkdir(this.root, { recursive: true })
			const { freeBytes } = await this.statfs(this.root)
			return freeBytes < this.caps.minFreeDiskMb * MIB ? "disk-low" : "ok"
		} catch (err) {
			this.log.debug({ err, dir: this.root }, "Free-disk metric unavailable; treating the disk as ok")
			return "ok"
		}
	}

	private async collect(): Promise<StoredFile[]> {
		const out: StoredFile[] = []
		const scan = async (base: string, category: StoredFile["category"]): Promise<void> => {
			for (const discoveryId of await listDir(base)) {
				const probe = category === "recordings" && PROBE_DIR.test(discoveryId)
				if (!probe && !DISCOVERY_ID.test(discoveryId)) continue
				const top = join(base, discoveryId)
				// a probe's dsd-fme may write into WAV/ or wav/ (Task 17 linking); those bytes count against the cap too
				for (const dir of probe ? await wavDirs(top) : [top])
					for (const name of await listDir(dir)) {
						const path = join(dir, name)
						try {
							const s = await stat(path)
							if (s.isFile()) out.push({ path, rel: relative(this.root, path), category, discoveryId, probe, bytes: s.size, mtimeMs: s.mtimeMs })
						} catch (err) {
							if (errorCode(err) !== "ENOENT") throw err
						}
					}
			}
		}
		for (const kind of RECORDING_KINDS) await scan(join(this.root, "recordings", kind), "recordings")
		await scan(join(this.root, "evidence"), "evidence")
		return out
	}

	private async removeEmptyDirs(): Promise<void> {
		const bases = [...RECORDING_KINDS.map(k => join(this.root, "recordings", k)), join(this.root, "evidence")]
		for (const base of bases)
			for (const discoveryId of await listDir(base)) {
				if (!DISCOVERY_ID.test(discoveryId)) continue
				const dir = join(base, discoveryId)
				if ((await listDir(dir)).length === 0) await rmdir(dir).catch(() => undefined)
			}
	}
}
```

### Task 17a: Occupancy history (persistent per-frequency activity, below the surfacing filter)

**Spec:** amendment from the main session (2026-10-09): remember intermittent emitters even when no observation passes the § 7.2 surfacing filter. Related: § 8 (engine files, atomic writes), § 9 (bounded memory), § 10.2 (revisit `activityScore`). **Depends on:** Tasks 1 (`SchemaMatches`/`Assert` in `src/core/spectrum/types.ts`), 16 (`ScannerPersistence`, `EngineStateSchema`). **Batch:** S1-A

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/spectrum/occupancy.ts`
- Modify: `src/core/scanner/store/persistence.ts` (Task 16: imports; `writeOccupancy`, `loadOccupancy`, `loadEngine` after `writeEngine`; private `occupancyFile`)
- Test: `tests/unit/core/spectrum/occupancy.test.ts`

**Contract additions:**

```ts
// src/core/spectrum/occupancy.ts
export const DEFAULT_BUCKET_HZ = 12_500
export const DEFAULT_MAX_BUCKETS = 20_000
export const OCCUPANCY_HOURS = 168
export interface OccupancyBucketView { startHz: number; dutyByHour: (number | null)[]; observedMs: number; activeMs: number }
export interface OccupancyQuery { bucketHz: number; buckets: OccupancyBucketView[] }
export interface OccupancyTop { startHz: number; duty: number; observedMs: number; activeMs: number }
export interface OccupancyState {
	version: 1
	bucketHz: number
	buckets: { index: number; lastHour: number; observed: string; active: string; carryObservedMs: number; carryActiveMs: number }[]
}   // observed/active: base64 little-endian Uint16 × 168 (whole seconds per hour)
export const OccupancyStateSchema
export class OccupancyHistory {
	constructor(opts?: { bucketHz?: number; maxBuckets?: number })
	readonly bucketHz: number
	get size(): number
	observe(at: number, usable: FreqRange, active: readonly FreqRange[], blockMs: number): void
	query(range: FreqRange, sinceMs: number, now: number): OccupancyQuery
	topActive(range: FreqRange, n: number, sinceMs: number, now: number): OccupancyTop[]
	seedScore(range: FreqRange, now: number): number
	exportState(): OccupancyState
	importState(s: OccupancyState): boolean
}
// src/core/scanner/store/persistence.ts (ScannerPersistence, added here)
writeOccupancy(sourceId: string, s: OccupancyState): Promise<void>     // atomic engine/occupancy/<encodeURIComponent(sourceId)>.json
loadOccupancy(sourceId: string): Promise<OccupancyState | null>       // null when missing or invalid (logged)
loadEngine(sourceId: string): Promise<EngineState | null>             // one source's engine file without load()
// src/core/scanner/scheduler.ts (Task 19 option, already in Task 19's code)
activitySeed?: (hop: Hop) => number
```

Design:

- **Buckets.** Bucket `i` covers `[i·bucketHz, (i+1)·bucketHz)` (aligned to 0 Hz). A range `[s, e]` with `e > s` touches buckets `floor(s/bw) … ceil(e/bw) − 1`; a zero-width range touches `floor(s/bw)`; an inverted range touches none. So a range ending exactly on a bucket edge does not touch the next bucket.
- **Ring.** Each bucket has two `Uint16Array(168)` slots indexed by `absoluteHour mod 168`: observed and active **whole seconds** in that hour, 0–3600 (stored values are clamped to 3600). It also keeps `lastHour` (the newest absolute hour written) and two Float64 carries, `carryObservedMs` and `carryActiveMs`, each in [0, 1000). The carries hold the sub-second remainder of the **current** slot (`lastHour`) only. Writing hour `h > lastHour` first flushes the carries into the `lastHour` slot as `Math.round(carry / 1000)` seconds, resets them, and zeroes the slots of hours `lastHour+1 … h` (at most 168). A closed hour therefore stores `round(totalMs / 1000)` for both values. Rounding is monotone and total active ≤ total observed, so a closed hour stays consistent (active ≤ observed) and loses at most 0.5 s. The active carry alone may exceed the observed carry (e.g. 500 vs 450 ms), so carries are never clamped against each other. A sample with `h ≤ lastHour − 168` is older than the ring and is dropped. A late sample inside the ring (an hour already closed) adds `Math.round(blockMs / 1000)` seconds, so late blocks under 0.5 s are lost (rare: only clock steps reorder blocks). Reads accept hour `h` only if `lastHour − 168 < h ≤ lastHour`. The current slot reads as `seconds × 1000 + carry`, capped at one hour, with active clamped to observed. That way stale slots never leak, there is no per-hour sweep, and the current hour is exact to the millisecond.
- **`observe`** is called once per integration block. `SpectrumService` (Task 37a) calls it on every trusted `block-summary`: `usable` = the summary's usable span, `active` = `summary.tracks`, `blockMs` = `integrationMs`, `at` = wall time of the block end. It adds `blockMs` to the observed carry of every bucket touched by `usable` and moves whole seconds into the slot. Active ranges are clipped to `usable`. It adds `blockMs` once to the active carry of every bucket touched by any clipped active range, so `active ≤ observed` by construction (and it is clamped as well).
- **Duty** of a slot = `active / observed` (`null` when the slot is unobserved). `query` returns the buckets touched by `range` that were observed in the hour window `[hour(sinceMs), hour(now)]`, clamped to the last 168 hours, in ascending `startHz`. `dutyByHour` runs oldest → newest. The REST layer (Task 36/37a) must bound `range` (e.g. ≤ 20 MHz = 1600 buckets) because each bucket returns up to 168 numbers.
- **`topActive`** ranks by window duty, then `activeMs`, then lower `startHz`. Buckets with no active time are excluded.
- **`seedScore`** is the **maximum** bucket duty over the last 24 hours (hour granularity: the current and the 24 previous hours) among buckets observed for ≥ 1 s, or 0. The scheduler's `activityScore` is the fraction of a hop's blocks with any open track. That fraction is at least the duty of the busiest bucket in the hop, so the max is the faithful lower-bound seed. A sum ratio would dilute one busy channel by every quiet channel in a 1.6 MHz hop (≈ 130 buckets).
- **Bound.** The Map is kept in least-recently-observed order: a touched bucket is re-inserted at the end, and the first entry is evicted while `size > maxBuckets`. One `observe` that touches more buckets than `maxBuckets` keeps the highest-frequency ones, so the bound always holds.
- **Memory and disk.** A bucket costs 2 × 168 × 2 B = 672 B of slots plus ≈ 100 B of object and Map overhead. The default bound of 20 000 buckets is ≈ 13 MB of slots (≈ 16 MB in total). That covers 250 MHz at 12.5 kHz, e.g. the whole VHF/UHF land-mobile and amateur bands. As base64 JSON a bucket is ≈ 1 KB, so a full history file is ≈ 20 MB, written every 5 min. `maxBuckets` stays configurable (`SpectrumService` could pass it from settings if a `scanner.storage.occupancyMaxBuckets` key is added later; today it is the default).
- **Persistence.** The state goes to `engine/occupancy/<encodeURIComponent(sourceId)>.json` in its own subdirectory rather than as `engine/occupancy-<sourceId>.json`. This avoids collisions with a source whose id starts with `occupancy-`. It also means Task 16's `readEngines` (which only reads `*.json` entries directly in `engine/`) needs no change. Writes are atomic (Task 16's `atomicWrite`) on the persistence chain. `SpectrumService` (Task 37a) writes it with the engine state every 5 min, when an engine stops and at shutdown, and loads it for every eligible source at start. The export lists buckets oldest-observed first, so an import restores the eviction order.
- **Scheduler seed.** Task 19's `SweepScheduler` takes the optional `activitySeed`. `ScannerService` (Task 37a) passes `hop => seed(hop.covered)` with `seed = spectrum.activitySeed(sourceId)` (which calls `history.seedScore(range, now())`), which is applied to hops at construction and to hops that are new after a re-plan.

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/occupancy.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"

import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"

import { ScannerPersistence } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/store/persistence.js"

}

		expect(h.seedScore(r(BASE + 5_000_000, BASE + 6_000_000), T0)).toBe(0) // never observed

})

describe("OccupancyHistory hourly ring", () => {
	const one = r(BASE, BASE + 12_500)

	it("rolls over to a new slot each hour", () => {
		const h = new OccupancyHistory()
		h.observe(T0 + HOUR - 2_000, one, [one], 2_000)
		h.observe(T0 + HOUR + 10, one, [], 1_000)
		expect(h.query(one, T0, T0 + HOUR + 10).buckets[0]).toEqual({ startHz: BASE, dutyByHour: [1, 0], observedMs: 3_000, activeMs: 2_000 })
	})

	it("keeps the current hour exact and rounds a closed hour's remainder to whole seconds", () => {
		const h = new OccupancyHistory()
		for (let i = 0; i < 29; i++) h.observe(T0 + i * 50, one, i < 10 ? [one] : [], 50) // 1450 ms observed, 500 ms active
		expect(h.query(one, T0, T0 + 2_000).buckets[0]).toMatchObject({ observedMs: 1_450, activeMs: 500 })
		h.observe(T0 + HOUR, one, [], 50)
		// hour H closed: 1 s + round(0.45 s) = 1 s observed, round(0.5 s) = 1 s active
		expect(h.query(one, T0, T0).buckets[0]).toEqual({ startHz: BASE, dutyByHour: [1], observedMs: 1_000, activeMs: 1_000 })
	})

	it("caps a slot at one hour and never reports active above observed", () => {
		const h = new OccupancyHistory()
		for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) h.observe(T0 + i, one, [one], 1_000_000)
		expect(h.query(one, T0, T0).buckets[0]).toEqual({ startHz: BASE, dutyByHour: [1], observedMs: HOUR, activeMs: HOUR })
	})

	it("wraps after 168 hours, drops samples older than the ring and keeps late ones inside it", () => {
		const h = new OccupancyHistory()
		h.observe(T0, one, [one], 2_000)
		h.observe(T0 + 170 * HOUR, one, [], 50)
		const now = T0 + 170 * HOUR
		let view = h.query(one, T0, now).buckets[0]
		expect(view?.dutyByHour).toHaveLength(168)
		expect(view?.dutyByHour.filter(d => d !== null)).toEqual([0])
		expect(view?.observedMs).toBe(50)
		h.observe(T0 + HOUR, one, [one], 2_000) // older than the ring: dropped
		h.observe(T0 + 169 * HOUR, one, [one], 2_000) // late but inside the ring: kept as whole seconds
		view = h.query(one, T0, now).buckets[0]
		expect(view?.observedMs).toBe(2_050)
		expect(view?.dutyByHour.at(-2)).toBe(1)
		expect(h.query(one, T0, T0 + 10 * HOUR).buckets).toEqual([]) // hours the ring no longer holds
	})
})

describe("OccupancyHistory bound", () => {
	it("evicts the least recently observed buckets", () => {
		const h = new OccupancyHistory({ maxBuckets: 10 })
		h.observe(T0, r(BASE, BASE + 125_000), [], 50)
		h.observe(T0 + 1_000, r(BASE, BASE + 25_000), [], 50)
		h.observe(T0 + 2_000, r(BASE + 1_000_000, BASE + 1_037_500), [], 50)
		expect(h.size).toBe(10)
		expect(h.query(r(BASE, BASE + 125_000), T0, T0 + 2_000).buckets.map(b => (b.startHz - BASE) / BW)).toEqual([0, 1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9])
	})

	it("holds the bound even when one block spans more buckets than allowed", () => {
		const h = new OccupancyHistory({ maxBuckets: 10 })
		h.observe(T0, r(BASE, BASE + 1_000_000), [], 50)
		expect(h.size).toBe(10)
		expect(h.query(r(BASE, BASE + 1_000_000), T0, T0).buckets.map(b => (b.startHz - BASE) / BW)).toEqual([70, 71, 72, 73, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79])
	})
})

describe("OccupancyHistory persistence", () => {
	function busyHistory(): OccupancyHistory {
		const h = new OccupancyHistory({ maxBuckets: 50 })
		blocks(h, T0, 40, r(BASE, BASE + 100_000), i => (i % 3 === 0 ? [around(1), around(6)] : []))
		blocks(h, T0 + 5 * HOUR, 40, r(BASE + 50_000, BASE + 150_000), i => (i % 2 === 0 ? [around(9)] : []))
		return h
	}

	it("round-trips through exportState/importState, including the eviction order", () => {
		const h = busyHistory()
		const state = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(h.exportState())) as ReturnType<OccupancyHistory["exportState"]>
		const copy = new OccupancyHistory({ maxBuckets: 50 })
		expect(copy.importState(state)).toBe(true)
		expect(copy.exportState()).toEqual(h.exportState())
		expect(copy.query(r(BASE, BASE + 150_000), T0, T0 + 6 * HOUR)).toEqual(h.query(r(BASE, BASE + 150_000), T0, T0 + 6 * HOUR))
		expect(new OccupancyHistory({ bucketHz: 25_000 }).importState(state)).toBe(false)
	})

	it("persists per source next to the engine state without disturbing engine loading", async () => {
		await withDir(async dir => {
			const p = new ScannerPersistence({ dir, logger, now: () => T0 })
			const engine: EngineState = { version: 1, absoluteFloors: [], spurs: [], kByRange: [] }
			const state = busyHistory().exportState()
			await p.writeEngine("rtl/1", engine)
			await p.writeOccupancy("rtl/1", state)
			expect(await p.loadOccupancy("rtl/1")).toEqual(state)
			expect(await p.loadOccupancy("other")).toBeNull()
			expect(await p.loadEngine("rtl/1")).toEqual(engine)
			expect(await p.loadEngine("other")).toBeNull()
			const loaded = await p.load()
			expect(loaded.engines).toEqual({ "rtl/1": engine })
			await mkdir(join(dir, "engine", "occupancy"), { recursive: true })
			await writeFile(join(dir, "engine", "occupancy", "bad.json"), JSON.stringify({ version: 1, bucketHz: 12_500, buckets: [{ index: 1, lastHour: 5, observed: "AAAA", active: "AAAA" }] }))
			expect(await p.loadOccupancy("bad")).toBeNull()
		})
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 21: Occupancy bounds
	// Validates: spec § 4.11
	it("keeps duty in [0, 1], active ≤ observed and size ≤ maxBuckets for any observe sequence", () => {
		const opArb = fc.record({
			dtMs: fc.oneof(fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 * HOUR }), fc.integer({ min: -200 * HOUR, max: 0 })),
			start: fc.integer({ min: -100_000, max: 1_000_000 }),
			width: fc.integer({ min: -10_000, max: 200_000 }),
			active: fc.array(fc.record({ start: fc.integer({ min: -200_000, max: 1_300_000 }), width: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 100_000 }) }), { maxLength: 4 }),
			// whole and fractional block lengths, up to blocks that saturate an hour slot
			blockMs: fc.oneof(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 5_000 }), fc.double({ min: 0.1, max: 200, noNaN: true }), fc.constant(2_000_000)),
		})
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 50 }), fc.array(opArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 60 }), (maxBuckets, ops) => {
				const h = new OccupancyHistory({ maxBuckets })
				let at = T0
				for (const op of ops) {
					at = Math.max(0, at + op.dtMs)
					h.observe(at, r(BASE + op.start, BASE + op.start + op.width), op.active.map(a => r(BASE + a.start, BASE + a.start + a.width)), op.blockMs)
					expect(h.size).toBeLessThanOrEqual(maxBuckets)
				}
				const all = r(BASE - 1_000_000, BASE + 3_000_000)
				for (const b of h.query(all, 0, at).buckets) {
					expect(b.activeMs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(b.observedMs)
					for (const d of b.dutyByHour) if (d !== null) {
						expect(d).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
						expect(d).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1)
					}
				}
				for (const t of h.topActive(all, 100, 0, at)) {
					expect(t.duty).toBeGreaterThan(0)
					expect(t.duty).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1)
				}
				const seed = h.seedScore(all, at)
				expect(seed).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
				expect(seed).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1)
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})
})
```
