- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the history**

```ts
// src/core/spectrum/occupancy.ts
/**
 * Persistent occupancy history (main-session amendment to spec § 7/§ 8): per RF bucket, a 7-day
 * ring of hourly observed and active seconds (Uint16, 0–3600) plus a sub-second carry for the
 * current hour, fed by every integration block, so intermittent emitters are remembered even when
 * no observation surfaces as a discovery. Bounded by `maxBuckets` (least recently observed
 * evicted); exported as base64 little-endian Uint16 arrays.
 */
import { z } from "zod"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../utils/errors.js"
import type { Assert, FreqRange, SchemaMatches } from "./types.js"

export const DEFAULT_BUCKET_HZ = 12_500
export const DEFAULT_MAX_BUCKETS = 20_000
export const OCCUPANCY_HOURS = 168
const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000
const SLOT_MAX_S = 3_600
const SLOT_BYTES = OCCUPANCY_HOURS * 2
const SEED_WINDOW_MS = 24 * HOUR_MS
const SEED_MIN_OBSERVED_MS = 1_000

export interface OccupancyBucketView {
	startHz: number
	dutyByHour: (number | null)[]
	observedMs: number
	activeMs: number
}
export interface OccupancyQuery {
	bucketHz: number
	buckets: OccupancyBucketView[]
}
export interface OccupancyTop {
	startHz: number
	duty: number
	observedMs: number
	activeMs: number
}
export interface OccupancyState {
	version: 1
	bucketHz: number
	buckets: { index: number; lastHour: number; observed: string; active: string; carryObservedMs: number; carryActiveMs: number }[]
}

const SlotsSchema = z
	.string()
	.regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/)
	.refine(s => Buffer.from(s, "base64").length === SLOT_BYTES, `expected ${OCCUPANCY_HOURS} uint16 values`)
const CarrySchema = z.number().min(0).lt(1_000)
export const OccupancyStateSchema = z.object({
	version: z.literal(1),
	bucketHz: z.number().int().positive(),
	buckets: z.array(
		z.object({
			index: z.number().int(),
			lastHour: z.number().int(),
			observed: SlotsSchema,
			active: SlotsSchema,
			carryObservedMs: CarrySchema,
			carryActiveMs: CarrySchema,
		}),
	),
})
export type OccupancyStateCheck = Assert<SchemaMatches<OccupancyState, typeof OccupancyStateSchema>>

interface Bucket {
	lastHour: number
	observed: Uint16Array
	active: Uint16Array
	/** Sub-second remainders of the `lastHour` slot. */
	carryObservedMs: number
	carryActiveMs: number
}

const hourOf = (ms: number): number => Math.floor(ms / HOUR_MS)
const slotOf = (hour: number): number => ((hour % OCCUPANCY_HOURS) + OCCUPANCY_HOURS) % OCCUPANCY_HOURS

function encodeSlots(a: Uint16Array): string {
	const buf = Buffer.alloc(a.length * 2)
	for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) buf.writeUInt16LE(a[i] ?? 0, i * 2)
	return buf.toString("base64")
}

function decodeSlots(s: string): Uint16Array | null {
	const buf = Buffer.from(s, "base64")
	if (buf.length !== SLOT_BYTES) return null
	const out = new Uint16Array(OCCUPANCY_HOURS)
	for (let i = 0; i < OCCUPANCY_HOURS; i++) out[i] = Math.min(SLOT_MAX_S, buf.readUInt16LE(i * 2))
	return out
}

/** Hour window [from, to] clamped to the ring, or null when empty. */
function hourWindow(sinceMs: number, now: number): [number, number] | null {
	const to = hourOf(now)
	const from = Math.max(hourOf(sinceMs), to - OCCUPANCY_HOURS + 1)
	return from <= to ? [from, to] : null
}

/** Milliseconds of absolute hour `h`, or null when the ring no longer (or not yet) holds that hour. */
function readSlot(b: Bucket, h: number): { observed: number; active: number } | null {
	if (h > b.lastHour || h <= b.lastHour - OCCUPANCY_HOURS) return null
	const s = slotOf(h)
	let observed = (b.observed[s] ?? 0) * 1_000
	let active = (b.active[s] ?? 0) * 1_000
	if (h === b.lastHour) {
		observed += b.carryObservedMs
		active += b.carryActiveMs
	}
	observed = Math.min(HOUR_MS, observed)
	return { observed, active: Math.min(observed, active) }
}

function addSeconds(b: Bucket, slot: number, observedS: number, activeS: number): void {
	const observed = Math.min(SLOT_MAX_S, (b.observed[slot] ?? 0) + observedS)
	b.observed[slot] = observed
	b.active[slot] = Math.min(observed, (b.active[slot] ?? 0) + activeS)
}

/** Flushes the current slot's carries (rounded), zeroes the hours up to `hour`, and moves to it. */
function advance(b: Bucket, hour: number): void {
	if (hour <= b.lastHour) return
	addSeconds(b, slotOf(b.lastHour), Math.round(b.carryObservedMs / 1_000), Math.round(b.carryActiveMs / 1_000))
	b.carryObservedMs = 0
	b.carryActiveMs = 0
	const steps = Math.min(OCCUPANCY_HOURS, hour - b.lastHour)
	for (let k = 1; k <= steps; k++) {
		const s = slotOf(b.lastHour + k)
		b.observed[s] = 0
		b.active[s] = 0
	}
	b.lastHour = hour
}

/** Adds one block to `hour`: exact through the carry for the current hour, whole seconds for a late one. */
function addBlock(b: Bucket, hour: number, ms: number, isActive: boolean): void {
	const slot = slotOf(hour)
	if (hour !== b.lastHour) {
		const s = Math.round(ms / 1_000)
		addSeconds(b, slot, s, isActive ? s : 0)
		return
	}
	b.carryObservedMs += ms
	if (isActive) b.carryActiveMs += ms
	const observedS = Math.floor(b.carryObservedMs / 1_000)
	const activeS = Math.floor(b.carryActiveMs / 1_000)
	// clamp to [0, 1000): float remainders of fractional blocks must stay valid for the export schema
	b.carryObservedMs = Math.min(999.999, Math.max(0, b.carryObservedMs - observedS * 1_000))
	b.carryActiveMs = Math.min(999.999, Math.max(0, b.carryActiveMs - activeS * 1_000))
	addSeconds(b, slot, observedS, activeS)
}

function newBucket(hour: number): Bucket {
	return {
		lastHour: hour,
		observed: new Uint16Array(OCCUPANCY_HOURS),
		active: new Uint16Array(OCCUPANCY_HOURS),
		carryObservedMs: 0,
		carryActiveMs: 0,
	}
}

export class OccupancyHistory {
	readonly bucketHz: number
	private readonly maxBuckets: number
	/** Least recently observed first. */
	private readonly buckets = new Map<number, Bucket>()

	constructor(opts: { bucketHz?: number; maxBuckets?: number } = {}) {
		const bucketHz = opts.bucketHz ?? DEFAULT_BUCKET_HZ
		const maxBuckets = opts.maxBuckets ?? DEFAULT_MAX_BUCKETS
		if (!Number.isInteger(bucketHz) || bucketHz <= 0)
			throw new WaveKitError(`Invalid occupancy bucket width ${bucketHz}`, "SCANNER_INVALID_OCCUPANCY")
		if (!Number.isInteger(maxBuckets) || maxBuckets < 1)
			throw new WaveKitError(`Invalid occupancy bucket bound ${maxBuckets}`, "SCANNER_INVALID_OCCUPANCY")
		this.bucketHz = bucketHz
		this.maxBuckets = maxBuckets
	}

	get size(): number {
		return this.buckets.size
	}

	observe(at: number, usable: FreqRange, active: readonly FreqRange[], blockMs: number): void {
		if (!Number.isFinite(at) || !Number.isFinite(blockMs) || blockMs <= 0) return
		const span = this.indexSpan(usable)
		if (span === null) return
		const activeIdx = this.activeIndexes(usable, active)
		const hour = hourOf(at)
		for (let i = span[0]; i <= span[1]; i++) {
			const b = this.touch(i, hour)
			if (b !== null) addBlock(b, hour, blockMs, activeIdx.has(i))
		}
	}

	query(range: FreqRange, sinceMs: number, now: number): OccupancyQuery {
		const hours = hourWindow(sinceMs, now)
		const buckets: OccupancyBucketView[] = []
		if (hours !== null)
			for (const [index, b] of this.bucketsIn(range)) {
				const dutyByHour: (number | null)[] = []
				let observedMs = 0
				let activeMs = 0
				for (let h = hours[0]; h <= hours[1]; h++) {
					const s = readSlot(b, h)
					if (s === null || s.observed === 0) {
						dutyByHour.push(null)
						continue
					}
					dutyByHour.push(s.active / s.observed)
					observedMs += s.observed
					activeMs += s.active
				}
				if (observedMs > 0) buckets.push({ startHz: index * this.bucketHz, dutyByHour, observedMs, activeMs })
			}
		return { bucketHz: this.bucketHz, buckets }
	}

	topActive(range: FreqRange, n: number, sinceMs: number, now: number): OccupancyTop[] {
		const out = this.totals(range, sinceMs, now).filter(t => t.activeMs > 0)
		out.sort((a, b) => b.duty - a.duty || b.activeMs - a.activeMs || a.startHz - b.startHz)
		return out.slice(0, Math.max(0, Math.floor(n)))
	}

	seedScore(range: FreqRange, now: number): number {
		let best = 0
		for (const t of this.totals(range, now - SEED_WINDOW_MS, now))
			if (t.observedMs >= SEED_MIN_OBSERVED_MS && t.duty > best) best = t.duty
		return best
	}

	exportState(): OccupancyState {
		const buckets: OccupancyState["buckets"] = []
		for (const [index, b] of this.buckets)
			buckets.push({
				index,
				lastHour: b.lastHour,
				observed: encodeSlots(b.observed),
				active: encodeSlots(b.active),
				carryObservedMs: b.carryObservedMs,
				carryActiveMs: b.carryActiveMs,
			})
		return { version: 1, bucketHz: this.bucketHz, buckets }
	}

	importState(s: OccupancyState): boolean {
		if (s.bucketHz !== this.bucketHz) return false
		this.buckets.clear()
		for (const entry of s.buckets) {
			const observed = decodeSlots(entry.observed)
			const active = decodeSlots(entry.active)
			if (observed === null || active === null) continue
			for (let i = 0; i < OCCUPANCY_HOURS; i++) active[i] = Math.min(active[i] ?? 0, observed[i] ?? 0)
			this.buckets.delete(entry.index)
			this.buckets.set(entry.index, {
				lastHour: entry.lastHour,
				observed,
				active,
				carryObservedMs: entry.carryObservedMs,
				carryActiveMs: entry.carryActiveMs,
			})
		}
		this.evict()
		return true
	}

	// ── internals ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	/** Inclusive bucket index span touched by `range`, or null for an inverted range. */
	private indexSpan(range: FreqRange): [number, number] | null {
		const { startHz, endHz } = range
		if (!Number.isFinite(startHz) || !Number.isFinite(endHz) || endHz < startHz) return null
		const first = Math.floor(startHz / this.bucketHz)
		const last = endHz > startHz ? Math.ceil(endHz / this.bucketHz) - 1 : first
		return [first, Math.max(first, last)]
	}

	private activeIndexes(usable: FreqRange, active: readonly FreqRange[]): Set<number> {
		const out = new Set<number>()
		for (const a of active) {
			const clipped = { startHz: Math.max(a.startHz, usable.startHz), endHz: Math.min(a.endHz, usable.endHz) }
			const span = this.indexSpan(clipped)
			if (span === null) continue
			for (let i = span[0]; i <= span[1]; i++) out.add(i)
		}
		return out
	}

	/** The bucket advanced to `hour` (a late hour leaves it as is), moved to the most recently observed end; null if older than the ring. */
	private touch(index: number, hour: number): Bucket | null {
		let b = this.buckets.get(index)
		if (b !== undefined) {
			if (hour <= b.lastHour - OCCUPANCY_HOURS) return null
			advance(b, hour)
			this.buckets.delete(index)
		} else {
			b = newBucket(hour)
		}
		this.buckets.set(index, b)
		this.evict()
		return b
	}

	private evict(): void {
		while (this.buckets.size > this.maxBuckets) {
			const oldest = this.buckets.keys().next()
			if (oldest.done === true) return
			this.buckets.delete(oldest.value)
		}
	}

	private bucketsIn(range: FreqRange): [number, Bucket][] {
		const span = this.indexSpan(range)
		if (span === null) return []
		const out: [number, Bucket][] = []
		if (span[1] - span[0] + 1 <= this.buckets.size) {
			for (let i = span[0]; i <= span[1]; i++) {
				const b = this.buckets.get(i)
				if (b !== undefined) out.push([i, b])
			}
			return out
		}
		for (const [i, b] of this.buckets) if (i >= span[0] && i <= span[1]) out.push([i, b])
		return out.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])
	}

	private totals(range: FreqRange, sinceMs: number, now: number): OccupancyTop[] {
		const hours = hourWindow(sinceMs, now)
		if (hours === null) return []
		const out: OccupancyTop[] = []
		for (const [index, b] of this.bucketsIn(range)) {
			let observedMs = 0
			let activeMs = 0
			for (let h = hours[0]; h <= hours[1]; h++) {
				const s = readSlot(b, h)
				if (s === null) continue
				observedMs += s.observed
				activeMs += s.active
			}
			if (observedMs > 0) out.push({ startHz: index * this.bucketHz, duty: activeMs / observedMs, observedMs, activeMs })
		}
		return out
	}
}
```

```ts
	writeOccupancy(sourceId: string, s: OccupancyState): Promise<void> {
		const text = JSON.stringify(s)
		return this.enqueue(() => atomicWrite(this.occupancyFile(sourceId), text))
	}

	/** One source's occupancy history; null when missing or invalid. Does not need load(). */
	async loadOccupancy(sourceId: string): Promise<OccupancyState | null> {
		const file = this.occupancyFile(sourceId)
		const read = await readJson(file)
		if (read.kind === "missing") return null
		const parsed = read.kind === "ok" ? OccupancyStateSchema.safeParse(read.value) : null
		if (parsed === null || !parsed.success) {
			this.log.warn({ file, issues: parsed?.success === false ? parsed.error.issues : undefined }, "Ignoring an invalid occupancy history file")
			return null
		}
		return parsed.data
	}

	/** One source's engine state; null when missing or invalid. Does not need load(). */
	async loadEngine(sourceId: string): Promise<EngineState | null> {
		const file = join(this.root, ENGINE_DIR, `${encodeURIComponent(sourceId)}.json`)
		const read = await readJson(file)
		if (read.kind === "missing") return null
		const parsed = read.kind === "ok" ? EngineStateSchema.safeParse(read.value) : null
		if (parsed === null || !parsed.success) {
			this.log.warn({ file }, "Ignoring an invalid engine state file")
			return null
		}
		return parsed.data as EngineState
	}

	private occupancyFile(sourceId: string): string {
		return join(this.root, OCCUPANCY_DIR, `${encodeURIComponent(sourceId)}.json`)
	}
```

Output shapes verified against the decoders (read them again before coding):

- **dsd-fme** (`src/decoders/builtin/dsd-fme.ts`): `call_start` data `{callId, startedAt, encrypted, protocol: DsdFmeProtocol, talkgroup: number | null, source: number | null, slot, dmr, p25, nxdn, dstar, ysf}` (`checkPendingCallEmission`); `call_end` data adds `{endedAt, duration, quality, flags: {encrypted, timeout, badSignal, falsePositiveSuppressed}, wavFile}` (`endCall`); `findWavFileAsync` re-emits `call_end` with `flags.wavFileUpdate: true` (a duplicate, ignored here). Suppressed false positives are never emitted by `endCall` today; the interpreter still ignores `flags.falsePositiveSuppressed` (§ 6.6). `DsdFmeProtocol` = `dmr | p25p1 | p25p2 | ysf | dstar | nxdn48 | nxdn96 | provoice | null`. `link` lines (C4, Task 28) say only `nxdn`/`p25`, so the state carries which NXDN the probe's mode decodes, and P25 identities live under the `p25p1` key for both phases.
- **multimon-ng** (`multimon-ng.ts` `parsePocsagOutput`/`parseFlexOutput`): `type: "message"`, POCSAG `{protocol: "POCSAG512|1200|2400", address: number, function: number, messageType: "alpha" | "numeric" | "tone only", message}`; FLEX `{protocol: "FLEX", mode, frequency, capcode: string, messageType: "ALN" | "NUM" | …, message}`. multimon-ng renders control characters as `<NUL>`, `<ETX>` …; those count as non-printable (`<CR>`, `<LF>`, `<HT>` as printable).
- **direwolf** (`direwolf.ts` `handleNetworkData`): `type: "aprs"`, data `APRSData` with `source` callsign (direwolf only emits frames whose FCS checks).
- **rtl_433** (`rtl433.ts` `parseOutput`): `type: "signal"`, data = the JSON object (`model`, `id`, and `mic` when the decoder verified a checksum/CRC/parity).

Rules implemented (spec § 6.4/§ 6.6/H2):

- `DoubleMatch.accept(key, value, crcClean)` counts **CRC-clean** occurrences per `(key, value)` and returns `true` exactly once, on the second; CRC-error lines never count. `markAccepted` / `isAccepted` let single-shot rules (plausible pager payload, APRS frame) share the same acceptance memory. At most 256 counted values per key (LRU) and 4096 accepted values.
- dsd-fme: identity (`dmr-cc`/`dpmr-cc` from CC, `p25-nac`, `nxdn-ran`, `ysf-dgid`, `dstar-call`), TG, SRC, slot, non-D-STAR callsign and `encrypted` are each accepted on their second CRC-clean line. A line yields one `DecodeEvidence` when at least one value on it became accepted or is a clean repeat of an already-accepted value (the evidence lists only those values); the evidence carries the latest accepted identity. Call events yield evidence (with `callId`) only once an identity is accepted, and carry only already-accepted TG/SRC/encrypted values.
- multimon-ng: capcode accepted on the second decode with the same capcode, or immediately when the payload is plausible: POCSAG function bits 0–3 and type `alpha`/`numeric`; FLEX type `ALN`/`NUM`; and the payload has ≥ 4 characters with printable ratio ≥ 0.9. Spec gap resolved: § 6.4 gives no minimum length; 4 is chosen because a 1–3 character noise decode is printable by chance with probability ≈ 0.4–0.75. Identity kind `pocsag-capcode` for both POCSAG and FLEX (the C1 vocabulary has no FLEX kind).
- direwolf: each new source callsign is accepted on its first frame.
- rtl_433: `model:id` accepted on its second decode that carries a non-empty `mic`.
- **Repeat evidence:** the double-match gate applies to first acceptance only. After that, every later clean occurrence of an accepted value (clean link line, multimon decode, APRS frame, `mic`-carrying rtl_433 decode) yields `DecodeEvidence` again. Task 34's ambient listener keeps one interpreter state per configured decoder for the whole epoch, so a one-shot rule would confirm each emitter once per process and never refresh `lastConfirm`/metadata (spec § 6.4: CRC-valid ambient output inside an observation's span is DecodeEvidence). CRC-error lines never yield evidence.

```ts
	// Validates: spec § 6.4, § 6.6

		const decodeArb = fc.record({
			cap: fc.constantFrom(1234567, 7654321, 1111111),
			plausible: fc.boolean(),
			fn: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }),
			good: fc.constantFrom("CALL OFFICE NOW", "TEST 1234", "Ambulance to bay 3"),
			bad: fc.constantFrom("<NUL><ETX><SOH>a<DEL>", "", "ab", "<STX><ETB><SYN><CAN>z"),
		})
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.array(decodeArb, { maxLength: 30 }), decodes => {
				const s = createInterpreterState({ epoch: 1, origin: "probe" })
				const emitted = new Map<string, number[]>()
				decodes.forEach((d, i) => {
					const ev = interpretMultimon(pocsag(d.cap, d.plausible ? d.good : d.bad, d.fn), s)
					expect(ev.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1)
					for (const e of ev) {
						const v = e.identity?.value ?? ""
						expect(v).toBe(String(d.cap))
						emitted.set(v, [...(emitted.get(v) ?? []), i])
					}
				})
				for (const cap of [1234567, 7654321, 1111111]) {
					const idx = decodes.flatMap((d, i) => (d.cap === cap ? [i] : []))
					const firstPlausible = decodes.findIndex(d => d.cap === cap && d.plausible)
					const candidates = [firstPlausible >= 0 ? firstPlausible : Infinity, idx[1] ?? Infinity]
					const expected = Math.min(...candidates)
					// first emitted at the acceptance index, then on every later decode of the capcode
					if (expected === Infinity) expect(emitted.has(String(cap))).toBe(false)
					else expect(emitted.get(String(cap))).toEqual(idx.filter(i => i >= expected))
				}
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})
})
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/probes/confirm/double-match.ts
/**
 * Acceptance memory shared by the confirm interpreters (spec H2, § 6.6): a value is accepted on its
 * second CRC-clean occurrence; single-shot rules mark values accepted directly.
 */
import type { DecodeEvidence } from "../../types.js"

/** Structural subset of DecoderOutput (src/decoders/types.ts). */
export interface DecoderOutputLike {
	type: string
	data: unknown
	timestamp: Date
}

const MAX_VALUES_PER_KEY = 256
const MAX_ACCEPTED = 4096

export class DoubleMatch {
	private readonly counts = new Map<string, Map<string, number>>()
	private readonly accepted = new Set<string>()

	/** True exactly once: on the second CRC-clean occurrence of `value` under `key`. */
	accept(key: string, value: string, crcClean: boolean): boolean {
		if (!crcClean || this.isAccepted(key, value)) return false
		let values = this.counts.get(key)
		if (values === undefined) {
			values = new Map()
			this.counts.set(key, values)
		}
		const seen = (values.get(value) ?? 0) + 1
		values.delete(value)
		if (seen >= 2) {
			this.markAccepted(key, value)
			return true
		}
		values.set(value, seen)
		if (values.size > MAX_VALUES_PER_KEY) {
			const oldest = values.keys().next()
			if (oldest.done !== true) values.delete(oldest.value)
		}
		return false
	}

	isAccepted(key: string, value: string): boolean {
		return this.accepted.has(`${key}\u0000${value}`)
	}

	markAccepted(key: string, value: string): void {
		const id = `${key}\u0000${value}`
		if (this.accepted.has(id)) return
		this.accepted.add(id)
		if (this.accepted.size > MAX_ACCEPTED) {
			const oldest = this.accepted.values().next()
			if (oldest.done !== true) this.accepted.delete(oldest.value)
		}
	}
}

export interface InterpreterState {
	epoch: number
	origin: "probe" | "ambient"
	probeId?: string
	decoderId?: string
	nxdn: "nxdn48" | "nxdn96"
	match: DoubleMatch
	accepted: Map<string, string>
}

export function createInterpreterState(opts: {
	epoch: number
	origin: "probe" | "ambient"
	probeId?: string
	decoderId?: string
	nxdn?: "nxdn48" | "nxdn96"
}): InterpreterState {
	const state: InterpreterState = {
		epoch: opts.epoch,
		origin: opts.origin,
		nxdn: opts.nxdn ?? "nxdn96",
		match: new DoubleMatch(),
		accepted: new Map(),
	}
	if (opts.probeId !== undefined) state.probeId = opts.probeId
	if (opts.decoderId !== undefined) state.decoderId = opts.decoderId
	return state
}

/** Fields every accepted evidence shares. */
export function evidenceBase(
	state: InterpreterState,
	at: number,
): Pick<DecodeEvidence, "crcClean" | "at" | "epoch" | "origin" | "probeId" | "decoderId"> {
	const base: Pick<DecodeEvidence, "crcClean" | "at" | "epoch" | "origin" | "probeId" | "decoderId"> = {
		crcClean: true,
		at,
		epoch: state.epoch,
		origin: state.origin,
	}
	if (state.probeId !== undefined) base.probeId = state.probeId
	if (state.decoderId !== undefined) base.decoderId = state.decoderId
	return base
}
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/probes/confirm/dsd-fme.ts
/**
 * dsd-fme confirm interpreter (spec § 6.4, § 6.6, H2): `link` lines drive acceptance (second
 * CRC-clean line with the same value); call events add the call id once an identity is accepted.
 */
import { z } from "zod"
import type { DsdFmeLinkLine } from "../../../../decoders/builtin/dsd-fme-link.js"
import type { DecodeEvidence, DiscoveryMetadataInput, IdentityKind, ScannerProtocol } from "../../types.js"
import { evidenceBase } from "./double-match.js"
import type { DecoderOutputLike, InterpreterState } from "./double-match.js"

const CallDataSchema = z
	.object({
		callId: z.string().min(1),
		protocol: z.enum(["dmr", "p25p1", "p25p2", "ysf", "dstar", "nxdn48", "nxdn96", "provoice"]).nullable(),
		talkgroup: z.number().nullable().optional(),
		source: z.number().nullable().optional(),
		slot: z.number().optional(),
		encrypted: z.boolean().optional(),
		startedAt: z.string().optional(),
		endedAt: z.string().optional(),
		duration: z.number().optional(),
		wavFile: z.string().optional(),
		flags: z
			.object({
				encrypted: z.boolean().optional(),
				falsePositiveSuppressed: z.boolean().optional(),
				wavFileUpdate: z.boolean().optional(),
			})
			.passthrough()
			.optional(),
	})
	.passthrough()

export type DsdFmeCallData = z.infer<typeof CallDataSchema>
export type DsdFmeScannerEvent =
	| { kind: "link"; line: DsdFmeLinkLine }
	| { kind: "call_start" | "call_end"; at: number; call: DsdFmeCallData }

const IDENTITY_KIND: Partial<Record<ScannerProtocol, IdentityKind>> = {
	dmr: "dmr-cc",
	p25p1: "p25-nac",
	nxdn48: "nxdn-ran",
	nxdn96: "nxdn-ran",
	ysf: "ysf-dgid",
	dstar: "dstar-call",
	dpmr: "dpmr-cc",
}

export function toDsdFmeScannerEvent(out: DecoderOutputLike): DsdFmeScannerEvent | null {
	if (out.type !== "call_start" && out.type !== "call_end") return null
	const parsed = CallDataSchema.safeParse(out.data)
	if (!parsed.success) return null
	return { kind: out.type, at: out.timestamp.getTime(), call: parsed.data }
}

function linkProtocol(p: DsdFmeLinkLine["protocol"], state: InterpreterState): ScannerProtocol {
	switch (p) {
		case "dmr":
			return "dmr"
		case "p25":
			return "p25p1"
		case "nxdn":
			return state.nxdn
		case "ysf":
			return "ysf"
		case "dstar":
			return "dstar"
		case "dpmr":
			return "dpmr"
	}
}

function identityValue(line: DsdFmeLinkLine): string | undefined {
	switch (line.protocol) {
		case "dmr":
		case "dpmr":
			return line.cc !== undefined ? String(line.cc) : undefined
		case "p25":
			return line.nac !== undefined && line.nac.trim() !== "" ? line.nac.trim().toUpperCase() : undefined
		case "nxdn":
			return line.ran !== undefined ? String(line.ran) : undefined
		case "ysf":
			return line.dgid !== undefined ? String(line.dgid) : undefined
		case "dstar": {
			const call = line.callsign?.trim().toUpperCase()
			return call !== undefined && call !== "" ? call : undefined
		}
	}
}

/** Identity key protocol for a call event (P25 phase 2 and both NXDN share the link-line key). */
function keyProtocol(p: DsdFmeCallData["protocol"], state: InterpreterState): ScannerProtocol | null {
	switch (p) {
		case "dmr":
		case "ysf":
		case "dstar":
			return p
		case "p25p1":
		case "p25p2":
			return "p25p1"
		case "nxdn48":
		case "nxdn96":
			return state.nxdn
		default:
			return null
	}
}

function build(
	protocol: ScannerProtocol,
	state: InterpreterState,
	at: number,
	metadata: Partial<DiscoveryMetadataInput>,
	encrypted: boolean,
	idProtocol: ScannerProtocol = protocol,
): DecodeEvidence {
	const ev: DecodeEvidence = { ...evidenceBase(state, at), protocol, metadata }
	const value = state.accepted.get(`${idProtocol}:id`)
	const kind = IDENTITY_KIND[idProtocol]
	if (value !== undefined && kind !== undefined) ev.identity = { kind, value }
	if (encrypted) ev.encrypted = true
	return ev
}

function interpretLink(line: DsdFmeLinkLine, state: InterpreterState): DecodeEvidence[] {
	const protocol = linkProtocol(line.protocol, state)
	const clean = !line.crcErr
	const m = state.match
	const metadata: Partial<DiscoveryMetadataInput> = {}
	let hits = false
	let encrypted = false
	/** A clean line confirms a value already accepted, or accepts it on its second clean occurrence (H2). */
	const hit = (key: string, value: string): boolean => {
		const yes = (clean && m.isAccepted(key, value)) || m.accept(key, value, clean)
		if (yes) hits = true
		return yes
	}
	const id = identityValue(line)
	if (id !== undefined && hit(`${protocol}:id`, id)) {
		state.accepted.set(`${protocol}:id`, id)
		if (line.protocol === "dstar") metadata.callsigns = [id]
	}
	if (line.tg !== undefined && hit(`${protocol}:tg`, line.tg)) metadata.talkgroups = [line.tg]
	if (line.src !== undefined && hit(`${protocol}:src`, line.src)) metadata.sources = [line.src]
	if (line.slot !== undefined && hit(`${protocol}:slot`, String(line.slot))) metadata.slots = [line.slot]
	if (line.protocol !== "dstar" && line.callsign !== undefined) {
		const call = line.callsign.trim().toUpperCase()
		if (call !== "" && hit(`${protocol}:call`, call)) metadata.callsigns = [call]
	}
	if (line.encrypted === true && hit(`${protocol}:enc`, "1")) encrypted = true
	return hits ? [build(protocol, state, line.at, metadata, encrypted)] : []
}

function interpretCall(ev: Extract<DsdFmeScannerEvent, { kind: "call_start" | "call_end" }>, state: InterpreterState): DecodeEvidence[] {
	const c = ev.call
	if (c.flags?.falsePositiveSuppressed === true || c.flags?.wavFileUpdate === true) return []
	const key = keyProtocol(c.protocol, state)
	if (key === null || c.protocol === null || c.protocol === "provoice") return []
	if (!state.accepted.has(`${key}:id`)) return []
	const metadata: Partial<DiscoveryMetadataInput> = {}
	const tg = c.talkgroup !== null && c.talkgroup !== undefined ? String(c.talkgroup) : undefined
	const src = c.source !== null && c.source !== undefined ? String(c.source) : undefined
	if (tg !== undefined && state.match.isAccepted(`${key}:tg`, tg)) metadata.talkgroups = [tg]
	if (src !== undefined && state.match.isAccepted(`${key}:src`, src)) metadata.sources = [src]
	const claimsEncrypted = c.encrypted === true || c.flags?.encrypted === true
	const encrypted = claimsEncrypted && state.match.isAccepted(`${key}:enc`, "1")
	const protocol: ScannerProtocol = c.protocol === "nxdn48" || c.protocol === "nxdn96" ? state.nxdn : c.protocol
	return [{ ...build(protocol, state, ev.at, metadata, encrypted, key), callId: c.callId }]
}

export function interpretDsdFme(ev: DsdFmeScannerEvent, state: InterpreterState): DecodeEvidence[] {
	return ev.kind === "link" ? interpretLink(ev.line, state) : interpretCall(ev, state)
}
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/probes/confirm/multimon.ts
/**
 * multimon-ng confirm interpreter (spec § 6.4): a POCSAG/FLEX capcode is accepted on two decodes
 * with the same capcode, or on one decode whose payload is plausible.
 */
import { z } from "zod"
import type { DecodeEvidence } from "../../types.js"
import { evidenceBase } from "./double-match.js"
import type { DecoderOutputLike, InterpreterState } from "./double-match.js"

const PagerSchema = z
	.object({
		protocol: z.string(),
		address: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
		capcode: z.string().optional(),
		function: z.number().int().optional(),
		messageType: z.string().optional(),
		message: z.string().optional(),
	})
	.passthrough()

const MIN_PAYLOAD_CHARS = 4
const MIN_PRINTABLE_RATIO = 0.9
/** multimon-ng prints control characters as their ASCII names in angle brackets. */
const CONTROL_TOKEN = /<(NUL|SOH|STX|ETX|EOT|ENQ|ACK|BEL|BS|HT|LF|VT|FF|CR|SO|SI|DLE|DC1|DC2|DC3|DC4|NAK|SYN|ETB|CAN|EM|SUB|ESC|FS|GS|RS|US|DEL)>/g
const TEXT_CONTROLS = new Set(["CR", "LF", "HT"])

function payloadPlausible(message: string): boolean {
	let controls = 0
	let textControls = 0
	const stripped = message.replace(CONTROL_TOKEN, (_token, name: string) => {
		if (TEXT_CONTROLS.has(name)) textControls++
		else controls++
		return ""
	})
	let printable = textControls
	let chars = 0
	for (const ch of stripped) {
		chars++
		const code = ch.codePointAt(0) ?? 0
		if (code >= 0x20 && code <= 0x7e) printable++
	}
	const total = chars + controls + textControls
	return total >= MIN_PAYLOAD_CHARS && printable / total >= MIN_PRINTABLE_RATIO
}

export function interpretMultimon(out: DecoderOutputLike, state: InterpreterState): DecodeEvidence[] {
	if (out.type !== "message") return []
	const parsed = PagerSchema.safeParse(out.data)
	if (!parsed.success) return []
	const d = parsed.data
	let protocol: "pocsag" | "flex"
	let capcode: string | undefined
	let plausible: boolean
	if (/^POCSAG\d+$/i.test(d.protocol)) {
		protocol = "pocsag"
		capcode = d.address !== undefined ? String(d.address) : undefined
		const fn = d.function
		const type = d.messageType?.toLowerCase()
		plausible = fn !== undefined && fn >= 0 && fn <= 3 && (type === "alpha" || type === "numeric") && payloadPlausible(d.message ?? "")
	} else if (d.protocol.toUpperCase() === "FLEX") {
		protocol = "flex"
		const raw = d.capcode?.trim()
		capcode = raw !== undefined && raw !== "" ? raw : undefined
		const type = d.messageType?.toUpperCase()
		plausible = (type === "ALN" || type === "NUM") && payloadPlausible(d.message ?? "")
	} else return []
	if (capcode === undefined) return []
	const key = `${protocol}:cap`
	// once accepted, every later decode of the capcode is evidence again (ambient refreshes lastConfirm)
	if (!state.match.isAccepted(key, capcode)) {
		if (plausible) state.match.markAccepted(key, capcode)
		else if (!state.match.accept(key, capcode, true)) return []
	}
	return [
		{
			...evidenceBase(state, out.timestamp.getTime()),
			protocol,
			identity: { kind: "pocsag-capcode", value: capcode },
			metadata: { capcodes: [capcode] },
		},
	]
}
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/probes/confirm/direwolf.ts
/** direwolf confirm interpreter (spec § 6.4): direwolf emits only FCS-valid frames; one frame confirms. */
import { z } from "zod"
import type { DecodeEvidence } from "../../types.js"
import { evidenceBase } from "./double-match.js"
import type { DecoderOutputLike, InterpreterState } from "./double-match.js"

const FrameSchema = z.object({ source: z.string() }).passthrough()

export function interpretDirewolf(out: DecoderOutputLike, state: InterpreterState): DecodeEvidence[] {
	if (out.type !== "aprs") return []
	const parsed = FrameSchema.safeParse(out.data)
	if (!parsed.success) return []
	const call = parsed.data.source.trim().toUpperCase()
	if (call === "") return []
	// every FCS-valid frame is evidence; the first one accepts the callsign
	state.match.markAccepted("aprs:call", call)
	return [
		{
			...evidenceBase(state, out.timestamp.getTime()),
			protocol: "aprs",
			identity: { kind: "aprs-call", value: call },
			metadata: { callsigns: [call] },
		},
	]
}
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/probes/confirm/rtl433.ts
/** rtl_433 confirm interpreter (spec § 6.4): model + id with a checksum/MIC field, seen twice. */
import { z } from "zod"
import type { DecodeEvidence } from "../../types.js"
import { evidenceBase } from "./double-match.js"
import type { DecoderOutputLike, InterpreterState } from "./double-match.js"

const DeviceSchema = z
	.object({
		model: z.string().min(1),
		id: z.union([z.number(), z.string().min(1)]),
		mic: z.string().min(1),
	})
	.passthrough()

export function interpretRtl433(out: DecoderOutputLike, state: InterpreterState): DecodeEvidence[] {
	if (out.type !== "signal") return []
	const parsed = DeviceSchema.safeParse(out.data)
	if (!parsed.success) return []
	const value = `${parsed.data.model}:${String(parsed.data.id)}`
	// accepted on the second checksummed decode; every later checksummed decode is evidence again
	if (!state.match.isAccepted("ism:device", value) && !state.match.accept("ism:device", value, true)) return []
	return [
		{
			...evidenceBase(state, out.timestamp.getTime()),
			protocol: "ism",
			identity: { kind: "ism-model", value },
			metadata: { ismModels: [parsed.data.model] },
		},
	]
}
```

### Task 19: Sweep scheduler (sample-based dwell, holds, revisits, gain memory, re-plan, progress)

**Spec:** § 10.2, § 10.5 (coverage), § 12.1 (PATCH applies at the next hop boundary, current hop re-indexed by centre), § 13 P9 (index bounds; P16 is tested in Task 35). **Depends on:** Tasks 1, 16 (`tests/mocks/scanner/job-spec.ts`). **Batch:** S1-A

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/scanner/scheduler.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/scheduler.test.ts`

Behaviour (the job runner feeds pipeline events and clock ticks; the scheduler only returns actions):

- **Visit = tune → epoch → dwell → (hold) → leave.** `start()` tunes hop 0. `onEpochStarted(startSample)` opens the dwell: `dwellEnd = startSample + max((minSurfaceBlocks + 1) × blockSamples, round((dwellMs − settleMs) × fs / 1000))` (the operator's `dwellMs` includes settle; markers make settle a sample position, so only the remainder is dwell). Each `onStale(blocks)` (the pipeline emits one `stale-discard` per discarded block) adds `blocks × blockSamples`. Blocks and tracks before the epoch started are ignored.
- **Restart on a new own epoch:** an `onEpochStarted` in `dwell` or `hold` means the hop was re-sent (Task 20 `resend-hop` on `source-up`, `preemptor-idle`, `resume`; Task 35 `resendHop`). The public `restartVisit(startSample: number): SchedulerAction[]` (which `onEpochStarted` delegates to) restarts the visit: `dwellEnd = startSample + dwellSamples()`, the visit's tracks are cleared, a hold ends with `[stop-probes]`, phase → `dwell`. Without it a new stream (sample indices restart at 0) would sit on the hop until it reached the old absolute `dwellEnd`, and a resumed stream (already past `dwellEnd`) would decide on the first block with tracks of the old epoch. No-op while idle.
- **Decide at `dwellEnd`:** no open track that needs confirmation (truncated and IQ-image tracks never do; both flags are sticky and may first appear on a later update, which clears the track's `needsConfirm` for good, and a held track that flips ends its probe like a timeout: next queued track or leave) or `hold.policy = never` → leave. Otherwise start a probe for the highest-SNR such track (`holdMs = confirmHoldMs + probeStartMs`, bounded by what is left of `maxHoldMs` since the hold began).
- **Hold:** `onConfirmed(trackId, follow)`: with `follow` and policy `hold` and the track still open → follow until `onTrackClosed` + `hangMs` or `maxHoldMs`; otherwise the next queued track (open, needs confirmation, not yet tried) gets a probe, else leave. `tick(now)` ends a confirm that timed out (same next-track rule), a hang, or the whole hold at `maxHoldMs`. Leaving a hold always emits `stop-probes` first.
- **Leave:** update the hop's `activityScore` (time-based EWMA of the fraction of dwell/hold blocks with an open track, half-life 10 min; first visit sets it), `lastVisit`, and gain memory; apply a pending re-plan; advance the coarse index (ascending, wrapping with `sweep-complete`); then maybe insert one revisit: a hop overdue by `maxIntervalMs` (never two forced revisits in a row), else after every `round(1/share)` coarse hops the visited hop (≠ the next coarse hop) with the highest `activityScore × (boost ? 2 : 1) × (now − lastVisit)` if that is > 0.
- **Gain memory** (`tuner.overload = "reduce-gain"` and a manual job gain): an overloaded visit lowers that hop's gain by 6 dB (60 tenths, floor 0); three consecutive clean visits raise it 6 dB toward the job gain. The `tune` action carries the hop gain (sent inside the same marker pair by the arbiter).
- **Re-plan:** applied at the next hop boundary: per-hop state and the visited set map to the new hop with the nearest centre (within the new half span), and the coarse position is re-indexed to the new hop nearest the current coarse hop's centre. `hopIndex` stays in `[0, hopCount)` throughout.
- **Progress:** `coverage` = fraction of hops whose dwell completed in the last completed sweep (during the first sweep: so far in this sweep); `sweepPeriodMs` = EWMA (α 0.3) of completed sweep durations.

```ts
// tests/unit/core/scanner/scheduler.test.ts
import fc from "fast-check"
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { SweepScheduler } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/scheduler.js"
import type { SchedulerAction } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/scheduler.js"
import type { HopPlan, NormalisedJobSpec } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/types.js"
import type { TrackSnapshot } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"
import { makeHopPlan, makeNormalisedSpec } from "../../../mocks/scanner/job-spec.js"
import { makeTrack } from "../../../mocks/scanner/observations.js"

const FS = 2_048_000
const B = 102_400 // 50 ms blocks
const MHZ = 1_000_000

function harness(plan: HopPlan, spec: NormalisedJobSpec, probeStartMs = 300) {
	const h = {
		clock: 0,
		sample: 0,
		s: null as unknown as SweepScheduler,
		/** Settles the current epoch (unless the caller already did) and runs blocks until an action list is returned. */
		dwell(blocks = 3, newEpoch = true): SchedulerAction[] {
			if (newEpoch) h.s.onEpochStarted(h.sample)
			let actions: SchedulerAction[] = []
			for (let i = 0; i < blocks && actions.length === 0; i++) {
				h.sample += B
				actions = h.s.onBlock(h.sample)
			}
			return actions
		},
	}
	h.s = new SweepScheduler(plan, spec, { blockSamples: B, sampleRateHz: FS, now: () => h.clock, probeStartMs })
	return h
}

const track = (id: string, snrDb = 20, truncated = false): TrackSnapshot =>
	({ ...makeTrack({ id, centreHz: 400 * MHZ, startedAt: 0, snrDb, truncated }), trackId: id })
const tune = (hopIndex: number, centreHz: number, gainTenthsDb: number | null = 496): SchedulerAction => ({ type: "tune", hopIndex, centreHz, gainTenthsDb })
const noRevisit = { share: 0, maxIntervalMs: null }

describe("SweepScheduler dwell", () => {
	it("dwells (minSurfaceBlocks + 1) blocks in samples from the settled epoch start", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ, 403.2 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		expect(h.s.start()).toEqual([tune(0, 400 * MHZ)])
		expect(h.s.onBlock(5 * B)).toEqual([]) // before the epoch started: ignored
		h.s.onEpochStarted(10_000)
		expect(h.s.onBlock(10_000 + 2 * B)).toEqual([])
		expect(h.s.onBlock(10_000 + 3 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
	})

	it("extends the dwell by every stale block and honours a longer operator dwell", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		h.s.start()
		h.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		h.s.onStale(1)
		expect(h.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([])
		expect(h.s.onBlock(4 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])

		const long = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit, dwellMs: 335, settleMs: 35 }))
		long.s.start()
		long.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		expect(long.s.onBlock(5 * B)).toEqual([])
		expect(long.s.onBlock(6 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
	})

	it("restarts the dwell when a new epoch starts at sample 0 mid-dwell (source down and up)", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		h.s.start()
		h.s.onEpochStarted(1_000_000)
		h.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		expect(h.s.onBlock(1_000_000 + B)).toEqual([])
		// the new stream counts from 0; the old dwellEnd (1_000_000 + 3 B) would hold this hop for minutes
		expect(h.s.onEpochStarted(0)).toEqual([])
		expect(h.s.onBlock(B)).toEqual([])
		expect(h.s.onBlock(2 * B)).toEqual([])
		// t1 belonged to the old epoch: no probe, just the next hop
		expect(h.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
	})

	it("restarts the dwell on resume after the old dwellEnd has passed (restartVisit)", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		h.s.start()
		h.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		h.s.onBlock(B)
		// paused: no blocks fed while the stream runs on to 50 B; resume re-sends the hop
		expect(h.s.restartVisit(50 * B)).toEqual([])
		expect(h.s.onBlock(51 * B)).toEqual([]) // the old dwellEnd (3 B) would decide here
		expect(h.s.onBlock(52 * B)).toEqual([])
		expect(h.s.onBlock(53 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
		// idle schedulers ignore it
		const idle = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		expect(idle.s.restartVisit(0)).toEqual([])
		expect(idle.s.progress().hopIndex).toBe(0)
	})

	it("reports sweep completion, coverage and the sweep period", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ, 403.2 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		h.s.start()
		h.dwell()
		expect(h.s.progress().coverage).toBeCloseTo(1 / 3)
		h.clock = 500
		h.dwell()
		h.clock = 900
		expect(h.dwell()).toEqual([{ type: "sweep-complete", sweepIndex: 0 }, tune(0, 400 * MHZ)])
		expect(h.s.progress()).toEqual({ sweepIndex: 1, hopIndex: 0, hopCount: 3, sweepPeriodMs: 900, holdingOn: null, coverage: 1 })
	})
})

describe("SweepScheduler holds", () => {
	it("holds for confirmHoldMs + probe start latency, then moves on", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		h.s.start()
		h.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		h.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		h.sample = 2 * B
		h.s.onBlock(h.sample)
		expect(h.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([{ type: "start-probe", trackId: "t1", holdMs: 2_100 }])
		expect(h.s.progress().holdingOn).toBe("t1")
		h.clock = 2_099
		expect(h.s.tick(h.clock)).toEqual([])
		h.clock = 2_100
		expect(h.s.tick(h.clock)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }, tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
	})

	it("never probes with policy never or for truncated tracks", () => {
		const never = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit, hold: { policy: "never", confirmHoldMs: {}, maxHoldMs: 60_000, hangMs: 2_000 } }))
		never.s.start()
		never.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		never.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		never.s.onBlock(B)
		never.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		expect(never.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])

		const cut = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		cut.s.start()
		cut.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		cut.s.onTrack(track("t1", 30, true), true, 1_800)
		cut.s.onBlock(B)
		cut.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		expect(cut.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
	})

	it("drops a track that becomes truncated, an IQ image or a spur after a clean first snapshot", () => {
		const imageOf = (t: TrackSnapshot): TrackSnapshot => ({ ...t, flags: { ...t.flags, iqImage: true } })
		const spurOf = (t: TrackSnapshot): TrackSnapshot => ({ ...t, flags: { ...t.flags, spur: true } })
		const queued = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		queued.s.start()
		queued.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		queued.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		queued.s.onTrack(track("t1", 20, true), true, 1_800) // later update: truncated (sticky from here on)
		queued.s.onBlock(B)
		queued.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		expect(queued.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])

		const held = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		held.s.start()
		held.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		held.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		held.s.onTrack(track("t2", 10), true, 1_000)
		held.s.onBlock(B)
		held.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		expect(held.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([{ type: "start-probe", trackId: "t1", holdMs: 2_100 }])
		// the held track flips to an image: its probe stops and the next queued track gets one
		expect(held.s.onTrack(imageOf(track("t1")), true, 1_800)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }, { type: "start-probe", trackId: "t2", holdMs: 1_300 }])
		expect(held.s.onTrack(imageOf(track("t2", 10)), true, 1_000)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }, tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])

		// a comb tooth promoted to a spur (Task 7a's late sticky flag): never probed when queued, cut when held
		const spurQueued = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		spurQueued.s.start()
		spurQueued.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		spurQueued.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		spurQueued.s.onTrack(spurOf(track("t1")), true, 1_800)
		spurQueued.s.onBlock(B)
		spurQueued.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		expect(spurQueued.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])

		const spurHeld = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		spurHeld.s.start()
		spurHeld.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		spurHeld.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		spurHeld.s.onTrack(track("t2", 10), true, 1_000)
		spurHeld.s.onBlock(B)
		spurHeld.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		expect(spurHeld.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([{ type: "start-probe", trackId: "t1", holdMs: 2_100 }])
		expect(spurHeld.s.onTrack(spurOf(track("t1")), true, 1_800)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }, { type: "start-probe", trackId: "t2", holdMs: 1_300 }])
	})

	it("ends a hold with stop-probes when the hop is re-sent and dwells again", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		h.s.start()
		h.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		h.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		h.s.onBlock(B)
		h.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		expect(h.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([{ type: "start-probe", trackId: "t1", holdMs: 2_100 }])
		expect(h.s.onEpochStarted(10 * B)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }])
		expect(h.s.progress().holdingOn).toBeNull()
		expect(h.s.onBlock(12 * B)).toEqual([])
		expect(h.s.onBlock(13 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
	})

	it("follows a confirmed call until it closes plus hangMs (policy hold)", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		h.s.start()
		h.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		h.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		h.s.onBlock(B)
		h.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		h.s.onBlock(3 * B)
		h.clock = 500
		expect(h.s.onConfirmed("t1", true)).toEqual([])
		h.clock = 5_000
		expect(h.s.tick(h.clock)).toEqual([])
		h.clock = 8_000
		expect(h.s.onTrackClosed("t1")).toEqual([])
		h.clock = 9_999
		expect(h.s.tick(h.clock)).toEqual([])
		h.clock = 10_000
		expect(h.s.tick(h.clock)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }, tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
	})

	it("moves on right after a confirm with policy confirm, and caps any hold at maxHoldMs", () => {
		const confirm = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit, hold: { policy: "confirm", confirmHoldMs: {}, maxHoldMs: 60_000, hangMs: 2_000 } }))
		confirm.s.start()
		confirm.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		confirm.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		confirm.s.onBlock(B)
		confirm.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		confirm.s.onBlock(3 * B)
		expect(confirm.s.onConfirmed("t1", true)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }, tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])

		const capped = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit, hold: { policy: "hold", confirmHoldMs: {}, maxHoldMs: 4_000, hangMs: 2_000 } }))
		capped.s.start()
		capped.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		capped.s.onTrack(track("t1"), true, 1_800)
		capped.s.onBlock(B)
		capped.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		capped.s.onBlock(3 * B)
		capped.s.onConfirmed("t1", true)
		capped.clock = 3_999
		expect(capped.s.tick(capped.clock)).toEqual([])
		capped.clock = 4_000
		expect(capped.s.tick(capped.clock)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }, tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
	})

	it("probes the strongest track first, then the next queued one", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		h.s.start()
		h.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		h.s.onTrack(track("weak", 12), true, 1_000)
		h.s.onTrack(track("strong", 30), true, 1_800)
		h.s.onBlock(B)
		h.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		expect(h.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([{ type: "start-probe", trackId: "strong", holdMs: 2_100 }])
		h.clock = 400
		expect(h.s.onConfirmed("strong", false)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }, { type: "start-probe", trackId: "weak", holdMs: 1_300 }])
		h.clock = 1_700
		expect(h.s.tick(h.clock)).toEqual([{ type: "stop-probes" }, tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
	})
})

describe("SweepScheduler revisits and gain memory", () => {
	const plan4 = makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ, 403.2 * MHZ, 404.8 * MHZ])

	it("revisits the most active, longest-unvisited hop after round(1/share) coarse hops", () => {
		const h = harness(plan4, makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: { share: 0.5, maxIntervalMs: null } }))
		h.s.start()
		h.s.onEpochStarted(0)
		h.s.onTrack(track("t1"), false, 0)
		h.sample = 0
		h.s.onBlock(B)
		h.s.onBlock(2 * B)
		expect(h.s.onBlock(3 * B)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)])
		h.clock = 1_000
		h.sample = 10 * B
		expect(h.dwell()).toEqual([tune(0, 400 * MHZ)]) // revisit of the active hop 0
		h.clock = 1_200
		expect(h.dwell()).toEqual([tune(2, 403.2 * MHZ)]) // back to the coarse order
	})

	it("forces a revisit of a hop overdue by maxIntervalMs", () => {
		const h = harness(plan4, makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: { share: 0, maxIntervalMs: 1_000 } }))
		h.s.start()
		h.dwell()
		h.clock = 1_500
		expect(h.dwell()).toEqual([tune(0, 400 * MHZ)])
		h.clock = 1_600
		expect(h.dwell()).toEqual([tune(2, 403.2 * MHZ)])
	})

	it("doubles a candidate hop's revisit weight while boosted", () => {
		const run = (boost: boolean): SchedulerAction[] => {
			const h = harness(plan4, makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: { share: 1 / 3, maxIntervalMs: null } }))
			h.s.start()
			h.s.onEpochStarted(h.sample)
			h.s.onTrack(track("a"), false, 0)
			h.dwell(3, false) // a second epoch would restart the visit and drop track a
			h.clock = 600
			h.s.onEpochStarted(h.sample)
			h.s.onTrack(track("b"), false, 0)
			h.dwell(3, false)
			if (boost) h.s.setBoost(1, true)
			h.clock = 2_000
			return h.dwell()
		}
		expect(run(false)).toEqual([tune(0, 400 * MHZ)]) // 1 × 2000 > 1 × 1400
		expect(run(true)).toEqual([tune(1, 401.6 * MHZ)]) // 2 × 1400 > 1 × 2000
	})

	it("lowers an overloaded hop's gain 6 dB and restores it after three clean visits", () => {
		const spec = makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit, tuner: { sampleRateHz: null, gainTenthsDb: 496, agc: false, overload: "reduce-gain" } })
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ]), spec)
		const gains: (number | null)[] = []
		const record = (actions: SchedulerAction[]) => {
			for (const a of actions) if (a.type === "tune" && a.hopIndex === 0) gains.push(a.gainTenthsDb)
		}
		record(h.s.start())
		h.s.onOverload(0)
		for (let visit = 0; visit < 9; visit++) record(h.dwell())
		expect(gains).toEqual([496, 436, 436, 436, 496])
	})
})

describe("SweepScheduler activity seed", () => {
	it("primes a hop's revisit weight from the seed (occupancy history), and leaves unseeded hops at 0", () => {
		const run = (seeded: boolean): SchedulerAction[] => {
			const plan = makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ, 403.2 * MHZ, 404.8 * MHZ])
			const spec = makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: { share: 0.5, maxIntervalMs: null } })
			const h = { clock: 0, sample: 0 }
			const s = new SweepScheduler(plan, spec, {
				blockSamples: B,
				sampleRateHz: FS,
				now: () => h.clock,
				probeStartMs: 300,
				...(seeded ? { activitySeed: (hop: { centreHz: number }) => (hop.centreHz === 400 * MHZ ? 0.8 : 0) } : {}),
			})
			const dwell = (): SchedulerAction[] => {
				s.onEpochStarted(h.sample)
				let actions: SchedulerAction[] = []
				for (let i = 0; i < 3 && actions.length === 0; i++) {
					h.sample += B
					actions = s.onBlock(h.sample)
				}
				return actions
			}
			s.start()
			dwell() // hop 0, quiet: the EWMA keeps the seed (no time has passed)
			h.clock = 1_000
			return dwell() // after hop 1: round(1/0.5) = 2 coarse hops → revisit check
		}
		expect(run(true)).toEqual([tune(0, 400 * MHZ)])
		expect(run(false)).toEqual([tune(2, 403.2 * MHZ)])
	})
})

describe("SweepScheduler re-plan", () => {
	it("applies a new plan at the next hop boundary, re-indexed by centre", () => {
		const h = harness(makeHopPlan([400 * MHZ, 401.6 * MHZ, 403.2 * MHZ, 404.8 * MHZ]), makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		h.s.start()
		h.dwell()
		const fine = makeHopPlan([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map(i => 400 * MHZ + i * 0.8 * MHZ), 409_600)
		h.s.replan(fine, makeNormalisedSpec({ revisit: noRevisit }))
		expect(h.s.progress().hopCount).toBe(4)
		expect(h.dwell()).toEqual([tune(3, 402.4 * MHZ)]) // hop 1 (401.6) is index 2 in the new plan
		expect(h.s.progress()).toMatchObject({ hopIndex: 3, hopCount: 8 })
	})

	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 9: Job transitions (scheduler index bounds)
	// Validates: spec § 10.1, § 10.2, § 12.1
	it("keeps hopIndex in [0, hopCount) and sweepIndex non-decreasing for any event sequence, including re-plans", () => {
		type Ev =
			| { k: "epoch" }
			| { k: "block"; n: number }
			| { k: "stale" }
			| { k: "track"; id: number; confirm: boolean }
			| { k: "confirmed"; id: number; follow: boolean }
			| { k: "closed"; id: number }
			| { k: "tick"; ms: number }
			| { k: "replan"; hops: number }
			| { k: "overload" }
			| { k: "boost"; hop: number; on: boolean }
		const evArb: fc.Arbitrary<Ev> = fc.oneof(
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("epoch" as const) }),
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("block" as const), n: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4 }) }),
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("stale" as const) }),
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("track" as const), id: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }), confirm: fc.boolean() }),
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("confirmed" as const), id: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }), follow: fc.boolean() }),
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("closed" as const), id: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }) }),
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("tick" as const), ms: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 70_000 }) }),
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("replan" as const), hops: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 8 }) }),
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("overload" as const) }),
			fc.record({ k: fc.constant("boost" as const), hop: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 9 }), on: fc.boolean() }),
		)
		const planOf = (n: number) => makeHopPlan(Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => 400 * MHZ + i * 1.6 * MHZ))
		fc.assert(
			fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 6 }), fc.array(evArb, { maxLength: 80 }), fc.boolean(), (initialHops, events, reduceGain) => {
				const spec = makeNormalisedSpec({
					revisit: { share: 0.3, maxIntervalMs: 20_000 },
					hold: { policy: "hold", confirmHoldMs: {}, maxHoldMs: 30_000, hangMs: 2_000 },
					tuner: { sampleRateHz: null, gainTenthsDb: 300, agc: false, overload: reduceGain ? "reduce-gain" : "flag" },
				})
				let latest = planOf(initialHops)
				const h = harness(latest, spec)
				let lastSweep = 0
				const check = (actions: SchedulerAction[]) => {
					for (const a of actions) {
						if (a.type === "tune") {
							expect(a.hopIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
							expect(a.hopIndex).toBeLessThan(latest.hops.length)
							expect(a.centreHz).toBe(latest.hops[a.hopIndex]?.centreHz)
							if (a.gainTenthsDb !== null) expect(a.gainTenthsDb).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
						}
						if (a.type === "sweep-complete") expect(a.sweepIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(lastSweep)
					}
					const p = h.s.progress()
					expect(p.hopIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
					expect(p.hopIndex).toBeLessThan(p.hopCount)
					expect(p.sweepIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(lastSweep)
					expect(p.coverage).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
					expect(p.coverage).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1)
					lastSweep = p.sweepIndex
				}
				check(h.s.start())
				for (const e of events) {
					switch (e.k) {
						case "epoch":
							check(h.s.onEpochStarted(h.sample))
							break
						case "block":
							for (let i = 0; i < e.n; i++) {
								h.sample += B
								check(h.s.onBlock(h.sample))
							}
							break
						case "stale":
							h.s.onStale(1)
							break
						case "track":
							check(h.s.onTrack(track(`t${e.id}`), e.confirm, 1_000))
							break
						case "confirmed":
							check(h.s.onConfirmed(`t${e.id}`, e.follow))
							break
						case "closed":
							check(h.s.onTrackClosed(`t${e.id}`))
							break
						case "tick":
							h.clock += e.ms
							check(h.s.tick(h.clock))
							break
						case "replan":
							latest = planOf(e.hops)
							h.s.replan(latest, spec)
							check([])
							break
						case "overload":
							h.s.onOverload(h.s.progress().hopIndex)
							break
						case "boost":
							h.s.setBoost(e.hop, e.on)
							break
					}
				}
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})
})
```

Note on the property's tune check: every `tune` after a `replan` call is emitted at a hop boundary, where the pending plan has just been applied, so it always refers to the most recent plan.

```ts
// src/core/scanner/scheduler.ts
/**
 * Sweep scheduler (spec § 10.2): ascending coarse hops, dwell measured in samples from the settled
 * epoch start, holds for confirmation and following, activity-weighted revisits, per-hop gain
 * memory, and re-plans applied at hop boundaries. Pure: the job runner feeds events and executes
 * the returned actions.
 */
import { WaveKitError } from "../../utils/errors.js"
import type { Hop, HopPlan, NormalisedJobSpec } from "./types.js"
import type { TrackSnapshot } from "../spectrum/types.js"

export type SchedulerAction =
	| { type: "tune"; hopIndex: number; centreHz: number; gainTenthsDb: number | null }
	| { type: "start-probe"; trackId: string; holdMs: number }
	| { type: "stop-probes" }
	| { type: "sweep-complete"; sweepIndex: number }

const ACTIVITY_HALF_LIFE_MS = 10 * 60_000
const SWEEP_PERIOD_ALPHA = 0.3
const GAIN_STEP_TENTHS = 60
const CLEAN_VISITS_TO_RAISE = 3
const CANDIDATE_BOOST = 2

interface HopState {
	activityScore: number
	scoreAt: number | null
	lastVisit: number | null
	gainTenthsDb: number | null
	cleanVisits: number
	boost: boolean
}

interface TrackInfo {
	snrDb: number
	needsConfirm: boolean
	confirmHoldMs: number
	open: boolean
	tried: boolean
}

interface Visit {
	hopIndex: number
	revisit: boolean
	dwellEnd: number | null
	blocks: number
	activeBlocks: number
	overloaded: boolean
	tracks: Map<string, TrackInfo>
	holdStartedAt: number | null
}

interface Hold {
	trackId: string
	mode: "confirm" | "follow" | "hang"
	deadline: number
}

type Phase = "idle" | "tuning" | "dwell" | "hold"

function nearestHop(plan: HopPlan, centreHz: number): number {
	let best = 0
	let bestDist = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
	plan.hops.forEach((hop, i) => {
		const dist = Math.abs(hop.centreHz - centreHz)
		if (dist < bestDist) {
			best = i
			bestDist = dist
		}
	})
	return best
}

export class SweepScheduler {
	private plan: HopPlan
	private spec: NormalisedJobSpec
	private readonly blockSamples: number
	private readonly sampleRateHz: number
	private readonly now: () => number
	private readonly probeStartMs: number
	private readonly minSurfaceBlocks: number
	private readonly activitySeed: ((hop: Hop) => number) | undefined
	private hops: HopState[]
	private pendingReplan: { plan: HopPlan; spec: NormalisedJobSpec } | null = null
	private phase: Phase = "idle"
	private visit: Visit | null = null
	private hold: Hold | null = null
	/** Current coarse hop while on a coarse visit; the next coarse hop otherwise. */
	private coarseIndex = 0
	private coarseSinceRevisit = 0
	private sweepIndex = 0
	private sweepStartedAt = 0
	private sweepPeriodMs: number | null = null
	private visited = new Set<number>()
	private lastCoverage: number | null = null

	constructor(
		plan: HopPlan,
		spec: NormalisedJobSpec,
		opts: {
			blockSamples: number
			sampleRateHz: number
			now: () => number
			probeStartMs: number
			minSurfaceBlocks?: number
			activitySeed?: (hop: Hop) => number
		},
	) {
		if (plan.hops.length === 0) throw new WaveKitError("A sweep needs at least one hop", "SCANNER_EMPTY_PLAN")
		this.plan = plan
		this.spec = spec
		this.blockSamples = opts.blockSamples
		this.sampleRateHz = opts.sampleRateHz
		this.now = opts.now
		this.probeStartMs = opts.probeStartMs
		this.minSurfaceBlocks = opts.minSurfaceBlocks ?? 2
		this.activitySeed = opts.activitySeed
		this.hops = plan.hops.map(hop => this.freshHop(hop))
	}

	start(): SchedulerAction[] {
		if (this.phase !== "idle") return []
		this.sweepStartedAt = this.now()
		this.coarseIndex = 0
		return this.tuneTo(0, false)
	}

	/**
	 * A new own epoch started at `startSample` (the first settled sample of the current hop). In
	 * `tuning` this opens the dwell; in `dwell`/`hold` the hop was re-sent (source-up,
	 * preemptor-idle, resume) and the visit restarts (see restartVisit).
	 */
	onEpochStarted(startSample: number): SchedulerAction[] {
		return this.restartVisit(startSample)
	}

	/**
	 * Restarts the current visit from `startSample`: `dwellEnd = startSample + dwell`, the visit's
	 * tracks are dropped (they belong to the old epoch) and any hold ends with `stop-probes`. A new
	 * stream restarts sample indices at 0 and a resumed stream has run past the old `dwellEnd`, so
	 * the old absolute `dwellEnd` is meaningless either way (§ 10.2 dwell in samples). Task 35's
	 * `resendHop` retunes; the re-sent hop's own epoch reaches this through `onEpochStarted` with its
	 * start sample. No-op while idle.
	 */
	restartVisit(startSample: number): SchedulerAction[] {
		const v = this.visit
		if (v === null || this.phase === "idle") return []
		const actions: SchedulerAction[] = this.phase === "hold" ? [{ type: "stop-probes" }] : []
		v.dwellEnd = startSample + this.dwellSamples()
		v.tracks.clear()
		v.holdStartedAt = null
		this.hold = null
		this.phase = "dwell"
		return actions
	}

	onBlock(endSample: number): SchedulerAction[] {
		const v = this.visit
		if (v === null || (this.phase !== "dwell" && this.phase !== "hold")) return []
		v.blocks++
		for (const t of v.tracks.values())
			if (t.open) {
				v.activeBlocks++
				break
			}
		if (this.phase === "dwell" && v.dwellEnd !== null && endSample >= v.dwellEnd) return this.decide()
		return []
	}

	onStale(blocks: number): void {
		if (this.phase === "dwell" && this.visit !== null && this.visit.dwellEnd !== null)
			this.visit.dwellEnd += blocks * this.blockSamples
	}

	onTrack(track: TrackSnapshot, needsConfirm: boolean, confirmHoldMs: number): SchedulerAction[] {
		const v = this.visit
		if (v === null || (this.phase !== "dwell" && this.phase !== "hold")) return []
		// truncated, iqImage and spur are sticky and may first appear on a later track-update: never probed (§ 4.9)
		const flagged = track.flags.truncated || track.flags.iqImage || track.flags.spur
		const known = v.tracks.get(track.trackId)
		if (known === undefined) {
			v.tracks.set(track.trackId, { snrDb: track.snrDb, needsConfirm: needsConfirm && !flagged, confirmHoldMs, open: true, tried: false })
		} else {
			known.snrDb = track.snrDb
			known.open = true
			if (flagged) known.needsConfirm = false
			else known.needsConfirm ||= needsConfirm
			known.confirmHoldMs = Math.max(known.confirmHoldMs, confirmHoldMs)
		}
		// the held track turned out truncated or an image: drop its probe and hold
		if (flagged && this.phase === "hold" && this.hold?.trackId === track.trackId) return this.afterProbe()
		return []
	}

	onConfirmed(trackId: string, follow: boolean): SchedulerAction[] {
		if (this.phase !== "hold" || this.hold?.trackId !== trackId) return []
		if (follow && this.spec.hold.policy === "hold") {
			const open = this.visit?.tracks.get(trackId)?.open === true
			this.hold = open
				? { trackId, mode: "follow", deadline: this.maxHoldDeadline() }
				: { trackId, mode: "hang", deadline: Math.min(this.now() + this.spec.hold.hangMs, this.maxHoldDeadline()) }
			return []
		}
		return this.afterProbe()
	}

	onTrackClosed(trackId: string): SchedulerAction[] {
		const t = this.visit?.tracks.get(trackId)
		if (t !== undefined) t.open = false
		if (this.phase === "hold" && this.hold?.trackId === trackId && this.hold.mode === "follow")
			this.hold = { trackId, mode: "hang", deadline: Math.min(this.now() + this.spec.hold.hangMs, this.maxHoldDeadline()) }
		return []
	}

	onOverload(hopIndex: number): void {
		if (this.visit !== null && this.visit.hopIndex === hopIndex) this.visit.overloaded = true
	}

	setBoost(hopIndex: number, on: boolean): void {
		const hop = this.hops[hopIndex]
		if (hop !== undefined) hop.boost = on
	}

	tick(now: number): SchedulerAction[] {
		if (this.phase !== "hold" || this.hold === null) return []
		if (now >= this.maxHoldDeadline()) return this.leaveHop([{ type: "stop-probes" }])
		if (now < this.hold.deadline) return []
		if (this.hold.mode === "confirm") return this.afterProbe()
		if (this.hold.mode === "hang") return this.leaveHop([{ type: "stop-probes" }])
		return []
	}

	replan(plan: HopPlan, spec: NormalisedJobSpec): void {
		if (plan.hops.length === 0) throw new WaveKitError("A sweep needs at least one hop", "SCANNER_EMPTY_PLAN")
		this.pendingReplan = { plan, spec }
		if (this.phase === "idle") this.applyReplan()
	}

	progress(): { sweepIndex: number; hopIndex: number; hopCount: number; sweepPeriodMs: number | null; holdingOn: string | null; coverage: number } {
		return {
			sweepIndex: this.sweepIndex,
			hopIndex: this.visit?.hopIndex ?? Math.min(this.coarseIndex, this.plan.hops.length - 1),
			hopCount: this.plan.hops.length,
			sweepPeriodMs: this.sweepPeriodMs,
			holdingOn: this.phase === "hold" ? (this.hold?.trackId ?? null) : null,
			coverage: this.lastCoverage ?? this.visited.size / this.plan.hops.length,
		}
	}

	// ── internals ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	/** A hop never visited under this plan; an optional seed (occupancy history) primes its activityScore. */
	private freshHop(hop: Hop | undefined): HopState {
		const seed = hop === undefined || this.activitySeed === undefined ? 0 : this.activitySeed(hop)
		const seeded = Number.isFinite(seed) && seed > 0
		return {
			activityScore: seeded ? Math.min(1, seed) : 0,
			scoreAt: seeded ? this.now() : null,
			lastVisit: null,
			gainTenthsDb: this.spec.tuner.gainTenthsDb,
			cleanVisits: 0,
			boost: false,
		}
	}

	private dwellSamples(): number {
		const blocks = (this.minSurfaceBlocks + 1) * this.blockSamples
		const operator = Math.round(((this.spec.dwellMs - this.spec.settleMs) * this.sampleRateHz) / 1000)
		return Math.max(blocks, operator)
	}

	private tuneTo(hopIndex: number, revisit: boolean): SchedulerAction[] {
		const hop = this.plan.hops[hopIndex]
		if (hop === undefined) throw new WaveKitError(`Hop ${hopIndex} is outside the plan`, "SCANNER_HOP_RANGE")
		this.visit = { hopIndex, revisit, dwellEnd: null, blocks: 0, activeBlocks: 0, overloaded: false, tracks: new Map(), holdStartedAt: null }
		this.hold = null
		this.phase = "tuning"
		return [{ type: "tune", hopIndex, centreHz: hop.centreHz, gainTenthsDb: this.hops[hopIndex]?.gainTenthsDb ?? this.spec.tuner.gainTenthsDb }]
	}

	private decide(): SchedulerAction[] {
		const v = this.visit
		if (v === null) return []
		this.visited.add(v.hopIndex)
		if (this.spec.hold.policy !== "never") {
			const next = this.nextCandidate()
			if (next !== null) {
				v.holdStartedAt = this.now()
				return this.startProbe(next[0], next[1])
			}
		}
		return this.leaveHop([])
	}

	private nextCandidate(): [string, TrackInfo] | null {
		const v = this.visit
		if (v === null) return null
		let best: [string, TrackInfo] | null = null
		for (const [id, t] of v.tracks) {
			if (!t.open || !t.needsConfirm || t.tried) continue
			if (best === null || t.snrDb > best[1].snrDb || (t.snrDb === best[1].snrDb && id < best[0])) best = [id, t]
		}
		return best
	}

	private startProbe(trackId: string, t: TrackInfo): SchedulerAction[] {
		const now = this.now()
		const holdMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(t.confirmHoldMs + this.probeStartMs, this.maxHoldDeadline() - now))
		t.tried = true
		this.hold = { trackId, mode: "confirm", deadline: now + holdMs }
		this.phase = "hold"
		return [{ type: "start-probe", trackId, holdMs }]
	}

	/** A probe finished (confirmed without following, or timed out): next queued track or leave. */
	private afterProbe(): SchedulerAction[] {
		const stop: SchedulerAction[] = [{ type: "stop-probes" }]
		const next = this.nextCandidate()
		if (next !== null && this.now() < this.maxHoldDeadline()) return [...stop, ...this.startProbe(next[0], next[1])]
		return this.leaveHop(stop)
	}

	private maxHoldDeadline(): number {
		return (this.visit?.holdStartedAt ?? this.now()) + this.spec.hold.maxHoldMs
	}

	private leaveHop(prefix: SchedulerAction[]): SchedulerAction[] {
		const now = this.now()
		const wasRevisit = this.visit?.revisit ?? false
		this.endVisit(now)
		this.applyReplan()
		const actions = [...prefix]
		if (!wasRevisit) {
			this.coarseIndex++
			this.coarseSinceRevisit++
		}
		if (this.coarseIndex >= this.plan.hops.length) {
			actions.push({ type: "sweep-complete", sweepIndex: this.sweepIndex })
			const period = now - this.sweepStartedAt
			this.sweepPeriodMs = this.sweepPeriodMs === null ? period : (1 - SWEEP_PERIOD_ALPHA) * this.sweepPeriodMs + SWEEP_PERIOD_ALPHA * period
			this.lastCoverage = this.visited.size / this.plan.hops.length
			this.visited.clear()
			this.sweepIndex++
			this.coarseIndex = 0
			this.sweepStartedAt = now
		}
		const revisit = this.pickRevisit(now, wasRevisit)
		if (revisit !== null) {
			this.coarseSinceRevisit = 0
			return [...actions, ...this.tuneTo(revisit, true)]
		}
		return [...actions, ...this.tuneTo(this.coarseIndex, false)]
	}

	private endVisit(now: number): void {
		const v = this.visit
		this.hold = null
		if (v === null) return
		const hop = this.hops[v.hopIndex]
		if (hop === undefined) return
		const active = v.blocks > 0 ? v.activeBlocks / v.blocks : 0
		if (hop.scoreAt === null) hop.activityScore = active
		else {
			const keep = 2 ** (-(now - hop.scoreAt) / ACTIVITY_HALF_LIFE_MS)
			hop.activityScore = keep * hop.activityScore + (1 - keep) * active
		}
		hop.scoreAt = now
		hop.lastVisit = now
		const jobGain = this.spec.tuner.gainTenthsDb
		if (this.spec.tuner.overload === "reduce-gain" && jobGain !== null && hop.gainTenthsDb !== null) {
			if (v.overloaded) {
				hop.gainTenthsDb = Math.max(0, hop.gainTenthsDb - GAIN_STEP_TENTHS)
				hop.cleanVisits = 0
			} else if (hop.gainTenthsDb < jobGain) {
				hop.cleanVisits++
				if (hop.cleanVisits >= CLEAN_VISITS_TO_RAISE) {
					hop.gainTenthsDb = Math.min(jobGain, hop.gainTenthsDb + GAIN_STEP_TENTHS)
					hop.cleanVisits = 0
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private pickRevisit(now: number, lastWasRevisit: boolean): number | null {
		if (this.plan.hops.length < 2) return null
		const next = this.coarseIndex
		const maxInterval = this.spec.revisit.maxIntervalMs
		if (maxInterval !== null && !lastWasRevisit) {
			let overdue: number | null = null
			let overdueAge = maxInterval
			for (const [i, hop] of this.hops.entries()) {
				if (i === next || hop.lastVisit === null) continue
				const age = now - hop.lastVisit
				if (age > overdueAge) {
					overdue = i
					overdueAge = age
				}
			}
			if (overdue !== null) return overdue
		}
		const share = this.spec.revisit.share
		if (share <= 0 || this.coarseSinceRevisit < Math.max(1, Math.round(1 / share))) return null
		let best: number | null = null
		let bestScore = 0
		for (const [i, hop] of this.hops.entries()) {
			if (i === next || hop.lastVisit === null) continue
			const score = hop.activityScore * (hop.boost ? CANDIDATE_BOOST : 1) * (now - hop.lastVisit)
			if (score > bestScore) {
				best = i
				bestScore = score
			}
		}
		return best
	}

	private applyReplan(): void {
		const pending = this.pendingReplan
		if (pending === null) return
		this.pendingReplan = null
		const old = this.plan
		const oldCoarseCentre = old.hops[Math.min(this.coarseIndex, old.hops.length - 1)]?.centreHz ?? 0
		const mapped = pending.plan.hops.map(hop => {
			const i = nearestHop(old, hop.centreHz)
			const prev = this.hops[i]
			const near = Math.abs((old.hops[i]?.centreHz ?? Number.NaN) - hop.centreHz) <= pending.plan.usableHalfSpanHz
			return prev !== undefined && near ? { ...prev } : null
		})
		const visited = new Set<number>()
		for (const i of this.visited) {
			const centre = old.hops[i]?.centreHz
			if (centre !== undefined) visited.add(nearestHop(pending.plan, centre))
		}
		this.plan = pending.plan
		this.spec = pending.spec
		this.hops = mapped.map((state, i) => state ?? this.freshHop(pending.plan.hops[i]))
		this.visited = visited
		this.coarseIndex = nearestHop(pending.plan, oldCoarseCentre)
	}
}
```

### Task 20: Job transition table

**Spec:** § 10.1 (states, reasons, table, in-window variant), § 10.3 (which states hold the lease), § 13 P9. **Depends on:** Task 1. **Batch:** S1-A

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/scanner/job-state.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/scanner/job-state.test.ts`

Mapping of the § 10.1 table (one `JobEvent` variant per table event; actions are the sweep actions, `actionsForMode("in-window", …)` strips the lease rows):

| From | Event | To | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|
| pending | `start` | starting | acquire-lease, hold-decoders, open-engine |
| pending | `create-rejected` (impact not consented / source busy) | failed(invalid) | none: the job runner answers 409 and never stores the job |
| starting | `engine-ready` | running | — |
| starting | `tuner-error` | failed(tuner-unavailable) | release-lease, release-decoders |
| running | `hold` | holding | — (the scheduler starts the probe) |
| holding | `hold-done` | running | — |
| running, holding | `pause` | paused(operator) | stop-probes |
| running, holding | `rest-write` | paused(preempted-operator) | stop-probes, release-lease, release-decoders (no restore) |
| running, holding | `relay-external` | paused(preempted-relay) | same |
| running, holding | `preempted-job` | paused(preempted-job) | stop-probes, release-lease (handed over with the snapshot). The job keeps its own decoder hold (Task 29 keys holds by holder; the preemptor takes its own), so configured decoders do not resume between the two holders |
| paused(operator), paused(source-down) | `preempted-job` | paused(preempted-job) | release-lease (the arbiter hands the lease over from a paused holder too; probes are already stopped; the job keeps its own keyed decoder hold, as above) |
| running, holding | `source-down` | paused(source-down) | stop-probes |
| paused(source-down) | `source-up` | running | resend-hop |
| paused(preempted-*) | `preemptor-idle` {impactGrew: false} | running | acquire-lease, hold-decoders, resend-hop |
| paused(preempted-*) | `preemptor-idle` {impactGrew: true} | paused(resume-blocked) | report-impact, release-decoders (drops a preempted-job job's own hold so configured decoders run while it waits for consent; a no-op after preempted-operator/relay, which released it already) |
| paused(operator) | `resume` | running | resend-hop (lease and hold were kept) |
| paused(resume-blocked) | `resume` {takeover: true} | running | acquire-lease, hold-decoders, resend-hop |
| paused(core-restart) | `resume` | running | acquire-lease, hold-decoders, open-engine, resend-hop |
| any non-terminal | `cancel` | cancelled | lease held: stop-probes, restore, release-lease, release-decoders; else (preempted-*, resume-blocked, core-restart) stop-probes only: such a job holds no lease, and a preempted-job job's own keyed decoder hold is dropped by Task 35's terminal teardown (never the preemptor's, which is keyed by the preemptor); pending: none |
| running, holding | `stop-condition` | completed | as cancel |
| any non-terminal | `source-removed` | failed(source-removed) | lease held: stop-probes, release-lease, release-decoders; else stop-probes (pending: none) |
| starting, running, holding, paused(*) | `boot` | paused(core-restart) | restore (the persisted lease snapshot, § 10.3; a job persisted in `starting` already held a lease) |

The lease is held in `starting`, `running`, `holding`, `paused(operator)` and `paused(source-down)`. Spec gap resolved: the boot row says auto-resume needs `resume.onBoot` but no row leaves `paused(core-restart)`; this task lets `resume` (auto with `onBoot`, or by the operator) leave it like `resume-blocked`, re-acquiring the lease and re-opening the engine. The `(create fails)` row maps to `failed(invalid)` so the table stays total; the runner discards such a job.
