```ts
describe("source hold for a sweep (spec § 10.4)", () => {
	it("suspends running configured decoders by the time holdSource resolves and resumes them when releaseSource resolves", async () => {
		const decoder = createConfigured()
		await manager.startDecoder("dmr")
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j1")
		expect(manager.isSourceHeld("rtl")).toBe(true)
		expect(decoder.running).toBe(false)
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")).toMatchObject({
			suspended: true,
			suspension: { reasonCode: "tuner-scanning" },
			desiredRunning: true,
		})
		await manager.releaseSource("rtl", "j1")
		expect(manager.isSourceHeld("rtl")).toBe(false)
		expect(decoder.starts).toBe(2)
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")?.suspended).toBe(false)
	})

	it("stays suspended while the scanner hops every 100 ms, which keeps re-arming the caps debounce", async () => {
		const decoder = createConfigured()
		await manager.startDecoder("dmr")
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j1")
		for (let hop = 0; hop < 20; hop++) {
			sources.setCenter("rtl", 412_000_000 + hop * 1_600_000)
			await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(100)
			expect(decoder.running).toBe(false)
			expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")?.suspension?.reasonCode).toBe("tuner-scanning")
		}
		expect(decoder.starts).toBe(1)
		expect(decoder.stops).toBe(1)
		await manager.releaseSource("rtl", "j1")
		expect(decoder.starts).toBe(2)
		await settle() // the debounced hop evaluation finds nothing left to do
		expect(decoder.starts).toBe(2)
		expect(decoder.stops).toBe(1)
	})

	it("releasing one holder keeps another holder's hold", async () => {
		const decoder = createConfigured()
		await manager.startDecoder("dmr")
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j1")
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j2")
		await manager.releaseSource("rtl", "j1")
		expect(manager.isSourceHeld("rtl")).toBe(true)
		await settle()
		expect(decoder.running).toBe(false)
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")?.suspension?.reasonCode).toBe("tuner-scanning")
		await manager.releaseSource("rtl", "j1") // already released: no-op
		expect(manager.isSourceHeld("rtl")).toBe(true)
		await manager.releaseSource("rtl", "j2")
		expect(manager.isSourceHeld("rtl")).toBe(false)
		expect(decoder.running).toBe(true)
		expect(decoder.starts).toBe(2)
	})

	it("outranks an unusable rate as the reported reason, which returns after release", async () => {
		createConfigured()
		await manager.startDecoder("dmr")
		sources.setRate("rtl", 20_000)
		await settle()
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j1")
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")?.suspension?.reasonCode).toBe("tuner-scanning")
		await manager.releaseSource("rtl", "j1")
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")?.suspension?.reasonCode).toBe("insufficient-sample-rate")
	})

	it("holds pinned (operator) decoders too", async () => {
		const decoder = createConfigured()
		await manager.startDecoder("dmr", { startMode: "operator" })
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j1")
		expect(decoder.running).toBe(false)
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")).toMatchObject({ startMode: "operator", suspended: true })
	})

	it("refuses refuseIfHeld starts and restarts on a held source, leaving the intent untouched", async () => {
		const decoder = createConfigured()
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j1")
		await expect(manager.startDecoder("dmr", { startMode: "operator", refuseIfHeld: true })).rejects.toSatisfy(
			(err: unknown) => err instanceof WaveKitError && err.code === "SOURCE_HELD_BY_SCANNER",
		)
		expect(decoder.starts).toBe(0)
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")?.desiredRunning).toBe(false)
		await manager.releaseSource("rtl", "j1")
		await manager.startDecoder("dmr")
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j1")
		await expect(manager.restartDecoder("dmr", { refuseIfHeld: true })).rejects.toMatchObject({
			code: "SOURCE_HELD_BY_SCANNER",
		})
		expect(decoder.stops).toBe(1) // the hold's suspension only; the refused restart stopped nothing
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")).toMatchObject({ desiredRunning: true, suspended: true })
	})

	it("startAll during a hold records the decoders as wanted and suspended; they start on release", async () => {
		const decoder = createConfigured()
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j1")
		await manager.startAll()
		expect(decoder.starts).toBe(0)
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")).toMatchObject({
			desiredRunning: true,
			suspended: true,
			suspension: { reasonCode: "tuner-scanning" },
		})
		await manager.releaseSource("rtl", "j1")
		expect(decoder.running).toBe(true)
		expect(manager.getStatus("dmr")?.suspended).toBe(false)
	})

	it("does not affect probes or decoders on other sources", async () => {
		sources.caps.set("spare", { ...iqCaps(2_400_000), centerFreq: 144_800_000 })
		manager.createDecoder({ id: "aprs", type: "rate-test", enabled: true, sourceId: "spare", options: { input: "iq" } })
		await manager.startDecoder("aprs")
		await manager.holdSource("rtl", "tuner-scanning", "j1")
		await manager.createEphemeralDecoder(probeConfig(), { owner: "scanner", jobId: "j1", input: new PassThrough() })
		expect(decoders.get("aprs")!.running).toBe(true)
		expect(decoders.get("scan-j1-dmr-1")!.running).toBe(true)
	})
})
```

```ts
	/**
	 * Keep stop/start cycles serialized while retaining the latest tuning
	 * request. Resolves once every evaluation pending at call time is applied.
	 */
	private drainCapsChanges(): Promise<void> {
		this.capsWork = this.capsWork.then(() => this.runPendingCapsChanges())
		return this.capsWork
	}

	private async runPendingCapsChanges(): Promise<void> {
		try {
			while (this.capsChangedHandler && this.pendingCapsChanges.size > 0) {
				const pending = new Map(this.pendingCapsChanges)
				this.pendingCapsChanges.clear()
				for (const [id, evaluation] of pending) {
					await this.handleCapsChange(id, evaluation.caps, evaluation.adapt)
				}
			}
		} catch (err) {
			this.log.error({ err }, "Failed to apply source tuning changes")
		}
	}
```

```ts
	/**
	 * Creates and starts a scanner probe (spec § 6.5): not in config, never
	 * persisted, not band-checked, held or pinned, never auto-restarted. With
	 * `input`, it reads that stream instead of a fanout branch. Resolves after
	 * the process started; on failure the instance is removed and the error
	 * rethrown.
	 */
	async createEphemeralDecoder(
		config: DecoderConfig,
		opts: { owner: "scanner"; jobId: string; input?: Readable },
	): Promise<Decoder> {
		if (this.decoders.has(config.id)) {
			throw new WaveKitError(
				`Decoder already exists: ${config.id}`,
				"DECODER_EXISTS",
			)
		}
		const decoder = this.registerDecoder(config, {
			jobId: opts.jobId,
			input: opts.input ?? null,
		})
		const state = this.decoders.get(config.id)!
		state.desiredRunning = true
		state.intentionallyStopped = false
		state.rateGeneration++
		try {
			const outcome = await this.wireDecoderToFanout(state)
			if (!outcome.wired) {
				throw new WaveKitError(
					`Scanner probe ${config.id} could not be wired: ${outcome.superseded ? "superseded" : `${outcome.reasonCode}: ${outcome.detail}`}`,
					"PROBE_NOT_WIRED",
				)
			}
			await decoder.start()
			// Attach only once the process exists: attachInput starts the stream
			// flowing and pipes to stdin only when a process is running, so an
			// earlier attach would drain the buffered pre-roll into the byte
			// counter instead of the decoder.
			if (state.input) {
				decoder.attachInput(state.input)
				state.inputAttached = true
			}
		} catch (err) {
			state.lastError = createDecoderLastError(err, "error")
			await this.removeDecoder(config.id)
			throw err
		}
		this.emitStatusChanged(state)
		return decoder
	}

	/** Stops and removes a probe; no-op for unknown ids. */
	async removeEphemeralDecoder(id: string): Promise<void> {
		const state = this.decoders.get(id)
		if (!state) return
		if (state.owner !== "scanner") {
			throw new WaveKitError(
				`Decoder ${id} is configured, not a scanner probe`,
				"DECODER_NOT_EPHEMERAL",
			)
		}
		await this.removeDecoder(id)
	}

	/**
	 * Holds a source for a scanner sweep (spec § 10.4): every configured
	 * decoder on it is suspended with reason "tuner-scanning" until the last
	 * holder released it, so per-hop caps changes do not resume and
	 * re-suspend them. Resolves once those decoders were suspended.
	 */
	async holdSource(
		sourceId: string,
		reason: "tuner-scanning",
		holderId: string,
	): Promise<void> {
		const holders = this.heldSources.get(sourceId) ?? new Set<string>()
		holders.add(holderId)
		this.heldSources.set(sourceId, holders)
		this.log.info(
			{ sourceId, reason, holderId, holders: holders.size },
			"Source held by the scanner",
		)
		await this.evaluateSourceNow(sourceId)
	}

	/**
	 * Drops one holder's hold; the source stays held while another holder
	 * remains. Resolves once the decoders were re-evaluated (resumed).
	 */
	async releaseSource(sourceId: string, holderId: string): Promise<void> {
		const holders = this.heldSources.get(sourceId)
		if (!holders?.delete(holderId)) return
		if (holders.size > 0) {
			this.log.debug(
				{ sourceId, holderId, holders: holders.size },
				"Scanner hold released; other holders remain",
			)
			return
		}
		this.heldSources.delete(sourceId)
		this.log.info({ sourceId, holderId }, "Source released by the scanner")
		await this.evaluateSourceNow(sourceId)
	}

	isSourceHeld(sourceId: string): boolean {
		return (this.heldSources.get(sourceId)?.size ?? 0) > 0
	}

	/**
	 * Evaluates a source on the serial caps worker now. The 300 ms debounce
	 * cannot be used for holds: every scanner hop emits caps-changed and
	 * re-arms it, so during a sweep it would never fire. Other sources'
	 * pending evaluations are applied by the same drain.
	 */
	private evaluateSourceNow(sourceId: string): Promise<void> {
		this.enqueueSourceEvaluation(sourceId, {
			caps: this.sourceManager?.getCaps(sourceId) ?? null,
			adapt: false,
		})
		return this.drainCapsChanges()
	}

	/** The hold reason that applies to a configured stdin decoder, if any. */
	private heldReason(state: DecoderState): "tuner-scanning" | null {
		if (state.owner !== "config" || state.decoder.caps.input === "external")
			return null
		const sourceId = this.selectedSourceId(state)
		return sourceId !== undefined && this.isSourceHeld(sourceId)
			? "tuner-scanning"
			: null
	}

	private assertNotHeld(state: DecoderState): void {
		if (this.heldReason(state) === null) return
		throw new WaveKitError(
			`Source ${this.selectedSourceId(state)} is held by a scanner sweep; decoder ${state.config.id} can start when the sweep ends`,
			"SOURCE_HELD_BY_SCANNER",
		)
	}
```

```ts
	/**
	 * Scanner hold first (spec § 10.4), then rate, then band. Rate and band are
	 * still assessed for reporting while held.
	 */
	private assessEligibility(
		state: DecoderState,
		caps?: SourceCaps | null,
	): Eligibility {
		const rate = this.assessState(state, caps)
		const band = this.assessBand(state, caps)
		// An operator start (pin) and the per-decoder opt-out override only
		// the band check; an unusable rate still suspends. Probes are exempt.
		const bandSuspends =
			state.owner === "config" &&
			this.config.bandSuspension &&
			this.decoderBandSuspension(state) &&
			state.startMode !== "operator"
		const blockedBy =
			this.heldReason(state) ??
			(rate.verdict === "unusable"
				? (rate.reasonCode ?? "unsupported-sample-rate")
				: bandSuspends && band.verdict === "out-of-band"
					? "frequency-out-of-band"
					: null)
		return { rate, band, blockedBy }
	}
```

```ts
/** 409 body for mutating routes on a scanner probe (spec § 6.5); null otherwise. */
export function scannerOwnedConflict(
	manager: Pick<DecoderManager, "getStatus">,
	id: string,
): ErrorResponse | null {
	if (manager.getStatus(id)?.owner !== "scanner") return null
	return {
		error: "Conflict",
		code: "DECODER_OWNED_BY_SCANNER",
		message: `Decoder '${id}' is a scanner probe; the scanner owns its lifecycle`,
	}
}

/** 409 body when a start is refused because a scanner sweep holds the source. */
function sourceHeldConflict(err: unknown): ErrorResponse | null {
	if (!(err instanceof WaveKitError) || err.code !== "SOURCE_HELD_BY_SCANNER")
		return null
	return { error: "Conflict", code: err.code, message: err.message }
}
```

```ts
	async prepareDecoderConfigs(
		configs: readonly DecoderConfig[],
	): Promise<DecoderConfig[]> {
		if (!this.config.enabled) return [...configs]
		const prepared: DecoderConfig[] = []
		for (const config of configs) {
			if (!this.isEligible(config) || this.channels.has(config.id)) {
				prepared.push(config)
				continue
			}
			let channel: VoiceChannel
			try {
				channel = await this.createChannel(config, "config")
			} catch (err) {
				// The decoder still runs, with call metadata only (-o null).
				this.log.error(
					{ err, decoderId: config.id },
					"Could not bind a digital voice UDP socket; voice disabled for this decoder",
				)
				prepared.push(config)
				continue
			}
			this.channels.set(config.id, channel)
			prepared.push(this.routeConfig(config, channel))
		}
		return prepared
	}

	/**
	 * Binds a voice socket for a scanner probe and returns its config routed
	 * to it (spec § 6.5). Unchanged when digital voice is disabled or the
	 * config sets its own output. Does not start the server: ensureStarted().
	 */
	async addChannel(config: DecoderConfig): Promise<DecoderConfig> {
		if (!this.config.enabled || !this.isEligible(config)) return config
		if (this.channels.has(config.id)) {
			throw new WaveKitError(
				`Digital voice channel already exists: ${config.id}`,
				"DIGITAL_VOICE_CHANNEL_EXISTS",
			)
		}
		const channel = await this.createChannel(config, "scanner")
		this.channels.set(config.id, channel)
		return this.routeConfig(config, channel)
	}

	/** Disconnects the channel's listeners and releases its socket; no-op if unknown. */
	async removeChannel(decoderId: string): Promise<void> {
		const channel = this.channels.get(decoderId)
		if (!channel) return
		this.channels.delete(decoderId)
		channel.detach?.()
		channel.paced.stop()
		channel.registry.closeAll("removed", true)
		channel.socket.close()
		this.emit("clients-changed")
		this.log.info({ decoderId }, "Digital voice channel removed")
	}

	/** Starts the HTTP server if it is not running (lazy start for the first probe). */
	async ensureStarted(): Promise<void> {
		if (this.running) return
		this.starting ??= this.start().finally(() => {
			this.starting = null
		})
		await this.starting
	}

	private routeConfig(config: DecoderConfig, channel: VoiceChannel): DecoderConfig {
		const voiceSlot = config.options["voiceSlot"] ?? this.config.voiceSlot
		this.log.info(
			{
				decoderId: config.id,
				owner: channel.owner,
				udpPort: channel.port,
				mode: channel.mode,
				channels: channel.channels,
				voiceSlot,
			},
			"dsd-fme voice routed to the digital voice stream",
		)
		return {
			...config,
			options: {
				...config.options,
				output: "udp",
				udpHost: "127.0.0.1",
				udpPort: channel.port,
				voiceSlot,
			},
		}
	}
```

### Task 32: Spectrum worker entry, build, and `SpectrumEngine`

**Spec:** § 3 (worker build, copy-once input), § 4.1, § 4.6, § 4.7, § 4.8, § 9 (worker queue ≤ 4 MiB), P6 (§ 13). **Depends on:** Tasks 2, 3 (`defaultFftSize`), 4, 8, 10, 10a, 10b (`untracked-retune`), 16 (`EngineStateSchema`), 24 (`ScannerConfigSchema`, test settings), 26, 27. **Batch:** S1-B

**Files:**

- Modify: `Dockerfile` (node-build stage line 546 `RUN ls -la dist/ && head -1 dist/index.js`: also assert the worker file)
- Create: `src/core/spectrum/worker-protocol.ts` (Zod schemas for worker messages)
- Create: `src/core/spectrum/spectrum-worker.ts` (thin `worker_threads` entry)
- Create: `src/core/spectrum/pipeline-host.ts` (`PipelineHost`, inline and thread hosts, worker URL)
- Create: `src/core/spectrum/spectrum-engine.ts` (`SpectrumEngine`, `EpochClock`, `EngineEpoch`, `buildPipelineConfig`, `USABLE_FRACTION`)
- Create: `tests/mocks/scanner/engine-fakes.ts` (fake fanout, sources, tuner; `testSettings`)
- Test: `tests/unit/core/spectrum/spectrum-engine.test.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/core/spectrum/spectrum-worker-build.test.ts`

Design notes (read before coding):
- **Where indices come from.** The engine owns the absolute sample index per stream: `nextSample` advances by every ingested sample and by every gap (fanout drops, worker-behind drops). Fanout drops are located by **branch byte position**: on the branch `backpressure` event the engine records `atBranchByte = totalBytesWritten − droppedBytesTotal` (bytes the branch accepted before the seam) and `droppedAt = droppedBytesTotal`; on `drain` it queues `{atBranchByte, droppedBytes: droppedNow − droppedAt}`. Bytes are delivered asynchronously, so the gap is applied when the engine's own branch byte counter reaches `atBranchByte`, never at event time. Gaps and stream boundaries share one queue ordered by branch byte position.
- **Order with the pipeline.** Task 10's pipeline requires `pending-epoch` to be posted before any bytes with index ≥ `commandSample`. `submitEpoch()` flushes the current batch (all of it is `< nextSample`) and posts synchronously. External triggers capture `commandSample` synchronously in the event handler and post in a microtask, which always runs before the next `data` macrotask.
- **Own retunes.** The arbiter (Task 33) wraps its command sequence in `suppressExternal(true/false)` and posts its own `PendingEpoch` through `submitEpoch()`; while suppressed, `command-sent`, `state-changed` and `caps-changed` from those commands are ignored.
- **Rate changes.** Task 10's pipeline rejects a `sampleRateHz` different from its config (`SCANNER_PIPELINE_RATE`), so a rate change recreates the host with the exported engine state and starts a new stream.
- **Streams.** `disconnected` sets `awaitingPayload` and queues a stream boundary at the branch byte the fanout has accepted so far (`totalBytesWritten − droppedBytesTotal`): bytes still buffered in the branch finish the old stream, all later bytes belong to the new one. An open drop episode is split at the boundary: the bytes dropped so far are queued as a gap on the old stream (ahead of the boundary) and the episode is re-armed for the new stream, so its drain only counts the later drops. The following `payload-started` only clears the flag. A `payload-started` without a preceding `disconnected` queues a boundary only if the fanout accepted bytes since the last stream start. A pipeline restart (rate change) starts its stream directly; it drops queued marks at or before the delivered byte count (that segment was discarded) and re-arms an open episode. `start()` resets the branch accounting (a new branch counts from 0).
- **Copy once.** Branch chunks are copied into engine-owned pooled `ArrayBuffer`s (`batchBytes` 131072, a multiple of 8), which are transferred to the worker and transferred back (`buffer` message). In-flight bytes are capped at `MAX_INFLIGHT_BYTES` (4 MiB); without a free buffer the engine sends a `gap` instead (the IQ ring still gets the bytes).
- **Host modes.** `host: "thread"` (default) needs `dist/spectrum-worker.js` next to the running bundle and throws `SCANNER_WORKER_MISSING` otherwise. Under vitest (source tree, no `.js` worker) tests pass `host: "inline"`, which runs the same `SpectrumPipeline` synchronously on the calling thread. There is no silent fallback.
- **Untracked retunes (§ 4.7, Task 10b).** On the pipeline's `untracked-retune` event the engine records an `EngineWarning`, registers the epoch's meta as `unverified` at the caps centre, and posts **no** `PendingEpoch` (the pipeline already started that epoch and follows with `epoch-started`, `settleMode: "none"`). Drivers react in Task 35 (a sweep re-sends its hop). Task 37a adds the host-reported centre check.
- **Layering.** Everything here lives in `src/core/spectrum/` and never imports `src/core/scanner/`: settings arrive as `() => SpectrumSettings` (the scanner passes its `ScannerSettings`, a structural superset), `defaultFftSize` comes from `fft.ts`, and `EngineStateSchema` from `engine-state.ts`. `buildPipelineConfig` passes `detection.shortIntegrationMs` and `detection.overlap` through, and `EngineMasks.inWindow` reaches the pipeline's `masks` input (the worker schema validates both, since Zod strips unknown keys).
- **Assumption (Task 4, agreed with its author):** `SpectrumPipeline.handle()` never retains a view of the caller's `bytes` after returning, so buffers are recycled right after `handle`.

```ts
// tests/mocks/scanner/engine-fakes.ts
import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"
import { PassThrough } from "node:stream"
import type { BranchConfig, BranchTelemetry } from "../../../src/core/fanout-manager.js"
import type { SourceCaps } from "../../../src/config.js"
import type { TunerState } from "@wavekit/api-types"
import { ScannerConfigSchema } from "../../../src/config.js"
import type { ScannerSettings } from "../../../src/core/scanner/types.js"

/** Scanner settings from the config schema defaults, with test overrides. */
export function testSettings(
	patch: (s: ScannerSettings) => void = () => undefined,
	dir = `/tmp/wk-scanner-${process.pid}`,
): ScannerSettings {
	const parsed = ScannerConfigSchema.parse({ storage: { dir } }) as ScannerSettings
	const settings = structuredClone(parsed)
	patch(settings)
	return settings
}

/** FanoutManager double with the same drop-on-congestion accounting (fanout-manager.ts :249-323). */
export class FakeFanout extends EventEmitter {
	readonly branches = new Map<
		string,
		{ stream: PassThrough; total: number; dropped: number; bp: boolean; hwm: number }
	>()

	addBranch(config: BranchConfig): PassThrough {
		const hwm = config.highWaterMark ?? 262_144
		const stream = new PassThrough({ highWaterMark: hwm })
		stream.on("error", () => undefined)
		this.branches.set(config.id, { stream, total: 0, dropped: 0, bp: false, hwm })
		return stream
	}

	removeBranch(id: string): void {
		const branch = this.branches.get(id)
		if (!branch) return
		branch.stream.destroy()
		this.branches.delete(id)
	}

	getBranchTelemetry(id: string): BranchTelemetry | undefined {
		const b = this.branches.get(id)
		if (!b) return undefined
		return {
			id,
			backpressureActive: b.bp,
			backpressureEnterCount: 0,
			droppedBytesTotal: b.dropped,
			droppedChunksTotal: 0,
			bufferBytes: b.stream.readableLength + b.stream.writableLength,
			highWaterMark: b.hwm,
			totalBytesWritten: b.total,
		}
	}

	/** Distributes one source chunk to every branch (dropped while congested). */
	write(chunk: Buffer): void {
		for (const b of this.branches.values()) {
			b.total += chunk.length
			if (b.bp) {
				b.dropped += chunk.length
				continue
			}
			b.stream.write(chunk)
		}
	}

	congest(id: string): void {
		const b = this.branches.get(id)
		if (!b) return
		b.bp = true
		this.emit("backpressure", id, b.stream.readableLength)
	}

	drain(id: string): void {
		const b = this.branches.get(id)
		if (!b) return
		b.bp = false
		this.emit("drain", id, 0)
	}
}

export class FakeSources extends EventEmitter {
	readonly caps = new Map<string, SourceCaps>()
	readonly streams = new Map<string, PassThrough>()
	rtlTcp = new Set<string>()

	constructor(sourceId = "rtl", caps?: Partial<SourceCaps>) {
		super()
		this.caps.set(sourceId, {
			kind: "iq",
			format: "U8_IQ",
			sampleRate: 1_024_000,
			centerFreq: 446_100_000,
			exclusive: false,
			...caps,
		})
		this.streams.set(sourceId, new PassThrough())
	}

	getCaps(id: string): SourceCaps | undefined {
		return this.caps.get(id)
	}

	getStream(id: string): PassThrough | undefined {
		return this.streams.get(id)
	}

	isRtlTcpSource(id: string): boolean {
		return this.rtlTcp.has(id)
	}

	setCaps(id: string, patch: Partial<SourceCaps>): void {
		const next = { ...this.caps.get(id)!, ...patch }
		this.caps.set(id, next)
		this.emit("caps-changed", id, next)
	}
}

export class FakeTuner extends EventEmitter {
	readonly states = new Map<string, TunerState>()

	constructor(sourceId = "rtl", frequency = 446_100_000) {
		super()
		this.states.set(sourceId, {
			sourceId,
			frequency,
			sampleRate: 1_024_000,
			gainMode: "manual",
			gain: 296,
			ppm: 0,
			agcMode: false,
			biasTee: false,
			directSampling: "off",
			offsetTuning: false,
			ifGain: 0,
			tunerIfGain: null,
			testMode: false,
			controlMode: "internal",
			commandCount: 0,
		})
	}

	getState(id: string): TunerState | undefined {
		const s = this.states.get(id)
		return s ? { ...s } : undefined
	}
}

/** Lets queued stream callbacks and microtasks run. */
export function settle(): Promise<void> {
	return new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve))
}
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/spectrum-engine.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import fc from "fast-check"
import pino from "pino"
import {
	SpectrumEngine,
	type SpectrumEngineDeps,
} from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/spectrum-engine.js"
import type {
	PipelineHost,
	PipelineHostHandlers,
} from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/pipeline-host.js"
import type {
	EngineState,
	PipelineEvent,
	PipelineInput,
} from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"
import {
	addInto,
	gaussianNoise,
	mulberry32,
	packCu8,
	tone,

import {

	FakeTuner,
	settle,
	testSettings,
} from "../../../mocks/scanner/engine-fakes.js"

const logger = pino({ level: "silent" })
const EMPTY_STATE: EngineState = { version: 1, absoluteFloors: [], spurs: [], kByRange: [] }

/** Records every input the engine posts; bytes are copied because buffers are recycled. */
class RecordingHost implements PipelineHost {
	readonly inputs: PipelineInput[] = []
	constructor(readonly handlers: PipelineHostHandlers) {}
	send(input: PipelineInput, transfer?: ArrayBuffer): void {
		this.inputs.push(
			input.kind === "bytes" ? { ...input, bytes: Uint8Array.from(input.bytes) } : input,
		)
		if (transfer) this.handlers.buffer(transfer)
	}
	exportState(): Promise<EngineState> {
		return Promise.resolve(EMPTY_STATE)
	}
	close(): Promise<void> {
		return Promise.resolve()
	}
}

function makeEngine(extra: Partial<SpectrumEngineDeps> = {}) {
	const sources = new FakeSources()
	const fanout = new FakeFanout()
	const tuner = new FakeTuner()
	const hosts: RecordingHost[] = []
	const engine = new SpectrumEngine({
		sourceId: "rtl",
		sources,
		routing: { getFanout: () => fanout as never, releaseUnused: () => undefined },
		tuner,
		settings: () => testSettings(s => { s.sweep.settleMs.network = 100 }),
		logger,
		createHost: (_cfg, handlers) => {
			const host = new RecordingHost(handlers)
			hosts.push(host)
			return host
		},
		batchBytes: 4096,
		...extra,
	})
	return { engine, sources, fanout, tuner, hosts }
}

/** Rebuilds each stream's sample bytes from posted inputs; gaps stay `null`. */
function rebuild(inputs: PipelineInput[]): { stream: number; bytes: (number | null)[] }[] {
	const streams: { stream: number; bytes: (number | null)[] }[] = []
	for (const input of inputs) {
		if (input.kind === "new-stream") {
			streams.push({ stream: input.stream, bytes: [] })
			continue
		}
		const current = streams.at(-1)
		if (!current) continue
		if (input.kind === "bytes") {
			expect(input.startSample * 2).toBe(current.bytes.length)
			for (const b of input.bytes) current.bytes.push(b)
		} else if (input.kind === "gap") {
			expect(input.startSample * 2).toBe(current.bytes.length)
			for (let i = 0; i < input.samples * 2; i++) current.bytes.push(null)
		}
	}
	return streams
}

describe("SpectrumEngine sample accounting", () => {
	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 6: Epoch and gap accounting
	// Validates: spec § 4.1, § 4.6
	it("keeps absolute indices consistent across fanout drops and reconnects", async () => {
		await fc.assert(
			fc.asyncProperty(
				fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 2 ** 31 - 1 }),
				fc.array(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 1500 }), { minLength: 4, maxLength: 24 }),
				fc.array(fc.tuple(fc.nat(23), fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 3 })), { maxLength: 3 }),
				fc.option(fc.nat(23), { nil: null }),
				async (seed, chunkSamples, congestions, reconnectAt) => {
					const { engine, sources, fanout, hosts } = makeEngine()
					await engine.start()
					const rng = mulberry32(seed)
					const sent: { stream: number; bytes: number[]; dropped: boolean[] }[] = [
						{ stream: 0, bytes: [], dropped: [] },
					]
					let congestedUntil = -1
					for (let i = 0; i < chunkSamples.length; i++) {
						if (reconnectAt === i) {
							await settle()
							sources.emit("disconnected", "rtl")
							sent.push({ stream: sent.length, bytes: [], dropped: [] })
						}
						const episode = congestions.find(([at]) => at === i)
						if (episode && congestedUntil < i) {
							await settle()
							fanout.congest("scanner-rtl")
							congestedUntil = i + episode[1] - 1
						}
						const chunk = Buffer.alloc(chunkSamples[i]! * 2)
						for (let j = 0; j < chunk.length; j++) chunk[j] = Math.floor(rng() * 256)
						const dropped = congestedUntil >= i
						fanout.write(chunk)
						const cur = sent.at(-1)!
						for (const b of chunk) {
							cur.bytes.push(b)
							cur.dropped.push(dropped)
						}
						if (congestedUntil === i) fanout.drain("scanner-rtl")
						if (reconnectAt === i) sources.emit("payload-started", "rtl")
					}
					// An episode running past the last chunk still ends (and reports its drops).
					await settle()
					if (congestedUntil >= chunkSamples.length) fanout.drain("scanner-rtl")
					await settle()
					await engine.stop()
					const streams = rebuild(hosts[0]!.inputs)
					expect(streams.map(s => s.stream)).toEqual(
						[...streams.map(s => s.stream)].sort((a, b) => a - b),
					)
					expect(new Set(streams.map(s => s.stream)).size).toBe(streams.length)
					expect(streams).toHaveLength(sent.length)
					for (let k = 0; k < sent.length; k++) {
						const got = streams[k]!.bytes
						const want = sent[k]!
						expect(got).toHaveLength(want.bytes.length)
						for (let j = 0; j < got.length; j++) {
							if (want.dropped[j]) expect(got[j]).toBeNull()
							else expect(got[j]).toBe(want.bytes[j])
						}
					}
				},
			),
			{ numRuns: 100, seed: 0x5ca7 },
		)
	})

	it("serves ring reads by absolute sample index after a drop", async () => {
		const { engine, fanout } = makeEngine()
		await engine.start()
		const a = Buffer.alloc(2000, 1)
		const b = Buffer.alloc(2000, 2)
		const c = Buffer.alloc(2000, 3)
		fanout.write(a)
		await settle()
		fanout.congest("scanner-rtl")
		fanout.write(b)
		fanout.drain("scanner-rtl")
		fanout.write(c)
		await settle()
		expect(engine.liveEdge()).toBe(3000)
		const read = engine.readRing(2000, 3000)
		expect(read?.startSample).toBe(2000)
		expect([...(read?.bytes ?? [])].every(v => v === 3)).toBe(true)
		const across = engine.readRing(500, 3000)
		expect(across?.startSample).toBe(2000)
		await engine.stop()
	})

	it("splits a drop episode that spans a reconnect between the two streams", async () => {
		const { engine, sources, fanout, hosts } = makeEngine()
		await engine.start()
		fanout.write(Buffer.alloc(1000, 1))
		await settle()
		fanout.congest("scanner-rtl")
		fanout.write(Buffer.alloc(600, 2))
		sources.emit("disconnected", "rtl")
		fanout.write(Buffer.alloc(400, 3))
		fanout.drain("scanner-rtl")
		sources.emit("payload-started", "rtl")
		fanout.write(Buffer.alloc(200, 4))
		await settle()
		await engine.stop()
		const streams = rebuild(hosts[0]!.inputs)
		expect(streams.map(s => s.bytes.length)).toEqual([1600, 600])
		expect(streams[0]!.bytes.slice(1000).every(b => b === null)).toBe(true)
		expect(streams[1]!.bytes.slice(0, 400).every(b => b === null)).toBe(true)
		expect(streams[1]!.bytes.slice(400).every(b => b === 4)).toBe(true)
	})

	it("keeps bytes still buffered in the branch at a disconnect in the old stream", async () => {
		const { engine, sources, fanout, hosts } = makeEngine()
		await engine.start()
		fanout.write(Buffer.alloc(1000, 1))
		sources.emit("disconnected", "rtl")
		fanout.write(Buffer.alloc(200, 2))
		sources.emit("payload-started", "rtl")
		await settle()
		await engine.stop()
		const streams = rebuild(hosts[0]!.inputs)
		expect(streams.map(s => s.bytes.length)).toEqual([1000, 200])
		expect(streams[0]!.bytes.every(b => b === 1)).toBe(true)
		expect(streams[1]!.bytes.every(b => b === 2)).toBe(true)
	})

	it("posts one timer-mode epoch for an external retune before any later bytes", async () => {
		const { engine, sources, fanout, tuner, hosts } = makeEngine()
		await engine.start()
		fanout.write(Buffer.alloc(4000, 7))
		await settle()
		tuner.emit("command-sent", "rtl", "set-frequency", 446_300_000, "rest")
		sources.setCaps("rtl", { centerFreq: 446_300_000 })
		fanout.write(Buffer.alloc(4000, 9))
		await settle()
		const inputs = hosts[0]!.inputs
		const pendings = inputs.filter(i => i.kind === "pending-epoch")
		expect(pendings).toHaveLength(1)
		const p = pendings[0]!.kind === "pending-epoch" ? pendings[0]!.pending : null
		expect(p).toMatchObject({
			commandSample: 2000,
			expectMarker: false,
			settleSamples: Math.round((100 * 1_024_000) / 1000),
			centreHz: 446_300_000,
			tuningTrust: "commanded",
			centreChanged: true,
		})
		const at = inputs.findIndex(i => i.kind === "pending-epoch")
		const laterBytes = inputs.slice(at + 1).filter(i => i.kind === "bytes")
		expect(laterBytes.every(i => i.kind === "bytes" && i.startSample >= 2000)).toBe(true)
		const earlier = inputs.slice(0, at).filter(i => i.kind === "bytes")
		expect(earlier.every(i => i.kind === "bytes" && i.startSample < 2000)).toBe(true)
		await engine.stop()
	})

	it("ignores the scanner's own commands while suppressed", async () => {
		const { engine, sources, tuner, hosts } = makeEngine()
		await engine.start()
		engine.suppressExternal(true)
		tuner.emit("command-sent", "rtl", "set-frequency", 446_500_000, "scanner")
		sources.setCaps("rtl", { centerFreq: 446_500_000 })
		engine.suppressExternal(false)
		await settle()
		expect(hosts[0]!.inputs.filter(i => i.kind === "pending-epoch")).toHaveLength(0)
		await engine.stop()
	})

	it("recreates the pipeline as a new stream when the sample rate changes", async () => {
		const { engine, sources, hosts } = makeEngine()
		await engine.start()
		sources.setCaps("rtl", { sampleRate: 2_048_000 })
		await settle()
		await settle()
		expect(hosts).toHaveLength(2)
		const ns = hosts[1]!.inputs.find(i => i.kind === "new-stream")
		expect(ns).toMatchObject({ kind: "new-stream", stream: 1, sampleRateHz: 2_048_000 })
		await engine.stop()
	})
})

describe("SpectrumEngine with the real pipeline (inline host)", () => {
	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 6: Epoch and gap accounting
	// Validates: spec § 4.6
	it("opens tracks of a retuned epoch only after its settled start, at the new RF", async () => {
		const fs = 1_024_000
		const sources = new FakeSources("rtl", { sampleRate: fs })
		const fanout = new FakeFanout()
		const tuner = new FakeTuner()
		const events: PipelineEvent[] = []
		const engine = new SpectrumEngine({
			sourceId: "rtl",
			sources,
			routing: { getFanout: () => fanout as never, releaseUnused: () => undefined },
			tuner,
			settings: () => testSettings(s => { s.sweep.settleMs.network = 100 }),
			logger,
			host: "inline",
		})
		engine.on("pipeline", (ev: PipelineEvent) => events.push(ev))
		await engine.start()
		const rng = mulberry32(42)
		const write = (n: number) => {
			const iq = addInto(gaussianNoise(rng, n, 0.05), tone(n, fs, 100_000, 0.5))
			fanout.write(Buffer.from(packCu8(iq.re, iq.im)))
		}
		for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) write(fs / 20)
		await settle()
		const commandSample = engine.liveEdge()
		tuner.emit("command-sent", "rtl", "set-frequency", 446_300_000, "rest")
		sources.setCaps("rtl", { centerFreq: 446_300_000 })
		for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) write(fs / 20)
		await settle()
		await engine.stop()
		const started = events.filter(
			(e): e is Extract<PipelineEvent, { kind: "epoch-started" }> =>
				e.kind === "epoch-started" && e.settleMode === "timer",
		)
		expect(started).toHaveLength(1)
		const epoch = started[0]!
		expect(epoch.startSample).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(commandSample + Math.round(0.1 * fs))
		const opened = events.filter(
			(e): e is Extract<PipelineEvent, { kind: "track-open" }> =>
				e.kind === "track-open" && e.track.epoch === epoch.epoch,
		)
		expect(opened.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
		for (const e of opened) {
			expect(e.track.startSample).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(epoch.startSample)
			expect(Math.abs(e.track.centreHz - 446_400_000)).toBeLessThan(2_000)
		}
	})
})

describe("SpectrumEngine untracked retunes (§ 4.7)", () => {
	it("marks an untracked retune unverified without posting an epoch of its own", async () => {
		const { engine, hosts } = makeEngine()
		await engine.start()
		const host = hosts[0]!
		const before = host.inputs.length
		host.handlers.events([
			{ kind: "untracked-retune", epoch: 7, startSample: 4096, deltaHz: -12_500 },
			{ kind: "epoch-started", epoch: 7, startSample: 4096, settleMode: "none" },
		])
		expect(host.inputs.slice(before).filter(i => i.kind === "pending-epoch")).toEqual([])
		expect(engine.currentEpoch()).toMatchObject({ epoch: 7, tuningTrust: "unverified", startSample: 4096 })
		expect(engine.warnings()).toEqual([{ code: "untracked-retune", deltaHz: -12_500, at: expect.any(Number) }])
		await engine.stop()
	})
})
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/spectrum/spectrum-worker-build.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { existsSync } from "node:fs"
import { resolve } from "node:path"
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url"
import pino from "pino"
import { InlinePipelineHost, ThreadPipelineHost } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/pipeline-host.js"
import { buildPipelineConfig } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/spectrum-engine.js"
import type { PipelineEvent } from "../../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"
import { gaussianNoise, mulberry32, packCu8 } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import { testSettings } from "../../../mocks/scanner/engine-fakes.js"

const WORKER = resolve("dist/spectrum-worker.js")

// Runs after `pnpm run build`; skipped on a clean checkout.
describe.skipIf(!existsSync(WORKER))("built spectrum worker", () => {
	it("runs the pipeline off-thread, returns transferred buffers and exports state", async () => {
		const fs = 1_024_000
		const cfg = buildPipelineConfig("rtl", "U8_IQ", fs, testSettings(), {
			fftSize: null,
			integrationMs: null,
			thresholdDb: null,
			sensitivity: null,
		})
		const events: PipelineEvent[] = []
		const returned: ArrayBuffer[] = []
		const errors: Error[] = []
		const host = new ThreadPipelineHost(
			cfg,
			{
				events: evs => events.push(...evs),
				buffer: buf => returned.push(buf),
				error: err => errors.push(err),
			},
			pathToFileURL(WORKER),
			pino({ level: "silent" }),
		)
		host.send({
			kind: "new-stream",
			stream: 0,
			centreHz: 446_100_000,
			sampleRateHz: fs,
			gainKey: "m:296",
			tuningTrust: "commanded",
		})
		const iq = gaussianNoise(mulberry32(7), fs / 4, 0.05)
		const bytes = packCu8(iq.re, iq.im)
		const buf = new ArrayBuffer(bytes.length)
		new Uint8Array(buf).set(bytes)
		host.send({ kind: "bytes", startSample: 0, bytes: new Uint8Array(buf) }, buf)
		expect(buf.byteLength).toBe(0)
		const state = await host.exportState()
		expect(state.version).toBe(1)
		// Artefact masks cross by structured clone (Task 35a): equal to an inline pipeline fed the same input.
		const inline = new InlinePipelineHost(cfg, { events: () => undefined, buffer: () => undefined, error: err => errors.push(err) })
		inline.send({ kind: "new-stream", stream: 0, centreHz: 446_100_000, sampleRateHz: fs, gainKey: "m:296", tuningTrust: "commanded" })
		inline.send({ kind: "bytes", startSample: 0, bytes: Uint8Array.from(bytes) })
		expect(await host.artefactMasks()).toEqual(await inline.artefactMasks())
		await inline.close()
		expect(returned.map(b => b.byteLength)).toEqual([bytes.length])
		expect(events.some(e => e.kind === "epoch-started")).toBe(true)
		await host.close()
		expect(errors).toEqual([])
	})
})
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the build changes**

`scripts/build-file.mjs`: replace the `entryPoints.push(arg)` line and the `entryPoints` option so every entry is written flat as `dist/<basename>.js` (a single entry keeps producing `dist/index.js`; two entries would otherwise be laid out under their common ancestor, `dist/core/spectrum/…`):

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
import { build, context } from "esbuild"
import { basename, extname } from "node:path"
import process from "node:process"

const args = process.argv.slice(2)
let watch = false
const entryPoints = []

for (const arg of args) {
	if (arg.startsWith("--watch")) {
		watch = true
		continue
	}
	if (arg.startsWith("-")) continue
	// Flat output: dist/<name>.js for every entry, so dist/index.js can load
	// dist/spectrum-worker.js with new URL("./spectrum-worker.js", import.meta.url).
	entryPoints.push({ in: arg, out: basename(arg, extname(arg)) })
}

if (entryPoints.length === 0) {
	console.error(
		"Missing entry file. Example: pnpm run build-file ./src/index.ts",
	)
	process.exit(1)
}

const options = {
	entryPoints,
	bundle: true,
	outdir: "dist",
	platform: "node",
	format: "esm",
	packages: "external",
}

if (watch) {
	const ctx = await context(options)
	await ctx.watch()
	await new Promise(() => {})
} else {
	await build(options)
}
```

```ts
// src/core/spectrum/worker-protocol.ts
/**
 * Messages between SpectrumEngine (main thread) and the spectrum worker.
 * Inbound worker messages are validated with Zod; outbound events are
 * produced by SpectrumPipeline and only checked for their envelope.
 */
import { z } from "zod"
import type { ArtefactMasks } from "./artefacts.js"
import { EngineStateSchema } from "./engine-state.js"
import type {
	EngineState,
	PipelineConfig,
	PipelineEvent,
	PipelineInput,
} from "./types.js"

const FreqRangeSchema = z.object({ startHz: z.number(), endHz: z.number() })
const RasterSchema = z.object({
	spacingHz: z.number().positive(),
	firstChannelHz: z.number(),
})
const TuningTrustSchema = z.enum(["commanded", "relay", "unverified"])

export const PipelineConfigSchema = z.object({
	sourceId: z.string().min(1),
	format: z.enum(["U8_IQ", "S16_IQ", "FLOAT32LE"]),
	sampleRateHz: z.number().positive(),
	fftSize: z.number().int().min(512).max(16384),
	integrationMs: z.number().positive(),
	usableFraction: z.number().gt(0).max(1),
	dcGuardHz: z.number().nonnegative(),
	ppmMargin: z.number().nonnegative(),
	hysteresisDb: z.number().nonnegative(),
	clipFraction: z.number().gt(0).max(1),
	minSurfaceBlocks: z.number().int().min(1),
	thresholdDb: z.number().nullable(),
	faTargetPerMhzMin: z.number().positive(),
	spectrumBins: z.number().int().min(16).max(4096),
	trackHangMs: z.number().nonnegative(),
	maxTracks: z.number().int().positive(),
	maxTrackMs: z.number().positive(),
	shortIntegrationMs: z.number().positive().nullable().optional(),
	overlap: z.union([z.literal(0), z.literal(0.5)]).optional(),
	persistedEngine: EngineStateSchema.optional(),
})

const PendingEpochSchema = z.object({
	epoch: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	commandSample: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	bufferedSamples: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	settleSamples: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	expectMarker: z.boolean(),
	markerTimeoutSamples: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	pllSettleSamples: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	centreHz: z.number(),
	sampleRateHz: z.number().positive(),
	gainKey: z.string(),
	tuningTrust: TuningTrustSchema,
	centreChanged: z.boolean(),
})

export const PipelineInputSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
	z.object({
		kind: z.literal("bytes"),
		startSample: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
		bytes: z.instanceof(Uint8Array),
	}),
	z.object({
		kind: z.literal("gap"),
		startSample: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
		samples: z.number().int().positive(),
	}),
	z.object({ kind: z.literal("pending-epoch"), pending: PendingEpochSchema }),
	z.object({
		kind: z.literal("new-stream"),
		stream: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
		centreHz: z.number(),
		sampleRateHz: z.number().positive(),
		gainKey: z.string(),
		tuningTrust: TuningTrustSchema,
	}),
	z.object({
		kind: z.literal("masks"),
		exclusions: z.array(FreqRangeSchema),
		cfarRanges: z.array(FreqRangeSchema),
		burstRanges: z.array(FreqRangeSchema),
		rasters: z.array(RasterSchema),
		obwHz: z.array(z.number().positive()),
		inWindow: z.boolean(),
	}),
	z.object({ kind: z.literal("spectrum-feed"), enabled: z.boolean() }),
])

export const MainToWorkerSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
	z.object({ type: z.literal("init"), config: PipelineConfigSchema }),
	z.object({ type: z.literal("input"), input: PipelineInputSchema }),
	z.object({
		type: z.literal("export-state"),
		requestId: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	}),
	z.object({
		type: z.literal("artefact-masks"),
		requestId: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
	}),
	z.object({ type: z.literal("close") }),
])

export type MainToWorker =
	| { type: "init"; config: PipelineConfig }
	| { type: "input"; input: PipelineInput }
	| { type: "export-state"; requestId: number }
	| { type: "artefact-masks"; requestId: number }
	| { type: "close" }

export type WorkerToMain =
	| { type: "events"; events: PipelineEvent[] }
	| { type: "buffer"; buffer: ArrayBuffer }
	| { type: "engine-state"; requestId: number; state: EngineState }
	| { type: "artefact-masks"; requestId: number; masks: ArtefactMasks }
	| { type: "error"; message: string }

/** Envelope check for worker → main messages (events come from SpectrumPipeline). */
export const WorkerToMainSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
	z.object({
		type: z.literal("events"),
		events: z.array(
			z.custom<PipelineEvent>(
				v => typeof v === "object" && v !== null && "kind" in v,
			),
		),
	}),
	z.object({ type: z.literal("buffer"), buffer: z.instanceof(ArrayBuffer) }),
	z.object({
		type: z.literal("engine-state"),
		requestId: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
		state: EngineStateSchema,
	}),
	z.object({
		type: z.literal("artefact-masks"),
		requestId: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
		// Built by SpectrumPipeline.artefactMasks() (plain data, Task 7a): envelope check only, like `events`.
		masks: z.custom<ArtefactMasks>(v => typeof v === "object" && v !== null && "epoch" in v),
	}),
	z.object({ type: z.literal("error"), message: z.string() }),
])
```

```ts
// src/core/spectrum/spectrum-worker.ts
/**
 * worker_threads entry (built to dist/spectrum-worker.js). A thin wrapper:
 * every validated input goes to SpectrumPipeline.handle(), events go back,
 * and each transferred byte buffer is transferred back for reuse.
 */
import { parentPort } from "node:worker_threads"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../utils/errors.js"
import type { PipelineConfig, PipelineEvent, PipelineInput } from "./types.js"
import { SpectrumPipeline } from "./pipeline.js"
import { MainToWorkerSchema, type WorkerToMain } from "./worker-protocol.js"

const port = parentPort
if (!port) {
	throw new WaveKitError(
		"spectrum-worker must run inside a worker thread",
		"SCANNER_WORKER_CONTEXT",
	)
}

let pipeline: SpectrumPipeline | null = null

function post(message: WorkerToMain, transfer: ArrayBuffer[] = []): void {
	port!.postMessage(message, transfer)
}

function errorMessage(err: unknown): string {
	return err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
}

/** Hands back the buffer of a bytes input even when the message was rejected. */
function returnBuffer(raw: unknown): void {
	if (typeof raw !== "object" || raw === null) return
	const input = (raw as { input?: { bytes?: unknown } }).input
	if (input?.bytes instanceof Uint8Array) {
		const buffer = input.bytes.buffer as ArrayBuffer
		post({ type: "buffer", buffer }, [buffer])
	}
}

port.on("message", (raw: unknown) => {
	const parsed = MainToWorkerSchema.safeParse(raw)
	if (!parsed.success) {
		post({ type: "error", message: `invalid worker message: ${parsed.error.message}` })
		returnBuffer(raw)
		return
	}
	const message = parsed.data
	switch (message.type) {
		case "init":
			pipeline = new SpectrumPipeline(message.config as PipelineConfig)
			return
		case "input": {
			const input = message.input as PipelineInput
			if (!pipeline) {
				post({ type: "error", message: "input before init" })
			} else {
				let events: PipelineEvent[] = []
				try {
					events = pipeline.handle(input)
				} catch (err) {
					post({ type: "error", message: errorMessage(err) })
				}
				if (events.length > 0) post({ type: "events", events })
			}
			if (input.kind === "bytes") {
				const buffer = input.bytes.buffer as ArrayBuffer
				post({ type: "buffer", buffer }, [buffer])
			}
			return
		}
		case "export-state":
			if (!pipeline) {
				post({ type: "error", message: "export-state before init" })
				return
			}
			post({
				type: "engine-state",
				requestId: message.requestId,
				state: pipeline.exportEngineState(),
			})
			return
		case "artefact-masks":
			if (!pipeline) {
				post({ type: "error", message: "artefact-masks before init" })
				return
			}
			// Answered after every input posted before the request (messages are ordered).
			post({ type: "artefact-masks", requestId: message.requestId, masks: pipeline.artefactMasks() })
			return
		case "close":
			pipeline = null
			port.close()
			return
	}
})
```

```ts
// src/core/spectrum/pipeline-host.ts
/**
 * Where SpectrumPipeline runs: a worker thread (production) or inline on the
 * calling thread (tests, which run from the source tree without a built
 * worker). Both hosts have the same contract: inputs in order, events out,
 * transferred buffers handed back through `handlers.buffer`.
 */
import { existsSync } from "node:fs"
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url"
import { Worker } from "node:worker_threads"
import { createComponentLogger, type Logger } from "../../utils/logger.js"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../utils/errors.js"
import type {
	EngineState,
	PipelineConfig,
	PipelineEvent,
	PipelineInput,
} from "./types.js"
import type { ArtefactMasks } from "./artefacts.js"
import { SpectrumPipeline } from "./pipeline.js"
import { WorkerToMainSchema, type MainToWorker } from "./worker-protocol.js"

export interface PipelineHostHandlers {
	events(events: PipelineEvent[]): void
	buffer(buffer: ArrayBuffer): void
	error(err: Error): void
}

export interface PipelineHost {
	/** Posts one input; `transfer` (the bytes' ArrayBuffer) is detached by the call. */
	send(input: PipelineInput, transfer?: ArrayBuffer): void
	exportState(): Promise<EngineState>
	/** Current artefact masks (§ 4.9) after every input sent before the call (identify, Task 35a). Optional: test hosts need not implement it. */
	artefactMasks?(): Promise<ArtefactMasks>
	close(): Promise<void>
}

export type PipelineHostMode = "thread" | "inline"

const CLOSE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000
const EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000

/** dist/index.js → dist/spectrum-worker.js (both built flat by scripts/build-file.mjs). */
export function defaultWorkerUrl(): URL {
	return new URL("./spectrum-worker.js", import.meta.url)
}

function asError(err: unknown): Error {
	return err instanceof Error ? err : new WaveKitError(String(err), "SCANNER_PIPELINE_ERROR")
}

export class InlinePipelineHost implements PipelineHost {
	private pipeline: SpectrumPipeline | null

	constructor(
		cfg: PipelineConfig,
		private readonly handlers: PipelineHostHandlers,
	) {
		this.pipeline = new SpectrumPipeline(cfg)
	}

	send(input: PipelineInput, transfer?: ArrayBuffer): void {
		if (!this.pipeline) {
			if (transfer) this.handlers.buffer(transfer)
			return
		}
		let events: PipelineEvent[] = []
		try {
			events = this.pipeline.handle(input)
		} catch (err) {
			this.handlers.error(asError(err))
		}
		if (transfer) this.handlers.buffer(transfer)
		if (events.length > 0) this.handlers.events(events)
	}

	exportState(): Promise<EngineState> {
		if (!this.pipeline) {
			return Promise.reject(
				new WaveKitError("Pipeline host closed", "SCANNER_PIPELINE_CLOSED"),
			)
		}
		return Promise.resolve(this.pipeline.exportEngineState())
	}

	artefactMasks(): Promise<ArtefactMasks> {
		if (!this.pipeline) {
			return Promise.reject(
				new WaveKitError("Pipeline host closed", "SCANNER_PIPELINE_CLOSED"),
			)
		}
		return Promise.resolve(this.pipeline.artefactMasks())
	}

	close(): Promise<void> {
		this.pipeline = null
		return Promise.resolve()
	}
}

export class ThreadPipelineHost implements PipelineHost {
	private readonly worker: Worker
	private readonly log: Logger
	private readonly exports = new Map<
		number,
		{ resolve: (s: EngineState) => void; reject: (e: Error) => void; timer: NodeJS.Timeout }
	>()
	private readonly maskRequests = new Map<
		number,
		{ resolve: (m: ArtefactMasks) => void; reject: (e: Error) => void; timer: NodeJS.Timeout }
	>()
	private nextRequestId = 0
	private closing = false
	private exited = false

	constructor(
		cfg: PipelineConfig,
		private readonly handlers: PipelineHostHandlers,
		workerUrl: URL,
		logger: Logger,
	) {
		this.log = createComponentLogger(logger, "SpectrumWorkerHost")
		if (!existsSync(fileURLToPath(workerUrl))) {
			throw new WaveKitError(
				`Spectrum worker not found at ${fileURLToPath(workerUrl)}; run pnpm run build`,
				"SCANNER_WORKER_MISSING",
			)
		}
		this.worker = new Worker(workerUrl, { name: `spectrum-${cfg.sourceId}` })
		this.worker.on("message", (raw: unknown) => this.onMessage(raw))
		this.worker.on("error", err => this.handlers.error(asError(err))) // @types/node types the listener arg as unknown
		this.worker.on("exit", code => {
			this.exited = true
			for (const [id, pending] of this.exports) {
				clearTimeout(pending.timer)
				pending.reject(new WaveKitError("Spectrum worker exited", "SCANNER_WORKER_EXIT"))
				this.exports.delete(id)
			}
			for (const [id, pending] of this.maskRequests) {
				clearTimeout(pending.timer)
				pending.reject(new WaveKitError("Spectrum worker exited", "SCANNER_WORKER_EXIT"))
				this.maskRequests.delete(id)
			}
			if (!this.closing) {
				this.handlers.error(
					new WaveKitError(`Spectrum worker exited with code ${code}`, "SCANNER_WORKER_EXIT"),
				)
			}
		})
		this.post({ type: "init", config: cfg })
	}

	send(input: PipelineInput, transfer?: ArrayBuffer): void {
		if (this.exited) {
			if (transfer) this.handlers.buffer(transfer)
			return
		}
		this.post({ type: "input", input }, transfer ? [transfer] : [])
	}

	exportState(): Promise<EngineState> {
		if (this.exited) {
			return Promise.reject(new WaveKitError("Spectrum worker exited", "SCANNER_WORKER_EXIT"))
		}
		const requestId = this.nextRequestId++
		return new Promise<EngineState>((resolve, reject) => {
			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
				this.exports.delete(requestId)
				reject(new WaveKitError("Spectrum worker state export timed out", "SCANNER_WORKER_TIMEOUT"))
			}, EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS)
			this.exports.set(requestId, { resolve, reject, timer })
			this.post({ type: "export-state", requestId })
		})
	}

	artefactMasks(): Promise<ArtefactMasks> {
		if (this.exited) {
			return Promise.reject(new WaveKitError("Spectrum worker exited", "SCANNER_WORKER_EXIT"))
		}
		const requestId = this.nextRequestId++
		return new Promise<ArtefactMasks>((resolve, reject) => {
			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
				this.maskRequests.delete(requestId)
				reject(new WaveKitError("Spectrum worker artefact masks timed out", "SCANNER_WORKER_TIMEOUT"))
			}, EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS)
			this.maskRequests.set(requestId, { resolve, reject, timer })
			this.post({ type: "artefact-masks", requestId })
		})
	}

	async close(): Promise<void> {
		if (this.exited) return
		this.closing = true
		const exited = new Promise<void>(resolve => this.worker.once("exit", () => resolve()))
		this.post({ type: "close" })
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			void this.worker.terminate().catch((err: unknown) => {
				this.log.warn({ err }, "Spectrum worker terminate failed")
			})
		}, CLOSE_TIMEOUT_MS)
		await exited
		clearTimeout(timer)
	}

	private post(message: MainToWorker, transfer: ArrayBuffer[] = []): void {
		this.worker.postMessage(message, transfer)
	}

	private onMessage(raw: unknown): void {
		const parsed = WorkerToMainSchema.safeParse(raw)
		if (!parsed.success) {
			this.handlers.error(
				new WaveKitError(`Invalid spectrum worker message: ${parsed.error.message}`, "SCANNER_WORKER_PROTOCOL"),
			)
			return
		}
		const message = parsed.data
		switch (message.type) {
			case "events":
				this.handlers.events(message.events)
				return
			case "buffer":
				this.handlers.buffer(message.buffer)
				return
			case "engine-state": {
				const pending = this.exports.get(message.requestId)
				if (!pending) return
				clearTimeout(pending.timer)
				this.exports.delete(message.requestId)
				pending.resolve(message.state as EngineState)
				return
			}
			case "artefact-masks": {
				const pending = this.maskRequests.get(message.requestId)
				if (!pending) return
				clearTimeout(pending.timer)
				this.maskRequests.delete(message.requestId)
				pending.resolve(message.masks as ArtefactMasks)
				return
			}
			case "error":
				this.handlers.error(new WaveKitError(message.message, "SCANNER_WORKER_ERROR"))
				return
		}
	}
}

export function createPipelineHost(
	mode: PipelineHostMode,
	cfg: PipelineConfig,
	handlers: PipelineHostHandlers,
	opts: { workerUrl?: URL; logger: Logger },
): PipelineHost {
	return mode === "inline"
		? new InlinePipelineHost(cfg, handlers)
		: new ThreadPipelineHost(cfg, handlers, opts.workerUrl ?? defaultWorkerUrl(), opts.logger)
}
```
