```ts
// src/core/spectrum/spectrum-engine.ts
/**
 * One per source with at least one consumer (scanner jobs, `spectrum` WS
 * subscribers; spec § 3, § 4.1).
 * Owns the fanout branch `scanner-${sourceId}`, the absolute sample index of
 * each stream (received + dropped samples), the IQ ring, the pipeline host
 * and the epoch triggers (§ 4.6). Implements EpochClock for the arbiter.
 */
import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"
import type { Readable } from "node:stream"
import type { TunerCommandOrigin, TunerState } from "@wavekit/api-types"
import type { SourceCaps } from "../../config.js"
import type { BranchTelemetry, FanoutManager } from "../fanout-manager.js"
import type { SourceFanoutRouter } from "../source-fanout-router.js"
import type { SourceManager } from "../source-manager.js"
import type { TunerController } from "../tuner-controller.js"
import { createComponentLogger, type Logger } from "../../utils/logger.js"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../utils/errors.js"
import { defaultFftSize } from "./fft.js"
import type {
	EngineState,
	FreqRange,
	IqFormat,
	PendingEpoch,
	PipelineConfig,
	PipelineEvent,
	PipelineInput,
	PipelineStats,
	Raster,
	SpectrumSettings,
	SettleMode,
	TuningTrust,
} from "./types.js"
import { bytesPerSample } from "./frame-source.js"
import type { ArtefactMasks } from "./artefacts.js"
import { IqRing } from "./iq-ring.js"
import {
	createPipelineHost,
	type PipelineHost,
	type PipelineHostHandlers,
	type PipelineHostMode,
} from "./pipeline-host.js"

/** Pre-channelizer usable fraction of the captured span (§ 5.3). */
export const USABLE_FRACTION = 0.8
export const SCANNER_BRANCH_HWM = 262_144
export const MAX_INFLIGHT_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024
const DEFAULT_BATCH_BYTES = 131_072
const BATCH_FLUSH_MS = 20

/** Commands that change what the samples mean (§ 4.6). */
const EPOCH_COMMANDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
	"set-frequency",
	"set-sample-rate",
	"set-gain-mode",
	"set-gain",
	"set-freq-correction",
	"set-if-gain",
	"set-agc-mode",
	"set-direct-sampling",
	"set-offset-tuning",
	"set-rtl-xtal",
	"set-tuner-xtal",
	"set-tuner-gain-index",
	"set-tuner-if-gain",
])

const IQ_FORMATS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["U8_IQ", "S16_IQ", "FLOAT32LE"])

export interface EngineTuning {
	fftSize: number | null
	integrationMs: number | null
	thresholdDb: number | null
	sensitivity: "low" | "normal" | "high" | null
}

export const DEFAULT_TUNING: EngineTuning = {
	fftSize: null,
	integrationMs: null,
	thresholdDb: null,
	sensitivity: null,
}

export interface EngineEpoch {
	stream: number
	epoch: number
	startSample: number | null
	centreHz: number
	sampleRateHz: number
	gainKey: string
	tuningTrust: TuningTrust
	settleMode: SettleMode | null
}

export interface EngineMasks {
	exclusions: FreqRange[]
	cfarRanges: FreqRange[]
	burstRanges: FreqRange[]
	rasters: Raster[]
	obwHz: number[]
	/** True while no sweep lease holds the source (§ 6.2: truncated segments report as `edge`). */
	inWindow: boolean
}

/** Trust warning (§ 4.7). Task 37a adds the `host-centre-mismatch` source. */
export interface EngineWarning {
	code: "untracked-retune" | "host-centre-mismatch"
	deltaHz: number | null
	at: number
}

const MAX_WARNINGS = 16

/** What the arbiter needs from the engine of a leased source (Task 33). */
export interface EpochClock {
	sampleClock(): { commandSample: number; bufferedSamples: number; sampleRateHz: number }
	allocateEpoch(): number
	submitEpoch(pending: PendingEpoch): void
	suppressExternal(on: boolean): void
	currentEpoch(): EngineEpoch
	readonly markerSupported: boolean | null
}

export interface SpectrumEngineDeps {
	sourceId: string
	sources: Pick<SourceManager, "getCaps" | "getStream"> & Pick<EventEmitter, "on" | "off">
	routing: Pick<SourceFanoutRouter, "getFanout" | "releaseUnused">
	tuner: (Pick<TunerController, "getState"> & Pick<EventEmitter, "on" | "off">) | null
	settings: () => SpectrumSettings
	tuning?: () => EngineTuning
	logger: Logger
	host?: PipelineHostMode
	workerUrl?: URL
	persistedEngine?: EngineState
	createHost?: (cfg: PipelineConfig, handlers: PipelineHostHandlers) => PipelineHost
	batchBytes?: number
}

export function isScannerIqFormat(caps: SourceCaps | undefined): caps is SourceCaps & { format: IqFormat } {
	return (
		caps !== undefined &&
		(caps.kind === "iq" || caps.kind === "recording") &&
		IQ_FORMATS.has(caps.format)
	)
}

export function gainKeyOf(state: TunerState | undefined): string {
	if (!state) return "na"
	return state.gainMode === "manual" ? `m:${state.gain}` : "agc"
}

export function buildPipelineConfig(
	sourceId: string,
	format: IqFormat,
	sampleRateHz: number,
	s: SpectrumSettings,
	tuning: EngineTuning,
	persisted?: EngineState,
): PipelineConfig {
	const sensitivity = tuning.sensitivity ?? s.detection.sensitivity
	const fftSize =
		tuning.fftSize ??
		(s.detection.fftSize === "auto" ? defaultFftSize(sampleRateHz) : s.detection.fftSize)
	const integrationMs =
		tuning.integrationMs ?? (sensitivity === "high" ? 100 : s.detection.integrationMs)
	const faTargetPerMhzMin =
		sensitivity === "low" ? 0.25 : sensitivity === "high" ? 2 : s.detection.faTargetPerMhzMin
	return {
		sourceId,
		format,
		sampleRateHz,
		fftSize,
		integrationMs,
		usableFraction: USABLE_FRACTION,
		dcGuardHz: s.detection.dcGuardHz,
		ppmMargin: s.detection.ppmMargin,
		hysteresisDb: s.detection.hysteresisDb,
		clipFraction: s.detection.clipFraction,
		minSurfaceBlocks: s.detection.minSurfaceBlocks,
		thresholdDb: tuning.thresholdDb,
		faTargetPerMhzMin,
		spectrumBins: s.ws.spectrumBins,
		trackHangMs: 500,
		maxTracks: 512,
		maxTrackMs: 120_000,
		shortIntegrationMs: s.detection.shortIntegrationMs,
		overlap: s.detection.overlap,
		...(persisted ? { persistedEngine: persisted } : {}),
	}
}

interface Batch {
	buf: ArrayBuffer
	used: number
	start: number
}

/** Something that happens when the engine's branch byte counter reaches `atBranchByte`. */
type BranchMark =
	| { kind: "gap"; atBranchByte: number; droppedBytes: number }
	| { kind: "stream"; atBranchByte: number; trust: TuningTrust }

export class SpectrumEngine extends EventEmitter implements EpochClock {
	readonly sourceId: string
	private readonly log: Logger
	private readonly branchId: string
	private readonly batchBytes: number
	private host: PipelineHost | null = null
	private cfg: PipelineConfig | null = null
	private fanout: Pick<FanoutManager, "addBranch" | "removeBranch" | "getBranchTelemetry" | "on" | "off"> | null = null
	private branch: Readable | null = null
	private ring: IqRing | null = null
	private bps = 2
	private fmt: IqFormat = "U8_IQ"
	private running = false
	private restarting = false
	private persisted: EngineState | undefined
	// Stream and sample accounting
	private stream = -1
	private nextSample = 0
	private branchBytes = 0
	/** Branch byte position where the current (or last queued) stream starts. */
	private streamStartByte = 0
	private remainder = new Uint8Array(0)
	private skipBytes = 0
	private awaitingPayload = false
	private gapSamplesTotal = 0
	private workerDroppedSamples = 0
	/** Gaps and stream boundaries, ordered by the branch byte where they apply. */
	private readonly branchQueue: BranchMark[] = []
	/** Open fanout drop episode: accepted bytes at its start, dropped total at its start. */
	private bpMark: { atBranchByte: number; droppedAt: number } | null = null
	// Batching
	private batch: Batch | null = null
	private readonly pool: ArrayBuffer[] = []
	private inflightBytes = 0
	private flushTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null
	// Epochs
	private lastEpoch = 0
	private suppressed = 0
	private externalPending: { trust: TuningTrust; commandSample: number; bufferedSamples: number } | null = null
	private readonly pendingMeta = new Map<number, EngineEpoch>()
	private streamMeta: EngineEpoch | null = null
	private current: EngineEpoch
	private lastTunerKey: string | null = null
	private marker: boolean | null = null
	// Consumers
	private readonly taps = new Set<(startSample: number, bytes: Uint8Array) => void>()
	private masks: EngineMasks | null = null
	private spectrumFeed = false
	private lastStats: PipelineStats | null = null
	private readonly warningList: EngineWarning[] = []

	constructor(private readonly deps: SpectrumEngineDeps) {
		super()
		this.sourceId = deps.sourceId
		this.branchId = `scanner-${deps.sourceId}`
		this.batchBytes = deps.batchBytes ?? DEFAULT_BATCH_BYTES
		this.persisted = deps.persistedEngine
		this.log = createComponentLogger(deps.logger, `SpectrumEngine:${deps.sourceId}`)
		this.current = {
			stream: 0,
			epoch: 0,
			startSample: null,
			centreHz: 0,
			sampleRateHz: 0,
			gainKey: "na",
			tuningTrust: "unverified",
			settleMode: null,
		}
	}

	get format(): IqFormat {
		return this.fmt
	}

	get isRunning(): boolean {
		return this.running
	}

	get markerSupported(): boolean | null {
		return this.marker
	}

	/** A0 / `stuckTestMode` outcome for this source's transport (§ 4.6). */
	setMarkerSupported(value: boolean | null): void {
		this.marker = value
	}

	async start(): Promise<void> {
		if (this.running) return
		const caps = this.deps.sources.getCaps(this.sourceId)
		if (!isScannerIqFormat(caps)) {
			throw new WaveKitError(
				`Source ${this.sourceId} is not an IQ source the scanner can read`,
				"SCANNER_SOURCE_NOT_IQ",
			)
		}
		this.fmt = caps.format
		this.bps = bytesPerSample(this.fmt)
		this.host = this.createHost(caps.sampleRate)
		this.running = true
		this.subscribe()
		const fanout = this.deps.routing.getFanout(this.sourceId)
		this.fanout = fanout
		fanout.on("backpressure", this.onBackpressure)
		fanout.on("drain", this.onDrain)
		const branch = fanout.addBranch({
			id: this.branchId,
			sourceId: this.sourceId,
			highWaterMark: SCANNER_BRANCH_HWM,
		})
		branch.on("data", this.onData)
		branch.on("error", this.onBranchError)
		this.branch = branch
		// A fresh branch counts from byte 0.
		this.branchBytes = 0
		this.branchQueue.length = 0
		this.bpMark = null
		this.awaitingPayload = false
		this.streamStartByte = 0
		this.beginStream(this.initialTrust())
		this.log.info({ format: this.fmt, sampleRateHz: caps.sampleRate }, "Spectrum engine started")
	}

	/** Stops the engine; returns the pipeline's engine state for persistence. */
	async stop(): Promise<EngineState | null> {
		if (!this.running) return null
		this.running = false
		this.flushBatch()
		this.unsubscribe()
		if (this.flushTimer) clearTimeout(this.flushTimer)
		this.flushTimer = null
		if (this.branch) {
			this.branch.off("data", this.onData)
			this.branch.off("error", this.onBranchError)
		}
		if (this.fanout) {
			this.fanout.off("backpressure", this.onBackpressure)
			this.fanout.off("drain", this.onDrain)
			this.fanout.removeBranch(this.branchId)
		}
		this.deps.routing.releaseUnused(this.sourceId)
		this.branch = null
		this.fanout = null
		this.taps.clear()
		const host = this.host
		this.host = null
		let state: EngineState | null = null
		if (host) {
			state = await host.exportState().catch((err: unknown) => {
				this.log.warn({ err }, "Engine state export failed")
				return this.persisted ?? null
			})
			await host.close()
		}
		this.log.info({ gapSamples: this.gapSamplesTotal }, "Spectrum engine stopped")
		return state
	}

	// === EpochClock ===

	sampleClock(): { commandSample: number; bufferedSamples: number; sampleRateHz: number } {
		const telemetry = this.fanout?.getBranchTelemetry(this.branchId)
		const sourceBuffered = this.deps.sources.getStream(this.sourceId)?.readableLength ?? 0
		const bufferedBytes = (telemetry?.bufferBytes ?? 0) + sourceBuffered + this.remainder.length
		return {
			commandSample: this.nextSample,
			bufferedSamples: Math.ceil(bufferedBytes / this.bps),
			sampleRateHz: this.cfg?.sampleRateHz ?? 0,
		}
	}

	allocateEpoch(): number {
		this.lastEpoch += 1
		return this.lastEpoch
	}

	submitEpoch(pending: PendingEpoch): void {
		if (!this.running || !this.host || this.restarting) return
		if (pending.sampleRateHz !== this.cfg?.sampleRateHz) {
			this.log.info(
				{ from: this.cfg?.sampleRateHz, to: pending.sampleRateHz },
				"Sample rate change starts a new stream",
			)
			void this.restartPipeline(pending.tuningTrust)
			return
		}
		this.flushBatch()
		this.pendingMeta.set(pending.epoch, {
			stream: this.stream,
			epoch: pending.epoch,
			startSample: null,
			centreHz: pending.centreHz,
			sampleRateHz: pending.sampleRateHz,
			gainKey: pending.gainKey,
			tuningTrust: pending.tuningTrust,
			settleMode: null,
		})
		this.send({ kind: "pending-epoch", pending })
	}

	suppressExternal(on: boolean): void {
		this.suppressed = Math.max(0, this.suppressed + (on ? 1 : -1))
	}

	currentEpoch(): EngineEpoch {
		return { ...this.current }
	}

	// === Consumers ===

	/** Absolute index of the next sample (the live edge) in the current stream. */
	liveEdge(): number {
		return this.nextSample
	}

	readRing(fromSample: number, toSample: number): { startSample: number; bytes: Uint8Array } | null {
		return this.ring?.read(fromSample, toSample) ?? null
	}

	/** Live bytes after they reach the ring; returns an unsubscribe function. */
	tap(listener: (startSample: number, bytes: Uint8Array) => void): () => void {
		this.taps.add(listener)
		return () => this.taps.delete(listener)
	}

	setMasks(masks: EngineMasks): void {
		this.masks = masks
		this.send({ kind: "masks", ...masks })
	}

	setSpectrumFeed(enabled: boolean): void {
		if (this.spectrumFeed === enabled) return
		this.spectrumFeed = enabled
		this.send({ kind: "spectrum-feed", enabled })
	}

	stats(): PipelineStats | null {
		return this.lastStats
	}

	config(): PipelineConfig | null {
		return this.cfg
	}

	/** Trust warnings, newest last (§ 4.7). */
	warnings(): EngineWarning[] {
		return this.warningList.map(w => ({ ...w }))
	}

	async exportState(): Promise<EngineState | null> {
		if (!this.host) return this.persisted ?? null
		return this.host.exportState()
	}

	/** The pipeline's artefact masks (§ 4.9) for identify (Task 35a); null without a pipeline or on a host error. */
	async artefactMasks(): Promise<ArtefactMasks | null> {
		const host = this.host
		if (!host?.artefactMasks) return null
		return host.artefactMasks().catch(() => null)
	}

	/** Applies new tuning (fftSize, integration, k) by recreating the pipeline. */
	async reconfigure(): Promise<void> {
		await this.restartPipeline(this.current.tuningTrust)
	}

	// === Internals: hosts and streams ===

	private createHost(sampleRateHz: number): PipelineHost {
		const tuning = this.deps.tuning?.() ?? DEFAULT_TUNING
		const cfg = buildPipelineConfig(
			this.sourceId,
			this.fmt,
			sampleRateHz,
			this.deps.settings(),
			tuning,
			this.persisted,
		)
		this.cfg = cfg
		const handlers: PipelineHostHandlers = {
			events: events => this.onEvents(events),
			buffer: buffer => this.onBuffer(buffer),
			error: err => {
				this.log.error({ err }, "Spectrum pipeline error")
				this.emit("error", err)
			},
		}
		if (this.deps.createHost) return this.deps.createHost(cfg, handlers)
		return createPipelineHost(this.deps.host ?? "thread", cfg, handlers, {
			...(this.deps.workerUrl ? { workerUrl: this.deps.workerUrl } : {}),
			logger: this.deps.logger,
		})
	}

	private async restartPipeline(trust: TuningTrust): Promise<void> {
		if (this.restarting || !this.host) return
		this.restarting = true
		this.flushBatch()
		const old = this.host
		try {
			this.persisted = (await old.exportState().catch(() => this.persisted)) ?? this.persisted
			await old.close()
			const caps = this.deps.sources.getCaps(this.sourceId)
			if (!this.running || !isScannerIqFormat(caps)) return
			this.inflightBytes = 0
			this.pool.length = 0
			this.host = this.createHost(caps.sampleRate)
			if (this.masks) this.send({ kind: "masks", ...this.masks })
			if (this.spectrumFeed) this.send({ kind: "spectrum-feed", enabled: true })
			this.restarting = false
			this.dropStaleBranchMarks()
			this.beginStream(trust)
		} finally {
			this.restarting = false
		}
	}

	private initialTrust(): TuningTrust {
		const state = this.deps.tuner?.getState(this.sourceId)
		if (state && !(state.unknownFields ?? []).includes("frequency")) return "commanded"
		return "unverified"
	}

	private beginStream(trust: TuningTrust): void {
		this.flushBatch()
		const caps = this.deps.sources.getCaps(this.sourceId)
		const sampleRateHz = this.cfg?.sampleRateHz ?? caps?.sampleRate ?? 0
		this.stream += 1
		this.nextSample = 0
		this.remainder = new Uint8Array(0)
		this.skipBytes = 0
		this.pendingMeta.clear()
		this.externalPending = null
		const ringSeconds = this.deps.settings().ringSeconds
		this.ring = new IqRing({
			bytesPerSample: this.bps,
			capacitySamples: Math.max(1, Math.round(ringSeconds * sampleRateHz)),
		})
		const gainKey = gainKeyOf(this.deps.tuner?.getState(this.sourceId))
		this.lastEpoch += 1
		this.streamMeta = {
			stream: this.stream,
			epoch: this.lastEpoch,
			startSample: null,
			centreHz: caps?.centerFreq ?? 0,
			sampleRateHz,
			gainKey,
			tuningTrust: trust,
			settleMode: null,
		}
		this.send({
			kind: "new-stream",
			stream: this.stream,
			centreHz: caps?.centerFreq ?? 0,
			sampleRateHz,
			gainKey,
			tuningTrust: trust,
		})
		this.emit("stream", this.stream)
	}

	private send(input: PipelineInput, transfer?: ArrayBuffer): void {
		if (!this.host) {
			if (transfer) this.onBuffer(transfer)
			return
		}
		this.host.send(input, transfer)
	}

	// === Internals: bytes, gaps and batches ===

	private readonly onData = (chunk: Buffer): void => {
		if (!this.running || this.restarting) {
			this.branchBytes += chunk.length
			return
		}
		let pos = this.branchBytes
		let off = 0
		while (off < chunk.length) {
			const mark = this.branchQueue[0]
			if (mark && mark.atBranchByte <= pos) {
				this.branchQueue.shift()
				this.applyMark(mark)
				continue
			}
			const limit = mark ? Math.min(chunk.length, off + (mark.atBranchByte - pos)) : chunk.length
			this.ingest(chunk.subarray(off, limit))
			pos += limit - off
			off = limit
		}
		this.branchBytes = pos
		this.applyDueMarks()
	}

	/** Applies queued gaps and stream boundaries the delivered bytes have reached. */
	private applyDueMarks(): void {
		if (!this.running || this.restarting) return
		while (this.branchQueue[0] && this.branchQueue[0].atBranchByte <= this.branchBytes) {
			this.applyMark(this.branchQueue.shift()!)
		}
	}

	private applyMark(mark: BranchMark): void {
		if (mark.kind === "gap") this.applyGap(mark.droppedBytes)
		else this.beginStream(mark.trust)
	}

	/** Bytes the fanout accepted into the branch so far (written minus dropped). */
	private acceptedBranchBytes(t: BranchTelemetry | undefined): number {
		return t ? t.totalBytesWritten - t.droppedBytesTotal : this.branchBytes
	}

	/**
	 * Starts a new stream at the branch byte the fanout has accepted so far:
	 * bytes still buffered in the branch finish the old stream. An open drop
	 * episode is split there, so each stream gets only its own dropped bytes.
	 */
	private queueStreamBoundary(trust: TuningTrust): void {
		const t = this.fanout?.getBranchTelemetry(this.branchId)
		const at = this.acceptedBranchBytes(t)
		if (this.bpMark && t) {
			const dropped = t.droppedBytesTotal - this.bpMark.droppedAt
			if (dropped > 0) {
				this.branchQueue.push({ kind: "gap", atBranchByte: this.bpMark.atBranchByte, droppedBytes: dropped })
			}
			this.bpMark = { atBranchByte: at, droppedAt: t.droppedBytesTotal }
		}
		this.branchQueue.push({ kind: "stream", atBranchByte: at, trust })
		this.streamStartByte = at
		this.applyDueMarks()
	}

	/**
	 * A stream started directly (pipeline restart) after the bytes up to
	 * `branchBytes` were discarded: marks at or before that point, and drops an
	 * open episode already counted, belong to the discarded segment.
	 */
	private dropStaleBranchMarks(): void {
		while (this.branchQueue[0] && this.branchQueue[0].atBranchByte <= this.branchBytes) {
			this.branchQueue.shift()
		}
		const t = this.fanout?.getBranchTelemetry(this.branchId)
		if (this.bpMark && t) {
			this.bpMark = { atBranchByte: this.acceptedBranchBytes(t), droppedAt: t.droppedBytesTotal }
		}
		this.streamStartByte = this.branchBytes
	}

	private ingest(input: Uint8Array): void {
		let bytes = input
		if (this.skipBytes > 0) {
			const n = Math.min(this.skipBytes, bytes.length)
			this.skipBytes -= n
			bytes = bytes.subarray(n)
		}
		if (this.remainder.length > 0) {
			const joined = new Uint8Array(this.remainder.length + bytes.length)
			joined.set(this.remainder, 0)
			joined.set(bytes, this.remainder.length)
			bytes = joined
			this.remainder = new Uint8Array(0)
		}
		const usable = bytes.length - (bytes.length % this.bps)
		if (usable < bytes.length) this.remainder = Uint8Array.from(bytes.subarray(usable))
		if (usable === 0) return
		const piece = bytes.subarray(0, usable)
		const start = this.nextSample
		this.ring?.write(start, piece)
		for (const listener of this.taps) listener(start, piece)
		this.appendBatch(start, piece)
		this.nextSample += usable / this.bps
	}

	/** `droppedBytes` were lost at the current position (fanout drop-on-congestion). */
	private applyGap(droppedBytes: number): void {
		const lost = droppedBytes + this.remainder.length
		this.remainder = new Uint8Array(0)
		const rem = lost % this.bps
		const samples = Math.ceil(lost / this.bps)
		this.skipBytes = rem === 0 ? 0 : this.bps - rem
		if (samples === 0) return
		this.markGap(samples)
	}

	private markGap(samples: number): void {
		this.flushBatch()
		const start = this.nextSample
		this.send({ kind: "gap", startSample: start, samples })
		this.ring?.markGap(start, samples)
		this.nextSample += samples
		this.gapSamplesTotal += samples
	}

	private appendBatch(start: number, piece: Uint8Array): void {
		let off = 0
		while (off < piece.length) {
			if (!this.batch) {
				const buf = this.takeBuffer()
				if (!buf) {
					// Worker is behind (> 4 MiB in flight): the worker gets a gap for
					// these samples; the ring and probe taps already have the bytes.
					this.flushBatch()
					const samples = (piece.length - off) / this.bps
					this.send({ kind: "gap", startSample: start + off / this.bps, samples })
					this.workerDroppedSamples += samples
					return
				}
				this.batch = { buf, used: 0, start: start + off / this.bps }
			}
			const space = this.batch.buf.byteLength - this.batch.used
			const n = Math.min(space, piece.length - off)
			new Uint8Array(this.batch.buf, this.batch.used, n).set(piece.subarray(off, off + n))
			this.batch.used += n
			off += n
			if (this.batch.used === this.batch.buf.byteLength) this.flushBatch()
		}
		if (this.batch && !this.flushTimer) {
			this.flushTimer = setTimeout(() => {
				this.flushTimer = null
				this.flushBatch()
			}, BATCH_FLUSH_MS)
			this.flushTimer.unref()
		}
	}

	private takeBuffer(): ArrayBuffer | null {
		const pooled = this.pool.pop()
		if (pooled) return pooled
		if (this.inflightBytes + this.batchBytes > MAX_INFLIGHT_BYTES) return null
		return new ArrayBuffer(this.batchBytes)
	}

	private flushBatch(): void {
		if (this.flushTimer) {
			clearTimeout(this.flushTimer)
			this.flushTimer = null
		}
		const batch = this.batch
		this.batch = null
		if (!batch) return
		if (batch.used === 0) {
			this.pool.push(batch.buf)
			return
		}
		this.inflightBytes += batch.buf.byteLength
		this.send(
			{ kind: "bytes", startSample: batch.start, bytes: new Uint8Array(batch.buf, 0, batch.used) },
			batch.buf,
		)
	}

	private onBuffer(buffer: ArrayBuffer): void {
		this.inflightBytes = Math.max(0, this.inflightBytes - buffer.byteLength)
		if (buffer.byteLength === this.batchBytes && this.pool.length < 32) this.pool.push(buffer)
	}

	private readonly onBackpressure = (branchId: string): void => {
		if (branchId !== this.branchId || !this.fanout) return
		const t = this.fanout.getBranchTelemetry(branchId)
		if (!t) return
		this.bpMark = {
			atBranchByte: t.totalBytesWritten - t.droppedBytesTotal,
			droppedAt: t.droppedBytesTotal,
		}
	}

	private readonly onDrain = (branchId: string): void => {
		if (branchId !== this.branchId || !this.fanout || !this.bpMark) return
		const t = this.fanout.getBranchTelemetry(branchId)
		const mark = this.bpMark
		this.bpMark = null
		if (!t) return
		const dropped = t.droppedBytesTotal - mark.droppedAt
		if (dropped <= 0) return
		this.branchQueue.push({ kind: "gap", atBranchByte: mark.atBranchByte, droppedBytes: dropped })
		this.applyDueMarks()
	}

	private readonly onBranchError = (err: Error): void => {
		this.log.warn({ err }, "Scanner branch error")
	}

	// === Internals: pipeline events ===

	private onEvents(events: PipelineEvent[]): void {
		for (const ev of events) {
			if (ev.kind === "epoch-started") {
				this.lastEpoch = Math.max(this.lastEpoch, ev.epoch)
				// An untracked retune (below) registers its meta under the epoch the pipeline started.
				const meta = this.pendingMeta.get(ev.epoch) ?? (ev.settleMode === "none" ? this.streamMeta : null)
				this.pendingMeta.delete(ev.epoch)
				this.current = {
					...(meta ?? this.current),
					stream: this.stream,
					epoch: ev.epoch,
					startSample: ev.startSample,
					settleMode: ev.settleMode,
				}
				if (ev.settleMode === "marker") this.marker = true
			} else if (ev.kind === "untracked-retune") {
				// § 4.7: the pipeline already started an unverified epoch (Task 10b); record it, post nothing.
				this.lastEpoch = Math.max(this.lastEpoch, ev.epoch)
				const caps = this.deps.sources.getCaps(this.sourceId)
				this.pendingMeta.set(ev.epoch, {
					...this.current,
					epoch: ev.epoch,
					startSample: null,
					centreHz: caps?.centerFreq ?? this.current.centreHz,
					tuningTrust: "unverified",
					settleMode: null,
				})
				this.warn("untracked-retune", ev.deltaHz)
			} else if (ev.kind === "stats") {
				this.lastStats = ev.stats
				if (ev.stats.stuckTestMode) this.marker = false
			}
			this.emit("pipeline", ev, this.currentEpoch())
		}
	}

	// === Internals: epoch triggers (§ 4.6, § 4.7) ===

	private subscribe(): void {
		this.deps.sources.on("disconnected", this.onDisconnected)
		this.deps.sources.on("payload-started", this.onPayloadStarted)
		this.deps.sources.on("caps-changed", this.onCapsChanged)
		const tuner = this.deps.tuner
		if (tuner) {
			tuner.on("command-sent", this.onCommandSent)
			tuner.on("state-changed", this.onStateChanged)
			this.lastTunerKey = this.tunerKey(tuner.getState(this.sourceId))
		}
	}

	private unsubscribe(): void {
		this.deps.sources.off("disconnected", this.onDisconnected)
		this.deps.sources.off("payload-started", this.onPayloadStarted)
		this.deps.sources.off("caps-changed", this.onCapsChanged)
		this.deps.tuner?.off("command-sent", this.onCommandSent)
		this.deps.tuner?.off("state-changed", this.onStateChanged)
	}

	private readonly onDisconnected = (sourceId: string): void => {
		if (sourceId !== this.sourceId || !this.running) return
		this.awaitingPayload = true
		this.queueStreamBoundary("unverified")
	}

	private readonly onPayloadStarted = (sourceId: string): void => {
		if (sourceId !== this.sourceId || !this.running) return
		if (this.awaitingPayload) {
			this.awaitingPayload = false
			return
		}
		// No disconnect seen: a new stream only if bytes arrived since the last one started.
		const accepted = this.acceptedBranchBytes(this.fanout?.getBranchTelemetry(this.branchId))
		if (accepted > this.streamStartByte) this.queueStreamBoundary("unverified")
	}

	private readonly onCommandSent = (
		sourceId: string,
		command: string,
		_value: number,
		origin?: TunerCommandOrigin,
	): void => {
		if (sourceId !== this.sourceId || this.suppressed > 0 || origin === "scanner") return
		if (!EPOCH_COMMANDS.has(command)) return
		this.queueExternal("commanded")
	}

	private readonly onStateChanged = (sourceId: string, state: TunerState): void => {
		if (sourceId !== this.sourceId) return
		const key = this.tunerKey(state)
		const previous = this.lastTunerKey
		this.lastTunerKey = key
		if (this.suppressed > 0 || previous === null || previous === key) return
		if (state.controlMode === "external") this.queueExternal("relay")
	}

	private readonly onCapsChanged = (sourceId: string, caps: SourceCaps): void => {
		if (sourceId !== this.sourceId || !this.running) return
		if (caps.sampleRate !== this.cfg?.sampleRateHz) {
			if (this.suppressed === 0) this.queueExternal(this.externalTrust())
			return
		}
		if (this.suppressed > 0) return
		if (caps.centerFreq !== undefined && caps.centerFreq !== this.current.centreHz) {
			this.queueExternal(this.externalTrust())
		}
	}

	private externalTrust(): TuningTrust {
		const state = this.deps.tuner?.getState(this.sourceId)
		return state?.controlMode === "external" ? "relay" : "commanded"
	}

	private tunerKey(state: TunerState | undefined): string | null {
		return state ? `${state.frequency}:${state.sampleRate}:${gainKeyOf(state)}:${state.ppm}` : null
	}

	private warn(code: EngineWarning["code"], deltaHz: number | null): void {
		this.warningList.push({ code, deltaHz, at: Date.now() })
		if (this.warningList.length > MAX_WARNINGS) this.warningList.shift()
		this.log.warn({ code, deltaHz }, "Spectrum engine trust warning")
		this.emit("warning", code, deltaHz)
	}

	/** Captures the command position now; posts in a microtask (before any later bytes). */
	private queueExternal(trust: TuningTrust): void {
		if (!this.running) return
		if (this.externalPending) {
			if (trust === "relay") this.externalPending.trust = "relay"
			return
		}
		const clock = this.sampleClock()
		this.externalPending = {
			trust,
			commandSample: clock.commandSample,
			bufferedSamples: clock.bufferedSamples,
		}
		queueMicrotask(() => this.flushExternal())
	}

	private flushExternal(): void {
		const pending = this.externalPending
		this.externalPending = null
		if (!pending || !this.running || this.restarting) return
		const caps = this.deps.sources.getCaps(this.sourceId)
		if (!caps) return
		if (caps.sampleRate !== this.cfg?.sampleRateHz) {
			void this.restartPipeline(pending.trust)
			return
		}
		const fs = caps.sampleRate
		const s = this.deps.settings()
		const centreHz = caps.centerFreq ?? this.current.centreHz
		this.submitEpoch({
			epoch: this.allocateEpoch(),
			commandSample: pending.commandSample,
			bufferedSamples: pending.bufferedSamples,
			settleSamples: Math.round((s.sweep.settleMs.network * fs) / 1000),
			expectMarker: false,
			markerTimeoutSamples: 0,
			pllSettleSamples: 0,
			centreHz,
			sampleRateHz: fs,
			gainKey: gainKeyOf(this.deps.tuner?.getState(this.sourceId)),
			tuningTrust: pending.trust,
			centreChanged: centreHz !== this.current.centreHz,
		})
	}

	/** Diagnostics for status (§ 12.1). */
	accounting(): { stream: number; liveEdge: number; gapSamples: number; workerDroppedSamples: number } {
		return {
			stream: this.stream,
			liveEdge: this.nextSample,
			gapSamples: this.gapSamplesTotal,
			workerDroppedSamples: this.workerDroppedSamples,
		}
	}
}
```

```ts
export type TunerFieldValues = LeaseTunerFields            // from store/persistence.ts (Task 16), one shape
export type LeaseLostReason = "preempted-operator" | "preempted-relay" | "preempted-job"
// "lease-lost"(lease, reason: LeaseLostReason) — "preempted-job" added (hand-over to a higher-priority job, § 10.1)
// "recovered"(sourceId, result: { restored: string[]; unrestorable: string[] })
export type ArbiterTuner = Pick<TunerController, "getState" | "setFrequency" | "setSampleRate" | "setGainMode" | "setGain" | "setAgcMode" | "setTestMode" | "on" | "off">
export interface ArbiterDeps { /* below */ }
// TunerArbiter extra methods:
operatorIdleSince(sourceId: string): number | null   // auto-resume input (§ 10.3)
setAgc(lease: Lease, enabled: boolean): Promise<void>  // job `tuner.agc`, inside the lease
impact(sourceId: string, spec: NormalisedJobSpec, exceptJobId?: string): Impact  // § 10.4; exceptJobId = the asking job (Task 35 passes record.id)
dispose(): void
```

Behaviour contract:
- **Lease scope.** One lease per source. `acquire` refuses sources without a `TunerController` state or that are not rtl_tcp (`SCANNER_NO_TUNER_CONTROL`), and sources in `controlMode: "external"` (`SCANNER_SOURCE_BUSY`, not consentable). An equal or higher priority holder refuses (`SCANNER_SOURCE_BUSY`); a lower priority holder is handed over: the new lease keeps the old snapshot and `changedFields`, the old lease is lost with `"preempted-job"`.
- **Snapshot.** Only fields not in `TunerState.unknownFields` (cloneState's list: fields backed by nothing). Written to `jobs.json` through `deps.persistLease` on acquire and cleared on release/loss. A field joins `changedFields` **before** the write that changes it, and that persist is awaited before the command goes out (before the epoch is posted, so the persist delay never lands between `commandSample` and the command), so a crash mid-sequence still leaves the field in the persisted lease. Persist failures are logged, not thrown.
- **Retune.** Order: rate change first, outside the markers (the engine turns a rate change into a new stream); then `PendingEpoch` built and posted through `EpochClock.submitEpoch` **before** the first command (Task 10 ordering), then `setTestMode(true, {origin:"scanner", accept:false})` → `setFrequency(…, {origin:"scanner"})` → optional `setGainMode("manual")`/`setGain` → `setTestMode(false, …)`. Current tuner values listed in `state.unknownFields` are placeholders (the controller reports `gainMode: "agc"`, `gain: 0` before anything is accepted), so a hop with a gain target writes `setGain` when `gain` is unknown or differs, and `setGainMode("manual")` first when `gainMode` is unknown or not `"manual"`. The arbiter tracks an open marker per source (`TEST_MODE 1` sent, no successful `TEST_MODE 0` since). `TEST_MODE 0` is sent in `finally` whenever markers are on, even after an error or a lease loss mid-sequence (the only command allowed after a loss). `suppressExternal(true/false)` brackets the sequence. Markers are on when `settings.sweep.markers` and the engine has not found the transport unable to pass test mode (`markerSupported !== false`).
- **Preemption.** `command-sent` with origin `"rest"` (or no origin: an untagged writer is not the scanner) on a leased source → `"preempted-operator"`. `control-mode-changed` to `"external"` → `"preempted-relay"`. Origin `"replay"` never preempts; it emits `"replay"(sourceId)`. Origin `"scanner"` is ours.
- **Restore.** On `release(lease, {restore: true})` with the lease still held: write back, in order sampleRate → frequency → gainMode → gain → agcMode, only fields in `changedFields` whose snapshot value is known; changed fields with an unknown snapshot value are reported in `unrestorable` and never written (as are fields whose write failed). Releasing a held lease always sends `TEST_MODE 0` first (§ 4.6 "on lease release"), with or without `restore`. A lost lease is never restored over and gets no command at all.
- **Marker cleanup on reconnect.** On `payload-started` of an rtl_tcp source with an open marker or a held lease, `TEST_MODE 0` is sent (a connection dropped mid-bracket can leave the dongle emitting counters, and test mode is never replayed); a persisted lease does it as the first step of recovery.
- **Crash recovery.** `recoverPersistedLeases()` remembers persisted leases. On that source's first `payload-started` the arbiter sends `TEST_MODE 0`, restores the snapshot's changed known fields plus `frequency` (always, when its snapshot value is known: the stale last hop is the H4 hazard) and clears the persisted lease. Fields with an unknown snapshot value are reported, not retried; only a failed write keeps the persisted lease for the next connection. Ordering: `wireTunerControl` (`src/core/tuner-wiring.ts`) registers its `payload-started` listener at boot, before `ScannerService.start()` subscribes the arbiter, so the controller's replay is written first and the restore lands last (rtlmux replays its cache before both, per the comment in tuner-wiring.ts). At boot the controller has no accepted state, so the replay writes nothing. The restore's `setFrequency` updates caps (`tuner-controller.ts` :600), which emits `caps-changed`, and that is what DecoderManager re-evaluates on (`manager.ts` :1122). Decoders therefore evaluate the restored centre, not the stale last hop (H4).
- **Impact** (§ 10.4) is computed from actual assignments: live-audio clients when live audio runs on the source, digital-voice listeners on decoders of the source, running non-suspended configured decoders, operator-pinned configured decoders (`startMode: "operator"`), other scanner jobs (`scannerJobsOn(sourceId, exceptJobId)`: the asking job never counts itself, or a job's own presence would always look like grown impact), and `unrestorable` fields the spec would change (`frequency` always; `sampleRate`, `gainMode`/`gain`, `agcMode` only when the spec sets them).

```ts
// tests/mocks/scanner/arbiter-fakes.ts
import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"
import type { TunerCommandOrigin, TunerState, TunerStateField } from "@wavekit/api-types"
import {
	TunerControlModeError,
	type TunerWriteOptions,
} from "../../../src/core/tuner-controller.js"
import type { EpochClock, EngineEpoch } from "../../../src/core/spectrum/spectrum-engine.js"
import type { PendingEpoch } from "../../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"

export interface SentCommand {
	sourceId: string
	name: string
	value: number
	origin: TunerCommandOrigin | undefined
	accept: boolean
}

/** TunerController double implementing exactly what TunerArbiter uses. */
export class ArbiterFakeTuner extends EventEmitter {
	readonly sent: SentCommand[] = []
	readonly states = new Map<string, TunerState>()
	readonly known = new Map<string, Set<TunerStateField>>()
	failNext: Error | null = null
	/** Rejects every write while set (a dropped socket). */
	failAll: Error | null = null
	/** Runs once, right after the next TEST_MODE 1 write resolves (between two arbiter awaits). */
	afterTestModeOn: (() => void) | null = null

	addSource(sourceId: string, unknown: TunerStateField[] = []): void {
		this.states.set(sourceId, {
			sourceId,
			frequency: 446_100_000,
			sampleRate: 2_048_000,
			gainMode: "manual",
			gain: 296,
			ppm: 0,
			agcMode: false,
			biasTee: false,
			directSampling: "off",
			offsetTuning: false,
			ifGain: 0,
			tunerIfGain: null,
			testMode: false,
			controlMode: "internal",
			commandCount: 0,
		})
		const all: TunerStateField[] = ["frequency", "sampleRate", "gainMode", "gain", "agcMode"]
		this.known.set(sourceId, new Set(all.filter(f => !unknown.includes(f))))
	}

	getState(sourceId: string): TunerState | undefined {
		const s = this.states.get(sourceId)
		if (!s) return undefined
		const known = this.known.get(sourceId) ?? new Set()
		const unknownFields = (["frequency", "sampleRate", "gainMode", "gain", "agcMode"] as const).filter(
			f => !known.has(f),
		)
		return { ...s, ...(unknownFields.length > 0 ? { unknownFields: [...unknownFields] } : {}) }
	}

	setControl(sourceId: string, mode: "internal" | "external"): void {
		const s = this.states.get(sourceId)!
		if (s.controlMode === mode) return
		s.controlMode = mode
		this.emit("control-mode-changed", sourceId, mode)
	}

	/** An operator or replay write that did not come from the scanner. */
	external(sourceId: string, name: string, value: number, origin: TunerCommandOrigin | undefined): void {
		this.emit("command-sent", sourceId, name, value, origin)
	}

	private write(
		sourceId: string,
		name: string,
		value: number,
		field: TunerStateField | null,
		opts: TunerWriteOptions = {},
	): Promise<void> {
		const s = this.states.get(sourceId)
		if (!s) return Promise.reject(new Error(`no source ${sourceId}`))
		if (s.controlMode === "external") return Promise.reject(new TunerControlModeError(sourceId))
		if (this.failAll) return Promise.reject(this.failAll)
		if (this.failNext) {
			const err = this.failNext
			this.failNext = null
			return Promise.reject(err)
		}
		const accept = name === "set-test-mode" ? false : (opts.accept ?? true)
		this.sent.push({ sourceId, name, value, origin: opts.origin, accept })
		if (field && accept) this.known.get(sourceId)?.add(field)
		this.emit("command-sent", sourceId, name, value, opts.origin)
		return Promise.resolve()
	}

	setFrequency(sourceId: string, hz: number, opts?: TunerWriteOptions): Promise<void> {
		return this.write(sourceId, "set-frequency", hz, "frequency", opts).then(() => {
			this.states.get(sourceId)!.frequency = hz
		})
	}

	setSampleRate(sourceId: string, hz: number, opts?: TunerWriteOptions): Promise<void> {
		return this.write(sourceId, "set-sample-rate", hz, "sampleRate", opts).then(() => {
			this.states.get(sourceId)!.sampleRate = hz
		})
	}

	setGainMode(sourceId: string, mode: "agc" | "manual", opts?: TunerWriteOptions): Promise<void> {
		return this.write(sourceId, "set-gain-mode", mode === "manual" ? 1 : 0, "gainMode", opts).then(() => {
			this.states.get(sourceId)!.gainMode = mode
		})
	}

	setGain(sourceId: string, tenthsDb: number, opts?: TunerWriteOptions): Promise<void> {
		return this.write(sourceId, "set-gain", tenthsDb, "gain", opts).then(() => {
			this.states.get(sourceId)!.gain = tenthsDb
		})
	}

	setAgcMode(sourceId: string, enabled: boolean, opts?: TunerWriteOptions): Promise<void> {
		return this.write(sourceId, "set-agc-mode", enabled ? 1 : 0, "agcMode", opts).then(() => {
			this.states.get(sourceId)!.agcMode = enabled
		})
	}

	setTestMode(sourceId: string, enabled: boolean, opts?: TunerWriteOptions): Promise<void> {
		const after = enabled ? this.afterTestModeOn : null
		if (enabled) this.afterTestModeOn = null
		return this.write(sourceId, "set-test-mode", enabled ? 1 : 0, null, opts).then(() => after?.())
	}
}

/** EpochClock double recording submitted epochs and the suppression depth. */
export class FakeClock implements EpochClock {
	readonly submitted: PendingEpoch[] = []
	suppressed = 0
	markerSupported: boolean | null = null
	private epoch = 0
	private sample = 0
	centreHz = 446_100_000

	sampleClock() {
		this.sample += 1000
		return { commandSample: this.sample, bufferedSamples: 64, sampleRateHz: 2_048_000 }
	}
	allocateEpoch(): number {
		this.epoch += 1
		return this.epoch
	}
	submitEpoch(p: PendingEpoch): void {
		this.submitted.push(p)
		this.centreHz = p.centreHz
	}
	suppressExternal(on: boolean): void {
		this.suppressed += on ? 1 : -1
	}
	currentEpoch(): EngineEpoch {
		return {
			stream: 0,
			epoch: this.epoch,
			startSample: 0,
			centreHz: this.centreHz,
			sampleRateHz: 2_048_000,
			gainKey: "m:296",
			tuningTrust: "commanded",
			settleMode: "marker",
		}
	}
}
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/scanner/tuner-arbiter.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"
import fc from "fast-check"
import pino from "pino"
import type { TunerStateField } from "@wavekit/api-types"
import {
	TunerArbiter,
	type ArbiterDeps,
	type Lease,
	type LeaseLostReason,
} from "../../../../src/core/scanner/tuner-arbiter.js"
import type { PersistedLease } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/store/persistence.js"
import type { NormalisedJobSpec } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/types.js"
import { ArbiterFakeTuner, FakeClock } from "../../../mocks/scanner/arbiter-fakes.js"
import { testSettings } from "../../../mocks/scanner/engine-fakes.js"

const logger = pino({ level: "silent" })

class Sources extends EventEmitter {
	isRtlTcpSource(id: string): boolean {
		return id === "rtl"
	}
}

function harness(unknown: TunerStateField[] = [], extra: Partial<ArbiterDeps> = {}) {
	const tuner = new ArbiterFakeTuner()
	tuner.addSource("rtl", unknown)
	const sources = new Sources()
	const clock = new FakeClock()
	const persisted: { sourceId: string; lease: PersistedLease | null }[] = []
	const deps: ArbiterDeps = {
		tuner: tuner as never,
		sources: sources as never,
		epochs: id => (id === "rtl" ? clock : undefined),
		settings: () => testSettings(),
		link: () => "network",
		persistLease: (sourceId, lease) => {
			persisted.push({ sourceId, lease })
			return Promise.resolve()
		},
		impactSources: { liveDemod: null, digitalVoice: null, decoders: { getAllStatus: () => [] } },
		scannerJobsOn: () => [],
		logger,
		...extra,
	}
	const arbiter = new TunerArbiter(deps)
	const lost: { jobId: string; reason: LeaseLostReason }[] = []
	arbiter.on("lease-lost", (lease: Lease, reason: LeaseLostReason) => lost.push({ jobId: lease.jobId, reason }))
	return { tuner, sources, clock, persisted, arbiter, lost }
}

type Op =
	| { t: "acquire"; job: "a" | "b" | "c"; priority: number }
	| { t: "retune"; job: "a" | "b" | "c"; centre: number; gain: number | null; interrupt: "none" | "rest" | "relay" | "fail" }
	| { t: "rest" }
	| { t: "relay"; external: boolean }
	| { t: "replay" }
	| { t: "disconnect" }
	| { t: "payload" }
	| { t: "release"; job: "a" | "b" | "c"; restore: boolean }

const job = fc.constantFrom<"a" | "b" | "c">("a", "b", "c")
const opArb: fc.Arbitrary<Op> = fc.oneof(
	fc.record({ t: fc.constant("acquire" as const), job, priority: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 100 }) }),
	fc.record({
		t: fc.constant("retune" as const),
		job,
		centre: fc.integer({ min: 400, max: 470 }).map(m => m * 1_000_000 + 37_500),
		gain: fc.option(fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 496 }), { nil: null }),
		interrupt: fc.constantFrom<"none" | "rest" | "relay" | "fail">("none", "none", "rest", "relay", "fail"),
	}),
	fc.record({ t: fc.constant("rest" as const) }),
	fc.record({ t: fc.constant("relay" as const), external: fc.boolean() }),
	fc.record({ t: fc.constant("replay" as const) }),
	fc.record({ t: fc.constant("disconnect" as const) }),
	fc.record({ t: fc.constant("payload" as const) }),
	fc.record({ t: fc.constant("release" as const), job, restore: fc.boolean() }),
)
const unknownArb = fc.subarray<TunerStateField>(["frequency", "sampleRate", "gainMode", "gain", "agcMode"])

describe("TunerArbiter lease discipline", () => {
	// Feature: signal-discovery-scanner, Property 5: Lease discipline
	// Validates: spec § 10.3
	it("never commands without the lease, never after a loss, restores only known changed fields", async () => {
		await fc.assert(
			fc.asyncProperty(unknownArb, fc.array(opArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 30 }), async (unknown, ops) => {
				const h = harness(unknown)
				const leases = new Map<string, Lease>()
				for (const op of ops) {
					const before = h.tuner.sent.length
					const lostBefore = h.lost.length
					switch (op.t) {
						case "acquire": {
							const hadHolder = h.arbiter.holder("rtl") !== undefined
							const state = h.tuner.getState("rtl")!
							const r = h.arbiter.acquire(op.job, "rtl", op.priority)
							if (state.controlMode === "external") expect(r.ok).toBe(false)
							if (r.ok) {
								leases.set(op.job, r.lease)
								if (!hadHolder) for (const f of state.unknownFields ?? []) expect(r.lease.snapshot).not.toHaveProperty(f)
							}
							break
						}
						case "retune": {
							const lease = leases.get(op.job)
							if (!lease) break
							const heldAtStart = h.arbiter.holder("rtl") === lease
							if (op.interrupt === "rest") h.tuner.afterTestModeOn = () => h.tuner.external("rtl", "set-frequency", 145e6, "rest")
							if (op.interrupt === "relay") h.tuner.afterTestModeOn = () => h.tuner.setControl("rtl", "external")
							if (op.interrupt === "fail") h.tuner.afterTestModeOn = () => { h.tuner.failNext = new Error("socket closed") }
							await h.arbiter
								.retune(lease, { centreHz: op.centre, gainTenthsDb: op.gain, sampleRateHz: null })
								.catch(() => undefined)
							h.tuner.afterTestModeOn = null
							const cmds = h.tuner.sent.slice(before)
							if (!heldAtStart) expect(cmds).toEqual([])
							for (const c of cmds.filter(x => x.name === "set-test-mode")) expect(c.accept).toBe(false)
							if (h.lost.length > lostBefore) {
								// lost between TEST_MODE 1 and the frequency write: only the marker close may follow
								// (a relay that took control rejects even that; the engine then reports stuckTestMode)
								const external = h.tuner.states.get("rtl")!.controlMode === "external"
								expect(cmds.map(c => [c.name, c.value])).toEqual(
									external ? [["set-test-mode", 1]] : [["set-test-mode", 1], ["set-test-mode", 0]],
								)
							} else if (cmds.some(c => c.name === "set-test-mode" && c.value === 1)) {
								expect(cmds.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ name: "set-test-mode", value: 0 })
							}
							expect(h.clock.suppressed).toBe(0)
							break
						}
						case "rest":
							h.tuner.external("rtl", "set-gain", 200, "rest")
							break
						case "relay":
							h.tuner.setControl("rtl", op.external ? "external" : "internal")
							break
						case "replay":
							h.tuner.external("rtl", "set-frequency", 446_100_000, "replay")
							expect(h.lost.length).toBe(lostBefore)
							break
						case "disconnect":
							h.sources.emit("disconnected", "rtl")
							break
						case "payload":
							h.sources.emit("payload-started", "rtl")
							break
						case "release": {
							const lease = leases.get(op.job)
							if (!lease) break
							const held = h.arbiter.holder("rtl") === lease
							const snapshot = { ...lease.snapshot }
							const changed = new Set(lease.changedFields)
							const r = await h.arbiter.release(lease, { restore: op.restore })
							leases.delete(op.job)
							const cmds = h.tuner.sent.slice(before)
							if (!held) {
								expect(cmds).toEqual([])
								expect(r.restored).toEqual([])
								break
							}
							// § 4.6: every release of a held lease closes test mode first.
							expect(cmds[0]).toMatchObject({ name: "set-test-mode", value: 0, origin: "scanner", accept: false })
							if (!op.restore) {
								expect(cmds).toHaveLength(1)
								expect(r.restored).toEqual([])
								break
							}
							for (const c of cmds.slice(1)) {
								const field = ({
									"set-frequency": "frequency",
									"set-sample-rate": "sampleRate",
									"set-gain-mode": "gainMode",
									"set-gain": "gain",
									"set-agc-mode": "agcMode",
								} as const)[c.name as "set-frequency"]
								expect(field).toBeDefined()
								expect(changed.has(field)).toBe(true)
								expect(snapshot[field]).toBeDefined()
							}
							for (const f of r.unrestorable) expect(snapshot[f as keyof typeof snapshot]).toBeUndefined()
							break
						}
					}
				}
			}),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})

	it("sends marker, frequency and gain in one bracket and posts the epoch first", async () => {
		const h = harness()
		const r = h.arbiter.acquire("a", "rtl", 50)
		if (!r.ok) throw new Error("acquire failed")
		const pending = await h.arbiter.retune(r.lease, { centreHz: 446_037_500, gainTenthsDb: 400, sampleRateHz: null })
		expect(h.tuner.sent.map(c => [c.name, c.value, c.origin])).toEqual([
			["set-test-mode", 1, "scanner"],
			["set-frequency", 446_037_500, "scanner"],
			["set-gain", 400, "scanner"],
			["set-test-mode", 0, "scanner"],
		])
		expect(h.clock.submitted).toEqual([pending])
		expect(pending).toMatchObject({
			expectMarker: true,
			centreHz: 446_037_500,
			gainKey: "m:400",
			tuningTrust: "commanded",
			settleSamples: Math.round((testSettings().sweep.settleMs.network * 2_048_000) / 1000),
		})
		expect([...r.lease.changedFields].sort()).toEqual(["frequency", "gain"])
	})

	it("sends TEST_MODE 0 after a failed frequency write and reports the failure", async () => {
		const h = harness()
		const r = h.arbiter.acquire("a", "rtl", 50)
		if (!r.ok) throw new Error("acquire failed")
		h.tuner.afterTestModeOn = () => { h.tuner.failNext = new Error("EPIPE") }
		await expect(
			h.arbiter.retune(r.lease, { centreHz: 446_037_500, gainTenthsDb: null, sampleRateHz: null }),
		).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "SCANNER_TUNER_WRITE" })
		expect(h.tuner.sent.map(c => [c.name, c.value])).toEqual([
			["set-test-mode", 1],
			["set-test-mode", 0],
		])
	})

	it("treats replay as a reconnect, REST as operator preemption and external control as relay preemption", () => {
		const h = harness()
		const replays: string[] = []
		h.arbiter.on("replay", (id: string) => replays.push(id))
		const a = h.arbiter.acquire("a", "rtl", 50)
		h.tuner.external("rtl", "set-frequency", 446_100_000, "replay")
		expect(h.lost).toEqual([])
		expect(replays).toEqual(["rtl"])
		h.tuner.external("rtl", "set-frequency", 145e6, "rest")
		expect(h.lost).toEqual([{ jobId: "a", reason: "preempted-operator" }])
		expect(a.ok && h.arbiter.holder("rtl")).toBe(undefined)
		const b = h.arbiter.acquire("b", "rtl", 50)
		expect(b.ok).toBe(true)
		h.tuner.setControl("rtl", "external")
		expect(h.lost.at(-1)).toEqual({ jobId: "b", reason: "preempted-relay" })
		expect(h.arbiter.acquire("c", "rtl", 90)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: "SCANNER_SOURCE_BUSY" })
	})

	it("hands the lease and its snapshot to a higher-priority job", () => {
		const h = harness()
		const a = h.arbiter.acquire("a", "rtl", 40)
		if (!a.ok) throw new Error("acquire failed")
		expect(h.arbiter.acquire("b", "rtl", 40)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: "SCANNER_SOURCE_BUSY" })
		const b = h.arbiter.acquire("b", "rtl", 60)
		if (!b.ok) throw new Error("hand-over failed")
		expect(b.lease.snapshot).toEqual(a.lease.snapshot)
		expect(h.lost).toEqual([{ jobId: "a", reason: "preempted-job" }])
		expect(h.arbiter.holder("rtl")).toBe(b.lease)
	})

	it("reports unknown changed fields as unrestorable and never writes them", async () => {
		const h = harness(["gain", "gainMode"])
		const r = h.arbiter.acquire("a", "rtl", 50)
		if (!r.ok) throw new Error("acquire failed")
		expect(r.lease.snapshot).toEqual({ frequency: 446_100_000, sampleRate: 2_048_000, agcMode: false })
		await h.arbiter.retune(r.lease, { centreHz: 450_012_500, gainTenthsDb: 300, sampleRateHz: null })
		h.tuner.sent.length = 0
		const res = await h.arbiter.release(r.lease, { restore: true })
		expect(res.restored).toEqual(["frequency"])
		expect(res.unrestorable.sort()).toEqual(["gain", "gainMode"])
		expect(h.tuner.sent.map(c => [c.name, c.value])).toEqual([
			["set-test-mode", 0],
			["set-frequency", 446_100_000],
		])
		expect(h.persisted.at(-1)).toEqual({ sourceId: "rtl", lease: null })
	})

	it("writes gain mode and gain when the current values are unknown placeholders", async () => {
		const h = harness(["gain", "gainMode"])
		const r = h.arbiter.acquire("a", "rtl", 50)
		if (!r.ok) throw new Error("acquire failed")
		// The placeholders (manual, 296) equal the target; unknown values still need the writes.
		await h.arbiter.retune(r.lease, { centreHz: 450_012_500, gainTenthsDb: 296, sampleRateHz: null })
		expect(h.tuner.sent.map(c => [c.name, c.value])).toEqual([
			["set-test-mode", 1],
			["set-frequency", 450_012_500],
			["set-gain-mode", 1],
			["set-gain", 296],
			["set-test-mode", 0],
		])
		expect([...r.lease.changedFields].sort()).toEqual(["frequency", "gain", "gainMode"])
	})

	it("persists changed fields before the commands that change them", async () => {
		let sentCount = () => 0
		const seen: { sent: number; changed: string[] }[] = []
		const h = harness([], {
			persistLease: (_sourceId, lease) => {
				seen.push({ sent: sentCount(), changed: [...(lease?.changedFields ?? [])] })
				return Promise.resolve()
			},
		})
		sentCount = () => h.tuner.sent.length
		const r = h.arbiter.acquire("a", "rtl", 50)
		if (!r.ok) throw new Error("acquire failed")
		await h.arbiter.retune(r.lease, { centreHz: 446_037_500, gainTenthsDb: 400, sampleRateHz: null })
		// acquire, then the grown set: both before the first command of the hop
		expect(seen).toEqual([
			{ sent: 0, changed: [] },
			{ sent: 0, changed: ["frequency", "gain"] },
		])
		expect(h.tuner.sent).toHaveLength(4)
	})

	it("restores a persisted lease on the first payload-started only", async () => {
		const h = harness()
		const recovered: string[] = []
		h.arbiter.on("recovered", (id: string) => recovered.push(id))
		h.arbiter.recoverPersistedLeases([
			{ sourceId: "rtl", jobId: "a", acquiredAt: 1, snapshot: { frequency: 446_100_000, gain: 296 }, changedFields: ["frequency", "gain"] },
		])
		h.sources.emit("payload-started", "rtl")
		await new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve))
		h.sources.emit("payload-started", "rtl")
		await new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve))
		expect(h.tuner.sent.map(c => [c.name, c.value, c.origin])).toEqual([
			["set-test-mode", 0, "scanner"],
			["set-frequency", 446_100_000, "scanner"],
			["set-gain", 296, "scanner"],
		])
		expect(recovered).toEqual(["rtl"])
		expect(h.persisted).toEqual([{ sourceId: "rtl", lease: null }])
	})

	it("retries recovery only after a failed write and always restores the frequency", async () => {
		const h = harness()
		const results: { restored: string[]; unrestorable: string[] }[] = []
		h.arbiter.on("recovered", (_id: string, r: { restored: string[]; unrestorable: string[] }) => results.push(r))
		h.arbiter.recoverPersistedLeases([
			{ sourceId: "rtl", jobId: "a", acquiredAt: 1, snapshot: { frequency: 446_100_000, gain: 296 }, changedFields: ["gain", "agcMode"] },
		])
		h.tuner.setControl("rtl", "external")
		h.sources.emit("payload-started", "rtl")
		await new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve))
		expect(results).toEqual([])
		expect(h.persisted).toEqual([])
		h.tuner.setControl("rtl", "internal")
		h.sources.emit("payload-started", "rtl")
		await new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve))
		expect(h.tuner.sent.map(c => [c.name, c.value])).toEqual([
			["set-test-mode", 0],
			["set-frequency", 446_100_000],
			["set-gain", 296],
		])
		// agcMode has no known snapshot value: reported once, never a reason to retry.
		expect(results).toEqual([{ restored: ["frequency", "gain"], unrestorable: ["agcMode"] }])
		expect(h.persisted).toEqual([{ sourceId: "rtl", lease: null }])
	})

	it("closes a marker left open by a dropped connection when the source comes back", async () => {
		const h = harness()
		const r = h.arbiter.acquire("a", "rtl", 50)
		if (!r.ok) throw new Error("acquire failed")
		h.tuner.afterTestModeOn = () => { h.tuner.failAll = new Error("socket closed") }
		await expect(
			h.arbiter.retune(r.lease, { centreHz: 446_037_500, gainTenthsDb: null, sampleRateHz: null }),
		).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "SCANNER_TUNER_WRITE" })
		expect(h.tuner.sent.map(c => [c.name, c.value])).toEqual([["set-test-mode", 1]])
		h.tuner.failAll = null
		h.sources.emit("disconnected", "rtl")
		h.sources.emit("payload-started", "rtl")
		await new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve))
		expect(h.tuner.sent.map(c => [c.name, c.value, c.accept])).toEqual([
			["set-test-mode", 1, false],
			["set-test-mode", 0, false],
		])
		expect(h.arbiter.holder("rtl")).toBe(r.lease)
		h.tuner.sent.length = 0
		await h.arbiter.release(r.lease, { restore: false })
		expect(h.tuner.sent.map(c => [c.name, c.value])).toEqual([["set-test-mode", 0]])
	})

	it("computes impact from actual assignments", () => {
		const h = harness(["agcMode"], {
			impactSources: {
				liveDemod: { getStatus: () => ({ running: true, sourceId: "rtl", clientCount: 2 }) } as never,
				digitalVoice: {
					getStatus: () => ({ decoders: [{ decoderId: "dmr", clientCount: 3 }, { decoderId: "other", clientCount: 5 }] }),
				} as never,
				decoders: {
					getAllStatus: () =>
						[
							{ id: "dmr", sourceId: "rtl", running: true, suspended: false, owner: "config", startMode: "operator" },
							{ id: "pager", sourceId: "rtl", running: false, suspended: true, owner: "config" },
							{ id: "other", sourceId: "air", running: true, suspended: false, owner: "config" },
							{ id: "scan-x", sourceId: "rtl", running: true, suspended: false, owner: "scanner" },
						] as never,
				},
			},
			scannerJobsOn: () => ["passive-rtl"],
		})
		const spec = { tuner: { sampleRateHz: null, gainTenthsDb: 300, agc: true, overload: "flag" } } as unknown as NormalisedJobSpec
		expect(h.arbiter.impact("rtl", spec)).toEqual({
			liveAudioClients: 2,
			digitalVoiceListeners: 3,
			runningDecoders: ["dmr"],
			pinnedDecoders: ["dmr"],
			scannerJobs: ["passive-rtl"],
			unrestorable: ["agcMode"],
		})
	})

	it("never counts the asking job among the scanner jobs on the source", () => {
		const calls: (string | undefined)[] = []
		const h = harness([], {
			scannerJobsOn: (_sourceId, exceptJobId) => {
				calls.push(exceptJobId)
				return ["passive-rtl", "sweep-a"].filter(id => id !== exceptJobId)
			},
		})
		const spec = { tuner: { sampleRateHz: null, gainTenthsDb: null, agc: null, overload: "flag" } } as unknown as NormalisedJobSpec
		expect(h.arbiter.impact("rtl", spec, "sweep-a").scannerJobs).toEqual(["passive-rtl"])
		expect(h.arbiter.impact("rtl", spec).scannerJobs).toEqual(["passive-rtl", "sweep-a"])
		expect(calls).toEqual(["sweep-a", undefined])
	})
})
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/tuner-arbiter.ts
/**
 * Tuner leases for sweep jobs (spec § 10.3, § 10.4). The scanner sends tuner
 * commands only through here; each carries origin "scanner". Test-mode
 * markers bracket every retune and are never accepted state (§ 4.6).
 */
import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"
import type { TunerCommandOrigin, TunerControlMode, TunerState } from "@wavekit/api-types"
import type { DecoderManager } from "../../decoders/manager.js"
import type { DigitalVoiceService } from "../digital-voice.js"
import type { LiveDemodulator } from "../live-demodulator.js"
import type { SourceManager } from "../source-manager.js"
import type {
	TunerController,
	TunerWriteOptions,
} from "../tuner-controller.js"
import { createComponentLogger, type Logger } from "../../utils/logger.js"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../utils/errors.js"
import { gainKeyOf, type EpochClock } from "../spectrum/spectrum-engine.js"
import type { LeaseTunerFields, PersistedLease } from "./store/persistence.js"
import type { Impact, NormalisedJobSpec, ScannerSettings } from "./types.js"
import type { PendingEpoch } from "../spectrum/types.js"

export type TunerFieldValues = LeaseTunerFields
export type LeaseLostReason = "preempted-operator" | "preempted-relay" | "preempted-job"

export interface Lease {
	sourceId: string
	jobId: string
	acquiredAt: number
	snapshot: Partial<TunerFieldValues>
	changedFields: Set<keyof TunerFieldValues>
}

export type ArbiterTuner = Pick<
	TunerController,
	"getState" | "setFrequency" | "setSampleRate" | "setGainMode" | "setGain" | "setAgcMode" | "setTestMode" | "on" | "off"
>

export interface ArbiterDeps {
	tuner: ArbiterTuner
	sources: Pick<SourceManager, "on" | "off" | "isRtlTcpSource">
	epochs: (sourceId: string) => EpochClock | undefined
	settings: () => ScannerSettings
	/** Timer-mode settle class of the source's transport (§ 4.6). */
	link: (sourceId: string) => "local" | "network"
	persistLease: (sourceId: string, lease: PersistedLease | null) => Promise<void>
	impactSources: {
		liveDemod: Pick<LiveDemodulator, "getStatus"> | null
		digitalVoice: Pick<DigitalVoiceService, "getStatus"> | null
		decoders: Pick<DecoderManager, "getAllStatus">
	}
	/** Ids of active scanner jobs on the source (other than `exceptJobId`). */
	scannerJobsOn: (sourceId: string, exceptJobId?: string) => string[]
	logger: Logger
	now?: () => number
}

const FIELDS: readonly (keyof TunerFieldValues)[] = ["sampleRate", "frequency", "gainMode", "gain", "agcMode"]

function toError(err: unknown): Error {
	return err instanceof Error ? err : new WaveKitError(String(err), "SCANNER_TUNER_WRITE")
}

export class TunerArbiter extends EventEmitter {
	private readonly log: Logger
	private readonly now: () => number
	private readonly leases = new Map<string, Lease>()
	private readonly priorities = new Map<string, number>()
	private readonly lost = new WeakSet<Lease>()
	private readonly recovering = new Map<string, PersistedLease>()
	private readonly lastOperatorAt = new Map<string, number>()
	/** Sources with TEST_MODE 1 sent and no successful TEST_MODE 0 since. */
	private readonly markerOpen = new Set<string>()

	constructor(private readonly deps: ArbiterDeps) {
		super()
		this.log = createComponentLogger(deps.logger, "TunerArbiter")
		this.now = deps.now ?? Date.now
		deps.tuner.on("command-sent", this.onCommandSent)
		deps.tuner.on("control-mode-changed", this.onControlMode)
		deps.sources.on("disconnected", this.onDisconnected)
		deps.sources.on("payload-started", this.onPayloadStarted)
	}

	dispose(): void {
		this.deps.tuner.off("command-sent", this.onCommandSent)
		this.deps.tuner.off("control-mode-changed", this.onControlMode)
		this.deps.sources.off("disconnected", this.onDisconnected)
		this.deps.sources.off("payload-started", this.onPayloadStarted)
	}

	holder(sourceId: string): Lease | undefined {
		return this.leases.get(sourceId)
	}

	acquire(
		jobId: string,
		sourceId: string,
		priority: number,
	):
		| { ok: true; lease: Lease }
		| { ok: false; code: "SCANNER_SOURCE_BUSY" | "SCANNER_NO_TUNER_CONTROL"; detail: string } {
		const state = this.deps.tuner.getState(sourceId)
		if (!state || !this.deps.sources.isRtlTcpSource(sourceId)) {
			return { ok: false, code: "SCANNER_NO_TUNER_CONTROL", detail: `Source ${sourceId} has no rtl_tcp tuner control` }
		}
		if (state.controlMode === "external") {
			return { ok: false, code: "SCANNER_SOURCE_BUSY", detail: "A tuner relay client controls the tuner" }
		}
		const current = this.leases.get(sourceId)
		if (current?.jobId === jobId) return { ok: true, lease: current }
		if (current) {
			if ((this.priorities.get(sourceId) ?? 0) >= priority) {
				return { ok: false, code: "SCANNER_SOURCE_BUSY", detail: `Lease held by scanner job ${current.jobId}` }
			}
			// Hand-over: the new job keeps the snapshot (§ 10.1 preempted-job row).
			const lease: Lease = {
				sourceId,
				jobId,
				acquiredAt: this.now(),
				snapshot: { ...current.snapshot },
				changedFields: new Set(current.changedFields),
			}
			this.lost.add(current)
			this.leases.set(sourceId, lease)
			this.priorities.set(sourceId, priority)
			void this.persist(lease)
			this.emit("lease-lost", current, "preempted-job")
			return { ok: true, lease }
		}
		const lease: Lease = {
			sourceId,
			jobId,
			acquiredAt: this.now(),
			snapshot: this.snapshotOf(state),
			changedFields: new Set(),
		}
		this.leases.set(sourceId, lease)
		this.priorities.set(sourceId, priority)
		void this.persist(lease)
		this.log.info({ sourceId, jobId, snapshot: lease.snapshot }, "Tuner lease acquired")
		return { ok: true, lease }
	}

	async retune(
		lease: Lease,
		target: { centreHz: number; gainTenthsDb: number | null; sampleRateHz: number | null },
	): Promise<PendingEpoch> {
		this.assertHeld(lease)
		const { sourceId } = lease
		const clock = this.deps.epochs(sourceId)
		if (!clock) throw new WaveKitError(`No spectrum engine for ${sourceId}`, "SCANNER_ENGINE_MISSING")
		const s = this.deps.settings()
		const opts: TunerWriteOptions = { origin: "scanner" }
		let state = this.requireState(sourceId)
		if (
			target.sampleRateHz !== null &&
			(target.sampleRateHz !== state.sampleRate || (state.unknownFields ?? []).includes("sampleRate"))
		) {
			await this.markChanged(lease, ["sampleRate"])
			this.assertHeld(lease)
			clock.suppressExternal(true)
			try {
				await this.deps.tuner.setSampleRate(sourceId, target.sampleRateHz, opts)
			} catch (err) {
				throw new WaveKitError(`Sample rate write failed: ${toError(err).message}`, "SCANNER_TUNER_WRITE", toError(err))
			} finally {
				clock.suppressExternal(false)
			}
			this.assertHeld(lease)
			state = this.requireState(sourceId)
		}
		const fs = state.sampleRate
		// unknownFields values are placeholders (controller: gainMode "agc", gain 0), never a reason to skip a write.
		const unknown = new Set(state.unknownFields ?? [])
		const needsGainMode = unknown.has("gainMode") || state.gainMode !== "manual"
		const gainChange =
			target.gainTenthsDb !== null &&
			(needsGainMode || unknown.has("gain") || state.gain !== target.gainTenthsDb)
		// Persisted before the epoch and the first command: a crash mid-sequence keeps them for recovery.
		const changing: (keyof TunerFieldValues)[] = ["frequency"]
		if (gainChange) changing.push(...(needsGainMode ? (["gainMode", "gain"] as const) : (["gain"] as const)))
		await this.markChanged(lease, changing)
		this.assertHeld(lease)
		const markers = s.sweep.markers && clock.markerSupported !== false
		const { commandSample, bufferedSamples } = clock.sampleClock()
		const pending: PendingEpoch = {
			epoch: clock.allocateEpoch(),
			commandSample,
			bufferedSamples,
			settleSamples: Math.round((s.sweep.settleMs[this.deps.link(sourceId)] * fs) / 1000),
			expectMarker: markers,
			markerTimeoutSamples: Math.round((s.sweep.markerTimeoutMs * fs) / 1000),
			pllSettleSamples: Math.round((s.sweep.pllSettleMs * fs) / 1000),
			centreHz: target.centreHz,
			sampleRateHz: fs,
			gainKey: target.gainTenthsDb !== null ? `m:${target.gainTenthsDb}` : gainKeyOf(state),
			tuningTrust: "commanded",
			centreChanged: target.centreHz !== clock.currentEpoch().centreHz,
		}
		clock.suppressExternal(true)
		clock.submitEpoch(pending)
		let failure: unknown = null
		try {
			if (markers) {
				this.markerOpen.add(sourceId)
				await this.deps.tuner.setTestMode(sourceId, true, { origin: "scanner", accept: false })
				this.assertHeld(lease)
			}
			await this.deps.tuner.setFrequency(sourceId, target.centreHz, opts)
			if (gainChange && target.gainTenthsDb !== null) {
				this.assertHeld(lease)
				if (needsGainMode) {
					await this.deps.tuner.setGainMode(sourceId, "manual", opts)
					this.assertHeld(lease)
				}
				await this.deps.tuner.setGain(sourceId, target.gainTenthsDb, opts)
			}
		} catch (err) {
			failure = err
		} finally {
			if (markers) await this.testModeOff(sourceId)
			clock.suppressExternal(false)
		}
		if (failure !== null) {
			if (failure instanceof WaveKitError && failure.code === "SCANNER_LEASE_LOST") throw failure
			throw new WaveKitError(`Retune failed: ${toError(failure).message}`, "SCANNER_TUNER_WRITE", toError(failure))
		}
		return pending
	}

	/** Job `tuner.agc` (sent once, inside the lease). */
	async setAgc(lease: Lease, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
		this.assertHeld(lease)
		await this.markChanged(lease, ["agcMode"])
		this.assertHeld(lease)
		await this.deps.tuner.setAgcMode(lease.sourceId, enabled, { origin: "scanner" })
	}

	async release(lease: Lease, opts: { restore: boolean }): Promise<{ restored: string[]; unrestorable: string[] }> {
		const held = this.leases.get(lease.sourceId) === lease && !this.lost.has(lease)
		this.lost.add(lease)
		if (!held) return { restored: [], unrestorable: [] }
		this.leases.delete(lease.sourceId)
		this.priorities.delete(lease.sourceId)
		// § 4.6: TEST_MODE 0 on every release of a held lease, before any restore.
		await this.testModeOff(lease.sourceId)
		let result: { restored: string[]; unrestorable: string[] } = { restored: [], unrestorable: [] }
		if (opts.restore) {
			const r = await this.restoreFields(lease.sourceId, lease.snapshot, [...lease.changedFields])
			result = { restored: r.restored, unrestorable: [...r.unknown, ...r.failed] }
		}
		await this.deps.persistLease(lease.sourceId, null).catch((err: unknown) => {
			this.log.warn({ err, sourceId: lease.sourceId }, "Clearing the persisted lease failed")
		})
		this.log.info({ sourceId: lease.sourceId, jobId: lease.jobId, ...result }, "Tuner lease released")
		return result
	}

	recoverPersistedLeases(persisted: PersistedLease[]): void {
		for (const lease of persisted) this.recovering.set(lease.sourceId, lease)
	}

	/** Since when nobody but the scanner touched the tuner (null while a relay holds control). */
	operatorIdleSince(sourceId: string): number | null {
		const state = this.deps.tuner.getState(sourceId)
		if (!state || state.controlMode === "external") return null
		return this.lastOperatorAt.get(sourceId) ?? 0
	}

	/** § 10.4. `exceptJobId`: the job asking, never counted among `scannerJobs`. */
	impact(sourceId: string, spec: NormalisedJobSpec, exceptJobId?: string): Impact {
		const { liveDemod, digitalVoice, decoders } = this.deps.impactSources
		const statuses = decoders.getAllStatus()
		const onSource = statuses.filter(s => s.sourceId === sourceId && s.owner !== "scanner")
		const ids = new Set(onSource.map(s => s.id))
		const live = liveDemod?.getStatus()
		const dv = digitalVoice?.getStatus()
		const state = this.deps.tuner.getState(sourceId)
		const unknown = new Set(state?.unknownFields ?? [])
		const changes: (keyof TunerFieldValues)[] = ["frequency"]
		if (spec.tuner.sampleRateHz !== null) changes.push("sampleRate")
		if (spec.tuner.gainTenthsDb !== null) changes.push("gainMode", "gain")
		if (spec.tuner.agc !== null) changes.push("agcMode")
		return {
			liveAudioClients: live?.running && live.sourceId === sourceId ? live.clientCount : 0,
			digitalVoiceListeners: (dv?.decoders ?? [])
				.filter(d => ids.has(d.decoderId))
				.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.clientCount, 0),
			runningDecoders: onSource.filter(s => s.running && !s.suspended).map(s => s.id),
			pinnedDecoders: onSource.filter(s => s.startMode === "operator").map(s => s.id),
			scannerJobs: this.deps.scannerJobsOn(sourceId, exceptJobId),
			unrestorable: changes.filter(f => unknown.has(f)),
		}
	}

	// === internals ===

	private requireState(sourceId: string): TunerState {
		const state = this.deps.tuner.getState(sourceId)
		if (!state) throw new WaveKitError(`Tuner source ${sourceId} is gone`, "SCANNER_NO_TUNER_CONTROL")
		return state
	}

	private assertHeld(lease: Lease): void {
		if (this.lost.has(lease) || this.leases.get(lease.sourceId) !== lease) {
			throw new WaveKitError(`Tuner lease for ${lease.sourceId} was lost`, "SCANNER_LEASE_LOST")
		}
	}

	private snapshotOf(state: TunerState): Partial<TunerFieldValues> {
		const unknown = new Set(state.unknownFields ?? [])
		const snapshot: Partial<TunerFieldValues> = {}
		if (!unknown.has("frequency")) snapshot.frequency = state.frequency
		if (!unknown.has("sampleRate")) snapshot.sampleRate = state.sampleRate
		if (!unknown.has("gainMode")) snapshot.gainMode = state.gainMode
		if (!unknown.has("gain")) snapshot.gain = state.gain
		if (!unknown.has("agcMode")) snapshot.agcMode = state.agcMode
		return snapshot
	}

	/** Adds fields about to be written and persists the lease (awaited) when the set grew. */
	private async markChanged(lease: Lease, fields: (keyof TunerFieldValues)[]): Promise<void> {
		const before = lease.changedFields.size
		for (const field of fields) lease.changedFields.add(field)
		if (lease.changedFields.size > before) await this.persist(lease)
	}

	private async persist(lease: Lease): Promise<void> {
		const record: PersistedLease = {
			sourceId: lease.sourceId,
			jobId: lease.jobId,
			acquiredAt: lease.acquiredAt,
			snapshot: { ...lease.snapshot },
			changedFields: [...lease.changedFields],
		}
		await this.deps.persistLease(lease.sourceId, record).catch((err: unknown) => {
			this.log.warn({ err, sourceId: lease.sourceId }, "Persisting the tuner lease failed")
		})
	}

	/** Never accepted state, so idempotent; the setTestMode call itself is issued synchronously. */
	private async testModeOff(sourceId: string): Promise<void> {
		try {
			await this.deps.tuner.setTestMode(sourceId, false, { origin: "scanner", accept: false })
			this.markerOpen.delete(sourceId)
		} catch (err) {
			this.log.error({ err, sourceId }, "TEST_MODE 0 failed; the engine reports stuckTestMode if counters persist")
		}
	}

	private async restoreFields(
		sourceId: string,
		snapshot: Partial<TunerFieldValues>,
		changed: (keyof TunerFieldValues)[],
	): Promise<{ restored: string[]; unknown: string[]; failed: string[] }> {
		const restored: string[] = []
		const unknown: string[] = []
		const failed: string[] = []
		const opts: TunerWriteOptions = { origin: "scanner" }
		const tuner = this.deps.tuner
		for (const field of FIELDS) {
			if (!changed.includes(field)) continue
			const value = snapshot[field]
			if (value === undefined) {
				unknown.push(field)
				continue
			}
			try {
				switch (field) {
					case "sampleRate":
						await tuner.setSampleRate(sourceId, value as number, opts)
						break
					case "frequency":
						await tuner.setFrequency(sourceId, value as number, opts)
						break
					case "gainMode":
						await tuner.setGainMode(sourceId, value as TunerFieldValues["gainMode"], opts)
						break
					case "gain":
						await tuner.setGain(sourceId, value as number, opts)
						break
					case "agcMode":
						await tuner.setAgcMode(sourceId, value as boolean, opts)
						break
				}
				restored.push(field)
			} catch (err) {
				this.log.warn({ err, sourceId, field }, "Restoring a tuner field failed")
				failed.push(field)
			}
		}
		return { restored, unknown, failed }
	}

	private lose(lease: Lease, reason: LeaseLostReason): void {
		if (this.leases.get(lease.sourceId) !== lease) return
		this.leases.delete(lease.sourceId)
		this.priorities.delete(lease.sourceId)
		this.lost.add(lease)
		void this.deps.persistLease(lease.sourceId, null).catch((err: unknown) => {
			this.log.warn({ err, sourceId: lease.sourceId }, "Clearing the persisted lease failed")
		})
		this.log.warn({ sourceId: lease.sourceId, jobId: lease.jobId, reason }, "Tuner lease lost; no restore")
		this.emit("lease-lost", lease, reason)
	}

	private readonly onCommandSent = (
		sourceId: string,
		_command: string,
		_value: number,
		origin?: TunerCommandOrigin,
	): void => {
		if (origin === "scanner") return
		if (origin === "replay") {
			this.emit("replay", sourceId)
			return
		}
		this.lastOperatorAt.set(sourceId, this.now())
		const lease = this.leases.get(sourceId)
		if (lease) this.lose(lease, "preempted-operator")
	}

	private readonly onControlMode = (sourceId: string, mode: TunerControlMode): void => {
		this.lastOperatorAt.set(sourceId, this.now())
		if (mode !== "external") return
		const lease = this.leases.get(sourceId)
		if (lease) this.lose(lease, "preempted-relay")
	}

	private readonly onDisconnected = (sourceId: string): void => {
		this.emit("source-down", sourceId)
	}

	private readonly onPayloadStarted = (sourceId: string): void => {
		const rtlTcp = this.deps.sources.isRtlTcpSource(sourceId)
		const persisted = this.recovering.get(sourceId)
		if (persisted && rtlTcp) {
			this.recovering.delete(sourceId)
			void this.recover(persisted)
		} else if (rtlTcp && (this.markerOpen.has(sourceId) || this.leases.has(sourceId))) {
			// A connection dropped mid-bracket can leave the dongle in test mode; replay never clears it.
			void this.testModeOff(sourceId)
		}
		this.emit("source-up", sourceId)
	}

	private async recover(persisted: PersistedLease): Promise<void> {
		const { sourceId } = persisted
		await this.testModeOff(sourceId)
		// Frequency always: a stale last-hop centre is the H4 hazard, whatever changedFields says.
		const fields = new Set<keyof TunerFieldValues>([...persisted.changedFields, "frequency"])
		const r = await this.restoreFields(sourceId, persisted.snapshot, [...fields])
		if (r.failed.length > 0) {
			// A write failed (for example relay control): retry on the next connection.
			// Unknown snapshot values can never be written, so they alone never cause a retry.
			this.recovering.set(sourceId, persisted)
			return
		}
		const result = { restored: r.restored, unrestorable: r.unknown }
		await this.deps.persistLease(persisted.sourceId, null).catch((err: unknown) => {
			this.log.warn({ err, sourceId: persisted.sourceId }, "Clearing the recovered lease failed")
		})
		this.log.info({ sourceId: persisted.sourceId, jobId: persisted.jobId, ...result }, "Restored the tuner after a crash during a sweep")
		this.emit("recovered", persisted.sourceId, result)
	}
}
```

Note: `operatorIdleSince` returns `0` when no operator action was ever seen (idle since boot).

```ts
// ProbePool extra methods:
```
