```ts
// src/core/scanner/job-runner.ts
/**
 * One discovery job (spec § 10.1–§ 10.5): the transition table, the sweep
 * scheduler, the lease and decoder hold, probe requests and progress.
 * Observations are owned by ScannerService; the runner gets per-job callbacks.
 */
import type { ScanJobProgress, ScanJobProbe } from "@wavekit/api-types"
import type { DecoderManager } from "../../decoders/manager.js"
import { createComponentLogger, type Logger } from "../../utils/logger.js"
import { WaveKitError } from "../../utils/errors.js"
import { ScannerApiError } from "./errors.js"
import { actionsForMode, isTerminal, transition, type JobAction, type JobEvent } from "./job-state.js"
import { DEFAULT_CONFIRM_HOLD_MS } from "./plan/plan-preview.js"
import type { ProbePool, ProbeRequest } from "./probes/probe-pool.js"
import { SweepScheduler, type SchedulerAction } from "./scheduler.js"
import type { EngineEpoch, SpectrumEngine } from "../spectrum/spectrum-engine.js"
import type { Lease, TunerArbiter } from "./tuner-arbiter.js"
import type {
	Classification,
	DecodeEvidence,
	FailReason,
	HopPlan,
	Impact,
	JobState,
	NormalisedJobSpec,
	PauseReason,
	PlanIssue,
	ScanJobSpec,
	ScannerConfidence,
	ScannerSettings,
	UndecodedReason,
} from "./types.js"
import type { TrackSnapshot } from "../spectrum/types.js"

export interface JobRecord {
	id: string
	name: string | null
	passive: boolean
	rawSpec: ScanJobSpec
	spec: NormalisedJobSpec
	plan: HopPlan
	issues: PlanIssue[]
	impact: Impact | null
	consentedImpact: Impact | null
	state: JobState
	reason?: PauseReason | FailReason
	createdAt: number
	updatedAt: number
	startedAt?: number
	endedAt?: number
	unrestorable: string[]
	counts: { observations: number; transients: number }
}

export interface LiveObservation {
	observationId: string
	sourceId: string
	trackId: string
	epoch: number
	jobIds: string[]
	discoveryId: string | null
	startedAt: number
	endedAt?: number
	classification: Classification
	probeIds: Set<string>
	hopIndex?: number
	lastActivityAt: number
	lastIngestAt: number
	lastTrack: TrackSnapshot | null
	decoded: boolean
	encrypted: boolean
	talkgroup?: string
	source?: string
	/** H3 reason recorded before the observation had a discovery; applied when it gets one. */
	undecodedReason?: UndecodedReason
}

export interface JobDriver {
	readonly record: JobRecord
	start(): Promise<void>
	dispatch(e: JobEvent): Promise<void>
	idle(): Promise<void>
	covers(sourceId: string, hz: number): boolean
	progress(): ScanJobProgress
	tick(now: number): void
	onEpochStarted(epoch: EngineEpoch): void
	onBlock(endSample: number, overload: boolean): void
	onStale(blocks: number): void
	onTrack(live: LiveObservation, track: TrackSnapshot, needsConfirm: boolean): void
	onTrackClosed(trackId: string): void
	/** § 4.7: the source moved without a command the core saw (pipeline `untracked-retune`). */
	onUntrackedRetune(): void
	onEvidence(probeId: string, ev: DecodeEvidence): void
	replan(spec: NormalisedJobSpec, plan: HopPlan): void
	dispose(): Promise<void>
}

export interface LeaseCandidate {
	jobId: string
	priority: number
	createdAt: number
}

/** P16: highest priority; ties go to the earliest job (then the smaller id). */
export function chooseLeaseHolder(candidates: readonly LeaseCandidate[]): string | null {
	let best: LeaseCandidate | null = null
	for (const c of candidates) {
		if (
			!best ||
			c.priority > best.priority ||
			(c.priority === best.priority && (c.createdAt < best.createdAt || (c.createdAt === best.createdAt && c.jobId < best.jobId)))
		) {
			best = c
		}
	}
	return best?.jobId ?? null
}

/** True when `now` disturbs anything the operator did not consent to (§ 10.3 auto-resume). */
export function impactGrew(now: Impact, consented: Impact | null): boolean {
	const c = consented ?? {
		liveAudioClients: 0,
		digitalVoiceListeners: 0,
		runningDecoders: [],
		pinnedDecoders: [],
		scannerJobs: [],
		unrestorable: [],
	}
	const notIn = (xs: string[], ys: string[]) => xs.some(x => !ys.includes(x))
	return (
		now.liveAudioClients > c.liveAudioClients ||
		now.digitalVoiceListeners > c.digitalVoiceListeners ||
		notIn(now.runningDecoders, c.runningDecoders) ||
		notIn(now.pinnedDecoders, c.pinnedDecoders) ||
		notIn(now.scannerJobs, c.scannerJobs) ||
		notIn(now.unrestorable, c.unrestorable)
	)
}

type Deferral = Extract<ReturnType<ProbePool["request"]>, { deferred: unknown }>["deferred"]

/** H3: the undecoded reason a probe deferral leaves behind; null when the request was only stale. */
export function undecodedForDeferral(d: Deferral): UndecodedReason | null {
	switch (d) {
		case "budget":
		case "max-probes":
		case "cpu":
			return "budget"
		case "no-transport":
			return "no-probe-transport"
		case "format":
			return "unsupported-format"
		case "stale-epoch":
			return null
	}
}

/** What ScannerService saw of one probe between "starting" and "stopped". */
export interface ProbeOutcome {
	startedAt: number
	holdMs: number
	/** Any evidence at all (the decoder synced on something). */
	output: boolean
	crcFailures: number
	/** Accepted identity or encryption flag (the pool's `confirmed`). */
	confirmed: boolean
}

/** A probe stopped before this share of its hold was released early (track closed, epoch, preemption): not a decode failure. */
const HOLD_USED_FRACTION = 0.9

/** H3: why a probe that used its hold without accepted evidence did not decode; null when it confirmed or was cut short. */
export function undecodedForProbe(o: ProbeOutcome, stoppedAt: number): UndecodedReason | null {
	if (o.confirmed) return null
	if (stoppedAt - o.startedAt < o.holdMs * HOLD_USED_FRACTION) return null
	if (o.crcFailures > 0) return "crc-errors"
	return o.output ? "timeout" : "no-sync"
}

export interface JobRunnerDeps {
	record: JobRecord
	arbiter: Pick<TunerArbiter, "acquire" | "retune" | "release" | "setAgc" | "holder" | "operatorIdleSince">
	probes: Pick<ProbePool, "request" | "release" | "releaseJob" | "follow" | "status" | "startLatencyMs">
	decoders: Pick<DecoderManager, "holdSource" | "releaseSource">
	settings: () => ScannerSettings
	openEngine: (sourceId: string) => Promise<SpectrumEngine>
	closeEngine: (sourceId: string) => Promise<void>
	engine: (sourceId: string) => SpectrumEngine | undefined
	/** Impact of this job's source excluding the job itself (`arbiter.impact(sourceId, spec, record.id)`). */
	impact: () => Impact
	/** H3: a probe request for this observation was deferred. */
	undecoded: (live: LiveObservation, reason: UndecodedReason) => void
	discoveryCounts: (jobId: string) => Record<ScannerConfidence, number>
	persist: () => void
	changed: (kind: "state" | "progress") => void
	logger: Logger
	now: () => number
}

const ACTIVE: ReadonlySet<JobState> = new Set(["starting", "running", "holding"])
const LOST_EVENTS: ReadonlySet<JobEvent["type"]> = new Set(["rest-write", "relay-external", "preempted-job"])

function inRange(hz: number, r: { startHz: number; endHz: number }): boolean {
	return hz >= r.startHz && hz <= r.endHz
}

export class JobRunner implements JobDriver {
	readonly record: JobRecord
	private readonly log: Logger
	private scheduler: SweepScheduler | null = null
	private lease: Lease | null = null
	private holdingDecoders = false
	private engineOpened = false
	private ownEpochs = new Set<number>()
	private epochOwn = false
	private hopIndex: number | undefined
	private hopCentre: number | null = null
	private chain: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve()
	private actionChain: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve()
	private readonly queued = new Set<JobEvent["type"]>()
	private readonly tracks = new Map<string, { live: LiveObservation; track: TrackSnapshot }>()
	private readonly windowHolds = new Map<string, { probeId: string; timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null; following: boolean }>()

	constructor(private readonly deps: JobRunnerDeps) {
		this.record = deps.record
		this.log = createComponentLogger(deps.logger, `Job:${deps.record.id}`)
	}

	private get sweep(): boolean {
		return this.record.spec.mode === "sweep"
	}

	private get sourceId(): string {
		return this.record.spec.sourceId
	}

	async start(): Promise<void> {
		await this.dispatch({ type: "start" })
	}

	dispatch(e: JobEvent): Promise<void> {
		const run = this.chain.then(() => this.apply(e))
		this.chain = run.catch(() => undefined)
		return run
	}

	idle(): Promise<void> {
		return Promise.all([this.chain, this.actionChain]).then(() => undefined)
	}

	covers(sourceId: string, hz: number): boolean {
		const { spec, state } = this.record
		if (sourceId !== spec.sourceId || !ACTIVE.has(state)) return false
		if (spec.ranges.length > 0 && !spec.ranges.some(r => inRange(hz, r))) return false
		if (spec.exclusions.some(x => inRange(hz, x))) return false
		if (this.sweep) return this.epochOwn
		const holder = this.deps.arbiter.holder(sourceId)
		return holder === undefined || holder.jobId === this.record.id
	}

	progress(): ScanJobProgress {
		const engine = this.deps.engine(this.sourceId)
		const p = this.scheduler?.progress()
		const stats = engine?.stats()
		const probes: ScanJobProbe[] = this.deps.probes
			.status()
			.filter(s => s.jobId === this.record.id)
			.map(s => ({
				probeId: s.probeId,
				decoderId: s.decoderId,
				trackId: s.trackId,
				targetHz: s.targetHz,
				protocol: s.protocol,
				transport: s.transport,
				state: s.state === "starting" ? "confirming" : s.state,
				startedAt: new Date(s.startedAt).toISOString(),
			}))
		return {
			sweepIndex: p?.sweepIndex ?? 0,
			hopIndex: p?.hopIndex ?? 0,
			hopCount: p?.hopCount ?? this.record.plan.hops.length,
			sweepPeriodMs: p?.sweepPeriodMs ?? null,
			coverage: p?.coverage ?? (stats && stats.observedSamples > 0 ? stats.settledSamples / stats.observedSamples : 0),
			holdingOn: p?.holdingOn ?? ([...this.windowHolds.keys()][0] ?? null),
			settleMode: engine?.currentEpoch().settleMode ?? null,
			probes,
			counts: { ...this.record.counts, discoveries: this.deps.discoveryCounts(this.record.id) },
		}
	}

	tick(now: number): void {
		const { state, reason, spec } = this.record
		if ((state === "running" || state === "holding") && this.scheduler) this.exec(this.scheduler.tick(now))
		if (
			(state === "running" || state === "holding") &&
			spec.stop.afterMs !== null &&
			this.record.startedAt !== undefined &&
			now - this.record.startedAt >= spec.stop.afterMs
		) {
			this.queueEvent({ type: "stop-condition" })
		}
		if (
			state === "paused" &&
			(reason === "preempted-operator" || reason === "preempted-relay") &&
			spec.resume.autoAfterIdleMs !== null
		) {
			const idleSince = this.deps.arbiter.operatorIdleSince(this.sourceId)
			if (idleSince !== null && now - idleSince >= spec.resume.autoAfterIdleMs && !this.deps.arbiter.holder(this.sourceId)) {
				this.queueEvent({ type: "preemptor-idle", impactGrew: impactGrew(this.deps.impact(), this.record.consentedImpact) })
			}
		}
	}

	onEpochStarted(epoch: EngineEpoch): void {
		const own = this.ownEpochs.has(epoch.epoch)
		if (this.record.state === "starting" && (!this.sweep || own)) this.queueEvent({ type: "engine-ready" })
		if (!this.sweep) return
		this.epochOwn = own && epoch.tuningTrust === "commanded"
		if (this.epochOwn && epoch.startSample !== null && this.scheduler) {
			this.exec(this.scheduler.onEpochStarted(epoch.startSample))
		}
	}

	onBlock(endSample: number, overload: boolean): void {
		if (!this.sweep || !this.epochOwn || !this.scheduler) return
		if (overload && this.hopIndex !== undefined) this.scheduler.onOverload(this.hopIndex)
		this.exec(this.scheduler.onBlock(endSample))
	}

	onStale(blocks: number): void {
		if (this.sweep && this.epochOwn) this.scheduler?.onStale(blocks)
	}

	onTrack(live: LiveObservation, track: TrackSnapshot, needsConfirm: boolean): void {
		if (this.hopIndex !== undefined && live.hopIndex === undefined && this.sweep) live.hopIndex = this.hopIndex
		this.tracks.set(track.trackId, { live, track })
		const policy = this.record.spec.hold.policy
		if (this.sweep && this.scheduler) {
			const holdMs = needsConfirm ? this.confirmHoldMs(live) : 0
			this.exec(this.scheduler.onTrack(track, needsConfirm && policy !== "never", holdMs))
			return
		}
		if (!needsConfirm || policy === "never" || this.windowHolds.has(track.trackId)) return
		const holdMs = this.confirmHoldMs(live)
		const res = this.requestProbe(live, track, holdMs)
		if (!res || !("started" in res)) return
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			const hold = this.windowHolds.get(track.trackId)
			if (hold && !hold.following) {
				this.windowHolds.delete(track.trackId)
				void this.deps.probes.release(hold.probeId)
			}
		}, holdMs)
		timer.unref()
		this.windowHolds.set(track.trackId, { probeId: res.started, timer, following: false })
	}

	onTrackClosed(trackId: string): void {
		this.tracks.delete(trackId)
		if (this.scheduler) this.exec(this.scheduler.onTrackClosed(trackId))
		const hold = this.windowHolds.get(trackId)
		if (!hold) return
		if (hold.timer) clearTimeout(hold.timer)
		this.windowHolds.delete(trackId)
		const hangMs = this.record.spec.hold.hangMs
		const timer = setTimeout(() => void this.deps.probes.release(hold.probeId), hold.following ? hangMs : 0)
		timer.unref()
	}

	onEvidence(probeId: string, ev: DecodeEvidence): void {
		if (!ev.identity && ev.encrypted === undefined) return
		const probe = this.deps.probes.status().find(p => p.probeId === probeId && p.jobId === this.record.id)
		if (probe) {
			const { spec } = this.record
			const follow = spec.hold.policy === "hold" && spec.record.voice
			this.deps.probes.follow(probeId, follow)
			if (this.scheduler) this.exec(this.scheduler.onConfirmed(probe.trackId, follow))
			const hold = this.windowHolds.get(probe.trackId)
			if (hold) {
				hold.following = follow
				if (!follow) {
					if (hold.timer) clearTimeout(hold.timer)
					this.windowHolds.delete(probe.trackId)
					void this.deps.probes.release(probeId)
				}
			}
		}
		if (this.record.spec.stop.onFirstDecoded && ev.identity) this.queueEvent({ type: "stop-condition" })
	}

	replan(spec: NormalisedJobSpec, plan: HopPlan): void {
		this.record.spec = spec
		this.record.plan = plan
		this.scheduler?.replan(plan, spec)
		for (const p of this.deps.probes.status()) {
			if (p.jobId === this.record.id && spec.exclusions.some(x => inRange(p.targetHz, x))) {
				void this.deps.probes.release(p.probeId)
			}
		}
	}

	async dispose(): Promise<void> {
		await this.idle()
		await this.teardown()
	}

	// === internals ===

	/**
	 * Drops everything the job holds: window holds, the lease (restored; a no-op when the
	 * arbiter already released or revoked it), the decoder hold and the engine reference.
	 * Called from `apply` for terminal states (inside the dispatch chain, so it must not
	 * await `idle()`) and from `dispose`.
	 */
	private async teardown(): Promise<void> {
		for (const hold of this.windowHolds.values()) if (hold.timer) clearTimeout(hold.timer)
		this.windowHolds.clear()
		const lease = this.lease
		this.lease = null
		if (lease) {
			const res = await this.deps.arbiter.release(lease, { restore: true }).catch((err: unknown) => {
				this.log.warn({ err }, "Releasing the lease on dispose failed")
				return null
			})
			if (res && res.unrestorable.length > 0) this.record.unrestorable = res.unrestorable
		}
		if (this.holdingDecoders) {
			this.holdingDecoders = false
			await this.deps.decoders.releaseSource(this.sourceId, this.record.id)
		}
		if (this.engineOpened) {
			this.engineOpened = false
			await this.deps.closeEngine(this.sourceId)
		}
	}

	/** Undoes the side effects of a transition whose actions failed and restores the previous state (§ 10.1). */
	private async rollback(
		before: { lease: boolean; holding: boolean; engine: boolean },
		prev: { state: JobState; reason?: PauseReason | FailReason; startedAt?: number },
	): Promise<void> {
		const { record } = this
		if (!before.engine && this.engineOpened) {
			this.engineOpened = false
			await this.deps.closeEngine(this.sourceId).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Closing the engine on rollback failed"))
		}
		if (!before.holding && this.holdingDecoders) {
			this.holdingDecoders = false
			await this.deps.decoders
				.releaseSource(this.sourceId, record.id)
				.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Releasing the decoder hold on rollback failed"))
		}
		if (!before.lease && this.lease) {
			const lease = this.lease
			this.lease = null
			await this.deps.arbiter
				.release(lease, { restore: true })
				.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Releasing the lease on rollback failed"))
		}
		record.state = prev.state
		if (prev.reason === undefined) delete record.reason
		else record.reason = prev.reason
		if (prev.startedAt === undefined) delete record.startedAt
		else record.startedAt = prev.startedAt
		record.updatedAt = this.deps.now()
		this.deps.changed("state")
	}

	private queueEvent(e: JobEvent): void {
		if (this.queued.has(e.type)) return
		this.queued.add(e.type)
		queueMicrotask(() => {
			this.queued.delete(e.type)
			void this.dispatch(e).catch((err: unknown) => {
				if (err instanceof ScannerApiError && err.code === "SCANNER_INVALID_TRANSITION") return
				this.log.warn({ err, event: e.type }, "Queued job event failed")
			})
		})
	}

	private async apply(e: JobEvent): Promise<void> {
		const { record } = this
		// The arbiter has already revoked the lease, whatever this job's state: never keep a stale one.
		if (LOST_EVENTS.has(e.type)) this.lease = null
		const from = record.reason === undefined ? { state: record.state } : { state: record.state, reason: record.reason }
		const t = transition(from, e)
		if ("invalid" in t) {
			throw new ScannerApiError(
				`Job ${record.id} cannot handle "${e.type}" in state ${record.state}`,
				"SCANNER_INVALID_TRANSITION",
				409,
			)
		}
		const actions = actionsForMode(record.spec.mode, t.actions)
		const before = { lease: this.lease !== null, holding: this.holdingDecoders, engine: this.engineOpened }
		const prev = {
			state: record.state,
			...(record.reason !== undefined ? { reason: record.reason } : {}),
			...(record.startedAt !== undefined ? { startedAt: record.startedAt } : {}),
		}
		if (actions.includes("acquire-lease")) {
			const r = this.deps.arbiter.acquire(record.id, this.sourceId, record.spec.priority)
			if (!r.ok) throw new ScannerApiError(r.detail, r.code, 409)
			this.lease = r.lease
		}
		const now = this.deps.now()
		record.state = t.state
		if (t.reason === undefined) delete record.reason
		else record.reason = t.reason
		record.updatedAt = now
		if (t.state === "running" && record.startedAt === undefined) record.startedAt = now
		if (e.type === "resume" && e.takeover) record.consentedImpact = this.deps.impact()
		try {
			for (const action of this.ordered(actions)) await this.run(action)
		} catch (err) {
			// A failed action (e.g. the engine cannot start before the source has caps) must not
			// leave the job in "starting" holding a lease or a decoder hold.
			await this.rollback(before, prev)
			throw err
		}
		if (isTerminal(t.state)) {
			record.endedAt = now
			await this.teardown()
		}
		this.deps.persist()
		this.deps.changed("state")
	}

	/** `restore` must run before `release-lease` (it releases with restore). */
	private ordered(actions: JobAction[]): JobAction[] {
		return [...actions].sort((a, b) => Number(b === "restore") - Number(a === "restore"))
	}

	private async run(action: JobAction): Promise<void> {
		const { record } = this
		switch (action) {
			case "acquire-lease":
				return
			case "restore":
			case "release-lease": {
				const lease = this.lease
				this.lease = null
				if (!lease) return
				const res = await this.deps.arbiter.release(lease, { restore: action === "restore" })
				record.unrestorable = res.unrestorable
				return
			}
			case "hold-decoders":
				// Awaited: configured decoders are suspended before open-engine / resend-hop retune (§ 10.4).
				await this.deps.decoders.holdSource(this.sourceId, "tuner-scanning", record.id)
				this.holdingDecoders = true
				return
			case "release-decoders":
				if (this.holdingDecoders) await this.deps.decoders.releaseSource(this.sourceId, record.id)
				this.holdingDecoders = false
				return
			case "stop-probes":
				for (const hold of this.windowHolds.values()) if (hold.timer) clearTimeout(hold.timer)
				this.windowHolds.clear()
				await this.deps.probes.releaseJob(record.id)
				return
			case "open-engine":
				await this.openEngine()
				return
			case "resend-hop":
				await this.resendHop()
				return
			case "report-impact":
				record.impact = this.deps.impact()
				return
		}
	}

	private async openEngine(): Promise<void> {
		const engine = await this.deps.openEngine(this.sourceId)
		this.engineOpened = true
		if (!this.sweep) {
			if (engine.currentEpoch().startSample !== null) this.queueEvent({ type: "engine-ready" })
			return
		}
		if (this.scheduler) {
			await this.resendHop()
			return
		}
		const cfg = engine.config()
		if (!cfg) throw new WaveKitError("Spectrum engine has no pipeline", "SCANNER_ENGINE_MISSING")
		const frames = Math.max(1, Math.round((cfg.integrationMs * cfg.sampleRateHz) / (cfg.fftSize * 1000)))
		this.scheduler = new SweepScheduler(this.record.plan, this.record.spec, {
			blockSamples: frames * cfg.fftSize,
			sampleRateHz: cfg.sampleRateHz,
			now: this.deps.now,
			probeStartMs: this.deps.probes.startLatencyMs("dsd-fme", "offset"),
			minSurfaceBlocks: this.deps.settings().detection.minSurfaceBlocks,
		})
		if (this.record.spec.tuner.agc !== null && this.lease) {
			await this.deps.arbiter.setAgc(this.lease, this.record.spec.tuner.agc)
		}
		this.exec(this.scheduler.start())
	}

	/** § 4.7: the source moved without a command we saw. A sweep re-asserts its hop (re-establishes `commanded`). */
	onUntrackedRetune(): void {
		if (!this.sweep || !this.lease) return
		this.epochOwn = false
		this.actionChain = this.actionChain
			.then(() => this.resendHop())
			.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Re-sending the hop after an untracked retune failed"))
	}

	private async resendHop(): Promise<void> {
		if (!this.lease || this.hopCentre === null || this.hopIndex === undefined) return
		await this.tune({ type: "tune", hopIndex: this.hopIndex, centreHz: this.hopCentre, gainTenthsDb: this.record.spec.tuner.gainTenthsDb })
	}

	private exec(actions: SchedulerAction[]): void {
		if (actions.length === 0) return
		this.actionChain = this.actionChain
			.then(() => this.execNow(actions))
			.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Scheduler action failed"))
	}

	private async execNow(actions: SchedulerAction[]): Promise<void> {
		for (const a of actions) {
			switch (a.type) {
				case "tune":
					await this.tune(a)
					break
				case "start-probe": {
					const t = this.tracks.get(a.trackId)
					if (!t) break
					this.requestProbe(t.live, t.track, a.holdMs)
					if (this.record.state === "running") this.queueEvent({ type: "hold" })
					break
				}
				case "stop-probes":
					await this.deps.probes.releaseJob(this.record.id)
					if (this.record.state === "holding") this.queueEvent({ type: "hold-done" })
					break
				case "sweep-complete": {
					const after = this.record.spec.stop.afterSweeps
					if (after !== null && a.sweepIndex + 1 >= after) this.queueEvent({ type: "stop-condition" })
					this.deps.changed("progress")
					break
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private async tune(a: Extract<SchedulerAction, { type: "tune" }>): Promise<void> {
		const lease = this.lease
		if (!lease) return
		this.hopIndex = a.hopIndex
		this.hopCentre = a.centreHz
		this.epochOwn = false
		try {
			const pending = await this.deps.arbiter.retune(lease, {
				centreHz: a.centreHz,
				gainTenthsDb: a.gainTenthsDb,
				sampleRateHz: this.record.spec.tuner.sampleRateHz,
			})
			this.ownEpochs.add(pending.epoch)
			if (this.ownEpochs.size > 64) this.ownEpochs.delete(this.ownEpochs.values().next().value as number)
		} catch (err) {
			if (err instanceof WaveKitError && err.code === "SCANNER_LEASE_LOST") return
			this.log.warn({ err, hopIndex: a.hopIndex }, "Retune failed")
			if (this.record.state === "starting") this.queueEvent({ type: "tuner-error" })
		}
		this.deps.changed("progress")
	}

	private confirmHoldMs(live: LiveObservation): number {
		const cls = live.classification.class
		const configured = this.record.spec.hold.confirmHoldMs[cls]
		return (configured ?? DEFAULT_CONFIRM_HOLD_MS[cls]) + this.deps.probes.startLatencyMs("dsd-fme", "offset")
	}

	private requestProbe(live: LiveObservation, track: TrackSnapshot, holdMs: number) {
		const s = this.deps.settings()
		if (this.record.passive && !s.passive.offsetProbes) return null
		const engine = this.deps.engine(this.sourceId)
		const fs = engine?.currentEpoch().sampleRateHz ?? 0
		const req: ProbeRequest = {
			jobId: this.record.id,
			priority: this.record.spec.priority,
			sourceId: this.sourceId,
			trackId: track.trackId,
			observationId: live.observationId,
			discoveryId: live.discoveryId,
			targetHz: track.centreHz,
			epoch: live.epoch,
			cls: live.classification.class,
			protocols: this.record.spec.protocols,
			preRollFromSample: Math.max(0, track.startSample - Math.round((s.hold.preRollMs * fs) / 1000)),
			holdMs,
			record: this.record.spec.record.voice,
			admission: {
				kind: this.record.spec.protocols.length > 0 ? "protocol-target" : live.decoded ? "reconfirm" : "undecoded",
				snrDb: track.snrDb,
			},
		}
		const res = this.deps.probes.request(req)
		if ("started" in res) live.probeIds.add(res.started)
		else {
			const reason = undecodedForDeferral(res.deferred)
			if (reason) this.deps.undecoded(live, reason)
		}
		return res
	}
}
```

```ts
export interface ScannerServiceDeps {

	tickMs?: number
}

const SNAPSHOT_EVERY_MS = 10_000
const MAINTENANCE_EVERY_MS = 5 * 60_000
const STATUS_EVERY_MS = 1_000
const RECENT_KEEP_MS = 10_000
const RECONFIRM_AFTER_MS = 15 * 60_000
const RESTORE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000

const PASSIVE_COST_LIMIT = 0.25

/** § 7.4: re-key when the estimate moves by more than half the smallest raster tolerance (rasterToleranceHz ≥ 1 kHz). */
const REKEY_MIN_CHANGE_HZ = 500

function storageCaps(s: ScannerSettings): StorageCaps {
	return {
		maxRecordingsMb: s.storage.maxRecordingsMb,
		maxEvidenceMb: s.storage.maxEvidenceMb,
		maxAgeDays: s.storage.maxAgeDays,
		minFreeDiskMb: s.storage.minFreeDiskMb,
	}
}

interface EngineEntry {
	engine: SpectrumEngine
	refs: number
	openedAt: number
	lastSummary: BlockSummary | null
}

function intersectRanges(sets: FreqRange[][]): FreqRange[] {
	if (sets.length === 0) return []
	let acc = sets[0]!
	for (const set of sets.slice(1)) {
		const next: FreqRange[] = []
		for (const a of acc) {
			for (const b of set) {
				const startHz = Math.max(a.startHz, b.startHz)
				const endHz = Math.min(a.endHz, b.endHz)
				if (startHz < endHz) next.push({ startHz, endHz })
			}
		}
		acc = next
	}
	return acc
}

function linkOf(cfg: SourceConfig): "local" | "network" {
	const host = cfg.host ?? "127.0.0.1"
	return host === "127.0.0.1" || host === "localhost" || host === "::1" ? "local" : "network"
}

function withTimeout<T>(p: Promise<T>, ms: number, fallback: T): Promise<T> {
	return new Promise(resolve => {
		const timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(fallback), ms)
		timer.unref()
		p.then(
			v => {
				clearTimeout(timer)
				resolve(v)
			},
			() => {
				clearTimeout(timer)
				resolve(fallback)
			},
		)
	})
}

		this.ambient = new AmbientEvidence({

	get enabled(): boolean {

	// === lifecycle ===

	async start(): Promise<void> {
		if (this.started) return
		this.started = true
		const loaded = await this.persistence.load()
		this.store.restore({ discoveries: loaded.discoveries, observations: loaded.observations, corrections: loaded.corrections })
		for (const entry of loaded.entries) this.store.replay(entry)
		if (loaded.droppedLines > 0) this.log.warn({ droppedLines: loaded.droppedLines }, "Dropped torn journal lines")
		this.overrides = loaded.settings

		for (const cfg of this.deps.sourceConfigs) this.updateFrequencyError(cfg.id, { rekey: false })
		this.persistedEngines = loaded.engines

		await this.evidence.removeOrphanProbeDirs().catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Orphaned probe folder cleanup failed"))
		this.store.on("mutation", this.onStoreMutation)
		this.store.on("change", this.onStoreChange)
		this.arbiter.on("lease-lost", this.onLeaseLost)
		this.arbiter.on("source-down", this.onSourceDown)
		this.arbiter.on("source-up", this.onSourceUp)
		this.arbiter.on("recovered", this.onRecovered)
		this.deps.sources.on("source-removed", this.onSourceRemoved)
		// Boot-time caps are absent until SourceManager.connect(): passive jobs are (re)built when a source becomes usable.
		this.deps.sources.on("connected", this.onSourceAvailable)
		this.deps.sources.on("caps-changed", this.onSourceAvailable)
		this.probes.on("evidence", this.onProbeEvidence)
		this.probes.on("recordings", this.onProbeRecordings)
		this.probes.on("probe-state", this.onProbeState)
		this.ambient.on("evidence", this.onAmbientEvidence)
		const leases = loaded.jobs.flatMap(j => (j.lease ? [j.lease] : []))
		for (const lease of leases) this.persistedLeases.set(lease.sourceId, lease)
		this.arbiter.recoverPersistedLeases(leases)
		for (const pj of loaded.jobs) await this.restoreJob(pj)
		this.disk = await this.evidence.diskState().catch(() => "ok" as const)
		// Disabled: jobs are listed (paused core-restart) but nothing resumes, ticks or touches the tuner.
		if (this.settings().enabled) {
			await this.ensurePassiveJobs()
			this.ambient.start()
			this.deps.cpuMeter?.start()
			this.timer = setInterval(() => this.tick(), this.deps.tickMs ?? 100)
			this.timer.unref()
		}
		this.log.info({ jobs: this.jobs.size, discoveries: loaded.discoveries.length, storageDir: this.storageDir }, "Scanner started")
	}

	async stop(): Promise<void> {
		if (!this.started) return
		this.started = false
		if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer)
		this.timer = null
		this.deps.sources.off("connected", this.onSourceAvailable)
		this.deps.sources.off("caps-changed", this.onSourceAvailable)
		await this.passiveChain
		await Promise.all([...this.drivers.values()].map(d => d.idle()))
		for (const sourceId of this.engines.keys()) {
			const lease = this.arbiter.holder(sourceId)
			if (lease) {
				await withTimeout(this.arbiter.release(lease, { restore: true }), RESTORE_TIMEOUT_MS, {
					restored: [],
					unrestorable: [],
				})
			}
		}
		await this.probes.destroy()
		for (const d of this.drivers.values()) await d.dispose()
		this.ambient.stop()
		this.deps.cpuMeter?.stop()
		for (const [sourceId, entry] of this.engines) {
			const state = await entry.engine.stop()
			if (state) await this.persistence.writeEngine(sourceId, state).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, sourceId }, "Engine state write failed"))
		}
		this.engines.clear()
		this.arbiter.dispose()
		this.deps.sources.off("source-removed", this.onSourceRemoved)
		await this.persistence.writeSnapshot(this.store.snapshot())
		await this.persistJobs()
		this.log.info("Scanner stopped")
	}

	// === status and settings ===

	status(): ScannerStatus {
		const s = this.settings()
		const probes = this.probes.status()
		const engines: ScannerEngineStatus[] = this.deps.sourceConfigs.map(cfg => this.engineStatus(cfg))
		return {
			enabled: s.enabled,
			channelizerAvailable: false,
			engines,
			budgets: {
				cpuBudgetCores: s.cpuBudgetCores,
				cpuCoresInUse: this.engines.size * CPU_COST.engine + probes.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.cores, 0),
				maxProbes: { offset: s.maxProbes.offset, channel: s.maxProbes.channel },
				probesInUse: {
					offset: probes.filter(p => p.transport === "offset").length,
					channel: probes.filter(p => p.transport === "channel").length,
				},
			},
			cpuGuard: {
				percent: this.deps.cpuMeter?.normalisedPercent ?? null,
				limitPercent: s.cpuGuardPercent,
				source: this.deps.cpuMeter?.mode ?? "os",
			},
			disk: this.disk,
			jobs: {
				active: [...this.jobs.values()].filter(j => !isTerminal(j.state)).length,
				total: this.jobs.size,
			},
		}
	}

	settingsView(): ScannerSettingsView {
		return {
			effective: this.effective.settings,
			passiveBySource: this.effective.passiveBySource,
			provenance: this.effective.provenance,
			bounds: SCANNER_SETTINGS_BOUNDS,
		}
	}

	async patchSettings(patch: RuntimeSettingsOverrides): Promise<ScannerSettingsView> {
		this.overrides = applySettingsPatch(this.overrides, patch)
		this.recomputeSettings()
		await this.persistence.writeSettings(this.overrides)
		await this.ensurePassiveJobs()
		this.emitStatus(true)
		return this.settingsView()
	}

	bandplans(): BandplanDto[] {
		return bandplansFor(this.deps.region)
	}

	recordMeasurement(m: Partial<PreviewMeasured>): void {
		this.measured = { ...this.measured, ...m }
	}

	// === jobs ===

	preview(spec: ScanJobSpec): PlanPreview {
		return previewPlan(spec, this.previewContext())
	}

	async createJob(spec: ScanJobSpec): Promise<ScanJob> {
		if (!this.settings().enabled) throw new ScannerApiError("The scanner is disabled", "SCANNER_DISABLED", 503)
		if (spec.kind === "monitor") {
			throw new ScannerApiError("Listen-scan jobs need the channelizer", "SCANNER_MONITOR_UNAVAILABLE", 400)
		}
		const preview = this.preview(spec)
		this.rejectErrors(preview.issues)
		const n = preview.spec
		if (n.mode === "sweep") {
			const impact = this.arbiter.impact(n.sourceId, n)
			if (this.impactNonEmpty(impact) && !n.takeover) {
				throw new ScannerApiError("This sweep disturbs other consumers; resend with takeover", "SCANNER_TAKEOVER_REQUIRED", 409, { impact })
			}
		}
		const now = this.now()
		const record: JobRecord = {
			id: `j_${ulid(now)}`,
			name: spec.name ?? null,
			passive: false,
			rawSpec: spec,
			spec: n,
			plan: preview.plan,
			issues: preview.issues,
			impact: n.mode === "sweep" ? this.arbiter.impact(n.sourceId, n) : null,
			consentedImpact: n.mode === "sweep" && n.takeover ? this.arbiter.impact(n.sourceId, n) : null,
			state: "pending",
			createdAt: now,
			updatedAt: now,
			unrestorable: [],
			counts: { observations: 0, transients: 0 },
		}
		const driver = this.createDriver(record)
		this.jobs.set(record.id, record)
		this.drivers.set(record.id, driver)
		try {
			await driver.start()
		} catch (err) {
			this.jobs.delete(record.id)
			this.drivers.delete(record.id)
			await driver.dispose()
			throw err
		}
		this.updateMasks(n.sourceId)
		await this.persistJobs()
		const dto = this.toDto(record)
		this.emit("job", dto)
		return dto
	}

	listJobs(): ScanJob[] {
		return [...this.jobs.values()].map(r => this.toDto(r))
	}

	getJob(id: string): ScanJob | undefined {
		const r = this.jobs.get(id)
		return r ? this.toDto(r) : undefined
	}

	async patchJob(id: string, patch: ScanJobSpec): Promise<{ job: ScanJob; plan: HopPlan; issues: PlanIssue[] }> {
		const record = this.requireJob(id)
		if (isTerminal(record.state)) throw new ScannerApiError("Job has ended", "SCANNER_JOB_TERMINAL", 409)
		const allowed: (keyof ScanJobSpec)[] = ["thresholdDb", "sensitivity", "exclusions", "hold", "revisit", "record", "protocols"]
		const merged: ScanJobSpec = { ...toJobSpec(record.spec) }
		for (const key of allowed) if (patch[key] !== undefined) Object.assign(merged, { [key]: patch[key] })
		const preview = this.preview(merged)
		this.rejectErrors(preview.issues)
		record.rawSpec = { ...record.rawSpec, ...merged }
		record.issues = preview.issues
		record.updatedAt = this.now()
		this.requireDriver(id).replan(preview.spec, preview.plan)
		this.updateMasks(record.spec.sourceId)
		await this.persistJobs()
		const job = this.toDto(record)
		this.emit("job", job)
		return { job, plan: preview.plan, issues: preview.issues }
	}

	async pauseJob(id: string): Promise<ScanJob> {
		return this.lifecycle(id, { type: "pause" })
	}

	async resumeJob(id: string, opts: { takeover: boolean }): Promise<ScanJob> {
		return this.lifecycle(id, { type: "resume", takeover: opts.takeover })
	}

	async cancelJob(id: string): Promise<ScanJob> {
		return this.lifecycle(id, { type: "cancel" })
	}

	deleteJob(id: string): void {
		const record = this.requireJob(id)
		if (!isTerminal(record.state)) throw new ScannerApiError("Only ended jobs can be deleted", "SCANNER_JOB_NOT_TERMINAL", 409)
		this.jobs.delete(id)
		this.drivers.delete(id)
		void this.persistJobs()
	}

	// === discoveries and evidence ===

	listDiscoveries(filter: DiscoveryFilter): { items: Discovery[]; nextCursor: string | null } {
		return this.store.list(filter)
	}

	getDiscovery(id: string): Discovery | undefined {
		return this.store.get(id)
	}

	discoveryObservations(id: string, cursor: string | null, limit: number): { items: Observation[]; nextCursor: string | null } {
		if (!this.store.get(id)) throw new ScannerApiError(`Discovery ${id} not found`, "SCANNER_DISCOVERY_NOT_FOUND", 404)
		return this.store.observations(id, cursor, limit)
	}

	async patchDiscovery(id: string, patch: Partial<NonNullable<Discovery["operator"]>>): Promise<Discovery> {
		if (!this.store.get(id)) throw new ScannerApiError(`Discovery ${id} not found`, "SCANNER_DISCOVERY_NOT_FOUND", 404)
		const d = this.store.setOperator(id, patch)
		if (patch.lockout) {
			await Promise.all(this.probes.status().filter(p => p.discoveryId === id).map(p => this.probes.release(p.probeId)))
		}
		return d
	}

	async deleteDiscovery(id: string): Promise<boolean> {
		const discovery = this.store.get(id)
		if (!discovery || !this.store.delete(id)) return false
		this.emit("discovery", { change: "deleted", discovery } satisfies ScannerDiscoveryEventData)
		await rm(join(this.storageDir, "evidence", id), { recursive: true, force: true })
		await rm(join(this.storageDir, "recordings", "dv", id), { recursive: true, force: true })
		await rm(join(this.storageDir, "recordings", "analog", id), { recursive: true, force: true })
		return true
	}

	recordingPath(recordingId: string): string | null {
		return this.evidence.recordingPath(recordingId)
	}

	async evidencePath(discoveryId: string, kind: "psd" | "iq"): Promise<string | null> {
		const dir = join(this.storageDir, "evidence", discoveryId)
		if (kind === "psd") {
			const path = join(dir, "psd.json")
			return existsSync(path) ? path : null
		}
		const files = await readdir(dir).catch(() => [] as string[])
		const iq = files.filter(f => f.startsWith("iq-") && f.endsWith(".cu8")).sort()
		return iq.length > 0 ? join(dir, iq[iq.length - 1]!) : null
	}

	// === engines ===

	private async openEngine(sourceId: string): Promise<SpectrumEngine> {
		const existing = this.engines.get(sourceId)
		if (existing) {
			existing.refs += 1
			await this.ensureEngineTuning(sourceId)
			return existing.engine
		}
		const engine = new SpectrumEngine({
			sourceId,
			sources: this.deps.sources,
			routing: this.deps.routing,
			tuner: this.deps.tuner,
			settings: () => this.settings(),
			tuning: () => this.engineTuning(sourceId),
			logger: this.deps.logger,
			host: this.deps.engineHost ?? "thread",
			...(this.persistedEngines[sourceId] ? { persistedEngine: this.persistedEngines[sourceId] } : {}),
		})
		const entry: EngineEntry = { engine, refs: 1, openedAt: this.now(), lastSummary: null }
		this.engines.set(sourceId, entry)
		engine.on("pipeline", (ev: PipelineEvent, epoch: EngineEpoch) => this.onPipelineEvent(sourceId, ev, epoch))
		engine.on("error", (err: Error) => {
			this.engineErrors.set(sourceId, err.message)
			this.log.warn({ err, sourceId }, "Spectrum engine error")
		})
		try {
			await engine.start()
		} catch (err) {
			this.engines.delete(sourceId)
			this.engineErrors.set(sourceId, err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err))
			throw err
		}
		engine.setSpectrumFeed(true)
		this.updateMasks(sourceId)
		return engine
	}

	private async closeEngine(sourceId: string): Promise<void> {
		const entry = this.engines.get(sourceId)
		if (!entry) return
		entry.refs -= 1
		if (entry.refs > 0) return
		this.engines.delete(sourceId)
		const state = await entry.engine.stop()
		if (state) {
			this.persistedEngines[sourceId] = state
			await this.persistence.writeEngine(sourceId, state).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, sourceId }, "Engine state write failed"))
		}
	}

	private engineTuning(sourceId: string): EngineTuning {
		const holder = this.arbiter.holder(sourceId)
		const spec = holder ? this.jobs.get(holder.jobId)?.spec : undefined
		if (!spec) return DEFAULT_TUNING
		return { fftSize: spec.fftSize, integrationMs: spec.integrationMs, thresholdDb: spec.thresholdDb, sensitivity: spec.sensitivity }
	}

	private async ensureEngineTuning(sourceId: string): Promise<void> {
		const entry = this.engines.get(sourceId)
		const cfg = entry?.engine.config()
		if (!entry || !cfg) return
		const t = this.engineTuning(sourceId)
		const differs =
			(t.fftSize !== null && t.fftSize !== cfg.fftSize) ||
			(t.integrationMs !== null && t.integrationMs !== cfg.integrationMs) ||
			t.thresholdDb !== cfg.thresholdDb
		if (differs) await entry.engine.reconfigure()
	}

	private updateMasks(sourceId: string): void {
		const entry = this.engines.get(sourceId)
		if (!entry) return
		const specs = [...this.jobs.values()].filter(j => j.spec.sourceId === sourceId && !isTerminal(j.state)).map(j => j.spec)
		const ranges = specs.flatMap(s => s.ranges)
		entry.engine.setMasks({
			exclusions: intersectRanges(specs.map(s => s.exclusions)),
			cfarRanges: ranges.map(r => ({ startHz: r.startHz, endHz: r.endHz })),
			burstRanges: ranges.filter(r => (r.protocols ?? []).some(p => BURST_PROTOCOLS.has(p))).map(r => ({ startHz: r.startHz, endHz: r.endHz })),
			rasters: ranges.flatMap(r => r.rasters ?? []),
			obwHz: [...new Set(ranges.flatMap(r => r.obwHz ?? []))],
			// § 6.2: in-window while no sweep lease holds the source (truncated segments → `edge`).
			inWindow: this.arbiter.holder(sourceId) === undefined,
		})
	}

	private rastersAt(sourceId: string, hz: number) {
		return [...this.jobs.values()]
			.filter(j => j.spec.sourceId === sourceId && !isTerminal(j.state))
			.flatMap(j => j.spec.ranges)
			.filter(r => hz >= r.startHz && hz <= r.endHz)
			.flatMap(r => r.rasters ?? [])
	}

	// === pipeline events → observations ===

	private onPipelineEvent(sourceId: string, ev: PipelineEvent, epoch: EngineEpoch): void {
		const drivers = this.driversOn(sourceId)
		switch (ev.kind) {
			case "epoch-started":
				void this.probes.onEpoch(sourceId, ev.epoch, epoch.centreHz).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Probe epoch change failed"))
				for (const d of drivers) d.onEpochStarted(epoch)
				return
			case "stale-discard":
				for (const d of drivers) d.onStale(ev.blocks)
				return
			case "track-open":
			case "track-update":
			case "track-close":
				this.onTrack(sourceId, ev, epoch)
				return
			case "transient":
				for (const d of drivers) if (d.covers(sourceId, ev.centreHz)) d.record.counts.transients += 1
				return
			case "block-summary":
				this.onBlockSummary(sourceId, ev.summary)
				for (const d of drivers) d.onBlock(ev.summary.endSample, ev.summary.overload)
				return
			case "untracked-retune":
				// § 4.7: the engine already marked the epoch unverified; sweeps re-send their hop,
				// in-window jobs continue with unverified observations.
				for (const d of drivers) d.onUntrackedRetune()
				return
			case "stats":
				return
		}
	}

	private onTrack(
		sourceId: string,
		ev: Extract<PipelineEvent, { kind: "track-open" | "track-update" | "track-close" }>,
		_epoch: EngineEpoch,
	): void {
		const track = ev.track
		const now = this.now()
		const covering = this.driversOn(sourceId).filter(d => d.covers(sourceId, track.centreHz))
		let live = this.live.get(track.trackId)
		if (!live) {
			if (covering.length === 0) return
			live = {
				observationId: `o_${ulid(now)}`,
				sourceId,
				trackId: track.trackId,
				epoch: track.epoch,
				jobIds: [],
				discoveryId: null,
				startedAt: now,
				classification: this.classify(track, sourceId),
				probeIds: new Set(),
				lastActivityAt: now,
				lastIngestAt: 0,
				lastTrack: track,
				decoded: false,
				encrypted: false,
			}
			this.live.set(track.trackId, live)
			this.emitActivity(live, track, true)
		}
		for (const d of covering) if (!live.jobIds.includes(d.record.id)) live.jobIds.push(d.record.id)
		live.lastTrack = track
		live.lastActivityAt = now
		if (ev.kind !== "track-open") live.classification = this.classify(track, sourceId)
		const closing = ev.kind === "track-close"
		if (closing || (now - live.startedAt >= 1000 && now - live.lastIngestAt >= 1000)) {
			this.ingest(live, track, closing ? this.endReason(sourceId, ev.endReason) : undefined)
		}
		const needs = this.needsConfirm(live, track)
		for (const d of covering) d.onTrack(live, track, needs)
		if (!closing) return
		for (const jobId of live.jobIds) this.drivers.get(jobId)?.onTrackClosed(track.trackId)
		this.probes.trackClosed(track.trackId)
		this.live.delete(track.trackId)
		live.endedAt = now
		this.recent.push(live)
		this.emitActivity(live, track, false)
		if (live.probeIds.size === 0 && live.discoveryId) this.markRecording(live.observationId, "none")
		void this.writePsdEvidence(live)
	}

	private endReason(sourceId: string, reason: ObservationEndReason): ObservationEndReason {
		if (reason !== "retune") return reason
		const holder = this.arbiter.holder(sourceId)
		return holder && this.jobs.get(holder.jobId)?.spec.mode === "sweep" ? "hop" : "retune"
	}

	private ingest(live: LiveObservation, track: TrackSnapshot, endReason?: ObservationEndReason): void {
		const now = this.now()
		const sweep = live.jobIds.some(id => this.jobs.get(id)?.spec.mode === "sweep")
		const res = this.store.ingest({
			id: live.observationId,
			sourceId: live.sourceId,
			jobIds: live.jobIds,
			track,
			classification: live.classification,
			startedAt: live.startedAt,
			...(endReason ? { endedAt: now, endReason } : {}),
			...(live.hopIndex !== undefined ? { hopIndex: live.hopIndex } : {}),
			singleBlockSurfacingAllowed: sweep,
		})
		live.lastIngestAt = now
		if (res.change === "transient" || res.discoveryId === null) {
			// A re-ingest that raised truncated/iqImage unlinks the observation (StoreMutation.removedObservations):
			// drop the link so evidence, recordings and activity events no longer point at the discovery.
			live.discoveryId = null
			if (endReason) for (const id of live.jobIds) {
				const r = this.jobs.get(id)
				if (r) r.counts.transients += 1
			}
			return
		}
		if (live.discoveryId === null) {
			for (const id of live.jobIds) {
				const r = this.jobs.get(id)
				if (r) r.counts.observations += 1
			}
		}
		live.discoveryId = res.discoveryId
		live.decoded = this.store.get(res.discoveryId)?.confidence === "decoded"
		if (live.undecodedReason) {
			this.markUndecoded(live, live.undecodedReason)
			delete live.undecodedReason
		}
		this.dirty = true
	}

	private classifierContext(sourceId: string, centreHz: number): { priors: Partial<Record<ScannerProtocol, number>>; protocols: ScannerProtocol[] } {
		const specs = this.driversOn(sourceId).filter(d => d.covers(sourceId, centreHz)).map(d => d.record.spec)
		const all = specs.length === 0 || specs.some(s => s.protocols.length === 0)
		const protocols = all ? [] : [...new Set(specs.flatMap(s => s.protocols))]
		const priors: Partial<Record<ScannerProtocol, number>> = {}
		const bandProtocols = specs
			.flatMap(s => s.ranges)
			.filter(r => centreHz >= r.startHz && centreHz <= r.endHz && (r.protocols ?? []).length > 0)
			.flatMap(r => r.protocols ?? [])
		if (bandProtocols.length > 0) {
			for (const p of probeProtocols) if (!bandProtocols.includes(p)) priors[p] = 0.5
		}
		if (!all) for (const p of probeProtocols) if (!protocols.includes(p)) priors[p] = 0
		return { priors, protocols }
	}

	private classify(track: TrackSnapshot, sourceId: string): Classification {
		return classifySpectral(track, this.classifierContext(sourceId, track.centreHz))
	}

	private protocolsFor(live: LiveObservation): ScannerProtocol[] {
		const specs = live.jobIds.map(id => this.jobs.get(id)?.spec).filter((s): s is NormalisedJobSpec => s !== undefined)
		if (specs.length === 0 || specs.some(s => s.protocols.length === 0)) return []
		return [...new Set(specs.flatMap(s => s.protocols))]
	}

	private needsConfirm(live: LiveObservation, track: TrackSnapshot): boolean {
		if (track.flags.truncated || track.flags.edge || track.flags.iqImage || track.flags.spur) return false
		const d = live.discoveryId ? this.store.get(live.discoveryId) : undefined
		if (d?.operator?.lockout) return false
		if (probeModesFor(live.classification.class, this.protocolsFor(live)).length === 0) return false
		if (!d || d.confidence !== "decoded") return true
		const last = this.lastConfirm.get(d.id) ?? 0
		return this.now() - last >= RECONFIRM_AFTER_MS || d.class !== live.classification.class
	}

	private onBlockSummary(sourceId: string, summary: BlockSummary): void {
		const entry = this.engines.get(sourceId)
		if (!entry) return
		entry.lastSummary = summary
		for (const live of this.live.values()) {
			const t = live.lastTrack
			if (live.sourceId !== sourceId || !t) continue
			const best = this.bestPsd.get(live.observationId)
			if (best && best.snrDb >= t.snrDb) continue
			const lo = Math.max(0, Math.floor((t.centreHz - 2 * t.obwHz - summary.startHz) / summary.binHz))
			const hi = Math.min(summary.bins.length, Math.ceil((t.centreHz + 2 * t.obwHz - summary.startHz) / summary.binHz) + 1)
			if (hi - lo < 2) continue
			this.bestPsd.set(live.observationId, {
				startHz: summary.startHz + lo * summary.binHz,
				binHz: summary.binHz,
				bins: summary.bins.slice(lo, hi),
				snrDb: t.snrDb,
			})
		}
	}

	private async writePsdEvidence(live: LiveObservation): Promise<void> {
		const best = this.bestPsd.get(live.observationId)
		this.bestPsd.delete(live.observationId)
		if (!best || !live.discoveryId) return
		const wants = live.jobIds.some(id => this.jobs.get(id)?.spec.evidence.psd)
		if (!wants) return
		const written = await this.evidence.writePsd(live.discoveryId, best).catch(() => false)
		if (written) this.store.setEvidenceFlags(live.discoveryId, { psd: true })
	}

	private markRecording(observationId: string, state: "linked" | "cut" | "encrypted-dropped" | "none", recordingIds: string[] = []): void {
		this.store.attachRecordings(observationId, recordingIds, state)
	}

	private emitActivity(live: LiveObservation, track: TrackSnapshot, active: boolean): void {
		const top = live.classification.hypotheses[0]
		const data: ScannerActivityEventData = {
			sourceId: live.sourceId,
			observationId: live.observationId,
			...(live.discoveryId ? { discoveryId: live.discoveryId } : {}),
			jobIds: live.jobIds,
			frequencyHz: track.centreHz,
			active,
			peakDbfs: track.peakDbfs,
			...(top ? { hypothesis: top } : {}),
		}
		this.emit("activity", data)
	}

	// === evidence ===

	private readonly onProbeEvidence = (probeId: string, req: ProbeRequest, ev: DecodeEvidence): void => {
		const outcome = this.probeOutcomes.get(probeId)
		if (outcome) {
			outcome.output = true
			if (!ev.crcClean) outcome.crcFailures += 1
			if (ev.identity || ev.encrypted !== undefined) outcome.confirmed = true
		}
		const live = this.findObservation(req.observationId)
		if (!live || ev.epoch !== live.epoch) return
		live.probeIds.add(probeId)
		this.applyEvidence(live, ev)
		for (const jobId of live.jobIds) this.drivers.get(jobId)?.onEvidence(probeId, ev)
	}

	private readonly onAmbientEvidence = (e: AmbientEvidenceEvent): void => {
		const now = this.now()
		const candidates = [...this.live.values(), ...this.recent].filter(o => {
			const t = o.lastTrack
			if (o.sourceId !== e.sourceId || !t) return false
			if (Math.abs(t.centreHz - e.hz) > Math.max(1500, t.obwHz / 2)) return false
			return e.ev.at >= o.startedAt - 2000 && e.ev.at <= (o.endedAt ?? now) + 2000
		})
		for (const live of candidates) this.applyEvidence(live, e.ev)
	}

	private applyEvidence(live: LiveObservation, ev: DecodeEvidence): void {
		if (ev.metadata.talkgroups?.[0]) live.talkgroup = ev.metadata.talkgroups[0]
		if (ev.metadata.sources?.[0]) live.source = ev.metadata.sources[0]
		if (ev.encrypted) live.encrypted = true
		if (!live.discoveryId && live.lastTrack) this.ingest(live, live.lastTrack)
		const discoveryId = live.discoveryId
		if (!discoveryId) return
		// § 7.1: the observation keeps its own accepted evidence (Observation.decode; A1/A3 metrics).
		if (this.store.appendObservationEvidence(live.observationId, ev)) this.dirty = true
		// § 6.2: leak/intermod caps are decided before the decode is applied, so a capped decode never reaches `decoded`.
		const cap = ev.identity ? this.capFor(live, ev.identity) : undefined
		const wasDecoded = this.store.get(discoveryId)?.confidence === "decoded"
		this.store.applyEvidence(discoveryId, ev, cap ? { cap } : {})
		// The decode may have merged the discovery (identity key): follow the survivor.
		const survivor = this.store.discoveryIdOf(live.observationId) ?? discoveryId
		live.discoveryId = survivor
		this.dirty = true
		if (!ev.identity || this.store.get(survivor)?.confidence !== "decoded") return
		live.decoded = true
		this.lastConfirm.set(survivor, this.now())
		if (!wasDecoded) this.updateFrequencyError(live.sourceId, { rekey: true })
	}

	private capFor(live: LiveObservation, identity: Identity): Classification["cap"] {
		const track = live.lastTrack
		if (!track) return undefined
		const others = [...this.live.values()]
			.filter(o => o !== live && o.sourceId === live.sourceId && o.epoch === live.epoch && o.lastTrack)
			.map(o => o.lastTrack!)
		const cfg = this.engines.get(live.sourceId)?.engine.config()
		return leakOrIntermod(track, others, id => this.decodedAt(id, live.sourceId), {
			identity,
			...(cfg ? { rbwHz: cfg.sampleRateHz / cfg.fftSize } : {}),
		})
	}

	/**
	 * § 7.4: per-source frequency error (median measured offset over ≥ 5 agreeing decoded
	 * discoveries). Reported in engine status; when it moves by more than REKEY_MIN_CHANGE_HZ the
	 * store re-keys the source's discoveries with the new correction (subtracted before snapping).
	 */
	private updateFrequencyError(sourceId: string, opts: { rekey: boolean }): void {
		const est = estimateFrequencyError(this.allDiscoveries({ sourceId, minConfidence: "decoded" }), sourceId)
		if (!est) {
			this.frequencyErrors.delete(sourceId)
			return
		}
		this.frequencyErrors.set(sourceId, est)
		if (!opts.rekey || Math.abs(est.hz - this.store.correction(sourceId)) <= REKEY_MIN_CHANGE_HZ) return
		const { merged } = this.store.rekey(sourceId, est.hz)
		for (const o of [...this.live.values(), ...this.recent]) {
			if (o.sourceId === sourceId) o.discoveryId = this.store.discoveryIdOf(o.observationId) ?? o.discoveryId
		}
		this.dirty = true
		this.log.info({ sourceId, correctionHz: est.hz, ppm: est.ppm, n: est.n, merged: merged.length }, "Frequency error estimate moved; discoveries re-keyed")
	}

	/** H3: the discovery stays at its classification tier with an explicit `undecodedReason`. */
	private markUndecoded(live: LiveObservation, reason: UndecodedReason): void {
		if (live.decoded) return
		if (live.discoveryId === null) {
			live.undecodedReason = reason
			return
		}
		if (this.store.setUndecodedReason(live.discoveryId, reason)) this.dirty = true
	}

	private decodedAt(identity: Identity, sourceId: string): { centreHz: number; peakDbfs: number }[] {
		return this.store
			.list({ sourceId, minConfidence: "decoded", limit: 500 })
			.items.filter(d => d.identity?.kind === identity.kind && d.identity.value === identity.value)
			.map(d => ({ centreHz: d.frequencyHz, peakDbfs: d.signal.best.peakDbfs }))
	}

	private readonly onProbeRecordings = (r: ProbeRecordings): void => {
		const observations = [...this.live.values(), ...this.recent].filter(
			o => o.trackId === r.req.trackId && o.sourceId === r.req.sourceId && o.discoveryId !== null,
		)
		const candidates = observations.map(o => ({
			observationId: o.observationId,
			discoveryId: o.discoveryId!,
			...(o.talkgroup ? { talkgroup: o.talkgroup } : {}),
			...(o.source ? { source: o.source } : {}),
			startedAt: o.startedAt,
			endedAt: o.endedAt ?? this.now(),
			encrypted: o.encrypted,
		}))
		void this.evidence
			.linkProbeRecordings(r.probeDir, candidates)
			.then(res => {
				for (const l of res.linked) this.markRecording(l.observationId, "linked", [l.recordingId])
				for (const id of res.cut) this.markRecording(id, "cut")
				for (const id of res.droppedEncrypted) this.markRecording(id, "encrypted-dropped")
			})
			.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, probeId: r.probeId }, "Linking probe recordings failed"))
	}

	private readonly onProbeState = (probeId: string, state: string, req: ProbeRequest): void => {
		// Mode stepping re-emits "starting" for the same probe: keep the first start (the hold covers all modes).
		if (state === "starting" && !this.probeOutcomes.has(probeId)) {
			this.probeOutcomes.set(probeId, { startedAt: this.now(), holdMs: req.holdMs, output: false, crcFailures: 0, confirmed: false })
		}
		if (state === "stopped") {
			const outcome = this.probeOutcomes.get(probeId)
			this.probeOutcomes.delete(probeId)
			const reason = outcome ? undecodedForProbe(outcome, this.now()) : null
			const live = reason ? this.findObservation(req.observationId) : undefined
			if (live && reason) this.markUndecoded(live, reason)
		}
		this.emitProgressFor(null)
	}

	private findObservation(observationId: string): LiveObservation | undefined {
		for (const o of this.live.values()) if (o.observationId === observationId) return o
		return this.recent.find(o => o.observationId === observationId)
	}

	private ambientTarget(decoderId: string): { sourceId: string; hz: number } | null {
		const cfg = this.deps.decoderConfigs.find(c => c.id === decoderId)
		if (!cfg) return null
		const sourceId = cfg.sourceId ?? this.deps.routing.getDefaultSourceId()
		if (!sourceId) return null
		const listed = cfg.frequencies?.[0] ?? (typeof cfg.options["frequency"] === "number" ? cfg.options["frequency"] : undefined)
		if (listed !== undefined) return { sourceId, hz: listed }
		const centre = this.deps.sources.getCaps(sourceId)?.centerFreq
		if (centre === undefined) return null
		const offset = typeof cfg.options["offsetHz"] === "number" ? cfg.options["offsetHz"] : 0
		return { sourceId, hz: centre + offset }
	}

	// === arbiter and source events ===

	private readonly onLeaseLost = (lease: Lease, reason: LeaseLostReason): void => {
		const driver = this.drivers.get(lease.jobId)
		if (!driver) return
		const type = reason === "preempted-operator" ? "rest-write" : reason === "preempted-relay" ? "relay-external" : "preempted-job"
		void driver
			.dispatch({ type })
			.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.debug({ err, jobId: lease.jobId }, "Lease loss ignored in this state"))
			.finally(() => this.updateMasks(lease.sourceId))
	}

	private readonly onSourceDown = (sourceId: string): void => {
		for (const d of this.driversOn(sourceId)) {
			if (d.record.state === "running" || d.record.state === "holding") void d.dispatch({ type: "source-down" }).catch(() => undefined)
		}
	}

	private readonly onSourceUp = (sourceId: string): void => {
		for (const d of this.driversOn(sourceId)) {
			if (d.record.state === "paused" && d.record.reason === "source-down") void d.dispatch({ type: "source-up" }).catch(() => undefined)
		}
		if (!this.persistedLeases.has(sourceId)) this.runBootResumes(sourceId)
		this.onSourceAvailable()
	}

	private readonly onSourceAvailable = (): void => {
		if (!this.started || !this.settings().enabled) return
		this.passiveChain = this.passiveChain
			.then(() => this.ensurePassiveJobs())
			.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Refreshing passive jobs failed"))
	}

	private readonly onRecovered = (sourceId: string): void => {
		this.persistedLeases.delete(sourceId)
		this.runBootResumes(sourceId)
	}

	private readonly onSourceRemoved = (sourceId: string): void => {
		for (const d of this.driversOn(sourceId)) {
			if (!isTerminal(d.record.state)) void d.dispatch({ type: "source-removed" }).catch(() => undefined)
		}
	}

	private runBootResumes(sourceId: string): void {
		if (!this.settings().enabled) return
		const ids = this.bootResume.get(sourceId)
		if (!ids) return
		this.bootResume.delete(sourceId)
		for (const id of ids) {
			void this.lifecycle(id, { type: "resume", takeover: false }).catch((err: unknown) =>
				this.log.warn({ err, jobId: id }, "Boot resume refused"),
			)
		}
	}

	private async onPersistLease(sourceId: string, lease: PersistedLease | null): Promise<void> {
		if (lease) this.persistedLeases.set(sourceId, lease)
		else this.persistedLeases.delete(sourceId)
		await this.persistJobs()
	}

	// === job plumbing ===

	private createDriver(record: JobRecord): JobDriver {
		return new JobRunner({
			record,
			arbiter: this.arbiter,
			probes: this.probes,
			decoders: this.deps.decoders,
			settings: () => this.settings(),
			openEngine: sourceId => this.openEngine(sourceId),
			closeEngine: sourceId => this.closeEngine(sourceId),
			engine: sourceId => this.engines.get(sourceId)?.engine,
			impact: () => this.arbiter.impact(record.spec.sourceId, record.spec, record.id),
			undecoded: (live, reason) => this.markUndecoded(live, reason),
			discoveryCounts: jobId => this.discoveryCounts(jobId),
			persist: () => void this.persistJobs(),
			changed: kind => (kind === "state" ? this.emitJob(record) : this.emitProgressFor(record)),
			logger: this.deps.logger,
			now: this.now,
		})
	}

	private async lifecycle(id: string, e: Parameters<JobDriver["dispatch"]>[0]): Promise<ScanJob> {
		const record = this.requireJob(id)
		await this.requireDriver(id).dispatch(e)
		await this.arbitrateLeases(record.spec.sourceId)
		this.updateMasks(record.spec.sourceId)
		return this.toDto(record)
	}

	/** P16: hand a free lease to the best runnable job that lost it to another job. */
	private async arbitrateLeases(sourceId: string): Promise<void> {
		if (this.arbiter.holder(sourceId)) return
		const waiting = [...this.jobs.values()].filter(
			j => j.spec.sourceId === sourceId && j.spec.mode === "sweep" && j.state === "paused" && j.reason === "preempted-job",
		)
		const best = chooseLeaseHolder(waiting.map(j => ({ jobId: j.id, priority: j.spec.priority, createdAt: j.createdAt })))
		if (!best) return
		const record = this.jobs.get(best)!
		await this.requireDriver(best)
			.dispatch({ type: "preemptor-idle", impactGrew: impactGrew(this.arbiter.impact(sourceId, record.spec, record.id), record.consentedImpact) })
			.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, jobId: best }, "Lease hand-back refused"))
	}

	private async restoreJob(pj: PersistedJob): Promise<void> {
		if (pj.id.startsWith("passive-")) return
		let plan: HopPlan
		try {
			plan = planForSpec(pj.spec, this.previewContext())
		} catch (err) {
			this.log.warn({ err, jobId: pj.id }, "Persisted job no longer plans; marking failed")
			plan = { hops: [], usableHalfSpanHz: 0, dcGuardHz: 0, ppmMarginHz: 0 }
		}
		const record: JobRecord = {
			id: pj.id,
			name: pj.rawSpec.name ?? null,
			passive: false,
			rawSpec: pj.rawSpec,
			spec: pj.spec,
			plan,
			issues: [],
			impact: null,
			consentedImpact: null,
			state: pj.state,
			...(pj.reason ? { reason: pj.reason } : {}),
			createdAt: Date.parse(pj.createdAt),
			updatedAt: Date.parse(pj.updatedAt),
			unrestorable: [],
			counts: { observations: 0, transients: 0 },
		}
		const driver = this.createDriver(record)
		this.jobs.set(record.id, record)
		this.drivers.set(record.id, driver)
		if (isTerminal(record.state)) return
		await driver.dispatch({ type: "boot" }).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, jobId: pj.id }, "Boot transition failed"))
		if (record.spec.resume.onBoot && this.settings().enabled) {
			const list = this.bootResume.get(record.spec.sourceId) ?? []
			list.push(record.id)
			this.bootResume.set(record.spec.sourceId, list)
		}
	}

	private async ensurePassiveJobs(): Promise<void> {
		const s = this.settings()
		for (const cfg of this.deps.sourceConfigs) {
			const id = `passive-${cfg.id}`
			const caps = this.deps.sources.getCaps(cfg.id) ?? cfg.caps
			const eligible =
				s.enabled &&
				s.passive.enabled &&
				this.effective.passiveBySource[cfg.id] === true &&
				isScannerIqFormat(caps) &&
				!this.passiveDisabled.has(cfg.id)
			let existing = this.jobs.get(id)
			if (existing && isTerminal(existing.state)) {
				// An ended passive job (e.g. its source was removed) is rebuilt once the source is eligible again.
				this.jobs.delete(id)
				this.drivers.delete(id)
				existing = undefined
			}
			if (!eligible && existing) {
				if (!isTerminal(existing.state)) await this.requireDriver(id).dispatch({ type: "cancel" }).catch(() => undefined)
				this.jobs.delete(id)
				this.drivers.delete(id)
				continue
			}
			if (!eligible || existing) continue
			const rawSpec: ScanJobSpec = {
				name: `Passive ${cfg.id}`,
				sourceId: cfg.id,
				mode: "in-window",
				protocols: [],
				priority: 0,
				resume: { onBoot: true },
			}
			const preview = this.preview(rawSpec)
			if (preview.issues.some(i => i.severity === "error")) {
				this.log.info({ sourceId: cfg.id, issues: preview.issues }, "Passive job not created")
				continue
			}
			const now = this.now()
			const record: JobRecord = {
				id,
				name: rawSpec.name ?? null,
				passive: true,
				rawSpec,
				spec: preview.spec,
				plan: preview.plan,
				issues: preview.issues,
				impact: null,
				consentedImpact: null,
				state: "pending",
				createdAt: now,
				updatedAt: now,
				unrestorable: [],
				counts: { observations: 0, transients: 0 },
			}
			const driver = this.createDriver(record)
			this.jobs.set(id, record)
			this.drivers.set(id, driver)
			try {
				await driver.start()
			} catch (err) {
				// The start rolled back (no lease, hold or engine kept). Drop the job so the next
				// connected / caps-changed / source-up rebuilds it (boot-time caps are often absent).
				this.log.warn({ err, sourceId: cfg.id }, "Passive job failed to start; retrying when the source changes")
				this.jobs.delete(id)
				this.drivers.delete(id)
				await driver.dispose()
			}
		}
	}

	private recomputeSettings(): void {
		this.effective = mergeScannerSettings({ config: this.deps.settings, sources: this.deps.sourceConfigs, overrides: this.overrides })
		// Runtime storage/detection settings reach the stores (§ 12.1 PATCH settings).
		const s = this.effective.settings
		this.store.setLimits({ maxDiscoveries: s.storage.maxDiscoveries, minSurfaceBlocks: s.detection.minSurfaceBlocks })
		this.evidence.setCaps(storageCaps(s))
	}

	private previewContext(): PreviewContext {
		const tuner = this.deps.tuner
		return {
			sources: this.deps.sourceConfigs.map(cfg => {
				const caps = this.deps.sources.getCaps(cfg.id) ?? cfg.caps
				const state = tuner.getState(cfg.id)
				return {
					id: cfg.id,
					kind: caps.kind,
					format: caps.format,
					sampleRateHz: caps.sampleRate,
					centreHz: caps.centerFreq ?? null,
					controllable: this.deps.sources.isRtlTcpSource(cfg.id) && state !== undefined,
					controlMode: state?.controlMode ?? null,
					role: sourceScannerConfig(cfg).role,
					link: linkOf(cfg),
				}
			}),
			channelizerAvailable: false,
			usableFraction: USABLE_FRACTION,
			settings: this.settings(),
			measured: {
				...this.measured,
				markerSupported: Object.fromEntries([...this.engines].map(([id, e]) => [id, e.engine.markerSupported])),
			},
			impactFor: (sourceId, spec) => this.arbiter.impact(sourceId, spec),
			region: this.deps.region,
			tunerRange: () => ({ startHz: 24_000_000, endHz: 1_766_000_000 }),
		}
	}

	private rejectErrors(issues: PlanIssue[]): void {
		const errors = issues.filter(i => i.severity === "error")
		if (errors.length === 0) return
		const busy = errors.find(i => i.code === "source-busy")
		if (busy) throw new ScannerApiError(busy.message, "SCANNER_SOURCE_BUSY", 409, { issues })
		const control = errors.find(i => i.code === "no-tuner-control")
		if (control) throw new ScannerApiError(control.message, "SCANNER_NO_TUNER_CONTROL", 409, { issues })
		throw new ScannerApiError("The job spec has errors", "SCANNER_PLAN_INVALID", 400, { issues })
	}

	private impactNonEmpty(i: Impact): boolean {
		return (
			i.liveAudioClients > 0 ||
			i.digitalVoiceListeners > 0 ||
			i.runningDecoders.length > 0 ||
			i.pinnedDecoders.length > 0 ||
			i.scannerJobs.length > 0 ||
			i.unrestorable.length > 0
		)
	}

	private requireJob(id: string): JobRecord {
		const r = this.jobs.get(id)
		if (!r) throw new ScannerApiError(`Job ${id} not found`, "SCANNER_JOB_NOT_FOUND", 404)
		return r
	}

	private requireDriver(id: string): JobDriver {
		const d = this.drivers.get(id)
		if (!d) throw new ScannerApiError(`Job ${id} not found`, "SCANNER_JOB_NOT_FOUND", 404)
		return d
	}

	private driversOn(sourceId: string): JobDriver[] {
		return [...this.drivers.values()].filter(d => d.record.spec.sourceId === sourceId)
	}

	private allDiscoveries(filter: DiscoveryFilter): Discovery[] {
		const out: Discovery[] = []
		let cursor: string | null = null
		do {
			const page = this.store.list({ ...filter, limit: 500, cursor })
			out.push(...page.items)
			cursor = page.nextCursor
		} while (cursor)
		return out
	}

	private discoveryCounts(jobId: string): Record<ScannerConfidence, number> {
		const counts = { activity: 0, candidate: 0, classified: 0, decoded: 0 }
		for (const d of this.allDiscoveries({ jobId })) counts[d.confidence] += 1
		return counts
	}

	private toDto(record: JobRecord): ScanJob {
		const driver = this.drivers.get(record.id)
		return {
			id: record.id,
			name: record.name,
			state: record.state,
			...(record.reason ? { reason: record.reason } : {}),
			passive: record.passive,
			spec: record.spec,
			plan: record.plan,
			issues: record.issues,
			impact: record.impact,
			unrestorable: record.unrestorable,
			progress: driver
				? driver.progress()
				: { sweepIndex: 0, hopIndex: 0, hopCount: 0, sweepPeriodMs: null, coverage: 0, holdingOn: null, settleMode: null, probes: [], counts: { observations: 0, transients: 0, discoveries: { activity: 0, candidate: 0, classified: 0, decoded: 0 } } },
			createdAt: new Date(record.createdAt).toISOString(),
			updatedAt: new Date(record.updatedAt).toISOString(),
			...(record.startedAt !== undefined ? { startedAt: new Date(record.startedAt).toISOString() } : {}),
			...(record.endedAt !== undefined ? { endedAt: new Date(record.endedAt).toISOString() } : {}),
		}
	}

	private emitJob(record: JobRecord): void {
		this.emit("job", this.toDto(record))
	}

	private emitProgressFor(record: JobRecord | null): void {
		const records = record ? [record] : [...this.jobs.values()].filter(r => !isTerminal(r.state))
		for (const r of records) {
			const p = this.drivers.get(r.id)?.progress()
			if (!p) continue
			const hop = r.plan.hops[p.hopIndex]
			const data: ScannerProgressEventData = {
				jobId: r.id,
				state: r.state,
				sweepIndex: p.sweepIndex,
				hopIndex: p.hopIndex,
				hopCount: p.hopCount,
				centerHz: hop?.centreHz ?? this.engines.get(r.spec.sourceId)?.engine.currentEpoch().centreHz ?? 0,
				...(p.holdingOn ? { holdingOn: p.holdingOn } : {}),
				coverage: p.coverage,
				probes: p.probes.length,
			}
			this.emit("progress", data)
		}
	}

	private engineStatus(cfg: SourceConfig): ScannerEngineStatus {
		const s = this.settings()
		const entry = this.engines.get(cfg.id)
		const engine = entry?.engine
		const pc = engine?.config() ?? null
		const stats = engine?.stats() ?? null
		const link = linkOf(cfg)
		const frequencyError = this.frequencyErrors.get(cfg.id)
		const disabledReason = this.passiveDisabled.get(cfg.id)
		const error = this.engineErrors.get(cfg.id)
		return {
			sourceId: cfg.id,
			state: engine ? (engine.isRunning ? "running" : "stopped") : error ? "error" : "idle",
			rbwHz: pc ? pc.sampleRateHz / pc.fftSize : null,
			fftSize: pc?.fftSize ?? null,
			kByRange: (stats?.kByRange ?? []).map(k => ({ startHz: k.range.startHz, endHz: k.range.endHz, k: k.k, faPerMhzMin: k.faPerMhzMin })),
			floorDbfs: stats?.floorDbfs ?? null,
			floorOccupied: entry?.lastSummary?.floorOccupied ?? false,
			overload: entry?.lastSummary?.overload ?? false,
			settleMode: engine?.currentEpoch().settleMode ?? null,
			settleMs: s.sweep.settleMs[link],
			settleMeasured: this.measured.settleMs[link] !== null,
			markerSupported: engine?.markerSupported ?? null,
			stuckTestMode: stats?.stuckTestMode ?? false,
			staleAfterSettle: stats?.staleAfterSettle ?? 0,
			blankedFrames: stats?.blankedFrames ?? 0,
			broadbandRfi: stats?.broadbandRfi ?? null,
			passive: {
				enabled: this.jobs.has(`passive-${cfg.id}`),
				...(disabledReason ? { disabledReason } : {}),
			},
			frequencyError: frequencyError ? { hz: frequencyError.hz, ppm: frequencyError.ppm, discoveries: frequencyError.n } : null,
			...(error ? { lastError: error } : {}),
		}
	}

	private emitStatus(force: boolean): void {
		const status = this.status()
		const json = JSON.stringify(status)
		if (!force && json === this.lastStatusJson) return
		this.lastStatusJson = json
		this.emit("status", status)
	}

	// === persistence and cadence ===

	private readonly onStoreMutation = (entry: Parameters<ScannerPersistence["append"]>[0]): void => {
		this.dirty = true
		void this.persistence.append(entry).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Journal append failed"))
	}

	private readonly onStoreChange = (id: string, change: ScannerDiscoveryEventData["change"] | "transient"): void => {
		if (change === "transient") return
		const discovery = this.store.get(id)
		if (!discovery) return
		this.emit("discovery", { change, discovery } satisfies ScannerDiscoveryEventData)
	}

	private async persistJobs(): Promise<void> {
		const jobs: PersistedJob[] = [...this.jobs.values()]
			.filter(r => !r.passive)
			.map(r => {
				const lease = this.persistedLeases.get(r.spec.sourceId)
				return {
					id: r.id,
					spec: r.spec,
					rawSpec: r.rawSpec,
					state: r.state,
					...(r.reason ? { reason: r.reason } : {}),
					createdAt: new Date(r.createdAt).toISOString(),
					updatedAt: new Date(r.updatedAt).toISOString(),
					...(lease && lease.jobId === r.id ? { lease } : {}),
				}
			})
		await this.persistence.writeJobs(jobs).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "jobs.json write failed"))
	}

	private tick(): void {
		const now = this.now()
		for (const d of this.drivers.values()) d.tick(now)
		// cpu- and budget-deferred probe requests start once the meter drops, not only when another probe stops
		this.probes.pump()
		this.recent = this.recent.filter(o => (o.endedAt ?? now) > now - RECENT_KEEP_MS)
		if (now - this.lastStatusAt >= STATUS_EVERY_MS) {
			this.lastStatusAt = now
			this.emitStatus(false)
			this.emitProgressFor(null)
			void this.checkPassiveCost(now)
		}
		if (this.dirty && now - this.lastSnapshotAt >= SNAPSHOT_EVERY_MS) {
			this.lastSnapshotAt = now
			this.dirty = false
			void this.persistence.writeSnapshot(this.store.snapshot()).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Snapshot write failed"))
		}
		if (now - this.lastMaintenanceAt >= MAINTENANCE_EVERY_MS) {
			this.lastMaintenanceAt = now
			void this.maintenance()
		}
	}

	private async maintenance(): Promise<void> {
		const s = this.settings()
		for (const [sourceId, entry] of this.engines) {
			const state = await entry.engine.exportState().catch(() => null)
			if (state) await this.persistence.writeEngine(sourceId, state).catch(() => undefined)
		}
		// § 8 storage.discoveryMaxAgeDays (never operator `keep`)
		const all = new Map(this.allDiscoveries({}).map(d => [d.id, d] as const))
		const pruned = this.store.pruneInactive(s.storage.discoveryMaxAgeDays)
		for (const id of pruned) {
			const discovery = all.get(id)
			all.delete(id)
			if (discovery) this.emit("discovery", { change: "deleted", discovery } satisfies ScannerDiscoveryEventData)
			await this.evidence.removeDiscovery(id).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, discoveryId: id }, "Removing pruned evidence failed"))
		}
		if (pruned.length > 0) {
			this.dirty = true
			this.log.info({ pruned: pruned.length, maxAgeDays: s.storage.discoveryMaxAgeDays }, "Pruned inactive discoveries")
		}
		const keep = new Set([...all.values()].filter(d => d.operator?.keep).map(d => d.id))
		await this.evidence.retention(keep).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Retention failed"))
		await this.persistence
			.pruneJournal({ maxBytes: s.storage.maxJournalMb * 1024 * 1024, maxAgeDays: s.storage.maxAgeDays })
			.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err }, "Journal prune failed"))
		this.disk = await this.evidence.diskState().catch(() => this.disk)
	}

	/** § 10.7: passive off for a source whose engine costs > 25 % of a core over its first minute. */
	private async checkPassiveCost(now: number): Promise<void> {
		for (const [sourceId, entry] of this.engines) {
			if (this.passiveDisabled.has(sourceId) || now - entry.openedAt < PASSIVE_COST_WINDOW_MS) continue
			if (!this.jobs.has(`passive-${sourceId}`)) continue
			const utilization = entry.engine.utilization()
			if (utilization === null || utilization <= PASSIVE_COST_LIMIT) continue
			this.passiveDisabled.set(sourceId, `engine-cpu ${(utilization * 100).toFixed(0)} % of a core`)
			this.log.warn({ sourceId, utilization }, "Passive scanning disabled: spectrum engine too costly on this host")
			await this.ensurePassiveJobs()
		}
	}

	private allocatePort(): Promise<number> {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			void import("node:net").then(net => {
				const server = net.createServer()
				server.on("error", reject)
				server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => {
					const address = server.address()
					const port = typeof address === "object" && address ? address.port : 0
					server.close(() => resolve(port))
				})
			}, reject)
		})
	}
}

/** Protocols a prior can be set on (every ScannerProtocol except the generic ones). */
const probeProtocols: readonly ScannerProtocol[] = [
	"analog-fm", "analog-am", "dmr", "p25p1", "p25p2", "nxdn48", "nxdn96", "ysf", "dstar", "dpmr", "pocsag", "flex", "aprs", "ism",
]
```
