```ts
						preRoll: fc.boolean(),
						offsetHz: fc.integer({ min: -900_000, max: 900_000 }),
					}),
					{ minLength: 1, maxLength: 20 },
				),
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 2 }),
				fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 6 }),
				(requests, maxOffset, maxChannel) => {
					const h = harness({ offset: maxOffset, channel: maxChannel })
					for (const r of requests) h.pool.request(req({ cls: r.cls, preRollFromSample: r.preRoll ? 1000 : null, targetHz: CENTRE + r.offsetHz }))
					const status = h.pool.status()
					expect(status.filter(s => s.transport === "offset").length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(maxOffset)
					expect(status.filter(s => s.transport === "channel").length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(maxChannel)
					expect(status.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.cores, 0)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(h.settings.cpuBudgetCores + 1e-9)
					for (const s of status) {
						if (s.transport === "channel") expect(probeChannelAdmitted(s.decoderType, s.targetHz, capture, 0.8)).toBe(true)
						if (s.decoderType === "rtl433") expect(s.transport).toBe("channel")
					}
				},
			),
			{ numRuns: 100 },
		)
	})
})

describe("channel invalidation (spec § 14.3, H5)", () => {
	it("cuts only the source's channel probes whose channel was invalidated", async () => {
		const h = harness()
		const offsetProbe = started(h.pool.request(req({ preRollFromSample: 1000 })))
		const a = started(h.pool.request(req({ preRollFromSample: null, targetHz: CENTRE + 100_000 })))
		const b = started(h.pool.request(req({ preRollFromSample: null, targetHz: CENTRE + 200_000 })))
		await vi.waitFor(() => expect(h.decoders.created.size).toBe(3))
		h.pool.onChannelsInvalidated("other-source", [`${a}-g1`])
		expect(h.cut).toEqual([])
		h.pool.onChannelsInvalidated("rtl", [`${a}-g1`, "unrelated-g1"])
		expect(h.cut).toEqual([a])
		// `removed` is pushed inside teardown, before stopProbe deletes the record and emits "stopped": wait for "stopped"
		await vi.waitFor(() => expect(h.states).toContainEqual({ probeId: a, state: "stopped" }))
		expect(h.decoders.removed).toContain(a)
		expect(h.decoders.removed).not.toContain(b)
		expect(h.decoders.removed).not.toContain(offsetProbe)
		expect(h.states).toContainEqual({ probeId: a, state: "stopped" })
		expect(h.pool.status().map(s => s.probeId).sort()).toEqual([offsetProbe, b].sort())
	})
	it("a re-request on the new epoch starts a fresh channel probe", async () => {
		const h = harness()
		const first = started(h.pool.request(req({ preRollFromSample: null, trackId: "tx", observationId: "ox" })))
		await vi.waitFor(() => expect(h.decoders.created.size).toBe(1))
		h.pool.onChannelsInvalidated("rtl", [`${first}-g1`])
		await vi.waitFor(() => expect(h.states).toContainEqual({ probeId: first, state: "stopped" }))
		h.engine.setEpoch(2, CENTRE)
		const second = started(h.pool.request(req({ preRollFromSample: null, epoch: 2, trackId: "tx", observationId: "ox" })))
		expect(second).not.toBe(first)
		expect(h.pool.status().find(s => s.probeId === second)).toMatchObject({ transport: "channel", epoch: 2 })
	})
})

	const channelTransports = (): TransportStrategy[] => [

		await h.advance(100)

		for (const d of running.filter(x => x !== dsd)) expect(d.config).toMatchObject({ useChannelizer: true, options: { channelHz: TARGET_HZ } })
		const transports = Object.fromEntries(h.last()!.trials.filter(t => t.outcome === "running").map(t => [t.protocol, t.transport]))
		expect(transports).toMatchObject({ dmr: "offset", aprs: "channel", pocsag: "channel" })
	})

	it("tries rtl_433 on a short OOK burst over a channel probe", async () => {

		await h.runner.start()
		h.tracks.push(viewOf(trackOf({ obwHz: 20_000, spectralShape: "peaked", blocks: 2, flags: { ...FLAGS, burst: true } })))
		await h.advance(100) // artefact check
		await h.advance(100) // resolved, 2 blocks: not settled yet
		h.tracks.length = 0 // the burst closed: planned on its last snapshot
		await h.advance(100)

		expect([...h.decoders.created.values()].map(d => d.config.type)).toContain("rtl433")
		expect(h.last()!.trials.find(t => t.protocol === "ism")).toMatchObject({ decoder: "rtl433", transport: "channel" })
	})
})
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/probes/channel-ids.ts
/** The channelizer names a decoder's channel `${sanitize(decoderId)}-g${generation}` (channelizer Task 21); probe ids are already sanitize-stable. */
export function isProbeChannel(probeId: string, channelId: string): boolean {
	const prefix = `${probeId}-g`
	return channelId.startsWith(prefix) && /^\d+$/.test(channelId.slice(prefix.length))
}
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/probes/channel-transport.ts
/**
 * Post-channelizer probe transports (spec § 6.5, § 14.2).
 *
 * - `channel`: options.channelHz = targetHz and useChannelizer: true. DecoderManager asks the core
 *   channelizer for the decoder's own channel request (channelizer Task 24). No pre-roll: a channel
 *   cannot be back-filled, so a channel probe started mid-call gets late-entry timing.
 * - `offsetPreRollTransport`: the S1 offset transport, restricted to requests that carry pre-roll,
 *   so the single full-rate slot is kept for key-up confirms.
 *
 * PROBE_CHANNEL_REQUESTS mirrors what the merged decoders request (channelizer Tasks 30/31, delta E9/E11);
 * it is used only to check admission before a probe is created, with the channelizer's own rule.
 */
import { admitChannel } from "../../channelizer/admission.js"
import type { DecoderChannelRequest } from "../../channelizer/types.js"
import type { DecoderConfig } from "../../../decoders/types.js"
import { probeCores } from "../plan/cost.js"
import { offsetTransport, type ProbeDecoderType, type TransportStrategy } from "./probe-pool.js"

export const PROBE_CHANNEL_REQUESTS: Readonly<Record<ProbeDecoderType, Omit<DecoderChannelRequest, "centerHz">>> = {
	"dsd-fme": { bandwidthHz: 12_500, transitionHz: 6_250, outputRateHz: 48_000, format: "cf32" },
	"multimon-ng": { bandwidthHz: 47_424, transitionHz: 288, outputRateHz: 48_000, format: "cf32" },
	direwolf: { bandwidthHz: 47_424, transitionHz: 288, outputRateHz: 48_000, format: "cf32" },
	rtl433: { bandwidthHz: 237_500, transitionHz: 6_250, outputRateHz: 250_000, format: "cu8" },
}

export function probeChannelAdmitted(
	type: ProbeDecoderType,
	targetHz: number,
	capture: { sampleRateHz: number; centerHz: number },
	usableFraction: number,
): boolean {
	return admitChannel({ centerHz: targetHz, ...PROBE_CHANNEL_REQUESTS[type] }, capture, usableFraction).admitted
}

export function createChannelTransport(opts: { available: () => boolean; usableFraction: number }): TransportStrategy {
	return {
		kind: "channel",
		preRoll: false,
		maxProbes: s => s.maxProbes.channel,
		cores: decoderType => probeCores("channel", decoderType),
		supports: (mode, ctx) =>
			opts.available() &&
			ctx.format === "U8_IQ" &&
			probeChannelAdmitted(mode.decoderType, ctx.req.targetHz, { sampleRateHz: ctx.sampleRateHz, centerHz: ctx.epoch.centreHz }, opts.usableFraction),
		configure: (base, ctx): DecoderConfig => {
			const options: Record<string, unknown> = { ...base.options, channelHz: ctx.req.targetHz }
			delete options["offsetHz"]
			return { ...base, useChannelizer: true, options }
		},
	}
}

export const offsetPreRollTransport: TransportStrategy = {
	...offsetTransport,
	supports: (mode, ctx) => ctx.req.preRollFromSample !== null && offsetTransport.supports(mode, ctx),
}
```

```ts
	/**
	 * Channel invalidation (centre change, wavekit-chan exit; spec § 14.3): the source's channel
	 * probes on those channels are cut. Evidence from their epoch is no longer accepted (P17);
	 * the scheduler re-requests on the new epoch if the target is still wanted.
	 */
	onChannelsInvalidated(sourceId: string, channelIds: readonly string[]): void {
		const at = this.now()
		for (const rec of [...this.records.values()]) {
			if (rec.transport.kind !== "channel" || rec.req.sourceId !== sourceId) continue
			if (!channelIds.some(id => isProbeChannel(rec.probeId, id))) continue
			rec.epochEndedAt ??= at
			this.emit("probe-cut", rec.probeId, rec.req)
			void this.stopProbe(rec, "cut").catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, probeId: rec.probeId }, "Stopping a cut probe failed"))
		}
	}
```

```ts
// tests/mocks/scanner/channel-signals.ts
/**
 * Channel-rate (48 kHz) helpers for the channel tier: FM modulation of an arbitrary
 * instantaneous-frequency track, AFSK 1200/2200, DCS 134.4 bps NRZ, band-limited voice-like
 * audio, interleaving and in-channel noise. Seeded only.
 */
import { addInto, gaussianNoise, meanPower, sigmaForSnr, type Iq } from "./signals.js"

export function toCf32(iq: Iq): Float32Array {
	const out = new Float32Array(iq.re.length * 2)
	for (let i = 0; i < iq.re.length; i++) {
		out[2 * i] = iq.re[i]!
		out[2 * i + 1] = iq.im[i]!
	}
	return out
}

/** FM: amp · exp(j · 2π ∫ f(t) dt), f in Hz. */
export function fmFromAudio(freqHz: Float32Array, fs: number, amp: number): Iq {
	const re = new Float32Array(freqHz.length)
	const im = new Float32Array(freqHz.length)
	let phase = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < freqHz.length; i++) {
		phase += (2 * Math.PI * freqHz[i]!) / fs
		if (phase > Math.PI) phase -= 2 * Math.PI
		else if (phase < -Math.PI) phase += 2 * Math.PI
		re[i] = amp * Math.cos(phase)
		im[i] = amp * Math.sin(phase)
	}
	return { re, im }
}

/** Bell 202 AFSK (mark 1200 Hz, space 2200 Hz, 1200 Bd, continuous phase) as a deviation track. */
export function afskAudio(rng: () => number, n: number, fs: number, deviationHz = 3000): Float32Array {
	const out = new Float32Array(n)
	const samplesPerBit = fs / 1200
	let phase = 0
	let bit = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		if (i % Math.round(samplesPerBit) === 0) bit = rng() < 0.5 ? 0 : 1
		phase += (2 * Math.PI * (bit === 1 ? 1200 : 2200)) / fs
		out[i] = deviationHz * Math.sin(phase)
	}
	return out
}

/** DCS-like sub-audible NRZ at 134.4 bps, ± deviationHz. */
export function dcsAudio(rng: () => number, n: number, fs: number, deviationHz = 500): Float32Array {
	const out = new Float32Array(n)
	const samplesPerBit = fs / 134.4
	let nextEdge = 0
	let level = 1
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		if (i >= nextEdge) {
			level = rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1
			nextEdge += samplesPerBit
		}
		out[i] = level * deviationHz
	}
	return out
}

/** Voice-like audio: 40 random sinusoids in 300–3000 Hz, scaled to rmsHz. */
export function voiceAudio(rng: () => number, n: number, fs: number, rmsHz = 1500): Float32Array {
	const out = new Float32Array(n)
	const parts = 40
	for (let p = 0; p < parts; p++) {
		const f = 300 + rng() * 2700
		const ph = rng() * 2 * Math.PI
		const w = (2 * Math.PI * f) / fs
		for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = out[i]! + Math.sin(w * i + ph)
	}
	let sq = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) sq += out[i]! ** 2
	const scale = rmsHz / Math.sqrt(sq / n)
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = out[i]! * scale
	return out
}

export function sumAudio(...tracks: Float32Array[]): Float32Array {
	const n = Math.min(...tracks.map(t => t.length))
	const out = new Float32Array(n)
	for (const t of tracks) for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = out[i]! + t[i]!
	return out
}

/** Adds complex AWGN for snrDb in 12.5 kHz relative to signalPower (default: the burst-inclusive mean power). */
export function noisy(iq: Iq, rng: () => number, snrDb: number, fs: number, signalPower = meanPower(iq)): Iq {
	const sigma = sigmaForSnr(signalPower, snrDb, fs)
	return addInto({ re: Float32Array.from(iq.re), im: Float32Array.from(iq.im) }, gaussianNoise(rng, iq.re.length, sigma))
}
```

```ts
// tests/mocks/scanner/wav-iq.ts
/**
 * Reads the public 2-channel IQ WAV fixtures (u8 or s16) and channelises one emitter to a
 * cf32 48 kHz tap (mix, windowed-sinc low-pass at the input rate, linear resample). Test-only:
 * mirrors what a channelizer tap delivers closely enough for feature tests.
 */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"
import { Fft, hannWindow } from "../../../src/core/spectrum/fft.js"

export interface WavIq { fs: number; iq: Float32Array }

export function readWavIq(path: string, maxSeconds: number): WavIq {
	const buf = readFileSync(path)
	if (buf.toString("ascii", 0, 4) !== "RIFF" || buf.toString("ascii", 8, 12) !== "WAVE") throw new Error(`${path}: not a WAVE file`)
	let offset = 12
	let fs = 0
	let bits = 0
	let channels = 0
	let format = 0
	while (offset + 8 <= buf.length) {
		const id = buf.toString("ascii", offset, offset + 4)
		const size = buf.readUInt32LE(offset + 4)
		const body = offset + 8
		if (id === "fmt ") {
			format = buf.readUInt16LE(body)
			channels = buf.readUInt16LE(body + 2)
			fs = buf.readUInt32LE(body + 4)
			bits = buf.readUInt16LE(body + 14)
		} else if (id === "data") {
			if (format !== 1 || channels !== 2 || (bits !== 8 && bits !== 16)) throw new Error(`${path}: need 2-channel PCM u8/s16 (format ${format}, ${channels} ch, ${bits} bit)`)
			const bytesPerFrame = (bits / 8) * 2
			const frames = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.min(size, buf.length - body) / bytesPerFrame), Math.floor(fs * maxSeconds))
			const iq = new Float32Array(frames * 2)
			for (let i = 0; i < frames * 2; i++) {
				iq[i] = bits === 8 ? (buf[body + i]! - 127.5) / 127.5 : buf.readInt16LE(body + 2 * i) / 32768
			}
			return { fs, iq }
		}
		offset = body + size + (size % 2)
	}
	throw new Error(`${path}: no data chunk`)
}

function lowpass(taps: number, cutoffHz: number, fs: number): Float32Array {
	const h = new Float32Array(taps)
	const mid = (taps - 1) / 2
	let sum = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < taps; i++) {
		const t = i - mid
		const x = ((2 * cutoffHz) / fs) * t
		const sinc = t === 0 ? 1 : Math.sin(Math.PI * x) / (Math.PI * x)
		const w = 0.42 - 0.5 * Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * i) / (taps - 1)) + 0.08 * Math.cos((4 * Math.PI * i) / (taps - 1))
		h[i] = sinc * w
		sum += h[i]!
	}
	for (let i = 0; i < taps; i++) h[i] = h[i]! / sum
	return h
}

/** Strongest emitter offset (Hz): averaged 8192-pt Hann periodogram, 9-bin smoothing, |f| ≥ 1 kHz. */
export function strongestOffsetHz(src: WavIq): number {
	const size = 8192
	const n = src.iq.length >> 1
	const fft = new Fft(size)
	const w = hannWindow(size)
	const re = new Float32Array(size)
	const im = new Float32Array(size)
	const acc = new Float64Array(size)
	for (let start = 0; start + size <= n; start += size) {
		for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
			re[i] = src.iq[2 * (start + i)]! * w[i]!
			im[i] = src.iq[2 * (start + i) + 1]! * w[i]!
		}
		fft.transform(re, im)
		for (let k = 0; k < size; k++) acc[k] = acc[k]! + re[k]! ** 2 + im[k]! ** 2
	}
	let best = 0
	let bestHz = 0
	for (let k = 0; k < size; k++) {
		const hz = ((k < size / 2 ? k : k - size) * src.fs) / size
		if (Math.abs(hz) < 1000) continue
		let smooth = 0
		for (let j = -4; j <= 4; j++) smooth += acc[(k + j + size) % size]!
		if (smooth > best) {
			best = smooth
			bestHz = hz
		}
	}
	return bestHz
}

/** Mix by −offsetHz, low-pass to ±bandwidthHz/2, linear resample to outFs (cf32 interleaved). */
export function channelise(src: WavIq, offsetHz: number, outFs = 48_000, bandwidthHz = 16_000): Float32Array {
	const n = src.iq.length >> 1
	const mixed = new Float32Array(n * 2)
	const w = (-2 * Math.PI * offsetHz) / src.fs
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		const c = Math.cos(w * i)
		const s = Math.sin(w * i)
		const a = src.iq[2 * i]!
		const b = src.iq[2 * i + 1]!
		mixed[2 * i] = a * c - b * s
		mixed[2 * i + 1] = a * s + b * c
	}
	const h = lowpass(127, Math.min(bandwidthHz / 2, src.fs / 2 - 1000), src.fs)
	const half = (h.length - 1) >> 1
	const filtered = new Float32Array(n * 2)
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		let re = 0
		let im = 0
		for (let k = 0; k < h.length; k++) {
			const j = i + half - k
			if (j < 0 || j >= n) continue
			re += h[k]! * mixed[2 * j]!
			im += h[k]! * mixed[2 * j + 1]!
		}
		filtered[2 * i] = re
		filtered[2 * i + 1] = im
	}
	const outN = Math.floor(((n - 1) * outFs) / src.fs)
	const out = new Float32Array(outN * 2)
	for (let m = 0; m < outN; m++) {
		const t = (m * src.fs) / outFs
		const i0 = Math.floor(t)
		const frac = t - i0
		out[2 * m] = filtered[2 * i0]! * (1 - frac) + filtered[2 * (i0 + 1)]! * frac
		out[2 * m + 1] = filtered[2 * i0 + 1]! * (1 - frac) + filtered[2 * (i0 + 1) + 1]! * frac
	}
	return out
}
```

`strongestOffsetHz` uses the S1 `Fft` (natural bin order) over the whole excerpt; it only has to land inside the emitter, because the channelise filter is 16 kHz wide and the features remove the residual tuning offset.

```ts
// src/core/scanner/classify/channel-features.ts
/**
 * Channel tier (spec § 6.3): features of a cf32 48 kHz channel tap at a track centre and the
 * channel-tier classification merged over the spectral one. Pure: no I/O, no timers.
 *
 * - FM discriminator histogram over on-samples (1 ms power above the geometric mean of p5/p95):
 *   peak count, span, std. 4 peaks and std < 2 kHz → 4FSK (span/3 ≥ 900 Hz: 12.5 kHz family,
 *   else 6.25 kHz); 2 peaks at about ±4.5 kHz → pager FSK; unimodal, wide, voice-band audio → FM.
 * - CTCSS: Goertzel bank over the 67–254.1 Hz tones after a 1 kHz low band (CIC2 + 265 Hz FIR);
 *   a tone counts when it captures ≥ 50 % of the low-band energy. DCS: a 134.4 Hz line in
 *   |Δ low band| ≥ 14 dB over its neighbourhood, only when no CTCSS tone is present.
 * - AFSK 1200/2200: ≥ 75 % of 300–3000 Hz audio power in 1000–2400 Hz, ≥ 12 % around each tone,
 *   ≤ 10 % in 300–800 Hz.
 * - Symbol rate: spectral line in |Δ discriminator| (6 kHz low-passed) ≥ 10 dB; the lowest line
 *   among 1200/2400/4800/9600 Hz wins, and 1200 is reported as null (not a listed rate).
 *
 * Thresholds for analog FM, APRS, P25, NXDN and D-STAR are unvalidated until Task 49 (spec § 15);
 * `scanner.channelTier.enabled` stays false until then.
 */
import { Fft, hannWindow } from "../../spectrum/fft.js"
import type { Classification, Hypothesis, ScannerClass, ScannerProtocol } from "../types.js"
import { applyPriors } from "./classifier.js"

export const CHANNEL_TIER_RATE_HZ = 48_000

export const CTCSS_TONES_HZ: readonly number[] = [
	67.0, 69.3, 71.9, 74.4, 77.0, 79.7, 82.5, 85.4, 88.5, 91.5, 94.8, 97.4, 100.0, 103.5, 107.2, 110.9, 114.8,
	118.8, 123.0, 127.3, 131.8, 136.5, 141.3, 146.2, 150.0, 151.4, 156.7, 159.8, 162.2, 165.5, 167.9, 171.3,
	173.8, 177.3, 179.9, 183.5, 186.2, 189.9, 192.8, 196.6, 199.5, 203.5, 206.5, 210.7, 218.1, 225.7, 229.1,
	233.6, 241.8, 250.3, 254.1,
]

export type SymbolRate = 2400 | 4800 | 9600

export interface ChannelFeatures {
	sampleRateHz: number
	durationMs: number
	onFraction: number
	discPeaksHz: number[]
	discSpanHz: number
	discStdHz: number
	ctcssHz: number | null
	dcs: boolean
	afsk: boolean
	symbolRateBd: SymbolRate | null
	voiceBandFraction: number
}

export interface ChannelTierContext {
	priors: Partial<Record<ScannerProtocol, number>>
	protocols: ScannerProtocol[]
	/** Track SNR in its bandwidth (TrackSnapshot.snrDb). */
	snrDb: number
}

/** Below these SNRs the FSK levels smear into one peak (numpy calibration, Task 41 header). */
export const CHANNEL_TIER_MIN_SNR_DB = { multiLevel: 25, twoLevel: 15 } as const

export const CHANNEL_TIER_HYPOTHESES: Readonly<Partial<Record<ScannerClass, readonly Hypothesis[]>>> = {
	"tdma-ms": [{ protocol: "dmr", score: 0.9 }],
	"fsk4-12k5": [
		{ protocol: "dmr", score: 0.6 },
		{ protocol: "ysf", score: 0.55 },
		{ protocol: "p25p1", score: 0.5 },
		{ protocol: "nxdn96", score: 0.45 },
		{ protocol: "digital-unknown", score: 0.3 },
	],
	// Unvalidated (no capture, spec § 15): top score < 0.5 keeps them `candidate`; dsd-fme decides.
	"fsk4-6k25": [
		{ protocol: "nxdn48", score: 0.45 },
		{ protocol: "dpmr", score: 0.4 },
		{ protocol: "digital-unknown", score: 0.3 },
	],
	"fsk2-wide": [
		{ protocol: "pocsag", score: 0.6 },
		{ protocol: "flex", score: 0.55 },
	],
	"gmsk-narrow": [
		{ protocol: "dstar", score: 0.45 },
		{ protocol: "digital-unknown", score: 0.3 },
	],
	"afsk-fm": [{ protocol: "aprs", score: 0.9 }],
	"analog-fm": [{ protocol: "analog-fm", score: 0.9 }],
	carrier: [{ protocol: "carrier", score: 0.9 }],
}

const IQ_FILTER_TAPS = 63
const DEFAULT_PASSBAND_HZ = 16_000
const CARRIER_STD_HZ = 250
const MULTI_LEVEL_STD_HZ = 2000
const FSK4_12K5_SPACING_HZ = 900
const HIST_BIN_HZ = 100
const HIST_HALF_HZ = 6000
const HIST_SMOOTH_BINS = 5
const STD_CLIP_HZ = 8000
const PEAK_MIN_FRACTION = 0.25
const PEAK_VALLEY_RATIO = 0.8
const SPECTRUM_SIZE = 4096
const LINE_SPECTRUM_SIZE = 8192
const LINE_MIN_DB = 10
const LINE_LOWPASS_HZ = 6000
const LINE_RATES = [1200, 2400, 4800, 9600] as const
const LOW_RATE_HZ = 1000
const LOW_CUTOFF_HZ = 265
const LOW_TAPS = 101
const CTCSS_MIN_CAPTURE = 0.5
const DCS_BAUD = 134.4
const DCS_MIN_DB = 14
const AFSK_MID_MIN = 0.75
const AFSK_TONE_MIN = 0.12
const AFSK_LOW_MAX = 0.1
const VOICE_BAND_MIN = 0.5
const ANALOG_STD_MIN_HZ = 400

function lowpassTaps(taps: number, cutoffHz: number, fs: number): Float32Array {
	const h = new Float32Array(taps)
	const mid = (taps - 1) / 2
	let sum = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < taps; i++) {
		const t = i - mid
		const x = ((2 * cutoffHz) / fs) * t
		const sinc = t === 0 ? 1 : Math.sin(Math.PI * x) / (Math.PI * x)
		const w = 0.42 - 0.5 * Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * i) / (taps - 1)) + 0.08 * Math.cos((4 * Math.PI * i) / (taps - 1))
		h[i] = sinc * w
		sum += h[i]!
	}
	for (let i = 0; i < taps; i++) h[i] = h[i]! / sum
	return h
}

/** Complex FIR, output aligned with the input ("same"). */
function filterComplex(iq: Float32Array, h: Float32Array): Float32Array {
	const n = iq.length >> 1
	const half = (h.length - 1) >> 1
	const out = new Float32Array(n * 2)
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		let re = 0
		let im = 0
		const k0 = Math.max(0, i + half - (n - 1))
		const k1 = Math.min(h.length - 1, i + half)
		for (let k = k0; k <= k1; k++) {
			const j = i + half - k
			re += h[k]! * iq[2 * j]!
			im += h[k]! * iq[2 * j + 1]!
		}
		out[2 * i] = re
		out[2 * i + 1] = im
	}
	return out
}

function filterReal(x: Float32Array, h: Float32Array): Float32Array {
	const n = x.length
	const half = (h.length - 1) >> 1
	const out = new Float32Array(n)
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		let acc = 0
		const k0 = Math.max(0, i + half - (n - 1))
		const k1 = Math.min(h.length - 1, i + half)
		for (let k = k0; k <= k1; k++) acc += h[k]! * x[i + half - k]!
		out[i] = acc
	}
	return out
}

/** Instantaneous frequency (Hz) of interleaved cf32: arg(z[n]·conj(z[n−1]))·fs/2π, length n − 1. */
export function fmDiscriminator(iq: Float32Array, sampleRateHz: number): Float32Array {
	const n = iq.length >> 1
	const out = new Float32Array(Math.max(0, n - 1))
	const k = sampleRateHz / (2 * Math.PI)
	for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
		const i0 = iq[2 * (i - 1)]!
		const q0 = iq[2 * (i - 1) + 1]!
		const i1 = iq[2 * i]!
		const q1 = iq[2 * i + 1]!
		out[i - 1] = Math.atan2(q1 * i0 - i1 * q0, i1 * i0 + q1 * q0) * k
	}
	return out
}

/** 1 ms power blocks; on = above √(p5·p95), or everything when p95 < 4·p5 (no burst structure). */
function onMask(iq: Float32Array, sampleRateHz: number): Uint8Array {
	const n = iq.length >> 1
	const mask = new Uint8Array(Math.max(0, n - 1))
	const block = Math.max(1, Math.round(sampleRateHz / 1000))
	const blocks = Math.floor(n / block)
	if (blocks < 2) return mask.fill(1)
	const power = new Float64Array(blocks)
	for (let b = 0; b < blocks; b++) {
		let s = 0
		for (let i = b * block; i < (b + 1) * block; i++) s += iq[2 * i]! ** 2 + iq[2 * i + 1]! ** 2
		power[b] = s / block
	}
	const sorted = Float64Array.from(power).sort()
	const p5 = sorted[Math.floor(0.05 * (blocks - 1))]!
	const p95 = sorted[Math.floor(0.95 * (blocks - 1))]!
	const continuous = p95 < 4 * p5
	const threshold = Math.sqrt(p5 * p95)
	for (let i = 0; i < mask.length; i++) {
		const b = Math.min(blocks - 1, Math.floor((i + 1) / block))
		mask[i] = continuous || power[b]! > threshold ? 1 : 0
	}
	return mask
}

function boxcar(h: Float64Array, width: number): Float64Array {
	const out = new Float64Array(h.length)
	const half = width >> 1
	for (let i = 0; i < h.length; i++) {
		let s = 0
		let c = 0
		for (let j = i - half; j <= i + half; j++) {
			if (j < 0 || j >= h.length) continue
			s += h[j]!
			c++
		}
		out[i] = s / c
	}
	return out
}

/** Local maxima ≥ 25 % of the maximum; neighbours without a ≥ 20 % dip between them merge. */
function histogramPeaks(h: Float64Array): number[] {
	let max = 0
	for (const v of h) max = Math.max(max, v)
	if (max === 0) return []
	const peaks: number[] = []
	for (let i = 1; i < h.length - 1; i++) {
		if (h[i]! > h[i - 1]! && h[i]! >= h[i + 1]! && h[i]! >= PEAK_MIN_FRACTION * max) peaks.push(i)
	}
	let merged = true
	while (merged && peaks.length > 1) {
		merged = false
		for (let k = 0; k + 1 < peaks.length; k++) {
			const a = peaks[k]!
			const b = peaks[k + 1]!
			let valley = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
			for (let i = a; i <= b; i++) valley = Math.min(valley, h[i]!)
			if (valley > PEAK_VALLEY_RATIO * Math.min(h[a]!, h[b]!)) {
				peaks.splice(h[a]! >= h[b]! ? k + 1 : k, 1)
				merged = true
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return peaks
}

interface DiscStats { centreHz: number; peaksHz: number[]; spanHz: number; stdHz: number }

/** Centre = mean of the p10–p90 on-samples (balanced for 2FSK, robust to clicks). */
function discriminatorStats(on: Float32Array): DiscStats {
	if (on.length === 0) return { centreHz: 0, peaksHz: [], spanHz: 0, stdHz: 0 }
	const sorted = Float32Array.from(on).sort()
	const lo = sorted[Math.floor(0.1 * (sorted.length - 1))]!
	const hi = sorted[Math.floor(0.9 * (sorted.length - 1))]!
	let sum = 0
	let count = 0
	for (const v of sorted) {
		if (v < lo || v > hi) continue
		sum += v
		count++
	}
	const centreHz = count > 0 ? sum / count : 0
	const bins = (2 * HIST_HALF_HZ) / HIST_BIN_HZ
	const hist = new Float64Array(bins)
	let sq = 0
	let kept = 0
	for (const v of on) {
		const d = v - centreHz
		if (Math.abs(d) <= STD_CLIP_HZ) {
			sq += d * d
			kept++
		}
		const b = Math.floor((d + HIST_HALF_HZ) / HIST_BIN_HZ)
		if (b >= 0 && b < bins) hist[b] = hist[b]! + 1
	}
	const peaksHz = histogramPeaks(boxcar(hist, HIST_SMOOTH_BINS)).map(b => -HIST_HALF_HZ + (b + 0.5) * HIST_BIN_HZ)
	const spanHz = peaksHz.length > 1 ? peaksHz[peaksHz.length - 1]! - peaksHz[0]! : 0
	return { centreHz, peaksHz, spanHz, stdHz: kept > 0 ? Math.sqrt(sq / kept) : 0 }
}

/** Mean Hann periodogram (50 % overlap), bins 0 … size/2 − 1; null when x is shorter than size. */
function averagedSpectrum(x: Float32Array, size: number): Float64Array | null {
	if (x.length < size) return null
	const fft = new Fft(size)
	const w = hannWindow(size)
	const re = new Float32Array(size)
	const im = new Float32Array(size)
	const acc = new Float64Array(size / 2)
	let segments = 0
	for (let start = 0; start + size <= x.length; start += size / 2) {
		let mean = 0
		for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) mean += x[start + i]!
		mean /= size
		for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
			re[i] = (x[start + i]! - mean) * w[i]!
			im[i] = 0
		}
		fft.transform(re, im)
		for (let k = 0; k < size / 2; k++) acc[k] = acc[k]! + re[k]! ** 2 + im[k]! ** 2
		segments++
	}
	for (let k = 0; k < acc.length; k++) acc[k] = acc[k]! / segments
	return acc
}

function bandPower(spec: Float64Array, binHz: number, loHz: number, hiHz: number): number {
	let sum = 0
	for (let k = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(loHz / binHz)); k < spec.length && k * binHz < hiHz; k++) sum += spec[k]!
	return sum
}

/** Low band at ~1 kHz: two cascaded moving means of fs/1000 (CIC2), decimate, 265 Hz FIR. */
function lowBand(audioHz: Float32Array, sampleRateHz: number): { y: Float32Array; rate: number } {
	const m = Math.max(1, Math.round(sampleRateHz / LOW_RATE_HZ))
	const movingMean = (x: Float32Array): Float32Array => {
		const out = new Float32Array(Math.max(0, x.length - m + 1))
		let s = 0
		for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
			s += x[i]!
			if (i >= m) s -= x[i - m]!
			if (i >= m - 1) out[i - m + 1] = s / m
		}
		return out
	}
	const twice = movingMean(movingMean(audioHz))
	const rate = sampleRateHz / m
	const dec = new Float32Array(Math.floor(twice.length / m))
	for (let i = 0; i < dec.length; i++) dec[i] = twice[i * m]!
	const h = lowpassTaps(LOW_TAPS, LOW_CUTOFF_HZ, rate)
	const valid = Math.max(0, dec.length - h.length + 1)
	const y = new Float32Array(valid)
	let mean = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < valid; i++) {
		let acc = 0
		for (let k = 0; k < h.length; k++) acc += h[k]! * dec[i + h.length - 1 - k]!
		y[i] = acc
		mean += acc
	}
	mean = valid > 0 ? mean / valid : 0
	for (let i = 0; i < valid; i++) y[i] = y[i]! - mean
	return { y, rate }
}

function dftPower(x: Float32Array, rate: number, hz: number): number {
	let re = 0
	let im = 0
	const w = (-2 * Math.PI * hz) / rate
	for (let n = 0; n < x.length; n++) {
		re += x[n]! * Math.cos(w * n)
		im += x[n]! * Math.sin(w * n)
	}
	return re * re + im * im
}

function windowed(x: Float32Array): { xw: Float32Array; sumW: number; sumW2: number } {
	const xw = new Float32Array(x.length)
	let sumW = 0
	let sumW2 = 0
	for (let n = 0; n < x.length; n++) {
		const w = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * n) / Math.max(1, x.length - 1))
		xw[n] = x[n]! * w
		sumW += w
		sumW2 += w * w
	}
	return { xw, sumW, sumW2 }
}

/** Standard CTCSS tone capturing ≥ 50 % of the low-band energy, or null. */
export function detectCtcss(audioHz: Float32Array, sampleRateHz: number): number | null {
	const { y, rate } = lowBand(audioHz, sampleRateHz)
	if (y.length < 200) return null
	const { xw, sumW, sumW2 } = windowed(y)
	let energy = 0
	for (const v of xw) energy += v * v
	if (energy === 0) return null
	let best: number | null = null
	let bestPower = 0
	for (const tone of CTCSS_TONES_HZ) {
		const p = dftPower(xw, rate, tone)
		if (p > bestPower) {
			bestPower = p
			best = tone
		}
	}
	// A pure tone gives |X|² = A²(Σw)²/4 and Σ(xw)² = A²Σw²/2, so this ratio is 1 for a lone tone.
	const capture = (bestPower * 2 * sumW2) / (sumW * sumW * energy)
	return capture >= CTCSS_MIN_CAPTURE ? best : null
}

/** 134.4 Hz transition line in |Δ low band| at ≥ 14 dB over 60–260 Hz (excluding ± 20 Hz). */
export function detectDcs(audioHz: Float32Array, sampleRateHz: number): boolean {
	const { y, rate } = lowBand(audioHz, sampleRateHz)
	if (y.length < 300) return false
	const d = new Float32Array(y.length - 1)
	let mean = 0
	for (let i = 1; i < y.length; i++) {
		d[i - 1] = Math.abs(y[i]! - y[i - 1]!)
		mean += d[i - 1]!
	}
	mean /= d.length
	for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) d[i] = d[i]! - mean
	const { xw } = windowed(d)
	let line = 0
	for (let hz = DCS_BAUD - 1.5; hz <= DCS_BAUD + 1.5; hz += 0.5) line = Math.max(line, dftPower(xw, rate, hz))
	const ref: number[] = []
	for (let hz = 60; hz <= 260; hz += 1) if (Math.abs(hz - DCS_BAUD) >= 20) ref.push(dftPower(xw, rate, hz))
	ref.sort((a, b) => a - b)
	const median = ref[ref.length >> 1]!
	return median > 0 && 10 * Math.log10(line / median) >= DCS_MIN_DB
}

export function detectAfsk(audioHz: Float32Array, sampleRateHz: number): boolean {
	const spec = averagedSpectrum(audioHz, SPECTRUM_SIZE)
	if (!spec) return false
	const binHz = sampleRateHz / SPECTRUM_SIZE
	const total = bandPower(spec, binHz, 300, 3000)
	if (total <= 0) return false
	const mid = bandPower(spec, binHz, 1000, 2400) / total
	const mark = bandPower(spec, binHz, 1100, 1300) / total
	const space = bandPower(spec, binHz, 2100, 2300) / total
	const low = bandPower(spec, binHz, 300, 800) / total
	return mid >= AFSK_MID_MIN && mark >= AFSK_TONE_MIN && space >= AFSK_TONE_MIN && low <= AFSK_LOW_MAX
}

export function symbolRateLine(audioHz: Float32Array, sampleRateHz: number): SymbolRate | null {
	const smooth = filterReal(audioHz, lowpassTaps(31, LINE_LOWPASS_HZ, sampleRateHz))
	const d = new Float32Array(Math.max(0, smooth.length - 1))
	for (let i = 1; i < smooth.length; i++) d[i - 1] = Math.abs(smooth[i]! - smooth[i - 1]!)
	const spec = averagedSpectrum(d, LINE_SPECTRUM_SIZE)
	if (!spec) return null
	const binHz = sampleRateHz / LINE_SPECTRUM_SIZE
	for (const rate of LINE_RATES) {
		if (rate + 1500 >= sampleRateHz / 2) continue
		const k = Math.round(rate / binHz)
		const line = Math.max(spec[k - 1]!, spec[k]!, spec[k + 1]!)
		const ref: number[] = []
		for (let j = Math.round((rate - 1500) / binHz); j <= Math.round((rate + 1500) / binHz); j++) {
			if (Math.abs(j * binHz - rate) >= 300) ref.push(spec[j]!)
		}
		ref.sort((a, b) => a - b)
		const median = ref[ref.length >> 1]!
		if (median > 0 && 10 * Math.log10(line / median) >= LINE_MIN_DB) return rate === 1200 ? null : rate
	}
	return null
}

/** Features of ≥ 500 ms of channel IQ (interleaved cf32 at sampleRateHz, normally 48 kHz). */
export function extractChannelFeatures(iq: Float32Array, sampleRateHz: number, passbandHz = DEFAULT_PASSBAND_HZ): ChannelFeatures {
	const filtered = filterComplex(iq, lowpassTaps(IQ_FILTER_TAPS, passbandHz / 2, sampleRateHz))
	const freq = fmDiscriminator(filtered, sampleRateHz)
	const mask = onMask(filtered, sampleRateHz)
	let onCount = 0
	for (const m of mask) onCount += m
	const on = new Float32Array(onCount)
	for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < freq.length; i++) if (mask[i] === 1) on[j++] = freq[i]!
	const stats = discriminatorStats(on)
	const audio = new Float32Array(on.length)
	for (let i = 0; i < on.length; i++) audio[i] = on[i]! - stats.centreHz
	const spec = averagedSpectrum(audio, SPECTRUM_SIZE)
	const binHz = sampleRateHz / SPECTRUM_SIZE
	const wide = spec ? bandPower(spec, binHz, 100, 12_000) : 0
	const ctcssHz = detectCtcss(audio, sampleRateHz)
	return {
		sampleRateHz,
		durationMs: ((iq.length >> 1) / sampleRateHz) * 1000,
		onFraction: mask.length > 0 ? onCount / mask.length : 0,
		discPeaksHz: stats.peaksHz,
		discSpanHz: stats.spanHz,
		discStdHz: stats.stdHz,
		ctcssHz,
		dcs: ctcssHz === null && detectDcs(audio, sampleRateHz),
		afsk: detectAfsk(audio, sampleRateHz),
		symbolRateBd: symbolRateLine(audio, sampleRateHz),
		voiceBandFraction: spec && wide > 0 ? bandPower(spec, binHz, 300, 3000) / wide : 0,
	}
}

/** The channel-tier class, or null when the features do not decide (spec § 6.3). */
export function channelClass(f: ChannelFeatures, spectralClass: ScannerClass, snrDb: number): ScannerClass | null {
	if (f.onFraction < 0.05) return null
	if (snrDb >= CHANNEL_TIER_MIN_SNR_DB.twoLevel && f.discStdHz < CARRIER_STD_HZ) return "carrier"
	if (f.afsk) return "afsk-fm"
	const peaks = f.discPeaksHz
	if (snrDb >= CHANNEL_TIER_MIN_SNR_DB.multiLevel && peaks.length >= 3 && peaks.length <= 5 && f.discStdHz < MULTI_LEVEL_STD_HZ) {
		if (spectralClass === "tdma-ms") return "tdma-ms"
		return f.discSpanHz / 3 >= FSK4_12K5_SPACING_HZ ? "fsk4-12k5" : "fsk4-6k25"
	}
	if (snrDb >= CHANNEL_TIER_MIN_SNR_DB.twoLevel && peaks.length === 2) {
		const lo = peaks[0]!
		const hi = peaks[1]!
		const spacing = hi - lo
		if (Math.abs(lo + hi) <= 1500 && spacing >= 7000 && spacing <= 11_000 && f.discStdHz >= 3000) return "fsk2-wide"
		if (spacing >= 1500 && spacing < 3500 && f.symbolRateBd === 4800) return "gmsk-narrow"
	}
	if (
		snrDb >= CHANNEL_TIER_MIN_SNR_DB.multiLevel &&
		spectralClass !== "tdma-ms" &&
		peaks.length <= 1 &&
		f.discStdHz >= ANALOG_STD_MIN_HZ &&
		f.voiceBandFraction >= VOICE_BAND_MIN
	)
		return "analog-fm"
	return null
}

/**
 * Merges the channel tier over a spectral classification. Undecided features return the input
 * object unchanged (the store then keeps the spectral tier). A leak/intermod cap is kept.
 */
export function classifyChannelTier(spectral: Classification, f: ChannelFeatures, ctx: ChannelTierContext): Classification {
	const cls = channelClass(f, spectral.class, ctx.snrDb)
	if (cls === null) return spectral
	const hypotheses = applyPriors(CHANNEL_TIER_HYPOTHESES[cls] ?? [], { priors: ctx.priors, protocols: ctx.protocols })
	const metadata: { ctcssHz?: number; dcs?: boolean } = {}
	if (cls === "analog-fm") {
		if (f.ctcssHz !== null) metadata.ctcssHz = f.ctcssHz
		if (f.dcs) metadata.dcs = true
	}
	return {
		class: cls,
		hypotheses,
		tier: "channel",
		...(spectral.cap !== undefined ? { cap: spectral.cap } : {}),
		...(Object.keys(metadata).length > 0 ? { metadata } : {}),
	}
}
```

```ts
		provider.invalidate("rtl", [...provider.streams.keys()])
		await expect(first).resolves.toBeNull()
		expect(runner.busy).toBe(0)
	})
})
```

```ts
const channelAnalog = (metadata?: Classification["metadata"]): Classification => ({ class: "analog-fm", hypotheses: [{ protocol: "analog-fm", score: 0.9 }], tier: "channel", ...(metadata ? { metadata } : {}) })

		const { discoveryId } = s.ingest(observation("o2"))
		s.applyClassification(discoveryId!, channelAnalog({ dcs: true }))
		expect(s.applyClassification(discoveryId!, channelAnalog())).toBeNull()
		expect(s.get(discoveryId!)!.metadata.dcs).toBe(true)
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/channel/channel-tap.ts
/**
 * Scanner channel taps (spec § 6.3, § 10.6): cf32 48 kHz channels requested from the core
 * channelizer for the channel tier, analog recordings and the monitor. A tap is not a decoder:
 * the scanner reads the stream itself. Admission is checked first (no request for a channel that
 * cannot be admitted). On `channel-invalidated` the tap stream is destroyed and "invalidated" is
 * emitted; nothing is re-opened here (the owner decides, after the new epoch settles).
 */
import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"
import type { Readable } from "node:stream"
import type { SourceCaps } from "../../../config.js"
import { admitChannel } from "../../channelizer/admission.js"
import type { ChannelAdmissionReason, ChannelProvider, DecoderChannelRequest } from "../../channelizer/types.js"
import type { Logger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import { createComponentLogger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"

export const TAP_RATE_HZ = 48_000
const TAP_TRANSITION_HZ = 4000
const TAP_MIN_BANDWIDTH_HZ = 16_000
const TAP_MAX_BANDWIDTH_HZ = 40_000

/** bw/2 + transition ≤ 24 kHz always (admission rule); 1.4 × OBW, 16–40 kHz. */
export function tapRequest(centerHz: number, obwHz: number): DecoderChannelRequest {
	const wanted = Math.ceil((obwHz * 1.4) / 100) * 100
	const bandwidthHz = Math.min(TAP_MAX_BANDWIDTH_HZ, Math.max(TAP_MIN_BANDWIDTH_HZ, wanted))
	return { centerHz, bandwidthHz, transitionHz: TAP_TRANSITION_HZ, outputRateHz: TAP_RATE_HZ, format: "cf32" }
}

export interface ChannelTap {
	readonly tapId: string
	readonly sourceId: string
	readonly centerHz: number
	readonly channelId: string
	readonly generation: number
	readonly stream: Readable
	readonly passbandHz: number
}

export type TapOpenResult = { ok: true; tap: ChannelTap } | { ok: false; reasonCode: ChannelAdmissionReason; detail: string }

export interface ChannelTapperDeps {
	provider: ChannelProvider
	caps: (sourceId: string) => SourceCaps | undefined
	usableFraction: number
	logger: Logger
}

export class ChannelTapper extends EventEmitter {
	private readonly taps = new Map<string, ChannelTap>()
	private readonly log: Logger
	private readonly onInvalidated = (_sourceId: string, _generation: number, channelIds: string[]): void => {
		for (const id of channelIds) {
			const tap = this.taps.get(id)
			if (!tap) continue
			this.taps.delete(id)
			tap.stream.destroy()
			this.emit("invalidated", tap)
		}
	}

	constructor(private readonly deps: ChannelTapperDeps) {
		super()
		this.log = createComponentLogger(deps.logger, "ScannerChannelTap")
		deps.provider.on("channel-invalidated", this.onInvalidated)
	}

	get openCount(): number {
		return this.taps.size
	}

	async open(sourceId: string, tapId: string, centerHz: number, obwHz: number): Promise<TapOpenResult> {
		const caps = this.deps.caps(sourceId)
		if (!caps || caps.centerFreq === undefined) return { ok: false, reasonCode: "channelizer-unavailable", detail: `no caps with a centre for ${sourceId}` }
		const req = tapRequest(centerHz, obwHz)
		const verdict = admitChannel(req, { sampleRateHz: caps.sampleRate, centerHz: caps.centerFreq }, this.deps.usableFraction)
		if (!verdict.admitted) return { ok: false, reasonCode: verdict.reasonCode, detail: verdict.detail }
		const result = await this.deps.provider.requestChannel(sourceId, tapId, req, caps)
		if (!result.ok) return { ok: false, reasonCode: result.reasonCode, detail: result.detail }
		result.stream.on("error", (err: unknown) => this.log.debug({ err, tapId }, "Tap stream error"))
		const tap: ChannelTap = { tapId, sourceId, centerHz, channelId: result.channelId, generation: result.generation, stream: result.stream, passbandHz: req.bandwidthHz }
		this.taps.set(result.channelId, tap)
		return { ok: true, tap }
	}

	async close(tap: ChannelTap): Promise<void> {
		if (!this.taps.delete(tap.channelId)) return
		tap.stream.destroy()
		await this.deps.provider.releaseChannel(tap.channelId)
	}

	async closeAll(): Promise<void> {
		await Promise.all([...this.taps.values()].map(tap => this.close(tap)))
	}

	destroy(): void {
		this.deps.provider.off("channel-invalidated", this.onInvalidated as never)
		for (const tap of this.taps.values()) tap.stream.destroy()
		this.taps.clear()
	}
}

/** Reads exactly `samples` complex cf32 samples; null on end, close, error or timeout. */
export function collectCf32(stream: Readable, samples: number, timeoutMs: number): Promise<Float32Array | null> {
	return new Promise(resolve => {
		const out = new Float32Array(samples * 2)
		const bytes = new Uint8Array(out.buffer)
		let have = 0
		let done = false
		const finish = (ok: boolean): void => {
			if (done) return
			done = true
			clearTimeout(timer)
			stream.off("data", onData)
			stream.off("end", onEnd)
			stream.off("close", onEnd)
			stream.off("error", onEnd)
			resolve(ok ? out : null)
		}
		const onData = (chunk: Buffer): void => {
			const take = Math.min(chunk.length, bytes.length - have)
			chunk.copy(bytes, have, 0, take)
			have += take
			if (have >= bytes.length) finish(true)
		}
		const onEnd = (): void => finish(false)
		const timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), timeoutMs)
		if (stream.destroyed) {
			finish(false)
			return
		}
		stream.on("data", onData)
		stream.once("end", onEnd)
		stream.once("close", onEnd)
		stream.once("error", onEnd)
	})
}
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/classify/channel-tier.ts
/**
 * Runs the channel tier for one track (spec § 6.3): opens a cf32 48 kHz tap at the track centre,
 * reads `channelTier.minMs` of IQ, closes the tap and classifies. Returns null when disabled,
 * busy, not admitted, invalidated or timed out; the spectral classification then stands.
 */
import type { Logger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import { createComponentLogger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import { TAP_RATE_HZ, collectCf32, type ChannelTapper } from "../channel/channel-tap.js"
import type { Classification, ScannerProtocol, ScannerSettings } from "../types.js"
import type { TrackSnapshot } from "../../spectrum/types.js"
import { classifyChannelTier, extractChannelFeatures } from "./channel-features.js"

const COLLECT_GRACE_MS = 2000
const DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT = 2

export interface ChannelTierRunnerDeps {
	tapper: Pick<ChannelTapper, "open" | "close">
	settings: () => ScannerSettings
	newTapId: () => string
	logger: Logger
	maxConcurrent?: number
}

export class ChannelTierRunner {
	private running = 0
	private readonly log: Logger

	constructor(private readonly deps: ChannelTierRunnerDeps) {
		this.log = createComponentLogger(deps.logger, "ScannerChannelTier")
	}

	get busy(): number {
		return this.running
	}

	async classify(input: {
		sourceId: string
		track: TrackSnapshot
		spectral: Classification
		priors: Partial<Record<ScannerProtocol, number>>
		protocols: ScannerProtocol[]
	}): Promise<Classification | null> {
		const tier = this.deps.settings().channelTier
		if (!tier.enabled || this.running >= (this.deps.maxConcurrent ?? DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT)) return null
		this.running++
		try {
			const opened = await this.deps.tapper.open(input.sourceId, this.deps.newTapId(), input.track.centreHz, input.track.obwHz)
			if (!opened.ok) {
				this.log.debug({ trackId: input.track.trackId, reasonCode: opened.reasonCode, detail: opened.detail }, "Channel tier skipped")
				return null
			}
			try {
				const samples = Math.round((TAP_RATE_HZ * tier.minMs) / 1000)
				const iq = await collectCf32(opened.tap.stream, samples, tier.minMs + COLLECT_GRACE_MS)
				if (!iq) return null
				const features = extractChannelFeatures(iq, TAP_RATE_HZ, opened.tap.passbandHz)
				return classifyChannelTier(input.spectral, features, { priors: input.priors, protocols: input.protocols, snrDb: input.track.snrDb })
			} finally {
				await this.deps.tapper.close(opened.tap)
			}
		} finally {
			this.running--
		}
	}
}
```

### Task 42: Analog recordings and IQ evidence snippets

**Spec:** § 8 (`recordings/analog/…`, `evidence/<id>/iq-*.cu8`, retention), § 6.3, § 10.1 (`record.analog`, `evidence.iq`), § 14.2. **Depends on:** Tasks 17, 35, 40, 41. **Batch:** S2

Design (bounded to this task): an analog-FM discovery (channel tier or a stored `analog-fm` protocol) whose observation is credited to a job with `record.analog` gets a cf32 48 kHz tap at the track centre. The first 100 ms set the squelch: channel noise = measured power − 10·log10(1 + SNR) using the track's in-band SNR, threshold = noise + 6 dB (`ChannelSquelch`, 2 dB hysteresis, 300 ms hang). Only open-squelch audio is written: Node FM discriminator → 750 µs de-emphasis (the repo's NFM τ, `csdr-stages.ts`) → 127-tap 3 kHz FIR → ÷6 → 8 kHz s16 mono WAV, capped at 120 s (`maxRecordingS`, spec § 8; a constant, as § 12.3 has no key for it). The tap closes `hold.hangMs` after the track closes. IQ evidence (opt-in `evidence.iq`): on the first accepted decode for a discovery, the ring is read ± 0.5 s around the confirm (after waiting 0.5 s for the second half) and passed through Task 34a's `decimateToChannel` (`src/core/scanner/evidence/iq-decimate.ts`: NCO mix to the target, FIR, integer decimation to the rate `chooseDecimation` picks at or just above 48 kHz, e.g. 51.2 kHz at 2.048 Msps); the snippet's real rate goes into the evidence metadata, and `EvidenceStore.writeIq` truncates to ≤ 1 s. Encrypted calls get none. This task adds no decimator of its own.

- Modify: `src/core/scanner/store/evidence-store.ts` (new `analogRecordingTarget`), `src/core/scanner/scanner-service.ts` (`maybeRecordAnalog`, `recordAnalog`, `maybeCaptureIq`, `writeIqSnippet`; calls from `onTrack`, `maybeChannelTier`, `onProbeEvidence`)

```ts
function dftAmp(x: Int16Array, rate: number, hz: number): number {
	let re = 0
	let im = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
		re += x[i]! * Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * hz * i) / rate)
		im -= x[i]! * Math.sin((2 * Math.PI * hz * i) / rate)
	}
	return (2 * Math.hypot(re, im)) / x.length
}

describe("FmAudioDemod (spec § 8: 8 kHz s16 mono)", () => {
	it("demodulates a 1 kHz tone at the configured full-scale deviation", () => {
		const iq = toCf32(fmFromAudio(toneTrack(FS, 1000, 2500), FS, 0.5))
		const pcm = new FmAudioDemod({ deemphasisUs: null, maxDeviationHz: 5000 }).process(iq)
		expect(pcm.length).toBe(ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ)
		const settled = pcm.subarray(100)
		expect(dftAmp(settled, ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ, 1000) / 32767).toBeCloseTo(0.5, 1)
		expect(dftAmp(settled, ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ, 3500) / 32767).toBeLessThan(0.01)
	})
	it("gives the same samples whether fed whole or in odd-sized chunks", () => {
		const iq = toCf32(fmFromAudio(toneTrack(FS / 2, 700, 3000), FS, 0.5))
		const whole = new FmAudioDemod().process(iq)
		const chunked = new FmAudioDemod()
		const parts: Int16Array[] = []
		for (let start = 0, k = 0; start < iq.length; k++) {
			const len = 2 * [1, 7, 480, 1023, 5][k % 5]!
			parts.push(chunked.process(iq.subarray(start, Math.min(iq.length, start + len))))
			start += len
		}
		const joined = Int16Array.from(parts.flatMap(p => [...p]))
		expect(joined).toEqual(whole)
	})
	it("is silent for an unmodulated carrier", () => {
		const iq = toCf32(fmFromAudio(new Float32Array(FS / 4), FS, 0.5))
		const pcm = new FmAudioDemod().process(iq)
		expect(Math.max(...pcm.map(v => Math.abs(v)))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1)
	})
})
```

```ts
// tests/unit/core/scanner/analog-recorder.test.ts
import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync, existsSync } from "node:fs"
import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"
import pino from "pino"
import { AnalogRecorder } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/channel/analog-recorder.js"
import { ChannelNoiseTracker, meanPowerDbfs, noiseFromActiveDbfs, squelchThresholdDbfs } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/channel/channel-level.js"
import { wavHeader } from "../../../../src/core/scanner/channel/wav-writer.js"
import { fmFromAudio, toCf32 } from "../../../mocks/scanner/channel-signals.js"
import { gaussianNoise, mulberry32, type Iq } from "../../../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest"

const FS = 48_000
const logger = pino({ level: "silent" })

function concat(parts: Iq[]): Iq {
	const n = parts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.re.length, 0)
	const out: Iq = { re: new Float32Array(n), im: new Float32Array(n) }
	let at = 0
	for (const p of parts) {
		out.re.set(p.re, at)
		out.im.set(p.im, at)
		at += p.re.length
	}
	return out
}
/** 0.5 s noise (−50 dBFS), 1 s FM tone (≈ −10 dBFS) over the same noise, 1 s noise. */
function transmission(seed: number): Buffer {
	const rng = mulberry32(seed)
	const sigma = 10 ** (-50 / 20)
	const tx = fmFromAudio(Float32Array.from({ length: FS }, (_, i) => 2000 * Math.sin((2 * Math.PI * 800 * i) / FS)), FS, 0.316)
	const txNoise = gaussianNoise(rng, FS, sigma)
	for (let i = 0; i < FS; i++) {
		tx.re[i] = tx.re[i]! + txNoise.re[i]!
		tx.im[i] = tx.im[i]! + txNoise.im[i]!
	}
	const cf32 = toCf32(concat([gaussianNoise(rng, FS / 2, sigma), tx, gaussianNoise(rng, FS, sigma)]))
	return Buffer.from(cf32.buffer, cf32.byteOffset, cf32.byteLength)
}
function target(dir: string, name: string) {
	return { recordingId: `d_1~${name}`, path: join(dir, name) }
}

describe("channel level helpers", () => {
	it("derives the noise power from an active channel and its SNR", () => {
		expect(noiseFromActiveDbfs(-20, 20)).toBeCloseTo(-40.04, 2)
		expect(squelchThresholdDbfs(-40, 6)).toBe(-34)
		const cf32 = toCf32(fmFromAudio(new Float32Array(480), FS, 0.1))
		expect(meanPowerDbfs(cf32)).toBeCloseTo(-20, 3)
	})
	it("tracks the noise floor only while the gate is closed and ignores onsets", () => {
		const t = new ChannelNoiseTracker({ alpha: 0.5 })
		t.update(-60, false)
		expect(t.noiseDbfs).toBe(-60)
		t.update(-50, false) // +10 dB: an onset the squelch has not seen yet
		expect(t.noiseDbfs).toBe(-60)
		t.update(-30, true)
		expect(t.noiseDbfs).toBe(-60)
		t.update(-58, false)
		expect(t.noiseDbfs).toBe(-59)
	})
})

describe("AnalogRecorder (spec § 8)", () => {
	it("writes only open-squelch audio (transmission + hang) as an 8 kHz mono s16 WAV", async () => {
		const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "wk-analog-"))
		const rec = new AnalogRecorder({ target: target(dir, "a.wav"), thresholdDbfs: -40, maxRecordingMs: 120_000, hangMs: 300, logger })
		const bytes = transmission(1)
		for (let at = 0; at < bytes.length; at += 4100) await rec.push(bytes.subarray(at, Math.min(bytes.length, at + 4100)))
		const result = await rec.finish()
		expect(result?.recordingId).toBe("d_1~a.wav")
		expect(result!.durationMs).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1250)
		expect(result!.durationMs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1350)
		const file = readFileSync(join(dir, "a.wav"))
		const dataBytes = file.length - 44
		expect(file.subarray(0, 44)).toEqual(wavHeader(8000, dataBytes))
		expect(dataBytes).toBe(Math.round((result!.durationMs / 1000) * 8000) * 2)
	})
	it("stops at maxRecordingMs exactly", async () => {
		const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "wk-analog-"))
		const rec = new AnalogRecorder({ target: target(dir, "b.wav"), thresholdDbfs: -40, maxRecordingMs: 500, hangMs: 300, logger })
		await rec.push(transmission(2))
		expect((await rec.finish())!.durationMs).toBe(500)
	})
	it("leaves no file when the squelch never opened", async () => {
		const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "wk-analog-"))
		const rec = new AnalogRecorder({ target: target(dir, "c.wav"), thresholdDbfs: -3, maxRecordingMs: 120_000, hangMs: 300, logger })
		await rec.push(transmission(3))
		await expect(rec.finish()).resolves.toBeNull()
		expect(existsSync(join(dir, "c.wav"))).toBe(false)
	})
})
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/channel/fm-audio.ts
/**
 * Node FM demodulator for scanner channel taps (spec § 8, § 10.6): cf32 48 kHz → 8 kHz s16 mono.
 * Discriminator → optional single-pole de-emphasis (750 µs, the repo's NFM τ) with +12 dB makeup →
 * 127-tap 3 kHz FIR → ÷6. Stateful across chunks (phase, de-emphasis, FIR history, decimation phase),
 * so chunk boundaries never change the output.
 */
import { WaveKitError } from "../../../utils/errors.js"

export const ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ = 8000
const FILTER_TAPS = 127
const CUTOFF_HZ = 3000
const DEEMPHASIS_MAKEUP = 4
const DEFAULT_DEEMPHASIS_US = 750

function lowpass(taps: number, cutoffHz: number, fs: number): Float32Array {
	const h = new Float32Array(taps)
	const mid = (taps - 1) / 2
	let sum = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < taps; i++) {
		const t = i - mid
		const x = ((2 * cutoffHz) / fs) * t
		const sinc = t === 0 ? 1 : Math.sin(Math.PI * x) / (Math.PI * x)
		const w = 0.42 - 0.5 * Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * i) / (taps - 1)) + 0.08 * Math.cos((4 * Math.PI * i) / (taps - 1))
		h[i] = sinc * w
		sum += h[i]!
	}
	for (let i = 0; i < taps; i++) h[i] = h[i]! / sum
	return h
}

export class FmAudioDemod {
	private readonly factor: number
	private readonly hzToUnit: number
	private readonly alpha: number | null
	private readonly gain: number
	private readonly taps: Float32Array
	private readonly history: Float32Array
	private head = 0
	private phase = 0
	private lastI = 0
	private lastQ = 0
	private deemph = 0

	constructor(opts: { inputRateHz?: number; maxDeviationHz?: number; deemphasisUs?: number | null } = {}) {
		const inputRateHz = opts.inputRateHz ?? 48_000
		this.factor = Math.round(inputRateHz / ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ)
		if (this.factor * ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ !== inputRateHz) {
			throw new WaveKitError(`FM audio needs an input rate that is a multiple of ${ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ} Hz (got ${inputRateHz})`, "SCANNER_AUDIO_RATE")
		}
		this.hzToUnit = inputRateHz / (2 * Math.PI) / (opts.maxDeviationHz ?? 5000)
		const tauUs = opts.deemphasisUs === undefined ? DEFAULT_DEEMPHASIS_US : opts.deemphasisUs
		this.alpha = tauUs === null ? null : 1 - Math.exp(-1 / (inputRateHz * tauUs * 1e-6))
		this.gain = tauUs === null ? 1 : DEEMPHASIS_MAKEUP
		this.taps = lowpass(FILTER_TAPS, CUTOFF_HZ, inputRateHz)
		this.history = new Float32Array(FILTER_TAPS)
	}

	reset(): void {
		this.history.fill(0)
		this.head = 0
		this.phase = 0
		this.lastI = 0
		this.lastQ = 0
		this.deemph = 0
	}

	/** Interleaved cf32 in, s16 out (floor((phase + n) / 6) samples). */
	process(cf32: Float32Array): Int16Array {
		const n = cf32.length >> 1
		const out = new Int16Array(Math.floor((this.phase + n) / this.factor))
		let o = 0
		for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			const re = cf32[2 * i]!
			const im = cf32[2 * i + 1]!
			let x = Math.atan2(im * this.lastI - re * this.lastQ, re * this.lastI + im * this.lastQ) * this.hzToUnit
			this.lastI = re
			this.lastQ = im
			if (this.alpha !== null) {
				this.deemph += this.alpha * (x - this.deemph)
				x = this.deemph * this.gain
			}
			this.head = (this.head + 1) % FILTER_TAPS
			this.history[this.head] = x
			this.phase++
			if (this.phase === this.factor) {
				this.phase = 0
				let acc = 0
				for (let k = 0; k < FILTER_TAPS; k++) acc += this.taps[k]! * this.history[(this.head - k + FILTER_TAPS) % FILTER_TAPS]!
				out[o++] = Math.max(-32768, Math.min(32767, Math.round(acc * 32767)))
			}
		}
		return out
	}
}
```

The first sample after `reset()` sees `last = (0, 0)`, so `atan2(0, 0) = 0`: no click.

```ts
// src/core/scanner/channel/channel-level.ts
/** Channel power helpers for squelch thresholds (spec § 8, § 10.6). dBFS: |z| = 1 → 0 dBFS (ChannelSquelch). */
import { CHANNEL_POWER_FLOOR_DBFS } from "../../channel-squelch.js"

export function meanPowerDbfs(cf32: Float32Array): number {
	const n = cf32.length >> 1
	if (n === 0) return CHANNEL_POWER_FLOOR_DBFS
	let p = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) p += cf32[2 * i]! ** 2 + cf32[2 * i + 1]! ** 2
	return p > 0 ? Math.max(CHANNEL_POWER_FLOOR_DBFS, 10 * Math.log10(p / n)) : CHANNEL_POWER_FLOOR_DBFS
}

/** P = S + N and SNR = S/N, so N = P / (1 + SNR). */
export function noiseFromActiveDbfs(channelPowerDbfs: number, snrDb: number): number {
	return channelPowerDbfs - 10 * Math.log10(1 + 10 ** (snrDb / 10))
}

export function squelchThresholdDbfs(noiseDbfs: number, squelchDb: number): number {
	return noiseDbfs + squelchDb
}

/** EWMA (in dB) of the channel power while the gate is closed; a +3 dB jump is an onset, not noise. */
export class ChannelNoiseTracker {
	private readonly alpha: number
	private value: number | null = null

	constructor(opts: { alpha?: number } = {}) {
		this.alpha = opts.alpha ?? 0.02
	}

	get noiseDbfs(): number | null {
		return this.value
	}

	seed(noiseDbfs: number): void {
		this.value = noiseDbfs
	}

	update(powerDbfs: number, gateOpen: boolean): void {
		if (gateOpen) return
		if (this.value === null) {
			this.value = powerDbfs
			return
		}
		if (powerDbfs > this.value + 3) return
		this.value += this.alpha * (powerDbfs - this.value)
	}
}
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/channel/wav-writer.ts
/** Streaming mono s16 WAV writer: header first, sizes patched on finish (spec § 8). */
import { open, unlink, type FileHandle } from "node:fs/promises"

const HEADER_BYTES = 44

export function wavHeader(sampleRateHz: number, dataBytes: number): Buffer {
	const h = Buffer.alloc(HEADER_BYTES)
	h.write("RIFF", 0, "ascii")
	h.writeUInt32LE(36 + dataBytes, 4)
	h.write("WAVE", 8, "ascii")
	h.write("fmt ", 12, "ascii")
	h.writeUInt32LE(16, 16)
	h.writeUInt16LE(1, 20)
	h.writeUInt16LE(1, 22)
	h.writeUInt32LE(sampleRateHz, 24)
	h.writeUInt32LE(sampleRateHz * 2, 28)
	h.writeUInt16LE(2, 32)
	h.writeUInt16LE(16, 34)
	h.write("data", 36, "ascii")
	h.writeUInt32LE(dataBytes, 40)
	return h
}

export class WavFileWriter {
	private bytes = 0

	private constructor(
		private readonly fh: FileHandle,
		private readonly path: string,
		private readonly sampleRateHz: number,
	) {}

	static async open(path: string, sampleRateHz: number): Promise<WavFileWriter> {
		const fh = await open(path, "wx")
		await fh.write(wavHeader(sampleRateHz, 0), 0, HEADER_BYTES, 0)
		return new WavFileWriter(fh, path, sampleRateHz)
	}

	get durationMs(): number {
		return (this.bytes / 2 / this.sampleRateHz) * 1000
	}

	async write(pcm: Int16Array): Promise<void> {
		if (pcm.length === 0) return
		const buf = Buffer.from(pcm.buffer, pcm.byteOffset, pcm.byteLength)
		await this.fh.write(buf, 0, buf.length, HEADER_BYTES + this.bytes)
		this.bytes += buf.length
	}

	async finish(): Promise<{ bytes: number; durationMs: number }> {
		await this.fh.write(wavHeader(this.sampleRateHz, this.bytes), 0, HEADER_BYTES, 0)
		await this.fh.sync()
		await this.fh.close()
		return { bytes: this.bytes, durationMs: this.durationMs }
	}

	async abort(): Promise<void> {
		await this.fh.close()
		await unlink(this.path)
	}
}
```

```ts
// src/core/scanner/channel/analog-recorder.ts
/**
 * One analog transmission → one WAV (spec § 8): ChannelSquelch per 10 ms block on the cf32 tap,
 * FM audio only for open blocks, ≤ maxRecordingMs. Callers await push() in order.
 */
import { ChannelSquelch } from "../../channel-squelch.js"
import type { Logger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import { createComponentLogger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import { TAP_RATE_HZ } from "./channel-tap.js"
import { ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ, FmAudioDemod } from "./fm-audio.js"
import { WavFileWriter } from "./wav-writer.js"

export const MAX_ANALOG_RECORDING_MS = 120_000
export const ANALOG_SQUELCH_DB = 6
export const ANALOG_SQUELCH_HANG_MS = 300
const BLOCK_BYTES = (TAP_RATE_HZ / 100) * 8 // 10 ms of cf32

export interface AnalogRecordingResult {
	recordingId: string
	durationMs: number
}

export class AnalogRecorder {
	private readonly squelch: ChannelSquelch
	private readonly demod = new FmAudioDemod({ inputRateHz: TAP_RATE_HZ })
	private readonly maxSamples: number
	private readonly log: Logger
	private writer: WavFileWriter | null = null
	private written = 0
	private remainder: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(0)

	constructor(
		private readonly opts: {
			target: { recordingId: string; path: string }
			thresholdDbfs: number
			maxRecordingMs: number
			hangMs: number
			logger: Logger
		},
	) {
		this.squelch = new ChannelSquelch({ sampleRate: TAP_RATE_HZ, thresholdDbfs: opts.thresholdDbfs, hysteresisDb: 2, hangMs: opts.hangMs, blockMs: 10 })
		this.maxSamples = Math.floor((opts.maxRecordingMs / 1000) * ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ)
		this.log = createComponentLogger(opts.logger, "ScannerAnalogRecorder")
	}

	async push(chunk: Buffer): Promise<void> {
		if (this.written >= this.maxSamples) return
		const data = this.remainder.length > 0 ? Buffer.concat([this.remainder, chunk]) : chunk
		let offset = 0
		while (data.length - offset >= BLOCK_BYTES && this.written < this.maxSamples) {
			const block = Buffer.from(data.subarray(offset, offset + BLOCK_BYTES))
			offset += BLOCK_BYTES
			const gated = this.squelch.process(block)[0] ?? block
			const pcm = this.demod.process(new Float32Array(gated.buffer, gated.byteOffset, gated.byteLength / 4))
			if (!this.squelch.open) continue
			if (!this.writer) {
				this.writer = await WavFileWriter.open(this.opts.target.path, ANALOG_AUDIO_RATE_HZ)
				this.log.debug({ recordingId: this.opts.target.recordingId }, "Analog recording started")
			}
			const room = this.maxSamples - this.written
			const slice = pcm.length > room ? pcm.subarray(0, room) : pcm
			await this.writer.write(slice)
			this.written += slice.length
		}
		this.remainder = Buffer.from(data.subarray(offset))
	}

	/** Null when the squelch never opened (no file was created). */
	async finish(): Promise<AnalogRecordingResult | null> {
		if (!this.writer) return null
		const { durationMs } = await this.writer.finish()
		this.writer = null
		return { recordingId: this.opts.target.recordingId, durationMs }
	}
}
```

`Buffer.from(subarray)` copies the block into a fresh, 4-byte-aligned buffer, so the `Float32Array` view is valid; `ChannelSquelch.process` returns exactly one block for one whole block (its remainder stays empty).

In `src/core/scanner/store/evidence-store.ts`, add a field `private analogSeq = 0` and the method (with `WaveKitError` imported if not already):

```ts
	/**
	 * Allocates recordings/analog/<discoveryId>/<file>.wav for a post-channelizer analog recording
	 * (spec § 8). recordingPath() resolves the id once the file exists; retention covers it with the
	 * dv recordings. Null while the disk is low.
	 */
	async analogRecordingTarget(discoveryId: string, startedAt: number): Promise<{ recordingId: string; path: string } | null> {
		if (!/^d_[0-9A-Za-z]+$/.test(discoveryId)) throw new WaveKitError(`Invalid discovery id ${discoveryId}`, "SCANNER_INVALID_ID")
		if ((await this.diskState()) === "disk-low") return null
		const dir = join(this.root, "recordings", "analog", discoveryId)
		await this.ensureDir(dir)
		const fileName = `${new Date(startedAt).toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-")}-a${++this.analogSeq}.wav`
		return { recordingId: `${discoveryId}~${fileName}`, path: join(dir, fileName) }
	}
```

```ts
	/** Open analog recordings by trackId. */
	private readonly analog = new Map<string, { stop: () => void }>()
	/** Discoveries with an IQ snippet being cut. */
	private readonly iqPending = new Set<string>()

	private maybeRecordAnalog(live: LiveObservation, track: TrackSnapshot): void {
		if (!this.tapper || live.discoveryId === null || this.analog.has(track.trackId)) return
		const discovery = this.store.get(live.discoveryId)
		if (!discovery || discovery.operator?.lockout === true) return
		if (live.classification.class !== "analog-fm" && discovery.protocol !== "analog-fm") return
		if (!live.jobIds.some(id => this.jobs.get(id)?.spec.record.analog === true)) return
		const discoveryId = live.discoveryId
		this.analog.set(track.trackId, { stop: () => undefined })
		void this.recordAnalog(live, track, discoveryId)
			.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, trackId: track.trackId }, "Analog recording failed"))
			.finally(() => this.analog.delete(track.trackId))
	}

	private async recordAnalog(live: LiveObservation, track: TrackSnapshot, discoveryId: string): Promise<void> {
		const tapper = this.tapper
		if (!tapper) return
		const target = await this.evidence.analogRecordingTarget(discoveryId, this.now())
		if (!target || !this.live.has(track.trackId)) return
		const opened = await tapper.open(live.sourceId, probeId("tap", "rec", ++this.tapSeq), track.centreHz, track.obwHz)
		if (!opened.ok) return
		const tap: ChannelTap = opened.tap
		let stopped = false
		this.analog.set(track.trackId, {
			stop: () => {
				stopped = true
				void tapper.close(tap)
			},
		})
		let recorder: AnalogRecorder | null = null
		try {
			const head = await collectCf32(tap.stream, TAP_HEAD_SAMPLES, 2000)
			if (!head) return
			const noise = noiseFromActiveDbfs(meanPowerDbfs(head), track.snrDb)
			recorder = new AnalogRecorder({
				target,
				thresholdDbfs: squelchThresholdDbfs(noise, ANALOG_SQUELCH_DB),
				maxRecordingMs: MAX_ANALOG_RECORDING_MS,
				hangMs: ANALOG_SQUELCH_HANG_MS,
				logger: this.deps.logger,
			})
			await recorder.push(Buffer.from(head.buffer, head.byteOffset, head.byteLength))
			for await (const chunk of tap.stream) {
				if (stopped) break
				await recorder.push(chunk as Buffer)
			}
		} catch (err: unknown) {
			if (!stopped) throw err
		} finally {
			await tapper.close(tap)
			const result = recorder ? await recorder.finish() : null
			if (result) this.markRecording(live.observationId, "linked", [result.recordingId])
		}
	}

	private maybeCaptureIq(req: ProbeRequest, ev: DecodeEvidence): void {
		if (ev.encrypted === true || this.jobs.get(req.jobId)?.spec.evidence.iq !== true) return
		const discoveryId = this.live.get(req.trackId)?.discoveryId ?? req.discoveryId
		if (discoveryId === null || this.iqPending.has(discoveryId) || this.store.get(discoveryId)?.evidence.iq === true) return
		const engine = this.spectrum.engine(req.sourceId)
		if (!engine || engine.format !== "U8_IQ") return
		const epoch = engine.currentEpoch()
		if (epoch.epoch !== req.epoch) return
		const half = Math.round(epoch.sampleRateHz * IQ_SNIPPET_HALF_S)
		const centre = engine.liveEdge()
		this.iqPending.add(discoveryId)
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			void this.writeIqSnippet(engine, discoveryId, req, epoch, centre - half, centre + half)
				.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, discoveryId }, "IQ evidence failed"))
				.finally(() => this.iqPending.delete(discoveryId))
		}, IQ_SNIPPET_HALF_S * 1000)
		timer.unref()
	}

	private async writeIqSnippet(engine: SpectrumEngine, discoveryId: string, req: ProbeRequest, epoch: EngineEpoch, from: number, to: number): Promise<void> {
		if (engine.currentEpoch().epoch !== epoch.epoch) return
		const ring = engine.readRing(from, to)
		if (!ring) return
		const snippet = decimateToChannel(ring.bytes, { inputRateHz: epoch.sampleRateHz, offsetHz: req.targetHz - epoch.centreHz, targetRateHz: IQ_SNIPPET_TARGET_HZ })
		const file = await this.evidence.writeIq(discoveryId, snippet.bytes, { sampleRateHz: snippet.sampleRateHz, centreHz: req.targetHz })
		if (file) this.store.setEvidenceFlags(discoveryId, { iq: true })
	}
```

with the module constants `const TAP_HEAD_SAMPLES = 4800 // 100 ms at 48 kHz: sets the analog squelch`, `const IQ_SNIPPET_HALF_S = 0.5 // ± 0.5 s around the confirm (spec § 8: ≤ 1 s)` and `const IQ_SNIPPET_TARGET_HZ = 48_000`.

Call sites:
1. In `onTrack`, `track-open` path, after `this.maybeChannelTier(live, ev.track)`: `this.maybeRecordAnalog(live, ev.track)`.
2. In `maybeChannelTier`'s `.then(…)`, after `this.store.applyClassification(…)`: `this.maybeRecordAnalog(live, track)`.
3. In `onTrack`, `track-close` path: `const rec = this.analog.get(ev.track.trackId); if (rec) setTimeout(() => rec.stop(), this.settings().hold.hangMs).unref()`.
4. In `onProbeEvidence(probeId, req, ev)`, after the store accepted the evidence (the `applyEvidence` result is not `null`): `this.maybeCaptureIq(req, ev)`.
5. In `stop()`, before `this.tapper?.closeAll()`: `for (const rec of this.analog.values()) rec.stop()`.

### Task 43: Probe budgets from the channelizer capacity gate; `maxProbes.channel`

**Spec:** § 9 (`cpuBudgetCores`, the cost row "the capacity gate replaces these numbers", `maxProbes`), § 6.5 (Admission), § 12.3, § 14.2. **Depends on:** Tasks 14, 24, 40; channelizer Task 36 (`docs/CAPACITY-<run-date>-CHANNELIZER.md`) committed. **Batch:** S2

Decision (bounded to this task): a `channel` probe is charged the channelizer's **marginal** cost per channel plus its decoder; the `wavekit-chan` process base cost is shared with configured channelised decoders and is not charged to probes. `maxProbes.channel`'s default is derived from the table with dsd-fme as the reference decoder (DMR is the first acceptance case), one `offset` slot reserved and the engine charged: `floor((cpuBudgetCores − engine − offsetProbe) / (channelBase + decoder["dsd-fme"]))`, clamped to 1–8. With the spec's numbers that is `floor(0.42 / 0.095) = 4`, the spec default. The admission budget still guards every mix of decoders.

```ts
export type ProbeCostDecoder = "dsd-fme" | "multimon-ng" | "direwolf" | "rtl433"

export interface CpuCostTable {
	engine: number
	offsetProbe: number
	channelBase: number
	decoder: Readonly<Record<ProbeCostDecoder, number>>
}

export interface CapacityMeasurements {
	/** Repo-relative path of the capacity doc the numbers come from. */
	source: string
	sampleRateHz: number
	/** wavekit-chan with one channel minus one marginal channel (cores). */
	chanBaseCores: number
	/** (cpu at 8 channels − cpu at 1) / 7 (cores). */
	chanPerChannelCores: number
	/** Channelised per-instance decoder costs the doc measured (cores). */
	decoderCores: Partial<Record<ProbeCostDecoder, number>>
}

/** Spec § 9 estimates (feasibility § 6, DIGITAL-VOICE.md, ROADMAP item 5). */
export const SPEC_COSTS: CpuCostTable = {
	engine: 0.08,
	offsetProbe: 0.5,
	channelBase: 0.05,
	decoder: { "dsd-fme": 0.045, "multimon-ng": 0.03, direwolf: 0.05, rtl433: 0.1 },
}

/** Read by hand from the channelizer capacity gate (Task 43 Step 1). */
export const CAPACITY_MEASUREMENTS: CapacityMeasurements = {
	source: "docs/CAPACITY-YYYY-MM-DD-CHANNELIZER.md", // the real file name from Step 0
	sampleRateHz: 2_048_000,
	chanBaseCores: 0, // Step 1
	chanPerChannelCores: 0, // Step 1
	decoderCores: {},
}

/** A channel probe pays the marginal channel cost; the process base is shared with configured decoders. */
export function deriveCosts(m: CapacityMeasurements, base: CpuCostTable = SPEC_COSTS): CpuCostTable {
	return { ...base, channelBase: m.chanPerChannelCores, decoder: { ...base.decoder, ...m.decoderCores } }
}

export const CPU_COST: CpuCostTable = deriveCosts(CAPACITY_MEASUREMENTS)

/** Default maxProbes.channel: one offset slot and the engine reserved, dsd-fme as the reference decoder, 1–8. */
export function maxChannelProbesFor(budgetCores: number, costs: CpuCostTable, reference: ProbeCostDecoder = "dsd-fme"): number {
	const spare = budgetCores - costs.engine - costs.offsetProbe
	const per = costs.channelBase + costs.decoder[reference]
	return Math.max(1, Math.min(8, Math.floor(spare / per + 1e-9)))
}
```

In `src/config.ts`, `ScannerConfigSchema.maxProbes.channel`: set `.default(n)` with `n = maxChannelProbesFor(1.0, CPU_COST)` computed once by hand from the filled table (a literal, so the config module does not import scanner code), and update the comment in `config/default.yaml` (`#     channel: n   # from docs/CAPACITY-…-CHANNELIZER.md`). ### Task 44: Monitor runner (listen-scan)

**Spec:** § 10.6, § 5b routing (§ 10.6 first bullet), § 7.2 (Lockout), § 6.3, § 10.1 (`kind: "monitor"`, `MonitorSpec`), § 9. **Depends on:** Tasks 1, 35, 40, 41, 42, CHECKPOINT S2. **Batch:** S3

Design (bounded to this task):
- A `MonitorRunner` is a `JobDriver` that **decorates** the job's normal `JobRunner` (built by the existing `createDriver` path with kind `discover`): state machine, lease, hops, holds, discovery and progress stay the JobRunner's; the monitor adds channel taps, squelch, per-transmission mode routing and audio selection. So in-window monitors and window-spanning monitors (the JobRunner sweeps with `hold.policy` holds, § 10.2) share one implementation: on every `epoch-started` the monitor re-taps the channels inside the new window; hops give audio gaps, as § 10.6 expects.
- Per channel: a cf32 48 kHz tap; 10 ms blocks; `ChannelNoiseTracker` learns the idle power (onsets ignored); `ChannelSquelch` threshold = noise + `squelchDb` (default 8 dB), 2 dB hysteresis, hang `monitor.hangMs` (2000). A channel that is busy when the tap opens learns its noise only after that transmission ends.
- On each squelch opening with `mode: "auto"`, the first 300 ms of gated IQ go through the channel tier (`channelClass`, SNR = open power − noise): 4FSK / TDMA / GMSK classes → **digital**: a dsd-fme probe on that channel (`channel` transport, Task 40), its decoded voice PCM forwarded; everything else → **analog**: Node FM demod (Task 42) of the buffered 300 ms then live blocks. When the features do not decide, the channel's discovery family decides (`digital-voice` → digital), else analog. `mode: "analog" | "digital"` skips the classification.
- Audio selection (`selectAudioChannel`): among open, unlocked channels the current one is kept until its squelch (including hang) closes; a `priorityChannels` channel preempts a non-priority current channel on its first open block (10 ms, inside one 20 ms audio frame); otherwise the highest `priority`, ties in spec order. A change clears the sink queue.
- Lockouts (`monitor.lockouts`, or the discovery's operator lockout) get no tap, no probe, no audio. At most `MONITOR_MAX_CHANNELS` (16) channels per monitor, so taps stay inside the channel budget.
- The monitor's audio sink and voice source are interfaces here; Task 45 implements them in `DigitalVoiceService`, Task 46 wires them.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/scanner/monitor/monitor-runner.ts`
- Modify: `src/core/scanner/scanner-service.ts` (`ScannerServiceDeps.monitorAudio`, `monitorVoice`; `createJob`/`patchJob` monitor path; `createDriver(record, kind)`; `withMonitorRanges`, `monitorChannels`, `discoveriesFor`; re-emit `"monitor"`)

```ts
			return () => void voiceBus.off(`pcm:${id}`, fn)
		},
		onCall: (id: string, fn: (call: { talkgroup: number | null; source: number | null; slot: number | null; encrypted: boolean; active: boolean }) => void) => {
			voiceBus.on(`call:${id}`, fn)
			return () => void voiceBus.off(`call:${id}`, fn)
		},
	}
	let released = 0
	let n = 0
	const runner: MonitorRunner = new MonitorRunner(
		record,
		{ channels, tapper, probes, voice, audio: sink, releaseAudio: () => void released++, currentEpoch: () => 1, newTapId: () => `scn-m-tap-${++n}`, logger },
		fakeInner(record),
	)
	const events: MonitorEvent[] = []
	runner.on("monitor", (ev: MonitorEvent) => events.push(ev))
	const streamFor = (hz: number) => {
		const call = [...provider.calls].reverse().find(c => c.req.centerHz === hz)
		if (!call) throw new Error(`no tap at ${hz}`)
		return provider.streams.get(`${call.decoderId}-g${provider.generation}`)!
	}
	return { provider, tapper, record, runner, sink, pushes, probes, voiceBus, events, streamFor, setCentre: (hz: number) => { caps = { ...caps, centerFreq: hz } }, releasedAudio: () => released }
}

describe("selectAudioChannel (spec § 10.6)", () => {
	const ch = (key: string, o: { priority?: number; preferred?: boolean; open?: boolean; locked?: boolean } = {}) => ({ key, priority: o.priority ?? 0, preferred: o.preferred ?? false, open: o.open ?? true, locked: o.locked ?? false })
	it("keeps the current channel until it closes, even for a higher priority", () => {
		expect(selectAudioChannel([ch("a"), ch("b", { priority: 9 })], "a")).toBe("a")
		expect(selectAudioChannel([ch("a", { open: false }), ch("b", { priority: 9 })], "a")).toBe("b")
	})
	it("lets a priority channel preempt a non-priority current channel", () => {
		expect(selectAudioChannel([ch("a"), ch("p", { preferred: true })], "a")).toBe("p")
		expect(selectAudioChannel([ch("p", { preferred: true }), ch("q", { preferred: true, priority: 9 })], "p")).toBe("p")
	})
	it("picks the highest priority, ties in spec order, never a locked channel", () => {
		expect(selectAudioChannel([ch("a", { priority: 1 }), ch("b", { priority: 5 }), ch("c", { priority: 5 })], null)).toBe("b")
		expect(selectAudioChannel([ch("a", { locked: true, priority: 9 }), ch("b")], null)).toBe("b")
		expect(selectAudioChannel([ch("a", { open: false })], null)).toBeNull()
	})
})

describe("resolveMonitorChannels and monitorRanges", () => {
	const d = (id: string, hz: number, o: Partial<Discovery> = {}) => ({ id, frequencyHz: hz, family: "digital-voice", operator: undefined, ...o }) as unknown as Discovery
	const lookup = (id: string) => ({ d_1: d("d_1", A), d_2: d("d_2", B, { operator: { lockout: true } }) })[id]
	it("resolves discoveries, frequencies, priority channels and lockouts", () => {

		expect(out).toEqual([
			{ key: "d_1", frequencyHz: A, discoveryId: "d_1", priority: 3, preferred: false, mode: "auto", squelchDb: 8, locked: true, family: "digital-voice" },
			{ key: "d_2", frequencyHz: B, discoveryId: "d_2", priority: 0, preferred: false, mode: "auto", squelchDb: 8, locked: true, family: "digital-voice" },
			{ key: `f${C}`, frequencyHz: C, discoveryId: null, priority: 0, preferred: true, mode: "analog", squelchDb: 12, locked: false, family: null },
		])
	})
	it("rejects unknown discoveries, empty and oversized monitors", () => {
		expect(() => resolveMonitorChannels({ channels: [{ discoveryId: "d_9" }] }, lookup, () => [])).toThrow(ScannerApiError)
		expect(() => resolveMonitorChannels({ channels: [] }, lookup, () => [])).toThrow(ScannerApiError)
		const many = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => ({ frequencyHz: A + i * 12_500 }))
		expect(() => resolveMonitorChannels({ channels: many }, lookup, () => [])).toThrow(ScannerApiError)
	})
	it("covers each channel with a merged ±6.25 kHz range", () => {
		expect(monitorRanges([channel("a", A), channel("b", A + 12_500), channel("c", C + 100_000)])).toEqual([
			{ startHz: A - 6250, endHz: A + 12_500 + 6250 },
			{ startHz: C + 100_000 - 6250, endHz: C + 100_000 + 6250 },
		])
	})
})
```
