```ts
// src/core/scanner/monitor/monitor-runner.ts
/**
 * Listen-scan monitor (spec § 10.6): channel taps with squelch, per-transmission analog/digital
 * routing from the first 300 ms, one audio selection per job (priority preemption inside one
 * 20 ms frame), lockouts. Decorates the job's JobRunner, which keeps state, lease, hops and holds.
 */
import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"
import type { Logger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import { createComponentLogger } from "../../../utils/logger.js"
import { ChannelSquelch } from "../../channel-squelch.js"
import { ChannelNoiseTracker, meanPowerDbfs } from "../channel/channel-level.js"
import { TAP_RATE_HZ, type ChannelTap, type ChannelTapper } from "../channel/channel-tap.js"
import { FmAudioDemod } from "../channel/fm-audio.js"
import { channelClass, extractChannelFeatures } from "../classify/channel-features.js"
import { ScannerApiError } from "../errors.js"
import type { JobDriver, JobRecord } from "../job-runner.js"
import type { ProbePool, ProbeRequest } from "../probes/probe-pool.js"
import type { DecodeEvidence, Discovery, MonitorSpec, ProtocolFamily, ScanRange, ScannerClass } from "../types.js"
import type { TrackSnapshot } from "../../spectrum/types.js"

export const MONITOR_MAX_CHANNELS = 16
const DEFAULT_SQUELCH_DB = 8
const DEFAULT_HANG_MS = 2000
const CHANNEL_HALF_HZ = 6250
const CHANNEL_OBW_HZ = 12_500
const BLOCK_BYTES = (TAP_RATE_HZ / 100) * 8 // 10 ms of cf32
const CLASSIFY_BLOCKS = 30 // 300 ms
const MONITOR_PROBE_HOLD_MS = 60_000
const DIGITAL_CLASSES: ReadonlySet<ScannerClass> = new Set<ScannerClass>(["tdma-ms", "fsk4-12k5", "fsk4-6k25", "gmsk-narrow"])

type LiveRef = Parameters<JobDriver["onTrack"]>[0]
type EpochRef = Parameters<JobDriver["onEpochStarted"]>[0]

export type MonitorMode = "analog" | "digital"

export interface ResolvedMonitorChannel {
	key: string
	frequencyHz: number
	discoveryId: string | null
	priority: number
	/** Listed in monitor.priorityChannels: preempts a non-priority current channel. */
	preferred: boolean
	mode: "auto" | "analog" | "digital"
	squelchDb: number
	locked: boolean
	family: ProtocolFamily | null
}

export interface MonitorEvent {
	jobId: string
	channel: string
	frequencyHz: number
	mode: MonitorMode | null
	discoveryId?: string
	talkgroup?: string
	source?: string
	slot?: number
	encrypted: boolean
	active: boolean
}

export interface ScannerAudioSink {
	push(pcm: Buffer): void
	setActive(active: boolean): void
	clear(): void
}

export interface MonitorVoiceCall { talkgroup: number | null; source: number | null; slot: number | null; encrypted: boolean; active: boolean }

export interface MonitorVoiceSource {
	onVoicePcm(decoderId: string, listener: (pcm: Buffer) => void): () => void
	onCall(decoderId: string, listener: (call: MonitorVoiceCall) => void): () => void
}

export interface MonitorRunnerDeps {
	channels: readonly ResolvedMonitorChannel[]
	tapper: Pick<ChannelTapper, "open" | "close" | "on" | "off">
	probes: Pick<ProbePool, "request" | "release" | "follow">
	voice: MonitorVoiceSource
	audio: ScannerAudioSink
	releaseAudio: () => void
	currentEpoch: () => number | null
	newTapId: () => string
	logger: Logger
}

export function resolveMonitorChannels(
	monitor: MonitorSpec,
	lookup: (discoveryId: string) => Discovery | undefined,
	fromDiscoveries: (f: NonNullable<MonitorSpec["fromDiscoveries"]>) => Discovery[],
): ResolvedMonitorChannel[] {
	const out = new Map<string, ResolvedMonitorChannel>()
	const lockouts = new Set(monitor.lockouts ?? [])
	const preferred = new Set(monitor.priorityChannels ?? [])
	const add = (frequencyHz: number, discovery: Discovery | null, o: { priority?: number | undefined; mode?: "auto" | "analog" | "digital" | undefined; squelchDb?: number | undefined }): void => {
		const key = discovery?.id ?? `f${Math.round(frequencyHz)}`
		if (out.has(key)) return
		const names = [key, String(Math.round(frequencyHz)), ...(discovery ? [discovery.id] : [])]
		out.set(key, {
			key,
			frequencyHz,
			discoveryId: discovery?.id ?? null,
			priority: o.priority ?? 0,
			preferred: names.some(n => preferred.has(n)),
			mode: o.mode ?? "auto",
			squelchDb: o.squelchDb ?? DEFAULT_SQUELCH_DB,
			locked: names.some(n => lockouts.has(n)) || discovery?.operator?.lockout === true,
			family: discovery?.family ?? null,
		})
	}
	for (const ch of monitor.channels ?? []) {
		if (ch.discoveryId !== undefined) {
			const d = lookup(ch.discoveryId)
			if (!d) throw new ScannerApiError(`Discovery ${ch.discoveryId} not found`, "SCANNER_DISCOVERY_NOT_FOUND", 400, { discoveryId: ch.discoveryId })
			add(d.frequencyHz, d, ch)
		} else if (ch.frequencyHz !== undefined) {
			add(ch.frequencyHz, null, ch)
		}
	}
	if (monitor.fromDiscoveries) for (const d of fromDiscoveries(monitor.fromDiscoveries)) add(d.frequencyHz, d, {})
	if (out.size === 0) throw new ScannerApiError("A monitor needs at least one channel", "SCANNER_MONITOR_EMPTY", 400)
	if (out.size > MONITOR_MAX_CHANNELS) {
		throw new ScannerApiError(`A monitor takes at most ${MONITOR_MAX_CHANNELS} channels`, "SCANNER_MONITOR_TOO_MANY", 400, { channels: out.size, max: MONITOR_MAX_CHANNELS })
	}
	return [...out.values()]
}

/** The job scope: each channel ± 6.25 kHz, merged. */
export function monitorRanges(channels: readonly Pick<ResolvedMonitorChannel, "frequencyHz">[]): ScanRange[] {
	const spans = channels.map(c => ({ startHz: c.frequencyHz - CHANNEL_HALF_HZ, endHz: c.frequencyHz + CHANNEL_HALF_HZ })).sort((a, b) => a.startHz - b.startHz)
	const out: ScanRange[] = []
	for (const s of spans) {
		const last = out.at(-1)
		if (last && s.startHz <= last.endHz) last.endHz = Math.max(last.endHz, s.endHz)
		else out.push({ ...s })
	}
	return out
}

/** Keep the current channel until it closes; a preferred channel preempts a non-preferred one; else highest priority, ties in order. */
export function selectAudioChannel(
	channels: readonly { key: string; priority: number; preferred: boolean; open: boolean; locked: boolean }[],
	current: string | null,
): string | null {
	const open = channels.filter(c => c.open && !c.locked)
	if (open.length === 0) return null
	let best = open[0]!
	for (const c of open) {
		if ((c.preferred ? 1 : 0) > (best.preferred ? 1 : 0) || (c.preferred === best.preferred && c.priority > best.priority)) best = c
	}
	const cur = open.find(c => c.key === current)
	if (!cur) return best.key
	if (best.preferred && !cur.preferred) return best.key
	return cur.key
}

interface ChannelRuntime {
	spec: ResolvedMonitorChannel
	tap: ChannelTap | null
	detach: (() => void) | null
	squelch: ChannelSquelch
	noise: ChannelNoiseTracker
	demod: FmAudioDemod
	remainder: Buffer
	open: boolean
	snrDb: number
	mode: MonitorMode | null
	cls: ScannerClass | null
	pending: Buffer[]
	probeId: string | null
	voiceOff: (() => void) | null
	callOff: (() => void) | null
	call: { talkgroup?: string; source?: string; slot?: number; encrypted: boolean }
	live: { observationId: string; trackId: string } | null
}

function f32(block: Buffer): Float32Array {
	return new Float32Array(block.buffer, block.byteOffset, block.byteLength / 4)
}

export class MonitorRunner extends EventEmitter implements JobDriver {
	private readonly channels: ChannelRuntime[]
	private readonly hangMs: number
	private readonly log: Logger
	private selected: string | null = null
	private retapping: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve()
	private readonly onInvalidated = (tap: ChannelTap): void => {
		const ch = this.channels.find(c => c.tap === tap)
		if (!ch) return
		if (ch.open) this.closeTransmission(ch)
		this.detachTap(ch)
	}

	constructor(
		readonly record: JobRecord,
		private readonly deps: MonitorRunnerDeps,
		private readonly inner: JobDriver,
	) {
		super()
		this.log = createComponentLogger(deps.logger, "ScannerMonitor")
		this.hangMs = record.rawSpec.monitor?.hangMs ?? DEFAULT_HANG_MS
		this.channels = deps.channels.map(spec => ({
			spec,
			tap: null,
			detach: null,
			squelch: this.newSquelch(),
			noise: new ChannelNoiseTracker(),
			demod: new FmAudioDemod({ inputRateHz: TAP_RATE_HZ }),
			remainder: Buffer.alloc(0),
			open: false,
			snrDb: 0,
			mode: null,
			cls: null,
			pending: [],
			probeId: null,
			voiceOff: null,
			callOff: null,
			call: { encrypted: false },
			live: null,
		}))
		deps.tapper.on("invalidated", this.onInvalidated)
	}

	get selectedChannel(): string | null {
		return this.selected
	}

	async start(): Promise<void> {
		await this.inner.start()
		this.syncTaps()
		await this.retapping
	}

	async dispatch(e: Parameters<JobDriver["dispatch"]>[0]): Promise<void> {
		await this.inner.dispatch(e)
		this.syncTaps()
	}

	covers(sourceId: string, hz: number): boolean {
		return this.inner.covers(sourceId, hz)
	}

	progress(): ReturnType<JobDriver["progress"]> {
		return this.inner.progress()
	}

	onEpochStarted(epoch: EpochRef): void {
		this.inner.onEpochStarted(epoch)
		this.retapAll()
	}

	onBlock(endSample: number, overload: boolean): void {
		this.inner.onBlock(endSample, overload)
	}

	onStale(blocks: number): void {
		this.inner.onStale(blocks)
	}

	onTrack(live: LiveRef, track: TrackSnapshot, needsConfirm: boolean): void {
		this.inner.onTrack(live, track, needsConfirm)
		for (const ch of this.channels) {
			if (Math.abs(track.centreHz - ch.spec.frequencyHz) <= CHANNEL_HALF_HZ) ch.live = { observationId: live.observationId, trackId: track.trackId }
		}
	}

	onTrackClosed(trackId: string): void {
		this.inner.onTrackClosed(trackId)
		for (const ch of this.channels) if (ch.live?.trackId === trackId) ch.live = null
	}

	onUntrackedRetune(): void {
		this.inner.onUntrackedRetune()
	}

	onEvidence(probeId: string, ev: DecodeEvidence): void {
		this.inner.onEvidence(probeId, ev)
	}

	replan(spec: Parameters<JobDriver["replan"]>[0], plan: Parameters<JobDriver["replan"]>[1]): void {
		this.inner.replan(spec, plan)
	}

	tick(now: number): void {
		this.inner.tick(now)
	}

	async idle(): Promise<void> {
		await Promise.all([this.inner.idle(), this.retapping])
	}

	async dispose(): Promise<void> {
		this.deps.tapper.off("invalidated", this.onInvalidated)
		this.retapping = this.retapping.then(() => this.closeAllTaps())
		await this.retapping
		this.selected = null
		this.deps.audio.setActive(false)
		this.deps.releaseAudio()
		await this.inner.dispose()
	}

	private newSquelch(): ChannelSquelch {
		// −1 dBFS keeps the gate closed until the first block sets noise + squelchDb.
		return new ChannelSquelch({ sampleRate: TAP_RATE_HZ, thresholdDbfs: -1, hysteresisDb: 2, hangMs: this.hangMs, blockMs: 10 })
	}

	private isActive(): boolean {
		const s = this.record.state
		return s === "starting" || s === "running" || s === "holding"
	}

	private syncTaps(): void {
		if (!this.isActive()) {
			this.retapping = this.retapping.then(() => this.closeAllTaps())
			return
		}
		if (this.channels.some(c => c.tap !== null)) return
		this.retapAll()
	}

	private retapAll(): void {
		this.retapping = this.retapping
			.then(async () => {
				await this.closeAllTaps()
				if (!this.isActive()) return
				for (const ch of this.channels) {
					if (ch.spec.locked) continue
					const opened = await this.deps.tapper.open(this.record.spec.sourceId, this.deps.newTapId(), ch.spec.frequencyHz, CHANNEL_OBW_HZ)
					if (!opened.ok) {
						this.log.debug({ channel: ch.spec.key, reasonCode: opened.reasonCode }, "Monitor channel not tapped")
						continue
					}
					this.attach(ch, opened.tap)
				}
			})
			.catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, jobId: this.record.id }, "Monitor re-tap failed"))
	}

	private attach(ch: ChannelRuntime, tap: ChannelTap): void {
		ch.tap = tap
		ch.squelch = this.newSquelch()
		ch.noise = new ChannelNoiseTracker()
		ch.demod.reset()
		ch.remainder = Buffer.alloc(0)
		const onData = (chunk: Buffer): void => this.onData(ch, chunk)
		tap.stream.on("data", onData)
		ch.detach = () => tap.stream.off("data", onData)
	}

	private detachTap(ch: ChannelRuntime): void {
		ch.detach?.()
		ch.detach = null
		ch.tap = null
		ch.remainder = Buffer.alloc(0)
	}

	private async closeAllTaps(): Promise<void> {
		for (const ch of this.channels) {
			const tap = ch.tap
			if (!tap) continue
			if (ch.open) this.closeTransmission(ch)
			this.detachTap(ch)
			await this.deps.tapper.close(tap)
		}
	}

	private onData(ch: ChannelRuntime, chunk: Buffer): void {
		const data = ch.remainder.length > 0 ? Buffer.concat([ch.remainder, chunk]) : chunk
		let offset = 0
		while (data.length - offset >= BLOCK_BYTES) {
			this.onBlockOf(ch, Buffer.from(data.subarray(offset, offset + BLOCK_BYTES)))
			offset += BLOCK_BYTES
		}
		ch.remainder = Buffer.from(data.subarray(offset))
	}

	private onBlockOf(ch: ChannelRuntime, block: Buffer): void {
		const power = meanPowerDbfs(f32(block))
		ch.noise.update(power, ch.open)
		const noise = ch.noise.noiseDbfs ?? power
		if (!ch.open) ch.squelch.setThreshold(noise + ch.spec.squelchDb)
		const gated = ch.squelch.process(block)[0] ?? block
		const nowOpen = ch.squelch.open
		if (nowOpen && !ch.open) this.openTransmission(ch, power - noise)
		else if (!nowOpen && ch.open) this.closeTransmission(ch)
		if (!nowOpen) return
		if (ch.mode === null) {
			ch.pending.push(gated)
			if (ch.pending.length >= CLASSIFY_BLOCKS) this.decide(ch)
			return
		}
		if (ch.mode === "analog") this.playAnalog(ch, gated)
	}

	private openTransmission(ch: ChannelRuntime, snrDb: number): void {
		ch.open = true
		ch.snrDb = snrDb
		ch.pending = []
		ch.cls = null
		ch.call = { encrypted: false }
		ch.mode = ch.spec.mode === "auto" ? null : ch.spec.mode
		this.reselect()
		if (ch.mode !== null) this.enterMode(ch)
	}

	private decide(ch: ChannelRuntime): void {
		const joined = Buffer.concat(ch.pending)
		const iq = new Float32Array(joined.length / 4)
		new Uint8Array(iq.buffer).set(joined)
		ch.cls = channelClass(extractChannelFeatures(iq, TAP_RATE_HZ), "unknown", ch.snrDb)
		const digital = ch.cls !== null ? DIGITAL_CLASSES.has(ch.cls) : ch.spec.family === "digital-voice"
		ch.mode = digital ? "digital" : "analog"
		this.enterMode(ch)
		if (ch.mode === "analog") for (const b of ch.pending) this.playAnalog(ch, b)
		ch.pending = []
	}

	private enterMode(ch: ChannelRuntime): void {
		if (ch.mode === "digital") this.startProbe(ch)
		this.emitEvent(ch, true)
	}

	private playAnalog(ch: ChannelRuntime, gated: Buffer): void {
		const pcm = ch.demod.process(f32(gated))
		if (this.selected === ch.spec.key && pcm.length > 0) this.deps.audio.push(Buffer.from(pcm.buffer, pcm.byteOffset, pcm.byteLength))
	}

	private startProbe(ch: ChannelRuntime): void {
		const req: ProbeRequest = {
			jobId: this.record.id,
			priority: this.record.spec.priority,
			sourceId: this.record.spec.sourceId,
			trackId: `mon-${ch.spec.key}`,
			observationId: ch.live?.observationId ?? `mon-${this.record.id}-${ch.spec.key}`,
			discoveryId: ch.spec.discoveryId,
			targetHz: ch.spec.frequencyHz,
			epoch: this.deps.currentEpoch() ?? 0,
			cls: ch.cls ?? "fsk4-12k5",
			protocols: [],
			preRollFromSample: null,
			holdMs: MONITOR_PROBE_HOLD_MS,
			record: this.record.spec.record.voice,
			admission: { kind: "protocol-target", snrDb: ch.snrDb },
		}
		const result = this.deps.probes.request(req)
		if (!("started" in result)) {
			this.log.info({ channel: ch.spec.key, deferred: result.deferred }, "Monitor probe deferred; no digital audio for this transmission")
			return
		}
		const probeId = result.started
		ch.probeId = probeId
		this.deps.probes.follow(probeId, true)
		ch.voiceOff = this.deps.voice.onVoicePcm(probeId, pcm => {
			if (this.selected === ch.spec.key) this.deps.audio.push(pcm)
		})
		ch.callOff = this.deps.voice.onCall(probeId, call => {
			ch.call = {
				encrypted: call.encrypted,
				...(call.talkgroup !== null ? { talkgroup: String(call.talkgroup) } : {}),
				...(call.source !== null ? { source: String(call.source) } : {}),
				...(call.slot !== null ? { slot: call.slot } : {}),
			}
			if (ch.open) this.emitEvent(ch, true)
		})
	}

	private closeTransmission(ch: ChannelRuntime): void {
		const mode = ch.mode
		ch.open = false
		if (ch.probeId !== null) {
			const id = ch.probeId
			ch.probeId = null
			void this.deps.probes.release(id).catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, probeId: id }, "Monitor probe release failed"))
		}
		ch.voiceOff?.()
		ch.callOff?.()
		ch.voiceOff = null
		ch.callOff = null
		ch.pending = []
		ch.demod.reset()
		if (mode !== null) this.emitEvent(ch, false, mode)
		ch.mode = null
		this.reselect()
	}

	private reselect(): void {
		const next = selectAudioChannel(
			this.channels.map(c => ({ key: c.spec.key, priority: c.spec.priority, preferred: c.spec.preferred, open: c.open, locked: c.spec.locked })),
			this.selected,
		)
		if (next !== this.selected) {
			this.selected = next
			this.deps.audio.clear()
		}
		this.deps.audio.setActive(next !== null)
	}

	private emitEvent(ch: ChannelRuntime, active: boolean, mode: MonitorMode | null = ch.mode): void {
		const ev: MonitorEvent = {
			jobId: this.record.id,
			channel: ch.spec.key,
			frequencyHz: ch.spec.frequencyHz,
			mode,
			encrypted: ch.call.encrypted,
			active,
			...(ch.spec.discoveryId !== null ? { discoveryId: ch.spec.discoveryId } : {}),
			...(ch.call.talkgroup !== undefined ? { talkgroup: ch.call.talkgroup } : {}),
			...(ch.call.source !== undefined ? { source: ch.call.source } : {}),
			...(ch.call.slot !== undefined ? { slot: ch.call.slot } : {}),
		}
		this.emit("monitor", ev)
	}
}
```

```ts
	private withMonitorRanges(spec: ScanJobSpec): ScanJobSpec {
		if (!this.tapper || !this.deps.monitorAudio || !this.deps.monitorVoice) {
			throw new ScannerApiError("Listen-scan monitors need the core channelizer (channelizer.enabled) and digital voice", "SCANNER_MONITOR_UNAVAILABLE", 400)
		}
		if (!spec.monitor) throw new ScannerApiError('kind "monitor" needs a monitor section', "SCANNER_MONITOR_EMPTY", 400)
		return { ...spec, ranges: monitorRanges(this.monitorChannels(spec.monitor)) }
	}

	private monitorChannels(monitor: MonitorSpec): ResolvedMonitorChannel[] {
		return resolveMonitorChannels(monitor, id => this.store.get(id), f => this.discoveriesFor(f))
	}

	private discoveriesFor(f: NonNullable<MonitorSpec["fromDiscoveries"]>): Discovery[] {
		const out: Discovery[] = []
		let cursor: string | null = null
		do {
			const page = this.store.list({ ...(f.jobId !== undefined ? { jobId: f.jobId } : {}), minConfidence: f.minConfidence, sort: "frequency", cursor, limit: 500 })
			for (const d of page.items) if (!f.protocols || f.protocols.length === 0 || f.protocols.includes(d.protocol)) out.push(d)
			cursor = page.nextCursor
		} while (cursor !== null && out.length <= MONITOR_MAX_CHANNELS)
		return out
	}
```

```ts
	private createDriver(record: JobRecord, kind: NormalisedJobSpec["kind"] = record.spec.kind): JobDriver {
		switch (kind) {
			case "discover":
				// existing S1 body (new JobRunner(…)) unchanged
			case "identify":
				// Task 35a: identify() wraps this runner in an IdentifyRunner (createIdentifyDriver); jobs.json never holds one.
				return this.createDriver(record, "discover")
			case "monitor": {
				const audio = this.deps.monitorAudio
				const voice = this.deps.monitorVoice
				if (!this.tapper || !audio || !voice) throw new ScannerApiError("Listen-scan monitors need the core channelizer and digital voice", "SCANNER_MONITOR_UNAVAILABLE", 400)
				const runner = new MonitorRunner(
					record,
					{
						channels: this.monitorChannels(record.rawSpec.monitor ?? {}),
						tapper: this.tapper,
						probes: this.probes,
						voice,
						audio: audio.open(record.id),
						releaseAudio: () => audio.close(record.id),
						currentEpoch: () => this.spectrum.engine(record.spec.sourceId)?.currentEpoch().epoch ?? null,
						newTapId: () => probeId(shortId(record.id), "mon", ++this.tapSeq),
						logger: this.deps.logger,
					},
					this.createDriver(record, "discover"),
				)
				runner.on("monitor", (ev: MonitorEvent) => this.emit("monitor", ev))
				return runner
			}
		}
	}
```

### Task 45: Scanner monitor audio stream on the digital voice server

**Spec:** § 10.6 (Audio bullet: one paced 8 kHz s16 mono stream per monitor job, `GET :8082/scanner/<jobId>/stream[.wav]`, `PacedPcmStream`, jitter 400 ms), § 12.4 (Digital voice), § 6.5 (Digital voice: `/stream` stays on configured decoders). **Depends on:** Tasks 30, 44. **Batch:** S3

Design (bounded to this task): `DigitalVoiceService` gains per-job scanner streams (own `AudioClientRegistry` + `PacedPcmStream`, paced only while a client listens, exactly like decoder channels) and a pre-pacing voice tap per decoder (`onVoicePcm`), so a monitor can route a probe's decoded voice into its own stream. The tap delivers exactly the mono PCM the decoder's own stream would play: encrypted audio is dropped by the existing rules before it. `onCall` filters the service's `call` events by decoder id. The two interfaces of Task 44 (`ScannerAudioSink`, `MonitorVoiceSource`) are satisfied structurally.

3. Methods (after `attachDecoder`):

```ts
	/** A paced 8 kHz monitor stream at /scanner/<jobId>/stream[.wav]; starts the HTTP server lazily. */
	addScannerStream(jobId: string): ScannerAudioSink {
		if (!SCANNER_JOB_ID.test(jobId)) throw new WaveKitError(`Invalid scanner job id for a stream: ${jobId}`, "DIGITAL_VOICE_BAD_STREAM_ID")
		let entry = this.scannerStreams.get(jobId)
		if (!entry) {
			const registry = new AudioClientRegistry(this.log, { stallTimeoutMs: this.options.clientStallTimeoutMs, label: "Scanner monitor", stream: STREAM })
			const paced = new PacedPcmStream({ sampleRate: STREAM.rate, tickMs: this.options.tickMs, jitterBufferMs: SCANNER_JITTER_MS, maxBufferMs: Math.max(this.config.maxBufferMs, SCANNER_JITTER_MS) })
			paced.on("audio", (chunk: Buffer) => registry.write(chunk))
			registry.on("client-connected", () => {
				if (this.running) paced.start()
				this.emit("clients-changed")
			})
			registry.on("client-disconnected", () => {
				if (registry.size === 0) paced.stop()
				this.emit("clients-changed")
			})
			entry = { paced, registry }
			this.scannerStreams.set(jobId, entry)
			void this.ensureStarted().catch((err: unknown) => this.log.warn({ err, jobId }, "Digital voice server did not start for a monitor stream"))
		}
		const { paced } = entry
		return {
			push: pcm => {
				if (paced.running) paced.push(pcm)
			},
			setActive: active => paced.setCallActive(active),
			clear: () => paced.clear(),
		}
	}

	removeScannerStream(jobId: string): void {
		const entry = this.scannerStreams.get(jobId)
		if (!entry) return
		this.scannerStreams.delete(jobId)
		entry.paced.stop()
		entry.registry.closeAll("stop", true)
	}

	scannerStreamUrls(jobId: string): { httpUrl: string; wavUrl: string } {
		const base = `/scanner/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}/stream`
		return { httpUrl: this.url(base), wavUrl: this.url(`${base}.wav`) }
	}

	/** Mono voice of a decoder as it would be played (encrypted audio already dropped); for monitors. */
	onVoicePcm(decoderId: string, listener: (pcm: Buffer) => void): () => void {
		let set = this.voiceListeners.get(decoderId)
		if (!set) {
			set = new Set()
			this.voiceListeners.set(decoderId, set)
		}
		const listeners = set
		listeners.add(listener)
		return () => {
			listeners.delete(listener)
			if (listeners.size === 0) this.voiceListeners.delete(decoderId)
		}
	}

	onCall(decoderId: string, listener: (call: DigitalVoiceCall) => void): () => void {
		const handler = (call: DigitalVoiceCall): void => {
			if (call.decoderId === decoderId) listener(call)
		}
		this.on("call", handler)
		return () => {
			this.off("call", handler)
		}
	}
```

4. `ingest`: replace the first early return and the final push. The method becomes:

```ts
	private ingest(channel: VoiceChannel, datagram: Buffer): void {
		channel.datagrams++
		channel.lastDatagramAt = new Date()
		const listeners = this.voiceListeners.get(channel.decoderId)
		const tapped = listeners !== undefined && listeners.size > 0
		if (!this.running || (!channel.paced.running && !tapped)) return
		const call = channel.call
		const encrypted = call?.active === true && call.encrypted
		const slot = call?.slot
		if (encrypted && (channel.channels === 1 || (slot !== 1 && slot !== 2))) {
			// Mono, or the slot is unknown: the whole datagram may be that call.
			channel.encryptedDropped++
			return
		}
		const mono = downmixDsdFmeDatagram(
			datagram,
			channel.channels,
			// Stereo: mute only the encrypted call's slot; a clear call on the
			// other slot keeps playing (dsd-fme zero-fills the muted slot too).
			encrypted && (slot === 1 || slot === 2) ? { muteSlot: slot } : {},
		)
		if (mono && datagram.length % dsdFmeDatagramBytes(channel.channels) !== 0) {
			if (channel.oddSized === 0) {
				this.log.warn(
					{
						decoderId: channel.decoderId,
						bytes: datagram.length,
						expectedMultipleOf: dsdFmeDatagramBytes(channel.channels),
						channels: channel.channels,
					},
					"Unexpected dsd-fme voice datagram size: is the mode or output format overridden?",
				)
			}
			channel.oddSized++
		}
		if (!mono) {
			if (channel.rejected === 0) {
				this.log.warn(
					{
						decoderId: channel.decoderId,
						bytes: datagram.length,
						channels: channel.channels,
					},
					"Rejected a malformed dsd-fme voice datagram",
				)
			}
			channel.rejected++
			return
		}
		if (encrypted) channel.encryptedDropped++
		if (channel.paced.running) channel.paced.push(mono)
		if (tapped) for (const listener of listeners) listener(mono)
	}
```

**Spec:** § 12.1 (`POST /api/scanner/discoveries/:id/listen`: post-channelizer starts or updates a one-channel monitor job), § 12.2 (`scanner:monitor`), § 10.6, § 17 (CLI listen hooks). **Depends on:** Tasks 36, 37, 38, 44, 45. **Batch:** S3

Append to `src/core/scanner/listen.ts` (imports: `type ScanJob` from `@wavekit/api-types`, `type ScanJobSpec` from `./types.js`, `ScannerApiError` from `./errors.js`):

```ts
export const LISTEN_JOB_NAME = "listen"
const LISTEN_CHANNEL_HALF_HZ = 6250
const TERMINAL = new Set(["completed", "cancelled", "failed"])

export interface MonitorListenService {
	listJobs(): ScanJob[]
	cancelJob(id: string): Promise<ScanJob>
	deleteJob(id: string): void
	createJob(spec: ScanJobSpec): Promise<ScanJob>
}

/**
 * Post-channelizer listen (spec § 12.1): one scanner-owned in-window monitor on the discovery;
 * the previous listen monitor is cancelled and deleted. Never retunes: outside the window → 409.
 */
export function monitorListen(service: () => MonitorListenService, streamUrls: (jobId: string) => { httpUrl: string; wavUrl: string }): ListenStrategy {
	return async (discovery, ctx) => {
		const centre = ctx.caps?.centerFreq
		if (centre === undefined || Math.abs(discovery.frequencyHz - centre) + LISTEN_CHANNEL_HALF_HZ > ctx.usableHalfSpanHz) {
			throw new ScannerApiError("The discovery is outside the current window; listen never retunes", "OUT_OF_WINDOW", 409, {
				frequencyHz: discovery.frequencyHz,
				...(centre !== undefined ? { centerHz: centre } : {}),
				usableHalfSpanHz: ctx.usableHalfSpanHz,
			})
		}
		const svc = service()
		for (const job of svc.listJobs()) {
			if (job.name !== LISTEN_JOB_NAME) continue
			if (!TERMINAL.has(job.state)) await svc.cancelJob(job.id)
			svc.deleteJob(job.id)
		}
		const sourceId = discovery.sourceIds[0]
		if (sourceId === undefined) throw new ScannerApiError("The discovery has no source", "SCANNER_DISCOVERY_NO_SOURCE", 409)
		const job = await svc.createJob({
			name: LISTEN_JOB_NAME,
			sourceId,
			kind: "monitor",
			mode: "in-window",
			monitor: { channels: [{ discoveryId: discovery.id }] },
			record: { voice: false, analog: false, data: false },
		})
		return { mode: "monitor", sourceId, frequencyHz: discovery.frequencyHz, jobId: job.id, ...streamUrls(job.id) }
	}
}
```

(A listen monitor records nothing: recording stays with the jobs that found the discovery.)

### Task 47: A0 retune and marker measurement; settle defaults

**Spec:** § 16 A0, § 4.6 (marker and timer modes, `markerTimeoutMs`, `pllSettleMs`, stuck test mode), § 2 (Retune settle, Test mode), § 11, feasibility § 7. **Depends on:** CHECKPOINT S1 (the analysis runs without the core; the defaults update edits Task 14/24/35 code). **Batch:** S4 (hardware, with the user)

Decision (bounded to this task): the script talks to rtl_tcp (local USB) or rtlmux (Pi) **directly, with the WaveKit core stopped**. Going through the core API cannot see the byte stream, and a second raw IQ client next to the core over Wi-Fi doubles the link load and invalidates the run (spec § 2 lessons, memory `user-drives-sdrpp`). So the script refuses to run unless `--confirm-core-stopped` is given, and the procedure stops the core first and re-syncs the tuner afterwards. Latencies are measured in **samples after the command's byte position** (what `settleSamples` must cover beyond the core's own queues), and reported in wall-clock too.

- Create: `scripts/scanner/retune-latency.py`

```python
# tests/unit/scanner/test_retune_latency.py
"""Pure analysis functions of scripts/scanner/retune-latency.py on synthetic cu8 streams."""
import importlib.util
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "scripts" / "scanner" / "retune-latency.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("retune_latency", SCRIPT)
rl = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(rl)

FS = 2_048_000
OFFSET = 100_000.0


def cu8(z):
	x = np.empty(z.size * 2)
	x[0::2] = z.real
	x[1::2] = z.imag
	return np.clip(np.round(x * 127.5 + 127.5), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8).tobytes()


def segment(rng, samples, carrier, start=0):
	z = (rng.normal(size=samples) + 1j * rng.normal(size=samples)) * 0.05
	if carrier:
		n = np.arange(start, start + samples)
		z = z + 0.5 * np.exp(2j * np.pi * OFFSET * n / FS)
	return cu8(z)


class CounterRuns(unittest.TestCase):
	def test_finds_the_exact_run(self):
		rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
		before = bytearray(rng.integers(0, 256, 1000, dtype=np.uint8).tobytes())
		before[-1] = 100
		run = bytes((250 + i) & 0xFF for i in range(700))
		after = bytearray(rng.integers(0, 256, 1000, dtype=np.uint8).tobytes())
		after[0] = 7
		self.assertEqual(rl.counter_runs(bytes(before) + run + bytes(after)), [(1000, 1700)])

	def test_random_bytes_have_no_run(self):
		rng = np.random.default_rng(2)
		self.assertEqual(rl.counter_runs(rng.integers(0, 256, 2_000_000, dtype=np.uint8).tobytes()), [])

	def test_merges_runs_split_by_a_dropped_byte(self):
		self.assertEqual(rl.merge_runs([(10, 400), (401, 900), (2000, 2300)]), [(10, 900), (2000, 2300)])


class TimerMode(unittest.TestCase):
	def test_latency_is_the_first_stable_new_state_frame(self):
		rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
		buf = segment(rng, 30_000, True) + segment(rng, 200_000, False)
		r = rl.analyse_timer(buf, OFFSET, FS, new_present=False)
		self.assertEqual(r["latencySamples"], 15 * rl.FFT_SIZE)

	def test_none_when_the_new_state_never_holds(self):
		rng = np.random.default_rng(4)
		self.assertIsNone(rl.analyse_timer(segment(rng, 200_000, True), OFFSET, FS, new_present=False))


class MarkerMode(unittest.TestCase):
	def counter(self, nbytes, start=0):
		return bytes((start + i) & 0xFF for i in range(nbytes))

	def test_clean_run(self):
		rng = np.random.default_rng(5)
		buf = segment(rng, 20_000, True) + self.counter(61_440) + segment(rng, 300_000, False)
		r = rl.analyse_marker(buf, OFFSET, FS, new_present=False, pll_settle_ms=5)
		self.assertTrue(r["found"])
		self.assertAlmostEqual(r["runMs"], 15.0, places=3)
		self.assertEqual(r["bufferedSamples"], 20_000)
		self.assertTrue(r["clean"])
		self.assertFalse(r["stale"])
		self.assertFalse(r["stuck"])

	def test_stale_samples_after_the_run(self):
		rng = np.random.default_rng(6)
		buf = segment(rng, 20_000, True) + self.counter(61_440) + segment(rng, 50_000, True) + segment(rng, 300_000, False)
		r = rl.analyse_marker(buf, OFFSET, FS, new_present=False, pll_settle_ms=5)
		self.assertTrue(r["found"])
		self.assertFalse(r["clean"])
		self.assertTrue(r["stale"])

	def test_missing_and_stuck(self):
		rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
		self.assertEqual(rl.analyse_marker(segment(rng, 300_000, False), OFFSET, FS, False, 5), {"found": False})
		stuck = rl.analyse_marker(segment(rng, 1000, True) + self.counter(2 * FS), OFFSET, FS, False, 5)
		self.assertTrue(stuck["stuck"])


class Recommendation(unittest.TestCase):
	def test_settle_is_p99_plus_20_percent_rounded_up_to_10_ms(self):
		self.assertEqual(rl.recommend([100.0] * 99 + [400.0], 0, 0, 0)["settleMs"], 130)

	def test_marker_supported_needs_99_percent_runs_and_clean_blocks(self):
		self.assertTrue(rl.recommend([], 199, 198, 200)["markerSupported"])
		self.assertFalse(rl.recommend([], 199, 197, 200)["markerSupported"])
		self.assertFalse(rl.recommend([], 197, 197, 200)["markerSupported"])
		self.assertIsNone(rl.recommend([], 0, 0, 0)["markerSupported"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
	unittest.main()
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the script**

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A0: retune latency and RTL test-mode marker measurement (spec § 16 A0, § 4.6; feasibility § 7).

Run ONLY with the WaveKit core stopped and SDR++ closed: this script must be the single raw IQ
client of the receiver (rtl_tcp on local USB, or rtlmux on the Pi over Wi-Fi). A second raw stream
over Wi-Fi doubles the link load and invalidates the run.

Timer mode: SET_FREQ only. Latency = samples from the command's byte position to the first 1 ms
frame that starts 20 consecutive frames in the new frequency's state (carrier present at A,
absent at B), plus the wall-clock arrival time of that frame.
Marker mode: SET_TEST_MODE 1, SET_FREQ, SET_TEST_MODE 0 in one write. Finds the RTL2832 counter
run (>= 256 bytes with b[n+1] = b[n] + 1 mod 256) and checks that the first 50 ms block after
the run + PLL settle shows only the new state.

Writes (merges) output/scanner-research/metrics-<date>.json under a0.<transport>.
numpy only.
"""

import argparse
import datetime as dt
import json
import math
import socket
import struct
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

SET_FREQ = 0x01
SET_SAMPLE_RATE = 0x02
SET_GAIN_MODE = 0x03
SET_GAIN = 0x04
SET_TEST_MODE = 0x07
SET_AGC_MODE = 0x08

HEADER_BYTES = 12
FFT_SIZE = 2048
MIN_RUN_BYTES = 256
PRESENT_DB = 15.0  # noise-only bins exceed 15 dB over the median with p ≈ 3e-10 per bin
STABLE_FRAMES = 20
BLOCK_MS = 50
STUCK_MS = 500
FRAMES_PER_CHUNK = 256


def command(cmd, value):
	return struct.pack(">BI", cmd, value & 0xFFFFFFFF)


def counter_runs(buf, min_len=MIN_RUN_BYTES):
	"""Maximal byte runs with b[n+1] == b[n] + 1 (mod 256), >= min_len bytes, as [(start, end))."""
	b = np.frombuffer(buf, dtype=np.uint8)
	if b.size < min_len:
		return []
	inc = ((b[1:].astype(np.int16) - b[:-1].astype(np.int16)) & 0xFF) == 1
	padded = np.concatenate(([False], inc, [False]))
	edges = np.flatnonzero(padded[1:] != padded[:-1])
	runs = []
	for s, e in zip(edges[0::2], edges[1::2]):
		if e - s + 1 >= min_len:
			runs.append((int(s), int(e) + 1))
	return runs


def merge_runs(runs, max_gap=2):
	"""A dropped byte splits the counter; runs closer than max_gap bytes are one run."""
	out = []
	for s, e in runs:
		if out and s - out[-1][1] <= max_gap:
			out[-1] = (out[-1][0], e)
		else:
			out.append((s, e))
	return out


def carrier_excess_db(buf, offset_hz, fs):
	"""Per 2048-sample frame: power of the carrier bin (± 1) over the frame's median bin, dB."""
	b = np.frombuffer(buf, dtype=np.uint8)
	frames = (b.size // 2) // FFT_SIZE
	out = np.zeros(frames)
	if frames == 0:
		return out
	window = np.hanning(FFT_SIZE).astype(np.float32)
	k = int(round(offset_hz / fs * FFT_SIZE)) % FFT_SIZE
	cols = [(k - 1) % FFT_SIZE, k, (k + 1) % FFT_SIZE]
	for f0 in range(0, frames, FRAMES_PER_CHUNK):
		f1 = min(frames, f0 + FRAMES_PER_CHUNK)
		x = (b[f0 * FFT_SIZE * 2 : f1 * FFT_SIZE * 2].astype(np.float32) - 127.5) / 127.5
		z = (x[0::2] + 1j * x[1::2]).reshape(f1 - f0, FFT_SIZE) * window
		p = np.abs(np.fft.fft(z, axis=1)) ** 2
		out[f0:f1] = 10 * np.log10(np.maximum(p[:, cols].max(axis=1), 1e-20) / np.maximum(np.median(p, axis=1), 1e-20))
	return out


def first_stable(states, want, stable=STABLE_FRAMES):
	run = 0
	for i, s in enumerate(states):
		run = run + 1 if bool(s) == want else 0
		if run == stable:
			return i - stable + 1
	return None


def analyse_timer(buf, offset_hz, fs, new_present):
	"""buf starts at the command's (IQ-aligned) byte position."""
	states = carrier_excess_db(buf, offset_hz, fs) > PRESENT_DB
	first = first_stable(states, new_present)
	if first is None:
		return None
	leave = next((i for i, s in enumerate(states) if bool(s) == new_present), first)
	return {"latencySamples": first * FFT_SIZE, "transientFrames": first - leave}


def analyse_marker(buf, offset_hz, fs, new_present, pll_settle_ms):
	runs = merge_runs(counter_runs(buf))
	if not runs:
		return {"found": False}
	start, end = runs[0]
	run_ms = (end - start) / 2 / fs * 1000
	stuck = end >= len(buf) - 1 and run_ms >= STUCK_MS
	post = end + (end % 2) + int(round(pll_settle_ms * fs / 1000)) * 2
	block_frames = int(round(BLOCK_MS / 1000 * fs / FFT_SIZE))
	block = buf[post : post + block_frames * FFT_SIZE * 2]
	states = carrier_excess_db(block, offset_hz, fs) > PRESENT_DB
	before = carrier_excess_db(buf[: start - start % 2], offset_hz, fs) > PRESENT_DB
	return {
		"found": True,
		"runBytes": end - start,
		"runMs": run_ms,
		"bufferedSamples": start // 2,
		"fragments": len(counter_runs(buf)),
		"clean": bool(len(states) == block_frames and np.all(states == new_present)),
		"stale": bool(np.any(states != new_present)),
		"newBeforeRun": bool(np.any(before == new_present)) if before.size else False,
		"stuck": bool(stuck),
	}


def pct(values):
	if not values:
		return None
	a = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64)
	return {"p50": float(np.percentile(a, 50)), "p95": float(np.percentile(a, 95)), "p99": float(np.percentile(a, 99)), "max": float(a.max()), "n": int(a.size)}


def recommend(timer_latency_ms, marker_found, marker_clean, marker_n):
	settle = None
	if timer_latency_ms:
		settle = int(math.ceil(float(np.percentile(timer_latency_ms, 99)) * 1.2 / 10.0) * 10)
	supported = None
	if marker_n:
		supported = marker_found / marker_n >= 0.99 and marker_clean / marker_n >= 0.99
	return {"settleMs": settle, "markerSupported": supported}


def arrival(marks, offset):
	for t, total in marks:
		if total >= offset:
			return t
	return marks[-1][0] if marks else float("nan")


class RtlTcp:
	def __init__(self, host, port):
		self.sock = socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=5)
		self.sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_RCVBUF, 1 << 20)
		header = self.read_exact(HEADER_BYTES)
		if header[:4] != b"RTL0":
			raise SystemExit(f"not an rtl_tcp stream (header {header[:4]!r})")
		self.received = 0

	def read_exact(self, n):
		data = b""
		while len(data) < n:
			chunk = self.sock.recv(n - len(data))
			if not chunk:
				raise SystemExit("upstream closed during the header")
			data += chunk
		return data

	def send(self, *cmds):
		self.sock.sendall(b"".join(command(c, v) for c, v in cmds))

	def read_for(self, seconds):
		deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
		chunks, marks = [], []
		while True:
			left = deadline - time.monotonic()
			if left <= 0:
				break
			self.sock.settimeout(left)
			try:
				data = self.sock.recv(1 << 16)
			except socket.timeout:
				break
			if not data:
				raise SystemExit("upstream closed the connection")
			chunks.append(data)
			self.received += len(data)
			marks.append((time.monotonic(), self.received))
		return b"".join(chunks), marks


def measure(client, args, mode):
	offset_a = args.carrier_hz - args.freq_a
	results = []
	for i in range(args.retunes):
		to_b = i % 2 == 0
		target = args.freq_b if to_b else args.freq_a
		new_present = not to_b
		cmd_offset = client.received
		t_cmd = time.monotonic()
		if mode == "marker":
			client.send((SET_TEST_MODE, 1), (SET_FREQ, target), (SET_TEST_MODE, 0))
		else:
			client.send((SET_FREQ, target))
		data, marks = client.read_for(args.dwell_ms / 1000)
		skip = cmd_offset % 2
		buf = data[skip:]
		if mode == "marker":
			r = analyse_marker(buf, offset_a, args.rate, new_present, args.pll_settle_ms)
			if r["found"]:
				r["wallMarkerMs"] = (arrival(marks, cmd_offset + skip + r["bufferedSamples"] * 2) - t_cmd) * 1000
				if r["stuck"]:
					client.send((SET_TEST_MODE, 0))
		else:
			r = analyse_timer(buf, offset_a, args.rate, new_present) or {"detected": False}
			if "latencySamples" in r:
				r["detected"] = True
				r["latencyMs"] = r["latencySamples"] / args.rate * 1000
				r["wallLatencyMs"] = (arrival(marks, cmd_offset + skip + r["latencySamples"] * 2) - t_cmd) * 1000
		results.append(r)
		print(f"{mode} {i + 1}/{args.retunes}: {r}", file=sys.stderr)
	return results


def summarise(timer, marker):
	out = {}
	if timer is not None:
		det = [r for r in timer if r.get("detected")]
		out["timer"] = {
			"n": len(timer),
			"detected": len(det),
			"latencySamples": pct([r["latencySamples"] for r in det]),
			"latencyMs": pct([r["latencyMs"] for r in det]),
			"wallLatencyMs": pct([r["wallLatencyMs"] for r in det]),
			"transientFrames": pct([r["transientFrames"] for r in det]),
		}
	if marker is not None:
		found = [r for r in marker if r["found"]]
		out["marker"] = {
			"n": len(marker),
			"runsFound": len(found),
			"runMs": pct([r["runMs"] for r in found]),
			"bufferedMs": pct([r["bufferedSamples"] / 2048 for r in found]),
			"wallMarkerMs": pct([r["wallMarkerMs"] for r in found]),
			"clean": sum(1 for r in found if r["clean"]),
			"stale": sum(1 for r in found if r["stale"]),
			"fragmented": sum(1 for r in found if r["fragments"] > 1),
			"stuck": sum(1 for r in found if r["stuck"]),
		}
	timer_ms = [r["latencyMs"] for r in (timer or []) if r.get("detected")]
	m = out.get("marker", {"runsFound": 0, "clean": 0, "n": 0})
	out["recommendation"] = recommend(timer_ms, m["runsFound"], m["clean"], m["n"])
	if "marker" in out and out["marker"]["runMs"]:
		out["recommendation"]["markerRunMs"] = int(math.ceil(out["marker"]["runMs"]["p99"]))
	return out


def check_state(client, args, want_present, label):
	client.read_for(1.5)
	before = client.received
	data, _ = client.read_for(1.0)
	data = data[before % 2 :]
	states = carrier_excess_db(data, args.carrier_hz - args.freq_a, args.rate) > PRESENT_DB
	frac = float(np.mean(states)) if states.size else 0.0
	if (want_present and frac < 0.95) or (not want_present and frac > 0.01):
		raise SystemExit(f"{label}: carrier present in {frac:.1%} of frames; pick a steadier carrier or an emptier B")


def main(argv=None):
	p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
	p.add_argument("--host", required=True)
	p.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=1234)
	p.add_argument("--transport", choices=["local", "network"], required=True)
	p.add_argument("--freq-a", type=int, required=True, help="centre (Hz) at which the carrier is visible")
	p.add_argument("--freq-b", type=int, required=True, help="centre (Hz) of an empty window")
	p.add_argument("--carrier-hz", type=int, required=True, help="absolute carrier frequency (Hz)")
	p.add_argument("--rate", type=int, default=2_048_000)
	p.add_argument("--gain-tenths", type=int, required=True, help="manual gain in tenths of dB (AGC off)")
	p.add_argument("--retunes", type=int, default=200)
	p.add_argument("--dwell-ms", type=int, default=None, help="read time per retune (default 800 local, 2000 network)")
	p.add_argument("--modes", default="timer,marker")
	p.add_argument("--pll-settle-ms", type=float, default=5.0)
	p.add_argument("--out", default=f"output/scanner-research/metrics-{dt.date.today().isoformat()}.json")
	p.add_argument("--confirm-core-stopped", action="store_true", help="required: the WaveKit core and SDR++ are not connected to this receiver")
	args = p.parse_args(argv)
	if not args.confirm_core_stopped:
		raise SystemExit("refusing to run: stop the WaveKit core (and SDR++) first, then pass --confirm-core-stopped")
	if args.dwell_ms is None:
		args.dwell_ms = 800 if args.transport == "local" else 2000
	offset_a = args.carrier_hz - args.freq_a
	if not (10_000 <= abs(offset_a) <= 0.4 * args.rate):
		raise SystemExit("the carrier must sit 10 kHz .. 0.4 x rate away from freq-a's centre")
	if abs(args.carrier_hz - args.freq_b) <= args.rate / 2 + 50_000:
		raise SystemExit("freq-b's window must not contain the carrier")
	modes = [m.strip() for m in args.modes.split(",") if m.strip()]
	client = RtlTcp(args.host, args.port)
	try:
		client.send((SET_TEST_MODE, 0), (SET_SAMPLE_RATE, args.rate), (SET_GAIN_MODE, 1), (SET_GAIN, args.gain_tenths), (SET_AGC_MODE, 0), (SET_FREQ, args.freq_a))
		check_state(client, args, True, "at A")
		client.send((SET_FREQ, args.freq_b))
		check_state(client, args, False, "at B")
		client.send((SET_FREQ, args.freq_a))
		client.read_for(1.5)
		timer = measure(client, args, "timer") if "timer" in modes else None
		marker = measure(client, args, "marker") if "marker" in modes else None
	finally:
		client.send((SET_TEST_MODE, 0))
		client.sock.close()
	report = {
		"measuredAt": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
		"host": args.host,
		"port": args.port,
		"sampleRateHz": args.rate,
		"gainTenthsDb": args.gain_tenths,
		"agc": False,
		"freqAHz": args.freq_a,
		"freqBHz": args.freq_b,
		"carrierHz": args.carrier_hz,
		"retunes": args.retunes,
		"dwellMs": args.dwell_ms,
		"pllSettleMs": args.pll_settle_ms,
		**summarise(timer, marker),
	}
	out = Path(args.out)
	doc = json.loads(out.read_text()) if out.exists() else {}
	doc.setdefault("a0", {})[args.transport] = report
	out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
	out.write_text(json.dumps(doc, indent=2) + "\n")
	print(json.dumps(report["recommendation"]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
	main()
```

`bufferedMs` divides by 2048 samples/ms, which is exact only at 2.048 Msps; use `args.rate / 1000` if another rate is measured (pass it into `summarise`).

Preconditions (spec § 16): SDR++ closed; no other raw client; manual gain recorded; AGC off.   --carrier-hz <carrier> --freq-a $((<carrier> - 300000)) --freq-b $((<carrier> + 3000000)) --gain-tenths 490

```bash
python3 scripts/scanner/retune-latency.py --confirm-core-stopped --transport network --host 192.168.86.23 --port 1234 \
```

`--gain-tenths 490` is the operating manual gain (49.0 dB, AGC off); if the carrier clips at that gain (IQ bytes pinned at 0/255), lower it in 10 dB steps and keep the noise IQ std ≫ 1 LSB (§ 16); record the value used in the metrics file. Never use 0 (it leaves the noise near 1 LSB). Use the Pi's rtlmux port from `docs/HANDOFF-2026-10-10.md` / the local config if it is not 1234. After restarting the core (with `WAVEKIT_APP_CONFIG` as above, matching the handoff's recreate command), re-sync the tuner exactly as the handoff lists (POST `/api/tuner/pi-iq/frequency`, `sample-rate`, `gain-mode`, `gain`, `agc`).
```ts
// src/core/scanner/plan/measured.ts
/**
 * A0 results (spec § 16 A0) per transport: timer-mode settle (p99 + 20 %), marker support and the
 * counter-run length. Copied by hand from output/scanner-research/metrics-<date>.json (Task 47);
 * null = unmeasured. The service feeds them to the preview (PreviewMeasured) at start.
 */
import type { PreviewMeasured } from "./plan-preview.js"

export interface A0Measurement {
	measuredAt: string | null
	settleMs: { local: number | null; network: number | null }
	markerSupported: { local: boolean | null; network: boolean | null }
	markerRunMs: { local: number | null; network: number | null }
}

export const A0_MEASURED: A0Measurement = {
	measuredAt: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ", // report.measuredAt of the later of the two runs
	settleMs: { local: 0, network: 0 }, // recommendation.settleMs per transport
	markerSupported: { local: null, network: null }, // recommendation.markerSupported per transport
	markerRunMs: { local: null, network: null }, // recommendation.markerRunMs per transport
}

export function previewMeasuredFor(a0: A0Measurement, sources: readonly { id: string; link: "local" | "network" }[]): Pick<PreviewMeasured, "settleMs" | "markerSupported"> {
	return {
		settleMs: { local: a0.settleMs.local, network: a0.settleMs.network },
		markerSupported: Object.fromEntries(sources.map(s => [s.id, a0.markerSupported[s.link]])),
	}
}
```

### Task 48: Captures C1–C3, C5 and the C4 terminator soak

**Spec:** § 15 (C1–C5, privacy, metrics), § 4.5 (k table, CFAR, FA target), § 16 preconditions, § 8 Privacy. **Depends on:** CHECKPOINT S3 (C4 needs the running core with the scanner; C1–C3/C5 need only the tools here), channelizer Tasks 1–3 (manifest v2, `download.sh`). **Batch:** S4 (hardware, with the user)

Decisions (bounded to this task):
- C1–C3 are 2.048 Msps cu8 from the **local dongle on the Mac** (`rtl_sdr`, core stopped; the Pi is never retuned for captures, delta § 7), 30 s each, trimmed with `dd` (even byte offsets), stored privately and fetched by `download.sh` with sha256, exactly like the channelizer's own captures (channelizer Task 7). Disk: three files ≈ 370 MB; the untrimmed originals are deleted after trimming.
- C5 (APRS) is captured **already narrowband**: `rtl_sdr` at 1.536 Msps pipes into `scripts/scanner/capture-tools.py narrowband`, which mixes 144.800 MHz to DC, decimates by 32 to 48 kHz and keeps only bursts (± 0.5 s) up to 30 s, so nothing wide is stored (spec § 15: "a narrowband 48 kHz excerpt only").
- Manifest v2 gains a role `scanner-classifier` with a `scanner.truth[]` block (time window, RF frequency, protocol, CTCSS, identity) that Task 49 validates against. The decoder harness never runs these entries.
- C4 stores no IQ (disk ≈ 95 % full): `scripts/scanner/fa-soak.mjs` drives the running core's REST/WS on a 50 Ω terminator: an operator in-window job, five pinned `thresholdDb` steps × 2 min, counting the job's `scanner:activity` openings per MHz of covered span per minute and the surfaced discoveries. The k recommendation is the smallest step meeting `faTargetPerMhzMin` (1.0). `scanner:activity` is rate-limited to 10/s (newest wins), which only matters far above the target, so low-k steps can under-count; the recommendation never comes from a step that hit the limit (flagged).

```python
# tests/unit/scanner/test_capture_tools.py
"""scripts/scanner/capture-tools.py: burst times and the streaming narrowband excerpt."""
import importlib.util
import io
import unittest
import wave
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "scripts" / "scanner" / "capture-tools.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("capture_tools", SCRIPT)
ct = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(ct)


def cu8(z):
	x = np.empty(z.size * 2)
	x[0::2] = z.real
	x[1::2] = z.imag
	return np.clip(np.round(x * 127.5 + 127.5), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8).tobytes()


class Bursts(unittest.TestCase):
	def test_finds_a_burst_at_the_channel_offset_only(self):
		fs = 2_048_000
		rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
		n = 3 * fs
		z = (rng.normal(size=n) + 1j * rng.normal(size=n)) * 0.02
		t = np.arange(n)
		on = (t >= fs) & (t < 2 * fs)
		z[on] += 0.3 * np.exp(2j * np.pi * 6000 * t[on] / fs)
		z += 0.3 * np.exp(2j * np.pi * -400_000 * t / fs)  # a continuous neighbour elsewhere
		out = ct.burst_times(ct.cu8_to_complex(cu8(z)), fs, 6000)
		self.assertEqual(len(out), 1)
		self.assertAlmostEqual(out[0]["startS"], 1.0, delta=0.02)
		self.assertAlmostEqual(out[0]["endS"], 2.0, delta=0.02)


class Narrowband(unittest.TestCase):
	def test_mixes_decimates_and_keeps_bursts(self):
		fs = 1_536_000
		rng = np.random.default_rng(2)
		n = 4 * fs
		t = np.arange(n)
		z = (rng.normal(size=n) + 1j * rng.normal(size=n)) * 0.01
		on = (t >= int(1.5 * fs)) & (t < int(2.5 * fs))
		z[on] += 0.3 * np.exp(2j * np.pi * (10_000 + 1_000) * t[on] / fs)
		out = io.BytesIO()
		kept = ct.narrowband(io.BytesIO(cu8(z)), out, fs, 10_000, keep_bursts=True, pre_s=0.5, post_s=0.5, max_seconds=30, timeout_s=60)
		self.assertAlmostEqual(kept, 2.0, delta=0.1)
		out.seek(0)
		with wave.open(out) as w:
			self.assertEqual((w.getnchannels(), w.getsampwidth(), w.getframerate()), (2, 2, 48_000))
			raw = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float64) / 32767
		y = raw[0::2] + 1j * raw[1::2]
		mid = y[int(0.75 * 48_000) : int(1.25 * 48_000)]
		spectrum = np.abs(np.fft.fft(mid)) ** 2
		peak_hz = np.fft.fftfreq(mid.size, 1 / 48_000)[np.argmax(spectrum)]
		self.assertAlmostEqual(peak_hz, 1_000, delta=5)

	def test_needs_a_32x_rate(self):
		with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
			ct.narrowband(io.BytesIO(b""), io.BytesIO(), 2_048_000, 0, False, 0.5, 0.5, 30, 60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
	unittest.main()
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the capture tools**

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Scanner capture helpers (spec § 15). numpy only.

  bursts <file.cu8> --rate 2048000 --offset <Hz>     → JSON on/off times of one channel (10 ms blocks)
  narrowband --rate 1536000 --offset <Hz> --out x.wav [--keep-bursts] < cu8 on stdin
                                                     → 48 kHz 2-channel s16 IQ WAV of that channel

Capture with the WaveKit core stopped (never a second raw IQ client over Wi-Fi next to it).
"""
import argparse
import collections
import json
import sys
import time
import wave

import numpy as np

BLOCK_S = 0.01
OUT_RATE = 48_000


def lowpass(taps, cutoff, fs):
	t = np.arange(taps) - (taps - 1) / 2
	h = np.sinc(2 * cutoff / fs * t) * np.blackman(taps)
	return (h / h.sum()).astype(np.complex64)


def cu8_to_complex(buf):
	x = (np.frombuffer(buf, dtype=np.uint8).astype(np.float32) - 127.5) / 127.5
	return (x[0::2] + 1j * x[1::2]).astype(np.complex64)


def burst_times(z, fs, offset_hz, bw_hz=12_500, threshold_db=10.0, min_s=0.05):
	"""Channel power per 10 ms block over the capture's median; runs above threshold_db."""
	n = int(round(fs * BLOCK_S))
	blocks = z.size // n
	size = 1 << int(np.ceil(np.log2(n)))
	sel = np.abs(np.fft.fftfreq(size, 1 / fs) - offset_hz) <= bw_hz / 2
	window = np.hanning(n)
	p = np.empty(blocks)
	for b in range(blocks):
		spectrum = np.fft.fft(z[b * n : (b + 1) * n] * window, size)
		p[b] = np.sum(np.abs(spectrum[sel]) ** 2)
	db = 10 * np.log10(np.maximum(p, 1e-20) / max(float(np.median(p)), 1e-20))
	out, start = [], None
	for i, on in enumerate(np.append(db > threshold_db, False)):
		if on and start is None:
			start = i
		elif not on and start is not None:
			if (i - start) * BLOCK_S >= min_s:
				out.append({"startS": round(start * BLOCK_S, 3), "endS": round(i * BLOCK_S, 3), "peakDb": round(float(db[start:i].max()), 1)})
			start = None
	return out


class Decimator:
	"""Mix offset → DC, then ÷8 (80 kHz FIR) and ÷4 (20 kHz FIR): 1.536 Msps → 48 kHz, streaming."""

	def __init__(self, fs, offset_hz):
		if fs != 32 * OUT_RATE:
			raise SystemExit("narrowband needs --rate 1536000 (= 32 x 48 kHz)")
		self.step = -2 * np.pi * offset_hz / fs
		self.phase = 0.0
		self.h1 = lowpass(63, 80_000, fs)
		self.h2 = lowpass(127, 20_000, fs / 8)
		self.c1 = np.zeros(62, np.complex64)
		self.c2 = np.zeros(126, np.complex64)

	def process(self, z):
		"""z.size must be a multiple of 32 (the caller reads whole blocks)."""
		mixed = z * np.exp(1j * (self.phase + self.step * np.arange(z.size))).astype(np.complex64)
		self.phase = float((self.phase + self.step * z.size) % (2 * np.pi))
		x1 = np.concatenate([self.c1, mixed])
		self.c1 = x1[-62:]
		y1 = np.convolve(x1, self.h1, "valid")[::8]
		x2 = np.concatenate([self.c2, y1])
		self.c2 = x2[-126:]
		return np.convolve(x2, self.h2, "valid")[::4]


def narrowband(src, dst, fs, offset_hz, keep_bursts, pre_s, post_s, max_seconds, timeout_s, threshold_db=10.0):
	"""Returns the seconds written. src yields cu8 bytes; dst receives a WAV."""
	dec = Decimator(fs, offset_hz)
	block_in = 32 * int(OUT_RATE * BLOCK_S) * 2  # bytes of cu8 per 10 ms of output
	n_out = int(OUT_RATE * BLOCK_S)
	pre = collections.deque(maxlen=int(round(pre_s / BLOCK_S)))
	history = collections.deque(maxlen=500)  # 5 s of block powers for the floor
	post_left = 0
	written = 0
	started = time.monotonic()
	pending = b""
	with wave.open(dst, "wb") as w:
		w.setnchannels(2)
		w.setsampwidth(2)
		w.setframerate(OUT_RATE)

		def emit(y):
			nonlocal written
			pcm = np.empty(y.size * 2, np.int16)
			pcm[0::2] = np.clip(np.round(y.real * 32767), -32768, 32767)
			pcm[1::2] = np.clip(np.round(y.imag * 32767), -32768, 32767)
			w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
			written += y.size

		while written < max_seconds * OUT_RATE and time.monotonic() - started < timeout_s:
			chunk = src.read(block_in * 100)
			if not chunk:
				break
			pending += chunk
			usable = len(pending) - len(pending) % block_in
			if usable == 0:
				continue
			y = dec.process(cu8_to_complex(pending[:usable]))
			pending = pending[usable:]
			for b in range(y.size // n_out):
				blk = y[b * n_out : (b + 1) * n_out]
				if not keep_bursts:
					emit(blk)
					continue
				power = float(np.mean(np.abs(blk) ** 2))
				floor = float(np.median(history)) if history else power
				active = 10 * np.log10(max(power, 1e-20) / max(floor, 1e-20)) > threshold_db
				if not active:
					history.append(power)
				if active:
					while pre:
						emit(pre.popleft())
					emit(blk)
					post_left = int(round(post_s / BLOCK_S))
				elif post_left > 0:
					emit(blk)
					post_left -= 1
				else:
					pre.append(blk)
				if written >= max_seconds * OUT_RATE:
					break
	return written / OUT_RATE


def main(argv=None):
	p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
	sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
	b = sub.add_parser("bursts")
	b.add_argument("file")
	b.add_argument("--rate", type=int, default=2_048_000)
	b.add_argument("--offset", type=float, required=True)
	b.add_argument("--bw", type=float, default=12_500)
	b.add_argument("--threshold-db", type=float, default=10.0)
	nb = sub.add_parser("narrowband")
	nb.add_argument("--rate", type=int, default=1_536_000)
	nb.add_argument("--offset", type=float, required=True)
	nb.add_argument("--out", required=True)
	nb.add_argument("--keep-bursts", action="store_true")
	nb.add_argument("--pre", type=float, default=0.5)
	nb.add_argument("--post", type=float, default=0.5)
	nb.add_argument("--max-seconds", type=float, default=30)
	nb.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=1800)
	args = p.parse_args(argv)
	if args.cmd == "bursts":
		with open(args.file, "rb") as f:
			z = cu8_to_complex(f.read())
		print(json.dumps(burst_times(z, args.rate, args.offset, args.bw, args.threshold_db), indent=1))
	else:
		with open(args.out, "wb") as out:
			kept = narrowband(sys.stdin.buffer, out, args.rate, args.offset, args.keep_bursts, args.pre, args.post, args.max_seconds, args.timeout)
		print(json.dumps({"out": args.out, "seconds": round(kept, 2)}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
	main()
```

The narrowband test's tone is 1 kHz above the mixed offset, the burst lasts 1 s, pre/post 0.5 s each: 2 s kept. `--keep-bursts` holds the floor at the median of non-burst blocks, so a long burst never raises it.

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the soak script**

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// scripts/scanner/fa-soak.mjs
// C4 (spec § 15, § 4.5): false-alarm calibration of k on a 50 Ω terminator through the RUNNING core.
// Stores no IQ. Usage:
//   node scripts/scanner/fa-soak.mjs run --api http://localhost:9000 --source pi-iq --confirm-terminator
//        [--steps 3.5,4,4.5,5,5.5] [--step-min 2] [--settle-s 5] [--target 1.0] [--table-k 4.0]
//        [--out output/scanner-research/metrics-<date>.json]
//   node scripts/scanner/fa-soak.mjs analyse <c4.json>
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs"
import { dirname } from "node:path"

const ACTIVITY_LIMIT_PER_S = 10

function parseArgs(argv) {
	const [cmd, ...rest] = argv
	const opts = { _: [] }
	for (let i = 0; i < rest.length; i++) {
		const a = rest[i]
		if (!a.startsWith("--")) opts._.push(a)
		else if (i + 1 < rest.length && !rest[i + 1].startsWith("--")) opts[a.slice(2)] = rest[++i]
		else opts[a.slice(2)] = true
	}
	return { cmd, opts }
}

export function analyse(data) {
	const steps = data.steps.map(s => ({ ...s, ratePerMhzMin: s.opens / data.mhz / s.minutes }))
	const ok = steps.filter(s => !s.limited && s.ratePerMhzMin <= data.target).sort((a, b) => a.k - b.k)
	const k = ok.length > 0 ? ok[0].k : null
	return { ...data, steps, recommendation: { k, deltaDb: k === null ? null : Math.round((k - data.tableK) * 10) / 10, met: k !== null } }
}

async function json(url, init) {
	const res = await fetch(url, init)
	const body = await res.text()
	if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${init?.method ?? "GET"} ${url}: ${res.status} ${body}`)
	return body ? JSON.parse(body) : null
}

const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms))

async function run(o) {
	if (!o["confirm-terminator"]) {
		process.stderr.write("refusing to run: replace the antenna with a 50 Ω terminator at the operating gain, then pass --confirm-terminator\n")
		process.exit(2)
	}
	const api = o.api ?? "http://localhost:9000"
	const source = o.source
	if (!source) throw new Error("--source is required")
	const steps = String(o.steps ?? "3.5,4,4.5,5,5.5").split(",").map(Number)
	const stepMin = Number(o["step-min"] ?? 2)
	const settleS = Number(o["settle-s"] ?? 5)
	const target = Number(o.target ?? 1.0)
	const tableK = Number(o["table-k"] ?? 4.0)
	const sources = await json(`${api}/api/sources`)
	const src = sources.find(s => s.id === source)
	if (!src?.caps?.centerFreq) throw new Error(`source ${source} has no centre frequency`)
	if (src.rateMismatch) throw new Error(`rate truth fails on ${source}: ${JSON.stringify(src.rateMismatch)}`)
	const tuner = await json(`${api}/api/tuner/${encodeURIComponent(source)}`)
	const half = (src.caps.sampleRate * 0.8) / 2 - 10_000
	const created = await json(`${api}/api/scanner/jobs`, {
		method: "POST",
		headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
		body: JSON.stringify({
			name: "c4-terminator-soak",
			sourceId: source,
			mode: "in-window",
			ranges: [{ startHz: src.caps.centerFreq - half, endHz: src.caps.centerFreq + half }],
			thresholdDb: steps[0],
			hold: { policy: "never" },
			record: { voice: false, analog: false, data: false },
			evidence: { psd: false, iq: false },
		}),
	})
	const jobId = created.id
	const detail = await json(`${api}/api/scanner/jobs/${jobId}`)
	const covered = detail.plan.hops[0].covered
	const excluded = (detail.plan.hops[0].excluded ?? []).reduce((s, r) => s + (r.endHz - r.startHz), 0)
	const mhz = (covered.endHz - covered.startHz - excluded) / 1e6
	const opens = new Map()
	let perSecond = new Map()
	const ws = new WebSocket(`${api.replace(/^http/, "ws")}/ws`)
	await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		ws.addEventListener("open", resolve, { once: true })
		ws.addEventListener("error", reject, { once: true })
	})
	ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: "subscribe", channels: ["scanner"] }))
	ws.addEventListener("message", ev => {
		const msg = JSON.parse(String(ev.data))
		if (msg.type !== "scanner:activity") return
		const second = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
		perSecond.set(second, (perSecond.get(second) ?? 0) + 1)
		const d = msg.data
		if (d.active && d.jobIds.includes(jobId) && !opens.has(d.observationId)) opens.set(d.observationId, Date.now())
	})
	const results = []
	try {
		for (const k of steps) {
			await json(`${api}/api/scanner/jobs/${jobId}`, { method: "PATCH", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ thresholdDb: k }) })
			await sleep(settleS * 1000)
			const from = Date.now()
			perSecond = new Map()
			await sleep(stepMin * 60_000)
			const to = Date.now()
			const count = [...opens.values()].filter(t => t >= from && t < to).length
			const limited = [...perSecond.values()].some(n => n >= ACTIVITY_LIMIT_PER_S)
			const surfaced = (await json(`${api}/api/scanner/discoveries?jobId=${jobId}&since=${new Date(from).toISOString()}&limit=500`)).items.length
			results.push({ k, minutes: (to - from) / 60_000, opens: count, surfaced, limited })
			process.stderr.write(`k=${k}: ${count} openings, ${surfaced} surfaced${limited ? " (rate-limited)" : ""}\n`)
		}
	} finally {
		ws.close()
		await json(`${api}/api/scanner/jobs/${jobId}/cancel`, { method: "POST" }).catch(() => null)
	}
	const status = await json(`${api}/api/scanner`)
	const c4 = analyse({
		measuredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
		sourceId: source,
		tuner: { frequencyHz: tuner.frequency, gainMode: tuner.gainMode, gainTenthsDb: tuner.gain, agc: tuner.agcMode, controlMode: tuner.controlMode },
		mhz,
		target,
		tableK,
		steps: results,
		cfar: status.engines?.find?.(e => e.sourceId === source) ?? null,
	})
	const out = o.out ?? `output/scanner-research/metrics-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`
	const doc = existsSync(out) ? JSON.parse(readFileSync(out, "utf8")) : {}
	doc.c4 = c4
	mkdirSync(dirname(out), { recursive: true })
	writeFileSync(out, `${JSON.stringify(doc, null, 2)}\n`)
	process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(c4.recommendation)}\n`)
}

const { cmd, opts } = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2))
if (cmd === "analyse") {
	process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(analyse(JSON.parse(readFileSync(opts._[0], "utf8"))))}\n`)
} else if (cmd === "run") {
	run(opts).catch(err => {
		process.stderr.write(`${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}\n`)
		process.exit(1)
	})
} else {
	process.stderr.write("usage: fa-soak.mjs run … | analyse <c4.json>\n")
	process.exit(2)
}
```

`GET /api/tuner/:sourceId` returns `TunerState` (`packages/api-types/src/tuner.ts`: `frequency`, `gainMode`, `gain` in 0.1 dB, `agcMode`, `controlMode`); the soak records them so the k it recommends is tied to the gain it was measured at.

### Task 49: Classifier threshold validation on C1–C3, C5, C6; channel tier default on

**Spec:** § 6.3 (thresholds unvalidated until § 15 fixtures; default-on only after), § 15 (C1–C3, C5, C6; missing protocols stay unvalidated), § 6.2 (ISM bursts), § 7.3. **Depends on:** Tasks 41, 48. **Batch:** S4 (data from the user's captures; runs on the Mac)

Decision (bounded to this task): validation is an env-gated integration test over the manifest's `scanner-classifier` entries (present only where `download.sh` fetched the private files) plus a sample of the public rtl_433 corpus (C6) through the spectral pipeline. Pass criteria (per truth window, 500 ms from `startS + 0.2 s`, the channel tier's `minMs`):
- SNR (channel power over a quiet 300 ms of the same channel) ≥ the gate: the channel class is correct (`dmr` → `fsk4-12k5` or `tdma-ms`; `analog-fm` → `analog-fm`; `aprs` → `afsk-fm`), CTCSS equals the truth tone, no CTCSS is invented;
- SNR below the gate (C3 weak): the spectral classification comes back unchanged (never a wrong class);
- C6: ≥ 80 % of the sampled rtl_433 files yield a track classified `ook-burst`, none `tdma-ms`.
Only after every criterion holds is `scanner.channelTier.enabled` flipped to `true`. P25, NXDN, D-STAR, dPMR and a DMR repeater have no capture: their channel classes keep top scores < 0.5 (Task 41), so they stay `candidate` and dsd-fme decides (§ 15).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the validation test**

Add to `tests/mocks/scanner/wav-iq.ts`:

```ts
/** cu8 file excerpt [fromS, toS) as interleaved float IQ (2.048 Msps captures). */
export function readCu8Iq(path: string, fs: number, fromS: number, toS: number): WavIq {
	const buf = readFileSync(path)
	const first = Math.max(0, Math.floor(fromS * fs)) * 2
	const last = Math.min(buf.length - (buf.length % 2), Math.floor(toS * fs) * 2)
	const iq = new Float32Array(Math.max(0, last - first))
	for (let i = 0; i < iq.length; i++) iq[i] = (buf[first + i]! - 127.5) / 127.5
	return { fs, iq }
}
```

```ts
// tests/integration/scanner-classifier-fixtures.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest"
/**
 * Classifier validation on the private scanner captures (C1–C3, C5) and the public rtl_433 corpus
 * (C6), spec § 15. Env-gated on presence: ./fixtures/download.sh --rtl433 <ids> first.
 */
import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs"
import { join } from "node:path"
import { CHANNEL_TIER_MIN_SNR_DB, classifyChannelTier, extractChannelFeatures } from "../../src/core/scanner/classify/channel-features.js"
import { classifySpectral } from "../../src/core/scanner/classify/classifier.js"
import { SpectrumPipeline } from "../../src/core/spectrum/pipeline.js"
import type { Classification, ScannerClass } from "../../src/core/scanner/types.js"
import type { PipelineConfig, TrackSnapshot } from "../../src/core/spectrum/types.js"
import { loadManifest, type Fixture } from "./fixtures/manifest.js"
import { gaussianNoise, mulberry32, packCu8 } from "../mocks/scanner/signals.js"
import { channelise, readCu8Iq, readWavIq, type WavIq } from "../mocks/scanner/wav-iq.js"

const RAW = process.env["WAVEKIT_FIXTURES_DIR"] ?? "fixtures"
const EXPECTED: Record<string, readonly ScannerClass[]> = { dmr: ["fsk4-12k5", "tdma-ms"], "analog-fm": ["analog-fm"], aprs: ["afsk-fm"] }
const WINDOW_S = 0.5
const ONSET_S = 0.2
const spectral: Classification = { class: "unknown", hypotheses: [], tier: "spectral" }

function excerpt(f: Fixture, fromS: number, toS: number): WavIq {
	const path = join(RAW, f.file)
	return f.format === "wav" ? sliceWav(readWavIq(path, toS), fromS) : readCu8Iq(path, f.sample_rate, fromS, toS)
}
function sliceWav(w: WavIq, fromS: number): WavIq {
	return { fs: w.fs, iq: w.iq.subarray(Math.floor(fromS * w.fs) * 2) }
}
function power(iq: Float32Array): number {
	let p = 0
	for (let i = 0; i < iq.length; i += 2) p += iq[i]! ** 2 + iq[i + 1]! ** 2
	return p / (iq.length / 2)
}
/** First 300 ms of the file outside every truth window (± 0.2 s). */
function quietStart(f: Fixture): number | null {
	const windows = (f.scanner?.truth ?? []).map(t => [t.startS - 0.2, t.endS + 0.2] as const).sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])
	let cursor = 0
	for (const [s, e] of windows) {
		if (s - cursor >= 0.3) return cursor
		cursor = Math.max(cursor, e)
	}
	return f.duration_s - cursor >= 0.3 ? cursor : null
}

const fixtures = existsSync("fixtures/manifest.yaml")
	? loadManifest().fixtures.filter(f => f.role === "scanner-classifier" && existsSync(join(RAW, f.file)))
	: []

describe.skipIf(fixtures.length === 0)("channel tier on own captures (spec § 15 C1–C3, C5)", () => {
	for (const f of fixtures) {
		describe(f.id, () => {
			const quiet = quietStart(f)
			f.scanner!.truth.forEach((t, i) => {
				it(`window ${i}: ${t.protocol} at ${t.frequencyHz} Hz [${t.startS}–${t.endS} s]`, () => {
					expect(quiet, "no 300 ms quiet span for the noise reference").not.toBeNull()
					const offset = t.frequencyHz - (f.center_hz ?? t.frequencyHz)
					const from = t.startS + ONSET_S
					const to = Math.min(t.endS, from + WINDOW_S)
					const tap = channelise(excerpt(f, from, to), offset)
					const noise = channelise(excerpt(f, quiet!, quiet! + 0.3), offset)
					const snrDb = 10 * Math.log10(Math.max(power(tap) / power(noise) - 1, 1e-3))
					const features = extractChannelFeatures(tap, 48_000)
					const out = classifyChannelTier(spectral, features, { priors: {}, protocols: [], snrDb })
					const detail = JSON.stringify({ snrDb: Math.round(snrDb * 10) / 10, features })
					const gate = t.protocol === "dmr" || t.protocol === "analog-fm" ? CHANNEL_TIER_MIN_SNR_DB.multiLevel : CHANNEL_TIER_MIN_SNR_DB.twoLevel
					if (snrDb < gate && t.protocol !== "aprs") {
						expect(out, detail).toBe(spectral)
						return
					}
					expect(EXPECTED[t.protocol] ?? [], detail).toContain(out.class)
					if (t.ctcssHz !== undefined) expect(out.metadata?.ctcssHz, detail).toBe(t.ctcssHz)
					else expect(out.metadata?.ctcssHz, detail).toBeUndefined()
				}, 30_000)
			})
		})
	}
})

const CORPUS = join(RAW, "raw/rtl_433_tests/tests")
const corpusFiles = existsSync(CORPUS)
	? (readdirSync(CORPUS, { recursive: true }) as string[]).filter(p => /433\.92M_250k\.cu8$/.test(p)).sort().slice(0, 20)
	: []

function pipelineFor(): PipelineConfig {
	return {
		sourceId: "c6",
		format: "U8_IQ",
		sampleRateHz: 250_000,
		fftSize: 256,
		integrationMs: 50,
		usableFraction: 0.8,
		dcGuardHz: 1500,
		ppmMargin: 2,
		hysteresisDb: 3,
		clipFraction: 0.001,
		minSurfaceBlocks: 2,
		thresholdDb: null,
		faTargetPerMhzMin: 1,
		spectrumBins: 512,
		trackHangMs: 500,
		maxTracks: 512,
		maxTrackMs: 120_000,
	}
}

describe.skipIf(corpusFiles.length === 0)("spectral tier on the rtl_433 corpus (spec § 15 C6)", () => {
	it("classifies ≥ 80 % of sampled ISM files as ook-burst and none as tdma-ms", () => {
		let ook = 0
		for (const [n, file] of corpusFiles.entries()) {
			const bytes = readFileSync(join(CORPUS, file))
			let mad = 0
			const head = Math.min(bytes.length, 20_000)
			for (let i = 0; i < head; i++) mad += Math.abs(bytes[i]! - 127.5)
			const sigma = Math.max(1, (mad / head) * 1.2533) / 127.5 // mean |x| → σ for a Gaussian component
			const rng = mulberry32(600 + n)
			const pad = (seconds: number) => {
				const z = gaussianNoise(rng, Math.round(250_000 * seconds), sigma * Math.SQRT2)
				return packCu8(z.re, z.im)
			}
			const pipeline = new SpectrumPipeline(pipelineFor(), { now: () => 0 })
			pipeline.handle({ kind: "masks", exclusions: [], cfarRanges: [], burstRanges: [], rasters: [], obwHz: [], inWindow: true })
			pipeline.handle({ kind: "new-stream", stream: 1, centreHz: 433_920_000, sampleRateHz: 250_000, gainKey: "agc", tuningTrust: "unverified" })
			const tracks: TrackSnapshot[] = []
			let sample = 0
			for (const part of [pad(1.0), new Uint8Array(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.length - (bytes.length % 2)), pad(1.0)]) {
				for (let off = 0; off < part.length; off += 8192) {
					const chunk = part.subarray(off, Math.min(part.length, off + 8192))
					for (const ev of pipeline.handle({ kind: "bytes", startSample: sample, bytes: chunk })) if (ev.kind === "track-close") tracks.push(ev.track)
					sample += chunk.length / 2
				}
			}
			const classes = tracks.map(t => classifySpectral(t, { priors: { ism: 1 }, protocols: [] }).class)
			expect(classes, file).not.toContain("tdma-ms")
			if (classes.includes("ook-burst")) ook++
		}
		expect(ook / corpusFiles.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.8)
	}, 120_000)
})
```

### Task 50: Acceptance A1–A8, evidence file, scanner capacity doc

**Spec:** § 16 (A0–A8, preconditions, evidence file), § 9 (estimates), § 10.3–10.5, § 10.8 (A8), § 12, § 15 (metrics), § 14.1. **Depends on:** Tasks 47, 48, 49, 7a and 35a (A8); CHECKPOINT S3 for A2 (A1, A3–A8 need only S1). **Batch:** S4 (hardware, with the user)

Design (bounded to this task): one script, `scripts/scanner/acceptance.mjs`, turns the running core's REST/WS data into the § 16 metrics. Its analysis subcommands also take `--input <file>` (a saved dump), so the computations are unit-tested and every run's raw data is kept beside the evidence. Live subcommands only read the API (the operator's actions—PTT, SDR++ connect, cable pulls—are manual and announced in the checklists). Evidence goes to `output/acceptance/scanner-<date>.json` (gitignored like every acceptance file; private), in the voice-decode file's top-level shape (`test`, `runtime`, `runs`, `review`, `false_positive`) plus `preconditions`, `capacity`, `open`.

Runtime: API `:9000`, live audio `:8081`, digital voice `:8082`, tuner relay `:4713` (docs/HANDOFF-2026-10-10.md). Source ids below use `pi-iq` (Pi over Wi-Fi) and `usb` (local dongle, A7); replace with the local config's ids.
